Semtil’ in Pathenin van le leiset ahinsemtai.
Ahin leiset chu alim le agong bei, twipi thuh tah a ki khang chule achungnga thim pi jingahin, twipi chu Pathen Lhagaovin a-opkhum’ e.
Pathenin, “kho hungvah hen,” atile, ahungvahtai.
Pathenin khovah chu avetle apha lheh jengin, muthim le khovah asep khentai.
Pathenin khovah chu “sun” asah-in, muthimchu “jan” asah-e. Jan akichaijin jingkah ahitan, nikhat alhingtai.
Pathenin, Twipi lah a chun vanthimjol hung kidal hen, Twipi chu alang langa dalten hen, atin;
Vanthimjol ajamdoh-in, twipichu chung le noiya adaltanin asepkhentai.
Twipi daltenna chu Pathenin “vanthamjol” asah-e. Jan akichaiyin jingkah ahitan, ni ni alhingtai.
Pathenin, “vanthimjol noiya twipi mun khat’a veikhom hen, tolgo hung doh hen,” atileh, aseibangin aumtai.
Tolgo lai chu Pathenin, “leiset” asah-in, twipi veikhom chengse chu “twikhanglen” asahtai. Aphatdan chu Pathenin amudohtai.
Pathenin, “leiset’in hampa, amunei hamphung, agathei thing, achi ding amunei cheh, ama amachi dungjui cheh-in hinsepdohhen, leiset chunga kehdohhen,” atileh ahung kehdoh tauve.
Leiset’in hampa ahinsep doh tan, hamphung ama ama chi dungjuiyin akehdoh-in, agathei amunei thingphung achi dungjuiyin ahung kehdoh tauve. Ahoidanchu Pathenin amudoh tai.
Jan akichaiyin jingkah ahitan, nithum alhingtai.
Pathenin, “sun le jan sepkhendin vanthamjol’a avah thei vahho hung kigol’u hen, kum kiheichin kum simtoh nan jong panguhen;
Vanthamjol’a konin leiset hinsalvah-u hen,” atileh, aseibang in aumtauve.
Pathenin vah len cheh ni asemin, nichang chu sun laiyin avahsah-e. Hiti hin ahsi ho jong asemdoh tai.
Pathenin, vah cheng chu leiset salvah ding le
Sun lai le jan laiya vah ding, muthim le khovah sepkhen din vanthamjol’a agoldohtai. Aphatje chu Pathenin amudoh tan ahi.
Jan akichaiyin jingkah ahitan, nili alhingtai.
Pathenin, “twi lah a ahon hona kijot le ding ganhing hiungdimset hen, “atin;
Pathenin twi lah acheng din ganhing lentah tah ho le adang dang ganhing tamtah asemin, akijot le nauva Twi, akidil chet chut jin, chule alha lengthei vachate aloi loiyin asemdoh-e. Aphat dan Pathenin amudoh tai.
Abonchauvin Pathenin phatthei aboh-in, “Hinphauvin, pungun, Twikhanglen le twi lah jouse dimset’uvin, chule vachate jong leiset’a pungu hen,” ati.
Hichun jan akichaiyin jingkah ahitan, ni-nga alhingtai.
Pathenin, “leiset’in ganhinglen le neo, ina vahthei le gamlah alha ding hinsep doh hen,” atileh, asei bangin aumtauve.
Pathenin leiset’a ganhing le sa jouse chule tol’a kithol ganhing jouse aloiloiyin asemdoh-in, avet le apha lheh jenge.
Chujouvin Pathenin, “Eiho lim le mel pun mihem semu hitin, ama ho twi lah anga jouse le chunga vacha te, leiset’a ganhing namkim, ina kivah le gamlah alha ho, alen aneo jouse chunga thunei vaihomin panguhen,” atin;
Ama lim le mel tobangin Pathenin mihem asemin, numei le pasal asemdohtai.
Pathenin ama ni chu phatthei aboh-in, “Chinphan pung lhonin, nason napah lhon leiset hung dimhen, twilah a nga, ju le vachate, leiset chunga ganhing namkim chunga hung vaihomu hen,” ati.
Pathenin, “ven, leiset’a muchi chivo, thingphung gathei jouse naneh lhon din kapen,
Leiset’a sa jouse le vachate, tol’a kithol ganhing ho le adang ho nehdin hamhing kapetai,” atin, hiti chun aumtai.
Hichun Pathenin athilsemsa chengse avet le ahoi behseh jengin pha asai. Hiti hin jan akichaiyin jingkah ahitan, nigup alhing tai.
Hiti hin thilsem pumpi akijousoh tai.
Ni sagi lhinnin Pathenin Athilsem ajousoh-in anatoh acholdotan ahi.
Athilsem aboncha ajosoh a, ni sagi lhinnia acholdo jeh-in hiche nikhohi Pathenin Phatthei aboh-in asuthengtai.
Hitia hi thilsempumpi hung kisemdoh ahi.
Leiset chunga hampa louhing akeh hih laiyin, muchijong adondoh hih laiye. Ajeh chu Pakai Pathenin go ajuh sah hih laiyin, loubol ding mihem jongaum hih laiye.
Leiset’ konjoh chun meijun ajamdoh jin, chutengle leichung ahinle chapkotjie.
Pakai Pathenin leiset alan mihem asemin, anahhom sunga hintheina hu ahailut peh le, mihem chu mihing asohdoh paiten ahi.
Chujouvin Pakai Pathenin niso lam Eden mun’a chun hon khat asemin, hikomma hin amihem sempa chu akoitai.
Honsunga hin vetnomnom thingphung gapha tahtah Pakai Pathenin akesah-in, alailungtah a chun hintheina thingphung le se le pha hetna thingphung jong akeh-e.
Edan honlei chap nou din hnleiya konin vadung khat ahung lhongin, honkal’a lhalka lin alongkhenin, vadung li asohdoh paitai.
Vadung masapen chu pishonahin, Havilah gamkol vel’in alongin,
Hiche gama hin sana theng atamin, samphai chang le songval chang jong akimui.
Vadung nina chu Gihon ahin, Cush gamkol vel’a alongin ahi.
Vadung thumna chu Tigris ahin, Assyria niso lama alongin, chule vadung li lhinna chu Euphrates ahi.
Pakai Pathenin mihempa chu aleibol ding le angah din Edanhonsunga akoitai.
Pakai Pathenin mihempa jah a, “honsunga thingga jouse naneh thei ahinan,
Se le pha hetna thingga vang khu naneh thei louhel dingahi; naneh ni ni le nathi tei tei ding ahi, ati. 18 Pakai Pathenin, “Mihempa achangseh a aum hi anompoi, aki- thopi ding aki- angtopi thei khatsempeh inge,” atin;

Leiset alan Pakai Pathenin sa namkim le vacha jouse asemin, ipi asah ding vetnan mihempa henga abonchan ahin hoiluttai. Hichea hi mihempan aminsah pen pen chu aminu hijeng ahitai.
HIti hin mihempan vacha jouse le sa namkim aminvo chehtan, ahinla khat cha beh jong ama kithopi thei le aki-angtopi thie aumtapoi.
HIjeh chun Pakai Pathenin mihempa chu a-imut milsah-in, a-ihmut lanin anahgu khat aheh lhan, anung chu aphen atonjol’in,
Anahgua kon chun numei khat asemdoh-in, mihempa henga ahinpuilut tai.
Hichun mihempan: “ Hiche hi kagu kachanga kon, Kaphe kavouva kiladoh ahijeh aPasal’a kona kiladoh ahijeh a ‘Numei’ kiti ding ahi.” ati.
Hijeh a chu Pasal’in anu le apa alhakanga aji akol chah joh a, chule ama ni phe khat vou khat hilhonahi.
Hichepet chun mihempa le ajinu asagohkeo ahilhonin, ahivangin akijapi lhonpoi.
Pakai Pathen thilsem ganhinglah a doha thuh pen chu gul ahi. Gul hin numei nu jah a,” Honsunga theiga ho khu naneh lhon louhel dia Pathenin akha mongham?” atile;
Numei nun,” Theiga dang vang kinetheiye;
Honlai lunga vang khu neh jong kaneh thie lhon lou ding, katoh khah lhon jongle kathi tei tei lhondin Pathenin eiseipeh lhon nai, “ati.
Hichun gul’in numienu jah a, Thi lhon hih hel’in nate.
Naneh lhon teng namitlam lhon kikeodoh a Pathen masap’a thilpha thilse nahetdoh lhonding jeh a Pathenin akha ahibouve, “ati.
Thingphung chu numei nu mitvet’ in ahoi lheh jengin, akineh le mi achihsah ding jeh-in jong aducha cheh jenge. Hijeh chun numei nun theiga chu akilon anen, ajipa jong apen, aman jong anetai.
Chutah-in amitlamlhon akikeodoh paiyin, asagohkeoahi ahedoh lhonin, theichang na akilmat mat lhonin kaipelengin akikai lhontai.
Nisa dailhah lamin honlei laiya Pakai Pathen va le husa aja lhonin, mihempa le ajinu hongsung thing lah a akisel lhontai.
Ahivangin Pakai Pathenin, “Vo Adam, hoiya um nahim?” tin ahinkouve.
Mihempan, “Honsunga nahusa kajah le, sagohkeo kahijeh a kichaa kisel kahi, “ati.
Pakai Pathenin, “kon sagohkeo nahi atim? Neh lou dia kisei thingga chu naneh hitanteong?”ati.
Mihempan, “Eilenkhompi dia neipeh numei nu hin thingga chu eipeh a kaneh ahitai,” tin aseiye.
“Ibol’a hitabangpi chu nabol ham?” tia Pakai Pathenin numei nu adoh le, amanun, ‘Gul chun eidohabol’a kaneh hichu me, “ati.
Chuphat’in Pakai Pathenin gul jah a, “Nathilbol jeh a hi gaosap nachan a, ganhing jouse lah atalen namat ding, nahinkho lhumkeiya na-op’a kithol’a leivei naneh ding ahi.
Numei nu to kakidousah a, ama chilhah le nang chilhah kigal to ding ahi. Ama chilhah pan nalu avoh chip’a, nangin akhotaljum nachuhpeh ding ahi.”ati.
Pakai Pathenin numei nu jah a, “Na-naovop teng gim gentheiyanaum a, nat hahsa thot acha nahinding ahi. Hijongle najipa jeng lhangaiya nahin’a aman nachunga vai ahom ding ahi, “ati.
Mihempa jah aPakai Pathenin, “Naji nu thua nanun aneh lou dia kaseipeh thiega na neh jeh a leiset jeng jong hi gaosap chang ahitai. Nahinkho lhumkeiya tohgim genthei puma tol natuh a neh ding nakihol ding ahi.
Nakidoupi din leiset’a theimi ling le meithai seltho ling hung keh-in tin, chule tollhanga anche louhing naneh ding ahi.
Nakisemdohna leiset”a nakile kit kah a, namaiya ulsa long longa na natohgim a’neh le chah nakihol ding ahi. Leivuiya kisemdoh nahin, Leivui nalesokit ding ahi, “ati.
Mihem nankim penna nu ahiphat’in Adamin ajinu chu amin Eve asah-e.
Pakai Pathenin mihempa le ajinu din savun ponsil asemin asilpehtai.
Pakai Pathenin, “Mihemhi ilah-uva khat bangin thilpha thilse hethieyin aumtan, hichea hi hinna thiega khu neh khahsah atonsot’a hinsah louhel ding ahi,” ati.
Hijeh chun akisemdohna leiset loubol’a kivah din mihempa chu Pakai Pathenin Edan honna konin asoldoh tai.
Hinna thingphung lampi ngah din hon niso lama Vantil lhanei chu akoiyin, chemjam deuje ju chu akipei kimvelsah tai.
Adamin ajinu Eve akitimetpin, amanu agaiyin chapa khat ahinge; “Pakai panpi jal’a achapa kahin,” tin amin Cain asah-e.
Chujouvin asopipa Abel ahing kit’in ahi. Abel chu kelngoi chingin apangin, Cain chu loubol’in apange.
Khongnungin Cain chun alhosoh gan Pakaiya kilhaina abol’in,
Abel’ in jong akelngoi peng masapen, athaopen khat athat’in, kilhai nananeiye. Hichea hin Abel kilhaina chunga Pakai alung lhaiyin, athilbol asanpeh tai.
Cain thilto vangchu asangpon, ama jong akhohsahtapoi. Cain alunghang behseh-in akaiku jenge.
Pakaiyin Cain jaha, “Ibol’a lunghanga kaiku jeng nahim?
Thildih bol le chun kipah ding nahin, thilse nabol jeh-in chonsetnan kotphunga nachang lhi jinge; jotho dia nagot vangin, nangin najotei ding ahinai,” ati.
Cain chun asopipa Abel jah a, “Gamlah a che hite, “atin; gamlah agei lhon phat’in Cain asopipa chunga achun athattai.
Hichejeh hin, “Nasopipa Abel la em?” tin Pakaiyin Cain ahindongtai. Aman, “Kei kasopipa ching gun set ka hi ong?” ati.
Pakaiyin, “Ibol’a nahim? Tol’ a kona naopipa thisanin eihinsap sap khu me’.
Hiche leiset hi pohkhia nasopipa thisan achop lut tah jeh hin, nang jong gaosap chang nahitan, leiset jeng jong hi lou va na bol thei lou ding ahitai.
Muchi tujongle chun hung kehdoh louhelding, chen mun det beiya leiset chunga vah thai ding beiya leiset chunga vah thai ding nahitai” ati.
Chuphat’in Cain chun Pakai jah a, “Neipeh talen hi alen behseh tan kapoh jouhoi ahitapoi.
Na- angsunga kona neisoldoh a, chenmun det beiya leiset’a kavah thai le ding, eitoh khapen penin eitha ding ahitai,” ati.
Ahinla Pakaiyin, “Chutiponte, Cain hinthat pen pen chunga sagi vei phuki la ding ahi,” atin; atoh kha khan atha louhel na din Cain chalpanga melchihna khat akoi-peh e.
Pakai angsunga konin Cain apotdoh-in, Eden solam gamkai, “Vahthai gam” sunga achengtai.
Cain ajinu akitimatpi le agaiyin, chapa khat ahingin, Enoch asah-e. Cain chun khopi khat asemdoh-in achapamin aputsah -in, Enoch asah-in ahi.
Enoch chun Irad ahingin, Irad-in Mahuja-el ahingin, Mahuja-el chun Methusha-el ahingin, Methusha-el ‘in Lemech ahinge.
Lemech chun ji ni akop, in Khatnu Adah ahin, khatjonu Zillah ahi.
Adah hin Jabal ahingin, Jabal hi ponbuh achengte le gancha ching miho penna pa ahunghi.
Jabal sopipa chu Jubal ahin, semjang saite le theile mutte chengse penna pa ahung hikhai.
Zillah hin Tubal Cain ahingin, amahin sum-eng manchah ding alhan, thih khengin apange; Tubal Cain sopinu chu Naamah ahi.
Lamech chun ajite nijah a, “Adah le Zillah kasei ngai lhonin, Vo Lamech jie ni kisei hi melchih lhontan; Gollhang khat’in eiden jeh-in kathat tai.
Cain tha jeh a sagi vei phu aki lah ding le Lamech tha jeh a som sagi le sagi vei phukila ding ahi,” ati.
Adamin ajinu akitimatpi kit le cha pa khat ahing kit’in, “Cain thapa Abel khel’a chi khai din Pathenin chapa khat eipekit tai,” tin anun amin Seth asah -e.
Seth-in chapa khat ahingin Enoch asah-e. Ama khanglaiya pat hin min ‘Pakai’ minin chibai ahinboh pantai.
Pathenin Ama lim ma bang banga asem mihem- Adam khanggui thusim chu hiti ahi.
Numei le pasal asemin, phatthei aboh-in, amin jong ‘Mihem’ asah tai.
Adam kum ja khat le somthum alhinin ama lim le melto kilo tah chapa khat ahingin, Seth asah-e.
Seth pen nungin Adam kum jaget ahinben, chanu chapa tampi ahingin,
Kum jako le somthum lhin kumin athitai.
Seth kum jakhat le nga ahin Enosh ahingin,
Enosh pen nungin Seth kum jaget le sagi ahinben, chanu chapa tampi ahingin,
Kum jako le som le ni alhin kumin athitai
Enosh kum somko ahin kenan ahingin,
kenan pen nungin Enosh kum jaget le som le nga ahinben chanu chapa tam pi ahingin,
Kum jako le nga lhin kumin athi.
Kenan kum som sagi ahin Mahalalel ahingin,
Mahalalel pen nungin Kenan kum jaget le som li ahinben, chanu chapa tampi ahingin,
Kumjako le som khat lhin kumin athi.
Mahalalel kum somgup le nga ahin Jared ahingin,
Jared pen nungin kum jaget kum jaget le somthum ahinben, chanu chapa tampi ahingin,
Kum jaget le somko le nga lhin kumin athi.
Jared kum jakhat le somgup le ni ahin Enoch ahingin,
Enoch pen nungin Jared kum jaget ahinben, chanu chapa tampi ahingin,
Kum jako le somgup le ni lhin kumin athitai.
Enoch kum som gup le nga ahin Methuselah ahingin,
Methuselah pen nungin kum jathum jen Pathen to akivop jingin, chanu chapa tampi ahinben,
Kum jathum le somgup le nga lhingin ahinge.
Enoch ahinkho lhumkeiyin Pathento akivop jingin, Pathenin ahing laiya alah phat’iin akiholmotai.
Methuselah kum jakhat le somget le sagi ahin Lamech ahingin,
Lamech pennungin Methuselah kum ja sagi le somget le ni ahinben, chanu chapa tampi ahingin,
Kum jako le somgup leko lhin kumin athi.
Leamech kum jakhat le somget le ni ahin chapa khat ahingin,
“Pathen gaosapsa, ikhut’ uva itoh gim nau hiche leiset’a kona hi hiche naosen hin eitha-ol sah diu ahi,” tinan amin Noah asah-e.
Noah pen nungin Lamech kum janga le somko le nga ahinben, cha tampi ahingin,
Kum ja sagi le som sagi le sagi lhin kumin athitai.

Leiset chunga mihem hapunin apungin, cha le nao tampi ahing tauve.

kong innei chu inchung nakhua, alhung khu tongkhat bou len ding, kong kotpi asih lama nahon a, lhong danthuma nadoa, achungnungpen, aban’a chule anoinungpen nado ding;

Vacha jat a konin kop sagi cheh leiset’a achikhai din kong sunga kai lut’in.
Ni sagi lhinteng nisom le jan som li sunga go kajuh sah-a, kasemsa ahing thei jouse kasuh mang hel ding ahitai,” ati.

Leiset chunga twisanglet chun Noah kum jagup alhingtai.
Twisanglet’a hoidoh na din Noah le ajinu, achapte le ajiteu kong sunga alut tauve.

ni nin Noah to kong sunga akijot lut tauve.
Ni sagi jouvin leiset’a twisang alentai.

Anu khat achal khat cheh, Pathenin Noah to akijot lut tauve. Noah alut phat’in Pakaiyin kongkot akhah tai.
nisom li le jan som li sungin leiset’a go ajun, twi apomtou tel tul’in Leiset sanga sang jon kong alet doh tai.
Leiset chung twi adimtel tul jengin, along matsoh tan, kong jong twi chunga akitol le lei.
Twi atamval’in van noiya molsang jouse geiyin achupsoh tai.
Twi chu akhang tou tou nalaiyin, molsang jouse sangin tongsom le ngan asangjoi.

Tolgoa cheng ganhing nah hai thei jouse athisoh tauve.
Leiset’a hing thei mihem le ganhing namkim, ju le va, tol’a kithol ho le chunga leng jouse Pakaiyin asugamin, Noah le kong sunga aumpi chengse chubou asoh chauve.
Ni jakhat le som nga sung geiyin twi akemsuh hih laiye.
Noah le kong sunga aumpi ganhing chengse Pathenin agel khoh jingin, Leiset chunga hui anun sah le twi akemsuh pantai.
Twinah jouse le van’a go-kot chengse akikhah-in, go ahaiyin kho aphan,
Ni jakhat le som nga sungin leiset’a twi akang hei hoitai.
Lha sagi lhin na, nisom le ni sagi lhin nin Ararat lhanga molvum khat’a kong aki-ngamtai.
Twi vang akemsuh jing jengin, lha som lhinna, ni masapen nin molvum jouse akimu theitai.

va-ah khat alha leh, leiset’a twi akanloulai jeh-in adung avaiyin alenglenahung kile kit tai.
Twi kan le kan lou hetnan Noah-in vakhu khat alha kit leh,
Leiset pumpi twiyin achup nah laijeh-in vakhu chun touna ding aholmon kong lama ahung kile kit;in, Noah-in agahsang lhan kong sunga achoilut tai.
Noah ni sagi akho ngaiyin, vakhu chu alha kit leh,
Nilhah lamin vakhuchun amuh a olive thing nathah khat ahinpon, ahenga ahung kile kit’e. Hichea hin Noah-in leiset’a twi kan ahe-tai.
Noah-in ni sagi ma a-ngah -in vakhu chu alhadoh kit leh, hichea vang hin vakhu chu ahenga ahung kile kit tapoi.
Noah kum jagup le khat (601) lhin kum, lha masapen, ni masa nin leiset’a twi akangsoh-in, Noah-inkong in chung khu ahodoh aavet leh, leiset chung twi akangsoh heltai.
Lha ni na nisom ni le sagi lhin nin leiset chung twi akang goheltan ahi.
Pathenin Noah jah a,
“Najinu le nachapate chule ajiteu toh kong sunga konin potdoh tauvin.
Naumpi ganhing namkim-ju le va, tol’a vah tahsaa hing jouse, apunjal’uva leiset adimsetna diuvin hinkai doh tan,” ati.
Hijeh chun konga konin Noah le ajinu, achapate le ajiteu apotdoh tauve.
Ganhing ho jong, tol’a kithol ho le vachate, leiset’a lhale jouse kong sunga konin akop kop’in ahung potdoh tauve.
Noah-in Pakai din maicham khat asemin, gancha theng le vacha theng lah akonin khat cheh adongkhomin, maichamphunga pumgo thilton agouvamtai.
Amuinam chun Pakai alung lhiayin alung sunga, “Aneocha pat mihem lungthim hi asesa kahet jeh-in, mihem thilse bol man a tukal leiset hi kagaosap kit lou hel ding ahitai. Tua kasuhgam banghin ganhing ho jong sumang ta ponge.
Leiset aum laisea muchi tuphat, lho lhun phat, gamsat le gamdap phat, nipi laile phalbi lai chule sun le jan um jing ding ahi,” ati.










Itih hijongle ganhing namkim twiya kisumang talouding, a-itih geiya jong twisanglenin leiset asuhmang lou ding ahitai.
Nangho le ganhing namkim dinga mantih neilou kitepna kaphudoh het jingnan,
Meilhang lah a kathalpi kakoiye; hiche hi vannoito kakitep het jingna hiding ahi.
Vanthamjol’a meilhang kajinsah teng thalpi chu kimudoh ding,
Chule ganhing namkim-ahing jouse twilenin asuhmang louna dia nahenguva kakitepna kageldohji dingahi.
Hitia chu meilhang lah athalpi ahung kilah teng, leiset chunga ganhing jouse le kei kah a mantin neilou kitepna chu kageldoh ding ahi.
Thalpi hi ganhing namkim to kakitepna malchihna ahi,” ati.
Kong sunga hung potdoh Noah chapate chu Shem, Ham chule Japheth ahiuvin, Ham hi Canaan pa ahi.
Hiche Noah chapa thum ho hi leiset chung cheng mihem chitin namtin penna pului ahitauve.
Noah hi loubol mi ahin, leiset’a lengpilei bol masapenin apange.
Noah-in lengpitwi adon le akhamin, aponbuh sunga del cheng louvin alumtai.
Canaan pa Hamin apa Noah del cheng louva lum amun, polama asopite ni agaseipeh-e.
Shem le Japhet-in ponsilchol khat ala lhonin, alengkouva akhai lhonin, apa del chenglouva um chu mu lounadin akihei mangin, anunglam ngan pnonbuh sunga atoi lut lhonin, apa lhon chu agakhu khum lhone.
Noah lengpitwi kham alimdoh phat’in achapa neopenin abolna chu ahedoh-in,
Hijeh chun, “Canaan hi gaosap chang hen, Asopite nin soh-in nei lhon hen.
Pakai, Shem Pathen vang vahchoiyin umhen, Shemin Canaan hi soh-in hinneihen.
Pathenin Japheth punsah hen, Achilhahte Shem chilhahto hung chengkhomu hen; Canaan vang Japheth soh-in hung pang hen,” ati.
Twisanglet nungin Noah kum jathum le som nga ahing nalaiyin,
Kum jako le som nga lhin kumin athi.
Noah chapate Shem, Ham chule Japheth chilhah ho khanggui thusim chu, twisanglet nungin athum’uvin chapa tampi ahing cheh-ui.
Japheth chapate chu Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech chule Tiras ahiuve.
Gomer chapate chu Ashkenaz, Riphath chule Togarmah ahiuve.
Javan chapate chu Elishah, Spain, Cyprus chule Rhodes ahiuvin;
Twikhanglen pang dunga hung cheng ho penna pului ahiuve. Hicheng hi Japheth chilhah ahiuvin, aphung phungin agamkai sung cheh a akichen’uvin, ama pao cheh akithouve.
Ham chapate chu Cush, Egypt, Libya chule Canaan ahiuve.
Cush chapate chu Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah chule Sabteca ahiiuve. Raamah chapate ni chu Sheba le Dedan ahi.
Cush-in Nimrod kiti chapa khat ahingin, leiset’a gal-hat masapenin apange.
Pakai panpi jal’in Nimrod hi sathat thei tah ahin, hijeh chun mihon, “Nimrod bangin Pakaiyin sathat thei nahisah hen,” akitijiuve.
Nimrod lenggam chun Babylon, Erech chule Accad, Babylon gamsunga um chengse ahopsoh keiye.
Hiche gama kon hin Nimrod Assyria gama achen, Nineveh khopi, Rehoboth Ir khopi, Calah khopi,
chule Nineveh khopi le khopi minthang tah Calah kikah a Resen khopi aphutdoh-e.
Egypt chapate chu Lydi, Anam, Lehab, Naphtuh,
Pathrus, Casluh chule Caphtor ahin, Caphtor hi Philistine mite penna pului ahi.
Canaan chapate chu amasan apeng masapen Sidon le Heth ahi lhonin,
chule Canaan chilhah chu Jebus mite, Amor mite, Girgash mite,
Hiv mite, Ark mite, Sin mite,
Arvad mite, Zemar mite le Hamath mite ahiuve. Khonung in Canaan insung kon chengse gamtin’a akithe chan soh keiyun,
agamgiu Sidon a pat Gerar lang jonin Gaza geiyin akilhung lut peh-in, Sodom lang jonin akilhungin, Gomorrah aphan, Admah ahinphan, chuin Zeboiim ahopan Lasha geiyin akilhung lut peh-e.
Hicheng hi Ham chihlhah ahiuvin, aphung phungin agamkai sung cheh a achengun, ama pao cheh akithouve.
Japheth upa Shem chu Hebrew mite penna pului ahi.
Shem chapate chu Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud chule Aram ahiuve.
Aram chapate chu Uz, Hul, Gether chule Meshkek ahiuve.
Arpachshad chapa chu Shelah ahin, Shelah chapa Eber ahi.
Eber hin chapa ni ahingin, khatpa khanga hi leiset mite paocheh jeh a akikhen jeh-un amin Peleg akitin, khatjo pa chu Jokatan ahi.
Joktan chapate chu Almodad, Shelph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
Hardoram, Uzal, Diklah,
Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
Ophir, Havilah, chule Jobab ahiuvin, abonchauva Joktan chapa jeng ahiuve.
Joktan chapate gamgi chu Mesha a pat Sephar lang jonin solam thing lhang gamsung geiyin akilhung lutpeh-e.
Hicheng hi Shem chilhah ahiuvin, aphung phungin agakai sung cheh a achengun, apao cheh akithouve.
Hiche miho hi ama ama jat dungjui le akondoh nau insung dungjuiya kisimtoh Noah insung kon cheh ahivin, twisanglet nunga leiset chung mihem hijat hi amahoa kondoh jeng ahiuve.
Hiche laichun leiset miten paokhat seh athon, thu cheng jong tha khat amanguve.
Mihemte chu niso lama akitol leu leh Babylon gama phaicham khat’a ahung lut’uvin, hikoma chun achengtauve.
Amaho khat le khat akihouvun,” Hungun, cheh dengu hitin goutah lhengu hite,” atiuvin; song panna pangdin cheh adenguvin, song lou din leingan amangui.
Mihon,” khopi khat semu hitin, insang, atingvum vanto kibang khat sau hitin imin kithansah-u hite, achutiloule leiset chunga ikimoh thethang gam diu ahi,” atiuve.
Mihemte khopi sem le insang sah chu vedin Pakai ahung kum lhai.
Hichea hin Pakaiyin, “Mihemte hijat khat bou ahin, pao khatseh bou athouve; athilbol’u hi tua bana aboldiu apatna bou ahinalaiyin, tukal abolnom nom abol jeng diu dol ahitai’
Kum lhau hitin apaovu gasucheh leu hen khat le khat kihou mon um’uvin tin atohban haitauvinte,” ati.
Hitia hi Pakaiyin miho chu leiset chunga ahtecheh soh phat’in akhopi sah ban ahaitauve.
Hikoma kona hi Pakaiyin mihemte pao asuh cheh a, leiset chunga athe chehsoh hel jeh-in akhopi min Babylon akisah lot tai.
Shem chilhah ho thusim hiti ahi. Twisanglet nung kum ni lhin kum, Shem kum jakhat ahin achapa Arpachshad ahinge.
Arpachshad pen nungin Shem kum ja nga ahingin, chadang tampi ahinbei.
Arpachshad kum somthum le nga alhinin achapa Shelah ahingin,
Shelah pen nungin Arpachshad kum ja li le thum ahingin, chadang tampi ahinbei.
Shelah kum somthum alhinin achapa Eber ahingin,
Eber pen nungin Shelah kum ja li le thum ahing nalaiyin, chadang tampi ahinbei.
Eber kum somthum le li alhinin achapa Peleg ahingin,
Peleg pen nungin Eber kum ja li le somthum ahing nalaiyin, chadang tampi jong ahinbei.
Peleg kum somthum alhinin achapa Reu ahingin,
Reu pen nungin Peleg kum ja ni le ko ahing nalaiyin, chadang tampi jong ahinbei.
Reu kum somthum le ni alhinin achapa Serug ahingin,
Serug pen nungin Reu kum ja ni le sagi ahing nalaiyin, chadang tampi jong ahinbei.
Serug kum somthum alhinin achapa Nahor ahingin,
Nahor pen nungin Serug kum ja ni ahing nalaiyin, cha dang tampi jong ahinbei.
Nahor kum som ni le ko alhinin achapa Terah ahingin,
Terah pen nungin Nahor kum jakhat le som le ko ahing nalaiyin, chadang tampi jong ahinbei.
Terah kum som sagi alhinin Abram le Nahor chule Haran ahinge.
Terah chilhah ho khanggui chu hiti ahi; Terah-in Abram le Nhor chule Haran ahingin ahi. Haran hin Lot ahinjou,
Apa Terah hinpet’ in Babylon gamsung achena khopi Ur a athitai.
Abramin Sarai akichenpin. Nahorin Haran chunu Milcah akichenpi: Haran hin Iscah jong ahingin ahi.
Sarai achingin cha neilouvin aumtai.
Terah hin achapa Abram le amou nu Sarai-Abram jinu, atupa Lot-Hanran chapa akipuiyin, Babylon gama Ur khopi dalhan Canaan gam jonin achetauve. Amahon Haran ahinphauvin, hikoma chun achengtauve.
Haran a chun Terah kum ja ni le nga alhinin athitai.
Pathenin Abram jah a, “Nagam leiset le na phung na chang, na- insung mite dalhan, keiman kavetsah got gam jonin chen.
Keiman nachilhah tampi kahisah a, nam lentah kaso ding, phatthei kaboh a min thang tah a ka koi ding, chu teng nangma phatthei bom nihi ding ahi.
Nangma phatthei na boh te phatthei kaboh a, Nagaosap jouse kagaosap thuh ding; Nang jeh achitin namtin phatthei kaboh ding ahi,” ati.
Abram kum som sagi le nga ahin, Pakaiyin aseipeh bangin, Haran akonin akipatdoh- in, Lot chun akilhonpi.
Abramin ajinu Sarai le asopipa cha Lot akipuiyin, Haran a alamdoh goujouse pon, soh chengse to kilhonin Canaan gam jonin achatauve. Canaan gam ahung lhun phat’ un,
Shechem muntheng lai, Moreh muna gangpi theng phung ahinphah kahsen Abramin gamsung chu akhol khol jenge. Hichepet hin gamsunga Canaan miho anachenguve.
Abram henga Pakai ahungkilah-in ajaha,” Nason nachilhahte kapehgot gam chu hiche hi ahi,” ati. Hichun ahenga hung kilah Pakai din Abramin maicham phung khat hikoma chun asemdoh tai.
Chujouvin Bethel khopi nisolam, lhanglam thinglhang gam manon Abram achen, nilhum lama Bethel le niso lama Ai kikah a ngahmun akisemtai. Hikoma jong hin maicham khat asemin Pakai minin ataove.
Hiti hin Abram muntin’a avah len, Canaan gamsung lhanglam gamkai sung ajontai.
Canaan gamsunga kel lhah jeh a ahhsat behseh phat’ in Abram puhsuiya khopem din Egypt gam jonin achesuh-e.
Egypt gamsung alut ding konin Abramin ajinu Sarai jah a,” Veteh, mitvet’a numei mel-hoi tah nahi kahei.
Egypt miten namu tengu keiji nahi heuvintin, kei eithauva, nang nakihoi diu ahi.
Nang jeh a eihing hoijuva eibol phatna diuvin kei naovin kiseiyin,” ati.
Abram Egypt gamsung alut phat’ in Egypt mite mitvet’ in jong ajinu chu numei mel- hoitah ahi nget’e.
Pharaoh leng chapaten amudoh-un, Sarai mel- hoi dan lengpa jah a aseiyui; hijeh chun Sarai chu leng inpia apuilut tauve.
Sarai jal’ in lengpan Abram abol phan, kelngoi hon, kelchate, bong hon, sa-ngante, soh le kol chule sangonsao tampi apei.
Ahinla lengpan Abram jinu Sarai akipuijeh-in, Pakaiyin lengpa chung le a-insung mite chunga nat khoh tah alansah tai.
Hichun Pharoah- in Abram agakousah-in ajah a, “Idia hita neibol ham? Hiche nu naji hitaa idia naseida ham?
Ibol’ a nanao ahi na tia, jia naipuisah mongham? Hin hin naji hi, kipuiyin potdoh loiyin.” tin anotai.
Pharaoh-in amite aseipeh-in, amahon Abram le ajinu chule athil keo alokeo pumin gamsunga konin akaidoh tauve.
Abramin ajinu akipuiyin, anei jouse apon, Lot to kilhonin, Egypt’ a konin Canaan lhanglam jonin achetai.
Abramin kelngoi le kelcha, bong chule sana dangka tampi aneiyinmihao tah ahitan ahi.
Canaan lhanglam gamkaiya konin akholjin len, muntin achonin, Bethel lang ahinjon’e. Masanga ngahmun asemna Bethel le Ai kikah ahinphan,
Masanga maicham asemna muna chun Pakai min ataove.
Lot’ in jong atumtah-in kelngoi le kelcha chule bong tampi le soh tampi aneiyin, a-insung mite toh ahiuve.
Abram le Lot’ in gancha tamtah gel anei lhon phat’in, ganchate neh ding gam aneo behseh tan acheng khom thei lhon tapoi.
Abram gancha ching ho le Lot gancha ching ho akinahso tauvin, akitohmo tauve. hichepet hin Canaan gamsunga Canaan mite le Periz mite acheng nalaiyui.
Abramin Lot jah a, “Insung khat kihi, namite le kamite kina thei pouvinte.
Kikhenta hite. Na- angsunga gam ongmo ngap lou, nadei dei lai kilhenin; jetlam nalhen le veilama cheng ting, veilam nalhen le kei jetlama chenge,” ati.
Lot akhodaa avet leh, Jordan phaicham pumpi, Zoar geiyin agah mun, twi atha lhingin, Pakai honsung le Egypt gamsung abang jengin ahi. Hichepet”a chu Pakaiyin Sodom le Gomorrah asuhmang loulai ahi.
Hi jeh chun Lot’ in Jordan phaicham pumpi akilhenin, nisolam jonin akitoldoh tai. Hitia cuh Abram le Lot kikhen ahilhon’e.
Abram Canaan gama acheng denin, Lot chu Jordan phaichama khopi ho lah a chun apansan, Sodom koma ngahmun asem’e;
Sodom kho mite chu a- engseuvin, Pakai dounan achonseuve.
Lot’in adalhah nungin Pakaiyin Abram jah a,” Nadin mun laitah akonin najet navei, sah le lhang vegolsoh keiyin;
Gam hitepi nang le nason napah kapeh ding, tonsot’a nagamu hiding ahi.
Nason nachilhah hapuna kapunsah ding, tam behseh jenguva leivui jat pha diu koman asim jou lou ding ahi.’
Keiman agam pumpia kapeh tah ding jeh-in, kipatdoh-in abonchan gakholsoh keiyin,” ati.
Chuphat’in Abram jong achen, Hebron a Mamre thingphung theng ho koma chun apansan, hikoma chun Pakai din maicham khat asemtai.
Hiche lai hin Babylon lengpa Amraphel le Ellasar lengpa Arioch, Elam lengpa Chaedorlaomer le Goiim lengpa Tidal
Akon’ uvin Sodom leng pa Bera le Gomorrah lengpa Birsha, Admah lengpa Shinah le Zeboiim lengpa Shemeber chule Bela ahiloule Boar lengpa chunga gal agabol tauve.
Tulaiya Twikhanglen thisa, Siddim phaichama hiche leng nga ho hi anapangkhom’ uve.
Kum somle ni sungin leng nga h hi Chedorlaomer lengpa noiya alut lo tauvin, nah nha- in kum som le thum kumin ahindou pan thie bep’ ui.
Ahin la kum som le li lhin kumin Chedorlaomer le apanpi leng ho ahung kon’ uvin, Ashteroth Karnaim a Rephaim mite ajouvun, Ham mun’ a Zuzim mite ajouvun,
Edom molsang lhanga Hor mite ajouvun, nelgam pamchim a Elparan geiyin agadel jampeh-uve.
Chua konin ahung kile kit’ uvin, masanga ‘Enmishpat kiti, tulai Kadesh mun akhun ahunguve. Hikoma hin Hazazon Tamar a cheng, Amor mite le Amalek mite ajouvun agam pumpi alauve.
Hichun Sodom le Gomorrah, Admah, Zeboiim chule Bela leng ho akikhom’ un Siddim phaiya galbol din akigotauve.
Leng nga hin Elam le Goiim, Babylon, Ellasal- leng li dou din agouve.
Siddim phai hi bon- ngan bol adimset’ in, Sodom le Gomorrah lengpa galmun’ a kona ajam lhon le bolsunga alha lut lhontan, leng dang thum vang chu molsang lama ajamdoh tauve.
Leng li honSodom le Gomorrah khopi sunga thilkeo ijakai, anneh geiyin akichom’ un achetauve.
Amahon Sodom khoa cheng, Abram sopipa chapa, Lot jong gal- hingin akaiyui, athilkeo jouse jong akipoh thauve.
Gal’ a hung jamdoh mi khat’ in thilsoh chengse hi Hebrew mi Abram jah a ahung seitai. Hichepet hin Abram hi Amor mi Mamre thingphung theng ho koma anachenge. Mamre’n sopi Eshcol le Aner aneiyin- Abram to pangkhom cheh ahiuve.
Asopipa chapa min gal- hinga akaimang jeng ajah phat’ in Abramin ainsung mi galbol thei cheh akhop le, jathum le som le get alhingun, ama lamkai nan leng li ho chu Dan geiyin agadel peh-ui.
Abramin asepaite chu aloi loiyin ahomkhenin, agalte chu janlaiyin anokhumin ajoutai, chu leDamascus sah lam, Hobah geiyin agadel jampeh-uve.

Chedorlaomer le leng dang ho agajao ahung kile kit chun ‘ lengpa phaicham’ kisah Shaveh phaiya Sodom lengpan Abram analamtoi.
