










































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































Persia gam munpi Susa khopi laltouna muna konin lengpa Xerxes hin India gam a pat Sudan gei,
gam ja khat le somni le sagi chunga vai ahom’e.
Alengvaipoh kal kumthum nan avaipote le vaihom chengse to nehkhom golvah abol’e. Golvahnaa hin Persia le Media gamhop sung sepaite le gamvaipote, milen milalte, akimsoh keiyui.
Lhagup lhungkeiyin lengpan lenggam haosatna le aloupi minthanje avetsah-e.
Ijakai avtsah soh phat’in, Susa tolpi sung mite din lengpan golvah chom khat bol’in, mihao mivai akousoh keiye. Golvah chu leng inpi hohnsunga hapta khat sungin abol’uve.
Leng inpi leitol chu pondum le ponkang adal khum’un, songval khom kiphut hoa chun tupat ponnemin dangka kol’a kitom abol-hom dunga akanbehuve. Leitol pumpia chun touna din sana le dangka kisem jeng akidon, song mantam, akang le asan, songval vahsel jeng, chule a-eng thipjet’in akitomjolsoj hel’e.
Donthei donna khon jouse sana jeng ahin, chule khon khat le khat kilo lou, lengpan leng inpi sung juneng jel’in ahom’e.
Judon tan phat umlou, lhacha ho chu min aduchan a donthei dia lengpan thu apehsah ahi.
Hiche sung hin leng inpi sunga lengnu Vashtin numeite din golvah abol’e.
Golvah vol kal ni sagi nin lengpan ju adonva set’in lung nomsel’in aumin, sole lhacha, nukiso sagi-Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar chule Carkas akoulut’in,
Lengnu Vashtin lallukhuh puma akimupi ding agakousah tai. Lengnu hi numei hoitah ahin, lengpan avaipote le maljin ho chu amel-hoi vetsah agot ahi.
Solle hon lengpa thupeh lengnu Vashti koma aseipeh-ule, ahung nompoi. Hijeh hin lengpa alung hang hangtai.
Umchan chondan thudol’a thuh le phah hethem ho doh hi lengpa umdol khat ahin, hijeh chun lengnu i-loa pha ding dol doh toh-din thumop themho akouve.
Lengpan thu adohnom miho chu-Carshenam Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, chule Memucan ahiuvin, Persia le Media leng gamsunga vaipo thunei chungnung pen vaipo cheh sagi ahiuve.
Hiche ho jah a hin lengpan, “Lengpa Xerxes ken, Vashti lengnu kouva sole kasol le, kathu angaipoi! I-ilo diuva danthun aseiyam?” tin adonge.
Hichun Memucan hin lengpa le avaipote koma-“Lengnu Vashti hin lengpa keo noi lhah louva, avaipote geiya einoi lhah-u ahitai; tahbeh-in gamsunga pasal jouse jong anoi lhah ahi!
Lengnu thilbol ja masa numei tinin jipa noisena aneithu thu diu ahi. Numeihon, ‘Lengpa Xerxes-in bon lengnu Vasti kouva, koudoh jou lou,’ ati diu ahi.
Persia le Media leng inpia vaipote lengnu kisah hi ajahdoh tengu, nilhum masanga ajiteu houna aneipai diu ahitai. Chuteng muntin a numei hon ajabol lou diu, pasal jouse ajite chunga lung hang ding ahiuve.
Lengpan nadei dingle, lengpa masanga Vasti hung kilah kit louhel din thuphon khat kiso jengle phante. Khel kit thei louhel dia Persia le Media danthua jih lut dia thu napeh din aphai. Chule lengnu khel’in numei hoijo khat lhengdoh le chun ahijenge.
Hiche thupeh phondohna hilenggam lentah sunga akihetsah soh hel teng, hao hen vai jongle pasal jouse ajiten ajabol cheh diu ahi,” ati.
Lengpa le avaipoten thu kiseidoh chu pha asauvin, Memucan seibangin lengpan aboltai.
Leng gamhop sunga gamkai tin a, apaovu le lekhajem cheh-in hiche thuphon chu ajihdoh-un, pasal jouse hi a-insunga apua pang, aman thu chaina asei dingin alhahsah tai.
Lengpa alungdam nung geiyin jong Vashti chonchan, chule adouna thupondoh abol chu agel jing nalaiye.
Lengpa kinaipi, thumop phabep’in akoma, “Lengpan nu-ngah thah mel-hoi tah nahol’a phalou ham?
Lenggam sunga gamkai vaipoten nu-ngah mel-hoi lai jouse, hikom munpi lai, Susa khopi leng inpia ahinpui diuvin seipeh-in, Nu-ngah jouse chu numeite vetup’a nakoi, nukiso Hegai noiya umsah-in, abonchauvin kisemhoisah phat pen.
Chuteng nu-ngah hoipen chu Vashti khel’in lengnun pansah-in,” atiuve. Aseiyu hi lengpan thilphan agel’in aboltai.
Susa khopi a chun Juda mi Jair chapa Mordecai achenge. Mordecai hi Benjamin phunga mi, Kish le Shimei son ahi.
Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzarin Judah lengpa Jehoiachin le sohchang dang Jerusalema kona akaimang chun alah-uva Mordecai jong apange.
Mordecai hin asopite chanu khat achanu banga akisem, Hebrew paova amin Hadassah kiti Esther, nu-ngah mel-hoi tah le gongso hoitah khat aneiye. Anule apa thi phat’a mordecai hin achanu bang banga avopdoh ahi.
Lengpan nu-ngah jouse khop dia thuphondoh abol phat’in, Susa khopia nu-ngah ahinpuilut nauva Esther jong apangkhai. Esther jong leng inpia, leng numeiho in vaipo Hegai thu noiya akoitauve.
Hegaiyin Esther adeiyin, Eshterin jong hegai along lhaisah lheh-e. Hegaiyin man gangtah-in Esther semhoina ding le atahsa thaosah lai din na atongpanin, neh le chah pha pha apetai. Esther chu leng inpi numeiho umnaa mun nompen apen, akibol din leng inpia numei sagi jen apansah tai.
Mordecaiyin ahilchah masah jen-in, Estherin Judah mi ahi chu aseidoh poi.
Niseh le Esther chu itobanga, achunga ipi soh ding ti hetdoh gon, Mordecai chu leng inpi numeiho umna maiya adung avaiyin achelejie.
Numei semhoina phat chu angaiya kum khat ahin, lhagup ma myrrh kinua tahsa mehnou chet ding, chule balsam thao nu na lhagup ma lutbe ding ahi.Hichengse akichaisoh hel teng nu-ngahho chu khat khat a lengpa Xerxes anga puilut ding ahi.
Numei inpia pat leng inpi ajot teng nu-ngah chun ipi hijongle adei dei akivon ding ahi.
Nilhah teng lengpa henga lut ding, jingkah teng numei inpi chom khat’a apuilut’uva, lengpa thaikemho vaipo, nukiso Shaashgaz noiya um ding ahi. Hiche a lutsa chu lengpan adeiya amin a akou kit loule lengpa koma lut kit lou ding ahitai.
Amupha chan seiphat, Abihail chanu, Mordecai chagavopnu, Esther lengpa henga lutna ding phat ahitai. Esther alut phat’in, numei inpi vaipo, nukiso Hedgaiyin von dia aseipeh bangin akivontai.
Hiti hin Xerxes lengchan kal kum sagi na, lha som lhin, Tebeth lhan, leng inpia Xerxes lengpa angsunga Esther apuilut tauve.
Lengpan Esther chu nu-ngah dang dang sangin adeipenin, nu-ngah dang sangin aman lengpa sei abol’in angailotai. Lengpan lallukhuh akhuhpeh-in, Vashti khel’in lengnun asemtai.
Esther jabolnan lengpan golvah abol’in, vaipo vaibol chengse akousoh keiye. Lenggam pumpia choldo nikho aphongdoh-in leng khat peh lomtah thilpeh tampi ahomdoh-e.
Hichepat hin lengpan Mordecai chu vaipo khat’in apansah tai.
Esther in Juda mi ahi aseidoh hih laiye. Mordecai hin koimacha aseipeh lou dia ahiljeh a, aneocha lhah thu anun jing banga, athua nunga aseidoh lou ahi.
Mordecaiyin leng inpia na atoh pet hin, lengpa indan sunga lutna kelkot ngahte ni-Bigthana le TEresh-in lengpa Xerxes adou lhonin, tha din ago lhontai.
Athilgon lhon hi Mordecaiyyin ahetdoh doh-in Esther ahil le, Mordecai thil het chu Estherin lengpa aseipeh tai.
Phatah a akholchil’u le, thudih ahin, mithat gote ni thingchunga akhailih tauve. Aumdol hi lenggam thusimbua jih lut din lengpan thu apetai.
Chom khat jouvin lengpa Xerxes-in Haman kitipa chu Semang pipun atung lentai.Haman hi Agag chilhah, Hammedatha chapa ahi.
Akinbol vaipo jouse kun cheh a Haman jabolna chibai aboh cheh diuvin lengpan aseitai. Abonchan abol cheh-un, Mordecai seh she adai.
Leng inpia vaipo dangsen, lengpa thupeh anit louna jeh Mordecai adongun;
niseh-in anit teina din asol sol jengun, amala anom naisaipoi. Aman, “kei Juda mi kahin, Haman noiya kun a chibai kaboh thei lou ding ahi,” ati.Vaipoten athusoh hi Haman aseipeh-un, Mordecai umchan angaidam ding le angaidamlou didng along dong lheh-ui.
Akoma Mordicai kun a chibai boh ding nop lou ajah phat’in Haman alung hang behseh jengin;
chule Mordecai m aJuda mi ahi ahetdoh phat’in, Mordecai she talen matsah sanga khoh cheh bolagoi. Hiti hin Persia gamsung pumpia Juda mi jouse thagam ding thil agongtai.
Lengpa Xerxes lengchan kal kum somle ni lhinna, lha masa, Nisan lhan, athilgon molsona ding nikho pha le lha kitoh holdoh didng deinan Haman hin Purim phun san ding aseitai.
Hiti hin Hamanin lengpa jah a, “Naleng gamsunga hin mihem nam khat kithecheh a, gamkai jousea chegnsoh kei aum’e. Hiche nam mite hin midangto kitoh louhel chonchan dan aneiyui. Akhoh cheh-in, amaho hin gamsung danthu jong anit pouvin, hijeh a chu amaho hinghoi hoi ding nan gdin hung phaponte.
Nadeile thugahna khat sunin lang hiche nam mite hi kithatgamle phante. Nanop pou poule, leng gamsung kivaipohna manchah din dangka talent sangsom peng ting, leng thil kholnaa koiyinge,” ati.
Lengpan khutjem mohor a kisem, thuphondoh jouse kinamkhumji chu asut lhan, Judate melmapa, Agag chilhah Hamandatha chapa Haman apetai.
Haman jah a, “Judate le asum jouseu nanga ahitan, pha nasah lam lamin bol jengin,” ati.
Lha masapen nisom le nithum nin Hamanin lengpa lekhajihho jouse akoukhomin, leng gamsunga kimang lekhajem jouse le pao jouse aledoh a jih ding, chule vaipote l egamvaipo chengse thotsoh hel din, thuphondoh khat ajihsah tai. Lekha chu lengpa Xerxes min a kijih, amohor kinamkhum ahi.
Solle hon hiche lakha chu gamsunga ahomsoh tauve. Asunga kisun chun-nikhatseh sung, Adar lha nisomle nithum ni le-Judate abonchauva, ateh akhang, numei chapang thagam hel dia asei ahi. Hepi beihel’a thagam ding, anei agou chengseu chomsoh ding ahi.
Nikho alhin teng miho kigingsa aum theina diuva gamkai jouse thuphondoh chu phonjalsoh ding ahi.
Lengpa thupeh-in thugahna chu munpipen khopi Susa a aphongdoh-un sole hon athu ho gamkai jouse alhutsoh tauve.Susa khopi sung mipi lung donga kihel lei loi pet hin lengpanle Hamanin nomtah-in toumun ju adon lhon’e.
Thilsoh jouse Mordecaiyin ajahsoh phat’in lung gimin aponsil chengse abottelsoh tai. Khaodip pon asil’in, lujanga leivui kiloiyin, khopi lailunga avah len, lhase tah-in othongje jun akap’in,
leng inpi kulpi kotphung geiyin ahunge. Khaodip ponsil koima lut ding aphal loujeh-un leng inpia alut poi.
Lengpa thuphondoh kisseidohna gamkai jousea, Judate lah a lunghem ka ogin thong akijai, Judate an ngol le kap le lunghemin aum’un, atamjonkhaodip pon dil’in vutvam lah a akijamtauve.
Mordecai umchan hi nukiso ho le Esther aseipeh phat’un, alung gim lheh jenge. Khaodip pon kheldohna dia Mordecai hi ponsil athot vangin, Mordecaiyin akilah dehpoi.
Hichun Estherin alhacha dia lengpan akoipeh, leng inpia nukiso, Hathach chu akouvin, ipi jeh a Mordecai chute chon ahidol photoh din asoltai.
Hathach chu Mordecai umna, khopi ningkoi, leng inpi lutna kotphunga achei.
Thilsoh chengse Mordecaiyin aseipeh-in, Judate akithagam le leng inpi thil kholnaa Hamanin akoilut nom sum jat jong aseithai.
Judate kithagamna dia Susa khopia kona kihomdoh thuphondoh lekha jong pheng khat Hathach apei. Mordecaiyin Hathach hin lekha chu Esther koma apeh a, aumdol hilchet’a, chule Esther asol’a amite chunga lengpan hepina anei theina dia ngeh didn aseipeh-e.
Hathach chun asei bangin abol’in,
Estherin ma Mordecai henga thu lethah kit dingin asol’in,
“Numei hihen pasal hile, kou louva leng inpi sung gil’a lut tapou chu thi jeng ding ahi. Hiche hi Danthu ahin, lengpa thumop ho apat gamkai mitinin ahet cheh ahi. Hiche danthu peldohna ding lam khat aumin, lengpan aleng tenggol adop khumpa vang sohcha ding ahi. Ahinla lengpan eikou louna hi lha khat jen alhingtai,” ati.
Mordecaiyin Esther thu thot amu phat’in,
gihsalna thu alethot’in, “Leng inpia naum vangin Juda dang sangin hoidoh nang tin kinep dan.
Hitobang phat’a hi naum thim le van a konin Judate kithopi ding hunga, huhhinga um tei diu nang vang nathi tei ding, napa khanggui bei ding ahitai. Kon ija ahet’em, ijem itile hitobang phat hung lhun ding jeh alengnua napan khat jong hithei tah ahi!” ati.
Estherin hiti hin Mordecai adonbut’in,
“Susa khopia Judate gakhomin lang, kei din an ngol’in neitaoeh-un, nithum l ejanthumin neh le chan bolda jengun. Kalhacha nu-ngahho le kenjong chutima kabol diu ahi. Chujoule, Danthu to kikal hijeng jongle, lengpa koma kalut ding, kahtilo jeng idng hijongle kathi mai ding ahi,” ati.
Mordecai akipatdoh-inEsther sei jouse aboltai.
A-an ngol nithum lhin nin Estherin leng pochol sil’in, leng inpi sunggil’a lut’in, laltouna indan sung, laltouna touvin, kotphung lam ana ngai.
polam a lengnu Esther ding amudoh phat’in alung lhaiyin, sana leng tenggol agadop sangpeh tai. Esther ahung lut paiyin, tenggol muh agah thamtai.
Lengpan, “Ipi hitam lengnu Esther? Nadei dei seiyin kapeh ding nahi, kalenggam keh khat hijongle it poge,” tin aseiye.
Estherin, “Lengpan pha nasah le, tuni lhah teng lengpa le Haman nehkhom golvah kabolpi nom’e,” ati.
Hichun Esther golvah ankong umpi din lengpan Haman kinloitah-in agah kouve. Hiti chun lengpa le Haman Esther gaovahna ache lhontai.
Ju anop thim phat’in lengpan Esther jah a, “Nadei dei kapeh ding nahi, seiyin. Kalenggam keh khat geiyin thum jongle chun penange,” ati.
Estherin,
“Lengpa nalung lhai dingle, jing teng jong le hitobang golvah khat bol kit ing ting, Haman to neihung lhah peh kit lhonin. Chuteng kadei chu sei nange,” ati.
Haman kipah tah-in golvah mun dalhan achedoh tai. Ahin leng inpi kulpi kot phunga Mordecai ajotpa teng, jabolna dingdoh louva aumji le along hang behseh jengin ahi.
Hijongle akitim nah nah-in in lam ajon’e. In a aloi agolte akoukhomin, ajinu Zeresh geiya pang din akouvin ahi.
Amaho hi ahao natsatje avetsah-in, hoitho tah-in chapa tampi aneile, lengpan panmun lena akhandoh thu, lengpa vaipote lah a thupipen ahidol jouse seiyin akiletsah-e.
Hamanin, “Ipi dang ngai nalaiyem? Lengnu Esther geiyin kei le lengpa bou golvah ankong um din eikou lhonin, jinga din jong eikou kit nalai lhon’e.
Ahivanginla leng inpi kulpi kotphunga Juda mi Mordecai tou kamu jing laisen, hichengpi jong hi imacha ahipoi,” ati.
Hichun ajinu le aloi agolten, “Ahi, thingpel metre somni le ni sang khat nasema, jingkah teng lengpa koma Mordecai khailih dia naseile iti-am? Chutile lung nom a golvah ankong naum thei ding ahi,” atiuve. Aseiyu chu Hamanin thilphan agel’in, thingpel chu asemtai.
Janin lengpa ihmu mon aumtan, hijeh chun leng gamsung lekhabu jouse asimpeh diuvin angeh tai.
Asimpeh nauva chun lengpa indan kotpi ngah a pang, leng inpia nukiso te ni, Bigthana le Teresh-in lengpa athagot lhon, Mordecaiyin aphondoh thusim jong apangkhai.
Hichun pengpan, “Hiche aboljeh a chu itobang gunchena le kipaman Mordecai hi kipetam?” tin adongtai. Asohten, “Mordecai imacha jong akibolpeh khapoi,” tin aseiyui.
Lengpan, “Leng inpia hi kavaipote khatbeh um’uvam?” tin ahol’e. Hichepet tah hin Haman leng inpi hongcha ahung keiye; Haman hi asemsa thingpel chunga Mordecia khailih ding thu lengpa koma sei dia hung ahi.
Asohten, “Haman aumin, kimupi din na-ngah-e,” atiuve. Lengpan, “Hinpui lut’un,” ati.
Haman ahung lut chun lengpan, “Jabol dia kadeitah mi khat aum’e. Hitobang mi chu i-kalo ding lom ham?” tin adonge. Haman akigeltoh masan, “Lengpan hibanga ajabolnom hi koi ahidm? Kei hitei veh tang, ati.
Hiti hin Hamanin lengpa jah a, “Nangin nasilji mong mong leng ponsandup chol chu galahsah-in lang,
leng kijepna sanajem ho chu nasakol jepan,
chuteng namihat lah a hatpen khat’in hitobang mi chu jem hen lang, sakol chunga toudohdah hen, aman sakol kaile hen, khopi dung lhungsoh keiyin mihatpa hin, ‘Veuvin, veuvin, lengpan jabol’a kipaman apeh pa hi!’ tin sam le le hen,” ati.
Chutah-in lengpan Haman jah a, “Leng ponsandup chol galan, sakol gakai loiyin, chule hiche Juda mi Mordecai khu hitobang chun jabolna neiyin. Nasei jouse chu ama din bol jengin. Leng inpi kulpi kotpuhnga tou jing ahi,” ati.
Hiti chun Hamanin leng ponsandup chol alan, sakol agakaiyin, ponsandup chol Mordecai asilpeh-in, sakol chunga Mordecai atouvin, Hamaninkhopi dung lhungkeiyin akailen, achepum lhonin mipi jah din, “Veuvin veuvin, lengpan jabol’a kipaman apehnom mi chu iti abol hitam!” tin asamle lei.
Haman jum behseh a mai pon a jel’a in lam ajot chun, Mordecai leng inpi kulpi kotphunga ache kit’e.
Haman chun thilsoh jouse ajinu le aloi agolte koma aseitai. Ajinu le aloite michingtah tah hon, “Mordecaiyin nathaneina achulhah pan ahitai. Juda mi ahin, najo louhel ding ahi. Aman najotei ding ahi,” atiuve.
Amaho akihou nalaiyun, leng inpia nukisoho, Esther ankong um dia Haman pui din ahung paitauve.
Hiti hin lengpa le Hamanin Esther to
aniveina nakong aumkhomtauve. Ju anop thim phat’in lengpan Esther adongkit’in, “Lengnu Esther, ipi nadei ham, tun seitan? Seiyin kapeh ding nahi. Kalenggam keh khat hijongle penge,” ati.
Lengnu Estherin, “Lengpan neinop peh dingle nemhaova ka-ngeh nom chu kei le kamite hinghoina ding kadeiye.
Kei le kamite hi thagam dia johdohsa kahitauve. Soh a kijohdoh mai hiuving, ima dang thu umlou hile, umthim a nang suboi lou didng kahi; tua vang hi kabonchauva suhgam a, suhmang ding kahitauve!” ati.
Chutah chun lengpa Xerxes chun, “Hitobang thil bolngam ding chu koi hiya, ama chu hoiya um ham?” tin adongtai.
EStherin, “Eihehseuva kamelmau, hiche migiloupa Haman hi ahi!” ton akoh tai.
Lengpa lung hangval’in akipatdoh-in, indan sung dalhan, leng inpi polam honleiya agavah lei. Lengpan talen amatsah tei ding amudoh phat’in Haman aumdenin, lengnu Esther koma ahinghoi teina din atao tao jenge.
Ahepi teina dinEsther jalkhuna akisep lhun ataove. Hichepet tah chun honleiya konin lengpa ahung nungkit’in insung ahunglut’e. Aumchan amudoh phat’in lengpa akisenjah jengin, “Hichepa hin kaleng inpi sung jenga jong, kamitmu changtah a lengnu geiya suhset aot hitam?” tin aseitai. Lengpan asei jou lou laiyin nukiso hon Haman luchang atom paitauve.
Nukiso ho lah a Harbonah chun, “Nahuhhinga Mordecai thana din Haman hin thingpel semsan a-in a akoiye. Thingpel lentah, metre somni le ni jen sang ahi!” ati. Lengpan, “Ama khailih nan ganeiyun!” ati.
Hiti hin Mordecai khailihn adinga asemsa thingpel a chun Haman akhailih-un, lengpa jong alungdamtai.
Hiche nikho chun lengpa Xerxes chun Judate melma Haman thille lo, neile gou abonchan Esther apetai. Mordecai apa-ngah ahichu Estherin lengpa aseipeh-in, hichea pat hin Mordecai lengpa koma alut theitai
Lengpan Haman khut’a anunglah, akhutjem, mohor umna chu asut lhan Mordecai apetai. Estherin Mordecai chu Haman neile gou jouse chingtup din akoitai.
Esther lengpa khophangbul;a lhun akap’in, Agag chilhah Haman thilse gon, Judate thagam dia agot chu suhtangna dia thil khatbeh bolsah din a-ngeh tai.
Lengpan Esther din leng tenggol adop khumin, amanu dingdoh-in aseitai,
“Lengpan pha nasah a, kei thi ding nadaa, dih nasah le, Agag chilhah, Hammedatha chapa Haman thupeh, leng gamsunga Judate thagam dia thupeh aneisa suh tangna din thuphondoh khat sodoh le chun kati.
Hitobang manthahna kamite chunga lhunga ka-inkote geiya kithagam ding chu iti kathoh ding hitam?” ati.
Hichun lengpa Xerxes-in lengnu Esther le Juda mi Mordecai jah a, “Ve-lhonin, Hamanin Judate thagam agotjeh-in kakhailih-in, anei agou jouse Esther kapetai.
Lengpa min a thuphondoh kisema leng mohor kinam khum vang chu kikhel theiponte, Judate vang chu nadei deiya lekha nathot thei lhon ahi; kei min a najih lhon a leng mohor nanamkhum thei lhon ahi,” ati.
Lha thum lhinna, Sivan lha, nisom ni le nithum nia hiche hi soh ahi. Mordecaiyin lengpa lekhajih ho akoukhomin, Judate le gamvaipote, vaibolte, India pat Sudan gei gamkai ja khat le somni le sagi sunga athot’ui. Lekhaho chu agamkai pao le lekhajem cheh, Judate din jong Judate lekhajem le apaovun ajihsoh keiyui.
Mordecaiyin lekha thot ho chu lengpa Xerxes minin ajihsah-in, leng mohor anamkhumsoh keiye. Lekha thot jouse chu leng sakolbuh a kihen, sakol jangkhai cheh mangin mi atousah-in agahopsah sohkeiye.
Hiche lekha thot hoa kisei chu-khopi jousea cheng Judaten akihuhdoh na diuva pangkhom thei din lengpan aphalpeh-e. Gamkai hoilai hihen, itobang manchah choi min hindel khum’u jongle, asat thuh-uva, numei chapang geiya athagam diu, khatcha hing hoi louva, anei agou jouseu geiya akichom diduvin aseiye.
Hiche thugahna hi lha somle ni lhinna, Adar lha, nisom le nithum ni, Judate thagam pumpia manchah dia kisei ahi.
Athu hi pondoh a Danthua pang ding, gamkai jousea mitin hetsah ding, hiche nikho chule Judate amelmateuva akihuhdoh theina diuva, kigingsa aumna diuva seipeh ding ahi.
Lengpa thupeh-in sakol themte leng sakol chunga atouvun, jangkhai vel’in alhaitauve. Thugahna chu munpi pen Susa khopia jong japi ahetsah-ui.
Mordecaiyin leng inpi dalhan, leng pon loupe, adumle akang, tupat ponnem sil’in, lallukhuh loupe tah khuh-in akondodh tai. Susa khopi sung kipa ogin athongsoh hel’e.
Judate din kipa lung olle, nopna chule galjona lungthin aumdoh tai.
Khopi jouse le gamkai jouse, lengpa thuphondoh kisimphah na jousea, Judaten toh bangin kipa golnop abolsoh keiyui. Dihtah-in midang tampi jong Juda mi asoh gamtauve. Ajeh chu mijousen aginlo tauvin ahi.
Leng thuphondoh manchahna ding, Asar lha, nisomle nithum ni amelmateuvin Judahte matchom agot niu ahung lhungati. Ahinla Judahten amaho ajolotauve.
Leng gamsung, Judate chenna mun jousea, asat diuva kigochanto kisat jeng din Judate akikhomtauve. Muntin a min Judate akichauvin, koiman adehjou tapouve.
Tahbeh-in, Mordecai aginjeh-un, gamkai vaipote le, gamvaipo ho, vaibol ho chule leng thalhenga antong jousen, Judahte apanpi cheh tauve.
Lenggam pumpia, leng inpia Mordecia thenai, aneibe cheh cheh thudol akithangsoh tai.
Hijeh chun Judahten amelmateu alo nom nom alo thei tauve. Chemjam choiyin adekhum’un, asat chap jenguve.
Munpi pen Susa khopi sung jenga jong Judahten mihem ja nga athat’uve.
Amitha lah-uva Judahte melma, Hammedatha chapa Haman chapate som khat jong apangun,
Parshandatha, Dalphon, Aspatha, Parmashta, Arisai, Asidai, chule Vaizatha ahiuve.

Thilkeo ima vang achomtapouve.
Hiche nikhoa Susa khopia mihem kithah jat chu lengpa aseipeh-uve.
Lengpan lengnu Edther jah a, “Susa khopi sung jenga jong Judahten mihem ja nga athat’un, Haman chapa som khat jong apangtai. Gamkai dang danga ijat i-alo dda diu ham! Ipi nadeibe nah laiyam? Namu thei ahi. Seiyin, namu jeng ding ahi,” ati.
Estherin, “pha neisah peh dingle, thunia abol banguvin Judahten jing jongle bol kit tadiu hen. Chule Haman chapa som khat chu thingpel a khaisang din noppeh-in,” ati.
Lengpan hiche jong hi aphalpeh-in, Susa khopi sunga thuphondoh khat ahomjaltauve. Haman chapa som khat long chu japi vet din aphoujah tauve.
Adar lha nisomle nile nin, Susa khopia Judahte akikhom’un, khosunga mihem jathum jen athabe kit’ui. Thilkeo vang achomdeh kit pouve.
Gamkai jousea Judahte jong akikhom’un, akihuh cheh tauve. Avetdauva pang mihem sang som sagi le sang nga athat gam’un, amelmateuva konin aongthol tauve. Thilkeo ima vang achompouve.
Hicheng chu Adar lha nisomle nithum nia thilsoh ahi. Ajing nikho, nisomle nili nin vang mi athabe tapouvin, kipa golvah nikhon amangjo tauve.
Susa khopia Judahten vang nisomle nithum, nisomle ni nga nia ahaijeh-un, nisomle ni nga ni choldo nin amanguve.
Hijeh a chu khote dunga cheng Judahten Adar lha nisomle nili ni hi kipa nihtnega amanjiu ahin; golvah bolna le khat le khat neh le chah kipetou ahi.
Mordecaiyin thilsoh hicheng hi ajihdoh-in, Persia gam pumpi, gamla naiya cheng Judahte jouse athot’in,
kumseh le Adar lha nisomle nili ni, nisomle ni nga ni nithenga anit diuvin aseipeh-e.
Hiche nikhote nia hi Judahten amelmateu athagamu ahi; hiche lha hi lung gim hesoh a kona kipa nopna kiheidohn alha ahi. Hiche nikhote ni hi golnop kut le anlhung nehna, neh le chah kithah toa, vaichate anthahna nei din aseipeh tai.
Judahten Mordecai thupeh ajuiyun, hiche golnop hi kum vanlhah kut’in aumdoh lo tai.
Judahte melma, Agag chilhah, Hammedatha chapa Hamanin Judahte suhgamna din Purim kiti mangin phun anasanin, nikho hoipen a suhgam didn ahol’in, thagam hel din anagoi.
Ahivangin Esther lengpa koma alut’in, lengpan thugahna asemin, Judahte bolna sia thilgon chu Haman chungjoh a achuh lon, amati acahpate ti thingpel a akhaisoh tauve.
Hijeh a chu hiche nithengte ni hi Purim kisah lo ahitai, Mordecai lekha thot ho jeh le achunguva thilsoh ho jal’in,
Judahten Dan akisem lo’uvin, amaho tah le atu achateu, koi hile Judah mi hung hithei, Mordecai thupeh dungjuiya kumseh le aphat phat cha hiche nikho teni ho nit jing din aboltauve.
Kinoptona asem’un, Judah insung mite jousen, akhang khanga, gamkai jouse le khopi jousea, ahung lhun phat tin a, Purim nikho te ni hi geldoh a nit jing din aseitauve.
Lengnu Esther, Abihail chanu le Mordecaiyin jong lekha ajih lhonin, masangjep a Mordecia sutse Purim thudol asei chu, thalhingset’in namdetna anei lhontai.
Hiche lekha chu Judahte jouse athot’un, atobng cheh chu Persdia lenggam gamkai ja khat le somni le sagi sunga athotsoh hel’ui. Lekhaa chun Judahte lah a cham le lungmon len ding akiseiyin,
Lungkham lunghem a an ngol’a nit dia kisei bang banga, aphat phat cha Purim nikhote ni chu amaho le atu achateu geiyin anit diuvin aseipeh lhon’e. Hiche thupeh hi Mordecai le Estherin asei cheh lhon ahinai.
Estherin Purim nit dol Dan kisem namdetna anei chu lekhajol khat’a akisuntai.
Lengpa Xerxes hin gamgil lama chengho hihen, Twikhanglen pang dunga cheng ho hileu-agamsung pumpia elbol natoh tohsah ding abol cheh-e.
Thil loupe le mingthang abol ho, Mordecai tohmun len a akhandoh thusim lhingkeiyin Persia le Media lengte thusimbua akijihsoh keiye.
Judah mi Mordecai chu lengpa Xerxes bantah ajauvin adei cheh-ui. Anam mite phatna dingle atu achateu lungmon theina ding jeng anatonge.
Uz gamsunga Pathen ginga tahsan Job anachengin, chondih tah ahin, thilse bol louhel ahi.
Job’in chapa sagi le chanu thum aneiye;
kelngoi sang sagi le sa-ngonsao sang thum, bongchal sang khat le sa-ngan ja nga aneiyin, soh tampi avul’in, niso lama mihao pentah ahi.
Job chapate aban banin kilhan golvah abol jiuvin, adang ho hung lhasoh kei ahiuvin, asopiu numei thum jong akou jiuve.
Golvah boljou jingkah teng Job jingpi tah-in athouvin, achate suh theng nadin kilhaina aboljin ahi. Job geldol’a achate khattouvin hetoh louva Pathen a-enghoukah diu agin mo ahi.
Ni khat van mite Pakai anga ahung kikhop nauva Satan jong alah-uva apange.
Pakaiyin Satan jah a, “Hoilam galhah nahim?” atileh, Satanin, “Leiset chung kalhah len, dung le vaiyin kachon len, tua hikoma hung kahi,” ati.
Pakaiyin, “Kalhacha Job chu namum? Ama banga kitah le pha leiset chunga midang aumpoi. Aman chibai eiboh jingin, thilse pou pou bol louhel ahi,” ati.
Satanin, “Job’in ajeh beiya Pathen agin beh ham?
Nangin ama le a-insung mite chule anei jouse vettup peh jing chu. Anatoh jouse phatthei naboh-in, gamsung pumpi agancha nadimsah tai.
Tun ijemtin anei jouse lah peh le chun namai change nagaosap ding ahi!” ati.
Pakaiyin Satan jah a, “Aphai, anei jouse khu nanop nop gallon, ahinkho vang nasuhset thei lou idng ahi,” atileh, Satan akondoh paitai.
Ni khat Job chaten a-upa pen’u in a golvah abol pet tah-un
solle khat Job henga ahung lhaijel’in, “Bongchal hon lou kakaiyun, akoma sa-ngante kavah-un,
het man louhel’in Sabea miten eihin del khum’un gancha jouse akitol mang tauve. Kei tilou nasohte jouse jong athat gam’un, kachangseh a hung jamdoh a hiche kaseipeh nahi,” ati.
Solle pan thu asei chai hih laiyin, lhacha khat ahung lhung paiyin, “Kelngoite le kelngoi ching ho keh’in asep lihsoh tan, kachangseh a hung jamdoh a kahungseipeh nahi,” ati.
Aman asei chai hih laiyin, lhacha chomkhatma ahung lhungin, “Chaldea sepai loi thum jenin eidel khum’un, kei tilou nalhachate athat gam’un, sa-ngongsao jouse akai mangun, kachangseh a jamdoh a nang kahung seipeh nahi,” ati.
Aman jong asei chai hih laiyin, lhacha khat ahung lhung pai kittan, “Nachaten a-upa pen’u in a kut abol laitah-un,
gamthip laiya konin khopi hui ahung langin, ain asem lhun, nachate adel lih soh tai, kachangseh a hung jamdoh a, nang kahung seipeh nahi,” ati.
Chutah chun Job akipatdoh-in, aponsil jouse abottel’in, asam avou chaiyin, tol’a amai asulut’in ataotao.
Job’in, “Sagoh keova peng kahin, sagoh keova kathi ding ahi. Pakaiyin eipeh ahin, Aman akilah kit ahitai! Nun nom hen Pakai min!” ati.
Thilsoh hijat jeh hin Job achonse deh pon, Pathen jong amosopoi.
Pakai angsunga van mite ahung kikhop kit phat’uvin, Satan jong alah-uva apange.
Pakaiyin Satan jah a, “Hoilam galhah le nahim?” ati. Satanin, “Leiset chung kalhah len, dung le vaiyin kachon len, tua hikoma hung kahi,” ati.
Pakaiyin, “Kalhacha Job chu namun? ama banga kitah le leiset chunga midang aumpoi. Chibai eiboh jingin, thilse pou pou bollouhel ahi, ajeh beiya suhmang dia nagot’a nabolset soh tah vangin, Job alung lha hih laiye,” ati.
Satanin, “Mihemin ahinna ding pou pou ahileh imacha dalhah lel neiponte.
Tun atahsa khu natsah temin, namai changtah a nagaosap jeng ding ahibouve!” ati.
Pakaiyin Satan jah a, “Aphai, Job khu nanop nop nalo theiye, thavang that thei pon nate,” ati.
Pakai koma konin Satan apotdoh-in, Job chu apum alongin aphahsah soh hel tai.
Job akipatdoh-in vutbouva agatouvin, bel hal khat’in atipat lai ho akhot khot jenge.
Job jinun ajah a, “Tugeiya jong lung lhadeh lou nahi ong? Pathen chu gaosap’in lang thidoh jeng tam-em!” ati.
Job’in ajinu jah a, “Na-ngol thubuh nasei ham! Pathenin thilpha eipeh laisea ikipaa, thilse eipeh teng akiphin ding ham?” ati. Genthei hesoh chujat athoh vangin, Job’in Pathen dounan thu cheng khat cha aseipoi.
Job hin gol thum aneiyin, amaho chu Teman khoa Eliphaz, Shuah gama Bildad, chule Naamath gam a Zophar ahiuve. Job hesoh genthei khohje ajah phat’un, alha mon din ahung kontauve.
Gal’a pang a Job ahin mu vangun, alim amel ahedoh thei tapouve. Ahetdoh phat’un aponsil abottel jengun, lung natah-in aluvum lam’uva leivui aleh thang’un, othongje jun akaptauve.
Anat hesoh behseh jeng amudoh phat’un, ni sagi sungin sun le janin atoupiuvin, a-uhpoh apaosa aumpouve.
Akhon nan Job apengjah-in apen nikho agaosap tai.
Job’in,
“Kapen nikho gaosap chang hen, Kakijil jan chu gaosap chang hen!
O Pathen, hiche nikho chu thimpi jinsah-in, Sumil del’in, kho vahsah da hel’in!
Muthim lhangkhal kiheh hen, Mei jing hen, nihu kilah da hen!
Kakijil jan chu kum sungin simtha dan, Kisimtha kit da hel hen!
Jan lunghem jan hisah-in, Lhaset jan hihen!
Kapen nikho chu gaothem hon gaosap hen, Levithan phin hang thei hon phin hang hen!
Jing valpa vahsah dan, Hiche jan chu khovah mon um hen!
Hiche jan hin eipensah jeh-in gaosap’in, Genthei hesoh eithohsah jeh-in gaosap’in
Kanu oisunga kathiden a, Kalong damsa ahung penlhah leh itim?
Idia kanun pheichunga eina pom’a, Idia noitwiya einavah ham?
Chulaiyin anathi ta leng, Tua kicholdo taing!
Leng inpi sapha leng le lalte to Lumkhom tange!
Chutileh sana dangka indim dim akoi, Leng le lal chapate toh lumkhom inge!
Nimel lhamel mu manlouva Chalam a eikipai tading!
Vuikhuh a migilou agilou tapon, Thacholte acholdotai!
Lhankhuh a sohchangte jong a-oltan, Songkul ngahpa hutot jong ajatapouve!
Milen mineo aumkhomsoh keiyun, Sohho jong achamlhat tauve.
Idia mihem hesoh gentheiya hinga, Lung nguiyan khovah amu ham?
Thikal angah lel lheh jengun, athimo hel’ui; Neile gou sangin buikhuh adeijo’uve!
Thia akivuidoh masangsen Nom asadeh pouve!
Akhonung thuu Pathenin aimpeh-in, Jet le veiya aumkimsoh tai!
Neh le chah khel’in lunghemin ka-umin, Gim genthei kathoh jinge!
Kaginpen thil’in eiphan, Katijatna penin eilhun dentai!
Lungmon le choldona kaneipoi, Kagentheina abei thei tapoi!
Eliphaz-in Job jah a, “I-khat kiseileh ngaidan natem?
Paopoh louva umna thei la Nahitapon!
Mi tampi nahildoh-in, Lhasamte bantha nahatsah-e!
Cholle nanga kisep lhu jouse Natilkhouvin nahatsah me!
Genthei nan naphah phat’in Imacha dou thei louvin na-um’e!
Pathen ginga manabei nahin, Kisonna le kinepna nanei ding dol ahi!
Phate chan gel temin, Hoikom pen a midih-in manthahna atom?
Keihet’in vang thilse louma gut’a gut, Thilphalou muchi tua tun aga akilo teiye.
Hitobang mite chu Pathenin khopihui semmang abahsah jie.
Migiloute sakei banga akisenlet lut vangun, Pathenin ameh thipjin ahau avopusoh jie.
Neh ding sahing kimat jou lou sakeite thigam, Anoute vahcheh bangin aum’uve!
Thip beh chan thu khat ahung lhungin, Guh thim chan kajai!
Ihmutlan a singdel bangin Kahung kinkhangin;
Kakicha behseh jengin, Kapum changing kakithing thinge!
Kamai ahung kijep dap hoiyin, Katimul athousot’e!
I-khat ahung ding jang keiyin, Kavet vangin kamuchen theipoi. Athip del jengin, Chuin ogin khat kajai!
“Pathen mitmua them chang ding koi hiya, Asempa angsunga theng jou ding koi ham?
Pathenin vanmi alhachate jong aging chapon, Avantilte themmona jongaphoh jie!
Leiset a kisemdohho aginchat dia nabol’a, Nget banga thin lhah thei leivuiya kisem chu aginchat ding ham?
Jingkah a damseh mihem chu, Hetman louva nilhah kah a thi thei ahi.
Ahinlose akilahpeh teng, Ngoljeh-in mihem athiji tai,” ati.
“Kouvin Job, koiham nahou ding? Nakiheina ding Vantil hoipen ham?
Lung gim hesoh nathipi ding vang, Pannabei ngol hoitah ahibouve.
Mi-ngol lungmong tah a um kamun, Hetman louvin ka-in gapsah jie!
Achapateu ameidoi gam’un, Thutann aphunga ding ngam jong aumpouve.
Lingle khao lah a keh jongle, gilkelten mingolte lhoga akilon; Midang chahten agou adei chauve.
Thilse hi tol’a hungkeh ddoh ahipon, Gentheina jong Leiset’a hungpeng ahipoi.
Meilhum sunga kona meisi alentou banga, Gentheina hi mihemin akiboldoh ahibouve.
Kei hivang leng Pathen heng jon ing ting, Kachung thu akoma sep lhang’e!
Athilbol loupitah tah ihekhen pouvin, Thil kidang abolla simjou ahitapoi.
Leiset chunga go ajuhsah jin, Loulai dung twi achap jie.
Miham domsanga, Lunghemte lhamon chu Pathen ahi.
Aman doha thuh ho htilgon asunoh-in, Imacha amolso sah hteipon;
Kichihsah ho achih nauvin amanin, Angaito jouseu asubei loijie.
Sun chang laiyin khon ajinden’un, Janlai bangin akimai leuve!
Pathenin vaichate ahinson, Bolset’a um milhasamte ahuhdoh jie!
Migiloute aphoh thip’in, Vaichate akinepsah-e!
Pathenin asuhdih thei mihem chu anun nom’e, Napho teng nagida hih-in!
Pathenin mi amavona atomjol jin, Navohna chengse aboldam jinai!
Gupvei jen hahsatnaa nahuhdoh ding, Sagi geiyin vang thilsen phapon nate!
Kel lhah teng jongle nahinso ding, Gal’a jong nathisah ponte!
Pathenin koima houset sah pon natin, Manthahnan phajongle chun huhdoh nannate!
Pumhat le kel nanuisat ding, Gamsa hang jong ging pon nate!
Hollei lah lhou khapon natin, Gamsa hangin jong sesepon nate!
Naponbuh a lung monga nachen ding, Nakelngoite jong ima tilou ding ahi.
Nason napah biha phaiha ja pha ding, Nacha nanao jong hampa jat pha ding ahi.
Chang minset akoi tobanga, Tehkem geiya nahin ding ahi.
Job kasei hi phat sotpi kasimtohsa ahi. Adih ahin, tun kisanin!” ati.
Job’in adonbut’in,
“Ohe, kanat thoh genthei jouse Kitetoh thei leh,
Twikhanglen a neldi jat sangin gihjon tin, Hibanga kahansetna hi datmo pon nate!
Hatchungnung Pathen thalpin eikap paiyin, Athalgun eichansoh tai; Pathenin tijat jatnan eibol jenge!
Sa-nganin hamhing akimu teng along lhaiyin, Bongchal’in an aneh teng athip’e!
Koiham chiso lou anche tamne nom? Ahtui pokang khu almong nam?
Chu tobanga anneh kaduchapon, Kaneh jongle kaloh asoh-e!
Idia Pathenin kadei eipeh da a, I-bol’a kataona eihou lou ham?
Akhut’in eituh hen Eijep lih le ahijenge!
Eitha ding heleng kichom jeng inge, Itobang nat genthei thoh jong leng, Pathen thenje kahe jingin, Athupeh peh nel ponge!
Hinjouna ding thala kanei tapon, Athive ve ding ibol’a kahin hin ham?
Song tah a tah kahiya, Sum-eng lhouva lhou kahim?
Kihinsona thei tha kaneitapoi, Bel ding jong kaneitapoi.
Pathen heng he hih leng, Hitobang gim genthei teng golpha ka-ngaiye!
Kagol kapaiten la neilhem chavaiyun, Gotwi bei teng lhanghoh go neibahsah-ui!
Lhanghoh dunga buhbang alhang lhangin akisen, Thop chet chut’in akikhol’ui.
Kholum teng leh ajun lhan, Alon mang teng lhanghoh akeovin aumji tai.
Kholjin miten twi aholmo’uvin, Nelgam save vu lah a athidenji tauve.
Tema kon kholjinten twi ahol’un, Sheba a hungkonten mutei akinem’ui!
AKinepnau abei phat’in alhaseuvin, Lhanghoh go lah a akisudong’ui!
Keidin hiche lhanghoh gosa tobang nahiuvin, Kagenthei namu phat’un na-nung kin’ui!
I-khat neipeh diu kathumbeh ha, Khattou sumguh neigapeh peh diduva katem ham?
Melmapa akona neihuhdoh diu kasei ha, Mibolsepa a kona neilha doh diuva kasei ham?
Aphai, kamona iham neihil’un, Thip beh-in nasei ngaiyinge!
Thutah-in mi athu nuntei me, I_bol’a manlou thujeng naseiyu ham?
Ajeh beiya moh pen pen a neigel’um? Itiba gentheiya kasei neidonbut’u ham?
Chaga soh chang ho pou vang san a kihom, Nagol ngaitah tah kiveina nei nahiuve ong!
Neive changmel’un Jou sei ponge!
Naval behseh tauve, adihlou bolda jengun; Mo neichan hih-un, kadih nai!
Jousei bep’in neigel’un, Adih amo hekhen louva neigel mongum?
Leiset mihem hinkho hi namnah a kisol sepai tobang, Thalah soh goiya kigoi tobang;
Che phat ni kihei ngah jing soh, Atohman ki-nga jing natong tobang ahi.
Lha hijat sung hi kahinlo aumpon, Jansim she-in gim genthei kathoh be be!
Kalup nah vnagin ihmu mon ka-umin, Khovah kal ngah lel’in kakipeh peh jie!
Katichung tinakhemdimin athansoh tai, Katinakhem akikhodoh leh vousan jeng ahi!
Kahinkho patphei kilham sangin achaljon, Kinepna beiyin abeiloi jitai.
O Pathen, kanopna abeitai, Kahinkho chomdan geldoh jingin!
Tua neimu vangin neimukit pon nate, Neive jongle chunbeipai tange!
Meilhang kitol mang banga Mihem athi teng hung kile kit lou ding,
Ama hesa jousen jong Asuhmil loi diu ahitai.
Ahipoi, moh umthim thei ponge, Hibanga gentheiya kilung hang Thu kasei tei ding ahibouve!
Twikhanglen ngapi ngap a neibol ham, Nei nga jing jeng ding?
Choldo din lum ing ting, Kanat ol domna ding gel’inge!
Hinla mangse se neimat sah-in, Mu nei neisah-in, sing neidelsah-e!
Hitobang nat genthei kathoh sangin, Kikhailih leng katijoi!
Kachim’e, kahin nompoi; Kahinlo jong aumpoi, neilimsah dan!
Mihem hi ija nabol’a hibanga thupia nagel’a, Idia abol chan namelchih keo ham?
Jingkah she-in nakholtoh-in, Phatseh-in napatep’e!
Kachil beh kaval manna dia Neivetda a nakihei mangle iti-am?
Vo mihemte Chingpa, kachonset nang dia ipi khoh am? Idia bidoiya neinei ham? Nang dia pohgih hahsa mong kahim?
Kachonset na-ngaidam joulou mong hiya, Kasuh khel nachulnam mo ham? Keila lhankhuh akijam loi tang ting, Neihol hol jongle chun Neiholmo tan nate!” ati.
Shuh mi Bildad-in adonbut’in,
“Hamve vua nasei na-ngah lou li ham?
Patheninthudih aletun ngaipon, Itih-in jong adihlou abol ngaipoi!
Nachate jong chonsea hitei diu, Hijeh a chu Pathenin asuhamng ahi!
Hijongle hung kiheiyin, Tun Pathen henga taovin!
Lung theng lungdih nahileh, Pathenin hung panpin tin, Nadih man’a nanei kiledoh a Na-in kisah phat namu loi ding ahi.
Nanei mangjat hi imacha hilou, Pathenin napeh ding chuto tethei hilou ding ahi.
Golui lai chihna ho ven, Pule paten dih asah-u hi gel temin!
Kum lhomcha, imacha helou, Ihinkhou jong nilim kihei mang bep ahi.
Hijongle khanglui lai mite chihna kihilsah-in, Aseiyu nagi phan!
Sitwi nomna louva pengthei akeh pon, Dop lah louva akimu ngaipoi.
Sat lhuh amanchah thei ahi masangin jong, Twi kan teng agop masan apang’e.
Pathen heloute jong chu che pengthei tobang ahiuvin, Pathen asuhmil tengu akinepnau abeijitai!
Akinepnau achavai jin, Akison nau maimom panjang bep ahi.
Maimon pan a kingai leu adou jouva, Patjanga kikhaileu atuh jou ding ham?’ atiuve.
Migiloute sunlai loudong abangun, Honsung anche dongpha abangui.
Ajung kikhon song ho aveichah-in, Songpi khi kah dunga akigol dettai.
Hinla kibotdoh leh, Koiman akena lam jong heponte!
Migiloute nopna chu hiti bep chu ahin, Midangin amun alahpehji tai!
Mi kitah vang Pathenin adonda khapon, Migiloute apanpi khah poi.
Nolnabei hile chun nui heovin lhan natin, Kipa othongin thu seiyin nate!
Nahote vetdan tin, Migiloute in-gap diu ahi,” ati.
Job’in adonbut’in, Hitin aseiye:
“Nasei jouse hi masanga kajahsa ahinai, Hinla Pathen maiya them chang ding koi ham?
Koiham Pathen to kinel thei ding? Koima adonbut joulou asang sang thudoh nei ding chu!
Pathen chu chingtah le hattah ahin, Koiman kidintepi theiponte.
Hetman louvin molsang ho atolmang jin, Alunghan teng asumangji tai!
Pathenin ling akihosah-in leiset akilinge; Leiset bulpi khom jouse ahot lingjin ahi.
Nisa athimsah jouvin, Janteng ahsite athimsah theiye.
Pathein van buhsona ason chun koima panpi angaipon, Twikhanglen ngapi achotphan koima athalah poi.
Vanlaijol ahsite, Ngambom uichal le Ngambom lungthu, bombel le Lhanggam ahsi jouse Pathen semsa ahicheh-e.
Athilbol loupe ho hejou poutin, Thil kidang abol jong akhonbei ahi.
Pathenin eihin hopa nan Kenla kamu thei hih beh-e!
Adei dei akilah thei, Aphoh tang ding umlou; ‘I-bol nahim? Ti-ngam koi ham?
Pathen alunghan teng Amelma amal tel jin; Adouva Rahab gulpi panpi jouse Asugoiyin asugam jitai!
Hiti ahijeh hin, Ipi seiya Pathen kadonbut thei ding ham?
Monabei hijong leng, Kachung thu tan ding Pathen henga chu Eilungset dia katao tho didng ahibouve!
Eipaosah mong jong le, Kasei ngaidin katahsangpoi.
Ajeh beihel’in jong eisuse din, Gopi huipi eidel khumsah bouve.
Hing gentheiyin eihinsah-in, Haisa theiyin eikoipoi.
Pumhat’a kano dingle, Koiham Pathen pumhat’a noding? Kihehpi ding kitijongle, Koiham Ama koulut jou ding?
Kitahle monabei kahinan Kasei chan thusen akilan, Kapaodoh chanin Kamona kaseidoh loi!
Monabei hijong leng khoh kasapoi, Hinjong kahin nom tapoi;
Moleng mohih leng imachom ahipoi, Pathenin hoijoh akhendeh poi.
Monabei mi hetman louva athi teng Pathenin anuisat’e.
Pathenin vannoi hi agiloupa apedoh tai. Vannoi thutan vaihomte mit achotsah-in, Pathen tilou koidangin Hitia abol thei ding ham?
Kahin nikho akitol jeng jungin, Thilpha mu man louvin ka-um’e.
Kahinkho kong kitol hattah abangin, Jucha man dia mu manlouva hung lenglha muvanlai abange!
Nui heova kanatna suhmil kagot vangin, Kagimna apong jitan;
Pathenin mo eichan kahen, Kichan gim genthei kathoh thou thouve.
Them channa chom deh lou, Ipi kakhohsah ngaiyam?
Buhbang twiyin kisil ing, Cha-ngel’in kisop jong leng,
Pathenin eh-khul sunga eileh lut’a, ponse nen sanga kibohjo ding!
Pathen hi mihem hileh Ddonbut’a kihehpi thei kahi.
Hijongle Pathen le kei kah thusei ding aumpon, Thu eitanpeh lhon ding aumpoi.
Talen neimatsah datan Pathen! Neihoh kichat chat datan!
Kalungthimin kamona kahepoi, Gin beiyin ngampel’in seiyinge!
Kahin nom tapoi, Kiphin ing ting kanop nop seiyinge!
Themmo neichandan Pathen! Neiseipeh jon iham mo neichanna?
Giloutah anasemsa neidonda, Migiloute thilgon phasah hi dih nam?
Keiho mihem thilvet banga Nangin jong navet ngap hitam?
Kahinkhou chom banga Hinkho chom nahim?
I-bola kachonset jouse nakholsoh keiya, Kasuh khel chan namelchih ham?
Kathemmo loula nahen, Nakhut’a kona koiman eichulhah lou ding jong nahei!
Nakhuttah a neisemsa chu Nakhutma maa seisuhmang ahitai!
Geldoh-in leivuiya neisemdoh ahin, Leivui sosah kit neigot hitam?
Kapa thisan a neilhoh lhah a, Kanu naobu sunga neikijilsah ahi.
Kagu kachang kalhintwi nasemin, Kaguho phe le cunin natomjol’e.
Neihinsah-in nei ngailui, Neikhohsah jal’a ihngbou kahi.
Hina hichanpia hi kathemmo le, Thadoh dia guhthimcha neigot kahetai.
Kachonset leh ngaidam louva Suhmang din neichang lhi jinge.
Kachonset tih tih neibolgim jin, Thilpha bol jong leng kaphatchompi deh poi. Gin genthei leh jum le Jachat kathoh bep’e!
Kadinkang khen khe leh, Sakei mibolna bangin neichon lhun, Datmo mo neibol khum jin, Neimavo lo jitai!
Eihehse ding nanei jingin, Neilunghan jingin suhsetna thei khat nagong jinge!
Pathen, i-bol’a neipensah ham? Koiman eimu thei masanga thidoh hitave leng!
Chutileh hing man louhel’a, Naobua kona lhankhuh jonpai ta ding!
Thi ding koncha kahitai, Chomkhat beh nom sange, neidondan!
Hung kile kit lou din chevah tange, Mithim lhangkhal monmo nagam jon tange!
Muthim lungdon, noimigam, Khovah jeng jong muthim bep hina gam chu!
Hichun Na-amath mi Zopharin adonbut’in:
Ngol-thubuh hijat donbut louva kikoiya, Kamtam man a mi them chang mong nam?
Kadonbut mou nahim, Job? Neidai chatvaiyu hi kamoh thip diu ham?
Nangsei bou dih nasan, Pathen vet dia thengin nakiseiye!
Pathen hung paodoh hen, Nahin donbut jengle katitave!
Pathenin chihna nahil’in tin, Mihem hetdoh theilou giltah tah aum’e. Nathoh ding sanga jangkhaijoa Pathenin talen napeh ahinalaiye!
Pathen thahat loupije athuh je le agilje Naholdoh jou mong ding hinam?
Van sangin asang jon naholdoh jou ahipon, Noimigam sangin athuh jon nahetthei ahipoi.
Pathen loupina leiset sanga lenjo, Twikhanglen sanga lenjo ahi.
Pathenin thutanna phunga kailut le chun Kon phoh lha theiyintem?
Pathenin pannabei jouse amun, Athilse bol chengseu amusoh-e.
Gamlah sa-ngan nou akivah ngoi teng Mi-ngol jong chingjep tante!
Lungdih pun, Job, Pathen lam sangin!
Thilpha lou chengse paidoh-in, Thil dihlou na-insunga koidan,
Chuteng mai lhaisel’a Hangtah a napan ding ahi.
Nagimna chengse sumil’in natin, Hohtwi kitolmang bep’a nagel ding ahi.
Nahinkho sunlai nisa sanga vahjoa, Muthim jeng jong jing khovah bang ding ahi.
Namelmate nagin lou ding, Mi tampin nang panpi ngai chante.

Migilouten jet le vei veu jongle Jamdohna ding lampi mupon tin, Akinepnau pen tah chu Laicha haisam chubou hitante.
Hichun Job’in adonbut’in:
Nangho tamjo jongleur chun Nathi tengu nachihnau jong beitante.
Keijong nahetchanu hea, lhasam deh kahipon, Nasei jouseu min ahesoh keinai.
Tunvang kagol kapaiyin einuisat’un, Nolnabei adih hijong leng einuisat bep’ui; Hinla phat khat teng Pathenin kataona sang nante.
Hahsatna neilouva neidai thangu ahin, Thi dingkonsa kei neijep beuve ong!
Athahat nau Pathen banga songte Gucha le pathen heloute mongtah-in aum’ui.
Hetbe nom chanin ju le va kidoh-un, Chunga leng vachate le ganhing hon hil nauvinte.
Tol’a ganhing ho le Twikhanglen ngate Chihna kidoh-un, hil nauvinte.
Hiche ganhing jouse hin Pakai semsa ahiu akihet cheh-ui.
Asemsa chengse hinsah Pathen ahin, Mihem hinkho jong ama khut’a um ahi.
Naleiyin antui atekhah cheh bangin Nakhangin thu angai nom’e.
Tehsete aching theiyin, Ahingsot ten ima ahekhen theiye.
Chihna le thahat hi Pathena ahin, Thu mopthem, thil hekhen them ahi.
Pathenin aphet lhah teng kon asah phat’a, Pathenin songkul’a ahen teng kon alhadoh jou idng ham?
Pathenin twinah asipbing teng Gotwi akang jin; Twinah ahondoh teng Twisang alen ji’e!
Pathen hi hattah, gal lel ngailou, Mihema le alheppa ajotho cheh-e!
Vaihomte chihna alamangin, Lamkaite angolto abahsah-e!
Leng ho asu-lha jin, Sohchangin ahenji tai!
Thempute jong apui chavaiyin, Thahatte jong asu nemjie.
Son umtah miho aphoh thip’in, Upate chihna alamangjie!
Thuneite ajumson, Vaihomte hatna asubeijie!
Muthim lhangkhal kiheh lai ahoh doh-in, Muthim jinglah avahsah theiye!
Namtin vaipi achoi-an jin, Chuteng gal alelsah-in asu mangjie!
Alamkaiteu angolsah jin, Lung dongin avamangsah jie!
Muthim lah a akimai le leuvin, Jukham bangin alonle leuve!
“Ven, hijatpi hi kamun, Kajan kahekhensoh nai.
Nahet jat’u kahen, Nang ho sangin kalhasamjopoi!
Pathen koma kiphin a Kinelpi hel ding nom kahi!
Joule nal’a kilep them, Panna bei Thempu jeng nahiuve!
Umthim beh leu chun Khattouvin michingin geljo’uvinte!
Ngai phauvin tun, Kachung chang thu seiyinge!
Idia thujou naseiyu ham? Najouthuu hi Pathen dia thilpha nagel’um?
Pathenchu huh dia go nahiuva, Thutanna in a kinelpi go nahiuvam?
Pathein nakholchil’u leh thilpha mun tem? Mihem lhep’a Pathen nalhep jou diu ham?
Guh thimin gingmo jongleur chun Patheninnaphosal tei diu ahi.
Pathen lal loupina naginlou diu hiya, Ama nakichat lou diu ham?
Nathuchih jouseu vutvai bep, Nakihon nau jong leipal chimbep ahi.
Thip chet’un kadei kagot seiying ting, Asoh soh soh jeng hen!
Thilo hel ding hijong leng Kagel gel kasei jeng ding ahi!
Kakiholpoi, Pathenin eitha thei ahi, A-angsunga kakihonna seiyinge!
Migilou bon Pathen angsunga pao ngamlou, Hangtah-in pang leng kahinlo thei ahi!
Kasei jouse ngai phauvin, Kaphondoh chan lung nachangin ngaiyun!
Kadih kahetjeh hin, Kachung thu sei ding kigoa kahi.
Mo neichan ding ham Pathen? Mo neichan dingle kihon dang ting thi tange!
Vo Pathen kachunga thil ni neibolpeh dan, Chutile namai kamu ngam ding ahi!
Talen neimatsah dan lang, Neihoh kichatsah dan!
Neikou masan Pathen, nahouvinge! Ahiloule ken seiyinge neihouvin!
Kachonset ipi pi hiya bolkel i-kanei ham? Mo neichanna ipi ham?
I-bol’a neidon da a, Melma banga neigel hitam?
Thingna bep kei hoh kichat neigot’a, Changpol gosa beo neisel khum got ham?
Kaneo lai chonset geiyin neiphul’in, Giloutah tah-in eihehsei!
Kakeng thihkhaovin nasomin, Kakho-lhah nave-lhi keiyin; Kakho-ni nung Namelchih jing jenge!
Hijeh chun thingmot kiloilhu kabangin, Nget nehsa ponsil kabangtai!
“Mitin lhasam le panpi ngaiya peng, Hinkho chomcha, gim hesoh dimset ahicheh-e!
Pahcha banga pah a pulloiji, Nisa lim banga kihei mangloiji ahi!
Hitobang bep mi hi neivet chil’a, Neikhol’a kathu natan ding ham Pathen!
Mihem banga thilboh lah a Thil theng khatcha kiloidoh ponte!
Mihem hinkho kitepsa, lha jat kisimsa, Khelmo hel dia nasuhtohsa ahitai!
Ahithei le gim hesoh hinkho hi nom asahna din, Vet vet dan, limsah datan!
Thingphung phuhsa din jong kinep aum nalaiyin, Mit-thah kit’a hingdoh thei ahi!
Akungbul apkai hen, Leichunga ajung go jong leh,
Gotwi lhah teng akeh thah bangin dondoh-in tin, Thingtoi thah banga abah jemdoh didng ahi.
Mihem athi teng akichai ahitan, Athi teng hoiya um jim?
Twi long lai vadung kantan le Damvei lai twi kang bangin,
Mihem athi teng athoukit ji poi, Van kitolmang kah a mihem ihmut’a kon thou lou diu ahi.
Noimigama neiselmanga, Phat khat teng geldoh kit dia Nalunghan beikah a Neiselmang ding kadei lheh-e!
Mihem athi teng hingkit theiyam? Kenvang hesoh phat kichai, Phat pha hung lhun ding ngah jing inge!
Chutia neihin kou teng houving ting, Neisemsa kachunga Lung lhaitan nate!
Chuteng kakho-lhah melchih jong le chun Kachonset him him holdoh pon nate!
Mudoh jongle chun ngaidamon natin sumangtan nate, Kabol khel abonchan theh ngaim nate!
Molsang jouse chimsoh a, songpi lentah tah kitolmang ding;
Song jouse twiyin lhoh a, Songpi lentah tah tah kitolmang ding; Mihem hinkhoa kinepna jong Sumangin nate Pathen!
Mihem nasu-nemin, itih a din nasolmang jin, Athin amai molsoh ji tai!
Atu achaten gunche mujongle ahepon, Jum le ja toh jongleu ahetapoi!
Atahsa nat thoh lel bou ahen, Alung gim hesoh bou ahei!” ati.
Hichea hin Teman mi Eliphaz chun adonbut’in:
“Michingin hita hi ahomkeova Khohui nung banga thu asei ding ham?
Miching koiman nasei bang aseipon, Lah theilouvin kihonna aseipoi.
Nadih mong le koiman Pathen ging pontin, Akoma tao nom jong umponte!
Nathuseiya nagitlou akilangdoh-in, Kilepdohna ding jeng thu naseiye!
Ken themmo kachan ngailouvin, Nasei chanin themmo nakichantai!
Mihem lah a peng masapen a kibol nahim? Mol le lhang hijat sanga kisem masa nahim?
Asemdoh masanga Pathen thilgon najah lhih ham? Mihem chihna nan gbou chang nahim?
Kahet louvu imacha nahepon, Kadat khen thei louvu imacha nadat khen thei deh poi.
Upa tehse tah a kihil ching, Napa sanga upajo koma kihil them kahiuve!
Pathenin nalhamon chu ida nadonda a, Lung geltah a kaseiyu nadonda ham?
Nalung phamo pai jengin, Mitdih mitchangin neive pouve!
Pathen nalunghan khumin, Nahouse se jenge!
Mihem hi theng jou mong ding hiya? Pahenkoma themchang jou um mong ding ham?
Pathenin Avantilte jong aging chapoi, A-angsunga them achangjou pouve.
Mihemin thilse twidonin adonin, Asea le ahomkeobou ahi!
Ngaiyin kahet chan Kamu chan seipeh inge!
Im beihel’a apu apateuvin ahil them, Thutah jouse eiseipeh tauve!
Agamsunguva gamchom mi alut theipon, Pathen a kona pui mang thei koima aumpoi.
Midang bolsea migilou chu Ahinkho lhumkeiya genthei ding ahi!
Tijat jatna thu jeng ajan, Nom asah pet tah-in guchan achomjie!
Muthima jamdoh din akinempon, Chemjam a lou dia um ahitai!
Muthongten athilong neh din angah jingun, Akhonung thu hahsat akihet’e!
Leng hattah bangin, Manthah nana del khumgoi!
Pathen douna khat lam a, Hatchungnung seisea Mihem chu chutobang ding ahi.
Hi tobang mihem chu, Kiletsah-in doumah mah abol’in,
Gal-lum choiyin Pathen jeng jong anakhumjie!
Amahin khopi jouse alan, In jouse alo teng aneiho ajam’un, Hinla hiche khopi ho le in ho hi Gal’in alah peh doh kei ding ahi.
Aneila umsot lou ding, haosot lou ding; Nisa lim bangin kihei mang loitante!
Muthima jamdoh lou ding, Mei hulgotsa thingphung le Apah jouse hui mutmang Thingphung to bang ding ahi.
Thilsea ngolman a kinem chun Thilse akisan ding ahi.
Aphat lhin kah-in gop lhan tin, thingbah gop bangin nou kit ponte.
Aga min masanga puljou lengpigui tobang, APah pulsa olive thing tobang ahi.
Pathen helouten son le pah neiponton, Nehguh a kisa in meiyin kante!
Thilse bol’a baotam pandoh chu hitobang ahiuvin, Lhep lhah ding bou agel’ui!
Hichun Job’in adonbut’in:
“Hitobang hi kajahsa ahin, Neilhamon’u jong gimna bep ahi!
Nasei sei jeng ding ham? Ipi lunghimona neiya neidonbut kit ham?
Kei tobangin, nang ho tobang leng, Kalu peikhum ing ting Thu tampi kasei den ding, Nasei seiyu kasei thei ding ahi.
Nalhamonna diu seiya, Kamchah leuva katilkhou diu ahi.
I-kisei jongle aphachompon, Umthim jong leng kanat a-olpoi.
Ka-insung mite la nasubeisoh tan, Neichaisoh ahitai Pathen!
Neimanin kamelma nasoh tai, Kagu –lheng lhol bou aumtan, Hiche hi kachonset photchetnan Mihon agelsoh tauve!
Lung hangtah-in Pathenin einoigep’in, Midih michangin eivepoi.
Mihon anop agot eiseikhum’un, Eiumchah-un ka-ngeiphe abengun ahi.
Pathenin Pathen hephaloute eipedoh-tan, Migiloute khut’a eisep luttai!
Thei nop’a ki-umpet eileh kadah-in, Kalol’in eimanin eijep goiyin, Eive lhi jingin, Mitt hip tenin eibol’e!
Jet le vei sahle lhanga konin thalpi eikap’in, Athalchangin eidotpai jeng vangin eivoujang natpipoi.
Avel vel’in eimavon, Sepai ngol bangin eidel khumtai.
Lunghemin khaodip pon kasil’in, Leivui lah a katoutai!
Maisan hel’in kakap tan, Kamit kamai apomsoh tai!
Hinla thilse kabol pon, Kataona jong athenge!
Vo leiset! Kathisan vuhmang dan, Thudih ka-ngeh jong suthip hih-in!
Van a eidinpia Eipanpi ding khat aumnai!
Kagol kapaiten eihouse seuvin, Pathen koma ka-mit lhi alonge!
Min agol apai ding aseipeh banga Pathen henga eitaopeh ding ka-ngaiye!
Kakum abei hei hoitan, Thina gam kajonpantai!
Haisam a thipai ding kahitan, Lhankhuh tilou imadang kaneipoi!
Ka-kiheina lam lam a Eidaithangun kadoujou tapoi!
Monabei kahi kasei neilahpeh-in Pathen! Eiseihu ding koima aumtapoi!
Alungthimu sumoh tajongle chun Kachunga noplensah hih hel’in!
‘Agol apai lhep lhahna sumguh kilah chu Achaten mitchot lonte!’ kiti
Hiche thuchih hi kei housetnan amangun, Ahungun kamaiya chil eiset khum’ui.
Lunggim lhilonin kamit athimlon, Kakhut kakeng gu-lheng lhon keo ahitai!
Lungthenga kigel hi atijauvin, Pathen hephalou bangin eiboltauve!
Gin le ja akigel hon Themjo danin akigel cheh cheh jengui!
Hinla kamasanga hung idngu jongleh Alah-uva aching khat beh mudoh ponge.
Kanikho abeihei hoiyin, kathigon ho athontan, Kakinepna jong abeitai!
Kaloi kagolten janlai jong sun abahsah-un, Muthim jong kho vah loi din aseiyui!
Noimigam bou kakineppi ahitan, Hikoma chun muthim lah a kijam tange!
Lhankhuh chu pan neiying ting, Thante chu kanu le kasopinun bol inge!
Kakineppi ding hoikoma um a, Kakinepna thei kon amun?
Noimigam kajotsuh teng Kinepna neitaponge!
Shuh mi Bildah-in adonbut’in:
“Job nang tobang nathip jengle iti-am? Sei ngaile chun kahil thei diu nahi!
Nangin keiho cheng hi Gancha ngol neibahsah-u ham?
Nalunghan chu nanatlo bep ahi. Nalunghan jeh a leiset kidonda a, Nalungdamna dinga Pathenin molsang jouse atolmang ding ham?
Migilou meivah kimut mit ding, Kongdoh kit lou ding ahi.
Migilou insunga mu athimin, Thaomei vah jong akimut mittai.
Golkha tah a kal ason jongle achomtan, Athilgon chengsea akipaltai.
Thangkol achonlut’in, Khuh sunga avah lut tai!
Akeng thanga a-oh den tan, thangkol a akihen-oh tai!
Alampia thang akikamin, Leivui akivuh khum’e!
Jet le vei sahle lhanga tijatna jengin, Akho-nung ajui jinge!
Mihao tah chunk el athoh tan, toset to akikhen tapoi!
Thina khop hel’in atipat’in, Akhut le akeng amonpai gotai!
Amonpi insunga alhop lhan, Thina angsunga akailuttauve!
Kat meiya akisuh theng teng, A-insunga apu louhel mi chengtante.
Abulbal ajung agop panin, Abah jouse agopantai!
Khosungle gamsunga amin thang tapon, Koiman ageldoh him him tapoi.
Son le pah la aneipon, Achilhah jong abeitai!

Niso le nilhuma ahinkho thusim japha chan, Tijan akihot lhul soh tauve!
Migilou, Pathen hephalou chu Hiti chih cheh ding ahi,” ati.
Job’in adonbut’in:
“Idia neisuh lung jing jing uva, Neiseithan gdeh jengu ham?
Neiphin phin jengun, Neihousetnau jong najahcha pouve.
Bol khel nei mong jong leng, Nang ho dia i-khoh ham?
Keisanga phajoa kigel’a, Kagimna hi kachonsetgaa nagel’um?
Pathen bol kahi namu louvu ham? ka-o na ding thang eikampeh chume!
Pumhat’a eibol kanel vangin koiman angaipon, Thudih kakhohsah vangin koiman angaipoi!
Pathenin kalampi akhah-in kachepai theipon, Kalamlhah jouse asuchotai!
Kagou jouse eilahpeh tan, Kaminthanna asubeisoh tai!
Jetle vei sahle lhanga eijep chinton, Kakinepna thingboh abotdoh tai!
Pathenin lung hangin eidel khumin, Amelma giloupen abngineiboltai!
Asepaite eidelkhumsah-in, Ka-inkima apangun eiumchah tauve!
Pathenin kasopite eijamsan sah-in, Eihesa chengsen het louvin eiboltauve!
Kasopi, ka-insung mite, kagol ngaitah tah ten Eijamsansoh tauve!
Ka-in alhung jing maljin hon eisumilsoh tan, Kasoh numeiten hetphah lou maljin bangin eibol’ui!
Lhacha khat kakou jongle eihoupon, Kamdama katao jongle eidonpoi!
Kajinun jong kakam-ui ajanompon, Kasopiten jong einailut nompouve!
Chapangten nahsah mon eibol’un, Nuijat nopnan eineitauve!
Kagol ngaitah tah ten eivet dauvin, Ka-ngaipen tah hon eidoutauve!
Kagu le kavun keobou um ahitan, Kapao paojeh a hingdan kahibouve!
Pathenin eijep lhuh ahitai! Neivoujang natpiuvin kagolle kapaite!
Pathenin eibolna kah a idia neibolgim’u ham? Neibol gim nau chimlou nahiuvem?
Khattouvin kaseiho hi melchih din Lekhabua jihlut leh katitave!
Ahiloule songpheng chunga kijih pol’a Aman louna dia kajihvomsoh hel hileh!
Ahinla akhonna kheh a eihung panpi ding Van a khat um kahei!
Kavun jouse patsoh tajongleh Katahsaphea Pathen kamutei ding ahi!
Kamit tah a kamutei ding, Lamdang louhel ding ahi. kemeidoi lo hel tai,
‘Keihon iti kabolgim beh-um?’ natijeh-un. Neidel khum theina diuvin Kamona ding nahol thu’ve!
Pathenin chonset satgamna alap Chemjam chu ginguvin! Thutah a khat aumdol nahetna diuva Chemjam alapji ahi!” ati.
Naamath mi Zopharin adonbbut’in:
“Job, neilung hansah tan Kadonbut tei ding nahitai.
Miphinna thusei nahin, Adonbutje kahenai!
Khanglui laipeh, Leiset’a mihem kichensah a pat,
Mi phinse migilou ahingsot pon, Pathen helou jong anopsot lou nahei!
Migilou minthang hen, van pha ding, Van a meilah nol’in sang jongleh,
Huiya leivui kithe-mang banga, Ahesahon jong ageina lam ahetlou diu ahi.
Jan-mang banga leng mang ding, Jan-mang banga kimukit lou ding ahi.
Amusan jong mukit pontin, A-in mun a jong kilulah kit ponte.
Achaten vaichate henga thumin tin, Apau bat jouse choltah a asah diu ahi.
Atahsa nouchet jongleh Thia leivui sohvah ding ahi.
Gitlouna thu ngeitah-in sei hen, Thutah seilep le le hen,

Keima kelngoi kul’a kisem mong mong, Samulpon kasilpeh teng eivahchoi cheh-ui.

Kabanjangte ni kivobang jeng hen, Kalengkoute nia koin kisat lha hen,
Pathenin talen eipeh ding kagingin, Hitobang thilse hi bol ponge.
Neile gou, sana dangka Kakisonpi ngaipon;
Kahaona chengse jong hi Hoithonan kanei khapoi.
Nisa vah jong kahou khapon, Lha mel-hoi jong chibai kabohpoi.
Nisa lhathah hou din eikilhem lhapon, Ni le lha hounan kakhut kachop khapoi.
Hita bolna hin Hatchungnung Pathen ataitomin, Abol’a chu thina thei talen matsah lom ahi.
Kamelmate genthei kakipapi khapon, Hamset atotengu nom kasa khapoi.
Kamelmate thina dia taova, Hitobang chonset chu bol louhel kahi.
Maljin ho kalhunsah jing hi Kanatong jousen ahesoh keiyui.
Kholjin jouse in a kalhunsah jin, Kholai dung tol-lhanga alum khapouve.
Min achonset asel cheh-un, Kenvang kasel ngaipoi.
Japin eidem ding jong kagingpon, Mihouset ginnan kot kal lhah louvin kaumthim ngaipoi.
Koiman kasei eingaipeh lou ding ham? Adih cheh kaseiye, Hatchungnung Pathenin eidonbut hen! Min eiheh nau hi kasim thei dia Kijihdoh soh keiya kikoi hileh,
Kiletsahpi tah a kalengkouva kaput ding, Kalua lallukhuh banga kakhuh ding ahi.
kabol chan Pathen seipeh ing ting, A-angsunga kalu kadosangsah le ding ahi.
Kaloumun leiset hi Aneipaa kona kaguh thoa,
Hiche lousoh gilkel kathohsah leh,
Suhlou chang le sakol chang khel’in Lingle khao hung keijo hen!” ati. Job thusei akichaitai.
Job chu ama them akichansoh hel phat’in, akinelpi pasal thum chun donbut louvin akoitauve.
Ahin akihouvu ngaiya pang, Ram phunga Buz insunga Barakel chapa, Elihu chu along hangtai. Ajeh chu Job’in Pathen mo apeh a amajoh them akichan hi nom asapoi.
Job golte mi thum chunga jong along hange; ajeh chu Job anel lhah thei louvu hin Pathen chu themmo dol’in akilange.
Alah a chun Elihu hi adongpen ahin, midang seichaisoh angah-in ahi.
Mi thumin Job adonbut thei lou phat’un, along hangtan,
thu aseipantai.
UPa domin naseiyuva, Khanglui dominchihna nahil diuva kagel ahi.
Hinla Hatchungnung Pathen Lhagao chu Mihem chunga hung chua chihna apeh ahibouve.
UPat man a mi chinga jong ahipon, Kum tam man a ima kihethem deh jong ahipoi.
Chapang jong leng kasei ngai leu chun kadeiye, Kalunggel seipeh-unge.
Naseiyu ka-ngai nagi jengin, Thu ngei ngei nahol’u jong ka-ngah-e.
Phatah a ka-ngai vangin, Khat chan jong Job nanel lhapouve.
Iti kachinge nati thei diu ham? Nanel lel’u ahitan, Pathenin Job donbut nante.
Job chu nang ho to kihou nahiuvin, kei eihoupoi; Hijongle nang ho donbut bangin donbut ponge.
Thu asei khel soh tauve, Job; Nadonbut thei pouve!
Sei din gbon neitalou ka-nga nah lai ding ham? Sei ding helouvin amoh dintauve.
Kenjong donbut ing ting, kalunggel kasei ding ahi.
Seikal ka-nga lel thotan, Kalungin kadoljou tapoi.
Kho-ngaisot leng, lengpitwi thah-in Savun peng atumkeh banga kapojal thei ahi.
Ka-ngah jou tapoi.Seijeng tange!
Langkaina jong nei pong ting, Koima jong lhemlha ponge!
Mi lhep lhahje jong kahepon, Lhem jong leng Pathenin eisuhmanglo ding ahi.
Ahile tun Job, Kasei ding hi lunglut tah-in nagiphan.
Ipi hijongle kalunga akgel hi Seidoh jeng dinga kigoa kahitai.
Lung thengsel’a Thudih tah sei kahi.
Pathen Lhagoavin einasemin Eina hinsah ahi.
Naki-nga chat le neidonbut’in, Neinelna ding kigeltoh chet’in.
Pathen mitmua nang le kei thakhat ihin, Leivuiya kisemdoh cheh ihibouve.
Neiginna ding jong aumpon, Kenjong jothon bol ponge.
Nangin naseipen tah Kajahsa chu hiche ahi:
‘Bol khel kaneipon, kathemmopoi; Monabei, chonsetna neilou kahi.
Pathenin eidouva, Melma banga eibol ahibouve.
Kakeng thih khaovin ahenin, Kakal chalna ave-lhi keove,’ nati.
Naseikhel heltai, Job: Pathen chu mihem sanga chungnungjo ahi.
Idia mihem kiphinna nahsah loudan a Pathen na-oimo ham?
Pathenin avel vel’a asei vangin Asei koiman nagisah-in aneipouve.
Mihem jan ihmut lanin jong Pathenin amangule Themgao thilmua thu aseiye.
Athusei mihemte ajahsah teng, Agihsaln aho jal’in atijauve.
Achonset jom louna diuva Pathenin asei ahin, Akiletsahda na diuva apho ahi.
Amanthahsah nom lou ahin, Thina theiya kona huhhing agot ahi.
Mihem adih dohna din Pathenin anatsah jin, Ati pumpi adammosah jie.
Adam louvin ima aduchapon, Antui tah mu jongle achil pulpoi.
Atahsa agongte tul’in, Agu aching keobou ahitai.
Lhankhuh sung jon ding kon, Mithigama kumsuh ding kon ahitai.
Mihemte toh ding hiljia Pathen Vantil asang sang lah a Khattouvin vang ahung panpi thei ahi.
Ahepi jeh a Vantil chun, ‘Lhadoh tan, Alhatdoh man aumnai, mithigam jotsuhda ta hen,’ ati thei ahi.
Chuteng ati noudoh kit’a, Atha hung kiledoh kit ding ahi.
Atao teng Pathenin houvintin, Kipah a Pathen ahou ding, Pathenin ijakai aboltoh peh ding ahi.
Aman japi lah a, ‘Kachonsen, thil dihlou kaboltai;Hichan jong hin Pathenin eihing hoiye.
Pathenin mithigam a eisol loulai jeh-in, Tugeiyin kahing nalaiye.’
Hichengse hi Pathenin Mihem chunga avel vel’a abolji ahi.
Mikhat ahuhhing jin nomtah-in ahinsahjie.
Job, kasei hi ngaiyin lang, Umthimin ken seiyinge!
Seiding nanei vang leh seiyin, Them kachansah nom lheh nahi.
Seiding nanei loule ngai thimin, Chihje nahil inge,” ati.
Elihun asei pai kit’in:
“Naching them thei lheh-ui, Tun kei sei ding hi ngaiyun!
An tui le tui lou kamsungin atep bangin, Thu ngei le ngei lu nabengin angaiye.
Hijeh chun thildih lhengu hitin, Thilpha datkhen temu hite.
Job them akichan nah vangin, Pathenin them achan nompoi.
Job’in, ‘Monabon kinei lou Jouseiyin bou eikigeltan, kachonset lou vangin Talen hah tah eikipetai,’ ati.
Pathen jabol louhel Job tobang mihem umkham?
Migiloute to bou akivop’in, Chonset toh akijot lei!
Pathen lungdei juigot hi A-itih a thilphan aseipoi.
Ima hethem nang hon kasei ngai phauvin, Hatchungnung Pathenin thil dihlou abol ngaiyam?
Pathenin miho atohman apeh cheh a, Achan diu lom achansah ahi.
Hatchungnung Pathenin itih-in thilse abolpon, Koima adih louvin abol ngaipoi.
Pathenin athaneina hi koi koma apalah ham? Kon Pathen chu vannoi poh theina tha apeh theiyam?
Pathenin mihema konin alhagao kilah hen, Hat theina hu kinung lah kit leh;
Mihing jouse thin tin, Leivui lesokit diu ahitai!
Miching nahileh Kasei ngaiphan!
Pathen dihtah chu mo nachansah a, Thudih ahot banga nagel ham?
Agitlouva aphatchom lou tengu Pathenin leng ho le vaihomte themmo achansahjie.
Mitin sempa ahijeh-in Pathenin Vaihomte panpia vaichate douna mihao panpi ahipoi.
Mihem hi jan ihmut lan a thi thei. Pathenin aden teng dihlhuh a mangthah thei, Mihat lai lai jong Imacha louhel’a atha thei ahi.
Pathenin mihem kho-lhah Kalson amelchih jinge.
Chonse kiselna din Khojin muthim jong ajingpoi.
Itih tah le mihem thu atanpeh ding Pathenin phat tep angaipoi.
Lamkaite haisah a akhel diu holna din, Het khel kholtoh khoh angaipoi.
Pathenin mi natoh ahe cheh-in, Jan kah-in akhup athal’in aleh-in asugoijitai.
Michonsete chu japi mitmun Pathenin ajep cheh jin ahi.
Ajeh chu Pathen nung ajui tapouvin, Athupeh chengse adonda tauve.
Vaichate Pathen henga akasah-un, Pathenin ataonau asangin panpi agoi.
Pathenin ima bolda agot teng Kon a-oimo theiyam Akihei mang tengleh Mihemin suhna ding heponte.
Pathen hephaloute achunguva avaihom teng, Namtin vaipin jong alonaje hepouvinte.
Job, nachonset jouse Pathen koma naphondoh a, Chonse kit loudia kitep nahitah em?
Namona chengse Pathenin navetsah dia nathuma, Thilse bol loudia nom nahitah-em?
Pathen thilbol bon deilou, Nadei nabolpeh ding kinam nahi nah em? Nathu thu ahi, kei kahipoi; nagel gel seidoh jengin!
Lung gel thei jouse nomteiyin tin, Kasei ngaiya miching jousen:
‘Job hin hetoh louva asei ahin, Asei jouse lah thei aumpoi, tinte.
Job sei jouse hi geltoh chet’un, Asei jouse hi migilou thusei tobang ahi.
Achonset besen Pathen doumah abol’in, Imaichanguva Pathen ataitom jenge!” ati.
Eluhun aseibe nalaiyin:
“Job, Pathen angsunga monabeiya Nakisei jeng hi nadihpoi!
Chule Pathen koma, ‘Kachonset loule ipi phachom a, Kachonset le na—ilou ham?’ nati hi adihpoi.
Nang jong donbut ing ting, Nagol napaite jong kahouset ding ahi.
Vanthamjol khu vetemin, Meilhangho khu vena sang thei lheh-e!
Chonse jongle chun Pathen din ima aloupoi. Thil bol khel jongle chun Pathen asuh khah am?
Dih lheh le chun Pathen ahu theiyem? Nanga konin Pathenin imacha angaichapoi.
Nachonset teng namihem chanpin athoh lel’in, Thilpha nabol leh aphatchompi,
Mihemin bolset ato teng na asauvin, Ahuhhing diu akouvui!
Agenthei pettah-uva kinepna pathei ASempau Pathen heng ajonpouve.
Ju le va, ganhing sanga eichihsah thei Chihna eipeu Pathen heng ajonpouve.
Agit louva akiletsah jeh-un, Panpi angeh vangun Pathenin adonpouve.
Pannabeiya kap a peng nahiuve; Hatchungnung Pathenin ajapon angaipoi.
Job, Pathen namuthei louvin seidan, Lung nengtah-in ngah-in a-ang sunga nathu alhungtai.
Pathenin chonset khohsah louva, Talen amatsah louvin nagel’e.
Napao pao jong pannabei ahi, Hetoh louva thusei nahi akichentai,” ati.
Elihun aseibe kit nalaiyin:
“Lung nengtah-in kho-ngai jep’in, Pathen thalhenga kasei hi ngaiphan.
Kahetna ajaovin, Eisempa dihje Vetsahnan kahet bangin seiyinge,
Najah a jou khatcha kaseipoi; Namasanga miching tahbeh namutai.
Pathen itihat hitam! Koima anahsahmo pon, Ahet lou thil khatcha aumpoi.
Chonsete ahinghoi ngaipon, Vaichate adih-in abol jinge.
Midihte ahong jingin, leng bangin vai apohsah-in, Tonsot’in jabol achansahjie.
Hinla miho achonna dungjuiya Thihkhaova kihen amudoh tengleh,
Pathenin achonsetnau leh Akiletsah nau avetsah jie.
Thilsea kona akihei mangna diuvin Miho chu agihsal jin ahi.
Pathen thu angaiyuva alhacha apan’u leh, Ahao theiyun along mongui.
Achutilou leh khopho louvin athiuvin, Mithigam jonin luipi agalkaiji tauve.
Pathen heloute chu along hang jingun, Talen amat’u jongle panpi ngaiyin atao pouve.
Khangdong lai laiyin athiuvin, Mi maiya jumle ja thoh-in aum’ui.
Pathenin vang thoh gimna hi mihil nan amangin, Gentheina hi kho muthei nan amange.
Pathenin gimna konin napuidoh-in lang mongin nakoiyin, Nadokhang chung neh le chah adimtai.
Tun nachan ding lomin Talen namantai.
Nehguh jeh alhep chatvaiya naum louna ding, Hao deichat jal’a navamang louna din ching theiyin.
Panpi ngaiyin peng jongle chund phachom pontin, Nathahat’in jong ima boldoh peh theiponte.
Namtin vaipi manthahna ding, Jan hung lhun ding kinem hih-in.
Thilse nabol louna dia genthei kithohsah nahi.
Pathen thanei loupije geldoh-in, Ama mihil them chungnungpen ahi.
Pathen chu thilse bol’a moso thei le Abol ding hil masa thei koi ham?
Atohna chung aseiphat aching jingin, Nangin jong navahchoitei ding ahi.
Mitinin athilbol amucheh-in, Koiman vang ahejou jaipoi.
Aloupina kihechen joupontin, Akum jong kisim thieponte.
Leiset’a kona twi chopdoh a, Gotwiya hinjuhsah kitji Pathen ahi.
Mitin namtin dia hung ju-lha din, Meilhang lah a konin gotwi ajuhsah-e.
Pathen chenna vanpi kinim le Meilhang kitolle koiman ahetheipoi.
Vanthamjol’a kol aphetsah nan, Twikhanglen lithuh laila athim jing theiye.
Hitia hi Pathenin mipi avah jinga Neh le chah neng jeng junga apeh ahi.
Akhut’in kehchang achoiyin, Adoina mun sepkha din alhai.
Khopihui hung ding teng van akinimin, Ganchaten ahung ding aheuve.
Hichea hin keijong kalung ling laovin, kalungchang achomdoh deh deh jenge.
Nabonchan Pathen ogin khu ngaiyuvin, Akamsunga kon van kinimpi khu!
Leiset mong langa kon lang khat geiyin, Vanthamjol’a kol aphetsah-e.
Chuteng a-ogin akijan, Van-gin kithong chutoh keh kisep akimui.
Pathen thusah jal’in datmo umtah thil asoh-in, Ihet thei louvu thil kidang asoh-e!
Leiset chunga buhbang alhahsah-in, Gobah le gose ajuhsah jin ahi.
Pathen natong jing ahi ahetdohna diuvin, Mihemte natoh avohaijin ahi.
Gamsa jousen jong abusing Akosung, age na akijot cheh-ui.
Lhanglama konin khopihui ahung nungin, Sahlama konin phalbi dap hui ahung nunge.
Pathen nahlai husan twipi amut leh, Twiho chu geltwi asohjie.
Pathenin meilhang lah ameilom asel’in, Meilom ho apokeh teng kol pheji ahi.
Meilhang ho hi Pathen deiyinakitol len, Vannoi gamtina Pathen lungdei abol’ui.
Leiset chapnou dia Pathenin go ajuhsah ahin, Mihem bolgimna le lungsetna go amanchah thei ahi.
Chomkhat kho-ngaiyin phaten nagiton-in.
Pathenin thu apeh a kol aphetsah Hiti ho hi nahet chet mong nah am?
Pathen thilbol kidang tah, Vanthamjol’a meilhang kitol dan nahet the-em?
Lhanglam khohuiyin leiset ahinsem hoh teng Gamsa nathoh lel ding chubou nahei.
Pathen banga nangin vanthamjol Phatvet banga dumje ju khu najamdoh theiyam?
Lungthima ima kicop pouvin sei idng kaneipouve. Pathenkoma kasei diu neihil’un.
Pathen to kihou ding ka-ngap chapoi, I-bol’a kakisuhmangsah ding ham?
Vanthamjol avah behseh-in kave-ngampouve, Khopihuiyin amut thengsel’e.
Sahlama sana vah chansel bangin akimun, Tijat umtah Pathen loupina vah chun eisalvah-ui.
Pathen thahat anasan kanai ngampouve, Adih-in thudih jengin mi abol’e.
Mitinin agin cheh ding mong ahi, Kichihsah ho vang iman agelpoi,” ati.
Khopihui chimpei lah a konin Pakaiyin Job ahindonbut’e:
“Kichihna song lel nang koi nahiya, Khopho louva thu hijat sei nahim?
Pasal nahileh dingdoh-in, kadoh chan neidonbut ding ahi.
Vannoi kasemdoh a chu naum am? Hijatpi nahet leh neiseipeh temin!
Vannoi itea sem ding kon aboltoh a, Kon atetoh ham nahet le seiyin!
Leiset khonpiho ipi chunga kitunga, Vannoi bulpi ning songkhom koi phu ham?
Chuche ni jinglah chun ahsi ten la asauvin, Van miten kipah-in asem’ui.
Twikhanglen twipi akoa kona alonjal ding teng Akotpi kamkhuma ting bingjia koi ham?
Twikhanglen meilhanga tomjol a, Muthim lhangkhal a sel chu Kei kahi!
Twikhanglen gamgi kasempeh-in, Kulpi kot kakam khumtai.
‘Hichan gei hin veiyin lang, Hichan a bou natwidil ka-nga ding,’ katipeh-e.
Job, mahinkho sunga hi Nikhat beh jong jinglah khovah dia naseipeh-em?
Leiset pumpia kho vahsah a, Migiloute kiselna muna deldoh dia naseipeh khah am?
Sun khovah hin mol le lhang akimun, Ponsil kijal bang le leingan a mohor kinam bangin akimui.
Sunlai khovah hi migiloute din akichen behseh-in, Pumhat change thilbol angampouve.
Twikhanglen laigil twisam putna nache khah a, Twikanglen tonoi lama navale khah tah-em?
Noimigam mithikhul kotpi Kelkot pung dung navetsah tah-uvem?
Vannoi hi ite pham? Nahet leh neiseipeh-in.
Hoiya kona kho hungvah a, Muthim kipatna bulpi nahet-em?
I-chan geiya nasol theiya, Nalesol kit thei ding ham?
Vanno kisemdoh a bon anaumta a, Hibanga upate bol theiteiyin nate!
Buhbang le gelchang kakholna Hiche kikholna chu namu khah tah-em?
Gim hesoh ni le gal nikhoa Manchah dia kakhol khom ahi.
Nisa hung konna nagavet khah a, Solam khohui hung nun patna navet khah hitam?
Gotwi lonna ding kon asempeh a, Kehchang lhahna ding lampi kon asem ham?
Mihem chenna louhel nelgam geiya Go juhsah jing thei koi ham?
Hampa louhing hin theina dia Tolgo lah chapnouna dia go juhsah koi ham?
Geltwi le daitwi hin Ahinga Pa anei ngap lhon ham?
Geltwi le daibang Hinga anu lhon koiham?
Geltwi le daibangin twi chu song asosah-in, Twikhanglen chunga akidalsah jie.
Ahsi bombel ho khu nakan gom theiya, Ngambom lungthu ahsi khu nalhap kang theiyam?
Kum kiheichin hetna dia ahsi nalamkai theiya, Ngambom uichal ahsi len le neo nahil thieyam?
Vanthamjol’a kimang Danho nahet’a, Hiche Dan ho hi leiset’a naman theiyam?
Meilhang ho nahohsal theiya, Twi napehna dia nakou lhah theiyam?
Kol naphetsah thei leh Najah a, ‘Nathun kanunge,’ ati ding hinam?
Nile vadung twilet ding vachate seipeh koi hiya, Gojuh ding ahchal hilmasa koiham?
Meilhang simna theiya ching koi hiya, Gotwi sosah theiya ching koi hiya, Gotwi sosah theiya choh chamthei,
Gotwi chu leivui chapnou sah a, Bon ngan sosah thei koiham?
Sakei te ding neh le chah namupeh a, Sakeinou gilkelte navahna khah em?
Akosunga akisel’uva, Akhuh sunga an anga tengu leh!
Va-ahte gilkel nahol teng vahva koi hiya, Anouten an athum teng pejia koiham?
Lhangvuma kolsa nou so phat nahet’a, Sakhi nou so phat nahet-em?
Itih chan nou akolpi nahet’a, Anouso ding phat nahet-em?
Itih tah leh kol’uva Nousoh diu nahet hinam?
Gamlah a anoute akhangdoh-un, Avah mangun ahung kile kitji pouve.
Koiham gam sa-ngante jalensah a, Lhathanga vathangsah a khu?
Gammang lah a chensah a, Chikhuh dunga lhatsah a Kei kahi!
Khopi husa kijah phah louna aum’un, Koiman vah a natohsah din ajoupoi.
Lhang sang dunga alhauvin, Neh din hamhing dum ahol leuve.
Gambong chal’in na natohpeh theiya, Nabongbuh a geh mong nam?
Khao nakhia lou nakaisah a, Naloulaiya langkon nakaisah theiyam?
Bongchal thahat nason a Na hahsa natohpeh ding naginchat am?
Changphal nalo khom peh a Cahngphol a nakaipeh dia nagel ham?
Va-ngonsaovin lha ijatvei ajap’a, Patva len alengthei nam?
Va-ngongsaovin tol’a tui aop’in, Leihu ahulsat sah theiye.
Ikhat’in achotkeh peh ding ahephapon, Gamsan aholgoi peh thei jong ahepoi.
Ama tui lou bangin agel’in, Hahsa tah a athah lhah jong khohsah lou bangin aum’e.
Hibanga ngolsah a Chihsah lou chu Kei kahi.
Hinla adin janga kithinga alhai leh, Sakol adeljamin achunga toupa geiyin akichai!
Hibanga sakol hatsah a, Angongmul bah kesah hi nang nahim Job?
Sakolte khaokhopi chop a chopsah a, Nah khon gin hamdeldul sah hi nang nahim?
Phaicham tolgo akhot’in, Galmun thal le teng lah anolut jeng jie.
Kichat tijat ahepouvin, Chemjam masanga gingdan ahipouve.
Sakol chung touho gal manchah Thal le tengkol nisan akhoval lah lah-e!
Lung hangtah-in sakolten maanouvin, Sumkon kimut teng adding thim theipouve.
Sumkon gin chai tengleh ahamin, Galmun aphah masangin Galvui nam ajan, Gal lamkaiten mano dia Lhang asap’u ajauve.
Mu khu lenje nahil hiya, Lhanglam nga leng thei ham?
Muvanlai khu molvum sang laiya Bu asahna dinga nang thupeh anga ham?
Songpi vum a bu akisen, Songpi khi kah chu kulpin aneiye.
Songpi chunga konin gamtin aven, Ganhing thaa neh ding ave-lhi.
Thilong phunga muthong akikhomun, Anoute thisan achop’ui,” ati.
Pakaiyin Job jah a aseitei:
“Job, Nangin Hatchungnung Pathen nachouve, Na-ngah didng ham ahiloule nadonbut ding ham?” ati.
“Ka-ngol thu kasei ahitai Pakai, Ipia kadonbut thei nah lai ding ham?
Ima ma jong keiman Seida tang’e!
Kasei ding abonchan kaseisoh tai, Velsei kit taponge,” ati.
Hichun huipi le gopi, chule chimpei lah akonin Pakaiyin Job jah a ahinseiyin:
“Pasal nahileh dinginkadoh chengse neidonbut’in.
Kei hi moso ding neigot’a, Nang kithemsah a Kei mosah neigot ham?
Kei banga nahat am? Kei banga na-oginin van akithisah jouvam?
Najo leh, kilsetsah le gunche tah-in dingin, Minthangna le loupe nan kivontemin.
Mi kiletsahte khu ven lang, Lung hankhumin su-lha temin.
Ahi, ven lang loilhu, Migiloute adin muna noigep’in.
