Eihotbol kamelmate houset le ohin Ka-ngai ngai jengin ahi!
Neitepnau kasuh keh dauva, Nang kasuhmil lou vangun Hichengse hi kachunguva Alhungsoh tai.
Nangla lheptol’in kabol pouvin, Nathupeh chengse kanitda pouve.
Ahinla gamsahang lah a neidalhauvin, Muthim lhangkhal jing lah a neidondauve.
Ka-Pathenu chibai kaboh dauva, Doi kahoutah-u jongleh,
Nahetdoh tei ding ahi, Ajeh chu kalungthim jouseu nahesoh-e.
Tunla Nang kahoujeh-un thading salhemin eikikoiyun, Tha dia koisa kelngoi bangin eikiboltauve.
Thouvin Pakai! Idia na-ihmut ham? Kipat’in, donda hel din neigel hih-un!
Idia kiselmang nahim? Kagenthei hesoh nau sumil hih-in!
Tol’a eichit thangun, Kalel jeh-un leivui lah a kalumden tauve.
Neihung panpiuvin, Nalungset long loujeh-in neihuhhingun!

Kalungthima thu ngei adimtan, Lengpa kalachoiye! Lekhasunpa lekhamol gonsa bangin Labol din kalei akilehgotai.
Pasal mel-houpen nahin, Thusei nathemin, Pathenin vang naboh jinge!
Nachemjam kikon, Vo leng thahat! Naminthangin nalal loupi!
Adih a panga adih a thutan din Galjou din sakol chunga hung touvin! Nathahat chun minthangtah-in Gal jouvin nate!
Nathalpi chang ahem theiyin, Namelmate lungchang akap pai jel jel’e; Namtin vaipi Nakhomuh a aboh khup’ui!
O Pathen, nalenggamin beitih neipontin, Thudih-in namite vai nahoppeh-e!
Nangin thilpha nadeiyin thilse nahoi; Hijeh chun Pathen, na-Pathenin lengdin nalhenge. Leng dang joouse sangin Kipa nopna napei!
Naponsil jouse myrrh le aloe gimvui anamin, Saihaa kijem leng inpia lathemhon nalem’ui!
Naleng inpia lhacha numeiho jong Lengte chanu jeng ahiuvin, Nalaltouna jetlama lengnu adingin, Ophir gama sana hoipenin akijem’e!
Kasei ngaiyin lengpa jia kipuinu! Namite le na-insung mite geldatan!
Namel-hoi jeh-in lengpan deichan natin, Napu jong ahijeh a athu na-ngai ding ahi.
Tyre gam miten thilpeh ding thil hinpon tin, Mihaoten nalung lhaina ahinhol diu ahi!
Leng inpia leng chanu aumin, amel-hoi lheh-e! Sana monkenga kijem poncho asil’e.
Aponchol jempah pumin lengpa henga apuiyun, Alhacha nu-ngah hon ajuiyun, abonin lengpa henga apuitauve.
Kipah thanomin ahungun, Leng inpia alut tauve.
Vo nangama kalengpa, Chapa tampi hingin, Leng changu hen napate khel’u hen, Leiset pumpi vaihomin pansah-in!
Kalabol hin naming seithang jingin tin, Akhang khanga min navahchoi diu ahi!

I-kiselnau le ihatnau Pathen ahin, Genthei teng kithopi din eigo jingui.
Hijeh chun leiset pumpi kihot ling hen, Molsang jouse Twikhanglena kileh lut jongle I-kichat lou diu ahi.
Twikhanglen kidil hen kinong hen, Thinglhang jouse hotjal jongle kichapoute.
Vadung khat alongin, Pathen khopi Chungnungpen Houin thenga kipana ahinlhut’e.
Khopia chun Pathen apansan, Koiman khopi chu sumangponte; Jingkah matah a hungkona Khopi chu Pathenin akithopi ding ahi.
Namtin vaipi akichauvin, Lenggam jouse akilingsoh tauve; Pathenin lhang asamin, Leiset ajol lhatai!
Thaneipen Pakaiyin eiumpiuvin, Jacob Pathena kisel ahiuve.
Hungun Pakai natoh hung veuvin, Veuvin itobang datmo thil abol hitam!
Vannoiya gal kisat jouse avotangin Thalchang aheh bongin, tengcha avobongin, Lum jouse ahal vamsoh tai!
“Umthim’uvin, heuvin Pathen kahi; Namtin vaipi lah a chungnungpen, Vannoiya thanei chungnungpen kahi,” ati.
Thaneipen Pakaiyin eiumpiuvin, Jacob Pathena kisel ahiuve!

Mitin vaipi kipah-in khut bengun! Othongin la san Pathen vahchoiyun!
Ginpen ding Hatchungnungpen Pakai ahin, Leng loupe ahin, vannoiya vai ahom’e!
Mitin vaipi eijosah-un, Namtin vaipi chunga vai eihomsah-ui!
Chemun gam eipeuvin, Angailut amite hoithopi gam anapei.
Pathenin alaltouna ajontouvin, Kipana kholhang akisamin sumkon akimut’e! Pakai akitol toutai!
Sauvin Pathen vahchoi la! I-Lengpau vahchoi la sauvin!
Vannoi pumpi leng Pathen ahi, Sauvin avahchoina La!
Pathen alaltouna thenga atouvin, Namtin vaipi vai ahompeh-e!
Namtin vaipi vaihomte Abraham Pathen mite toh akikhom’ui! Gal-hat jouse sanga hatpen Pathen ahin, Minthengtah-in vai ahom’e!

Aloupi Pakai chu, I-Pathenu khopi, Alhang theng chunga Loupi tah a vahchoi ding ahi!
Pathen molsang Zion, Asangin ahoiye; Leng loupipen khopi Vannoi dia kipana ahi.
Akhopi kulpi sunga Pathen amatah Kulpidet’a apandan aphonge!
Leng jouse akikhom’un Zion mol nokhum din ahungtauve!
Ahin Zion molsang amuphat’un akichauvin, Atijauvin ajamtauve!
Kichan akihot lhulsoh tauvin, Numei naosoh ding bangin na asalheh-ui!
Tarshish kong innei Khopihui kinonglai toh kha abangui!
Thaneipen Pakai i-Pathenu khopi sunga Pathen natoh thu kanajauvin, Tun mit’in jong kamutauve; Pathenin akhopi ahoidam jing ding ahi.
O Pathen nahouin sunga Nalungset long lou kageldoh-ui!
Muntina min navahchoiyin, Leiset chunga naminthangsoh tai! Thudih-in vai nahomin,
Adih-in thu natan’e Zion mite kipah hen! Judah gam khopi jouse kipah hen!
Pathen mite Zion kimvel’in kijot’un, Insang lai jouse simtoh-un!
Khopipal malchih-un, Akulpi kholtoh-un! Khangkit’a mite naseipeh diu ahi.
“Hiche Pathen hi tonsot’a i-Pathenu ahin, Phat jousea eilamkai diu ahi,” tiuvin.

Hiche hi ngaiyun mitin vaipin, Muntin aching,
Alen aneo, ahao avaiyin Ngai cheh-uvin!
Thuh tah-in lung kagel’in, Chihna thujeng kaseiye.
Thuchih jeng ngai phang ting, Semjang saito thon hilchen inge!
Melman eiumchah a, Aneile agouva kisong ho
Ahao kiletsah piten eium jongleh Hitobang phatsea jong hin kakichapoi!
koila ama kilhatdam theipon tin, Ahinkho manjat Pathen apeh jou deh lou ding ahi.
Mihem man akisim joupon, Ijat kipejongleh lhing ponte;
Tonsot’a hing jinga Thina lhankhuh ajotda lou ding ahi.
Mi-ngol mivaichate thi bangin Michingte jong athin, Anei agou jouseu jong Midang adalhah pehji tauve.
Mihem gampi le pua anapan vangun Alhankhuh-uva akijamji tauvin, Hikoma hin aumdenji tauve.
Mihem aloupinan ahinso joupon, Ganchate thi bangin athi thouve.
Ngol-han a anei angaa kisongte Manthah ding dan chu,
Thadia koisa kelngoite bang diu, Thinan kelngoi chin a achin’uva Thiuva tahsa monloi ding, Noimigama cheng sen diu ahi; Midihte vang khovah a vah diu ahi.
Keivang Pathenin eihuhdoh ding, Thinaa kona eihuhhing ding ahi.
Mi khat ahaodoh a Gou alambe jongleh thangsen tijat dan,
Mi athi teng agou apothei pon, Aloupinan jong lhansunga ajuilut theipoi.
Ahinlaiya nomsa jing mi, Athilpha boljeh a pachat chang jong
Tonsot muthim thina geisa Apu pate henga chetai ding ahi.
Mihem aloupinan ahinso joupon, Ganchate thi bangin athi thouve.

Pakai, thaneipen Pathen apaovin, leiset pumpi, so le lhuma konin Mi akou kou jenge!
Khopi hoi chamkimsoh Zion a Pathen avah emsel’e.
I-Pathenu ahungin athongje jui, Amasanga mi halvam thei mei akongin, Huipi le gopi kithon atomsoh keiye!
Amite thu atanna hettohsah a pang din Pathenin van le leiset akouve,
“Kilhaina bol’a keito kitepna semdoh, Tansan umtah kamite hung kikhom’un,” tin akouve.
Pathen dihtah ahile thutanpa ahi Van mun jousen aphongdoh tai.
“Ngaiyun kamite thu seiyinge; Nang douna kasei ding ahi-Israel, Keima hi Pathen, Na-Pathen kahi.
Kilhaina hijat naboljeh le Tang louva pumgo thilto neipeh jeh a Them kachansah ding nahipoi.
Na-insoh bongchalte kaseipon, Nakel-hon lah a kelchate jong kadeipoi.
Ajeh chu gamsa jouse keiya ahin, Mol le lhang san gkhat’a lha Gancha jouse keiya ahi.
Vacha jouse jong keiya ahin, Gamlah ganhing namkim keiya ahiuve.
“Kel jong leng nahenga thum ponge, Leiset pumpi le adunga um jouse keiya ahi.
Bongchal sa kaneh monga, Kelcha thisan kadon mong-em?
Pathen koma nakilhai sangin Thangvah jon lang, Hatchungnung Pathen henga Nakitepna jat molson,
Nagenthei teng hung taovin, Nahuhhing ing ting neivahchoi ding ahi,” ati.
Mihilou jah a Pathenin, “Idia kathupeh chengse chinpha naseiya, kakitepna chu naseile ham?
Kahilgot le nadan, Kathupeh chengse napaitai.
Gucha namuphah chanto nakiloiyin, Mi jonbolte to nakivop’e.
“Thuse nasei nom jingin, Kho-ngai louhel’in joujeng naseiye.
Nasopite douna jeng naseigo jingin, Athemmo nau hodoh nago jingjie.
Hicheng hi nabolten, Kalimsah hih laiye; Hijeh chun nang tobang din neigel’in ahi. Tua vang kaphoa kahilchet nahi.
“Einahsah louten hiche hi ngaiyun, Achutiloule kasuhmanguva Koiman nahuhhing jou lou diu ahi.
Thangvahna neiyan kilhaiya eijabol ahin, kasei ngai jouse kahuhhing tei ding ahi,” ati.
O Pathen neikhoton, Nalungset longlou ahi; Namikhotona alene, Kachonset jouse theh ngimin!
kagitlouna jouse sop lhan, Kachonset’a kon neisuthengin!
Kamona jouse kahen, kachonset ho kahejinge!
Nang douna mong monga chonsea, Nahotpen kabol ahitai! Hijeh chun dihtah-in neibol’in, Mo neichanjeh-in nadih tai.
Chonsesa kajil’a Themmosa hung peng kahi!
Nangin kitahna le thutah nadeiyin, Hiche ding hin chihna kalunggil’a neikhumpeh-in!
Kachonset sumangle chun theng tange. Neisop le chun buhbang bangin bang jonge!
Neimehgep a neisuhgoisa hijongleh Kipana la thanopna ogin neijahsah kit’in, Chuteng kipah thanom kit tange!
Kachonset ho neivetpeh dan, Kagitlouna chengse theh ngimsoh-in!
O Pathen, kalungsung semthah-in, Kasunga tomngaina lhagao thah neikhumpeh-in!
Nakoma konin neisel mang dan, Kachunga na-Lhagao Theng lamang hih-in!
Namihuhhing kipana neipekit’in, Thanom tah-in nathua neinunsah-in!
Chuteng chonsete nathupehho kahil’a, Nahenga hung kilekit diu ahi.
O Pathen, neihuhhingin neilhing hoiyin, Chuteng kipah-in nadihna seichoi lenge!
Pakai kathusei neipanpin, Chuteng nangma vahchoiyinge!
Kilhaina jong nadeipon, Toh jeng jong leng pumgo thilto jong nadeipoi.
O Pathen, lung lengvaiya kisih hi Kilhaina sangin nadeijon; Hijeh chun lung lengvaiya kisihte Nahsah mo pon nate!
O Pathen, Zion khopi khoton panpin, Jerusalem kulpi jouse kaiphan!
Chuteng adih a kilhaina kibol’in tin Nalungna chim ding; Namaicham phunga pumgo thilto kipea, Bongchaltea kilhaina kinei ding ahi.


Vo mihatpa, idia nathilse bol Nakiletsahpi ham? Pathen mingailut hi tonsot’a ahibouve.
Midang suhmangna ding jeng nagon, Namuh themsiu seucin; Semthu jouthu jeng naseiye.
Thilpha sangin thilse nadeijon, Thutah sangin jouthu nadeijoi.
Mijoupa, midang suhgetna jeng naseiyem ong!
Pathenin nang nasuhmang hel ding, Namat’a na-ina kona nakaimang ding ahi; Mihing leiset’a kona Napaidoh ding ahi.
Midihten amuteng tijauvintin, Nanuisat’uva,
“Ven, Pathena kisong loupe, Anei anga jenga kisonga Athilse bol chengse Kisonnaa neipa pi khu,” tiuvinte.
Keivang Pathen Houin sunga Olive thing hing kabangin, Atonsot atonsot’a din Pathen lungset long louva kakisonge.
O Pathen, nathilbol ho jeh a Nangma kathangvah jing ding, Namite angsunga Naphatna kahonjal ding ahi.


Mi-ngolten, “Pathen aumpoi,” atiuvin, Nehguh a kivah jeng, Thet umtah tah bol ho, Thildih bol khatcha aumpoi.
Miching, Pathen hol aum khat leh, Tin Vana konin Pathenin mihemte ahinvei.
Hinla akiheimangsoh keiyun, Kibang cheh-in aphamouvin, Thildih bol khatcha aumpon, Khat’a khat jong abeihel’e.
“Kamite chomgama, Kahenga tao kha louhel, Hiche thilse jeng bolte hi Kho helou khat hiuva, Imacha jong ahetlou tah bah-u ham,” Tin Pathenin aseiye.
Anasoh kha louhel Pathenin Amite kidoupi ho gu le chang Athethangsoh tengleh Abonchauva tijat thi diu ahi. Pathenin adonlou ahitan, Amaho mangthah diu ahitai.
O Ziona konin Pathen hung hen Israelte gal josah tave leh! Pathenin Isarel ahaodohsah teng Jacob insung iti kipa thanop diu hitam!

Vo Pathen naminin neihuhhingin, Nathahat’in neihongin!
O Pathen kataona ngaiyin, Kasei neigelpeh-in!
Mi kiletsahten eidel khumun, Pathen ginglou engseten thadin eigo!
Hinla eipanpia Pathen ahin, Eihuh a Pakai ahi.
Kagalte hi Pathenin thilsen lethuh hen, Kitah tah Pathen ahijeh-in abonchan sumang hen!
O Pakai, naphat jal’in Kipah tah-in nahenga kilhiaying ting, Nangma thangvah tange!
Kagimna jousea neihoidoh tan, Kamelmate nasuhmang kamutai!


O Pathen kataona ngaiyin, Kathum nungsun dan!
Ngaiyin neihouvin, Lunggim lih pai ding kahitai!
Kamelmaten kindot dot’in eilhan, Migilouten einehgep pai diu ahitai. Gimna jeng eilhut khumun, Eilunghan’un eiho’uve!
Kakicha behseh jengin, Kathillo paiding ahi!
Kichan kakithing thingin, tijalih pai ding kahitai!
Ohe, vakhu bangin lhaving neiying, Leng mangin choldo mun gahol leng!
Gamla tah aleng ing ting, Gamthip laiya cheng tange!
Huipi le gopi masanga jong Kiselna mun muloi tange!
O Pakai, kamelmate kihoutoh mon lhan! Khopi sunga kinah l ekidou kamun,
Sun le janin khopi aum’uvin, Adihlou le hesohna jeng abol’uve.
Muntina thil le lo asuseuvin, Kholai dung jousea mi abolseuvin abolgentheiyui!
Melman eidaithang hileh Kathoh thei ding, Kakidoupin kiletsahna einei hileh Kakisel mang thei ahi.
Kadoulel hila kahetsa, kaloi kagol ngaitah nang nahibouve!
Thu ngei ngei iseikhom jin, Houin ikaikhom ji lhon me!
Kamelmate hi aphat lhon masangin thiu hen, Ahing laiyin noimigam jon’u hen; A-insunguva jong thilse jeng, Alunguva jong thilse jeng aum’e!
Hinla eipanpi din Pakai Pathena kataove, eihuhhing nante.
Jingkah nalhah sunin Kagimna le kakiphinna aheng alhung jinge, Aman ka-ogin janante.
Melma hijat kidoupi kanei vangin Galmuna konin jong Kitup keiyin eihinle pui kit nante.
Tonsot’a vaihom Pathenin Kataona ngaiyintin amaho ajo ding ahi. Ajeh chu amahon lung aheipouvin, Pathen jeng jong agingpouve.
Masanga kagol’in aloite adelkhumin, Akitepna jouse asukeh tai.
Athuseiho khoiyu sangin analhumjon, Alungthima vang mi avetdan ahoi; Asei jouse thao bangin anal’in, Hinla chemjam hem banga mithat thei ahi.
Nagimna jouse Pakai chunga sep lhan, Aman nakhankho gel nante; Aman itih-in jong midih Gal alelsah ngaipoi.
O Pathen, tolthatte le mijouho khu, Hinkho bang khaiyin kokhuh a leh lut’in! Keivnag hi Nanga ki-ngai jing inge!

O Pathen neikhoton, Nilhum lhumin kamelmaten Eibolgentheiyun, Kengton eichil chil jengui!
Nilhum hel’in eidel khum khum jengun, Eidouva atam behseh jengtauve.
Kakichat phat hin Nanga kakingaiye, O Hatchungnung Pakai!
Kicha louvin Pathena kakisongin, Athutep jal’in kathangvah-e! Tahsa mihem mai maiyin I-eilo thei idng ham?
Kamelmaten nilhum lhumin eibol gentheiyun, Kei dsuhsetna ding jeng agong’ui,
Kiselna thei channa akikhom’un, Eithana diuvin kabolchan amelchih-ui!
O Pathen, akhanset jeh-un engbol’in, Lung soutenin mitin vaipi tolse nan neiyin!
Kagimna nahesoh keiyin, Kamit lhilon namelchih jingnan, Abonchan nalekhabua najih lutsoh tai!
Nahenga katao ni nil eh Kamelmate nungjamsoh diu, Hijeh hin Pathenin eipanpi kahei!
Hiche Pakai hi Athutep chengse kathangvah-in;
Kison nan kaneiyin ima kagingpoi, Tahsa mihem mai maiyin I-eilo thei ding ham?
Vo Pathen, kakitepna jat napeng ting, Kathangvahna thilto peng’e!
Ajeh chu thi idngsa neihuhdoh tan, Gal neijosah tai. Hijeh chun Hinna khovah Pathen angsunga kavah lei.

Neikhoton O Pathen neikhoton, Naheng kahinbel’e! Khopihui le gopin eidalhah kahsen Nalhaving noiya kakisel’e!
Chungnungpen Pathen, kangaichat chan eipethei Pathen henga kataove.
Vana kon eihouva eihuhhing ding, Eibolsete asuhnem’a kitahtah le Long louva eilungset ding ahi.
Mihingnea sakeite bangin Kamelmaten eiumkimsoh tauvin; Ahau tengham le thal-hem abange, Aleiyu jong chemjam hemtah abangin ahi.
Vo Pathen, vanthamjol’a nalalna phongin, Leiset pumpi chunga naloupi phongin!
Kamelmaten lenpel eisonpeh-un, Hesoh lih pai ding kahi. Kalampi khuh alaiyun, Hinla amahojoh alhalut tauve.
Vo Pathen, lung dettah-in kapange, Navahchoila sange!
Thouvin kalhagao, Kipat’un selangdah le kasemjang, Nipilai jeng jong Kahoh khah lo ding ahi.
O Pakai, namtin vaipi laiya Nangma thangvah inge; Namtin japi lah a Navahchoi la sange!
Nalungset longlouvin van aphan, Nakitahnan vanthamjol aphai!
Vo Pathen, vanthamjol’a nalalna phongin, Leiset pumpi chunga naloupi phongin!

Vaihomten adih a thu natanu hinai, Mitin thu kitoh a nabolpeh jiu hinam?
Ahinaisaipoi, thilse jeng nagel’un, Leiset’a pumhat’in asejeng nabol’u!
Migiloute chu ahinkho lhumkeiyin Lamdih lou jenga acheuvin, Apen niuva pat Thujou jeng aseiyui!
Gul banga gu nei jeng ahiuvin, Gulsum na-ngong bangin akolseh-ui.
Gulsumin gulsaiho theile gin ajapon, Guldoi choiho phunsam jong ajapoi.
O Pathen sakei tobangte ha subongin, Sakeinou tobangte tenhem sunil’in Pakai!
Hohtwi long mang bangu hen, Hampa kichonthang bangu hen!
Dahdeng goden bangu hen lang, Ni mulou naosen pengsol bangu hen!
Ahet masnagun hampa kisattan bangu hen, Ahing laiyun Pathenin alunghan teng mu tmang hen!
Chonseten talen amat teng Midihte kipah diu; Midihten chonsete thisan kengtoa achil thang diu ahi.
Mihon, “Midih-in kipaman akisanin, Leiset thutan Pathen aum monge,” ati diu ahi.

Kamelmatea konin neihuhhingin Pathen, Eisel khumtea konin neihuhdoh-in!
Migiloutea konin neihuhhingin, Tolthattea konin neihuhdoh-in!
Ven, tha din eichang lhiuvin, Eidou din migiloute akikhom’ui! Chinsetna le bolkhel kaneijeh jong ahipon,
Themmona kaneijeh jong ahipoi Pakai, Hibanga akinothe thu vangun!
Kipantan Pakai thaneipen Pathen, Keima neipanpin; Vo Israel Pathen! Namtin vaipi talen matsah tan. Joulhep hat thilse bolte Khatcha jong khoto dan!
Nilhah teng ahung kit jiuvin, Khopi sunga akijot’un uichate bangin apengset dot’ui.
Mi aphin’uva a-enghou nau ngeiyun, Aleiguiyu chemjam hem hat abangin, Athuseiyu koiman ajah loudin agel’ui!
Amaho khu nuisat’in Pakai, Namtin vaipi khu daithangin!
O Pathen kakisonpi Kakiselna nahi!
Eingailua ka-Pathenin eihung vil ding, kamelmate gal lel eimusah ding ahi.
Amaho hi thadan Pathen, Achutiloule kamiten sumil’unte; Nathahat’in thethangin lang Sunemdoh-in eihuhhingu Pakai!
Chonset thujeng aseiyun, Asei jouseu chonsetna jeng ahi. AKiletsah nauva kipal’u hen, Mi agaosap’un jou aseiyui.
Lung hangin sumangin, Abonchauvin sugamhel’in! Chuteng Israel chunga Pathen vaihom Mitinin ahetsoh ding, Leiset pumpia avaihom hi Kihedohsoh hel ding ahi.
Kamelmate nilhah teng ahung kit jiuvin, Khopi sunga akijot’un uichate bangin apengset sot’ui.
Ui anholmo helbangin Kholai dunga akijot le leuve.
Genthei nikhoa kakiselna kulpi Nang, Nathahat vahchoi la sang ting, Jingkah she leh nalungset longlou Jailan oiyinge!
Eingailua Pathen, Kakiselna Pathen, Eipanpi jing Nangma vahchoila sange!

Neilunghan jeh-un, Kagalpal jouseu phe lhan lang, Neipaidoh ta jongleur chun Tun neihungvil kit’un Pathen!
Leiset lingpin hot’in lang, Akeh lhapai ding ahitai Tun kichisah kittan!
Namite neibolgim behseh-un, Jukham bangin kalonle letauve!
Amanthah louna diuvin Natahsante nahilchah masajie.
Namingailutte hoidohna din, Kataonau sangin lang Nathahat’in neihuhhingun!
Amunthenga konin Pathenin, “Kajothoa Shechem kahop khen ding, Sukkoth phai kamite kahoppeh didng ahi.
Gilead le Manasseh keiya, Ephraim kathih lukhuh, Judah kaleng tenggol ahi.
Moab kakengto sop ding, Edom kachotpha ding; Philistia hanla kasha den sing ahi,” ati.
Vo pathen, koiham kulpia eikailut’a, Edom a eikai ding koi ham?

Khutbengun vahchoiyun! Hamlah lah-in khut bengin vahchoiyun!
Ganhing namkimin Pakai vahchoiyun! Vahchoiyun Pakai!



















































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































Jerusalem khopia leng chang, David chapa, michingthempa thusei ho chu hicheng hi ahi.
Michingthempan thil ijakai hi pannabei jengin aseiye. Hinkho jong pannabei, ijakai hi pannabei ahi.
Hinkhon cholle nangin na natongun, ahivangin ipi phatchomna vetsah ding naneiyum?
Mihem khang akichaiyin khang chom chom ahungin, leiset la baep’in aum jinge.
Nisa la asona ngaiya asoh jingin, alhumna ngaiya alhumin, chille nangin ahung kipat kitna ding mun a akile kit’in ahi.
Hui jong sahle lhang, simle mal, kolkimvel’a avel vel’in anung kimvel vel jenge.
Vadung jouse Twikhanglen la along lut’in, Twikhanglen la adim deh poi. Twi chu luidung nah dunga ahung kipanlit’in, avel’in ahung kitol kit’e.
Thil ijakai cholna jeng ahin, chol aum behseh jengin seijou jai ahipoi. Mit la vet achimpoi.
Asohsa thil chu hung soh kit ding ahi. Akibolsa thil chu kibol kit ding ahi. Vannou pumpia hin thil thah aumpoi.
Mihon, “ven, hikoma thil thah aum’e!” atiuve. Ahivangin hiche jong hi masang, ipen masangpeh-uva sohsa ahitai.
Masanglai thilsoh chu koiman ageldoh pon, tulai min jong khonung thilsoh ding le tukah a thilsoh ding geldoh ponte.
Michingthempa kei hi Jerusalem khopia, Israel chunga, leng kana change.
Vannoi leiset’a kibol kitong thil jouse hi kholchil ding, phot chet din kakiteptai. Pathenin mihem abolna vang hi nopna him him ahipoi.
vannoi leiset’a kibol thil jouse kamun, kaseipeh nahi, aboncha pannabei jeng hai. hui leng lai mat ding go bep akihi.
Akonsa le sujang theipon natin, aum loula simtha theipon nate.
Kalungthimin, “kaminthang lheh tan, kamasanga Jerusalem a lengvaippote jouse sangin kachingjoi. Chihna le hetna jong ipi mong mong kiseina ahi kahetai,” kati.
Hetna le ngolna kibah lou je, chih le ngol kibah louje hetdoh kagoi. Hichea jong hin hui lenglai mat godol’in kakihei.
Nachih cheh le nalung gimbe cheh, nahetbe jep le nalung natbe cheh ding ahi.
Nom satah a uma, nopna hi hatchet tei kagoi. Ahinla hiche jeng jong hi pannabei ahi kamu dohtai.
Nui ngolna ahiya, nopsah nan thilpha aso sah lou jong kahe dohtai.
Kachih nom behseh jeh-in, kisuh lipna din ju kadonin nom um ding kagoi. Leiset hinkho chomcha sunga hitia umding hi mihem dia thil phapen din kanegel’e.
Thil loupe tah tah katongdoh tai: in tampi kakisah-in, Lengpilei tampi kakibol’e.
Hon le pahcha lei kabol’in, thei gathei jouse kaphut’e;
achap nouna ding twikul kalaiye.
Soh tampi kachon, ka-insunga peng den soh jong tampi kavul’e. Kamsasanga Jerusalema leng ho sangin kahaojon gancha tamjo kaneiye.
Kavaipohna gamsunga leng inpi thil kholna chengsea konin sana dangka kapokhomin kasevum leove. Kei nopsahna din numeiyin la asauvin, pasal deichat lom numei chamkim keiyin kaneiye.
Kaloupi lheh jengin, kamasanga Jerusalema cheng leng ho sangin loupin kaumdoh tan, kachihna athon ngaipoi.
Kadeichan kamun; nopsahna thei kalhaso ngaipoi. Katohdoh chan kahoithopin, hiche hi katohman ahimaiye.
Hicheng tohdohna dia hahsa kathoh chengse kagel le imacha pang din aumdoh theipoi. Pannabei hui lenglai mat go bep kahi.
Akhonna kheh a leng khat’in abol thei chu leng masa ho bolsa chubou ahi. Hijeh chun hcihna le chihgil chule ngolna umdol hi kagel pantai.
Hiche vang hi kahetai—“Chihna hi ngolna sangin aphajon, muthim sanga khovah phatchom tobang ahi.
Michingin kaselna ding akihet’in, mi-ngol’in kho amupoi,” kati. Chule iboncha ithi cheh diu jong kahe dohtai.
Kalungin, “Mi-ngol ho banga kathitei ding ahi. Achutile hibanga kahcih hi ipi kaphat chompim?” kati. Kei le ken, “Thil imcha cha phat chompi kaneipoi,” tin kaseiye.
Miching geldohna jong aumppon, mi-ngol geldodhna jong aumppoi. Khonung tengle koiman eigeldoh pouvinte. Miching mi-ngol iboncha itih cheh diu ahi.
Hijeh hin mihem hinkho hi imacha ding katipoi, ajehc hu hinkhon gim hesoh tilou adang ima eipetheipoi. Pannabei hel ahin, hui lenglai man go bep kanahi.
Katohsa le kabolsa chengse phatchom nan kaneipon, kakhel’a pang dinga dia kadalhah ding kahei;
ama chu miching hithei, mi-ngol hithei-kon ija ahet’em? Hoijoh hile katohsa, kachihnan hiche leiset’a atohdoh chengse, aman alo ding ahi. Aboncha pannabei jeng ahibouve.
Hibang hahsa na katoh chu kakisih lheh jenge.
Nachihna le nahetna, nathepna mangcha natohdoh chengse chu atong louhel khat nadalhah peh didng ahi. Pannabei hel, thil dih lou ahi!
Hinkhoa lung gim hesoh a na natoh a, ipi tohman nasan ding ham?
Nahinlai damsunga natohdoh chengsen thil dang sodoh pontin, lung gimna le lung natna bou asodoh ding ahi. Janin jong lung ol’in naum thiepoi. Aboncha pannabei jeng ahi.
Mihem toh thei thilpha pen chu-atohga neh a don ding, nomsa tah aum didng hi ahi.Ahinla hiche jeng jong hi Pathen peh a kimubou ahi kahedoh tai.
Hiche tilou chu thil dang ipi neh a nomsa naum thei ding ham?
Pathenin adei bolte chu chihna, hetna chule nopna apeh ahi; chonsete vang natong sumhol’a apansah a, alodohsah a akholsah kit’a, Pathen lungtohte peh dia akoisah ahi. Aboncha hi pannabei bep, hui lenglai man dia kigo bep ahibouve.
Hiche vannoi leiset a thilsoh jouse hi Pathenin asosah nom phat dungjuiya soh cheh ahi.
Pen phat aumsah-in, thi phat aumsah-e; Thing phu phat aumin, thing bodoh phat aum’e.
Suhlih phat aumin, boldam phat aum’e. Sahdoh phat aumin, phet lhah phat aum’e,
Gim phat aumsah-in, nop phat aumsah-e; Lunghem phat aumin, lam phat aum’e.
Kidei phat aumin, kihotphat aum’e; Kichopto phat aumin, kichop lou phat aum’e.
Thil holdoh phat aumsah-in, thil mansah phat aumsah-e; Loidoh phat aumin, semang phat aum’e.
Bo-eh phat aumin, khuibit phat aum’e; Umthim phat aumin, paopoh phat aum’e.
Ki-ngai phat aumsah-in, kihot phat aumsah-e; Kisat phat aumin, kicham phat aum’e.
Itoh gimchengseuva kona ipi imudoh-um?
Pathenin pohgih hahsa eipohsah-u kahei.
Aman thil ijakai din phat kitoh che’tin akoiye, Khonung thu ding hetnomna eipeuvin, ahivangin athilbol lhingset’a het’a lung nachimpi ding eiphalpeh pouve.
Hijeh chun ihinlai damsunguva itoh thei chan toh a nopsah pi ding hi toh thei penin kahei.
Ibonchauva itohga neh a don ding, nopsah pi ding ahi. Hiche hi Pathen thilpeh ahi.
Pathen thilbol jouse beitih neilou ding kahei. Bolbe thei jong hilou, lahdoh thei jong hilou ahi. Pathen thilbol khat chu-ibonchauva Ama eiginsah got’u ahi.
Thilsoh ho le asoh ding ho hi asohsa ahitai. Asohsa chu Pathenin avel vel’a asosah ahibouve.
Achung chonin, vannoiya hin thudih kiseiya thildih bolna dinga gitlouna namudoh ding kahetai.
Kachangseh-in, “Thilsoh jouse le thil kibol chengse hi aphat dungjui cheh a soh ahijeh-in, Pathenin midih le migilou thu kibanga atan ding ahi,” tin kagel’e.
Eiho hi ganchate sanga phajo deh lou ihiu vetchetna dia Pathenin eipatep dol’un kahei.
Hoi hileh-mihem hihen gancha hileh thei cheh ding ahi. Khat thi banga jong thi thou ahi.Ahoi hoi hiya thilsem gel ahi. Mihem jong gancha sangin aphachom dehpoi, ajehc hu hoijoh ding ahin hinlo aumpoi.
Mun khat ajot lhon a, leivui sohgel ding ahi. Leivuiya kisemgel, leivui sohgel ding ahi.
Mihem lhagao van a akaldoh mongin, gancha lhagao lei noiya ache monge, ti kon asei thei dang ham?
Hijeh chun thilpha pen a kagel chu itohsa chunga lung nom a um ding hi ahi. Bol thei dang ineipouve. Ithi nung tengu ipi aso ding hetdoh theina lampi ineipouvin ahi.
Vannoi leiset’a thil dihlou kibol chengse kavei. Bolsetna thohte aka vangun koiman apanpi deh poi. Abolsetau chu thanei thu neiloi ahijeh-un koiman apanpi nagmpoi.
Thia mangsa ka-otchajo tai; ahing nalaiho sangin amaho chun nom asajouve.
Athi le ahing sanga phajo cheh kit chu-apen a peng lou, vannoiya thil dihlou kibol mukha louhel ho chu ahiuve.
Mihon hibanga kihanlhoten a na atoh-u jong kahe dohtai; midang tohna thangset jal’a abol’u ahi. Hijongle hiche jong hi pannabei ahibouve.Hui lenglai mat ding kigo bep ahi.
Amahon khut kikhoitum a an ngol’a thia chu angol’in bou aseiyui.
Dih khat nante, ahivnagin khut ong man louhel’a hui lenglai mat ding goa kiseimo jeng sangin, lung ol heocha themcha bou nei aphajoi.
Ken hinkho sunga pannabei khat jong kamudoh-e.
Pasal khat hi achangseh-in achenge. Cha la neipon, sopi jeng jong aneipoi; ahivangin umthim thei louvin na atongin, anei chasun along lhaipipoi. Koi ding bep ngaitoa kicholdoh man louhel’a hibanga na atoh ham? Hiche hi pannabei, hinkho hahsa tah ahibouve.
Khatseh sangin mi ni aphajoi, ajeh chu mi ni akitho theiye.
Khat joh sang lhu lhon jongle khat’in aphong ding theiye. Mi khatseh vang chu lhu ta le aphong ding aumtapoi.
Adap teng mi nin lumkhom alum asah thei ahin, nachangseh a iti lum nasah diu ham?
Mi khat nan lel chu mi nin ananjou tei ding ahi. Khao jang thum kihel lhop botan hahsa ahi.
Leng tehse mi-ngol, thumop sang lou hisangin, vaicha khangdodng miching hi aphajoi.
Hitobang gollhang chu songkul lutsa leng hung chang hijongle, vaicha chaga cha peng hijeng jongle aphajo nalaiye.
Vannoiya cheng mihem jouse kagel’in, hoikom ham alah-uva gollhang khat pen chu lengpa mun hilo ding umkahedoh tai.
Lengin vai apohna sunga hin mipi simsen lou unman tin, lengpa athi teng atohsah koiman gelpha ponte. Hiche hi pannabei, hui lenglai mat dia kigoa tobang ahi.

Houin kaidol ching theiyin. Kho pholou mi-ngolten abol’a kilhaina thil moh to to jeng sanga, thu ngaiya kihil them dia Houin kai aphajoi.
Napaodoh masangin geltoh masan, chule geltoh louvin Pathen koma kitepna bol jeng dan. Pathen van a um, nang leiset’a um bou nahin, nasei dia lombep kalval’in imacha sei hih-in.
Nalung gim cheh le mangse naneibe cheh thei, thu nasei tam chan a ngol-hoi thu naseidoh be thei ahi.
Pathen koma kitepna naneikhah le, tong doh loi jengin, Pathenin mi-ngol adeipoi, bol dia naseisa chu bol jengin.
Kitepsa bolda sangin, kitepna him him boldan aphajoi.
Naseisan kipal dan, Pathen Thempu jah a geldoh louva nabol’in seidan. Idia Pathen nakiphin lung hang ding ham? Nabolse chu i-bol’a nasuh mangsah ding ham?
Mangle bul ijat neiyin lang, pannabei na ijat tongin, thu ijat sei jongle chun, Pathen nagin tei tei ding ahi.
Leiset vaipoten vaichate abol hesoh a, thu dih tanpeh louva, achan diu lom apeh d anamu jongle datmo hih-in. Vaihom thunei jouse chu asanga lenjo khat cheh-in ave-lhi, alenpen jong chu alen cheh khat’in avet lhi jing ahi.
Lengpa jong alalna lhosoh chunga ki-ngam ahibouve.
Sum nadei behseh le, itih-in jong lung nachimna neipon natin; hao lung nagul le, nadei chanmusoh pon nate. Pannabei ahibouve.
Nahao cheh le naneh peh ding jong tambe cheh ahi. Naphat chompi pen chu nahao nahet tho chu ahibep’e.
Natong jing vang chun neh kham kimu hen kimu hih jongle nomsel’in a-ihmu theiyin, mihao vang chu anei lung jin pin ihmu mon akhovah jitai.
Vannoiya thil melse tah khat kamui; mihon khonunga nom neh dingin sum akhol khol’un,
ahivangin hamsetna khat jeh hamin amoh suh mang hel jiuvin, atu acha ding khen louhel’in aumlo jitauve.
Imacha polut louva vannoiya ihung lut bangun, pohdoh neilouvin adalhaji tauve.Tong gim lheh jong leu hen ipohdodh theiyu khat cha aumpoi.
Dih louhel ahi! Ihung lut banguva potdoh kit ahiuve. Itong gim’un, hui lenglai mat ding geiyin igo’uvin, ipi ikimu’vem?
Mitsin khojin le gim hesoh thoh-in ihingun, lung gim le lung phamo chule nat hesoh ithoh-ui.
Hiche hi kamudoh bep’e. Thilpha pen chu min Pathenin apeh ahinkho chom cha sunga hi atohga alhosoh ne le don a nop sahna anei hi ahi; hiche hi mihem chan ahibep’e.
Pathenin mihem chu haole gou pehen, nop sahnan neisah le atoh lo chu kipa pinte. Hiche hi Pathe thilpeh ahi.
Vannoiya hin thil dihlou kibol khat kamui.
Pathenin mihem khat nei le gou, jabolna, ijakai adeichan apen, ahivangin hicheng chu nop sahnan aneisah hih beh-e. APeh louhel khat’in nopsah nan aneijie.Hiche hi pannabei hel, thil dih lout ah ahi.
Mihem khat’in cha ja khat jen nei hen sotpi hing hen, itih chan ahin vangin nop sahna neikha louhel le phate keichan kivui hihle, apenlhah lhah a thipai jeng naosen ma aphajoi, tin kagel’e.
Hiche naosen chu apenlo vang umlou, mitsin khojin gam alut kit, koiman geldoh kit lou ahitai.
Nisa vah jong mupha lou, mihem hinkho umje jong helou ahin, kichol dona beh vang akimui.
Kum sangni jen hing jongle hin nopna hephalou mihem sangin aphajoi.Anigel lhon’a mun khat jon a che lhon ahi.
Mihemin atoh chan kamsung ding ahin, chimla achimdeh poi.
I-atile mi-ngol sanga miching phajo ham? Mi vaichan hinkho manje ahet them chun ipi aphat chomsah mong ham?
Pannabei she, hui lenglai mat go bep ahi. I-khat ngaicha jinga um sanga nanei lung lhaipi chu thil phajo ahi.
Thilsoh jouse hi aso masanga gontohsa ahitan, mihemin asanga hatjo akinelpi thei lou jong ihecheh-ui.
Nakinelpi sot chan a pha mo cheh ahin, phatchom nan naneideh poi.
Nisa lim banga kihei mang loi, hiche pannabei hinkho chomcha sunga hi mihemin ahinkho dia thilpha iti akihet thei ding ham? Athi nung teng leiset’a thilsoh ding kon ija ahet thei ding ham?
Min phat hi thao namtui sangin aphajon, napen nikho sangin nathi in aphajoi.
Golvah na in a lhah sangin lunghemna in a che aphajoi, ajeh chu mihing jousen athi ding sumil louvin aum theiye.
Nui sangin lungkham aphajoi; maiso hoimo sah jongle, lungthim he themna apetheijoi.
Nopsah ding jeng gel mihem chu a-ngol’ah ahi. Michingin thina bou agelkhoh-e.
Mi-ngolten navahchoi la sah sangun, naphoh ding miching nanei aphajoi.
Mi-ngol nuigin chu linghema belto kihet tobang ahin, ajeh apol beihel ahibouve.
Michingin mi alepthol teng ngolchon ahitai. Nehguh nalah teng naming phat kisuhmang nahi.
Thil ijakai akipatna sangin akichina aphajoi. Kiletsah sangin thoh hat aphajoi.
Lung han gloi hih-inl lung ul jing hi ngol thubuh bou ahi.
Itih-in jong, “Itia tulai sanga masanga thil phajo ham?” tin sei hih hel’in. Hiche hi chih hoi thudoh ahipoi.
Mihing jouse chih lom tah ahi; chihna hi gou kilamdoh tobang ahin,
sumin asemdoh thei banga lungmon napethei ahi. Chihnan nahoidoh sah thei ding ahi-hiche hi hetna phat chomna ahi.
Pathen thilbolsa gel’in.Pathenin asemkonsa chu kon ahejang thei ding ham?
Thil ijakai aphat thei pet le kipah-in, gim hesoh hung lhun teng, nopna le gimna Pathen a kon gel ahi geldoh-in; akit teng thilsoh ding ipi ahi nahepoi.
Pannabei kahinkho sung hin thil ijakai kamusoh tai; mipha thi thi jeng thei, migilou hing hing jeng thei ahi.
Hijeh chun phat behseh le chih behseh bol dan-idia nang le nang nakitha ding ham?
Engset val le ngol val jong boldan-idia naphat masanga nathi ding ham?
Chonval tho dan. Hougut nahile lolhing thouvin nate.
Vaipo som khat’in khopi khat akithopi sangin, chihna hin mi ahatsah joi.
Leiset’a hin bol khel neilou thildih bol jing koima aumpoi.
Mi sei jouse ngai hih-in, nasoh pan nahoutom na jong jadoh get’in nate.
Nangin jong tamtah vei midang nahoutom nakihet chu me.
Chihnan hicheng hi kapatep soh tai. Chih ding kago lheh nan sophan hoi ahipoi.
Hinkho umje dol hedoh jou ding koiham? Eiho din athuh val’in, hetdoh hahsa tah ahi.
Hijongle het ding gultenin sim kagon; chihna holdoh tei kagon, kahetnom cheng donbutna mudoh a, ngolna phatmo dan mong mong photchet ding kagoi.
Hichea hin thina sanga khohjo khat kamudoh-e. Hichu numei ahi. Numeiyin nadeichat teng thangkam kilhopel khah le khaova kihen nabah ding ahi; numeiyin nakoichah den teng thih khaova kihen bang bang hin nate. Pathen lung deiya chonpa vang jam doh nan tin, chonsepa vang oh den ding ahitai.
Michingthempan aseiyin, thil ijakai kakhol tohnaa kona hiche hi athem thema kamudoh ahi, tin aseiye.
Thildang kahol vangin khatcha jong kamudohpoi. Pasal sang khat lah a jabol theidol khat bou kamun, numei khatcha jong kamupoi.
Hicheng hi kasimdoh ahi; Pathenin baikhen cha eisemdoh-u ahin, eiho le eiho kisunoh den ahiuve.
Michingin bou thil ho umdol ahethem’e. Chihnan mail lhaisel’in aumsah-in, amelse aselpeh theiye.
Lengpa sei sei bol’in, geltoh louvin Pathen koma kitepna neiloi hihin.
Lengpan abolnom nom abol thei ahi, hijeh chun a-angsunga konin potdoh loiyin, tijat umtah mun ahin umsot dan.
Thuneina neiya lengpa thil bol ahin, athilbol phoh ngam aumpoi.
Athupeh nanit chan a nadia pha, michingin bou itih a ipi bol ding akihet thieye.
Thil ijakai hi adih a bol phat umcheh ahi, eihon imacha ihepouve!
Thil hungsoh dingla ihepouvin, eiseipeh theiyu jong koima aumpoi.
Koima thilou thei aumpon, nathina ding nikho vochon thei jong aumpoi. Hiche hi ijamdoh thei lou nau galmun ahi; lepthol’in jamdoh theipoute.
Vannoiya thil kibol n akitong chengse kagel gelle hicheng hi kamudoh-e, vannoiya hin mihem thanei phabep noiya adangsen gim hesoh athoh-e.
Ahimonge, migiloute thia lhana akivui kamun, lhanphunga konin in lam jot pet’in, masanga thilse tampi abolnau khopia mihon, migilou kavuisa ho pachatna thu aseiyui. Hiche hi mohseh mong ahi.
Ipi dia mipin thilse amoh bol bol jeng ham? Thilse bolte talen kimatsah vah vah loujeh ahi.
Chonsen thilse ja khat cheng bol jongle ahing thei thei nalaiye. Hiche hon asei kahedoh tai, “Pathen thu nanit pou le ima tiponte,
amavang migilouvin hoidohna neiponte. Ahinkhou la nisa lim kihei bep, Pathenthu angai loujeh-uva donthi diu ahi,” atiuve.
Ahinla hiche hi ngol thubuh ahi. Vannoiya ipi soh tam; abang kom le midih-in migiloutalen mat ding amanin, migilouvin midih kipaman san ding asange. Hijeh chun pannabeiyin kaseiye.
Min nom asah ding bou dihjon kageltai; ajeh chu ahinkho lung nopna pen chu aneh a adon a nomsa um ding hi adeipen ahi. Hiche beh hi vannoiya Pathenin apeh hinkho anei laisunga abol thei ahi.
Kichihsah a vannoiya thilsoh hetdoh kagot chanin, sun le jan a hah khovah vah, tou nilhum thei nahi,
Pathen thilbol khat beh nahetdoh thei louhel ding kahedoh tai. Itobanga khohsah-in gut jongle chun mudoh jou deh pon nate. Michingten het go nauvin tin, hedeh pouvinte.
Hiche thudol hi sopi le giltah-in kagel’in, Pathenin michingte le midihte natoh thilbol jouse athu nunin, angailut nau le amihot nau geiyin athu thun ahei theiye. Mihem koiman amsanga thilsoh ding ahepoi.
Imacha akikhenna aumpoi. Midih le migilou, mipha l emiphalou, hougut le houbei, kilhaina thilto pe jingle pelou-kibanga thi cheh diu ahi.Mi chonse sangin mipha aphachom deh pon; kihahsel bolpa jong abol loupa sangin apha dehpoi.
Mi jouse kibanga thi cheh diu ahin, hiche jeng jong hi vannoiya thilsoh lah a dih lou thou thou ahi. Mihemte ahin leisen alung sungu thilse le ngolna dim, het man louva thiji ahiuve.
Amavang mihing gamsunga cheng chun kinepna phabep aneiteiye; uicha hin ghcu sakei thisa sangin aphachom’e.
Ahing’an thi ding akihet’in, athisan vang ima ahetapoi. Kipaman san ding jong anei tapouvin, koiman ageldoh tapouve.
Angailutnau le ahotnau, alung gul’u aboncha thi tha ahitauve. Hiche vannoiya thilsoh lah a pang kit louhel ding ahitauve.
Chen kipah thanomin an kineh-in;lengpitwi kidonin lang kisuhal’in. Pathen din aphanai.
Halpel’in thanom jing jengin.
Vannoiya Pathenin pannabei hinkho naneisah sungsen nadeitah naji to nomsa lhonin. Pannabei nikho ho hi nomsan mangin, hibou chu nacholman ahibep’e.
Natoh chan thakhen louhel’in tongin, ajeh chu nachena ding noimigama chun toh dingle lunggel, hetna le chihna jong abeitai.
Kahetdoh kit thil khat chu-vannoiya hin lhai hatpa jengin jong kilhai tet ajoudeh pon, gal-hangpan jong gal ajo jing ahideh poi. Michingin neh le chah akimuchom a, lungthim chingin haona anei chom a, atongthempan tohmun sang alo chom deh ahipoi. Mitinin toset atoh cheh theiye.
Itih a i-nati ding phat nakihetpoi. Hetman louva vacha thang-oh bang le, nga len a kijeldoh tobanga igel loupet tah-uva phat gilou khat’a oh denji ahiuve.

Mihem tam beh lou chenna, khopi neo thim khat aum’e. Leng thanei tah khat hin adel khumtai. Khopi chu aum chah kheh-in, pal voh chim din agoi.
Khopi sunga hin mi vaicha, ahivanga khopi huhdoh theina khop a ching khat acheng’e. Ahinla koiman ama chu iman agelpoi.
Ken kaei jing chu-chihna hi thahat sanga phachomjo ahin, hijongle koiman vaichapa chu michingin agelpon, asei jong koiman ngaisah-in aneippoi.
Mi-ngolte kikhopnaa lengpa kisen gin ngai sangin, thip beh cha miching houlim ngai aphajoi.
Chihnan gal manchah kimang sangin na ahatoh jon, ahin chonse khat’in thilpha tampi bolsa asuse theiye.
Thicheng phung thoulhen thao namtui kithe jong a-uisah theiyin, ngolna them khat’in chihna loupitah tah asumang hel theiye.
Michingin thildih bol’a, mi-ngol’in thildih lou bol hi chon ngai dol mong ahi.
Mi-ngol ngolna chu hephah lou lampi dunga akitopin jong ahedoh theiye; aman angol chu mitin ahetsah jin ahi.
Nachunga vaipon nalung han teng, haina lekha peh dan; umthim beh le chun bol khel melse tah geiya ngaidam um thei ding ahi.
Vannoiya hin thil dohlou-vaihomten thil dih lou tah abol’u kamudoh tai.
Mi-ngolte panmun len lai lai apeuvin, mihao ho nahsah louvin aumsah tauve.
Soh ho sakol chunga touvin, milen milal ho kengin acheuvin ahi.
Khuh laile chun nang lhalut’in natin, pal tumjal le chun gul’in nachuh ding ahi.
Songtum tangle chun songin nasekhah ding ahi. Thing ehle chun thinghal’in nasekhah ding ahi.
Naheicha mol’a nol-hem louvan hatuh a natuh ngai ahi. Thil ijakai gontoh masah chu chihna joh ahi.
Gul nakihcuh masah sah thei le nagul saithemlo aumpoi.
Michingin thu aseiteng min agin lon, mi-ngol vang aseisaa thi ahibouve.
Chapang thu jeng thupat nan aneiyin, ngol thubuh-in achaiye.
Mi-ngol’in thuchaije helouvin asei sei jengjie. Khonung thilsoh ding koiman ahepon, ithi nung tengu thilsoh ding eihil theiyuva jong koima aumpoi.
Mi-ngol inlam jotle jong kihet lou mi chu natoh achimvah jin ahi.
Lengpa achapan behseh a, lamkaiten jan khovah vah agolnop abol teng gamsungin hahsa athoh lo jie.
Ama chamtah a thu ngahna semdoh thei leng le aphat cha neh le chah kijon thei, kitim them a jukham lou lamkaite neikhaa gamsung chu ahampha ahiuve.
Mihem athaset behseh a inchungse lai tholbit nom lou chu, go vantin, in lhuh lo ding ahi.
Golvah hin nakipasah-in, judon hin nalipsah chom nai; ahivangin sum beiyin khat’a khat jong nabol theipoi.
Guh thim hijongle lengpa seiset dan, najalkhun thip sung hijongle mihao chu seise hih-in. Naseidoh chu vacha khat touvin pontin agaseipeh thei ahi.
Gamchom mito kiveikhom nan sum toh le chun, tu tiphat khat le sumkan namu tei ding ahi.
Muntin gamtin a sum koisoh keiyin, ajeh chu hiche vannoiya hi itobang hamsetna nato ding nakihet masahpoi.
Thingphung chu hoilam pen ngan lhu jongle, alhuhnaa chu kijam den jeng ding ahi. Meilhang ajin teng go ajuijie.
Huile go khophat kito phat ngah a natong louva naumle lho lhung ding neipon nate.
Numei naobu sunga naosen hinkhothah hung kipat nahet thei lou banga thil ijakai sem Pathen natoh thilbolje nahet thei lou ding ahi.
Jingkah nilhah-in muchi tun, natulut chan pha, khangdoh doh ding ham, alah a khatseh bou khangdoh ding ham nahepoi.
Sunlai khovah hi nomsahna dinga nomtah ahi.
Nahinkhon kum lhunseh le kipah-in. Itih chan hing jongle chun sot louva nathi ding geldoh jingin. Kinemtah a nga jing ding jong aum sampoi.
Vo khangdong, nakhangdon kipapin! Nakhangdon pat’in kipah jingin. Nabolnom nom bol’in, nadei deiyin chonin. Amavnag ipi hile nabol chan chu Pathenin thu natanpeh ding geldoh jingin.
Imacha lung gimpi dan, thoh lel jong nei hih-in. Khangdong sot ding naihpoi.
“Kahin nomtapoi,” natina ding-ni le lha kum ho hunglhun masang, nakhangdon pet hin Nasempa geldoh jingin!
Nateh teng-nisa vah le lha vah, ahsite vah geiyin nang din thimtan tin, namaiya meibol jing tobang dingahi.
Chuteng nakihonna banjangte ni kithingin tin, tua hatna lai nakengte ni hung thabei ding, naha pulsoh a, lhom behseh ding-an nalhaimo ding, namit thim a namu chen thei lou ding ahi:
Na-ngongin natin, kholai dung husa jatapon nate. Sumheiya chang kigot gin le tumging thei kitum jacheo cheovin natin, ahivangin vacha hamin kinkhangin nate.
Khousang laiya kaldoh ngam pon natin, chele vale jong tijat umtante. Nasem kangin tin, kisuh hei kitouhei hahsa nasah a, imacha lung gul naneilou ding ahitai. Ngahmun jon a che ihitauvin, kholai dunga ka le lunghem umtante.
Dangla khang kobottan ding sana thaomei hung lhaa keh ding twikul’a twi thalna khao tan a twibel lenglhaa kitatjal ding ahi.
Itahsapheu leiset’a kile kit’a leivui soh ding, hinna hu hi eipeuva Pathen henga kile kit ding ahi.
Pannabei seh-in michingthempan aseiyin, aboncha hi pannabei hel’in aseiye.
Michingthempa hi achih jal’in mipi chu ahet jouse ahil jing jeng theiye. Thuchihho kihilna aneiyin, adihjeu apatep cheh-e.
Michingthempan lungmonna thuh holdoh agon, asutdoh thucheng ho hi thu kitah jeng ahi.
Michingte thusei ho hi kelngoi chingten kelngoi hoikhomna aman’u tenggol lhoutah tobang ahin, thuchih kidong khom ho jong thilkil’a kikhendet kheh banga umsot ding ahi.Hicheng hi kelngoi chin a Eichingpau Pathen thilpeh ahi.
Kachapa, kichih theina ding khat auim nalaiye. A-ngahbu ajobu um louva lekha kijih jing ahi, hasim behseh hi nacholsah bep hinte.
Hijat kalval hin seibe ding thil khat aum’e: Pathen gingin, athupeh chengse nit’in; ajeh chu hiche dinga hi mihem asemdoh ahi.
Thil ijakai-apha hihen ase hileh, guh thima kibol ho geiya Pathenin ibol ho’u cuhnga ithuu atan cheh ding ahi.
