Judah gama Uzziah le Jotham, Ahaz chule Hezekiah lal lai le Israel gamsunga Jehoash chapa Jeroboam lal laiya Beeri chapa Hosea kama Pakai thusei chu hiche hi ahi.
Pakaiyin Hosea henga thu asei masah chun akoma hitin aseiye, “Ji gakipui le chun numei chavai soh-in tin, nachateu jong anuu to bangunte. Kamiten jong eidalhah-uva kitah lou, chavai soh ahitauve,” ati.
Hiti hi Hosea’n Diblaim chanu, Gomer chu akichenpi. Chapa khat anei nung lhonin
Pakaiyin Hosea jah a, “Apu Jehun Jezreel phaiya tol atha jeh a Israel lengpa talen kamatsah vah ding jeh-in nachapa min hi ‘Jezreel’ sah-in. Jehu leng vai neina kasuh bei ding ahi.
Chuteng Jezreel phaiya Israel sepai tha neina kasuh bei ding ahi,” ati.
Gomerin cha numei khat aneikit’in ahi. Pakaiyin Hosea jah a, “Israelte ngailu louva, achonset nau jong ka-ngaidam tah lou sing jeh-in nachanu hi amin ‘Ngailutlou’ sah-in.
Judah mite vang ngailu nange. Kei-Pakai, a-Pathen’un amaho huhhing ing ting, galmun a chemjam le thalpi, chule thalchang ham sakolte ham le sakol touthemte ham manchah a bol kagot ahipoi,” ati.
Gomer chanun noi aban nungin Gomerin nao avop kit’in chapa khat ahing’e.
Hosea jah a Pakaiyin, “Israelte hi kamite ahitapouvin, keijong a-Pathenu kahitapoi, hiijeh chun nachapa hi amin ‘Kamite-hilou’ sah-in,” ati.
Hijeh chun name Israelte chu, “Pathen mite, Pakai ngailut ho,” tin minvon.
Vo kachate, kaji bangin umta hih hen lang, keijong aji hita hih jong leng, nanuu gajol’un. Notia apan a mito ajon jon khu jol lhauvin ngahsah-un.
Angah louhel le avon jouse lahpeh ing ting, apen nikho banga akeova kalha ding ahi. GAmkang golah bahsah ing ting, dangchah a kathisah ding ahi.
Achate jong khohsah-in hepi ponge, ajeh chu jum helou noti cha ahibouvui.
Amapi jong, “Kadongmate koma lut leng, neh le chah eipeuvin tin, samul pon le tupat ponnem eipeh-uva, olive thao le ju eidonsah diu ahi,” ati.
Hiche nu hi lingle khao kaikhum ing ting, pal kaget khum ding, alampi kakha bing ding ahi.
Adongma ho delle le jongle, maipha pon tin, gahol hol jongle muponte. Chuteng, “Kaji masapa henga kile kit tenge, tulai sangin chulaiyin nom kasajoi,” tinte.
Baal hou nan nei jongle, sana la dangka, olive thao, lengpitwi le chang pejing hi Kei kahilam ahedoh hih hel’e.
Hijeh a chu lho lhun tengle kathilpeh-chang le lengpitwi kile lah ing ting, samul pon le tupat ponnem kapehsa jong kalahpeh a ponsil beiya kakoi ding ahi.
Adongmate angsunga akeovin jam ing ting, koiman kakhut’a eichu lhah jou louhel ding ahi.
Kumhei golnop abol chengse, kumlhun kut hihen, lha lhin kut hile, Choldo nikho kut ahiya, houthua kikhopna abol jouse kasuh tang hel ding ahi.
Ama deichat sum a adongmaten apeh a asei, alengpigui ho le atheichang phung ho kasuhgam peh ding ahi. Alengpilei ho le apahcha lei jouse gammang lai kasosah ding, gamsaten achil thang diu ahi.
kei eisuh mil a Baal houna gimnamtui ahalnam a, sanapah a kijem a adongmae adelle le lai, chuche phat angolna jeh a chu talen kamatsah tei ding ahi. Pakaiyin aseisa ahitai.
Hiche nu hi gammang noiya pui lut ing ting, onem heova houva kathu nun ding ahi.
HIche nu hi alengpilai nungpeh ing ting, gimna phaicham jong kinepna kotpi kasosah ding ahi. hikoma hin anu-ngah laiya bangin kasei ngai nante, Egypt’a kona ahung doh til’a abol bang chun.
Chutengle ajinpan eikou kit’in tin, ama dinga Baal eiti kit louhel ding ahitai.
Baal min him him kaphah pohsah lou didng ahi.
Hiche tengle kamite asuh khah louna diuva gamsate le vachate ti kitepna kasem ding ahi. Gamsunga gal manchah pou pou, chemjam jouse le thalpi jouse kasuhmang ding, kamite lung ol le lung monga kachensah ding ahiuve.
Vo Israel, jia kanei ding, Nadia kitah tah le dihtah kahiya, Long louvin lungset ing ting, kahepia Katonsot gouva kasem ding kani.
Kakitepna nit’a Keiya kasem ding, Nangin Pakaiya nei nei ding ahi.
Hiteng chule kamite Israel taona sang ing ting, Leiset’a gotwi kanensah ding,
Leiset’in gaphatah tah, Changle lengpiga, olive apunsah ding ahi.
Gamsunga kamite chensah ing ting, Kaphat tousah ding ahi. “Ngailut lou,” kitiho ngailung ting, “Kamite hilou,” kiti ho chu “Kamite,” tia kasei ding, Amahon, “Ka-Pathenu,” tia eidonbut diu ahi.


Pakaiyin kajah a aseiyin, “Akideipi to chonse jing numei khat gahel’in. Doichom chom houvu hen, milimdoi ho hounan lengpithei changlhah toh jingo jongle Israelte ka-ngailut jing banga, hiche numei chu na-ngailut tei tei ding ahi,” eiti.
Hijeh chun hiche nu man din dangka som le nga kapen, sakol chang kilogram ja le som nga pen kagachoi.
Hiche nu hin sotpi ei-nga, notia jong pang lou ding, pasal dangto jong jong lou din kaseipeh-e. Kenjong ama ka-nga jing din kaseiyin ahi.
Hitobanga chu Israelte jong phat sotpi leng le lamkai bei, kilhaina gan that lou, doikhom song jong phut lou, phunsanna dinga milimdoi ho le milim sem louva um diu ahi.
Israelte hi Pakai a-Pathenu henga ahung kihei phat khat hung lhungin tin, David chilhah leng khat koma hung kikhom diu ahi. Chuteng Pathen ging’un tin, thilpha apeh chengse kisan tauvinte.
Hiche gamsunga chengte douna Pakaiyin hehsetna khat apohdoh ahi. Ngaiyin Israel Pakai thusei hi: “Gamsunga kitahna l engailutna alengpoi, amiten jong Kei hi Pathenin eigel pouve.
Kitepna abol chengseu la apal keh jiuvin, jou aseiyun, tol athat’un, aguchauvin, chule akijonbol’ui. Chonval la apung cheh cheh-in, tol la akithat that jengtai.
Gamsung hung go-lhan tin, ijakai gopsoh ding ahi; gancha jouse le ganhing ho, ju le va, nga ho geiya thigam ding ahiuve,” ati.
Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Mipi kinah dau hen kihehto dau hen: vo Thempuho, nang ho bou kahehset nahiuve.
Sunle jan a nakipal lhuh lhuh jeng diu, Themgao ho jong phachaom deh lou diu ahi. Ken nanu Israel hi kasuhmang ding ahi.
Kei eihet loujeh-uva kamite mangthah ahitauve. Nang ho Thempuhon neihe pouvin, kahil nasang pouve, hijeh a chu kapaidoh diu, nachateu jong Thempua kapansah lou ding ahi.
“Thempu natambe cheh-u le Kei dounan chonset nabolbe cheh-ui, hijeh a chu min najabolnau chu vetdana kaheidoh peh diu ahi.
Kamite chonset bol chu nanghon haodoh nan naneiyun, hijeh chun chonset nabolsah sah nom’ui.
Mipi thoh gim banga nanghon jong genthei hesoh nathoh diu ahi! Thilse nabol jal’uva talen kamatsah a kahtohsah ding ahiuve.
Nachan diu kilhaina gantha sa nejong leu chun, gilkel thoh a naum jing diu ahi. Cha tam neina din doiphunga notin pang jong leu chun, doichom chom nahoujeh-uva cha nanei deh lou diu ahi.
“Ju lui jut hah don’in, kamite angol gamtauve!
Kungbul phung pou phunin asan’uvin, tenggol chun ahetnom’u aseipeh bangin agel’ui! Eidalhatauve. Notia pang numei bangin, doichom chom kom ajonsoh tauve.
Molvum doiphung dunga kilhaina abol’uvin, lhangvum vum, thingphung dang nou dunga kithoina gimnamtui ahal’un, ali nom sah jeh-in theoboh adah-uve. “Hiche kon hin nachanu jouseu notin apangun, namouteu mito ajong tauve.
Hijongle athilbol jeh-u hin amaho talen matsah ponge, ajeh chu nangho tah jong doiphunga kijoh noti ho to kijot manga chonse, chule kilhaina thil toh khomji nahiuve. Thuchih-in, ‘Lungthimbei mite chu mangthah diu ahi’ ati bang diu ahi.
“Kei dia Israelte nakitah lou vangun, Judahte vang hitobang thil hin athemmo pouve. Gilgal le Bethel mun a jong doihou din hung dauvin, hikoma chun hing jing Pathen minin kitepna jong bol sauvin.
Lahlou sakol pol bangin Israelte vang alouchal behseh jengui. Hamhing lah a kelngoi vah banga iti kivah vah ding ham?
Israelte hi doihouvin angol tauve. Anop nop’in um jengu hen.
Ju adon khamset’un, notin apangun, jabol sangin jachatna adeijo’uve.
Hui lhoh mang bang diu, doichom chom houjeh a jahcha diu ahi.
“Vo Thempuho, ngaiyuvin! Ngai phauvin Israelte! Leng insung miten ngaiyuvin! Adih a thutan dia kigelte, nachunguva thu kitan lo ding ahitai! Mizpah a chun kipalnan napangun, Tabor lhanga lenpel’in nakisongun,
Acacia khopia thuh tah khuh kilai nabanguivn, hijeh a chu nabonchauva talen kamatsah ding nahiuve.
Israel itobang ahi kahenai, kakoma kisel theiponte. Numei kitahlou tobang ahi, amite jong eihou din alolhing pouve,” ati.
Mipi thilse bol hin a-Pathen komu ahin jot lutsah thei lou ahitai. Milimdoi ahou nom behseh-un, Pakai ahepha tapouve.
Mipi kiletsahna chu amaho douvin apangtai. Achonset nauvin akipalsah-in alhuhsah tai, Judah te geiyin alhuh tha tauve.
Pakai koma kilhaina din kelngoite le bong ho akai nauvin, ahivangin phatchom nan aneippouve. Pakai amudoh jou pouve, ajeh chu Aman adalhatauve.
Pakaidin akitah pouvin, achateu jong Pakaiya ahipouve. Hijeh a chu amaho jong agamsungu jong kisubei ding ahitai.
Gilead a gal konna din sumkon mut’un! Ramah khoa gal khongpi vouvin! Bethel khoa galsat din kho-lhang sam’un! Gal kon’uvin, Benjamin chilhah ho!
Talen matna ding nikho ahung lhunge, Israel mangthah ding ahitai. Vo Israelte, hiche hi soh tei ding ahi!
Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Judah lamakien Israel asat’uva, agamsung alahpeh jeh-un kalung ahange. Hijeh a chu achunguva talen twipi kisunglha kabahsah ding ahi.
Israel hi min abolsen, achanlom tah gamsung geiyin, panpi phachom louhel ho akineppi jal’in, min alahpeh tai.
Israel sumang ing ting, Judahte manthahna kalhut khum ding ahi.
“Israel’in aveiset akimudoh a, Judah-in amaput akimudoh teng, Israel’in Assyria gam kumpipa henga panpi gathumin tin, amanla damsah a amaput boldam peh thei deh lou ding ahi.
Israelte le Judahte chu sakei midel khum banga kadel khum ding, atel adah-uva kajan a kadalhah ding ahi. Kakai mang teng koiman eichu lha theiponte.
“Achonset jeh-uva athoh khopset’uva, eihung ho kahseuva, kamite hi kadonda ding ahi. Athoh gim behseh tengu eimudoh thei maiyu ahi,” ati.
Mipin aseiun, “Pakai koma kile kit taute! Eibolgimu ahitan, damjong eidamsah teiyunte; eimavosau ahitan, imahau eitompeh tei lou diu ham?
Ni ni nithum jou teng eisuhal’un tin, a-angsunga inom hin diu ahi.
Pakai het tei din goute. Jing kho avah tei tei bangle, chuh lai gotwiyin leiset achap nou banga, ihenguva hung tei ding ahi,” atiuve.
Ahivangin Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Vo Israel le Judah, i-kalo didng ahiuvam? Jingkah daitwi kang loi bangin, nei ngailutnau abeiloiji tai, sun nisa daitwi kanghei hoi bep ahi.
Hijeh a chu thutanna le suhgamna thu pohsah a ka-Themgao te kahinsolpeh nahiuve. Nahenguva ka-ngeh hi akichen jenge;
kilhaina gantha sangin ngailutna kadeijon, pumgo thilto eipeh sangun kamiten eihet diu kadeijoi.
“Ahinla gamsung ahung lut lut’un Adam mun a kakitepna asukeh tauve.
Gilead khopi sung mihiloute le tolthat ho adimset’ui.
Thempuho jong mi changlhi jing gucha hon abangui. Shechem mun theng lampi jenga jongmi athat’uve. Thilse hijatpi hi henasa saa abol’u ahitai!
Israel sunga kidah dah um kahitan, milimdoi houvin kamite akisubohsoh tauve.
“Vo Judah mite, nathilbol chengseu jeh a nang ho talen pehna ding phat khat kakoinai.
“Kamite Israel damsah a, haodoh sah kit kanop phat phat le, agitlou nau le thilse abol ho’u kamudohji tai. Khat le khat akilhem to’uvin; bang aphujal’un, aguchauvin; kholai dunga mi achom’ui.
Thilse hijat abol’u kagel jing didng hi lungin jong agel phapouve. Achonset nauvin avuh tauvin, kamu khel aumppoi.”
“Mipin thilse bol’in lengpa le avaipote geiyin alhem lhauve.
Mijong jeng le mi kitahlou jeng ahiuve. Mi ahotnau meilhum sung meisa abangin, kan ding changlhah kigon jou kah a changlhah kangpan mut kou hih jongle deoje ju tobang ahi.
Lengpa gaolvah nin lengpa le avaipote ju atul kham’un, asu-ngolsoh tauve.
Athilse bolnom danu meilhum abangin, along hang khovah vah-un, jingkah teng meikou deojah jeng abangui.
“Alunghan val jeh-un avaihomteu athat’un, alengteu aban banin athat’un, ahivangin kahenga taova aum hih hel’ui.
“Israelte hi changlhah alang kan minlou tobang ahiuve. Akimvel’uva namtin vaipi akison piuvin,
hitobang gamchom mite chunga kison hin athahat alah mang ahilam helouvin aum’ui. Amanna didu nikho dimtohsa ahitan, amahon la ahedoh pouve.
Israelte kiletsahna amaho douna thu aseitai. Thil hijatpi soh tajongle kahenga hung kile kit ding agel pouvin, Pakai a-Pathenu eihol pouve.
Israel hi lungthimbei vakhu tobang ahin, amasan amiten apanpi diuvin Egyptte akouvun, chuin Assyria lam asel’ui!
Ahivanga achenna chan’uva lenpel kason a vacha banga kamatdoh ding ahiuve. Thilse abol chengseu jal’a talen kamatsah tei ding ahiuve.
“Ohe ada ahiuve! Eisalhauvin eidou tauve! Kasuhgam ding ahiuve. Kahuhhing nom vangin, jou jouvin eihouvui.
Lungtheng sel’in kahenga atao pouve, chiding namdangte umchan bangin tol dunga akipehle leuve. Chang le lengpitwi athum tengu jongle chiding namdangte umchan atho’uve. Vo doumah bolte!
Kavahdoh a kahatsah vangin, kei douna jeng abol’uve.
Eida lhauvin, thabei, semthu pathen abel’ui. Kisonpi theilou thalchang kon tobang ahiuve. Alamkaiteu kiletsah thusei jal’a thisea thisoh diu, Egypt miten anuisat diu ahi.
“Gal sumkon mut loiyun, melmaten kagamsung chu, muvanlai lengsuh bangin ahindelsuh tauve! Kamiten amaho to kakitepna asukeh-un, kahilna thuhil adoutauve.
A-Pathena eiseiyuva, kamitea akiseiyuva, eihet banga asei vangun,
thilpha apaitauve. Hijeh a hi amelmateuvin adel del jeng diu ahi.
“Kamiten leng ho akilhen vangun, acham cham a abol’u ahibouve. Kei phatsah louvin lamkai akilhen’ui. Amanthahna diuvin, sana le dangka adongkhom’un milimdoi akisem’ui.
Samaria kho sung miten sanaa kisem bongchal lim ahouvu kahoi. Acunguva kalung hange. Itih tah le milimdoi ahouda diu ham?
Israel mi khut them khat’in asemdoh ahin, pathen ahinaisai poi. Samaria khopia kihou sana bongchal lim chu kisugep ding ahi.
Huise tu ahiuvin, khopihui aki-at diu ahi. Chang min louna louma changlhah ding kilamdoh ponte. Kilamdoh mong jongle gamchom min nedoh bep’unte.
Israel jong namdang bep ahitan, pannabei bel kehsa tobang ahitai.
Lahlou sa-ngan banga louchal Israelte anop nop’in akihei tauve. Assyria mite panpi ngai chan acheuvin, ahuh diuvin namdang ho tohman apeuve.
Ahivanga abonchauva kakhop ding, talen kamatsah ding ahiuve. Assyria kumpipan abolset tengu nasa asah behseh jeng diu ahi.
“Chonset suh beina dia Israelten maicham asembe vangun chonsetna ding mun tampi aneibe cheh-ui.
Mipi hilna ding simsen lou kajih doh tan, ahivangin datmo le thilchom beh-in agel’un apaitauve.
Kahenga gam athat’un asa aneuve. Hijongle Kei-Pakai hi achunguva kalung lhaipoi. Hijeh a chu achonset’u kageldoh a, talen kamatsah ding, Egypt gama kanungsol kit ding ahi!
“Israelten leng inpi tampi asemdoh-un, ahivangin Asempau asumil tauve. Judahten kulpi kikaikhum khopi tamtah asadoh-un, ahivanga leng inpiho le khopi chengse chu kahal lhahding ahi,” ati.
Vo Israelte, doihou ho banga kut nabol chengseu hi ngauvin. Na-Pathenu dalhan navah mangun, Ama din kitahna nanei tapouve. Gamsung pumpia Baal koma noti bangin nakijoh tauvin, aman napeh-uva nagel’u chang nadei lheh-ui.
Ahivanga nachangu beivah ding, olive thao beisoh a, lengpitwi jong lhasam ding ahi.
Pakai gamsunga Israelte chengsot lou diu, Egypt gama kile tol kit’uva, Assyria gamsungaanboh aga neh diu ahi.
Hiche migam sunga chu Pakai koma lengpitwiya kilhai thei lou diu, kilhaina gan jong atha thei lou diu ahi. Aneh chah-uvin anechan asuh boh a, thi-opsa kine tobang hiding ahi. Oivana dia kinebou hi ding, Pakai Houin a kitoh banga kisei thei louding ahi.
Pakai choi-atna kut bol phat hung lhun teng ipi abol diu hitam?
Manthahna hung lhun a mipi kithecheh teng, Egypt miten achop khom diu, alhoh khom’uva Memphis a vui diu ahi! Agouvu dangka le ain mun jouseu chu lingle khao dimset’a hung keh ding ahi.
Talen matsah phat ahung lhung tan, athoh ding mipin athoh phat ahunglhungtai. Hiche hi asoteng Israel’in hanante. Nanghon, “Hiche themgaopa a-ngol’in, Pathen hu-lha khumpa hi atanangtai,” natiuve. Nachonset behseh jeh-un mipin hibang hin neiho’uve.
Pathenin amite Israel gihsal dia eihinsol ahi. Ahivangin kachena chan a vacha thang kikampeh bangin kipalsah neigo’uve. Pathen gamsung nah nah aching miten Themgaopa adouvuve ong!
Gibeah a aumchan bangun, kinepna beihel thilse jeng bol ahitauve. Pathenin achonsetnau gel jingintin, talen amatsah tei ding ahi.
Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Israel kamudoh til chun gammang laiya jam lengpigui tobang ahi. Napu napate kamu til chun, aphatcha theichang ga min mudoh kabangin ahi. Ahinla Peor molsang ahung geiyun Baal doi ahou pan’un, aseichat’u doiho bangin kidah dah aumdoh tauve.
Israel loupina vacha banga leng mang loi ding, cha le nao jong aneikit lou diu, numei naovop l aumpon tin, nao peng jong umbe ponte.
Cha le nao vahdoh jongleu kathagam a khat beh kahoipeh lou didng ahi. Hiche mite kadalhah teng achunguva datmo umtah thil soh ding ahi,” ati.
Vo Pakai, achateu min athagam peh kamui.
Hiche mite hi ipi nabolpeh dia ka-ngeh ding ham? Anumeite jouseu chinsah-in, vah ding chasen neisau hen!
Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Athilse bol chengseu hi Gilgal a hung kipan ahi. Gilgal a pat kahinvet da pan ahitauve. Thilse abol jeh-uva kagamsunga kona kadeldoh ding ahiuve. Alamkai jouseuvin eidouvun, lungset kit taponge.
Israelte hi ajung gosa, gathei lou thingphung tobang ahiuve. Cha le nao nei tapouvinten, nei mongu jongle a-it tah tah-u achateu kathagampeh ding ahi,” ati.
Alhacha kapan Pathenin amite paiyinte; ajeh chu amahon athu ngaipeh aneipouve. Namtin vaipi lah a vah thai ding ahiuve.
Israelte hi lengpigui ga phatah bang ahiuve. Ahao cheh-ule maicham asembe cheh-ui. Agam gau apun cheh le, doikhom song asemhoi cheh cheh-un chibai aboh-uve.
Lungthima lepche jing miten achonset man athoh gim tei diu ahi. Pathenin amaicham jouse susen tin, doikhom dong jouse sumanginte.
Hetman louva hiche mite hin, “Pakai igin loujeh-un leng inei tapouve. Neijong leu hen leng chun eiho dia ipi aboljou nah ding ham?” tiuvinte.
Thu homkeo aseiyun, jouva kitepna asem’un, chule pannabei kigahna asem’ui. Thudih thudihlou asouvin, lou laiya lounamse pungtel tul jeng abange.
Samaria khopia chengte kichauvin tin, Bethel a sana bongchal lim kisem manjeh a lungthoi diu ahi. Amaho le milimdoi limbol’a pang Thempuho kap diu ahi. Sana giltah tah akikhodoh teng kapsoh diu ahi.
Hiche sana milimdoi hi Assyria gam kumpi minthangpa kaiya peh dia apoh mang diu ahitai. Thumop ajui ho jal’a Israel min avetda a, jumle ja athoh ding ahi.
Twichunga thinghal kilap banga, alengpau min akai mang ding ahi.
Aven lhangvum doiphung, Israelten milimdoi ahou nau mun chu min asuhmang ding ahi. Amaicham phunguva ling le khao hng keh ding, mipin molle lhang sang ho jah a, “Neisel’un, neikhu’vin,” tia asap diu ahi.
Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Gibeah a achonset’uva pat Israelten Kei douna chonset atang tapouve. Hijeh a chu Gibeah agal’in alap den diu ahi.
Hiche mi chonsete hi delkhum ing ting talen kamatsah ding ahi. Amaho dou din namtin vaipi pangkhomin tin, achonset chengseu jal’a talen amat tei diu ahi.
“Israel hi phat khat’in bongla gol lahngoisa, chang chil ding gosadema um ahin, angong jolsel’a namkol pohsah a natoh hahsa jo hil kagot anahi. Judah chu lou kaiyin kamangin, Israel thingtum kakaisah-e.
Keiman, ‘Louthah thah kaiyun lang, thudih muchi tun tu’uvin, kahenga nakipeh lut jal’uva vangboh chu lhosoh ga bangin kilo’uvin. Na-Pakaiyu Kei henga nahung phat’u ahitai, kahunga vangbohna kabuh lhah khum ding nahiuve,’ kati.
Ahinla thilsejo muchi tun natu’vin, aga nalou tauve. Najouseiman naneh-u ahitai. “Ajeh chu nakangtalaiho le nasepai tampi nakison piuvin,
ahinla namite gal’in hindel khumin tin, nakulpi chengseu asuhamng ding ahi. Shalman lengpan Betharbel khopi gal a asuhmanga, nu nao chapang jouse asuhgam hel nikho chutoh bang dingahi.
Vo Bethel mite, nathilse bol’u melset veng vung jal’a hitobang thil chu nachunguva soh ding ahi. Gal kisat pat pat le Israel lengpa thipai jeng ding ahi,” ati.
Pakaiyin aseiyin: “Israel asen laiyin kalungsen, Egypt’a konin kachapa kakoudoh-e.
Kahakou cheh le alhai gamla cheh-ui. Kamiten Baal kilhaina abol’un, milimdoi hou nan gimnamtui alhut’ui.
Ahinla Israel lamjotje hil’a kahin, Kamite ka-angjangin kapomin; Ahivangin amaho kakhou khahna Amahon ahepha hih hel’ui.
Hepi le ngailun kakou lut’in, Kabengto kasip beh jingin; kabungin aneh diu an kapei.
“Ahivangin kaheng ahinjon nom pouvin, hijeh a chu Egypt’a kile kit tei tei diu, achunguva Assyria mite vaihom ding ahi.
Akhopi chengseu galten lonvuh-in tin, kulpi kelkot chengse atumboh diu ahi. Thilpha pena agel’u thil jeng abol jal’uva gal’in kamite asuhmang ding ahi.
Kakoma kona jamdoh dingbou aseiyun, apoh-u namkol jeh a peng peng diu, koimanla asut peh deh lou diu ahi.
“Vo Israel, iti kapaidoh jouva, Iti kadonda thei ding ham? Admah bol’a kabol theiya, Zeboiim banga kabol thei nahim? Kalungthimin hiti chu eibolsah ponte, Ka-ngailutna asang behseh bouve.
Lunghan vangin talen matsah dang ting, Israel suhmang kit da tange. Pathen kahin, mihem kahipoi, Naumpi jing Athengpa chu kahi. Lung hangin hung kit taponge.
“Amelmateu chu sakei kisen banga kakisen khum teng, kamiten eijui kit tauvinte. Lhumlam a konin eihin del del jengunte.
Egypt’a konin vacha len hin thouvin tin, Assyria gama kona vakhu len ahintho diu ahi. Keiman a-inlum’uva kahin puilut kit ding ahi. Kei-Pakaiyin kasei ahitai,” ati.
Jingkah a pat nilhah geiya Israelten abol’u hi pannabei le manthahna bou ahi. Lepthol le pumhatna alah-uva apung jinge. Assyria mite toh kitepna asem’un, Egypt mite to kiveikhom din akihouvui,” ati.
Pakaiyin Judah mite douna sei ding aneiye: Israel jong amite umchan khan chah jal’a talen amatsah ding ahi. Athilbol dungjuiyuva alethuh cheh ding ahinai.
Apuluiyu Jacob jong chu apenkhoppi a-upa Esau toh anu oisung, naobua aumlai lhonin akisato lhone; Jacob akhandoh phat’in Pathen to akibon’e.
Vanil to akibonin ajouve, akap’in vangboh athum jenge. Bethel muna ipuluiyu Jacob henga pathen ahungin akihoupi.
Hiche hi Pakai Pathen Hatchungnung ahi. Pakai kiti min ahin Ama chibai boh ding ahi.
Chuti ahile tun Jacob son ho, na-Pathenu tansan’un lang adih-in chon’un, na-Pathenu panpina chu thoh hat tah-in ngah jinguvin.
Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Israelte jong Canaan mite bangin alepthol’ui; nahenguva thilcho ho lepthol’in, adih lou thilte nan atepeh-uve.
Amaho pin, ‘Ikivei kan’un haodoh ihitauve, lepthol’a ihaodoh- hi koiman eihehse thei pouvinte,’ tin aseiyui.
Hichea hi Kei-Pakai na-Pathenu, gamthip laiya nahung vil pau, Egypt a kona hinpuidoh pan, ponbuh a nachen banguva kachensah kit ding nahiuve.
“Themgaote jah a thu tampi kaseiyin, mu tampi kaneisah-e, chule Themgaote mangchan kamite kagihsal jinge.
Ahivangin Gilead a milimdoi pou ahouvun, hiche houchengse chu thigam diu ahi. Gilagal a Bongchal ho kilhainan aneiyun, chukoma maicham ho jong chu a-onglai jousea songtum alhuh lhuh-in aseuve,” ati.
Kapuluiyu Jacob Mesopotamia gama jamlut din aumin, hikoma chun ji kilo nan mi na tongin akelngoite achinpeh-e.
Pakaiyin Egypt gama sohchang Israelte puidoh avetup din Themgao khat asolpeh-e.
Israelten Pakai asulung hang lheh jengun, achonset jel’un thi din akilom’uve. Pakai asuh jum jal’uva Pakaiyin talen amatsah tei diu lom ahi.

Masang laiya Ephraim phung miten thu asei teng, Israel phung dang ho akichauve; mihon Ephraim phung chu jatah-in aveuve. Ahinla amahon Baal ahouvun achonsetauve, hijeh a chu athilo tei diu ahi.
Chonset abol jom jingun, hou din milimdoi, dangka akhengun, mihem lung suhtoa kigel doh, mihem khut’a kisem ho pou ahouvui. Amahon, “Hiche ho hi kithoinan neiyun,” tin aseiyui. Hitobang milimdoi ho hi min iti achop theiya, bongchal lim a kisemthu chu iti kitahsan theiding ham!
Hiche mite hi jingkah daitwi banga leng mang diu, sunlai nisa kahgot bang ding ahiuve. Changphol a changpol hui lhoh mangbangle, meikhu longa meikhu kitungdoh tobang bep hi ding ahiuve.
Pakaiyin aseiyin, “kei hi Egypt a kona nahinpuidoh-u Pakai na-Pathenu kahi. Kei tilou Pathen dang nanei pouve. Keibou nahuhhingpu kahi.
Nelgam go lah a kakhou khah-un ahi.
Ahivangin gampha nalut phat’un naming lhingun na-oiva tauvin, kiletsah hoithon neisumil tauve.
Hijeh achu sakei mibokhum banga kabokhum diu, lutnu michan banga nalampiuva kachan lhih ding nahiuve.
Anou mansah savom midel le kabah ding, kabotel ding nahiuve. Sakei mibolna banga amun akaval lhum jeng diu ahi, chule gamsa hang mibolna banga natel nadah a kajan diu ahi.
“Kasuhmang ding nahiuve, Israelte! Kon nakithopi jou ding ham?
Leng khat nathum’un, lamaki ding mi tampi na-ngeh-ui, hiche ho hin najet’u iti ahuhhing jou ding ham?
Lung phamosa sa kapeh leng ho chu kalunghan phat’in kasumangtai.
“Israel chonset le themmona lekha ajihdoh soh tan, phate chan akikoihe tai.
Israel hin kihinsona thei phat pha khat aneiyi, angol behseh jeh-in akisan thiepon, naosen penglha din naobua hungdoh ding ada tobang bep ahitai.
Hiche mite hi noimigama lutna dia konin huhdoh pong ting, thina thahat’a konin jong huhdoh ponge. Vo thina namidena hinpo lut tan! Vo noimigam, manthahna hinlhut loiyin! Hiche mite hi voujang natpi kit taponge.
Israel hi pumping bangin nalhasil sel jongle, nelgama kon niso lama kon huisave vuhung nungin tin, teinah phungle twikul jouse asemgot ding ahi. Thil manlu jouse alhoh mang ding ahi.
Vo Israelte, Pakai na-Pathen henga hung kile kit tauvin. Chonset jal’a kipal lhu nahiuve.
Pakaiya kile kit’un, ahenga hitin taovun: “Kachonset’u ngaidamin, katao nau sangin, kakitepsau bangin navahchoi unge.
Assyria miten eihuh joupontin, galsat them dakolten eidal jou pouvinte. Milimdoi kasemho’u chu ka-Pathen danun sei kit hih hel unge. O Pakai Nangin bel ding neiloute nahepiji mong ahi,” toiuvin.
Pakaiyin aseiyin: “Kamite kinungpui kit ing ting, Lung giltah a kalungset ding, Achunguva lung hang kit taponge.
Israelte dia gamgo lah a Gotwi julhah kabah ding; Pacha banga pah diu ahi. Lebanon lhang thingphung banga jungkho det chet diu ahi.
Thing nanou banga hingdiu, Olive thing hoiya hoi ding ahiuve. Lebanon lhang cedar thing banga Muinam jen jun diu ahi.
Kahoidamna kulpi sunga cheng kit’uva, Honlei phatah bang diu; Lengpigui ga phatah banga, Lebanon lhang lengpiga pha minthang bang diu ahi.
Israelten milimdoi ahoukit louhel diu, Ataonau sanpeh a kahoidam ding, Thingna dum jing banga kanou sah ding, Vangbohna amu jouseu Keiya kon ahi,” ati.


Pathuel chapa Joel koma Pakai thusei chu hiche hi ahi.
Ngaiphauvin upate, Judah gama chengten ngaiyuvin! Nangho khang hihen napu napateu khang hile, Hitobang thil hi soh khan am?
Nacha nanaoteu seipeh-un lang, Amahon jong acha anaoteu aseipeh diu, amahon jong khang kit kit’a Mite aseipehson son dingu ahi.
Khaokhopiten ahon honin andong aneuve, Khaokhopi masaloi neh moh aban banin anetai.
Vo jukhamho, thouvun kap’un pangun julop ho. Lengpitwi thah thah semna ding Lengpiga chengse asumangtauve.
Khaokhopi hon jamah-in igamsungu alonvuh tan, Ahuse behseh jengun simsen jong ahipouve. Ahau jong sakei ha bangin ahemtheiye.
Ilengpiguiyu asumangsoh-un, Itheichangna anechaisoh tauve. Ana anechaisoh-un abah agosh tai.
Nuh-ngah-in adongma thilong aka bangin, Mipi nabonchan kap jenguvin.
Houin a to ding chang le lengpitwi abeisoh tai, Pakai koma toding beijeh-in Thempute along dongtauve.
Loujao la akeovin akijamtan, Chang kisuhgam leiset geiyin adoulel’e. Cahngdong kisuhgam phat’in Lengpigui jouse agop soh tai. Olive thing jouse agamtai.
Lunghem’uvin loubol jouse, Lengpilei bolte kap’uvin; Suhlou change sakol chang, Cahngdong mimdong asugamhel tauve.
Lengpigui le theichang phung agosoh tan, Agathei thing jouse aheovin athitai. Hijeh chun mipi kipana jong abeitan ahi.
Khaodip pon sil’in kap’un, Maicham phung lhacha Thempuho! Houin akitol touvn jan khovah-in lung gim’un, Na-Pathen napeh diu chang le lengpitwi abeitai.
Japi khom’un lang an ngol ding deiyun, Lamkai chengse le Judahte khomsoh-un, Pakai na-Pathenu Houin sunga Kap’un ahenga thum’uvin!
Pakai Nikho ahung naiye, Hatchungnungin manthahna abol ding Nikho chu ahung naitai; Hiche hikhon itobang tijatna aso ding hitam!
Ka-andong jouseu kinechai jeng kamoh vet’un, Ka-Pathen Houin a jong kipana abeitai.
Leigo lah a muchi athi thu thun, Changsal’a koi ding changla abeitan, Cahngsal keosa ho hi alhenglhona kijam ahitai.
Neh ding hamhing umlou jal’in, Gancha jouse, bong le kelngoi hon Akel lel soh gamtauve.
Vo Pakai, meikah banga hamhing le Thingphung jouse got jeh a nahenga tao kahi.
Luidung joouse akan jeh-in Gamsa ho geiyin nahenga ataovui.
Sumkon mut’un, Pathen lhang theng Zion a kiginna khongpi vouvin. Kithing thing jengun Judahte, Pakai Nikho hung lhungvah ding ahitai.
Muthim khojin nikho, Muthim lhangkhal kiheh ni hinte. Molsang meilomin atom bangin, Khaokhote ahon honin ahung kitol’ui. Hitobang thil hi soh kha loulai ahin, Sohjong soh kit lou ding ahi.
Hamhing jouse meikah bangin anechaiyun, Alut masanguva Eden hon tobang gamsung chu Adalhah nungle akeohel’in, Imacha cha pou louhel’in, aumtai.
Sakolte lheh lheh ahiuvin, Galsat sakolte lhaiyin alhaiyui.
Molvuma akichop doh tengule Kangtalai kitagih abangun, Gamkanglai meikah abahsah-un, GAlsat dia kigoltoh sepai hon jamah abangui.
Ahung neitel tul’ule mitin akichan, Mitin mai anguisoh heljie.
Gal-hangho midel khum abngun, Sepaite bangin pal dunga akal’ui. Malam non akitol tol jengun, Ajotnau khel louhel’in acheuvin,
Khat masanga khat asingpoi. Tho kikaiho jong adelpeh jengun, Imacha chan asutang joupoi.
Khopi alonvuh jengun, Palvum vuma akaldoh-uvin; Intingvum geiya akaltouvun, Guchate bangin in bangkot Sung dunga alut lut jengui.
Ahung kitol tengu leiset akiling leuvin, Vanthamjol geiyin akithing jin ahi. Nisa le lha athim leuvin, Ahsite jong avahji tapoi.
Pakaiyin asepaite kolphe bangin thu apen, Athu ngai sepaite tamtah le hattah ahiuve, Pakai Nikho itobanga kichat um hitam! Ahingdoh thei idng koiham?
Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Tu hijeng jongle, Thangsel’in lung heiyun lang, Kap le lung kisih chule an ngol thon Kahenga hung kilt kit’uvin.
Nakisih nau chun nalung gim phongdoh-un, Ponsil botel maimaiyin alhingpoi. Pakai na-Pathen heng hinjon kit’un. Mi khoto them, hepina lhingset ahi; Athoh hat’in akitepna anit jinge; Talen matsah louva ngaidam go jing ahi.
Pakai na-Pathen’un lung akhel’a, Changle mim phatheiya nalha theiyu ahi. Chuteng nang hon chang le Lengpiteiya Ama nahou theiyu ahi.
Zion lhanga sumkon mut’un lang, An ngol ding seiyun, japi khom’uvin!
Japi koukhom’uvin, Houbung kikhopna sem’uvin; Upa cheng koukhom’un, Chapangho le naosen ho koukhom’un. Kichengtil hon jong Indan sung dalha hung diu ahi.
Houin hongchal le maicham kah a Pakai kinbol Thempu ho kap a tao diu: “Pakai namite khoton, Namdang ho totna le daithangin neikoi dauvin, ‘Na-Pathenu hoilamba hitam?’ tin seidau hen,” atiuve.
Pakaiyin agamsung khohsahna aneitan, Amite ahepitan ahi.
Ataonau adonbut’in aseiye: “tua vang change lengpitwi olive thao Kapeh ding nahitauvin, Lung nachima nanei diu, Namdang miten totna le Daithanga nanei lou diu ahitai.
Sahlama hungkon khaokhote sugam ing ting, phabeppi nelgam sunga kadel lut’a, Amasa chengse Twimanga kalelut ding, Anunung chengse Mediterranea Twikhanglena kalelut ding ahi. Athilongu uijen jun ding, Athilongu uijen jun ding, Athilongu uijen jun ding, Athilbolset chengseu jal’a kasuhmang ding ahi.
“Vo loujaoho kicha hih hel’un, Pakaiyin nabolpeh thil ho jeh-un kipah thanomjo’uvin.
Gancha ho, kicha hih hel’un, Hamhing adumsoh tan, Gathei thingphung ho agatan; Theichangle lengpithei tampi agatai.
“Vo Zion mite, Pakai na-Pathenu Thilbol jal’in kipah thanom’uvin. Chavang go nengsel’in napeuvin, Phalbi gotwi le khallai gotwi nengtah-in napeuve. Chuteng Pakai panpi holchan huhinga um ding, Pakaiyin asei banga, Jerusalema um phabep jamdoh a, Kalhendohsa cheng hingdoh ding ahi,’ ati bang,” ati.
Changphol jouse chang dimsoh ding, Lengpitwi le thao chilna khuh ho let lha ding ahi.
Khaokhoten na-andongu anehgam kum sunguva Namansah chengseu kapeh kit diu ahi. Khaokhote hinsol’a jong Keima kahi.
Neh le chah nengtah a naneiyuva, Lung nachimtah a naum diu ahi. Pakai na-Pathenu navahchoi diu, Thil kidangtah nabolpeh Pau nathangvah diu ahi. Kamite kidaithang kit louhel diu ahi.
Chuteng nalah-uva ka-um jing hetauvin nate, Israel, Koidang umlou Kei-Pakai na-Pathenu kahi hateuvin nate. Kamite daithanga kikoi kit louhel ding ahi.
Pakaiyin aseiyin: “Hicheteng chule Keiman Judah gam le Jerusalem Hamphatna kasem phat peh ding ahi.
Namtin vaipi khom ing ting, Thutanna phaicham kalhutsoh ding; Hikoma chu kamite abolnau jal’a Athuu katanpeh ding ahi. Israelte gamtin a athe thenguvin, Kagamsung, Israel akihomtel tauve.
Sohchangho angsanin akihom’un, Noti l eju chohna din nu-ngah gollhang soh-in ajoh-ui.
“Vo Tyre, Sidon chule Philistia gam pumpi, ilo neigot’u ham? I-khat khat lethuh neigot’u ham? Neigot’u le mangangtah a kalethuh ding nahiuve!
Kasana dangka nachomgam’un, kagou chengse nahouin sunguva napolutsoh tauve.





















Hiche ho hi Tekoa khoa kelngoi ching mi Amos thusei ho ahi. Ling kiho masang kum ni na, Judah gama Uzziah lal lai, Israelgama Jehoash chapa Jeroboam lal laiyin, thil hijat hi Pathenin Israel thudol’in aphongdoh tai.
Amos’in aseiyin: “Zion lhanga Pakai akisenin, Jerusalema konin a-ogin akithonge. Hamhing jouse agopsoh tan, Carmel molsang hampa ageosoh tai,” ati.
Pakaiyin asiyin, “Damascus kho mite achonse se jengun, hijeh a hi talen kamatsah tei didng ahi. Galead mite sei theilouvin abolseuve.
Hijeh a chu Hazael sahdoh leng inpia mei kahal’a, Benhadal lengpa kulpi jouse akahvam ding ahi.
Damascu khopi kelkot jouse tumbong ing ting, Aven phaiya chengte le Betheden a vaihompa kadeldoh ding ahi. Syria gama chengte chu Kir gama sohchanga min akai diu ahi,” ati.
Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Gaza mite achonse se jengun, hijeh a chu talen kamatsah tei didng ahi. Mihem nam khat apumpin Edom langa soh-in ajoh chai hel’uve.
Hijeh a hi Gaza kulpi pal jouse kahal’a, akulpi jouse akah lhah ding ahi.
Ashdod khopi le a Ashklon khopia vaihom ho kalahdoh ding ahi. Ekron khopi talen kamatsah a, Philistinete amoh chengse thigam ding ahiuve,” ati.
Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Tyre mite achonse se jengun, hijeh a chu talen kamatsah tei ding ahi. Mihem nam khat apumpin soh-in Edom gama ajoh chai hel’uvin, jol le gol’a kitepna asemsau jong anit pouve.
Hijeh a hi Tyre khopi pal jouse kahal’a, akulpi chengse akah lhah ding ahi,” ati.
Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Edom mite achonse se jengun, hijeh a chu talen kamatsah tei ding ahi. Asopiteu Israelte chu sadel’in adel’un, voujang natpina aneipeh pouve. Alung hang han gjengun, lung damlou hel’in aum’uve.
Hijeh a chu Teman khopi kahal’a, Bozrah kulpi chengse akah lhah ding ahi,” ati.
Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Ammon mite achonse se jengun, hijeh a chu talen kamatsah teiding ahi. Gam keh letna dia gal asat laiyun Gilead nupi gai geiyin ache jengui.
Hijeh a chu Rabbah khopi pal jouse kahal’a, akulpi chengse akah lhah ding ahi. Chuteng gal kisat khosam kithonga, kisatgin chu huise le gose kitho bang ding ahi.
Alengpau le avaipote chengse sohchang dia kitol diu ahi,” ati.
Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Moab mite achonse se jengun, hijeh a chu talen kamatsah tei didng ahi. Noise manjen she-in Edom lengpa gabuh jouse ahalvam’un vutdi asohsah-ui.
Moab gamsung kahal ding, Kerioth kulpi jouse kalhasoh didng ahi. Sepaiten sumkon mut’a kholhang asap tengu, Moab mite chu gal husa thigam diu ahi.
Moab gamsung vaihomte le gamsung lamkai jouse katha ding ahi,” ati.
Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Judah mite achonse se jengun, hijeh a chu talen kamatsah tei didng ahi. Kahilna la angaipouvin, kathupehho jong anit pouve. Apu apateu hou Pathen dihlou hon apui chatvaiyu ahitai.
Judah gam kahal’a, Jerusalem kulpi jouse akahvam ding ahi,” ati.
Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Israelte achonse se jengun, hijeh a chu talen kamatsah tei ding ahi. Abat salel milungdih ho le kengchot to khat man jeng jong lepeh joulou vaichate soh-in ajoh-uve.
Mi lhasam le panpi ngaite chotphan aneiyun, vaicahte lampia aneh doh-ui. Apa le achapan soh-nungah khat akitimatpi gel lhonin, hitobang hin kamintheng asuboh tauve.
Pathen lhaina muntin a vaichate thil tun man a alah-u pon sil’in alum’ui. A-Pathenu Houin sunga jong sum batman a alah-u ju adon jiuve.
“Ahivangin kamite, nang ho khohsah jal’a, gangpi tah a tah, cedar thing san a sang Amor mite geiya kasuhmang ahi.
Egypt’a konin kahin puidoh-un, kum som li sungin gamthip noiya kapuilen, Amor mite gam chu nangho kapeuve.
Nagollhangteu phabep Themgaovin kapanssah-in, adang phabep jong Nazirin kapansah-e. Kasei hi dih lou ham Israel te? Kei-Pakaiyin kasei ahitai.
Ahinla Nazir ho ju nadonsah-un, Themgaoten kathu aseiphong diu nakhah-ui.
Tua vang toljepna kanei diu, changing kangtalai adelnem kabehsah ding nahiuve.
Mi kaljangtah jong jamdoh lou ding, thahat’a jong thabeiya, sepaite jong kihinso jou lou diu ahi.
Thal thempa jong pang jou lou ding, kaljang jong jamdoh man louva, sakol touthemho jong kihinso jou deh ponte.
Hiche nikho chule sepai hangpenin jong manchah paiya jamding ahi,” ati.
Vo Israelte, Egypt’a kona ahinpuidoh nam pumpi, nachung changuva Pakaiyin asei thu hi ngaiyuvin.
“Leiset namtin vaipi hijat lah a kahet le kakhohsah-nang ho bou nahiuve. Hijeh a chu nachonsetnau jong khoh deh a kigel, hicheng jeh tah a chu talen kamatsah tei ding nahiuve,” ati.
Kihoutoh masa louva mi ni kholjin khom nam?
Sa manlou gamthip’a sakei kitum nam? Mat khah neilou sakei nou akosunga kithol lem?
Thang kampeh louva vacha thanga oh ngaiyam? I-toh khah louva thang jangkam kipel ngaiyam?
Khopi sunga gal sumkon kimut teng mipi kicha louva um theiyem? Pakai sol tilouva khosunga manthahna lut ngaiyam?
Alhacha Themgaoho koma phongdoh masa louvin Hatchungnung Pakaiyin athilgon ima atongdoh ngaipoi.
Sakei kisen teng kicha lou didng koi ham? Hatchungnung Pakaiyin thu asei teng, athusei phongdoh lou ding koi umngaiyum?
Egypt le Ashdoh khopi leng inpi dunga chengte koma gaphongun, “Samaria kimvel lhang sang joudsea hung kikhom’un, akhosunga kinahla le kitonona, thilse kibol chengse khu veuvin,” tiuvin.
Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Hiche miho hin ain jouseu pumhat le dih louva kichom doh thilkeo adip’un, lungthenje jong ahepouve.
Hijeh a chu melma khat’in agamsungu umchah-in tin, akulpi chengseu asuhmanga, a-in ho’u jong achomgam ding ahi,” ati.
Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Kelngoi chingpan sakei nehmoh kelngoi keng ni ham ahiloule abilkol khatseh ham amudoh banga, tua insung choldo mun nomtah tah a aning anop’a chon Samaria khosung mite amoh themcha bou hingdoh diu ahi.
Tun ngaiyuvin, Jacob chilhah ten, Thanei Hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseiyin,
‘Israel achonset jal’uva talen kamatsah ni le Bethel a maicham sumang ing ting, maicham ningli saki chengse kiheh bonga tol’a lhamang diu ahi.
Phalbi lai le nipi lai in jouse jong lhu lhama inngem soh diu, in len chengse jong kisumang ding ahi,’ tin aseiye,” ati.
Hiche hi ngaiyuvin Samaria khosung numeiho, Bashan phaiya kivah thao bongpi banga kivah thao ho, tahlelte bolsea, vaichate sugenthei, najipateu henga jut hum jing jeng ho!
Hatchungnung Pakai hi athen bangin akihahsel’in, “mihon thihkoiya nakoiyuva, amichang cheh thihkoiya nga kiman banga namatna diu nikho hung lhung ding ahi.
Pal chim anaipen koma nakailut’uva polama napai mang diu ahi,” ati.
Hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Vo Israelte, Bethel a namuntheng phunguva cheuvin, deilheh nahiule gachonsetau! Gilgal’a cheuvin najochanin chonseuvin! Cheuvin, jingkah seh a kilhaina din dancha hintol tol jengun, nithum lhinseh le hopsom toh toh jenguvin1
Kipat’un thangvahna din changlhah thilto toh toh jengucin, chule natoval jeh-un kithang-at at jengun! Hitobang thil ho holnom nahiuve.
“Nakhopi jouseu kel lhahsah Kei kahin, ahivangin kaheng nahin jon deh pouve.
Na-anche louhingun gotwi lhahsah lou Kei kahi, Khopi khat din go kajuhsah-in, achom khat din kavotangin, loujao khat din go kajuhsah-in, achom khat din kavotange.
Dangchah a thi din naum’un, khopi tam tah a min kho chom khat’a twi thal ding kinemin acheuvin, donkham cha jong amupouve. Hichan geiyin jong neihin jon deh pouve.
“Nalhosoh ga chengseu semheo din huise kalansah-in, nahonlei jouseu le nalengpi lei jouseu, natheichang phungu, chule olive thingna jouse khaokhoten anegamtan, hichan gei hin jong neihinjongpouve.
“Egypt s kalansah tobang gamna hise kalansah-in, nagollhangteu galmuna kathat gamin, nasakolteu kalahpehsoh hel’in, na-ngahmun dunguva thilong monsa uithe thu kanahsah-un, ahivangin neihin jondeh pouve.
“Sodom le Gomorrah kabolna bangin abang bang kasumangun, ahingdoh cheng jong gamkang ka akiloidoh mei leoheosa molkang nabangun, hichan gei hin jong neihinbel deh pouve,” tin Pakaiyin aseiyin;
“Vo Israelte, hijeh a chu talen kamatsah ding ahiuve. Hita kabolgot’u ahitan, kathutanna thoh din kigo jengun,” ati.
Pathen hi molle lhang huile go sempa ahin, Alunggel mihemte ahetsah jin; Senlai nisa jong jan asohsah theiye. Leiset sanglai molvum vuma kengto angam’e. Pakai Pathen thaneipen kiti hi Ama min ahi!
Vo Israel, hiche thivui la kasha khumu hi ngai tem’un:
Nu-ngah tobang Israel alhutai, Kiphongdoh kit louhel ding ahi! Donlouvin tol’a akijamtan, Akaithou ding abeitan!
Hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Israel sung khopi khat’a galkon sepai sang khat soldoh thei chun, ja khat bou ahung kile kit’e. Khopi khatman jakhat asoldoh le som khat she ahung kilei,” ati.
Pakaiyin Israelte jah a aseiyin, “kaheng hinjon’un kihinsouvin!
Pathen hou didn Beersheba a chedauvin, Bethel’a jong neihung hol dauvin, Bethel chu mohseh soh iddng ahi. Gilgal’a che dauvin, amite min gal-hinga akai mang diu ahibouve,” ati.
Pakai kom jon leu chun hinlo jo’uvin nate. Nache daule Israelte chunga mei-am kisunkhum hung bang ding ahi. Hiche meiam chun Bethel khosung mite kavamin tin, aphelmit jou umponte.
Mipi achan ding lom lepthol’a, thudih dunghei vaihei tho loi ada nahiuve!
Pakaiyin ahsi hijat asemin, Bombel le ngambom lungthu jong asem’e. Muthim jinglai avahsah-in, Sunlaipi mu athimsah theiye. Twikhanglen twi achopdoh-in Leiset tolhanga aphi lhai. Amin jong Pakai ahi.
Ahat apaote le akulpi jouseu asumangtai.
Vo thutanna phunga thudih seite hotbol’a, thudih lou nelkal ho kidintepi jing ho!
Mi vaichate bolsen, aching jouseu inhoi tah tah nasah-uva cheng thei louva, lengpilei hoitah tah a naphusau lengpitwi nadon lou diu ahi.
Nachonset melsetjeu le naboljat’u thilse kahe jinge. Mipha bolsen, nehguh nalauvin, thutanna phunga vaichate themchan ding napheltan’ui.
Hitobang phat pha lou laiya umthim beh chu chihhoijo ahitai.
Nahin theina diuvin thilse boldan, thilphajoh bol’uvin. Chutile nasei bangun Pakai Pathen thaneipen chun naumpi tahbeh diu ahi.
Thilse hotbol’un, thilpha boljo’uvin, chule thutanna phunga thudih lensah-un. Chutile tegeiya hingna lai hiche nam mite hi Pakaiyin ahepi thei mai ahi.
Hiti hin Pakai thaneipen Pathenin aseiyin, “Kholai dung jousea ka le mao o-thong ding. Thi-opte lunghempi dinga loubolte geiya kikoulo ding ahi.
Lengpilei lai tina mi kap’intin, nangho talen kamatsah ding jeh a hicheng hi soh tei ding ahi,” ati. Pakaiyin aseitai.
Akineppite din Pakai Nikho chutijat umtah ahi! Hiche Nikho chun ipi thilpha nasodoh peh diu ham? Nangho din khovah hilou, muthim khojin nikho ahibouve.
Sakei ginna jam’an savom ato tobang ahibouve. Insunga jamlut tobang atuhnaa gul’in achuh tobang ahi.
Pakai Nikhoa chu mu thim ding, kho vah lou ding ahi; lung navah bei, lung jin nikho ahi.
Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Nakut bol jouseu kahon, kathoh nampoi!
Pumgo thilto bol’un, changing kilhai jongleur chunsang ponge; kahenga to dia navah thaochet’u ganchate jong sanpeh pouvinge.
Thumje jua la nasah-u jong ngauvin, naselangdah gin’u jong kangai nompoi.
Chusangin thudih chu vadung twilong bahsah-un, adih chu kantih bei vadung long bahsah tau.
“Vo Israelte, kum somli sunga gamthip laiya kapui leu chun kilhaina gantha le thilto ka-ngeh poi.
Ahinla tua doilim kisem Sakkuth Pathen leng le ahsi pathen Kaiwam milimho nahou phat’un,
Damascus khopi kalpeh a gal-hinga kakai tengu nakipohle diu ahitai,” tin asieyin ahi, Pakai, amin thaneipen Pathen kiti chun.
Ohe nadau ahi-Zion lhanga nomtah a chengte, Samaria khopia lung mongtah a um, hiche nam lentah Israel milen milalte, mipin akithopi dia angaichat jing ho!
Calneh khopi gaveuvin. Hamath khopi minthang gaveuvin, kitolsauh-un Philistinete khopi Gath gaveuvin. Hicheng hi Judah le Israel lenggam te ni sanga phajo mong am? Agamu khu nang ho gam sanga lenjom?
Manthahna nikho hung lhung lou din naseiyun, nathilbol chengseu hinla anaisah tel tul’e.
Ohe nadau ahi-saihaa kisem jalkhun chunga kijaole lea, kelngoi thao lailaiya kivah ho!
David boldan danin la nabol’un, semjang saiyin nasaiyuve ong!
Khon letlha hel hel ju nadon’un, gimnamtui pen nakinu’vin, Israel manthahna lung gimpi louvin na-um’uve.
Hijeh a chu min gal-hinga akai masah pen ding nahiuve. Chuteng nakut’u le golvah kibol kit lou ding ahitai.
Thaneipen, Hatchungnung Pakaiyin hitin aseiye, “Israelte kiletsah hi kahoi, a-in’u loupe tah tah jong imacha ding katipoi. Akhopiu le asunga thil jouse amelmateu kapeh ding ahi,” ati.
Insung khat’a mi som hingdoh nah nah jong thi thou thou ding ahi.
Mithipa hengle kom, thivuiya pang chun alongu insunga akaidoh thoding ahi. Thivui pan insunga umpen pen jah a, “Khatbeh to naumkhom lou ham?” ati ding ahi. Chuteng ogin khat’in, “Aumtapoi,” tinte. Chutah le thivuipan, “Paopoh hih-in! Pakai min geiya iphah poh lou diu ahi,” tia asei ding ahi.
Pakaiyin suhmang dia asei teng ni lentah tah hihen neocha cha hijongle ahalsi sia leng mang jeng thei ahi.
Songpi chunga sakolte lhai theiya, min Twikhanglen langkon a akai theiyum? Nanghon akaleh beh-in thudih gutwi nasouvin, thildih dih lou nasouve.
Lodebar khopi nalah-u nahoithopiuvin ahi. Kiletsah tah-in, “Karnaim khopi ilah jengu iha lheh-ui,” natiuve.
Pakai thaneipen Pathenin, “Vo Israel nagamsungu lo dia gamchom mi sepaite kahinsol ding ahi. Hicheho hin sahlam Hamath lamlen a pat lhanglam Arabah phaicham geiya nabol hesoh diu ahi,” ati.
Hatchungnung Pakaiya konin mu kaneiye. Kathilmu naa hi-lengpan hamhing a-at nung, hamdong thah hung kepat dontah-in Pakaiyin khaokhote simsen lou asemdoh tai.
Hiche mu kaneinaa hin-khaokhoten gamsunga ipi hile adong lai lai-hamhing jouse anechaiyun, hijeh chun kenjong, “Hatchungnung Pakai, mipi hi ngaidam jengin! Athigam lo diu ahitai! Alhom’un lhasam tah ahibouvui,” tin kaseiye.
Pakaiyin lung aheiyin, “Namu bang hin kabolda tante,” ati.
Hatchungnung Pakaiya kon thil khat kamu kit’e. Hichea hin Pakaiyin amite maiya halgam agoi. Meipi hin vannoi Twikhanglen lentah geiyin akavam jengin, gam leiset jong akapantai.
Chuphat’in kenjong, “Vo Pakai Pathen, namiten iti addoujou ding ham, nga jengin-alhom behseh-un lhasam tah ahiuve!” tin kataove.
Pakaiyin lung aheiyin, “Hiche jong bolda ding hitante,” ati.
Pakaiya kon mu khat kanei kit’e. Hichea hin Pakai chu songkhai intenaa kitetoh a kigen bang koma adingin, songkhai intena chu achoiye.
Pakaiyin kajah a, “Ipi namun, Amos?” tin eidonge. Kenjong, “Songkhai intena khat,” kati. Hichun Aman, “Bang onsa tobang kamite tetohna dia hiche songkhai intena hi Kaman ahi. Amaho talen matsah kagot hi lung hei lou ding kahi.
Isaac chilhahte doiphung jouse suhmang ding ahi. Israel muntheng geiya ahomsa kijam ding ahi. Jeroboam lengpa leng vai neina kasuhbei ding ahi,” ati.
Bethel a Thempu Amaziah hin Israel lengpa Jeroboam henga thu athot’in, “Mipi jalah a Amos hin nang demna jeng aseiyin, athusei hi gamsungin adou jou tapoi.
Amos sei chu, ‘Jeroboam galmuna thi ding, Israelte hi agamsunga thi ding, Israelte hi agamsunguva kona min gal-hinga akai mang diu ahi,’ tia asei ahi,” ati.
Amaziah hin Amos aphoh-in, “Vo mitva neipa navaltai! Judah gam a kile kit’in chukoma thu gaseitan. Chule mihon tohman penauvinte.
Bethel a vang thu hung seikit hih-in. Nampi Houin, lengpa pathen houna mun ahi,” ati.
Amos chun, “Kei hi tohman neiya gaothusei Themgao kahipoi. Kelngoi chingmi, theipi na kivei kahi.
Ahinla Pakaiyin kelngoi ching kahinaa eikoudoh a amite Israelte koma gaothusei dia eisol ahi.
Hijeh chun Pakai thusei ngaiyin. Israelte kaphoa, gaothu kasei ding najah dai.
Ngaiyin Amaziah Pakaiyin hiche hi naseipeh ahi, ‘Najinu kholai dunga notia panga, nachate galmun a thisoh diu; nagamsung kihomtel tel’a midang kipedoh ding, nangtah jeng jong chiding namdangte gamsunga nagathi ding ahi. Thon louhel’a Israelte hi agamsunguva kona min gal-hinga akaimang tei diu ahitai,’ tia asei ahi,” ati.
Hatchugnung pakaiya konin mu khat kanei kit’e. Hichea hin theiga dimset paipeh khat kamui.
Hichun Pakaiyin, “Ipi namun, Amos?” tin seidonge. Ken jong, “Theiga dimset paipeh khat,” kati. Hichun Pakaiyin, “Kamite Israel beina ding ahung lhungtai. Talen matsah kagot hi hai taponge.
Hiche nikho chuleh leng inpia la kisa jouse lunghem kana kaheidoh ding ahi. Muntin a thilong jeng thilong jeng akijam ding, min thip beh cha apai pai jeng diu ahi,” ati.
Gamsunga vaichate sumanga, neilelte kengchotpha neihom hiche hi ngaiyuvin.
Nangho pin, “Choldo nikho ho beivah vah hen chang kijoh leu hen. Choldo Nikho beivah hen thil kijoh loi leh. Thil manval val lah a, thiltena lhem a te ding, thil cho le thiljoh ho lepthol’a thiltena dih lou kimang ding ahi.
Suhlou chang manmo jong manlu tah a kijoh a, a bat salel, kengchot to khat man jeng jong pejou lou vaichate chu soh dia ikichoh diu ahi,” natiuve.
Pakai Israel Pathen kahisel’in aseiyin, “Thilse abol chengseu sumil ponge.
Ling kihot’a gamsung mi abonchauva lung hesoh diu ahi. Gam pumpi kihot ding . Nile va dung banga kinuh lap lap ding ahi.
Sun laiya nisa kalhumsah a, khovah laiya leiset kathimsah ding phat hung lhung ding ahi. Kei-Hatchungnung Pakaiyin kasei ahitai.
Golnop kut nabol jouseu thivuina kaheidoh a, kipa la nasah chengseu lunghem kana kaehidoh ding ahi. Sam vouchaiya khaodip pon kasilsah diu, chapa khatseh thi kapi minu le mipa kabahsah diu ahi. Hiche nikho chu a chai ni geiya thoh lel hi ding ahi.
“Gamsunga kel kalhahsahna ding phat ahung lhunge. Mipi kel thoh ding chu neh le chah ngaichat hipontin, twi ducha dangchah jong hipouvinte. Pakai thusei ngaicha gilkel le dangchah hiuvinte. Kei-Hatchungnung Pakaiyin kasei ahitai.
Mipi hin sah le lhang simle mal adel le jeng diu ahi. Muntin a Pakai thusei del leuvin tin, mu la mudoh deh pouvinte.
Hiche nikho tengle numei pasal khangdong thahat lai lai jong dangchah a lhu lham soh diu ahi.
Samaria khopia milimdoi pan a kihahsel ji, ‘Dan a pathen jeh, Beersheba pathen jeh,’ tia sei chengse chu dinlhuhsoh hel diu, thou kit lou diu ahi,” ati.
Maicham phunga Pakai din jing kamun, thu apen, “Houin khompi chengse luvum chu havoh voh-in von lang, in pumpi kilingsoh hen. Vojal’in mipi luvum a kitajalsah tan. Athimoh chengse galmun a kathagam ding ahi. Ahin gdodh ajamdoh beihel ding ahi.
Noimigam geiyin jamsuh jongleur, kamatdoh tei tei ding, vanchung geiya kaldoh jongleur, kaloi lhahsoh ding ahi.
Carmel molvum a kisel jongleur, kaholdoh a kamasoh didng ahi. Twikhanglen noiya kisel jongleur gul-lhempi sol ing ting kachuhsah ding ahiuve.
Amelmateuvin gal-hinga akai tengle, athagam diuva kaseipeh ding ahi. Kithopi daa suhgam kagot mong mong ahitai, “a ti.
Hatchungnung, thaneipen Pakaiyin Leiset atham leh ling akihot’in, Leichung chengte alunghemsoh tauve. Leiset pumpi Nile vadung bangin akinuh lap lap’e.
Pakaiyin van a in asan, Leiset chunga vanthamjol adal’e. Twikhanglen twipi achopdoh-in, Leiset chapnou nana mange. Ama hi amin Pakai ahi!
Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Vo Israelte, nangho hi midang to ichomin kagelpon, Sudan mite bangin kagel’e. Nangho Egypt a kahin puidoh bang hin Crete a konin Philistinete kahinpuidoh-in, Kir a konin Syria mite kahin puidoh-e.
Kei-Hatchungnung Pakaiyin hiche chonset dimset Israel lenggam hi kave vei, leiset chunga kasuhgam hel ding ahi. Jacob chilhahte vang abonin sugam ponge.
“Israelte hi tengsa changchi kiloh chil banga kalosah ding, namtin vaipi lah a kalothangsoh a, pannanbei chengse kapaidoh ding ahi.
Kamite lah a chonset chengse galmun a thiden diu- ‘Pathenin thilse eiphahsah pouvinte,’ ti jouse thisoh diu ahi,” ati.
Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Ingemsa tobang David lenggam kasemphatna ding Nikho khat ahung lhunge. Apal jouse semphang ting, katundoh kit ding ahi. Kasah phat’a masang laiya tobang kahisah ding ahi.
Chutengle Edom gamsung jolou chengse Israelten ajo diu, Keiya hisa namtin vaipi ajotho diu ahi,” ati. Hiche sosah ding Pakai chun aseitai.
“Nikhoho chu ahunglhunge,” tin aseiye Pakaiyin; Loukaipan chang-atpa aphah thu ding, Lengpitwi childo pa Lengpiga loupan aphah thu ding ahi. Mol le lhang jouse lengpitwi dimsoh a, Alhang lhganga hoh a long ding ahi.
Kamite agamsunguva kahin puilut kit’a, Khopi gemsa jouse sephaa cheng kit diu ahi: Lengpilei bol’a kivah diu; Honlei bol’a kivah ding ahiuve.
Kapehsa gamsunga kamite kachensah ding, Kikalkang kit lou diu ahitai,” ati. Pakai na-Pathen’uvin aseitai.
Obadiah gaothusei chu hiche hi ahi: Edom mite chung thudol’a Hatchungnung Pakai thusei chu hiche hi ahi.
Pakaiyin Edom jah a seiyin, “Lhasamin nalhang ting, Namtinin nanoise ding ahi.
Nahoi tho nan nalhem lhan, Nakhopi kulpi songthum jeng ahin, Molvum a in kisah nahi; Hijeh hcun naseiyin, ‘Eisu lhu jou ding koi ham?’ nati.
Na-in chu muvanlai bu banga sangtah a nasah a, Ahsite to akivet chep jeng vangin, Kaloilhah a kakai lhah ding nahi.
“Janteng gucha ahungle alahnom bou alai. Mihon lengpiga alo teng them khat asalhateiye. Nang vang namelmaten nasuhgam hel ding ahi.
Esau chilhahte, nagou jouseu min achomsoh tai.
Napanpi ten nalepthol’un, nagamsunga konin nadelmangtauve. Chamdel’a nalenpiten gal’in nabol’un najoutauve. Ankong khat naso khompiten kipalna thang nakampeh-ui. Amahon nathudol aseiyun, ‘Achihna hoiya um hitam?’ atiuve.
“Edom talen kamatsah ni leh amichingteu kasuhgam a, achihnau aboncha kasuhbei ding ahi.
Teman gal-hangte tija lih diu, Edom gamsung sepaite aboncha min athagam ding ahi.
“Nasopite, Jacob chilhah ho nachomgama natha jal’a, nakisugam hel ding, a-itih a jum thoh a na um ding ahi.
Melmaten akelkot jouse aphutjal nikho, nangin jong napeldoh ni leh, Jerusalem gou jouse pomanga kihomsoh gamchom miho chutoh nabah ding ahi.
Judah gama nasopite hamset chu nakipapi lou ding dol ahi. Ahamset nikhouva chu nakipa lou ding, agim nau chu nuisat hoh a nanei lou ding ahi.
Kamite khopi sunga chu agenthei hesoh nau nuisat a, ahamset nikhouva agou jouseu chomgam dia nalut lou diu dol ahi.
Ajamdoh go ho mantan dia lamsom ajong nadin lou ding ahi. Ahamset nikhouva amaho hi amelmatau khut’a napehdoh lou ding ahi.
“Kei-Pakaiyin namtin vaipi thu Katanna ding nikho anaiye. Vo Edom, mi nabol banga nakibol ding ahi. Napehsa chu nachan kit ding ahi.
Kamiten talen ju kha tah adontauve, ka lhang theng chunga chun, ahinla akimvel’a cheng namtin vaipin akhacheh talen ju adon diu ahi. Ju donchimset’untin leng mang jel diu ahi.
“Zion molsanga phabep hung jamlut’un tin, alhang jeng jong muntheng soh ding ahi. Jacob chaten agoulo gamu chu alo kit diu ahitai.
Jacob chate le Joseph chate chu meikou bang jeng diu, meiyin changpol akah banga Esau chate asuhgam diu ahi. Esau chilhah khatcha hingdoh ponte, Kei-Pakaiyin kasei ahitai.
“Judah gam lhanglama chengten Edom gamsung alo diu ahi. Lhumlam thinglhang bul’a chengten Philistia gam alah diu ahi. Israelten Ephraim le Samaria alah diu, Benjamin chaten Gilead alah diu ahi.
Israel gam sahlam a sohchang sepaite hung kile kit’untin Phoenicia alah diu, Zarephath geiya alah diu ahi. Sardis a sohchang Jerusalema umten Judah gamsung lhanglam khopi chengse alah diu ahi.
Jerusalema galjouten Edom delkhumintin achunga vaihom diu, Pakai amatah leng chang ding ahi,” ati.
Ni khat hi Amittai chapa Jonah koma Pakaiyin thu aseitai.
Aman, “Khopi lentah, Nineveh a chen lang, khopi dounan thu gaseitan; khosung mite gitlou engsetna jouse kahetai,” ati.
Ahivangin pakai thupeh peldohna din Jonah lamchom beh a akiheitai. Joppa achen, Spain gam jon ding kon gkhat amudoh-in, Pakaiya kona gamlat ding ngaoti nan, kong touman pen, Spain gam jon din gkong tol ho to akilhontai.
Ahin Pakaiyin Twikhanglen chu huise hattah anunsah-in, huise chu ahat behseh jengin, kong inneichu apeichip pai ding ahitai.
Kongtol ho atija lih gamtauvin, amichan cheh-in ama ama pathen kom cheh a ataovun, panpi athumtauve. Chujongle kong innei chu ajandomna din kong sunga thilkeo chu apaidoh doh tauve. Hichepat tah hin Jonah chu kong tolam indan sunga alut’in khomang meiyin a-ihmui.
Jonah chu kongtol lamkaipun amudoh-in ajah a, “I-atileh hitobanga ihmu a nahim? Thouloiyin na-Pathen henga panpi thumin tao loi tang-em. Chutile eilungset’uva eihinso theiyu hichu men,” ati.
Kongtol ho akihouvun, “hitobang hamset itolo nau hi koipen ahiding vang san’uhitin holdoh temu hite,” akitiuve. Hitia abol’u le Jonah min ahung potdoh tai.
Hijeh chun amahon jong ajah a, “Ngoh thei mong nahim neihil’un. Hikoma ipi bol’a jong hung nahim? Hoiche gama hungkon, ipi jat mi nahim?” tin adongtauve.
Jonah-in adonbut’in, “Kei Hebrew mi kahin Twikhanglen le leiset Sempa Pakai Van Pathen hou mi kahi,” ati.
Pakaiya kona jam ahijong chu Jonah hin aseipeh tai. Kongtol ho chu atija lih jel jengun ajah a, “Tijat umtah thil nabol hita chu men!” atiuve.
Huise Chula akhoh cheh cheh jengin, hijeh chun kongtol hon, “Huise thipna dia nang hi i-kalo diu ham?” tin adongui.
Jonah-in adonbut’in, “Twikhanglen a neisep lut leu chun huise hi thip tante. Kei jal’a hiche huise nato khah-u kahenai,” ati.
Hijongle kongtol hon kong inneichu twi pamchin a toldoh tei din thahangsanin apangui. Ahinla huise chu akhoh cheh cheh tan, suhna ding ahetapouve.
Hijeh chun Pakai henga akap jengun, “Vo Pakai, hichepa tha nagot jeh-in keiho jong neitha tha dauvin! Hitobangpi hi Nang bol ahin, Nang mopohna bou ahi,” tin ataovui.
Hiti hin Jonah chu Twikhanglen a aselut’u le, apet pet’in huise chu athip del tai.
Hiche hin Kongtol ho akichatsah tan, pakaiya akilhaiyun, Ama kinbol din akitep lo tauve.
Twito lam ngapi oisunga konin Jonah chu Pakai a-Pathen koma ataovin:
“Vo Pakai, kagimpet’in kakouvin, Nangin jongneihouve. Noimigama konin kahin kouvin, Panpi ngaiya katao najai.
Twikhanglen tothuh laiya neileh lut’in, Twipin eichupsoh tan, Natwipi kinonglaiyin Eilonvuh soh tauve.
Na-angsunga kona paidoh a um, Na-Houin theng mukit dia kinem lou kahitai.
Twipin wichuptan, akichisoh tai, Twikhanglenin eichupsoh hel ahitai, Twipi kidil’in eilonvuh tai.
Molsang bulpi kaheitan, Kot kihontih umlou Gamsung kageitai. Hijongle vo Pakai ka_pathen, Lithuh laiya konin kahingin neipuidoh-in !
Kahinkho beihel kahetan, Hijeh chun nahenga kataovin, Na-Houin theng sunga Kataona ogin najai.
Pananbei milimdoi houten, Nang dia akitahnau apaitauve.
Kenvang navhachoi la sang ting, Nakoma kilhaiying ting kakitepna molsonge. Huhingna chu Pakaiya kon bou ahi!” tin ataove.
Hijeh chun Pakaiyin ngapi chu Jonah lodoh din asol’in, ngapin jong aseipeh bangin twi pamchin a alodoh tai.

Pakiyin Jonah koma thu asei kit’in,
“Kaseipeh thu hi Nineveh khopi minthang tah dudnga gaseitan,” ati.
Hijeh chun Jonah hin Pakai sei angaiyin, Nineveh khopi lentah, nithum sunga jong jotdoh lel a chun achei.
Jonah hin khopi chu ajot panin, nikhat lhumkei ajot nungin lhang asamin, “Nisom li sunga hiche Nineveh khopi hi kisumang ding ahitai,” ati.
Nineveh khopi miten Pathen thusei cu atahsan tauve. Hijeh chun alungheiyu vetsahnaa mitinin an ngol’a, alen aneo aboncha khaodip pon sil cheh din pha asatauve.
Nineveh khopi lengpan ajahsoh phat’in alaltouna akipatdoh-in, aponchol hoh lhan, khaodip pon sil’in, leivui lah a atoutai.
Nineveh khopi mite koma phonjal ding thu khat alhan, “Hiche lengpa le avaipote thupeh ahi Koimacha cha, mihem hihen bong ho hile, kelngoiho geiya an nei twidon um thei louhel ding ahi.
Mihem jouse le gancha jousen jong khaodip pon asilsoh hel ding ahi. Mitinin thilse bol angah a, chonthanghoi angah diu, lung giltah a Pathen henga tao cheh diu ahi.
Chutile Pathenin lung aheiya, eihinso theiyu jong ahi!” ati.
Lungheiya athilbol’u hi Pathenin amutai; achon gitlou nau angah jengu chu amudohtan ahi. Hijeh chun Pathenin lung aheiyin, aseisa bangin talen amatsah tapoi.
Jonah hin nommo san along hangtai.
Hijeh hin ataovin, “Vo pakai, hitia hi nabol dia kaseisa hilou ham? Hijeh a chu Spain langa jamsoh tei kanagot ahi! Milungset them le mihepi them, thoh hat jing, khoto jing lunghei ding go jing talen matsah lougo nahi kahei.
Vopakai tunvang kahin sangin neithat le chun phajonte,” ati.
pakaiyin adonbut’in, “nalunghanpi thei ipi ham?” ati.
Jonah chu apotdoh-in khopi niso lama agatouve. Hikoma hin lim kisonin alim noiya atouvin, Nineveh khopia e-aso ding ve-lhi jingin aum’e.
Hichun Pakaiyin Jonah limbel din umphung khat akesah-in ahi. Jonah-in umphung akipapi lheh jenge.
Ahinla ajing khovah lhah-in umphung chu Pathen thusah-in lungin anen athitai.
Nisa son Pathenin niso lam huisa alansah-in, nisan aluchang asah peh behseh phat’in Jonah chu alhu lham pai ding a hitai. Jonah chuathi nom leo jengin, “Thi leng kadeijoi,” tin aseitai.
Ahivangin Pathenin ajah a, “Hiche umphung jeh a lunghanna thei ipi naneiyem?” ati. Jonah chun adonbut’in, “Lunghang dia kilom mong, thi geiya lung hang thei kahi!” tin aseiye.
Pakaiyin ajah a aseiyin, “Hiche umphung hi jankah a hung kehdoh, ajinga thi kit ahin, nang kesah jon ghilou nathisah hilou-ahivangin nalung natpi lheh-e!
Achutile Nineveh khopi lentah khu Ken ichan geiya ka-itjoh ding hitam! Ahimongin jong akhosunga khun monabei chapang mai mai jong milhing sang ja khat le sang som ni lahingin, gancha simsen lou to aumthai!” ati.
Judah gama Jotham le Ahaz chule Hezekiah lengvai poh laiyin Moresheth khoa cheng Micah henga Pakaiyin asei chu hiche hi ahi. Pakaiyin Micah henga Samaria le Jerusalem khopi te ni chung chang thudol abonchan aphongdoh-e.
Namtin vaipin ngaiyuvin; Leiset chung chengten jasoh keiyun! Hatchungnung Pakaiyin nangho douna aseiye. Ngaiyun, avan Houin a thu aseitai!
Pakai amunthenga konin ahungin, Hung kumlhan, molvum jouse achot ding ahi.
Achot ten gmolsang jouse jolsoh din g, Molsang jouse molvuma twilhaisuh banga phaichama longlha diu ahi.
Pathen douna Israelte chonsea doumah abol jal’uva thil hicheng hi hungsoh ding ahi. Israel doumah bol hi koipen mochang ding ham? Akhopiu Samaria ngoh ding ahi! Judah gamsunga milimdoi kihou hi koi themmio ding ham? Jerusalem khopi themmi ding ham? Jerusalem khopi ngoh ding ahi!
Hiti hin Pakaiyin aseiye, “Samaria khopi hi khogem kaso ding, lengpileiya bol thei kahisah ding ahi. Khopi sung thilse jouse phaicham khat’a kasun lhah ding, khopi bulpi khom jouse alheng lhol’a kajam ding ahi.
Milomdoi manlu tah tah ho kasuhgoiya, Houin a noti ho kipe chengse chu kahalvam ding, amilimdoi chengse alhuh lhuh a kise ding ahiuve. Semaria khopin hicheng hi leiphatna dia kithoina amanu ahin, tua vang melmaten munchom a doi hou dia akaimang diu ahitai,” ati.
Micah hin aseiyin, “Hichejeh hin kap’in maovinge. Kalung gim vetsahna sagohkeo le kengto keova kavale ding ahi. Kamkei penin peng ing ting, va-ngongsao hamin ham ing’e.
Samaria maha kiboldam thei lou ding, Judah jong hitobanga chu genthei thoh ding koncha ahitai; kamite chenna Jerusalem kelkot phunga manthahna ahung lhungtai,” ati.
Gal ilel’u hi Gath a kamelmateu gaseipeh dauvin: nakau jong musah hih-un. Beth Leaphrah mite, nalung gim chu vetsahnan leivui lah a kilih leuvin!
Vo Shaphir mite, sagoh keo, jum le ja thoh-in ohchangin kitol’uvin. Zaanan khoa chengte akhopiuva konin apotdoh ngam tapouve. Bethezel kho mite lunghem najah tengu, kiselna aum loudol hetauvinnate.
Pakaiyin manthahna Jerusalem kom ahinlhut phat’in Maroth miten onthol ding angah lel lheh tauve.
Lachish a chengten sakolte kangtalai to tolloiyun. Israelte nachonset nakom’un, Jerusalem geiyin nachonset sah tauve.
Hijeh chun tun Judah tan Moresheth Gath lhadoh tauvin. Isdrael lengthen Achzib khopia konin panpina imacha mutapouvinte.
Vo Mareshah mite, nakhopiu toupha din gmelma khut’a Pakaiyin naoehdoh diu ahitai. Israel lamkai loupe the the ho jong Adullam songkoa gakisel diu ahi.
Vo Judahte, na-it lai lai yu chapang ho lung gimpin sam kivochai jengun. Muthong bangin lutol’in um’uvin, nachateu akikaimangin sohchangin atol tauve.
Jalkhuna mitsing louva thilse jeng gel jingte ada nahiuve! Jingkah khovah vah-in, agonsau thilse chu amasapenin abol pan jengui.
Loumun adei le alauvin, mi thil imacha cha abit’a aum theipoi.
Hijeh chun Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Hahsatna lhun khumsah kagot nahiuvinm jamdoh theipouvin nate. Gim hesohna nato diu, hoi tho tah a lam najot lou diu ahitai.
Hiti hi ahung lhun teng, nathoh nai mihon gim hahsa khohje kihilna hiche anoiya la hi asah diu: Amangthah hel kahitauve, Kagamu Pakaiyin alamangtan, Soh a eihenteu apedoh tai,” tiuvinte ati.
Hichea hi Pakai mite agamsung hi akilepeh ki tphat jongle nangho chan ding umponte.
Mihon eihil’un kajah a, “kakom’uva thu seiphong hih-in. Nasei phong ho chengse seiphong phong dan. Pathenin eihot louhel diu ahi.
Israelte hi gaosap chang a nagel ham? Pakaiyin lung alhaso hitam? Hitobangpi hi abolmong ding ham? Thildih bolte dia thilpha khoto to um asei lou ham?” atiuve.
Pakaiyin adonbut’in, “kamite nadel khum’un, inluma choldo nom a galmuna hung kile kit ho geiyin ponsil nihchen lahpeh kit din nachang lhiuve.
kamite numeiho inluma konin nadeljam’un, achateu chu kavangboh changkit louhel din nahcom gamtauve.
Kipatdoh-in chen, hikoma lungmon abeitai. Nachonsetnauvin hiche mun jeng jong hi manthahna achuhsah ding ahitai.
“Hiche miten adeiyu Themgao chu jouthu le lepthol thu jeng seile lea, ‘Lengpitwi le ju nadon jing theina diuvin gaopeh nange,’ ti ho chubou ahi.
“Kenvang kaikhom ung ting, Israel amoh chengse kachop khom ding ahi. Akulsung jon dia kihoikhom kelngoi hon banga kahoi khom ding nahiuve. Hamdong lah kelngoite dimset banga nagamsungu hi mihem tamtah hung dim kit ding ahi,” ati.
Pathenin lampi semdoh-in tin, amaho hi sohchanna muna konin puidoh-inte. Khopi kelkot phujal’un tin, jalen diu ahi. Alengpau –Pakai Amatah-in apuidoh diu ahi.
Ngaiyuvin Israel vaipoten! Thudih khohsah dia kigel nang hon,
thilpha naho’uvin, thilse nadeijo’uve. Kamite vun nalip’un, apheu na-at lhauvin,
kamite nanegam tauve. Avun’u nalipdoh-un, aguu naheh bongun, aphe avouvu belsunga hontheiyin na-atpan pan’ui.
Pakai henga natao phat’u hung lhung ding, Aman la nahou lou diu ahi. Thilse nabol jal’un natao nau sang ponte.
Sum apeh tengu chamna um ding seipeh a, apeh da tengu gal hung kon jeng dia thusei Themgaoten kamite alhemlha gamtauve. Hiche Themgaoho jah a hin Pakaiyin aseiyin,
“Vo themgaoho, hingsot tapouvin nate! Nisan nalhum khum diu ahitai. Kamite lam hilouva napui jal’uva, Themgao thilmua jong ima namu lou diu, thilsoh ding imacha jong nasei thei lou diu ahitai,” ati.
Khonung thilsoh ding seiho chu aguilhun lout eng mi vetda chang diu ahi. Pathenin adonbut lout eng min avet neo diu ahi.
Keivang Pakaiyin A-Lhagaoeidip’in, thahat eipen, thudih le hanna eipen, Israelte chonsetna chengse kaseipeh ngamin ahi.
Ngaiyuvin Israel vaipote, thudih deimoa, thildih chu adih louva kheldoh ho!
Jerusalem khopi chu tolthana ke thudih louva natousah-u ahitai!
Khopi sung vaipoten nehguh akilah-un, Themputen Danthu chu tohman neiyin ahilchen’un, themgaohom sum lo nan thu aphonguve. Abonchauvin Pakaiyin aumpi dol’in akiseiyuve. “Pakaiyin eiumpiuve,” ati cheh-ui.
Nangho jal’a Zion lhang hi loukaiya kikaiya, Jerusalem hi khogem doh ding, Houin kisahna lhang hi gammang thim lai soh ding ahi.
Houin kisahna molsang hi Molsang pen ahina ding nikho hung lhunga, Molle lhang jouse sanga Sangjo ding ahi. Namtin vaipi simsen louvin Hiche molsang chu hinbel’in tin,
Amiteuvin jong asei diu, “Pakai molsanga kal’u hitin, Israel Pathen Houin a cheute. Eibolsahnom’u eihil diu, Asemsa lampia iche diu ahi. Pakai hilchahna Jerusalema hungkon ahin, Zion a konin Pakaiyin Amite jah a thu seiye,” tiuvinte.
Pakaiyin gamla naiya thaneitah tah Namtin vaipi kidou thu seichaminte. Agal chemjamu langkonin khengun tin, Tengcha jouse kangkuiya akhen diu, Namtin vaipi gal kon kit louva, Galsat dia jong kigo lou didu ahi.
Mitin lung monga um diu, Alengpilei le theichang leiya chenguva, Ahoh kicha ding beihel ding, Hiche Thaneipen Pakaiyin atepsa ahitai.
Mi anam namin adoi-apathen cheh ngaiyintin, akihou cheh diu, eihon vang tonsot tonsot’a Pakai i-Pathenu ihouvuva athua inun diu ahi.
Pakiyin aseiyin, “Talen kamatsah a, sohchang genthei thohte kakhop khomna din gphat ahung lhunge.
Elbai chatmoa, in a kona gamla tah gei ahitauvin, ahingdoh amoh chengse to abul kapatdoh a thah a, nam lentah kasosah ding ahi. Hichea pat hi Zion a pansa, tonsot tonsot geiya achunguva vai kahomding ahi,” ati.
Vo Jerusalem, kelngoi chingpa banga Pathenin amite achin jingna mun, nalenggam dinga khopi lenpen mun nahi kit tei ding ahi.
Idia hibang othonga peng nahim? Iti namei naoso nat nabah ham? Leng beiya nauma, thumop them jouse thigam jeh ham?
Vo Jerusalem mite, tua khopi dalha gamchang noiya nachen ding jeh-in, numei naoso nat bangin, na san kipehle le jengin. Babylon gam najot din gahitan, hijongle namelmatea konin pakaiyin nahuhhing nante.
Nadelkhum din namtin vaipi akikhomtauve. Amahon, “Jerusalem hi suhmang tei tei ding ahi! Hiche khopi hi alheng alhol’in jam jengu hite,” atiuve.
Ahivangin hiche nam mite hin Pakai lunggel ahepouve. Cahngphal kipukhoma kichilngem banga Pakaiyin talen matsah dia apuikhom lam akihet phah pouve.
Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Jerusalem mite, cheuvin namelmateu talen matsah-un! Aki thih to bang, atin sum-eng tobang bongchal hat’a kahatsah diu, namtin vaipi nasuhgep’uva, pumhat’a achomdoh-u neile gou chengse chu, Vannoi pumpi Pakai-Kei neipeh diu ahi,” ati.

Vo Jerusalem mite, sepaite khomsoh loiyun! Galmin eiumchah tauve! Israel lamkaipu adelkhum tauve!

Judah gama Amon chapa Josiah lengpa khanga Pakaiyin Zephaniah henga asei thu hiche hi ahi. (Zephaniah hi Hezekiah lengpa son ahin, Hezekiah cha Amariah ahin, Amariah cha Gedariah, Gedaliah cha Cushi, chule Cushi cha chu Zephaniah ahi.)
Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Keiman leiset thil jouse kasuhmang ding ahi.

Gaza kho sung a koima kikhen lou didng ahi. Ashkelon kho min dalha soh- intin, Ashdod kho mite nilanga kiseljamsoh ding ahiuvin, Ekron khosung mite khosunga kona kinodoh ding ahiuve.

Kikhel lou Hing jing Israel Pathen kahinaa kihahsel kahi-Moab le Ammon hi Sodom le Gomorrah banga kasuhgam ding ahi. Akhomun jouseu jong chikhuh soh didng, tonsot khogem a kijam a, lingle khao keh dimset ding ahi. Kamite ahingdoh chengin amaho hi chomgam’untin, agamsungu alahpeh diu ahi,” ati.

Kabol gimna hi kamiten gel jinga, kagahna asan diu, chuteng eija lheh diuvin kanagel’e. Ahinla chomkah louvin chavai bubah-in alamkittauve,” ati.
