Sudan gam lang peh a thechehsa kamiten jong kahenga kilhaina thilto ahinchoi diu ahi.
hiteng chule neidou jal’uva mit le maim oh aum lou din gnahitauve. Kelietsah hoitho chengse tolmang ing ting, kalhang theng chunga neidou kit louhel diu ahi.
Mi nun nem le kineosah chengse khen in gting, kahenga panpi ngaiya hun gjing diu ahi.
Israel ahin gdoh chengin mi koima dih louvin bol pouvintin, jou sei lou ding, lhep lhah thu jong sei pouvinte. Lung mong le khangtouva um a, gin nei lou didng ahiuve,” ati.
Vo Israelte, kipa la sauvin! Vo Jerusalem nalungthim pumpin kipah-in!
Pakiyin nathohna asubeitan, Namelmate atolmangdoh tai. Pakai, Israel Lengpan naumpiuve, Kichatna ding him him aumtapoi.
Phat ahung lhunge mihon Jerusalme jah a, “Kicha hih-in Zion khopi! Ban-gol jesal jingin!
Pakai na-Pathenin naimpi jinge, Athahat’in gal najosah tai. Pakaiyin kipapin natin, Alungset jal’in hinkhothah pen nate, Nachung change kipa la santé.
Kut laiya kipah ho bang ding ahi,” ati diu ahi. Pakaiyin aseiyin: “hutotna ka-ngatan, Vetda nachan kasubeitai.
Phat ahung lhungtai! Nabolse talen matsah ing ting, Elbai chengse kahuhdoh ding, Sohchangte inlama hin puiyinge. Jumle ja athohna chengseu Ginle jabolna kaheidoh a, Vannoi miten apachat diu ahi.
Phat ahung lhunge! Namite cheh chaosa puikhom ing ting, Vannoi minthang kihisah ding, Naphat theiya nahaodoh kit ding ahi,” ati. Pakaiyin aseitai.
Darius Persia gamvaipoa apan kal kum ni lhinna, lha gupna, ni masapen nin Haggai Themgao kamin Pakaiyin thu ahinseiye. Athusei hi Judah gam vaipo Zerubbabel, Shealtiel chapa le Thempu chungnung Joshua, Jehozadak chapa ding ahi.
Thaneipen Pakaiyin Haggai jah a aseiyin, “Hiche ho hi Houin sah phatna ding hilou laiyin aseiyui,” ati.
Hijeh chun Pakaiyin mipi dingin hiche thu hi Haggai Themgao kamin aseiye:
“Vo kamite, idia nang ho, in phatah tah a chenga, Kei Houin asesa kijam ham?
Nachunguva thilsoh mulou nahiuvem?
Muchi tampi natu vangun lhosoh ga themcha bou namu’uve. Neh ding nanei vangun oivana kham ahipoi. Lengpitwi don ding naneiyun, chimna kham ahipoi! Ponsil naneiyun, lum nasahpi khamu ahipoi. Natong’an oivana amujoupoi.
I-tile hiti ho hi soh ahi namudoh louvu ham?
Tun thinglhang lama kaltouvun; inthil gajongun Houin saphauvin; kalung lhai ding, eikihou dol’a eikihou ding ahi.
“Lhoga tampi mu ding nakinem’un, amala lhomcha ahiji. Lhosoh in a nahinpoh lut tengu jongle kamut mangpehjitai. Idia kabol ham? Ka-Houin sesa um a, nading cheh bolna nakisah lel jal’u ahi.
Hijeh a chu gotwi lha louva muchi chivo phalou-keh lou ahi.
Gamsunga gotwi kang a, molle lhang gosoh, bulei le lengpilei jouse go a, olive honlei jouse gosoh, muchi chivo jouse gotwi ngai, mihem le gancha chule thil ijakai gotwi ngaiya umsoh ahitai,” ati.
Babylon a sohchang hung kile kit-Zerubbabel le Joshua chule mipin Pakai a-Pathen’un bol dia aseipeh-u chu aboltauve. Pakai sole Themgao Haggai chu aging cheh-un asei angaiyui.
Hichun Haggaiyin Pakai thusei chu mipi aseipeh-in: “Kakitep ahitai-kaumpi jing ding nahiuve,” ati.
Sohchang hung kile kit-Zerubbabel, Judah gam vaipopa, Thempu chungnung Joshua, chule mipi abonchauvin Houin sapha din Pakaiyin atildoh tai. Hijeh chun thaneipen Pakai a-Pathenu Houin asapantauve.
Asah patnau chu Darius gamvaipoh kal kum nina, lhagup lhin, nisom ni le li ni ahi.
Darius leng chankal kum ni lhinna, lha sagi lhin, nisom ni le khat nin Pakaiyin Haggai Themgao kamin thu ahinsei kit’e.
Aman Haggai chu Judah gam vaipo Zerubbabel le Thempu chungnung Joshua, chule mipi jah a thu sei din asol’in,
“Houin loupije chu geldoh theiya nalah-uva mihem khat beh umlou ham? Itobanga namujiu vem? Tunvang imacha ahitapoi.
Hijongle khatchan jong lungthoinan neidauvin. Tongpan’un, Ka-umpi jing nauve.
Egypt’a kona nahungdoh-u chun ka-umpi jing diuvin kakiteptai. Tunjong kaumpi jingui kicha hih-uvin.
“Phat chomkah louva van le leiset, Twikhanglen kaholingsoh ding ahi.
Namtin vaipi lehkhup soh ing ting, anei agou chengseu hikoma kahin poh khom ding, Houin hi nei le gou dimset ding ahi.
Vannoiya sana dangka jouse aboncha Keiya ahi.
Houin luipa sanga Houin thah loupijo cheh ding, chuteng kamite chamle lungmon, haona kapeh ding ahi,” ati. Thaneipen Pakaiyin asei ahitai.
Darius gamvaipoh kal kum ni na, lha ko lhin, nisom ni le ni li lhin nin thaneipen Pakaiyin Haggai Themgao kamin thu ahinseiyin,
“Aban a kisei thudol’a hin Thempuhon ilo ding agot’um dong temin:
Mihem khat touvin kilhaina sathenga kithat sahal khat tou aponsil’in kichundoh hen, hiche ponsil hin ipi thil hijongle: changlhah ham, an minsa ham, lengpitwi ham, olive thao ham, khat pen pen tongkha le, atoh khah pen pen chu sutheng theiyin tem?”a ti. Hiche thudoh hi adoh phat’un thempuhon, “Theng theiponte,” atiuve.
Haggaiyin adong kit’in, “Mihem khat’in thilong tongkhan kisuboh taleh, aman atoh khah khah neh le chah ho chu boh thei ding ham?” ati. Thempuho, “Boh theiyinte,” atiiuve.
Haggaiyin aseiyin, “Pakaiyin aseiyin, hitobanga chu hiche nam mite chunga jong chuti ding ahin, atohdoh aboldoh chengseu jong chuti ding ahi; hiti hin maicham phunga atodoh chengseu jong abohsa jeng ahibouve,” ati.
Pakaiyin, “Nachunguva thilsoh hi nahetdoh thei louvu ham? Houin sah phat napat masangun,
chang kilogram ja ni jen tedoh din che leu chun kilogram jakhat bou umintin, lengpitwi litre jakhat thaldoh din lengpitwi bel gave leu chun litre som li bou um ding ahi.
Ke dohsah tei dia natu anche louhing jouse semchai din khohui hamve vun kalansah-in, lungnaheideh pouve.
Tuni hi lha ko na, nisom ni le ni lhin na, Houin inmun kilaijou nikho ahi. Tua pat ipi hungsoh ding vetem’uvin.
Changsal keosoh hen, lengpiga heosoh hen lang, theichang ga heo hen, kolbuthei le olive thing ga heo ta jongle, tua pat vang phatthei kaboh diu ahitai,” ati.
Chuche lha, nisom ni le ni li lhin nin Pakaiyin Haggai kam a, thu asei kit’in,
athusei hi Judah gam vaipo, Zerubbabel ding ahin, “Ken Van le leiset kaholing a,
lenggam jouse le athaneina chengse akhup athal’a kakoi ding ahi. Kangtalai ho le atol ho akhup athal’a kale a, sakolte thigam a, achung toute kithat to diu ahi.
Hiche nikho tengle kalhacha Zerubbabel, nang hi kamin a vaihom dia kalhendoh ding nahi. Kalhendohsa nahitai,” ati. Thaneipen Pakaiyin aseitai.
Darius hin Persia gamvai apoh kal kum ni na, lha get nan Iddo tupa, Berechiah chapa, Zechariah Themgao henga Pakaiyin hiche thu hi aseiye.
Thaneipen Pakaiyin Zechariah hi mipi aseipeh din aseiyin, “Kei-Pakai hi napu napateu chunga lung hang kahi,
hijongle nang ho hi, ‘hung kit’un, Keijong nahenguva hungkit nange.’
Napu napateu umchan jop dauvin. Masangin themgao hon thilse boldin ail’un, chonse lou din asei peh-ui.Ahivangin kasei ngailou, kathu nit louvin aum’ui.
Napu napateu le Themgao ho chu abeisoh tai.
Kalhacha Themgao ho mang chan-napu napateu thu kapen, kagisaljie, ahivangin nahsah mon aum’un gim genthei athoh lo’uve. Chutah le thaneipen Pakai Ken talen matsah lom ahi banguva kabol hon, lung aheiji tauve,” ati.
Darius gamvai poh kal kum ni na, lha som le khat, Shebat lha, nisom ni le ni li lhin nin, jan a mu kaneinaa Pakaiyin sei ding thu khat eihil’e.
Pakai Vantil khat hi sakolsan chunga atouve. Vantil chu phaicham a huisum thing lah a adingin, anunga hin sakol dang-asan le abong, akang tampi aum’uve.
Kenjong, “Pu, hiche dakolte hi ipito tekah ham?” tin kadonge. Aman, “Nahilchen nange.
Leiset gakholtoh dia Pakaiyin asol ho chu ahiuve,” ati.
Hiche ho hin Vantil jah a thu ahinlhut’un, “Vannoi leiset kagakhol soh keiyun, vannoi pumpi panpibei le mi noiya umkamu’ve,” tin aseiyui.
Hichun Vantil’inaseiyin, “Vo Thaneipen Pakai, Jerusalem khopi le Judah gamsung khopi jouse chungakum som sagi sungin nalung hangin, itih tah le ba nahepi ding ham?” ati.
Pakaiyin Vantil chu lungmon na thun adonbut’in,
Vantil chun thaneipen Pakai thusei phongjal din eihil’in, “Kakhopi theng, Jerusalem ka-it behseh jengin,
chamle lungmonga nomtah a um nam mite chunga kalung hangtai. Kamite chunga chom khat lung dam kabol kahseh-in jong, hiche nam mite hin kamite melse cheh-in abolgentheiyui.
Hijeh a chu Jeruslem khopi hepi dia hungkile kit ahi. Jerusalem khopi kisapha a, Ka-Houin kisemthah didng ahi,” ati.
Vantil’in kaphonjal din aseiyin, “Thaneipen Pakaiyin akhopi jouse khangtou kit’a, Jerusalem jong akithopia, Ama khopi mong monga asei din aseiye,” ati.
Kagaochan na a thilte-na jol choi pasal khat kamui.
Kenjong, “Hoiche ding nahin?” tin kadonge. Aman, “Jerusalem khopi let le neo, asaodol tetoh didng kahi,” ati.
Hichun kajah athusei jing Vantil chun eihin nailut’in, Vantil chom khat man ahinjonin akitoh lhon’e.
Vantil masan khatjoh jah a, “Thilte-na choi golhangpa khu gaseipeh-in, Jerusalem khopi sunga mihem l egancha tamval’a kulpin adol lou ding ahi.
Pakai Amatah kitep’a, khopi kimvel’a chu Ama meikou banga pal a kigen ding, Aloupina hunei tah apanga khopi a-nga ding ahi,” ati.
Pakaiyin amite jah a aseiyin, “Nabonchauvin sahle lhang, simle mal’a kathecheh-un,
tunvang sohchang chengse Babylon a kon jamdoh loiyun, Jerusalem hinjon tauvin.
Min najepnau hi kamitchang kikaldoh tobang ahi,” ati. Hiti hin amite chomgam namtin vaipi henga hiche thu hi seipeh din Pakaiyin eisol’in:
“Pakai Amatah-in nadouvuntin, khatvei soh a navulteuvin nachomgam diu ahi,” ati. Hitobang thil hi aso teng, thaneipen Pakaiyin eisol ahi-mitinin hedoh tante.
Pakaiyin, “Vo Jerusalem mite, kipa la sauvin! Nalah-uva cheng din kahunge!” ati.
Hiteng chule namtin vaipi Pakai henga hungun tin, amite hi diu ahi. Nalah-uva chenga, nahenguva eihinsol nahetdoh diu ahi.
Agamtheng sunga Judah hi agou lhantum hiya, Jerusalem hi angailut pen khopi hi didng ahi.
Achenna munthenga konin Pakai ahunge, amasanga mitin thip chet’in um’uvin.




kagaochanna khat’a Pakaiyin Thempu chungnung Joshua, Pakai Vantil masanga ding eivetsah-e. Joshua koma chun Satan adingin, ahehse din gonsan aum’e.
Pakai Vantil’in Satan jah a, “Vo Satan, Pakaiyin mo nachan hen! Jerusalem ngailua Pakaiyin themmo nachan hen! Hichepa hi meilhum sunga kiloidoh tenggol tobang ahi!” ati.
Joshuan ponsil nen sil’in hikoma chun adinge.
Vantil’in Vanmi lhachate jah a, “Hichepa ponsil nen ho hi sut lhauvin,” ati. Hichun Joshua jah a, “Naconset kalamangtai, sil ding ponthah kapeh ding nahi,” ati.
Chuin lhacha hon Joshua chu delthah akop peh diuvin aseiye. Lhacha hon asei bangin abol’un, Pakai Vantil dinpet hin ponthah jeng asil peh atauve.
Vantil chun Joshua jah a
Thaneipen pakaiyin aseitai, “Kadanthu nit’a nganse na cheng natohdoh le, Ka-Houin lhachan pangin natin, hongcha dung limbol’a napan ding, chule kamasanga um jing Vantilte taona kasan banga nataona kasan ding ahi.
Ngaiyin Joshua, nang thempu chungnung nahin, chule a Themputpi dang hon jong ngaiyun-khonung hamphatna ding dol’a um nang hon: kalhacha-Abah kiti chu kaphondoh ding ahi!
Joshua masanga maisagi jen a kisem song khat kakoiye. Song chunga hin lekhajem jih in gting, nikho khatseh sunga hiche gamsung chonsetna kasuhmang ding ahi.
Hiche nikho chu ahung lhun teng, nanghon nahenga nakom kouva, lengpilei le theichang ga thalhingset chu kipa lungmon pi dinga natem didu ahi,” ati.
Kajah a thusei Vantil chu ahungin, a-ihmu kibolna bangin eihung suthouve.
Chule kajah a, “Ipi namun?” tin eidonge. Kenjong, “Sanaa kisem thaomeikhom kamun, achunga khun thaokhon khat akikoiye. Thaomeikhom chunga khun thaomeikhom chunga khun thaomei sagi aumin, thaomei khat khat’in meijang sagi cheh aneiyui.
Thaomeikhom koma hin olive thing phung ni cheh akeh-in, ajet aveiya khat khat’in akeh-e,” kati.
Vantil chu kadongin, “Hiche ho hi ipito tekah ham, kapu?” kati.
Aman, “Nahet lou ham?” eiti. Kenjong, “Kahepoi,” tin kadonbut’e.
Hichun Vantil’in Pakaiya konin hiche hi Zerubbabel seipeh din eihil’in, “Sepaite le thahat vang hilouva, Ka-Lhagao vanga najo tei ding ahi.
Kisuhmona ding molle lhang kikhangsang bang jongle, namasanga kitol mangsoh diu, Houin nasah phat’a, Inmun song nukhah pen nakoiteng, mipin sam’untin, ‘Ahoiye, ahoiye!’ tia aseidiu ahi,” ati.
Pakaiya konin kahenga thu khat ahung lhung kit’in,
Zerubbabel’in Houin mun asep joutai, Houin jong asah jou ding ahi. Asah jou teng kamiten ahenguva nang sol’a Kei kahi hedoh tauvinte.
tohban chalmo jeh-in lung himon aum’un, Zerubbabel’in Houin sah ban ajop jing amudoh tengu kipah thanom lheh-unte,” ati. Vantil chun kajah a, “Thaomei sagi hileiset pumpi musoh hel Pakai mit sagi ahiuve,” ati.
Kenjong, “Thaomeikhom jet le veiya olive thingphung te ni khu ipito tekah ba ham?
Chule olive thaotwi lonna sana-long te ni kom a olive thing bathe ni khu ipito tekah ham?” tin kadonge.
Aman, “Nahet lou ham?” tin eidonge. Kenjong, “Pu kahepoi,” kati.
Hichun aman, “Hiche te ni hi, leiset pumpi Pakaiyin alhachaa pang dia alhendoh te ni chu ahi,” ati.
Kagah vet kit le, vanlaijol’a leng lekhajol khat kamui.
Vantil chun ipi kamu eidonge. Kenjong, “Vanlaijol’a lengle, metre ka sao, metre li le keh len, lekhajol khat kamui,” kati.
Aman kajah a aseiyin, “Hichejol’a khu leiset pumpi chunga thejal ding gaosapna kisun ahi. Lekhajol lang khat’a khu gamsunga gucha jouse nodoh ding kisun a, alang khat’a khu jou pan a kihahsl chengse tolmang ding kisei ahi.
Thaneipen Pakaiyin hiche gaosapna lhadoh ding aseiyin, gucha jouse le jou pan a kihahsel’a thusei jouse insunga lut didng ahi. A-insunguva pansan tin, asuhgam hel’a adalhah ding ahi,” ati.
Vantil chu ahung kilah kit’in, “Ven, thil chom beh khat ahungdoh kit’e!” ati.
Kenjong, “Ipi ham?” tin kadonge. Aman, “Pocha khat ahin, gamsung pumpi chonset to tekah ahi,” ati.
Pocha sin chu hahngeh a kisem ahi. Kavet le asin ahongdoh-un, pocha sunga chun numei khat atouve!
Vantil chun, “Hiche numei hi gitlouna to tekah ahi,” ati. Hichun numei nu chu pocha sunga asonlut’in asinkhumtai.
Kagah vet le vasai lhaving tobang neiya, numei ni kaheng lam ngan ahung leng lhone. Pocha chu akhaidoh lhonin, alen mangpi lhontai.
Kenjong Vantil chu kadongin, “Hoilam lhut agot lhon ham?” kati.
Aman eodonbut’in, “Houin asahna diuva Babylon gama apoh mang lhon ahitai. Houin chu asah jou tengu, pocha chu koiyuntin, chule hichu ahou diu ahi,” ati.
Gaochan nan mu kanei kit’e. Sum-eng molsang ni kah a konin kangtalai li ahung kitoldoh-e.
Kangtalai masapen chu sakolsan in akaiyin, anina chu sakolvomin akaiyin,
thumna chu sakolvomin akaiyin, li lhinna chu sakolpol’in akaiye.
Vantil jah a hin kenjong, “Pu, hiche kangtalaiho hi ipito tekah ham?” tin kadonge.
Aman, “Amaho hi kolkimvel ning lia khopihui ahiuvin, leiset pumpi Pakai ang sunga hung kondoh ahiuve,” ati.
Sakolvom ho kai kangtalai chun sahlam Babylon lang ajonin, sakolkangte kaiyin lhumlam ajonin, sakolpolte kaiyin lhanglam gamsung ajon’e.
Sakolpolte akijotdoh phat’in leiset gakholtoh loi ding a-ngah lel’ui. Hijeh chun Vantil’in, “Leiset gakhol loiyun!” tin aseiye. Hiti chun agakhol tauve.
Hichun Vantil’in eihin kouvin, “Sahlam Babylon lang jon sakolten Pakai lunghan asuthip tauve,” ati.
Pakaiyin hitin thu eiseipeh-e,
“Sohchang mi Helsai le Tobijah, chule Jedaiah thilpeh ho hi choiyin lang, Josiah, Zephaniah chapa koma gache loiyin, Amaho hi abonchauva Babylon gama sohchang hung kile kit ahiuve.
Athilpeh-u dangka le sana ho hin lallikhuh khat semin, Thempu chungnung, Joshua, Jehozadak chapa khu khuhpeh-in.
Ajah a Thaneipen Pakai thusei seipeh-in, ‘Abah kitipa chu hung phattheiya, Pakai Houin asah phat ding ahi.
Ama hin Houin saphan tin, leng khat chanlom tah change, amite chunga vaihom ding ahi. Alaltouna koma Thempu khat ding jingin tin, lung khat le chamnan na tong lhoninte,’ tin.
Lallukhuh hi Helsai le Tobijah, chule Jedaiah le Josiah het jingna dia Pakai Houina kikoi jing ding ahi,” ati.
Muntin le gamtin a chengte hunguntin, Pakai Houin sapha hung pan gdiu ahi. Houin kisah phat jou teng, nahenguva Thaneipen Pakaiyin eihinsol hi nahetdoh diu ahi. Pakai na-Pathenu thupeh chengse nanit’u le thil hijetpi hi guilhung ding ahi.
Darius lengvaipoh kal kumli na, lha ko, Kislev lha, ni li nin Pakaiyin thu khat eiseipeh-e.
Bethel kho miten Sharezer le regemmelech chu amiteu to Pakaiya vangboh thum din, Thaneipen Pakai Houin a asol’un,
chule Thempuho le Themgaote chu thu gadonga, “Kum hijat sunga kahinbol jingo, lha nga lhin she le houin kisuhmang jal’a an ngol’a lunghem kabol’u hi kajom nah lai diu ham?’ ti din asol’uve.
Pakaiyin kajah a sei thu chu hiche hi ahi.
“Gamsung mite le Thempuho seipeh-in, kum som sagi sunga, lha nga le lha sagi lhinseh le an ngol’a lunghem athoh jui khu, Kei jabolna abol’u ahipoi.
Aneh-uva adon tengu jongle oiva na dinga nea don ahibouvui,” ati.
Jerusalem khopi phatthei lai, khosung dimset’a mihem chen lai, khopi kimvel kholen dunga mihem chen dimset, lhanglam le lhumlam thinglhang bul dung geiya mihem chen dimset laiya Themgao masate koma Pakai thusei chu hiche hi ahi.
Pakaiyin Zechriah jah a aseiyin,
“Masanglaiyin kamite kaseipeh-in, ‘Thildih bol’uvin, khat le khat khoton kihepi to cheh-un.
Meithai le chagate, nalah-uva cheng gamchom mi, chule koi hile neilel tapou bolse hih-un. Khat le khat kisuhsetna ding thil gon dauvin,’ kati.
Ahivangin kamiten lungtah tah-in ajadauvin ahi. Lungkot hong louvin aum’un,
alungthimu songtah-in atahsah-ui. Masang lai Themgaote kama kaseisa thu ho angai loujeh-un kalung hangtai.
Thu kaseipet’a angai loujeh-un, atao tengu jongle kasangpoi.
Twisoh thil lhoh bangin abonchauvin gamchom a cheng din kalhoh mangtai. Gam phatah hiche gam hi ahomkeovin akijamin, koimachan chennan aneitapoi,” ati.
Thaneipen Pakaiyin Zechariah jah a hiche thu hi aseiye.
“Kamite kakhohsah beh seh, khohsah val jeh a amelmate chunga kalunghan lo nah in Jerusalem kithopi nom jinga um kahi.
Kakhopi theng, Jerusalema hung cheng kit ding kahi. Khopi kitah, Thaneipen Pakai lhang chu lhang theng kiti ding ahi.
Numei pasal tehse kembet net, tenggol phut’a lamjot ho chu kholai nin gkoi dunga hung tou kit diu ahi.
Kholai lemlen dunga kichem ding nu-ngah golhang hung dimset ki tdiu ahi.
“Hitobang thilsoh ding hi tua amoh cheng na mite lah a hingdoh ho gel din soh dia kilomlou hel ding ahin, Kei didn imacha ahimo poi.
Kamite min ahen nau gamsunga konin huhdoh ing ting,
Jerusalema cheng dia niso le nilhum a kona kahinlepui kit ding ahiuve. Kamite hiuvintin, a-Pathenu, kitah le dih tah a chunguva vaihom kahi ding ahi.
“Hanguvin! Ka-Houin sah phatna dia inmun kiset phat laiya themgaote thusei ho ma ma chu najah kit’u ahi.
Hiche masang chun mihem hihen gancha hile thalah didng akimujoupoi, melmate masanga hoidoh thei jong ana umpoi. Ken miho chu khat le khat kakisousah-e.
Tunvang hiche nam mite lah a ahingdoh chengse hi lamchonbeh-in kaboltai.
Chamle lung mongin vaikon’untin, alengpiguiyu gatheiya, leiset’in muchi chivo asemdoh ding, gotwi nengsel sing ahi. Kamite ahingdoh chengse vangbohna hijatpi hikapeh ding ahi.
Vo Juddah le Israel mite! Malaiyin gamchom mite khat le khat akigaosap’un,’Hitobang hamsetna Judah le Israel lhunkhum hin nang jong lhun khum hen!’ akitiuve. Ahivangin nahuhhing ung ting, hiche gamchom mite chu khat le khat,’Judah le Israel chunga lhung vangbohna cheng nang jong changing,’ kiti diu ahi. Hijeh chun hangtah-in pangun, kicha hih hel’un,” ati.
Thaneipen Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Napu napateuvin eiphin lung hang phat’un, sumang din kagon, khelchom louvin kasumangtai.
Tua vang Jerusalem le Judah mite vang boh kagot ahi. Hijeh chun kicha hih-un.
Hitobanga hi naum diu ahi: Khat le khat thutah-in kihouvun. Thutanna phunga thudih mong mong, cham len theina seiyun.
Khat le khat susuhsetna ding thil gon dauvin. Jouvin kihahsel dauvin. Jousei le thudihlou, pumhat kahoi,” ati.
Thaneipen Pakaiyin Zechariah jah a hiche thu hi aseiye;
“Lha li, lha nga, lha sagi, chule lha som lhin na an ngol kibolji ho hi Judah mite dia kipa thanopna kut akiheidoh ding ahi. Thudih le chamna khohsah-uvin,” ati.
Thaneipen Pakayin aseiyin, “khopi tina miten Jerusalem ahinjotna diu phat ahung lhunge.
Khopi khat’a hung kon hon khopi choma hung kon ho jah a, ‘Thaneipen Pakai xhibai boh a ahenga vang thum ding kahiuve. Hungin kilhonute,’ ati diu ahi.
Namtin a mi, nam hunei tah tah ho thaneipen Pakai chibai boh dia Jerusalema hung diu, ahenga vang athum diu ahi.
Hiteng chule gamchom mi som jen Judah mi khatseh koma hunguva, ‘Patheninnaumpiu kajauvin, Najotna mun’uva din kihon jengute,’ tia asei diu ahi,” ati.
Pakai thusei chu hiche hi ahi: Hadrach gamsung le Damasus khopi talen man din akoitai. Israelte khopi maiseh hilouvin, Syria khopi maiseh hilouvin, Syria khopi jong Paakiya ahibouve.
Hadrach to kigamgi Hamth jong Pakaiya ahin, Tyre le Sidon chule athepna chengseu jong Pakaiya ahi.
Tyre hin kulpi akisemin, dangka sana ahao behseh-in imalou bangin aumtai!
Hinla anei chasun Pakiyin alah mangpeh ding ahi. Anei agou jouse Twikhanglen a leh lut’intin, akhopi kavamhel ding ahi.
Hiche thilsoh hi Ashkelon khopin amudoh teng tija ding ahi. Gaza khopin mudoh-intin, a thoh lel lheh ding ahi. Ekron khopi jong chute ding, akinepna chengse beisoh ding ahi. Gaza lengpa thi ding, Ashkelon khopi ahomkeova um ding,
Ashdod khopi jong nam choplop hung chengkhom diu ahi. Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Hiche Philistine mi kiletsahte hi kasuhnem ding ahi.
Sa jong thisan puma aneh lou diu, nehmo ho jong aneh da diu ahi. Ahingdoh amoh cheng chu kamite lah a kisimtha a, Judah phungbah khat banga um diu ahi. Ekron jong, Jebua mite banga kamite to kisimtha diu ahitai.
Kagamsung ki-ngang ting, sepaite kajotpa sah lou ding ahi. Vaipo giloute kamite bol gentheisah ponge. Itobanga kamiten ganthei hesoh athoh kamudoh tai,” ati.
VO Zion chate, hachangpan kipah-un! Kipah-in khosam’un, Jerusalem mite! Ven, nalengpau ahunge! Galjo minthangin ahungin; Nun nemtah-in sa-ngan chunga touvin, Sa-ngan nou lagol chunga touvin ahung!
Pakaiyin aseiyin: “Israelte galsatna kangtalai jouse sumang ing ting, Jerusalema sakolte kakai mang ding; Galmuna manchah thlpi kaheboh doh ding ahi. Nalengpauvin namtin vaipia chamna semintin, Twikhanglen lang khat’a pat langkhat geiya vai ahoma, Euphrates luipia pat leiset mong geiya vai ahom didng ahi,” ati.
Pakaiyin aseiyin: “Kilhaina thisan a mohor namkhumsa Eikitepnau jal’a, Namiteu chamlhatsah ing ting, Twi beina sohchanna muna ongthonl diu ahi.
Vo Sohchang kinem jing ho, hung kile kit’un; Nalungmonna mun hinjon’uvin! Nathohgim nau jat nia vangboh dia Tua hi kateppeh nahitauve!
Judah hi sepai Thalpin mang ing ting, Isdrael hi Thalchanga Kaman ding ahi. Zion mite chamjam banga kaman’a, Greek mite satna kanei ding ahi,” ati.
Pakai amite chungvuma kitahdoh-intin, Athalchang kolphe banga alensah ding; Hatchungnung Pakaiyin sumkon mut’in tin, Lhanglama pat go le huipia hung kitol ding ahi.
Thaneipen Pakaiyin amite ngah-intin, Amahon amelmateu asuhgam diu ahi. Galmuna jukhan pen-ohjen jun banguntin, Amelmateu thisan alonsah diu; Kilhaina gan thisan long banga, Maicham phunga khona kisunglha bang ding ahi.
Hiche nikho hi haung lhun teng. Pakaiyin amite ahuhhing ding; Kelngoi chingpan akelngoite Thidingsa ahuhdoh bang ding ahi. Lallukhuh a sum-eng pah banga Agamsunga vah jing diu ahitai.
Gamsung phat ding le hoi ding je chu! Cahngle lengpitwi vanga khangdong thahat diu ahi.
Chavang laiya go juhna din Pakaiyin taovun! Mei kaisah, dai lhahsah chule go juhsah Pakai ahin, mitin dia louma phatsah Amabou ahi.
Mihon doi asan’un, phunsan ho pou adongun, jouthu le ngol thubuh bou akimu’ve. Abang bangin mang aleuvin, lam hilou lama napuitauve; nalhamon nau jong pannabei ahi. Hijeh chun mipi hi kelngoi mangsa bangin suhna ding helouvin avah le leuve. Lamkai beiyin hesoh genthei athoh tauve.
Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Kamite chunga vaipo gamchom miho chunga kalung hange, amaho khu talen kamatsah ding ahi. Jusahte kami ahin, Kei-thaneipen Pakaiyin kivet tep nange. Galsatna sakol hattah banga kanei ding ahiuve.
Kamite chunga vaipo ding alah-uva vaihom le lamkai, sepai lamkai sing hung pengsoh ding ahi.
Kholai dunga amelmateu bon-ngan lah a chil thang thang sepaite banga Judah miten gal ajo diu ahi. Pakaiyin apanpi jeh-uva gal asat diu, melma sakol touthem ho geiya ajo diu ahi.
“Judahte hatsah ing ting, Israelte kahuhdoh ding ahi. Abonchauvin voujang natping ting, In a kahinlepui doh kei ding ahiuve. Kapaidoh khah louhel bang diu, Pakai a-Pathenu kahi, atao nau sang inge.
Israel sepai hattah bang diu, Lengpitwi donchima kipah ho bang diu ahi. Hiche agaljo’u hi ason apah-un geljingun tin, Pakai thilbol hi akipapi diu ahi.
“Kamite kakoukhom ding, Huhdoh ing ting angaiya katamsah didng ahi.
Namtin vaipi lah a thecheh jong leng, Gamla tah a kona eigeldoh diu ahi. Amaho le achateu ahingdoh cheng, In a hung kile kit diu ahi.
Egypt le Assyria kona In a kahinpui ding, Agamsunguva kachensah ding ahi. Gilead gam le Lebanon a chensah ing ting, Gamsung pumpi midim ding ahi.
Gim hesohna Twikhanglen kinong bangin jot’u jongle, Kei-Pakaiyin twi kinonglai kaphothip ding ahi. Nile lithuh geiya kansah a, Assyria hoitho tah nemlhan tin, Egypt hunei tah jong thabeiya um ding ahi.
Kamite hatsah ing ting, Chibai boh a kathua nung diu ahi,” ati. Pakaiyin asei ahitai.
Vo Lebanon, cedar thing jouse halvamna din Nakotpi chengse hongdoh loiyin!
Kap’in maovin, thinggi jouse le Cedar thing ho alhusoh tai; Thing minthangtah tah ho asugamtauve. Bashan phaiya gangpi thing hokap’in maovun! Gammang thimlai atuchaitauve.
Vaipote lunghemin akap’ui, aloupi nau amangtai; Sekeie kisen ginpi khu ngaiyun; Achen nau gammang lai Jordan pang atuchaitauve!
Pakai ka-Pathenin kajah a, “Thangam dia kikoi kelngoi hon chingpa bangin umin.
Aneihon kelngoite thatgam’untin, talen man louva umdiu ahi. Asa kijoh-untin, ‘Vahchoiyun Pakai, ihaodoh tauve!’ tiuvinte. Kelngoi chingho jengin jong adipdappi pouve,” ati.
Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Leiset mi khat cha jong khoto taponge. Mihemho hi achunguva vaipote noiya kalutsah ding ahi. Hiche vaipoe hin leiset sugamhel’untin, akhut’uva konin chu-lha ponge,” ati.
Kelngoi choa joh hon eithalah-un, thadia kikoi kelngoite kachinge. Tenggol ni kalan, khat chu, “Deichom,” katin, khat chu, “Kipumkhatna,” kati Chuin kelngoi hon kachinge.
Kelngoi chingma ma midang thum, eiho jing chunga kalung hangjah-in, lha khat sungin athum’un kasumangtai.
Hichun kelngoihon jah a, “Ken naching tapouvinge. Athi thi ding kithi hen. Suhgam ding ding kisugam hen. Amoh ahing cheng jong khat le khat kisumangu hen,” kati.
Chuin “Deichom,” kisah tenggol chu kalan, Pakaiyin namtin vaipi to akitepna suhkehna din kahehbongtai,
Hiti hin hiche nikho hin kitepna chu akisuhkeh tai. Kelngoi choa le joh hon eive lhi jingun, kathilbol chu Pakaiyin thuseina anei ahe jingui.
Ken ajah-uva, “Nanop’u le katohman neipeuvin, nadaule kikoitauvin,” kati. Hijeh chun katohman din dangka somthum eipeuve.
Pakaiyin kajah a aseiyin, “Sum chu Houin goukholnaa koiyin,” eiti. Hijeh chun sum dangka somthum hi-manlu tah a agel’u chu-Houin goukholnaa kakoitai.
Chuin tenggol nina, “Kipumkhatna,” kiti chu kahehbongin, Judah le Israel kipumkhatna akehtai.
Pakaiyin kajah a aseiyin, “Kelngoi chingin pang kit’in, tua napan vang hi pannabeiya napan ding ahi.
Mi khat kakelngoite ching din kakoiyin, ahivangin aman mangthah goa kelngoite akithopi poi; amangla ahol pon, mapu jong aboldam poi; ahing cheng jeng jong avahva pon ahi. Athao lai lai akithan, atin kikah abottel kelngoi chingpa chu adana-e! Kelngoi hon adalhatai! Athaneina gal’in asuhbei hel ding, aban tha ngoiya, amitchang jetlem cho ding ahi,” ati.

Mihem hinsah a, Leiset semdoh, vanthamjol jaldoh Pakai, hiche Pakaiyin Israel thudol asei chu hiche hi ahi.
“Jerusalem hi judonna khon tobanga kasemdoh ding ahi; akimvel’a namtin vaipin don’un tin, jukham banga lonle le siu ahi. Jerusalem khopi aumchah tengu, Judah gamsung khopi dang jouse jong min aumchah ding ahi.
Hiche phat hi ahung lhun teng, Jerusalem hi songtum gihtah kabahsah a, dopkhang dia doa nammite chu kisanchat diu, vannoi namtin vaipi kithouva adel khum didu ahi.
Hiteng chule asakolteu hoh kin ing ting, achunga toute ka-ngolsah soh didng ahi. Judahte vetup ing ting, amelmateu sakolte mit kachotsah ding ahi.
Chutah le Judah phunga miten, ‘Jerusalema cheng Thaneipen Pakai Pathenin amite thahat apei,’ ati diu ahi.
“HIteng chule Judah phunga mite hi gamkang le changkung go lah a kihal meikou kabahsah a, akinel’a namtin vaipi asuhgam ding ahi. Jerusalem kho mite vang khosunga lung monga cheng diu ahi.
“Kei-Pakaiyin amasaa Judah sepaite gal kajosah a, David son le pah, chule Jerusalem sn lom jabolna chu, Judah gamsung san ding sanga thupijo deh lou ding ahi.
Chutengle Jerusalema chengte Pakaiyin ngah-intin, alah-uva lhasampen jong David hat’a hat ding ahi. David chilhahten miho chu Pakai vantil, Pathen tah tah banga alamkai diu ahi.
Chuteng Jerusalem delkhum dia kigo namtin vaipi koi hile kasuhmang ding ahi.
“David chilhahte le Jerusalema cheng midang ho jong hepina le taona Lhagao kasipsoh ding ahi. Mihem asutlihoh chu veuvintin, cha khatseh thijal’a laina tah a kap ho banga alainatpi diu ahi. Chapa peng masapen thi jal’a kap ho bangin lhase tah-in kap’unte.
Hiteng chule Jerusalem lunghem ka le mao chu, Migiddo phaiya Hadadrimmon dia lunghema kap ho kagin husa bang ding ahi.
Gamsung miten a-inko koa pul adou didu, David insungin a-insung pul adouva, ajiu numeihon pul adou diu; Nathan insungin Nathan insungpul adouva, numeihon jong adou diu;
Levi insungin jong Levi insung pul adouva, ajiu numeihon jong adou diu; Shimei insungin jong Shimei insung pul adouva, ajiu numeihon jong adou diu:
insung dang dangin jong hitobanga hi ainsung cheh-u pul adouvuva, anumeiteuvin jong pul adou cheh diu ahi.
“Hiche phat hi ahung lhun teng, David chilhahte le Jerusalem mite chonset le doi houva kona sop theng dia twsam hung put ding ahi.
Chuteng gamsunga milimdoi min him him kaphahpoh sah lou ding ahitai. Ki-Themgaosah ho kasuhmanga, milimdoi hou nomna kasuhamng ding ahi.
Gaothu seitei tei aumle, Pakai thu seiya kigel’a, ou jeng seipan atilo tei ding chu anule apan aseipeh ding ahi. Gaothu aseipet tah a anule apan asutlih jeng ding ahi.
Hiteng chule mu nei Themgaovin ahoithopi lou ding, themgao umchan thoa, mipi lhep lhahna dia Themgao von jong avon lou ding ahi.
Hisanga chu, ‘Themgao kahipoi, loubol mi, kahinkhoa lou natong kahibouvin, ‘Na-op le natungtuna mapon ho chu ipijeh ham?’ tia adoh khah le; ‘Kagol kapaite in a eivohnau ahibouve,’ ti hen,” ati.

Thaneipen Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Vo chemjam, thouvin kakelngoi chingpa delkhumin. Thet’in, kelngoite kithe cheh nante. Kamite delkhum ing ting,
gamsung mi hop thuma hop ni thigam diu ahi.
Chuteng hop khat hingdoh chengchu, meiya dangka kilhatheng bangin, sutheng inge. Sana kipatep bangin patep ing ting, chuteng kahenga hung tao diu, ataonau kasan ding ahi. Kamite ahiu seipeh ing ting, a-Pathenu kahi phongdoh tauvinte,” ati.
Thupi tannaa Pakai touna ding nikho anaitai. Chuteng Jerusalem khopi min chomgamintin, namit mu tah a thil chomdoh kihom diu ahi.
Jerusale sat din Pakaiyin namtin vaipi koukhomintin, khopi alah diu in jouse achom’uva, numeiho abol thang diu ahi. Mipi keh khat hel sohchanga kitol diu, adangse vang khopi sunga konin kaidoh pouvinte.
Chuteng Pakai kipat’a hiche namtin vaipi ho chu asat ding, gollui laiya asat banga asat ding ahi.
Chuteng olive molsang, Jerusalem niso lama hung pansantin, olive molsang chu pohkeh a, akah a phaicham lentah umdoh ding ahi. Molsang keh khat sahlama kitolsuh ding ahi.
Molsang kehni soa phaichama hi najamdoh diu; Judah lengpa Uzziah khanga ling kihopet’a napu napateu jamdoh banga najam diu ahi. Pakai ka-Pathen chu Vantilto lhonna hung ding ahi.
Hiche phat hile dap lou didng, geltwi kai lou ding,
mujong thimponte. Janteng jongle khovah jing ding ahi. Itih phat le hitia um ding hi Pakaiyin bou ahei.
Hiche teng hile Jerusalema kona twitheng hung longa, akeh khat Twikhanglen twimang dunga lon glut’a keh khatma Mediterranea Twikhanglena long lut ding ahi. Kum lhung hel, chuh le khal’a jong long jing jeng ding ahi. Egypt miten lhambuh kut abol dau le, Jerusalem ache nomlou namtin vaipi chunga lang natseh chu Pakaiyin achunguva alhunsah ding ahi.
Chuteng leiset pumpia Pakai leng chang ding;mitinin Ama Pathen ahina bangin chibai boh-umtin, min khat’a ahet diu ahi.
Sahlam Geba pat lhanglam Rimmon gei, gamsung pumpi kilai Jerusalem kikhang sangpen ding; khopi chu Benjamin kelkot’a pat, masanga kelkot kisem nasa, inning kelkot phungpeh gei ding, Hananel intingvuma pat lengte lengpitwi chilna phung gei ding ahi.
Hikoma hi manthah ding ging louhel’a, mipi ho lung mongtah a cheng diu ahi.
Jerusalem khopi sat namtin vaipi chunga Pakaiyin natset alansah a, ahing laiya atahsau natset’a monlha ding ahi. Amit’u le aleiguiyu vang monponte.
Hiteng chule Pakaiyin abonchauvin kisuh dongsah-intin, kichatmana min akinaipi pen pen abokhum jeng diu ahi.
Jerusalem huhna Judahten gal abol diu ahi. Namtin vaipi neile gou-sana, dangka, chule nihchen ponsil-thalhingset’a akichomdoh diu ahi.
Sakolte le sakolte, sa-ngongsaote le sa-ngante, melmate ngahmun a gancha jouse chunga tijat umtah natsat lang ding ahi.
Jerusalem delkhum namtin vaipi lah a hingdoh amoh chengsen, kumseh le Thaneipen pakai, Leng chu Jerusalema chibai ahung boh diu, lhambuh kut ahung manji diu ahi.
Koi to bang nam min Thaneipen Pakai, Leng chu chibai ga boh ding adaule, agamsunguva gotwi lha lou ding ahi.

Lhambuh kut abol daule Egypt mite le namtin vaipi chunga bol hesohna dia hiche natset chu chucheh ding ahi.
Hiche nikho chule sakolte khaova jong, “Pakaiya kikatdohsa,” tia kijih cheh ding ahi. Houin sunga anhonna bel ho jeng jong, maicham a khon ho banga theng ding ahi.
Jerusalem le Judah gamsunga anhonna bel ho geiya Thaneipen pakai chibai boh teng man dia kikhen ding ahi. Mipin kilhaina sa honna aneidiu ahi. Hiche teng hileh Thenneipen Pakai Houin a kiveimi umlou ding ahitai.
Pakaiyin Israel mipi seipeh dia Malachi jah a asei thu chu hiche hi ahi.
Pakaiyin amite jah a, “nangho ka-ngalu jingui,” ati. Amahon, “Iti nei-ngailut’u ham?’ atiuve. Pakaiyin adonbut’in, “Esau le Jacob sopi ahi lhonin, ahivangin Jacob le achilhahte ka-ngailun,
Esau le achilhahte vang kahoi. Esau chenna thinglhang gamsung kasuchaiyin, gamsate chenna din kapetai,” ati.
Esau chilhah, Edom miten, “Ka-khopi jouse kisuse jongle kisah phat kit tauvinge,” tijongleu; Pakaiyin donbut’intin, “Sapha kit’u hen, kaphet lhah peh diu ahi. Mihon, ‘Migiloute gam,’ atiuve, ‘Tonsot’a Pakai lunghan nam mite,’ ati diu ahi,” tin te.
Israelten hiche hi amit tah a amu diu, chuteng amahon, “Israel gam kalpeh a jong Pakaiyin eilunghan’u ahi!” tiuvinte.
tahneipen Pakaiyin thempute jah a aseiyin, “Chapan apa ajabol teiyin, soh-in apu ajatei me. Na Pau Kei idia neijabol dau ham? Nahsah mon neibol’un, ‘Iti nahsah moa kabol’um? Pou neitiuve.
kamaicham phunga manmo thil jeng nato jeh-uva nei nahsahmou ahi. Nangho pin, ‘Iti nang jabol louva kakoi diu ham?’ natiuve! Kamaicham thang le dol’a nabol jeh-uva neija louvu ahi.
Kakoma kilhaina dia gancha mitcho ham, dammo ham, elbai ham khat nahin kaiyu hi thildih bol’a kigel nahiuvam? Hitobang gancha hingmo hi gam vaipo katnan ganeitem’un! Nakipia nathum thum napeh ding hinam?” ati.
Tun themgaopuho, ichunguva Pathen lung lhaina din taovun. Nataonau asan lout eng, nang ho themmo ahibouve.
Thaneipen Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Pannabeiya akamaicham phunga mei natikou kou sangun, khattouvin Houin kotpi jouse gakamchah le katitave! Nachunguva kalung lhaipoi; neithilpeh-u sang ponge.
Vannoi kolkimvel lhungsoh min eijabol cheh nauve. Muntin a gimnamtui alhuntan’un, santhei dol tah kilhaina thil atoh nauve. Abonchan eijabol cheh-uve!
Nanghon vang kamaicham isah louva nabol’uva, deimosa neh le chah todohna nanei jeh-un nahsahmon neikoitauve.
Nanghon, ‘Thilto to jong kachimtai!’ natiuvin, nanah neikhon khum’uve. Kahenga to dia nahin kaiyu jong gancha naguh thou ham, adammo ham, a-elbai ham ahi. Hitiho hi kasan peh dia nagel’um?
kei peh dia tepsa kelngoi hon lah a kelngoi hoitah tah sel’a, kelngoi hingmoa kilhina boljia eilhem ho chu gaosap chang hen! Ajeh chu Leng loupe tah kahin, namtin vaipin eiging cheh-uve!” ati.
Thaneipen Pakaiyin thempuho jah a aseiyin, “Hiche thupeh hi nangho ding ahi.
Natoh nabol chan’uva neijadiu ahi. Kasei na-ngai louvu le kagaosap ding nahiuve. Nachan diu thil ho geiya kagaosap ding ahi. Kathupeh nagel khoh loujeh-uva kagaosapsa jong nahitauve.
Natu nachateu telen matsah ing ting, namaiyuva kilhaina gan nathau eh kaloikhum diu-gancha eh puma kakaidoh ding nahiuve.
Chutah l ethempuho le Levite to kakitepna suhkeh louna dia hiche thupeh hi kapeh nahetdoh diu ahi.
“Kakitepnaa hin hinnop le damtheina kateppeh-in, eijabolna diuva hiche chu kapeh ahi. Hiche lai chun eigingun eijabol nauve.
Mi thudih ahil’un, adih lou ahil pouve. Keito kitoh del’in aum’un; amaho she-in thildih abol pouvin, midang ho geiyin thilse abolsah dauve.
Min Pathen adih a ahet ding hi thempuhon ahil diu ahi. Kalungdei chu mipin Thempuho koma agahetdoh diu ahi, ajeh chu amaho hi Thaneipen Pakai sole ahiuve.
“Tunla Thempuhon lamdih napel tauve. Namihil’un mi tamtah apuisei. Nanghon kakitepna nasukeh tauve.
kalungdei nadondauve, kamite nahil tengu langkaina nanei jeh-un, Kenjong ISraelte nahsahmoa ka-umsah ding anhiuve,” ati.
Pa khat lhah ihi louvu ham? Pathen semcheh ihi louvu ham? I-bol’a kha le khat kitepna isuh keh-uva, ipu ipateu le Pthen kitepna nahsahmoa ibol’u ham?
Judahten Pathento kitepna asukeh-un, Jerusalem le Judah gam pumpia tijat umtah abol tauve. Pakaiyin a-it pen Houin asuhboh tauve. Pasal hon douhou numeiho akichenpiuve.
Hitobang thil bol jouse Pakaiyin Israel lah a konin kaidoh hen, Thaneipen Pakai dia thilto inam miteu lah a pang hih hel’u hen.
Hitobang jong hi nabol’ui. Nathilto chengseu asan lou phat’in kap le maovin na-um’un, Pakai maicham phung chu lhi le nap nadiptauve.
I-atile nathiltou asanlou nadatmo’uve. Nasenji nakikhenpi jal’uva asan lou ahi. Najinu hcu natibah ahin, Pathen angsunga achunga kitah jing dia kitep ngalta, nakitepna nasukeh tai.
Pathenin hiche numei chuto tahsa le lhagao khat’a nagopsa hilou ham? Ipi ngaitoa abol hitam? Pathen midih tah hidia cha le nao naneipi ding ahi. Hijeh chun koiman ajinu kikhenpida hen.
Pakai Israel Pathenin, “Nupa kikhen hi kamah ahi. Pasal’in abol thang jong kaseipoi. Hijeh chun najinu chunga kitah jing dia nakitepnau sukeh hih hel’un,” tin aseiye.
Nakam tam behseh-un Pakaiyin ajadai. Nangho pin, “Iti eithei chim diu ham? Thaneipen Pakaiyin thilse bolte mipha agel’a, amaho chubou adeijoh ahi,” natiuve. Chuma le, “Thildih bol dia kigel Pathen chu hoiba hitam?” tin nahol’ui.
thaneipen Pakaiyin, “Kalampi semtoh din kasolle sol nange. Chutah le nahol jingo Pakai chu hetman louva a-Houin hun glut jeng ding ahi. Na-nga jingo sole chu hunga kakitepna aphonjal ding ahi,” ati.
Ahinla hiche nikho hunglhun tang thoh jou didng koi ham? Ama hung kilah ten ghingdoh ding koi ham? Ama chu ponsop theng dabon hattah le thih gojolna mei-am hatah tobang ahi.
Dangka goujol’a suthengpa banga thutam dia hung ding ahi. Thih-khengpan dang ka le dana agojol banga, Pakaiyin thildih apha ato theina diuva, Pakai sole pan Thempuho asuh theng ding ahi.
Chuteng masang laiya banga, Judah gam le Jerusalem miten Pakai dia thilto ahinchoiyu chu lung lhaina anei ding ahi.
Thaneipen Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Thutan din nalah-uva hung kiphong ing ting, mitpheldoi themho le numei jonpi ho, jouva hettohsah ho, mi tohman lepthol ho, meithaiho le chagate, gamchom mi maljin ho-kinopsahna nei ho, Kei jalou chengse kahehset ding ahi.
“kei hi Pakai, kikhel lou kahi. Hijeh chun nnangho Jacob chilhahte namangthah hel hih laiyui.
Malai napu napateu bangin nan ghon jong Kadanthu jouse napeldoh-un nanit tapouve. Hung kile kit’un, nahengu hinjon inge. Nanghon, ‘Naheng kahinjot theina diuva ipi kabol diu ham?’ tin naseiyui.
Kadoh nahiuve, min Pathen alepthol theiyam? Alhem ngaipoi, nang hon vang neilhem’ui. Nanghon, ‘Iti kalhep’um?’ natiuve. Hopsoma hop khat le htilto peh dol’in neilhem’ui.
Nam pumpin neilepthol jeh-un nabonchau chunga gaosapna achutai.
houin a neh le chah lhingset’a koi din hopsom ahop khat lhingkeiyin hinchouyun. Neive patep’un, van a bangkot chengse hongdoh ing ting thilpha jouse nang jeng junga kasun lhah peh ding anhiuve.
Nachangdong laiyu ganhingte duhmang sah pong ting, nalengpiguiyu gaboh keikoi ding ahi.
Chuteng nagamsungu chen mun pha soh a, namtin vaipin min nun nom nahisah diu ahi.
“Kachung change tijat jat um thu naseiyui,” tin Pakaiyin aseiye. “Ahivangin nanghon, ‘Nathudol ipi kaseibeh-um?’ natiuve.
Nanghon, ‘pathen kinbol jong pannabei ahi. Asei sei bol jong i-phachom a, i-bolse chunga thaneipen Pakai koma kisih thusei jong ipi phachom ham?
Mi hoithote anompen a pang imuukhu me. Migiloute la hao thei keo hilouvin, Pathen phinna monga thilse abol’u jongle ahoidoh thouvui,’ tin naseiyui,” ati.
Pakai gingte akihou lim’un, aseiyu Pakaiyin ajatai. Pakai angsunga, Pakai ginga jabolte thudol lakhabu khat’a ajih luttauve.
Thaneipen pakaiyin aseiyin, “Amaho hi kamite hi diu, kachaloh ni nil eh, kalhentum chom beh hi di ahi. Akinbol jing chapa chunga mipa hepina dingahiuve.
Chuteng kamiten avel’a, midih le migilou kibah louje, kakinbol pa le bol loupe kah a thilsoh amudoh ki tdiu ahi,” ati,






Abraham chilhah David guiya peng Jesu Christa khanggui thusim hitia kisun ahi.
Abrahamin Isaac ahingin, Isaac chun Jacob ahinge; Jacob hin Judah le asopi pasal dang ho ahinge.
Judah hin Tamara konin Perez le Zerah ahingin, Perez hin Hezron ahinge; Hezron chun Ram ahingin,
Ramin Aminadab ahinge; Aminadab chun Nahshon ahingin, Nahshonin Salmon ahinge;
Salmonnin Rahab’a konin Boaz ahingin, Boaz hin Ruth a kon in Obed ahinge; Obed hin Jesse ahingin,
Jessen David lengpa ahinge. David hin Uriah jinua kon in Solomon ahingin,
Solomonin Rehoboam ahinge; Rehoboamin Abijah ahingin, Abijah chun Asa ahinge;
Asan Jehoshaphat ahingin, Jehoshaphat’in Joram ahinge; Joramin Uzziah ahingin,
Uzziah chun Jotham ahinge; Jothamin Ahaz ahingin, Ahaz chun Hezekiah ahinge;
Hezekiah hin Manasseh ahingin, Manasseh chun Amon ahinge; Amonin Josiah ahingin, Babylon lama gal-hinga akai laiyun Josiah chun Jechoniah le asopi pasal dang ho ahinge.

Babylon lama gal-hinga akai nungun Jechoniah chun Shealtiel ahingin, Shealtiel chun Zerubbabel ahinge;
Zerubbabel hin Abiud ahingin, Abiud chun Eliakim ahinge; Eliakimin Azor ahingin,
Azor chun Zadok ahinge; Zadok hin Achim ahingin, Achimin Eliud ahinge;
Eliud chun Eleazar ahingin, Eleazarin Matthan ahinge; Matthanin Jacob ahingin,
Jacob chun Joseph ahinge; hiche Joseph hi Messiah kiti Jesu hingnu Mary jipa ahi.
Hiti hin Abraham a pat Davin gei khang som le khang li ahin, David a pat Babylon lama gal-hinga akai mang geiyu chu khang som le khang li ma ahi kite’e; chule Babylon lama gal-hinga akai manguva pat Messiah pen gei chu khang som le li ahi.
Jesu Christapen um chan chu hiti ahi. Anu Mary cu Joseph to kicheng dinga kitepsa ahinm ahinla akigop masang lhonin Lhagao Thenga kona agai chu Mary hin akihet doh tai.
Ahin ajipa joseph hi midih tah ahijeh-in Mary hi lhangphonga mipi seithanga umsah ding a nompon, guh thim cha akitepna lhon suh keh a kikheni din agoi.
Joseph-in hitobang lung agel laitah hin Pakaiya kon Vantil khat’in mangin akimusah-in, “David chilhah Joseph, Mary khu kipuiya jia nei ding tija hih hel’in; ijeh-inem itile Lhagao Thenga kona gai ahibouve.
Chapa khat ahinding, amin Jesu nasah ding ahi; ajeh chu amatah hin amite achonset’uva klna ahuhhing ding ahi,” tin aseipeh-e.
thil chicheng hi Pakaiyin Themgao kama aseisa gui lhun theina dinga soh ahin, asei chun,
“Ven, nu-ngah chu gaiyin tin chapa khat ahin ding, amin ‘Emmanuel’ kiti ding ahi, Amin hi, ‘Pathenin eiumpiuve,’tina ahi” ati.
Joseph a-imut khah phat’in Pakaiya kon Vantil’in ahil bang bangin abol’in, Mary chu ji dingin akipuitai;
ahin Maryn chapa ahinahin masangsen nupaa kitimatpina vang aneipi khah hih hel;e, Naosen ahung pen phat’in amun chu Jesu asah tai.
Judah gama Herod lengpa lal laiyin Bethlehem khopia Jesu ahung pengin, niso lama ahsi umdol hethem mihoJerusalem khopia ahungun,
“Judate chunga leng chang dia hung peng naosen chu hoiya um tam? Ama pen jeh a niso lama ahsi hung kilah kamu-va naosen chu chibai boh dinga hung kahiuve,” tin aseiyui.
Athudoh-u ajah phat’un Herod lengpa ti Jerusalem mite ti along jing lheh tauve.
Hejeh chun Herod’in Thempu pipu ho leh mipi lah a Danthu lekha them ho akoukhom loiyin, “Messiah chu hoiya hung peng ding ham?” tin adonge.
Amahon, “Judea gamsung Bethlehem khopia peng ding ahi; ajeh chu Themgaopan hitin asun’e”
‘Vo Judea gama Bethlehem! Judah vaipote lah a itina ma jongleh aneopen nahipoi; Nanga kona kamite Israel lamkai ding khat Hung peng doh dong ahi,’ ati.” Atiuve.
Chuphat’in Herod chun ahsi umdol hethem miho chu atimin akimupinm itih phat tah a ahsi hung kilah chu aphochentai.
Chujouvin amaho chu Bethlehem lama asol’in, “Cheuvin lang naosen che phat chan gahol doh-un, keijong ka chea chibai kagabohna dinginm namudoh tenguleh neihung seipeh tauvin,” tin athu lhah-e.
Lengpa thsei ajah pha’un akipatdoh paiyun, ahin mupeh sau niso lama ahsi chu amasanguva achepeh-in, naosen umna chung aphah phat’in aki-ngai.
Ahsi amudoh kit phat’un akipah behseh jenguve!
Chuin insunga agalut’u leh naosen chu anu Mary toh agamu thauvinm boh khip cheh-in chiabi aboh tauve. Chujongle agoubomu hongin thil manlu cheh-sana, bego chule myrrh atoh-un, thilpeh hicheng hi apetauve.
Herod henglam ahopa kit louhelna diuva Pathenin amanguva ahilchah phat’ in lamchom khat ajuiyun agam olanguva akile kit tauve.
Ahsi umdol hethem miho che nungin, Pakaiya kon Vantil khat Joseph manga akilah-in, “Thouvin, naosen le anu puiyin lang Egypt langa jampinm kahinkou masangsen ta-umpi tan; ajeh chu herod’in naosen hi suhmang din angaiton ahol’e,” ati.
Joseph jong athouvin naosen le anu apuiyin janlaiyin Egypt langa ajampin,
Herod thi kahsen aga-umpitai. Hitobang thil hi Pakaiyin themgao kama aseisa, “Egypt’a konin kachapa kakoudoh tai,” ati chu guilhunna dinga soh ahi.
Ahsi umdol hethem mihon alhim lhah ahetdoh phat’inHerod along hang behseh jeenginm mi asol’in ahsi umdol hethem mihoa kona naosen pen ahetdoh phat chutoh kitoh chet’in asimin, Bethlehem khopi le khovel dunga naosen pasal kum nia lhah noi lames se athagam sah tai.
Hechea hin Jeremiah Themgao kama kiseia-
“Ramah koa lhaset lunghem Ka le mao ogin nasatah akijan, Rachel in achate aka ka jengin, Athigam tah jeh-un lhepbi jou ahita poi,” kiti chu agui lhung tai.

“Thouvin, naosen le anu puiyin lang Israel gam jontan, naosen tha dinga hol ho athigam tauve,” ati.
Joseph athoupaiyin, naosen le anu apuiyin Israel gamsung jonin ahung kile kit tai.
Ahin Judea gama apa Herod khel’a Archelaus leng chan ajah doh phat’in Judea gama chenden ding Joseph akichanm amang ma akihil chah jeh chun Galilee gamsung joh ajonin,
Nazareth khopia achengtai. Hiche hi Themgaohon, “Nazareth mi kiti ding ahi,” atiu gui lhunna dia chute ahi.
Hiche lai hin John Baptist thu ahil lhang len,
“Nachonset lung khel’unm ajeh chu van a lenggam chun hikom ahinpha tai!” tin asam’e.
John hi Isaiah Themgaovin anaseisa; “Gamthip laiya khosam ogin khat’in, “Pakai lampi semtoh-un lang, Alamlen semjangsan koiyinm tin aseiye,” ati chu ahitai.
John pon-ah chu sa-ngongsao mul ahin, akonggah savunm a-anneh khaokhote le gam khoiju ahi.
Jerusalem khomite leh Judea gam pumpia mi, chule Jordan gamkol sung pimpia konin miho John henga acheuvin,
achonset nau aphong cheh-un, Jordan vadunga john khut’in baptize achangtauve.
Pharisee ho leh Saducee ho tamtah ama khut’a baptize chang dia hung amu phat;in Johnin ajahuva, “Vo gulse son ho, kho nunga hung lhung ding Pathen lungsatnaa kona jamdoh dia thu namop’u koi peh ham?
Nalung khel’u natohgan phongdoh-un;
‘Abraham son kihina chu,’ tin nalah-uva kiholim nan neidauvin; kaseipeh nahiuve, Pathenin hiche song ho geiya Abraham chilhah a asemthei ahi.
Thingphung bul tin’a heicha aki phutsoh tai, aga pholou chengse kiphuh lhua meilhum sunga kileh lut ding ahi.
Nalung khel’u phot chetna twiya baptize kachansah nahiuvinm kei bana hungpa vang khu keisanga gamchenga chungnung jo ahinm kei hi akengchot te I sut dinga kilom jong kahipoi; ama chun Lhagao Teng le meikonga baptize nachasah diu ahi.
Akhut a chang japna achoiyin, phola chang jap ngimsel;in tin, chuteng achangtah ho changsal’a akhum tip ding, asi chengse vang mit thie lou meilhim sunga agovam ding ahitae,” ati.
Hichepet hin Glilee gama konin Jesun Jordan lui ahin jonin, John khut’a bapize chang din ahung tai.
Ahivangin John anathu phan, ‘Keijoh nang khut’a baptize kachan dingsih a kei henga nahung tan’e!” anati.
Jesun adonbut paiyin, “tun hit hin molso pou pouvinm ajeh chu hitobanga hi Pathen dei chan ibol bulhingsoh ding ahi,” ati, Hichen John jong anomtai.
baptize achan jouva Jesu twiya kona apotdoh chunm ama din van akihongin Pathen Lhagao vakhu bang a hung kumlha achunga chu amui.

Hiche jou hin Diabol lhep patep dingin Jesu chu Lhagaovin gamthip’ah apui toutai.
Nisom li le jan som li geiya an ngol’a aum jouvin Jesu agilkeltai.
Hichun alhempatep chu ahungin ajah a, “Pathen chapa nahileh hiche song ho hi changlhah so na dingin seipeh-in,” ati.
Jesun adonbut’in “Pathen lekhabua kisun chun Mihem hi changlhah keova hing theilou ding, Pathen kamsoh thuhoa bou hing dinga kisei ahi,” ati.
Hichun Diabol’in Jesu khopi thenga apui yin, Houin tingvum asang laiya adinsahin,
“Pathen chapa nahileh keleh lha jengin, ‘songa nakisuh khah louna dingin Pathenin a-Vantilte thu pentin akhut’uvin nadom nauvinte,’ tin Pathen lekhabua akisun nai,” ati.
Jesun aseipeh paiyin, “Hitin jong, ‘Pakai na-Pathen patep a na -lhep chatvai louhel ding ahi,’ tin akisun’e,” ati.

ajah a, “Kahenga naboh khup’a chibai neiboh le hichengpi hi peng kate.” ati.
chutah chun Jesun ajah a, “Chedohin Satan! ‘Pakai na-Pathen chu chibai naboh a, ama jeng bou nahou ding ahi,’ tin Pathen lekhabua akisun bouve!” atitai.
Chuphat’in Diabol chun adalhatai. Hichun Vantilte ahungun Jesun angaichatna jouse ahung jenle tauve.
John songkul a akhum’u ajah phat’in Jesu jong Galilee gam langa akikhindoh tai.
Amavang Nazareth kho dalhan achen, Zebulun le Naphtali gamsung, Galilee dillen pang, Capernaum khoa apansai.
Hitia aum hi Isaih Themgao kama kiseisa;
“Zebulun gam le Naphtali gam, Jordan gal’a Twikhanglen lampi; Namtin vaipi chenna Galilee,
Muthim lah a chengten Khovah vah tah amutauvin; Thina muthim gama chengte chunga Kho ahung vah tai,” kiti chu gui lhunna dinga chuti ahi.
Hichelaiya pat chun Jesun thu ahil lhanglen, “Van a Lenggam chun ahinphatai, nachonset lung khel’uvin,” ati.
Galilee dillen panga Jesu ava le le pet’in nga man mi ni Peter kitipa Simon le anaopa Andrew Twikhanglen a lensep pet amui.
Chuin ajah lhona, “Neijui lhonin mihem matje hil lhon inge,” atileh;
alen lhon dalhan Jesu ajui pai lhontai.
Ache kit leh ucha chom dang ni, Jacob le anaopa John kiti Zebedee to len anakhui phat pet’u amun, amani jong akouve.
Jacob le Johnin kong le apa Zebedee dalhan nung ajui lhontai.
Galilee gam pumpia Jesu ache le len japi houkhomna in tin ah thu ahil len, Lenggam Kipana Thupha aseiphong len, mipilah a nat jat chom choma na ho aboldamin ahi.
Chutah chun Syria gam pumpia achung chang thu athangsoh tan, nat jat chom choma naa, natthoh lel, thilhavop, buh thi chule langthi ho jouse Jesu henga ahinpuiyun aman aboldamsoh keitai.
Chutjongle Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea gam le Jordan gal langa konin mipi tamtah-in Jesu nung ajuitauve.
Mipi amu phat’in Jesu molvuma akaltouvin atou leh aseijuite ahenga ahung kikhomtauve.
Hichun Jesu apaodoh-in mipi thu ahil’in hitin aseiye:
“Lhagaova chimthih neilou ho anun nom’ui, Van a Lenggam chu amahoa ahi!
Lung lengvai ho anun nom’ui, Pathenin alhamon diu ahi!
Milung neng ho anun nom’ui, Amahon leiset alo diu ahi!
Pathen dei holna gilkel dangchah thoh ho anun nom’ui, Pathen deiya lung nachim diu ahi.
Mi hebol ho anun nom’ui, Pathenin amaho ahebol ding ahi.
Milung theng ho anun nom’ui, Amahon Pathen amu diu ahi.
Mi sucham ho anun nom’ui, Pathen chate kiti diu ahi.
Pathen dei boljeh a bolset thoh ho anun nom’ui, Van a Lenggam amahoa ahi.
“Keima jal’a min nabolset, nahouset’uva chule nang ho douna jouthu le thu gilou ijakai naseikhum tengu leh anun nom nahiuve.
Hitobang tah a hi nang ho sanga masajo Themgao ho jong anabol setsau ahitai! Kipah-un tha nom’un, van a nasan diu kipaman tampi akikoiye.
“Nang ho leiset chi nahiuve. Chi khu tamtah le ipia ki-alsah kit ding ham? A-al lou teng panna bei ahitan, akipai mang jin, min keng chotphan aneijitai.

Koiman thaomei avah-in lo akhu khum ngaipoi, thaomei khom chunga atungin insunga um jouse asalvahsoh keijie.
Hitobang chun navah-u miho masanga kilang hen, chutileh min natoh phat nau muntin, van a um na-pau avahchoi diu ahi.
“Kei hi Mose Danthu l eThemgao ho thuhil sumang dia hungin neigel hih hel’un, asumang ding hilouva amolso ding joh a hung kahibouve.
Dih tah a kaseipeh nahiuve, van l eleiset man kahse le thil jouse bei kah sea Danthu kisun lekhajem neopen le ahalsi khat jeng jong mang lou ding ahibouve.
Hijeh a chu hiche thupeh lah a aneopen khat susea, midang jong chu tibol dinga hilchan chu van a Lenggama aneopen a pang ding, chu tobangma a anit them le midangin anit themna dinga hilchan chu van a Lenggama alen a kisei ding ahi.
Chuti ahijeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, Danthu them ho le Phrisee ho sanga nathem chan nau achung nun joh loule van aLenggamma nalut louhel diu ahi.
“‘Tol natah lou diu ahi, koi hijongle tol that chu achung thu kitan ding kicha jing ding ahi,’ tia malai mite jah a kiseisa chu najtauve.
Kenvang kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hijongle asopi chunga lung hang chan chu achung thu kitan ding kicha jing ding ahi; chu jongle koi ahi asopi jah a, ‘Pananbei’ tia house jouse chu hou vaipoloi kikhopnaa athu kitan ding kipha lam jinga, chule asopi jah a, ‘Panabei mi-ngol’ tia house chan jong damun neidil’a lut ding kicha geova um ding ahi.
Hijeh chun maicham phunga thiltoh din hung t ajongle chun, chua chu nasopi nachunga lung himona nageldoh leh,
maicham maiya nathilto ding dalhan, nasopi chutoh gakicham masan, chujou teng hung kit’in lang thil chu Pathen koma toh-in.
“Naheh pan thutanpu heng nalhut masangin lampia kichampin, achuti loule thutanpa koma nakai lut’in tin, thutan pan songkul ngah pa pehdoh-in natin, aman songkul’a nakhum lo ding ahi.
Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi, paisa nongnai geiya napeh theng hel masangin songkul’a koin potdoh thei pon nate.

Ken vang kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hijongle numei jon lung gul’a vea chun alungthima ajonpi ahitai.
Hijeh chun namit jelamin nachon setah l ekaldoh-in lan gpai mang jengin; tahsa pumpia damun a nakile lut sangin, natibah khat lhin lel ding aphajoi.
Nakhut jetlamin nachonset sah jong le sat lhan pai mang jengin, tahsa pumpia damun a nakile lut sangin natibah khat lhin lel ding aphakoi.
“‘Koi hileh ajinu daa chun jida na lekha pehen,’ kitisa ahi.
Kenvang kaseipeh nahiuve, mito ajonjeh tilouva jida chan chun ajinu ajonso ahin, dasa numei kichenpi jong chu mito jong-ah ahi.
“Chukit leh, ‘Nakitepna sukeh hih-in, nakitepna jat chu Pakai koma molson,’ tia malai mite kiseipeh chu najatauve.

Leiset panin jong kihahsel hih-un Pathen kengto ngapna ahi, Jerusalem panin kihahsel dauvin, Leng loupi khopi ahi,
naluchang jong panin kihahsel dauvin, nasamjang khat jeng jong nakansah navomsah theipouve.

Kenvang kaseipeh nahiuve, Agiloupa chu lethuh hih-un, chusangin nangeiphe jet lem benga chu naveilam jong dopeh-in.
Hehset’a nasongkhol sung nung lah peh ding gopa chu nasangkhol ponungalenpa geiyin peh than.
Koi hile nada nacham louva mile khat napuigoa chu mile ni geiyin kilhonpin.
Nahenga thil thuma chu pen, bat ding deiya jong peh louvin koidan.
