Kenvang kaseipeh nahiuve, Namelmateu ngailu’vin, nabolse jouseu taopehun;
chutilh van a um na-Pau chate nahi theidiu ahi. Ajeh chu Aman migilou le mipha chunga kibangin nisa asat sah gel’in, midih le midih lou chunga go ajuhsah gel’e.
Ahimonga jong na-ngailute bou na-ngailut’u leh ipi kipaman namu diu ham? Kaidong chonse hon jong chutia abol’u hi louham?
Chule nasopi bou nasalam’u leh midang sanga nachungnun nau ipi um am? Pathen heloute jengin jong chutia abol’u hilouham?
Hichejeh chun vana um na-Pau chamkimsoh banga naphat chamkimsoh diu ahi.
“Houva nakitah nau miho mu ding deina nabol louna diuvin ching theiyun. Chutia nabol vangu leh van a um na-Pava kona kipaman nanei lou diu ahi.
“Mi thil napeh teng, mipha lhem hon pachat deinaa Hou thua kikhopna in tin le lam lhong tin’a abol bangun, namasang sanga sumkon kimut bahsah hih hel’in. Dihtah a kaseipeh nahiuve, amahon kipaman akisanu ahitai.
Mi thil napeh tengleh, nathilpeh chu guh thim ahi theina din nakhut jetlama napeh chu veilam jeng jong hetsah dan.
Chutileh guh thima vejing na-Pan kipaman napeh tei ding ahi.
“Natao tengu leh mipha lhem ho toh bang hih-un, amahon mi mu ding deinan Hou thua kikhopna in tin a dindoh a tao le kholai lamkon dunga din a tao ding bou adeiyui. Dih tah a kaseipeh nahiuve, amahon kipaman akisanu ahitai.
Nang vang natao teng, na-indan sunga lut’in, kotpi kikam khumin, mit’a mu thei lou na-Pa hengah guh thimin taojon; chutileh guh thima vejing na-Pan kipaman pejon nate.
“Natao tengu le chidang namdang ho bangin tampi kisei chu ajah chom ding ngaiton thu hom keo tamtah seidauvin.
Amaho umchan tho hih-un; ajeh chu nathum masanguva jong na-pauvin na-ngai chat jouseu ahetsa ahitai.
Hijeh chun hiti hin taovun: ‘Van’a um ka-Pau, namintheng kijabol jing hen,
Nalenggam hung lhung hen, Van’a bangin leiset’a nalungdei kim soh hen;
Tunia kaneh khop diu an neh neipeuvin,
Eibolseteu ka-ngaidam bangun, Kasuh khelnau ngaidamin;
Chonset lona thei patepna neilhut dauvin, Agiloupaa konin neihuhdoh jo’uvin,’ tin.
“Ajeh chu mi suhkhel na-ngaidamu leh van a um naPauvin jong nasuh khel nau ngaidamin te.
Mi suh khel na-ngaidam lou vanguleh, na-pauvin jong nasuh khel’u ngaidam ponte.
“An na-ngol tengu mipha lhem ho bangin ki-nguisah dauvin. Mipha lhem hon vang an angol’uvin, mi het ding deinan amaisou achom sah jiuve. Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, amahon kipaman akisanu ahitai.
Nangin vang an na-ngol teng nalu thao kinujol’in, namai kiphet ngimjon;
na-anngol chu miho hetsah louvin, guh thima um, na-Pa hetsah in; chutileh guh thima vejing na-Pan kipaman pejon nate.
“Nget le thih-eh suhmang theina, guchan aphet vanga aguh mang theina leiset chunga gou khol hih-in;
chusangin nget le thih-eh suhmang thei louna, guchan jong aphet vanga aguh mang thei louna van a gou khol jo’uvin.
Ijeh-inem itile nagou umnaa chu nalung cheng jing ding ahi.
“Mit hi tahsan meivah ahin, namit chim leh natahsa pumpi vahsoh ding ahi.
Namit aphat lou vang leh natahsa pumpi thim jeng ding ahi. Hijeh chun nasunga vah thim taleh iti khoh ding hitam!
“Soh koiman Pakai ni kin abolkop joupoi, kop taleh khat hotbol’in tin, khat joh alungset ding, ahiloule khat’a hakaiya khat joh anahsahmo lo ding ahi. Hijeh chun Pathen kinbol le sum hol kop thei pouvin nate.
“Hichejeh a chu kaseipeh nahiuve, hinkhoa neh le chah chunga lungkham bol dauvin, tahsa sille chen dingin jong lungkham hih-un; anneh twidon sanga hinkho thupi joa, nihchen ponsil sanga tah sa khoh jo hilou ham?
Vanlai jol’a akhol sampouvin, hijongle changsal’a akhol sampouvin, hijongle van a um na-Pauvin avah nauve. Vachate sanga khu nang ho manlu jo nahi louvu ham?
Nalah-uva lungkham hat’a ahinkho tong khat jopbe thei koi nahiuvam?
I-bol’a nihchen ponsil jal’a lungkham nahiuvam? Gamlah apahcha ho khu iti khandoh ham gel phauvin, na la atong pouvin, sil ding patse bol’a ponkhong jong ahipouve;
ahinla kaseipeh nahiuve, Solomon jeng jong ahao dungjui tah akijep vangin hiche pahcha ho khat hoi bangin ahoi joupoi.
Gamlah hampa tunia kimu, jing teng gop’a meilhum sunga kileh lut ta ding bon Pathenin achuti jep hoi leh, Aman hiche ho sanga najep hoijoh lou diu ham? Vo tahsan lhomho!
Hijeh chun, ‘Ipi kanehuva ipi kadon diu, ipi kasil’uva akchen diu ham?’ tin lungkham dauvin.
Hicheng hi Pathen hepha louten ahol’un, Nang hon na-ngai chat’u jong van a um na-Pauvin ahesoh keiye.
Hijongle amasan Pathen dei le alenggam hol masauvin, chuteng adang ho chengse hi nakipehbe dingu ahinai.
Jing dingin lungkham hih-un, jing chun anikhoa ding hinkigel nan e. Nikho khat cheh-in agimpi khop cheh anei nai.
“Oimo nachan louna diuvin midang oimo dauvin;
mithu nakhol bang banga nathu kikhol cheh ding ahin, midang nabol nau dan dungjuiya kibol ding nahiuve.
Ipi dinga nasopi mit’a bohsi chu namelchih keova, nang mit’a thing long tejen chu mulouva um nahin?
Iti jong nasopi jah a, ‘Namit’a bohsi chu neilahdoh sah-in,’ tia nasei ngam a, nang mit’a thing long tejen chu don louva um nahim?
Vo mipha lhem, namit’a thinglong tejen chu kilahdoh masah l echun nasopi mit’a bohsi chu muchenin natin, ladoh thei tan nate.
Thil theng chu uichate peh dauvin, hung kiheiya nape lou diu ahi; vohchate masanga jong natwikoh chang sep lha hih-un, akengtoa achil thang bep diu ahi.
“Thum’un kipauvin nate, hol’un namudiu ahi; kiuvun nakihonpeh diu ahi.
Ijeh-inem itile athum chan kipe ding, ahol’an amuding akiuva kihonpeh ding ahi.
Nalah-uva achapan neh ding changlhah athum l esong pea,
nga athum leh gul peding koiham?
Migiloutah nang hon bon nachateu thilpha pehje nahet’uleh, van a um na-Pauvin ahenga thumte chu itobang tah a thilpha apeh ding hitam!
Hijeh chun min iti nabol le nadeiyum, nang hon jong hitobnagma chun bolpeh-uvin, hitia bolding hi Danthule themgaote thuhil to kitoh ahi.
“Kot jim a lut’un, ajeh chu manna lam chu akot lentah ahin, alampi alenin, mitamtah hichea chun alut’ui.
Hinna lam chu akot jong akichin, alampi ahah-in, hijeh chun alut’a mi lhomcha ahiuve.
“Kelngoi phat’a kiphatsah, asung lam ngeihang tah tobang Themgao lhem nahenguva hungji ho koma kichih theiyun.
Itobang ahiu atohgauva nahet diu ahi.Ling phunga lengpi theiga kilouva, meithai seltho linga theichang ga ikilou ngaiyam?
Hitobang hin thing phung phalou ga aphapoi.
Thingphung phaa ga pha lou ga ngai lou, thing phung phalouva jong ga pha ga ngai lou ahi.
Aga phalou thingphung jouse chu akiphuh lhun meilhum sunga akileh lutjitai.
Hijeh a chu mi atohgauva nahetdoh diu ahi.
“Pakai, Pakai eiti chan chu van a lenggam lut lou ding, van a um ka-Pa deilam bol’a bou lut ding ahi.
Hiche Nikho chuleh mi tamtah hunguva, ‘Pakai, Pakai, keiho namin a gaothu seisa, thilha nodohsa chule thil kidang bolsa kahilouuvu ham? ati diu ahi.
Chuteng ajah-uva phong tah a, ‘Vo Dan dih lou bolte, kakoma konin potdoh louyun, nang ho kahe kha hih hel’ui,’ kati ding ahi.

Gon ajuh khuma, vadung in aso den a, huipin ahin mut vangin, hiche in chu aluden poi; ajeh chu a-inbul khom songpi chunga kiphut det chet ahi.
Kathusei hicheng hi ja abol lou vang chu milungthimbei, nellei chunga in kisah toh kitekah ding ahi.
Gon ajuh khuma, vadungin aso den a, huipin amut tengleh in chu alhujitan, alhuh chu melse tah ahi,” ati.
Jesun chujat asei chai chaiyin mipin athuhil chu kidang asa lheh jenguvin ahi.
Ijeh-inem itile aman Danthu themho hil banga hil louva thunei tah banga ahil jeng thei ahi.
Jesu molvuma ahung kumsuh chun mihonpin ahin juiyui.
Hichun miphah khat ahungin akoma bohkhup’in, “Pakai, nalung ahileh neidam theng sah thei ahi,” ati.
Jesun athamin, “Kalung ahinai damthengtan,” ati leh, apettah chun aphahnat adamthengtai.
Chuphat’in Jesun ajah a, “Koimacha henga seidoh hih hel’in, amavang chen lang Thempu gakivetsah-in, nadamtheng hi phot chetna din Mose thu peh dungjuiyin nathilto ding lom gatoh tan,” tin ahil’e.
Jesu Capernaum khoa alut chun sepai jalamkai khat ahenga ahungtaovin,
“Pakai, in a um kalhacha chapang khat langthin agen thei lheh jenge,” ati.
Jesun, ajah a, “Hung damsah nang e,” atileh;
jalamkaipan adonbut’in, “Pakai, nang hi kei in sunga lut dinga kilom nahipoi, thu mai mai sei jong le chun kalhacha chapang chu dam jeng thei ahinai.
Ajeh chu kei jong thunei ho noiya um kahin, kei noiya jong sepaite aum’uvin, khat pen pen jah a, ‘Chen,’ katile achen; achom dang khat jah a, ‘Hungin,’ katil eahunge; chule kalhacha jah a, ‘Hiche hi bol’in,’ katileh, abolji nai,” ati.
Athujah hi Jesun kidang asa behseh jengin, anunga hung ho jah a, “Dih tah a kaseipeh nahiuve, Israelte lah jenga jong hitobnag tahsan len kamudoh hih laiye.
Hi jeh a chu kaseipeh nahiuve, niso lam le nilhum lama kon a mitamtah hung kikhom’uva van a Lenggam a Abraham le Isaac chule Jacob toh ankong aumkhom diu ahi.
Ahin lenggam chate dia kigel ho joh chu polam muthim lah a kileh lut diu, hikoma chu ka le hagel um ding ahi,” ati.
Chuin Jesun jalamkaipa jah a, “Chetan, natahsan banga lhung ding ahinai,” atipeh-e.
Jesu Peter insunga alut leh, Peter nupanu nat lhut’a na a lum agatoh khai.
Jesun akhut agah tham leh anat lhut chun alhan, amanu ahung thoudoh paiyin ajen len apangtai.
Nilhah lamin thillhavop mi tampi Jesu henga ahin puiyun, Aman thu cheng khatseh seiyin thilhaho anodoh-in, damloute adamsah soh keitai.
Hitobang kiseisa, “Aman inatna jouseu le iveiset chengseu akilah-in apomangtai’” kiti chu guilhunna dinga chutiso ahi.
Akimvel’a mipi kikhom amudoh phat’in Jesun dil gal lang khat’a galkai ding asomtai.
Hichun Danthu lekha them khat ahungin ajah a, “Houhil, nache che naa juiyinge,” ati.
Jesun ajah a, “Gam-uiten ko aneiyun, chunga leng vachaten bu aneiyui; mihem Chapan mun aneipoi,” ati.
Seijuiho lah a khat’in, “Pakai amasan kapa vui din neisol tadin,” ati.
Jesun ajah a, “Neijui jengin, mithi hon athilongu kivui nauvinte,” ati.
Jesu kong sunga alut’in aseijuiten akilhonpiuve.
Hetman louva dilpi chu khopihui hattah-in ahin nuh leh, twi kinongin kong chu achup pai ding ahitai. Jesu vang aihmu nalaiye.
SEijuiten agasukhang loiyun, “Pakai neihuhhing loiyun twiyin eichup lih diu ahitai!” atiuve.
Jesun ajah-uvah, “Vo tahsan lhom ho idia chuti kichat nahiuvem?” atin, athoudoh-in khopihui le dillen chu haphoa apho leh athip del jenge!
Mihon adatmo soh keiyun, “Ipi mi bep hiya hui l edillen geiyin athu angai jeng hitam!” atiuve.
Jesu agalkaiya Gadara gamsung alhunin, lhankhuh lah a hung kon thilhavop mi nin akimutopi lhon’e. Thilhavop te ni chu kichat aum behseh jeh-in aumna lhon lampi chu koiman ahopa ngampoi.
Amani apengjah lhonin, “Vo Pathen Chapa, ilo ding neitiu ham? Akitep Phat lhin masanga keiho bolgentheiya hung nahim?” ati lhon’e.
Akom’uva kon chun muphah don khat’a hin vohcha tampi hon khat alhai.
Thilhahon ahenga, “Neikaidoh tei diu leh hiche vohchate sunga khun neisol’uvin,” tin ataovui.
Jesun “Lut tauvin,” ati phat’in, ahung potdoh-un vohchate sunga aluttauve. Chutah chun Vohhonpi chu ha-lhaiyin alhaiyun, kol’ah a alhai lhauvin, dil sunga achomlut soh hel’auvin, twi lah a athidentauve.
Chuphat’in vohcha ching ho kho sunga ajamlut’un, thilhavop te ni chunga thusoh le athilmu jouseu agaseisoh tauve.
Chutah chun kho sung mite abonchan Jesu henga ahungun, Ama chu agamsunguva kona potdoh din ajoltauve.
Jesu konga alut’in, ahung kile tol galkaiyin khopi sung ahung lhungtai.
Hichea hin mihon pasal langthi khat alupna pumin Jesu henga ahinpuiyui. Jesun atahsanu amuchet phat’in langthipa jah a, “Kihol lel hih-in chapa, nachonset jouse ki-ngaidam ahitai,” ati.
Hichun Danthu lekha them phabep’in, “Hichepan Pathen ataitom’e,” tin agel’ui.
Alung gel’u Jesun ahen, “Idia hitobang thilse nagel’u ham?
‘Nachonset aki-ngaidamsoh tai,’ ti leh “Thouvin lam jottan,’ ti hoijoh seibai jom?
Leiset chunga Mihem Chapan chonset ngaidamna tha anei kavetsah nahiuve,” atin, lang thipa jah a, “Thouvin, nalupna kilah-in na-inlam jontan,” ati.
Langthipa akipatdoh paiyin inlam ajontai.
Mipin hiche hi amu phat’un akichauvin, ahinvangin mihemte chunga hitobang thaneina pea Pathen avahchoitauve.
Jesun hikom chu dalhan ache leh Matthew kiti mi khat a kaidonna mun a tou amun, ajah a, “Neijuiyin,” atileh; Matthew akipatdoh-in ajuitai.
Matthew in a Jesun ankong aum phat’in kaidong ho tamtah l ethet umtah tah miho ahungun Jesu le aseijuite toh ankong aumkhom’uve.
Pharisee hon hichu amuphat’un aseijuite jah a, “I-bol’a na Houhil pauvin kaidong ho le thet um tah tah ho to an aneh khom ham?” tin adongui.
Jesun aseiyu ajan, “Midamin louthem angaipon, adam louvin bou angaiye.
Keiman hepina bou kangeh-in, kilhaina ka-ngeh poi,’ kiti hi ipi kiseina ham gakhiltoh-un. Ajeh chu midohho kouva hung kahipon, chonset kouva hung joh kahibouve,” ati.
John seijuite Jesu henga ahungun, “I-atileh keiho le Pharisee hon an-ka-ngol mat chet juva, nang seijuiten an ngol khah louvu ham?” tin ahung dongui.
Jesun adon but’in, “Kichen golvahna hung lha ho chu aji neipan alenkhomi laisea lunhham ngaiyam? Amavang aji neipa akom’uva kona akipui mang nikho hung lhung ding ahin, chutengleh kichen golvah a hung lha hon an ngol diu ahinai.
“Koiman sopnem loulai ponhal’in ponlui abeh ngaipoi, beh leh abehnan pon lui chu bot-eh jontin, haset cheh lo ding ahi.
Chujongle min savun peng lui sunga jong lengpitwi thah akhum ngaipoi, khum ta leh alengpitwi pen gchu tumkeh intin, lengpitwi long jal’a apeng jong mang lo ding ahi. Hijeh chun lengpitwi thah chu savun peng thah a akikhum jin, lengpitwi le apeng anigel’in ahoidoh theiye,” ati.
jesun hiche hi asei nalaiyin, vaihom pasal khat akom’a ahung bohkhup’in, “Tutah chun kachanu athitai, hinla hungin achunga na khut ngamle chun hingkit teiyinte,” tin ataove.
Jesu akipatdoh paiyin vaihompa to akilhon phat’in aseijuiten jong ajuitauve.
Lampia chun kum som-le kum ni thi longa dammi numei khat hi Jesu nunga ahungin apon mong kai atham’e.
Amanu kigel’a chu, “Apon mong jeng jong thamkha len gdam inge,” ati ahi.
Jesu agah kihei leh numei nu chu amun, “Kihol lel hih-in chanu, natahsanin nadamsah ahitai,” ati. Hiche pet tah chun ama nu adamsel tai.
Jesu vaihompa in a alut leh thi-opna akuli mut h leh mipi poh chei choiya um amun,
“Nabonchan potdoh-un, chapangnu hi athi-ah ahipoi, a-ihmu ahibouve,” atileh amahon amoh nuisat atauve.
Hinla mipi adeldoh phat’in Jesu insunga alut’in, chapangnu chu akhut’a akaileh chapangnu athudoh tai.
Hiche thusoh hi chuche gamsungse sea akithangsoh tai.
Chukom dalha a Jesu acheleh, mitcho mi nin ajui lhon’in, “Vo David chapa neilungset’in,” tin asam lhontai.
Insung khat’a agalut phat’in mitcho tenin jong ajuilut lhontai. Hichun Jesun ajah lhon’a, “Namit lhon hahsah thei ding monga neitahsan lhon ham?” atileh; amanin jong, “Henge Pakai!” ati lhon’e.
Chuphat’in Jesun amit lhon athampeh-in, “Natahsan lhon bang in mit hah lhontan,” atileh;
hichun amitlhon ahah paitai. Jesun amani akham chah kheh-in, “Koima hetsah-lhon hih beh-in,” ati.
Mitchote ni chula apotdoh lhonin chuche gamkol sungse seah Jesu thudol athechansoh lhontai.
Agah potdoh-u leh thilhavop mi paomo khat Jesu henga ahinpuiyui.
Jesun thilha anodoh peh phat’in paomopa apaothei paitai. Chutah chun mipin kidang asauvin, “Israelte lah jenga jong, hitobang thil akimu kha hih laiye,” atiuve.
Pharisee hon vang, “Thilha lengpa vanga thilhate adeldoh hichume,” atiuvin ahi.
Jesun khopi jouse l ekhoneo jouse achonsoh keiyin, Houthua kikhopna intin a thu ahil len, Lenggam Kipana Thupha ahil lhangin, veise dammo jouse aboldamin ahi.
Jesun mipi avet leh alainatpi lheh-e. Ajeh chu achingbei kelngoite bangin gim le da athoh-un, apan hu diu aumpoi.
Hijeh chun Jesun aseijuite jah a, “Chang-at ding atam lheh nan, natonga alhom’e,
chang-at ding mi ahinsol be na din chang-at thunei Pakai henga taovun,” ati.
Jesun aseijui som le ni chu akoukhomin, lhagaoboh ho deldohna ding le dammo veiset jouse boldam theina tha aei.
Solchah som le ni ho min chu: amasapenin Peter kisah Simon le asopipa Andrew ahin, adang Zebedee chapa t eni Jacob l easopipa John,
Philip l eBartholomew, Thomas, kaidongpa Matthew, Alpheus chapa Jacob, Thaddaeus,
Canaan mi Simon, chule Jesu matsah a pang Judas Iscariot-hicheng hi ahiuve.
Som le ni asoldoh chun Jesun hitin ahilchah-e: “Chidang nam dangte gamsung le Samaria mite khoi ho jot dauvin.
Kelngoi mang sa tobang Israel insung mite henga chejo’uvin.
Nache pum pum’un, ‘Van a Lenggam chun hikom ahin phatai,’ tin samleuvin.
Ana damsah-un, mithi kaithouvun, aphah suthengun, thilha nodoh-un, manbeiya nakisanu ahi, manbeiyin homjal’un.
Nasum dip sunga sana, dangka sumsan kipoh sauvin;
cholam ding sum thumna din sakhao jen gjong kendauvin, sangkhol tho ni ah hih-un, kengchot hihen tenggol hileh kendauvin. Ajeh chu natong’an aneh ding amu lom ahi.
“Khopi hihen khoneo hileh naphah phah nauva nalhunsah nom miu holdoh-un, chukom nadalhah kahseuvin umpiuvin.
Nalut lut nau insung jah a, ‘Lungmon leng hen,’ tin salam cheh-uvin.
Insung khattaouvin lamtoa nalhunsah-u leh salam’un lang, nalhunsah nom lou vangu leh salam datauvin.
Insung khattou le khopi khattouvin lamto loule lhunsah da akop’uva, nathu seiyu jong angaidau leh, nakengphanguva leivui geiyin thin lhah khum’un dalhauvin.
Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, Thupi tan nikho leh chuche mun mite thoh ding sanga Sodom le Gomorrah khopi thoh baijjo ding ahi.
“Veuvin, ngeihon lah a kelngoi kilha lut banga kasol nahiuve. Hijeh chun gul bangin ching theiyun, vakhu bangin lung nem’un.
Chingtheiyun, mihon man’uvin natin Hou vaipoloi kikhopna nakai lut diu, Houthua kikhopna in dunga najep diu ahi.
Keima jal’in vaipote le leng ho anga kailut’un tin, hinla amaho le chidang namdangte henga kathupha hettohsah a napan diu ahi.
Hitia nakailut tengu leh nasei diu le nasei ding dol’un lung kham hih-un, apettah leh kipenauvin nate.
Ajeh chu nalunggel mai mai nasei diu ahipon, nasunguva cheng na-Pau Lhagao chun naman chah-uva asei ding ahibouve.
“Pasal’in asopite aheh lih a, mipaten achate chutima abol diu, chaten jong anu apa adouva athiso cheh diu ahi.
Keima jal’a mitin hot le paiya na-um diu, hinla akhon ni geiya thoh lhumpa bou huhhinga um ding ahi.
Khopi khat’a nabolset tengu khopi chom khat’a jam lut’in, tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve. Mihem Chapa hung kah a Israelte khopi jouse nachotsoh louhel diu ahi.
“Seijui chu ahilpa sangin achungnungjo pon, soh jong apu sangin achungnung ngaipoi.
Seijui chu ahilpa tobang bep ahiya, soh apu toh abah joule aphaset ahi. Ainneipa bon Beelzebul ahisah ngamu leh a-insung mite ipi ahisah da diu ham?
“Mihem kichah hih-un. Ajeh chu phondoh louva sel mang ding aumpon, hetdoh louva im-mang ding jong aumpoi.
Muthima kaseipeh-u hi khovah a naphonjal diu, guh thima kahil’u hi intingvuma naphonjal diu ahi.
Tahsa sunmang thei jongle lhagao that thei lou chu kichat dauvin, chusangin tahsa le lhagao akop’a damun a sol a sumang thei Pathen joh ginguvin.
Vasah ni paisa khatseh man a kijoh ji lou ham? Ahivangin na Pau phatsah louva khat jeng cha jong tol’a kimoh selhah lou ding ahi.
Nang ho jong nalujang sam jouseu geiya simtohsa kikoi ahitai.
Hijeh chun kicha hih-un, vahsah ho sanga manlujo nahiuve.
“Koi hile japi lah a Christa mi ahi kiphongdoh chan chu Ken jong van a um ka-Pa angsunga kaphondoh ding ahi.
Koi hi leh Christa mi ahina japi lah a immang chan chu Ken jong van a um ka-Pa angsunga kaseilep ding ahi.
“Leiset chunga chambol’a hungin neigel dauvin, chambolma lah chemjama kidouna dinga hung kahibouve.
Ajeh chu pa le chapa kidohsah a, nu le chanu kidohsah ding, tehpi leh mounu kidohsah dinga hung kahibouve.
Mihem dia amelma khohpen tahchu a-insung mi ma ma hiding ahi.
“Koi hile Kei sanga anu apa lungset jo jong kaseijui lom ahipoi.
Athingpel kiput’a kanung jui lou chu kaseijui lom ahipoi.
Koi hile kihinso nom chun athilo ding, keijal’a thilo chanin kihinsona anei ding ahi.
“Koi hileh nang ho lem a lhunsah chanin Kei eilem a lhunsah a kila ding, Kei eilem a lhunsah jouse chu Eisolpa lema lhunsah a ahi.
Pathen Themgao lem a lhunsah chun Themgao kipaman akihoppi ding ahin, mipha lem a lhunsah jong chu mipha kipaman amuding ahi.
Dihtah a kaseipeh nahiuve, kaseijuite lah a aneopen khat hijong leh seijui ahina jeh a twidap khon khat pejeng jong chu kipaman akisan tei ding ahi,” ati.
Jesun aseijuite som le ni ahilchahsoh phat’in chukom dalhan, naivel khopi dunga thuhil’a seiphong le din achetai.
Akihenna songkul’ah Messiah natoh thilbol kithang ajan, John chun aseijui phabep Jesu henga asol’e.
Amahon Jesu jah a, “Hung dia kisei chu nahim, achom dang khat ka-nga nah lai diu ham” atiuve.
Jesun ajah-uvah, “Kile kit’un lang najah chengseu le namu chengseu hi gaseipeh tauvin;
mitchon kho amun, elbaiyin lam a jot tan, miphah suhthengin aumin, na-ngongin kho ajan, mithi kaithouvin aumtai, chule vaichate Kipana Thupha akiseipeh tai.
Kachunga lung opkaina neilou chu anun nom’e,” ati.
John seijuite kile phat’in, John thudol mipi jah a Jesun aseiyin; “Gamthip laiya ipi vetnom’a che nahiuvem? Hui mut ling peng venom nahiuvam?
Ipi vedia che mong nahiuvem? Kile lah ponsil mi ham? Pon kikhel sil miho leng inpia achengbouvui!
Ipi vetnoma cheba nahiuvem? Themgao ham? Ahinai, Themgao mai mai ahi poi, thupitah Themgao ahi.
Pathen Lekhabua Pathenin, ‘Nalampi sem toh din namasanga kasolle kasol masai,’ tia asei chu John hi ahitai.
Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, numei sung peng cheh ahivangin John Baptist sanga lenjo mihem apeng kha hih laiye; hinla van a lenggama neopen jong ama sangin alenjo nalaiye.
John Baptist thuseiphong nikhoa pat tuni geiyin van a lenggam hi min pumhat jengin anon, mi huseten pumhat’a lah din agouve.
John khang geiya Themgao jouse le Mose Danthun Lenggam thudol aseiyu ahin,
nakisan nom’u leh John hi hung dia kisei Elijah chu ahitai.
Nakhang neiyan ngai hen!
“Hiche khang mite hi ipi to kitekah theiyin tem? Kailhang dunga tou chapang ho loikhat’in adang ho jah a,
Kipana kuli kamut vangun nalam pouvin, thi lhah la kasah-u jongle nakap pouve,’ tia kihouho tobang ahiuve.
Ajeh chu John hi muhem neloule midon don louva aumle ‘THilhavop ahi,’ atiu vin;
mihem Chapan mineh ngai aneh a midon ngai adon vangin, Neh het le lengpitwi lop, kaidong ho le chonsete jol le gol,’ tin asei kit’ui. Hoi hileh chihna chu atohgan them achan ahibouve,” ati.
Jesun thil kidang ahabol dehna mihon lung ahei loujeh-un aphohsal’in,
“Ohe Chorazin khopi nada ahi! Ohe Bethsaida khopi nada ahi! Nakhosunga thil kidang kibol chengse hi Tyre le Sidon kho sunga kibol hileh, khomiten kisihin khaopon sil’a vut kinu’vintin achonset lung heisoh tauvinte.
Tahbeh a akseipeh nahiuve, thupi tan nikho le nang ho thoh sanga Tyre le Sidon kho mite thoht oljo ding ahi!
Chule Capernaum nang hi! Van geiya kichoisang go nahim? Noimigam a nasot lhah diu ahibouve. Nakho sunga thil kidang kibol sengse hi Sodom kho sunga kibol leh mangthth hih laiyinte.
Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi, thupi tan nikho leh nang thoh sanga Sodom thoh oljo ding ahi,” ati.
Hichepat hin Jesun, “Pa van le leiset Pakai! Michingte le mi themte dia na-impeh chengse mimol ho naseipeh jeh-in kathangvah-e!
hiti dinga hi nadeimong hinte he-Pa!
“Ka-Pan thil ijakai eippedoh tai. Pa tilou koiman Chapa ahepon, Chapa le aman aphondoh peh nom ho tilou koima dangin Pa ahepouve.
“Tong gimte leh pohgihte kahenga hungun, Keiman choldoh sah unge!
Kanamkoljon kilah-un pouvin, Keiya kihil’un, Keima lung nengtah le nun nemtah kahi, Keiya hinjouna nanei diu ahi.
Ijeh-inem itile kanamkoljon apoh anop’in, kapoh jong ajang’e,” ati.
Chom khat jouvin Choldo nin Jesun bulei lai ajotpai. Aseijuiten gilkel jeh-in changvui asih pantauve.
Athilbol’u hi Pharisee hon amu’uvin Jesu jah a, “Ven, naseijuiten Choldo nin dan ngailou abol’ui!” atiuve.
Jesun adonbut’in, “David l ealoite agilkel’uva chu ipi abol’u nasim khah louvu ham?
I-atileh Pathen Houin a lut’a, Thempu tilou neh ngai louhel, Pathen um jing hetna kitohsa changlhah aloite toh aneh jengu ham?
Ole Choldo niseh leh Houin sunga lutji Thempu hon Choldo nikho asuhkeh vanguva themmo achanda diu Danthu chu nasim khah louvu ham?
Kaseipeh nahiuve, Houin sanga thupijo khat hikoma aum’e!
Pathen lekhabua, ‘Gan alhai ka-ngeh poi, hepina bou kadeiye,’ kiti chu heleu chun monabei miho themmo nachan lou diu ahi.
Ijeh-inem itile Mihem Chapa hi Choldo nikho Pakai ahi,” ati.
Hikom chu dalhan Houthua kikhopna in khat’a Jesu aluttai.
Kikhopn ain a chun pasal khut lang ngoi khat ana umin, alah-uva chun Jesu thilbol dihsah lou jeh a hehse nom mi phabep jong aum’e. Amaho hin, “Choldo nikhoa damlou boldam hi Danthu to kikal hilou ham?” tin adongui.
Jesun adonbut’in, “Choldo nikhon nalah-uva koiham khat kelngoi kokhuuh a lahlut taleh aneipan agakaidoh lou ding ham?
Mihem hi Kelngoi sanga gam chenga mantamjo ahi! Hijeh chun i-Danthuu hin Choldo nikhoa mi kithopi ding aphal’e,” ati.
Hijeh chun Jesun khut lang ngoipa jah a, “Nakhut langin,” ati. Khut ngoipan alhandoh jen gleh adamtan, adamlang bep bep ahitai.
Chuphat’in Pharisee h apotdohun Jesu thana ding akihousomtauve.
Ama than ding akihousomu ahet doh phat’in Jesu chukom dalhan apotdoh le japin ajuitauve. ana jouse aboldamin
Ama thusim chu midang aseipeh da diuvin ahilchah-e.
Hitobang thil hi Isaiah Themgao kama kiseisa:
“Ven, kalhentum lhacha deitah, Kadeitah le kalung lhaina pen! Achunga ka-Lhagao chensah ingting, Chitin namtin lah a kathutan aphondoh ding ahi!
O-sanga mi anelkal lou ding, Kholai dunga jong lhang asap lou ding;
Tahlelte dia nun nem ding, Panpibeite akhoto ding ahi! Dan dihtah a thu akitan kahsea Adou dou jeng ding ahi!
Chule namtin vaipin akineppi diu,” kiti chu guilhunna dia soh ahi.
Hichepet hin thilhavop mitcho paomo mi khat hi Jesu henga ahin puiyun, Jesun aboldam phat’in apao theiyin kho amutai.
Jesu thil kidang bol hi japin adatmo behseh jengun, “Hichepa hi David Chapa hi-ngap ding hitam?” akitiuve.
Pharisee hon ajahdoh phat’un, “Thilha lengpa Beelzebul thahat’a thilahte anodoh hichu me!” atiuve.
Alunggel’u ahet phat’in Jesun ajah-uvah, “Kilang khen a kidouto lenggam tapou mangthah ding, ki lang khen a kidouto khopi hihen insung hi jong le mangthah vah ding ahi.
Satanin Satan anodoh leh akilangkhen ahitauvin, alenggam beivah ding ahitai.
Thilha lengpa Beezebl thahat vanga thilhate nodoh a neiseiyu leh naseijui teuvin koi thahat vanga anodoh-u ba ham? Namo nau phongdoh a naseijuiteu pang diu ahi.
Pathen Lhagao vanga thilhate nodoh kahi vang leh Pathen Lenggam chu nalah-u lhung ahitai.
“Mihat insunga lut chun ama somkon masa louva kon anei achom thei ngaiyam? Inneipa asomkon jou tengle bou anei achompeh ding ahi.
“Koi hileh eipanpi lou chu eidou mong ahin, eilhoh khomhu lou mi chu athecheh a pang ahibouve.
Hijeh a chu kaseipeh nahiuve, mihemte chonsetna le Pathen ataitom nai itobang hijongl eki-ngaidam thieyin tin, Lhagao Theng taitom vang ngaidam chang louhel ding ahi.
Mihem Chapa douna thusei jong ki-ngaidam thieyin tin, Lhagao Theng taitom vang hcu itih chan a jong ngaidam chang louhel ding ahi!
“Thingga pha deiyan thing phung pha nei angaiye, nathing phung aphat loule thingga phalou nanei ding ahi. Ajeh chu thingphung hi agan akihei.
Gulse guiya peng ho, gitlou puma iti thupha nasei theidiu ham? Ajeh chu lungsung alet teng kamsunga hungpotdoh ahibouve.
Miphan athilpha kholna lung sunga konin thipha asodoh jin, misen athilse kholna lungsunga konin thilse asodoh jie.
“Kaseipeh masah nahiuve, thupi tan Nikho leh mintinin manlou thu asei jouseu geiya asuhto soh kei diu ahi.
Naseisau thu hoa chu nathem namo nahcung thu kitan diu ahi,” ati.
Danthu them phabep le Pharisee phabep’in Jesu jah a, “Houhil, thil kidang nabol kavetnom’ui,” atiuve.
Jesu a-eojah-in, “Pathen hephaloute leh khang gilouva miten melchihna nahol’um? Jonah Themgao melchihna itlou melchihna dang kipelou ding nahiuve.
Ngapi oisunga Jonah nithum le janthum athamden banga Mihem Chapa jong leiset Lailunga nithum le janthum thamden ding ahi.
Thupi tan nikho leh Nineveh kho mite chu hiche khang mite toh hung ding khom’uva themmo achan diu ahi; ijeh-inem itile Nineveh kho miten Jonah thuseu ajah phat’un chonset lung aheiyui; hinla veuvin Jonah sanga lenjo khat hikoma aum’e!
Thupi tan nikho leh Sheba lengnu chu hiche khang mite toh idng khoma themmo achan ding ahi; ajeh chu leiset kolmang lang peh a konin Sheba lengnun Solomon chih thusei ahung ngai gunset theiye; tunla veuvin Solomon sanga lenjo khat hikoma aum’e!
“Lhagaoboh hi mihem sunga apotdoh teng gamgo lah a avah len choldo mun ahol lelen, mu la amuji poi.
Chutengleh, ‘Kahung potdoh namun ma ma a lut kit tange,’ atin, ahung kile kit leh, mihem chu sagoh keova kithen ngimsel’a um amun,
ache kit’in ama sanga khohjo lhagaoboh sagi ma agapui ben, mihem sunga chun alut’un achenpha tauve; chutah chun mipa umchan hi amasa sangin akhoh cheh tai. Hiche khanga migiloute jong hung chuiti diu ahi,” ati.
Jesun mipi jah athu asei nalaiyin anu le asopite ama to kihou nomin ahungun inpo-ah angah-ui.
Hijeh chun mi khat hin Jesu jah a, “Ven, nanu le nasopite nang to kihou nomin ahungun inpo-ah na-ngah-ui,” atipeh-e.
Ajah a thuseipa jah a Jesun, “Kanu koi hiya, kasopite koi koi hiuvam?” atin,
aseijuite akoh-in, “Ven kanu l ekasopite hi!
Ajeh chu koi hileh van a ka-pa lungdei bol’a chu kasopipa, kasopinu chule kanu ahiuve,” ati.
Hiche nikhoa hi Jesun in dalha dil pang lama chea atou phat’in
mipi ahung kikhom’un, Ama kong sunga alut’in atouve. Mipi vang va0kam a adingui.
Hichun Jesun mipi ajah a thu tampi thulemin aseiye: “Pasal khat muchi the din akontai.
Muchi athephat’in abang lamsih a achun, vachaten akilogam tauve.
Muchi phabep jong song lheo chung, lepatnaa achun, aleiphat jeh-in ahung keh doh loiye.
Hinla nisan asah phat’in leipat jeh a ajungkho thuh loujeh chun asang gop jitai.
Muchi phabep ma ling lah a achukhan, ling ho akhandoh phat’in adep lih jin ahi.
Muchi phabeppi vang leipha laiya achun, akhangdoh-in agatan, abang jakhat cheng, abang somgup cheng chule abang som thum chengin apunge,
“Nakhang neiyan ngai hen.” ati.
Seijuiten anailut’un Jesu jah a, “I-bol’a mipi koma thulem jenga thu nasei ham?” atiuve.
Jesun adonbut’in “Nang ho hi van a lenggam thuguh hetna kiseipeh nahitauvin, amaho vang kisepeh nailou lai ahi.
Aneiya chu anei let setna dia kipeh be ding, aneilou vang themcha nei jongle kilahpeh ding ahi.
Ijeh-inem itile amaho hin veu jongle muthei lou ding, ngai jongle ajah thei lou diu ahi jeh a thulema kisei ahi.
Hichea hin Isaiah Themgao seisa: ‘Ja jong leu nahet khen thei lou diu, Ve jong leu chun namu chet thei lou diu;
Ijeh-inem itile hiche nam mite hi alungthimu amoh-in, Akolseh gam’un, amit’u achosoh tai; Chutilou leh mit’in mu’vin tin naa ajah diu, kadamsah diu ahi,’ ati chu guilhung ahitai.
“Nanghon vang namu’va najah tah jeh-un hampha tah nahiuve!
Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, namu chengseu hi Themgao tampi le midih tam tah-in amu nom vangun amupouvin, ajah nom lheh vangun ajapha pouve.
“Hijeh chun muchi thepa thulem hi ngaiyuvin.
Lenggam thu kiseipeh la ja a hekhen thei lou miho chu lamsih a chu muchi tobang chu ahiuve. Alung sunguva kikhum lutsa jong Agiloupan ahung lah mangpeh jitai.
Lenggam thu kisei ajah teng kipah tah a kisan pai jeng ho chu songlheo chung leipatna a chu muchi tobang ahiuve.
Asunguva alut gil loujeh-in chom khat aum jin, akisansau thu jeh a bolsetna ahung teng adonda paijitauve.
Ling lah a chu muchi hi lenggam thu ja a, ahivanga leiset khan khoa lungkhamna l ehaova nopsah ding deinan adep lihji miho ahiuvin, galouvin aumjitauve.
Leipha laiya chu muchi hi lenggam thu ja a hetthem miho ahiuvin, ahung gaphan, abang ja khat cheng, abang somgup cheng chule abang somthum chengin apungjie,” ati.
Jesun ajah-uva thulem khat aseikit’in: “ Van a Lenggam chu mi khat loulaiya muchi pha thea to bang ahi.
Jan khat mi ihmut thip nungin melma khat ahungin chang lah achun changlhem athen ache mangtai.
Chang kung kikhan lhit’a changpah do phat’in changlhem ho jong akilangdoh tai.
Hichun in neipa sohte ahungun ajah a, “Kapu, lolaiya muchi pha jeng nahte me, hoilam kona changlhem ho keh ham?” atiu leh,
aman, ‘Melma khat touvin abol hinte,’ ati. Hichun asohten, ‘Changlhem ho khu kagabo doh diu nadeiyem?” atiuve.
Aman ajah-uva, ‘Gabodoh datauvin, changlhem nabodoh nauva changtah jong bodoh tha khauvin nate,
Chang-at phat kah-in changtah le changlhem keh khom tante, chang-at phat tneg keiman chang-at ho chu changlhem chengse meiya govam di akankhom’uva chule changtah chengse kachangpang sunga akhum diuvin seipeh nange,’ tin aseiye,” ati.
Jesun thulem khatma aseipeh kit’in, “Van a Lenggam chu mi khat’in loulaiya ankam mu athe to bang ahi.
Ankam mu hi muchi lah a aneo pen ahivangin akhandoh phat’in thingphung tejen aphan, chunga leng vacha ten jong bu sahna le ge nan aneitauve,” ati.
Jesun thulem khat asei kit’in, “Van a Lenggam chu numei khat’in changbong danthum leh a chol avuiya, apomsoh kahsea abil tobang ahi,” ati.
Jesun mipi jah a thulem hijat hi aseiyin, thulem louvin thucheng khat cha aseipoi.
Thulem asei hi, “Thulem seinan pao ving ting, Lei set bul kiphu til’a pat kisei thuguh chengse phongdoh inge,” kiti Themgao seisa chu gui lhunna dia asei ahi.
Mipi dalhaa Jesu insung agalut leh aseijuite ahungun, “Lou laiya changlhem chu ipi kiseina ham neihil chen’un,” atiuve.
Jesun adonbut’in, “Muchi pha thea chu Mihem Chapa ahin,
loulai chu vannoi leiset ahi; muchipha chu Lenggama lut chate ahiuvin, changlhem chu Agiloupa mite ahiuve;
chule changlhem thepa chu Agiloupa ahiye. Chang-at phat chu Vannoi khang kichaina ahitan, chang-at ho chu Vantilte ahiuve.
Changlhem chengse akhop khom’uva meiya ahalvam banguva vannoi leiset khang kichai nikho jong hiding ahi.
Mihem Chapan avantilte sol’in tin Alenggam sunga kisuhmo na bolte leh akhangse jouse akhop khomsah a,
meilhum deuje ju sunga alelut diu, hikoma chu kap le hagel gel’a um diu ahi.
Midih chengse vang a-Pau lenggama nisa banga vah emsel diu ahi. Nakhang neiyan ngai hen!
“Van a lenggam chu loulaiya gou kiselguh, mi khat’in amudoh a, ima akhu khuma kipah tah a chea anei jouse joh a hiche lou chu kichoh jeng tobang ahi.
“Van a Lenggam chu sumkolvei min twikohchang manlu tah ahol tobnag ahi.
Twikohchang chu amudoh phat’in acheloiyin anei jouse ajoh-in twikohchang chu achotai.
“Van a LEnggam chu min Twikhanglen lai lunga len aseuva nga tin nga tang amat khomu tobang ahi.
Len chu nga adim phat’in akaidoh-un, atoupin nga pha jouse paipeh sunga akhol’un, manmo chengse apaitauve.
Vannoi khang kichai nikho jong chutobang ding, Vantilte kon’un tin midih lah a migiloute alhendoh diu,
meilhum deuje ju sunga alelut’uva, hikoma chu kap l ehagel gel’a um diu ahi.
Jesun, “Hicheng hi nahet chet tah-um?” atileh; Mihon, “Henge,” atiuve.
Hichun Jesun ajah-uvah, “Hijeh a chu Danthu them mi Van a Lenggam dia seijuiya pang chu akholna in a kona thil thah le alui hinpo doh doh jeng in neipa to bang ahi,” ati.
Thulem hijat asei jou phat’in chukom dalhan
Jesun akho ajonin, Houthua kikhopna in dunga thu ahil le leh, mihon kidang asauvin, “Hitobang chihna l ethaneina hi houya akilah ham?
Ama hi thingthem bolpa chapa hilou haimo? Anu min jong Mary kitia, asopite Jacob, Joseph, chule Simon l eJudas hilou ham?
Asopi numei ho jong ilah-uva cheng ahimeu? Hijat chihna le thaneina hi houya akilah hintem?” atiuvin,
asanda gam tauve. Hijeh chun Jesun ajah-uva, “Themgao chu akho sung le a-insung tilou mundanga vang akija bol tei nai,” ati.
Atah san loujeh-un hikoma chun Jesun thil kidang tampi abolpoi.
Hiche lai hin gambih vaipo Herod-in Jesu thudol kithang ajan,
alhachate jah a, “Hichepa hi athisa John Baptist chu thoukit hitei ding ahitai; hijeh a chu hitobang thil kidang ho hi abol thei ahi,” ati.
Herod hin anaopa Philip jinu Herodias thumop jal’a John chu songkul’a anakhum ahi.
Ajeh chu John hin Herod jah a, “Herodias nakichenpi hi Dan ngai ahipoi,” tia anaphosa ahi.
Herod-in John anatha nom vangin mipin John hi Themgaova agel jeh-un tha jeng ding akichai.
Herod pen nikhon Herodias chanu japi lah a ahung lamin, Herod alung lhaisah lheh-e.
Hijeh chun Herod-in, “Ipi hijongle nadeipen pen kapeh jeng ding nahi,” tin aki hahselin akiteptai.
Anu thumop dungjuiyin Herodias chanun, “Tutah-in John baptist luchang chu kongin hindomin neipen,” tin athumtai.
Lengpa alung kham lheh jeng nan, ankong phunga atoupi ho angsunga akitepna jeh chun John luchang apeh tei din anomtai.
Mi asol’in Songkul’a John luchang agatansah-in,
John luchang chu ahindop’uva nu-ngah chu agapeh-u leh, aman anu agapetai.
John seijuite hunguva John long chu agavuiyu ahi; chujouva hunguva Jesu ahung hetsah-u ahiye.
John kibolna thusim ajah phat’in Jesun chukom dalhan achangseh-in gamthip laiya din kongin akitol tai. Mipin achedoh ahet phat’in akhopi chenguva konin ahungun Jesu nung ajuitauve.
Jesu konga kona vaokama ahung potdoh leh mipi atoh paiyin, avet leh alainatpi lheh kengin, adamlou ho chu aboldamtai.
Nilhah phat’in aseijuite Jesu henga ahungun, “Hikom la gam thip lai ahin, nisa ma lhum pai ding ahitan, akho khoa acheuva neh ding agakichoh na diuvin mipi hi sol ngap tan,” atiuve.
Jesun ajah-uva, ‘Ache louvu akhoh poi, nang hon neh ding peuvin,” ati.
Seijuiten ajah a, “Changlhah pheng nga le nga ni seh bou kanei yui,” atiuve.
Jesun, “Changlhah le nga chu hinchoiyun,” atin;
chule japi chu hampa dum lah a tou din asol’e. Chuin changlhah pheng nga le nga ni chu alan, van lam ven Pathen athangvah-in, changlhah ho chu aheh bal bal’in seijuite apen seijuiten mipi ahoppeh tauve.
Japin anevaset cheh-un, anehval chengseu paipeh som le paipeh ni dimset alohdoh-ui.
Anea chu numei chapang sim louvin pasal sang nga jen ahiuve.
Jesun Mipi alhah doh phat’in aeijuite chu masaa gal lang khat kai masa din kong kha tsunga alut sah-in asoltai.
Mipi asoldoh nung in achangseh a mol chunga tao din akaltouve. Nilhah geiyin mol chunga Jesu achangseh-in aum’e.
Hiche don hin kong chu dil lailung ageitai. Huiyin ale lama anuh jehin twi kinongin kong chu aleh le jengin ahi.
Jingkah lam nidan thum le nidan gup kikah-in seijuite heng jonin dil’a twi chunga Jesun lam ahinjot’e.
Twichunga lam ahinjot chu seijuiten amudoh phat’un, “Lhadam ahi,” tin kichan a-aosot jengui.
Jesun ahin houpaiyin, “Lung linglao hih-un Kei kahibouve, kicha hih-un,” ati.
Peterin ahin houvin, “Pakai nang nahi nah leh twi chunga naheng kahinjotna din neiseipeh in,” ati.
Jesun, “Hungin,” atileh; Peter jong konga akumlhan, twi chunga achen Jesu heng ajontai.
Hinla huiyin twi anon amuphat’in akichan alha lut pantan, apeng jah jengin, “Pakai, neihuhhingin!” tin asam tai.

Keiman van a Lenggam kot-heh kapeh ding, leiset’a nakha chan van’a jong kikhah ding, leiset’a nahon chan van a jong kihong ding ahi,” ati.

napuiho thu geiya angai loule Houbung henga thulhut’in. Houbung thu geiya angai lou vang leh chidang namdang le kaidong ho bolna bangin bol tan.

Ajeh chu hoikom hileh kamin a ni le thum nakikhopna chan’uva ka-umpi jingui,” ati.

jesun, “Itobnag thilpha nei doh ham? Apha Khatseh bou aum’e! Tonsot’a nahin nom le Thupeh chengse nit’in,” ati.

hijeh chun Jesun aseijuite jah a seiyin, “Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, mihoa dia van a Lenggam alut hah sa lheh ding ahi.

hitia chu koi hijongle kamin jal ‘a in le lou, sopi ule nao, nu le pa, cha le nao chule gam leiset geiya dalha jousen ajat ja khat cheng amubea, tonsot hin na aneitei ding ahi.

“Van a Lenggam chu mihao khat jingpi tah a kondoh a alengpi leiya natong dia tha hol’a chepa tobang ahi.
Thahol pa chu natong ding ho to, nikhat tohman Denarii* khat din akinop touvin, alengpi leiya natong din asoltai.

‘Nang ho jong lengpi leiya kon’uvin natoh man diuva kilombep pe nang’e tin asol kit’e.
Amaho akontauve. Sunkim don le nilhangkai donin jong apotdoh kit leuvin hito bangma chun agabol kit’in ahi.
Vaiche kontah a jong apotdoh leh midang hitobanga ding ho agamudoh kit’in, amaho jah a jong, I-bol’a nilhum keiya hikoma mohjeh seh a ding nahiuvem?’ atileh;
amahon, ‘Koima eigoi diu um louva,’ atiuve. HIche ho jah a jong, ‘Nang ho jong lengpi leiya kon’uvin,’ ati.
“Nilhah phat’in lengpi lei nei pan natoh vaibolpa jah a, ‘Natong ho koukhomin, akon nukhah pen a pat akon masa pen geiyin atoh man’u petan,’ ati.
Vaiche phat’a kon ho ahungun Denarii khat cheh akisantauve.
Akon masa pen hon asan tam tei diu gingcha ahunguleh, amahon jong Denarii khat cheh akisan bouvui.
Akilah vangun mihaopa chunga aphun cheh-un,
“Keihon sun nilhum keiya na kitonga nisa hah lai kithoh lhum keiya, hiche nidan khat seh tongho toh kibangin tohman neipeuve,” tin aseiyui.
“Mihaopan adonbut’in alahuva mi khat jah a, ‘Golapa, ken adih lou kabolpoi, Denarii* khat bou lo dinga ikinopto lhon hilouham?
Natohman kilah-in chetan. Akon nukhah pen pa jong nang kapeh jat jat kapeh nom ahin,
kanei chu kadei dei ya kabol thei lou ding ham? Kaphat jeh a hi neimit thip ngap hitam?’ ati.
“Hitobanga chu amasa tamtah nukhah ding, anukhah tamtah masa ding ahi,” ati.
Jesun Jerusalem ajonin lampi dunga seijuite chu achomin apuidoh-in achepum pum’un ajah-uva,
“Veuvin, Jerusalema icheuvin, hikoma chu hihon Mihem Chapa hi Thempu pipu ho le Danthu them ho apeh doh diu, amahon tha ding pha asah-uva,
kichepna anei diu, ajep’uva thingpel’a khetbeh dia chi dang namdangt eapeh doh diu ahin, hijongle nithum nia ama kaithouva umtei ding ahi,” ati.
Zebedee chapate ni anun apuiyin Jesu henga aboh khup’in ngeh khat neiyin ataove.
Jesun, “Ipi nadeiyem?” tin adonge. Amannun, “Leng nahi tneg hiche kachapate ni najet naveiya tou sah idn teppeh-in,” ati.
Jesun, “Nathumu hi nahet louvu ahi. Nangin kadon ding khon a hi nadon ngam lhon idng hinam?” ati. Amanin, “Ka-ngam’e” ati lhon’e.
Jesun kakhon a hi nadon tei lhon ding vang ahinan, hijongle kajet kaveiya tousah ding vang hi Kei peh thei ahipoi; hiche touna hi ka-Pan gonsa akoipeh miho tou ding ahibouve,” ati.
Seijui somni hichu ajah doh phat’un ucha te ni chugna alung himotauve.
Ahivangin Jesun amaho akouvin, “Chidang namdangte lah a vaipoten amite chunga thu aneiyuva, alamkaiteuvin atha neinau ajedoh jing naheuve.
Nang ho lah avang chuti lou ding ahi, koi hileh nalah-uva alenpen hinom chu nalha chauva panga,
achungnung pen hinom chu nasohuva pang ding ahi.
Hitobanga chu Mihem Chapa jeng jong jen dinga hung ahipon, ajen ding le mitamtah lhatdamna a ahinkho toh doh dia hung ahibouve,” ati.
Jesu le aseijuiten Jericho khopi agah dalhah-u leh mi tamtah in ajuiye.
Mitcho ni lampama anatouvin, Jesun ahin hopa chu aja lhonin, “Vo David Chapa kapu, neilungset’in,” tin asam lhon’e.
Amani chu mipin pho thip din agouve. Amanin la ahasap cheh kit lhonin, “David Chapa neilungset’in!” ati kit lhon’e.
Jesu adingin amani chu agah kouvin, “Ipi eibolpeh-in nati lhon ham?” ati.
Amanin, “Kho neimusah lhonin kapu!” atilhone.
Jesun alainat pin, amit lhon akhoipeh leh, kho amu thei pai jeng lhonin, Jesu nung ajui lhontai.
Jesu le aseijuiten Jerusalem anai lam tauvin, Olive lhanga Bethphage kho ahung geitauve. Hichea hin Jesun seijui ni asol masan,
“Namasang khoa khun lut lhon le chun sa-ngan khat anouto kihen tha mupai lhonin nate; hinsut’in hinkai lhonin.
Mi khat touvin i-khat asei leh, ‘Aneipan angaichat ahi,’ ti lhon le chun, aman hinlhah peh lhontannate,” ati.
Hiche hi Themgao kama kiseisa:
“Zion khopi seipeh-un, Ven, na -Lengpan na hinjon’e! Lung nengtah-in sa-ngan chunga atouvin, Sa-ngan nou chunga atouve,” kiti chu guilhung ahitai.
Seijuite ni achen, Jesun ahil bang bangin agabol lhon’e.
Sangan le anou ahinkai lhonin, achunga pon aphauvin Jesu atouve.
Mitamtah-in lampi dunga pon aphauvin, abangin theoboh alham’un, lam dunga aphauve.
Jesu nung le maa kijot mipin, “Pakai min a hung pa anun nom’e! David Chapan huhing hen!” atiuve.
Jesu Jerusalem khopi sung alut phat’in, “Hiche Pa hi hoi, koi hitam!” atiuvin, khopi sung akiloh soh jengui.
Japin, “Galilee gam Nazareth khoa hung kon Themgao Jesu ahi,” atiuve.
Jesu Houin a alut’in, asunga thiljoh ho leh thil cho ho anodoh soh keiyin, sum lheng ho dokhang jouse alekhup peh-in, vapal joh ho touna jong alekhup peh soh keiye.
Chule miho jah a aseiyin, “Ka-in chu taona in kiti ding ahi, tia kisun ahin, nang hon michom ho gebuhin nasemtauve,” ati.
Jesu Houin a aumpet chun mitcho ho le elbai ho ahenga ahungun, Aman abonchan aboldam soh keiye.
Thempu pipu ho le Danthu them hon thil kidang aboldoh chengse chu amu’vin, chule Houin sunga chapang hon kho asap’uva, “David Chapan huhing hen” atiu chu ajah phat’un alung hangun,
Jesu jah a, “Hite ho hin ipi aseiyu najah nah em?” atiuve. Jesun, “Kaja nai, ‘Naosen ho le noi chep lai ho kamsunga konin vahchoina nachamkimsah tai,’ kiti Pathen lekhabu chu nasim khah louhel’u ham?” ati.
Jesun mipi adalhan, khopia konin apotdoh-in Bethany kho ajonin, aga jan geh tai.
Jingkah a Jesun khopi lam ahinjot leh agilkel pantai.
Hichun lampam a theichang phung khat amun, agavet leh ana tilou aga amupoi. Hijeh chun theichang phung jah a, “Imatih chanin ga kit hih beh-in,” tia agaosap leh, hichepet tah chun agop jenge.
Seijuiten amudoh phat’un kidang asa behseh jengun, “I-atileh theichang phung gop jeng hintem?” atiuve.
Jesun ajah-uva, “Dih tah a kaseipeh nahiuve, lung opkai louhel’a natahsanu leh theichang phung kibolna tobang keo hilouva hiche molsang jah a khun, ‘Kichon doh-in lang Twikhanglen a kileh lut tan,’ tijongleu chun hithei jeng ding ahi.
Hitia chu tahsan tah a nathum chan namu jeng diu ahi,” ati.
Jesu Houin a alut’a thu ahil pet’in Thempu pipu ho le upate ahungun, “Ipi tha neina a hiti ho hi nabol’a, hiche thuneina hi koipenin napeh ham?” tin adongui.
Jesun adonbut’in, “Kenjong thu khat dong ung ting naseidoh theiyu leh ipi tha neina kaneiye hiti ho hi kabol seipeh nau ivnge.
John baptize bolji pa hin bol theina van a kon alah ha mihem a kona alah ham?” ati. Chuphat’in amaho le amaho akinel’un, ‘Van a kon ahi,’ tileu hen la, ‘Achutile i-bol’a natahsan dau am?’ tin tin!
‘Mihem a kon ahi,’ ti ding la japi kichat aumin, ajeh chu mi jousen John chu Themgaova agel cheh ahi,” atiuve.
Hijeh chun Jesu jah a, “Kahepoi,” atitauve. Jesun ajah-uvah, “Kahepoi,” atitauve. Jesun ajah-uvah, “Kenjong ipi thaneina jeh a hiche ho kabol sei peh deh pou vinge.
“Iti nagel’um? Pasal khat’in chapa ni aneiyin, apeng masa pa jah a, ‘Chapa, tunin lengpi leiya konin lang na gatongin,’ ati.
Achapan, ‘Kon ponge,’ ati. Ahinla chom khat jouvin lung aheiyin akontai.
Mipa chu achapa khat joh henga achen hitobangma a chu agaseileh, ‘Kon nange hepa,’ atin, konla akonpoi.
Amani koi joh hin apa dei abol ham?” ati. Amahon, “Apeng masapan,” atiuve. Jesun ajah-uvah, “Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve. nang ho sangin kaidong ho le noti ho Pathen Lenggama alutmasajo tauve.
Ijeh-inem itile John chun adih a hinje lampi nahil’u ahitan, natahsan pouve; hichea hin kaidong ho le noti hon anatahsan’ui. Ama namutah vangun lungheiyin natahsan deh pouve.
“Thulem khat ngai kit’uvin: mihaotah khat’in lengpi lei khat abol’in, akimvel’a tho akaiyin, lengpiga chilna leiko alaiyin, loubuh asan, kemsang adoi. Chuin lengpilei chu aleibol ho ngansen kholgama achetai.
Theiga lo phat’in lengpiga po din aleibol ho ngansen kholgama achetai.
Lengpilei bol hon asoh te chu aman’un abang avouvin, abang athat’un chule abnag songin asep’ui.
Chuin asol masah sohte sanga tamjo asol kit vangin, amahon abol ngai bang bangin anabol’ui.
Akhon na keiyin, ‘Kachapa beh jabol teiyunte,’ tin lengpilei bol ho henga achapa asoltai.
Ahinla lengpilei bol hon achapa amudoh phat’un, ‘Hichepa hi agoulo dingpa ahi,’ that’u hitin agou eiho changute,’ akitiuvin,
aman’un lengpilei polama akaidoh-un athat tauve.
“Lengpilei neipa chu ahung teng aleibel ho chu i-lotan tem?” ati.
Amahon, “lengpilei neipan hiche migilou ho chu engbol’in tin asuhgam ding, lengpilei chu aphat cha aga pethei lengpilei bol thei dang khat petante,” atiuve.
Jesun ajah-uva,” Pathen lakhabua: ‘Insa hon deimoa apaiyu song chu. In-ning songkhom det penin apangtai! Hiche hi Pakai thilbol ahi, Imit mu’vin thil kidangtah ahi,’ kiti lai chu nasim khah louvu ham?
“Hijeh a chu kaseipeh nahiuve, Pathen Lenggam chu nakilah peh-uva apunbe sah thei nam mite kipedoh ding ahitai.
Koi hile hiche song chunga kitat kha chan chu kisep chip jeng ding ahin, alhah khah pen pen jong atagep jeng idng ahi,” ati.

Jesun mipi henga thulemin aseikit’in,
“Van a Lenggam chu achapa dinga jinei golvah bol ding goa lengpa khat tobang ahi.
Golvahna lha dia ki-ngeh chengse koukhom dia lengpan asohte asol vangin koima ahung pouve.
Soh dang phabep asol kit’in, ‘Akikou ho jah a, “Bongchal ho le gancha thaotah tah kathat’in golvah ankong akigong tupsoh tai, golvahnaa hung lha cheh-un,” ati gatiuvin,’ ati.
Ahinla akikouhon imachan agelpouve, abang louva akonin, abang ma kinchom choma achen,
adangin ma asohte chu aman’un, melse tah-in avouvin athat tauve.
Lengpa alung hang behseh tan, asepaite asol’in mithat ho asugamin, akhopiu ahalvamtai.
Hichun asohte jah, ‘Kichen golvah akigong soh tai, ane dia kikouho la ahungpon,
cheuvin lan gkhopi kelkot phunga namuphah chanu koi hileh golvah an ne din hinkhom’un, ati.
Sohte chu lamlen dunga acheuvin, amu phah chan, mise mipha ahinpuiyule kichen golvahna ami adimset tai.
″Lengpan akikou jin ho ahung vet leh moupui golvah vonbei khat amudoh-e.
Ajah a, ‘Jol, moupui golvah vonbeiya iti hung lut nahim?’ ati vangin, ama la athip beh jenge.

Asopite chu nina pa, thumna pa, aban bain sagina geiyin athisoh hel tauvin ahi.
Achaina keiyin numei nu jong athitai.
Hichea hin thokit nil eh numeinu hi koipen ji hitan tem? Ajeh chu aboncha jia anei cheh-u ahi,” atiuve.
Jesun adonbut’in, Pathen lekhabua thu hihen, Pathen thahat hijongle nahet pen’u aum loujeh a nakhel del’u ahitai.
Ijeh-inem itile thokitnaa chu nu le pa kichen jong umlou, chen jong akichensahlouvu ahitan, van a Vantilte tobang ahitauve.
Hiti hin mithi thokit thudol ahileh Pathenin naseipeh sau chu nasim khah louvu ham?
‘Keima Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen, chule Jacob Pathen kahi,’ atilou ham? Pathen chu mithi ho Pathen ahipon, miheng ho Pathen joh ahi,” ati.

Hiche hi thupeh lenpen leh amasapen ahin,
thupeh lenpen nina chu: ‘Nang naki-ngailutbanga naheng nakom na-ngailut ding,’ kiti ahi.
Thupeh hiche te nia hi Danthu pumpi le Themgaote thuhil ki-ngamsoh kei ahi,” ati.

David-in Ama chu ‘Pakai atileh, Messiah chu achilhah a iti pen thei ding ham?” ati.

“Danthu themho le Pharisee ho hi Mose Danthu hilchen a pang ahiuvin,
ipi hijongle naseipeh-u nit’un bol jong bol’un, amaho chon bangin vang chondauvin.
Amahon pohgih hahsa akan’un milengkouva aputsah-uvin, akhut jung jeng chan jong akhoiloh dong agoupouve.
Abol atoh chanu mi mitmu din bou abol’un ahi. Danthuchih bom akibuu le akibeh chengseu chu apeh aletsah-ui.
Golvahna le Houthua kikhopna in dunga touna pipen adeiyun,
kailhangdunga min salam abol’a, ‘Rabbi,’ ati diu bou adeiyui.
Nang hon vang mi, ‘Rabbi,’ kitisah hih-un, ajeh chu Houhil khat bou naneiyun, naboncha sopi cheh nahiuve.
Leiset chunga koima, ‘Pa,’ sah hih-un, van a na-Pau khat bou aum’e.
Miho, ‘Lamkai,’ kitisah dauvin, lamkai khatseh, Messiah chu nanei nauve.
Nalah –uva alenpen chu nalhachauva pang ding ahi.
Mi ama kichoi sang chu kisunem ding, ama kineosah chu kichoi sang ding ahi.
“Ohe, danthu them ho le Pharisee mipha lhem ho nadau ahi! Mipha lhem ho! Miho din van a Lenggam kot nakhah tan’un, nang ho la nalut thei deh pouvin, lut dia kigo ho geiyin nalutsah pouve!
(Ohe Danthu them ho le Pharisee mipha lhem ho nadau ahi! Meithai ho in dunga sottah tah nataovun nabahgam jiuve. Hijeh a chu genthei hesoh chungnung nathoh diu ahi.)
“Ohe, Danthu them ho le Pharisee mipha lhem ho nadau ahi! Mi khatseh jong Juda hou housah din Twikhanglen jousea nakitol’un, gamkai jouose nachonsoh-un, nahousah tengule nangho sanga ajat nijen khoh jon Damun jon din nasemdoh jiuve.
“Ohe nadau ahi, ‘Koi hile Houin pan a kihahsel chu ajeh pon, Houin a kikoi sana pan a kihahsel vang ajeh theiye,’ tia mihil lamkai mitcho ho!
Mitcho mi-ngol ho! Houin jeh a sana athenga kisimpi chu hoijoh thupi jom sana ham Houin ham?
Chuma leh, ‘Maicham pan a kihahsel vangin akijeh pon, maicham chunga kitoh thil-ho pat jeh-in je na aum theiye,’ na tiuve.
Mitcho ho! Maicham jeh a a thilto thenga kisimpi chu hoijoh thupijom-maicham ham thilto ham?
Ajeh chu maicham pan a kihahsel chanin maicham chunga kitoh thil geiya apat tha a kihalsel ahitai.

Adang nabol’u chutoh kilhon a hicheng jong hi nabol diu ahi.
Lamkai mitcho ho! Nang hon thou vaisi nalhiuvin, sa-ngongsao napum val’ui.

Pharisee mitcho ho! Khon chu asung silngim leu chun apolam jong ngim ding ahi!
“Ohe, Danthu them ho le Pharisee mipha lhem ho nadau ahi! Nang ho hi lhan kiloi bang, polam vet dia hoi, asung la mithigu le aboh anen ijakai dimset tobang nahiuve.

Hitobang hin Themgaote that’a pang ho chihlhah nahi nau nang hon naphongdoh tauve.
Napu napateu toh ban chu tong molso ngal’un!
Vo gulse son, gulsete! Damun a talen namat diu chu iti otdoh theiying natiu ham?
Veuvin Themgaote le miching ho chule Danthu them ho kahinsol peh-e, abang nathauva, abang thingpel’a nakhet beh diu, abangma Houthua kikhopna in dunga najep’uva, khotin a nadel le diu ahi.

Hijeh a chu na-in kamdel’a kidalhah peh ding nahi!
Kaseipeh nahiuve, tua pat, ‘Pakai min a Hungpa anun nom’e,’ nati masangseuva neimukit lou diu ahitai,” ati.

Jesun ajah-uva, “Ahinai, aloupije hi vesoh keiyun, amavang kaseipeh nahiuve, song khat chunga khat kisethom hung umlou hel ding, kipehsoh kei ding ahi,” ati.
Olive molchinga Jesu atoupeh’in guh thim chan aseijute ahungun, “Hitobang thilse ho chu ith hung lhunga, nahung kit ding phat leh lseiset kichai ding chu ipia kimel chih ding ham?” tin adongui.

Mihem tamtah kamin a hunguva, Keima Messiah kahi,’ atiuva mitampi alhep lhah diu ahi.
Gal kisat husa le gal kisat thukithang najah tdiu, hi jongle kicha hih-un; hitobang ho hi soh tei ding, amavang achaina hilou lai ding ahi.
Gam khat le gam khat kidouva, lenggam khat le lenggam chom khat kisat ding, muntin a kel lhantin, ling kihot ding ahi.
Hicheng hi naoso nat bang da kipatna ahi nalaiye.
Min namat’uva midang ho khut’a napeh diu, talen namatsah uva natha diu ahi. Keima jal’a namtinin nahotlo diu ahi.
Chutah le mi tampi tahsan a pull ha a, khat le khat kipedoh toa kihoto diu;
Themgao lhem tampi sohdoh-in tin, mi tamtah alhep lhah diu ahi.
Chon chatvaina pung cheh cheh-in tin, mi tamtah ngailutna dailha diu ahi.
Hinla akhon ni geiya thoh lhumkeiya chu huhhinga umtei ding ahinai.
Chule hiche Lenggam Kipana Thupha hi vannoi pumpia kiseiphonga kihettohsah ding, chu jou tengleh kichai ding ahibouve.
“Hichejeh chun mi sumang thet umtah, Daniel Themgao kama kiseisa chu muntheng phunga adin namu tenguleh! (asim sim an he hen)
‘Judea gama um chengse molsang sanga jam’u hen.
Inting vuma um jong insunga thilkeo kilah din kumlhah da hen.
Loukon jong ponsil kilah din kile da hen.
Ohe, chulai ta a numei agaiya le nao noi chepsah nalai ho chu ada na-e!
Najam cheh nau phat chu phalpi lai le Choldo nikho ahilouna din taovun!
Chutengle hesoh genthei chungnung hung um ding, hitobang hi vannoi kisemtil’a pat tulai geiya soh kha louhel lai ahin, hung jong hungsoh kit lou ding ahi.
Hiche niho chu Pathenin asuhchom lou hileh tahsa mihing khat cha jong soh cha lou ding ahi, hijeh a chu lhenchomte jal’a hiche nikho hi kisuchom ding ahi.
“Hichepet hileh min najahuva, ‘Ven, hiche hi Messiah ahi,’ ati ham, ahiloule ‘Hiche hi Ama ahi,’ ati ham hijongle tahsan hihuvin.
Ajeh chu Messiah lhem le Themgao lhem tampi hung kisem doh-un tin, ahithei le bon thenchomte geiya pui mangna dia melchihna le thil kidang nasa tah tah ahinbol diu ahi.
Veuvin, ahung lhun masanga kahil masah dem nahiuve.
“Ahilouva, ‘Veuvin, Messiah gamthip laiya aum’e,’ atiu jongle chedoh a vet din gel dauvin; ‘Veuvin indan sung nunga aum’e’ tijongleu tahsan hih-un.
Ajeh chu kolphe nisolama ahung phet leh nilhom lam geiya asalvah banga Mihem Chapa hung kit ding chuti ding ahi.
“Hoikom hileh thilong phunga muthong kikhom tei ding ahi.
“Thoh genthei hesoh nikho kichaisohtengleh nisa thim a, lha jong vah talou ding, vanlaijol’a kona ahsite pul lhan tin, van a thaneina jouse kihot lingsoh ding ahi.
Chutah le vanlaijol’a Mihem Chapa melchihna hung kilang ding ahin vannoi leiset phungtin a min dip le lai kidoh’uva, van meilhang lah a Mihem Chapa thanei tah le loupe tah a hung amu dingu ahi.
Mihem Chapa sumkon gin nasatah ho thoa Avantilte’asol ding, lhenchomte chengse van mong lang khat’a pat among lang khat geiya, kolkimvel ning lia akhop khom diu ahi.
“Theichang phung hin thulem kihil’un. Ajih adot’a ana anou teng nipi naidol naheuve.
Hihe chun hichengse hi namu tengu leh naiya hung ding koncha ahi heuvin.
Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, thil hicheng hi aguilhun masangsea hiche khang hi kichai lou ding ahi.
Van le leiset mang ding ahin, kathusei ho vang mang lou ding ahi.
“Hiche Nikho hi Pa tilou van a Vantilte le Chapan jong chule koimachan ahepoi.
Mihem Chapa hungkit hi Noah nikho lai thilsoh banga hungsoh ding ahi.
Noah nikho lai twisang let masang, Noah kong alut ni geiyin, mihon aneuvin adon’un, akichengun, chen jong akichensah-ui;
twisang lenin achup mang kahseuvin, kho helouvin aum’uve. Mihem Chapa hungkit jong chute ding ahi.
Chuteng mi ni louva umkhom jong khat kila khat kida lha ding,
numei ni sumhei khat’a chang goikhom te ni jong khat kila khat kida lha ding ahi.
Hijeh chun na-Pakaiyu hung ding nikho nahet loujeh-un kiging phauvin.
Gucha itih a hung ding inneipan heleh kiging jinga um ding, a-in aphet vangsah lou ding naheuve.
Hichejeh chun kiging jingin um’un, nakigin loupet tah-uva Mihem Chapa hung ding ahi.
“Soh tahsan um le chingtah, a-insung mite aphat cha neh le choh hoppeh dia, insung vaipoa apun anganse chu koi ham?
Apu hung teng hitobanga anatoh atokhah soh chu anun nom’e!
Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, ama chu apun anei jouse chunga vaipoa akoi ding ahi.
Soh gilou chun alung gel’in, ‘Kapu hungvah ponte,’ tin
asoh chanpi chengse deng panta hen, anop nop nehen don taleh,
hiche sohpa chun agel lou nikho le ahet loupet tah a apu hung ding,
asohpa chu tum ni asoa, mipha lhem ho talen amatsah ding, hikoma chu kap le hagel gel’a um ding ahi
“Hiche phat hileh van a Lenggam chu athaomeiyu kichoi cheh a ji nei dingpa lamto goah nu-ngah som tobang ding ahi.
Nu-ngah nga chu lungthimbei ahiuvin, nga chu lungthim pha ahiuve.
Lungthimbei hon thaomei aken vangun thaotwi akeng pouve;
lungthim pha hon vang athaomeiyuva det kham thaotwiya akenthauve.
Ji nei dingpa ahung geibehseh phat’in nu-ngah ho alu lhu’uvin, a-ihmusoh tauve.
“Jan khangkim laiyin ji nei dingpa ahungtai! Hungun galam touvin” akiti.
Chutah-in nu-ngah ho athouvun thaomei akigot tauve.
Hichun lungthimbei hon lungthim pha ho jah a, ‘Kathaomeiyu thaotwi aumtapoi, thaotwi them khat beh neipeuvin,’ tin athum tauve.
Ahinla lungthim pha hon adonbut’un, ‘Igom’uva din lhing ponte, chusangin cheuvin lang ajoh ho koma gakichoh vah tauvin,’ atiuve.
Lungthimbei ho thaotwi choa ache lan’un ji nei dingpa ahung paiyin, kigingsa um chengsen kichen golvahna mun’ah akijot lut piuvin, kot kikhah tai.
“Chom khat jouvin lungthim bei nu-ngah ho ahungun, ‘Kapu, kapu, kot neihon’un!’ tin asamtauve.
Ji nei dingpan, ‘Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, nang ho kahe khapoi,’ ati tai.
“Anikho le anidan tah nahet loujeh-un kigingun.
“Hiche phat hileh van a Lenggam chu khol gamla tah chedoh goa, asohte koukhoma, anei jouse asohte ngansepa thusim tobang ding ahi.
Soh khat chu talent nga apen, khat talent ni apen, khatma chu talent khat apen, athan ajokhop cheh-in ahoppeh-in khol’a achetai.
Talent nga sangpa akipat’a kiveina aneileh talent nga ma aveikan bei.
Talent ni sangpa akipat’a kiveina aneileh talent ni ma aveikan bei.
Talent khat sangpan vang lei alaiyin apupa sum chu asel tai.
“Phat sotpi nungin hiche soh ho pupa hi ahung kile kit tan, asohte toh som asutouve.
Talent nga sangpan talent nga ma ahinchoi ben, ‘Kapu, talent nga neipen, talent nga ma kavei kan bei,’ tin apetai.
Apun, ‘Tahsan umtah soh pha, nabol pha lheh jenge! Thil themcha chunga kitah nahin, tampi chunga vai kahomsah ding nahi. Hungin napu kipana a hung kipah-in,’ ati.
Talent ni sangpan, ‘Kapu, talent ni neipen, talent ni ma kaveikan bei,’ tin apetai.
Apun, ‘Tahsan um soh pha, nabol pha lheh jeng! Nang jong thil themcha chunga kitah nahin, tampi chunga vai kahomsah ding nahi. Hungin napu kipana a hung kipah-in,’ ati.
Talent khat sangpa jong ahungin, ‘Kapu, mi kikhel nahikahen, natuna louva at theiya, nathe na louva jong chomkhom thei nahin,
nang kagin jeh-in kachen natalent chu lei noiya kaseltai. Hiche hi nasum ma ma nakilah kit ahi,’ tin apetai.
Apun jong, ‘Vo soh gilou le thase! Katuna louva ka-atjia kathe na louva kachomkham ji nahet ahiye ong!
Kasum chu sumkolvei ho koma apung dia nanakoi leh itim? Chutileh kahung phat’a kasumpi le akan kilah that a ding!
Hichepa talent chu lahpeh-un lang taleng som neipa chu petauvin,
ijeh-inem itile aneiya kipehbea anei letset ding, anei lou vang aneisun jong kilahpeh ding ahi.
Chule hiche soh phachomlou hi polam muthim lah a gapai mangun, hikoma chu kap le hagel gel’a um ding ahi,’ ati.
“Mihem Chapa aloupinaa Vantilte toh ahung teng leh alaltouna loupe tah a tou ding,
namtin vaipi a-angasunga kikhom kimsoh keiya, kelngaoi chingpan keltah lah a kelngoi chengse alhendoh bang, Ama jong miho alhen khen a, achom khen ding,
kelngoi chengse ajet lama akhindoh a, keltah chengse aveilama akhindoh ding ahi.
Chutha le lengpan ajet lama umte jah a, ‘Hungun ka-Pa phatthei boh change, vannoi kisemtil’a pat nang ho dia gonsa kikoi Lenggam chu hung lo’uvin,
ajeh chu kakel pet’in neh ding neipeuvin, kadangchah pet’in don ding neipeuve; Kakholjin naa nei lhunsah-un,
ponbeiya ka-umin jong pon neisilpeh-ui. Kadammon nei hung veuvin, songkul kalut’in jong neihung vil’ui,’ ati ding ahi.
“Chuteng midih hon, ‘Pakai, itih a nakel pet toh khan eh ding kapeh-uva, chule nadangchah toh kha don ding kapeh khah-uvam?
Hoikom nakholjin na kalhunsah khah-uva, itih a ponbeiya naum kamu’va pon kasilpeh khah-u ham?
Itih nadammo veiset pet’a kahung vet’uva, itih a nasongkul lutpet kahung vil’uvam?’ ati diu ahi.
Lungpen adonbut’a, ‘Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, hiche kasopite lah a aneopen khat nabol nau chu kei neibol nau ahi,’ tinte.
“Chuteng aveilama umho jah a, ‘Gaosap chang ho, kakoma konin potdoh’un lang Satan le avantilte dia gonsa kikoi tonsot mitmo meilhum sunga lut tauvin,
ijeh-inem itile kakelpet’in neh ding neipepouvin, kadangchah-in don ding neipepouvin,
kakholjin na a neilhunsah dauvin, ponbeiya ka-um jong pon neisilpeh pouve; kadammo la neihung ve pouvin, songkul kalut’in la neivil pouve,’ ati ding ahi.
“Chutah le amahon donbut’un tin, ‘Pakai, itih a keihon nagilkel, nadangchah, nakholjin, ponbeiya naum, nadammo chule songkul’a na-um kamu’va don louva kakoi khah-um?’ tin sei yunte.
Lengpan ajah-uva, itobang ijase loupen hijongle hiche ho lah a khat nabol lou nau chu Keima neibol louvu ahi,’ ati ding ahi.
Chuteng amaho hi tantih neilou talen man dia cheuva, midih ho vang tonsot hin naalut diu ahi,” ati.
Hicheng hi ahilchaisoh phat’in Jesun aseijuite jah a,
“Nahet banguva ni ni jou teng Kalchuh kut hi ding, Mihem Chapa hi thingpel a khetbeh dia min apehdoh ding ahitai,” ati.
Hichepet hin Thempu pipu ho le upate Thempulen Caiaphas inpia akikhom’un,
Jesu chu doha bol’a mat ding, chule tha theina ding akihou somtauve.
Ahivangin, “Kut lai hida le phante, ajo le japi lah a boina um khante,” atiuve.
Jesu chu Bethany khoa Simon mipha pa ina aum pet’in,
numei khat’in songval hai khat’ah thao namtui manlu tah ahinchoiyin, Jesun ankong aum pet’in aluchanga asun khum’e.
Athilbol hi seijuiten amu phat’un alung hanguvin, “I-bol’a thao namtui hi amoh suh mang ham?
Sum tampi man a joh a vaicha gentheite peh khamset hi la ahin,” atiuve.
Jesun akihou nau ahen ajahuvah, “Idia numei nu chu nasuh lung gim’u ham? Aman thilpha tah eibolpeh ahi,
ajeh chu mivaicha gentheite chu nakom’uva um jing ding ahin, Keivang nakomu’va um jing ding kahi poi.
Aman thao namtui eisun khum hi vui ding lima eisem ahitai.
Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, hoikom hijongle vannoiya hiche Kipana Thupha kiseiphongna chan a athilbol jong hi amanu het jingna dia kiseitha jing ding ahi,” ati.
Seijui som le nil ah a khat Judas Iscariot kitipa chu Thempu pipu ho henga achen,
“Jesu khu matsah leu veng ipi neipe nom’un natem,” atileh, amahon, dangka somthum apeuve.
Hichea pat hin Judas-in Jesu matsahna thei phat kitup kom ave-lhi jingtai.
Cholsolou changlhah kut ni masa nin seijuite Jesu henga ahungun, “Kalchuh kut an nanehna ding hoikom gago leu veng nadeivem?” tin adongui.
Jesun, “Khopi sunga lut’uvin pasal khatpen jah a, “Houhil’in Keidia phat kiteppeh ahung naitai, kaseijuite toh na-in a kalchuh kut an kaneh diu ahi,’ tin aseiye gatiuvin,” ati.
Jesun ahil bangun seijuiten abol’un kalchuh kut an chu agagong tauve.
Nilhah phat’in Jesun seijui som le nit oh ankong aumtai.
Aan neh laitah-un aman, “Tahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, nalah-uva khat’in mi eimatsah ding ahi,” ati.
Seijuite alung dong lheh jengun, khat khat’in, “Keivang kahilou ahina ong Pakai?” atiuve.
Jesun adonbut’in, “Lheng sunga changlhah kadekotpi pa tah hin eimatsah ding ahi, .
Mihem Chapa aumchan ding Pathen lekhabua kisun banga soh tei ding ahin, hinla Mihem Chapa matsahna dia manchah a pangpa chu ohe adana-e! Ama chu apen a peng lou hileh ama dia phajo ta dinga!” ati.
Jesu pehdoh a matsah dingpa Judas chun adonbut’in, “Kei neisei ahipoi ong Houhil?” ati. Jesun adonbut’in, “Chutia nasei ahi,” ati.
An neh laitah-in Jesun changlhah alan, phatthei aboh jouvin aheh bal bal’in seijuite apen, “Kilah-un neuvin, hiche hi katahsa ahi,” ati.
Chuin khon chu alan, athangvah jouvin seijuite apen, “Nabonchan donsoh keiyun;
hiche hi chonset ngaidamna dia mi tamtah dinga kilhoh lha kathisan ahi.
Kaseipeh nahiuve, ka-Pa Lenggama nang ho to athah a kadon khom nikho hung lhun kit kahsea lengpiga twi hi kadon kit lou ding ahitai,” ati.
Chuin la khat asauvin Olive mol jonin achetauve.
Jesun aseijuite jah-a, “Tujan teng kachunga nakisuhmo soh hel diu ahi, ajeh chu, ‘Kelngoi chingpa kavoh lhuh teng kelngoite cheh soh diu ahi,’ tin Pathen lekhabua akisun’e.
Hijongle hinga eikikaithou teng Galilee gama nang ho sangin masajo tange,” ati.
Peterin Jesu jah a, “Midangin nadalhah soh hel jongle kenvang dalha hih hel inge,” ati.
Jesun Peter jah a, “Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi, tujan ah khon masanga thumvei neiseilep ding ahi,” ati.
Peterin ajah a, “Nangto thitha ding hi jong leng naseilep hih hel inge,” ati. Seijui dangsen jong chutin asei cheh-ui.
Jesu le seijuite chu Gathsemani kiti laiya acheuvin, Jesun ajah-uvah, “Khu koma kachea kaga tao sungsen hikoma hin anatou jingun,” ati.
Jesun Peter le Zebedee chapa te ni akipuiyin, chuin lung gim hesoh nasa tah-in ahinphan,
ajah-uva, “Thina khop hel’in kalung hesoh behseh tai, hikoma hin um’un neikiginpi jngun,” ati.
Chuin themkhat ache chonin, tol’a mai asulut’in, “Hepa! Ahithei leh hiche khon hi Keiya konin tolmangin, hinla Kei dei hilouvin Nang lungdei joh hihen,” tin ataove.
Chujouvin seijui thum henga ahung leh ana-ihmut’u atoh khan, Peter jah a, “Iti nidan khat jeng jong neikiginpi jou louvu ham?
Lhepna nalhah louna din kigingin tao jingun, lhagaovin ago nan tahsa lahasam behseh jenge!” ati.
Anivei nan Jesu ache kit’in, “Hepa! Hiche khon hi kadon lousea kitol mang thei lou ahileh Nangma lung got got hita hen!” tin ataove.
Ahung kile kit leh, seijuite ihmutsoh behseh a ihmut mildel ahungtoh-e.
Seijuite dalhan athumvei chan nan agataovin, asei ngai ngai agaseiyin ahi.
Chuin aseijuite henga ahungin, “Ihmua kicholdo nalai nahiuvem? Veuvin phat alhingtan, Mihem Chapa hi mi chonsete khut’a apehdoh diu ahitai.
Kipat’un chetaute. Veuvin! Eipedoh pan kakom ahin phatai!” ati.
Jesun thu asei nalaiyin, seijui som le nil ah a Judas chu Thempu pipu ho le, Thempulen ho le upate hinsol, chemjam le moltum thoa hung kon, mipi toh lhonin ahung lhungtai.
Jesu pedoh a pangpan miho chu melchihna ahilmasah a, “Kachop pen pen chu Ama ahi, man jengun!” ati ahi.
Judas chun Jesu ajon jangkeiyin, “Chibai, Houhil!” tin achoptai.
Jesun ajah a, “Golpa, nahung lo na bol jengin,” ati. Chutah chun mipin ahindelvuhun Jesu man’un akantauve.
Jesu to umkhom ho khat’in chem.jam asatdoh-in Thempu pipu soh pa asat jengleh, abilkol lang khat asat lhai.
Jesun, “Nachemjam chu apaiya khum jengin, chemjam pan jouse chemjama lou ding ahi.
Tutah jenga jong ka-Pan Vantilte sang som sagi le sang ni val jen eihinsolpeh dia kathummo a nabol ham?
Chutin kibol leh Pathen thu hitobanga thilsoh dia asei chu iti guilhun thei ding ham?” ati.
Hichea hin Jesun mipi jah a, “Gucha michom man ding banga, chemjam le moltum thoa Kei man dia hungkon nahiuvam?” ati. Niseh-in Houin a katouvin mi kahil jin la nei man pouvin,” ati.
Hoi hileh Pathen lekhabua Themgaote sutsa jouse guilhunna dinga hicheng hi soh ahi,” ati. Chutah chun seijuiten adalhauvin ajam mang tauve.
Jesu man hon Jesu chu Thempu chungnung Caiaphas in a akaiyu leh, hikoma chun Danthu them ho le upate anakikhom’ui.
Peterin Jesu chu galkangin ahinjuipeh-in, Thenpu chungnung inpi leitol geiyin ahunge; hichea hin, “Achaina munge,” tin alut’in lhacha ho lah a atouve.
Thempu len chengse le HOu vaipoloi chengsen Jesu tha theina din adou nan jouthu jeng hettohsah ahol’un,
mitampin jou thua hettohsah abol vangun athina thei lom khat cha aseidoh pouve. Akhon nan mi nin,
“Hiche Pa hin, ‘Pathen Houin kaphet lhah a nithum sunga kasahdoh thei ahi,’ tin aseiye,” atilhone.
Thempu Chungnung akipat doh paiyin, “Nahehset na cheng seu hi nadonbut lou ding ham?” tin Jesun adonge.
Jesu la athip beh jeng. Hichun Thempu chung nungin ajah a, “Hing jing Pathen min a kahahsel’a kasol nahi, Pathen Chapa Messiah chu nahi nahilou ham-seiyin?” tin anoi.
Jesun adonbut’in, “Chutia nasei ahi! Hinla kaseipeh nahi, tua pat Mihem Chapa hi Thaneipen jet’a touva, vanlaijol, meilom lah a hung namu diu ahi, : ati.
Chutah chun Thempu chungnungin aponsil akibo-eh paiyin, “Pathen ataitomtai. Hettohsah dang angai tapoi! Tutaha Pathen ataitom najah cheh tah-u chu me!
Iti nagel’um?” ati. Mihon, “Athemmoi, thi tei tei ding ahi,” atiuve.
Chutah chun mihon Jesu maiya chil asetkhum’un, achum’un, gaovin lang seitemin, koiham na denga chu?” tin ahouseuve.
“Messiah, gaovin lang seitemin, koiham nadenga chu?” tin ahouseuve.
Peter chu polam leitol’a atouve. Soh nu-ngah khat ahungin, “Nang jong Galilee mi Jesu to kiloi nahibouve,” ati.
Hinla Peterin japi angsunga aseilep’in, “Ipi nasei ham kahepoi,” ati.
Kelkot polam a agapotdoh leh, soh nu-ngah khatman amudoh kit’in chukoma um ho ja a chun, “Hichepa jong hi Nazareth Jesu toh kivohsa ahi,” ati.
Peterin kihahsel to thon aseilep kit’in, “Hichepa khu kahe khapoi,” ati kit’e.
Chom khat jouvin chu koma ding miho ahungun Peter jah a, mong nahibouve, napao dan hin nakiphong doh tai,” atiuve.
Hiche phat vang hin Peter jong kigaosap le kihahsel thon, “Hiche pa him him kahe kha hih hel’e!” tia aseilep pet tah-in ah ahung khongtai.
Hichun, “Ah khon masanga thumvei neiseilep ding ahi,” tia Jesun asei chu Peterin ageldoh tan, polama apotdoh loiyin lhase tah-in akaptai.
Jingpi tah-in Thempulen ho le upate Jesu than a thei ding akihousom tauve.
Jesu chu thihkhaovin akan’un, akaiyun Rome gam vaipo Pilate apedoh tauve.
Jesu matsah a pang Judas chun, Jesu tha dia thu kitan ahetdoh phat’in akisih behseh jengin, dangka somthum chu Thempu len ho le upaho alepeh kit’in,
“Themmonabei tha dinga kapehdoh chu kathemmotai!” ati. Amahon la, “Keiho i-kin hiya ong? Nangin kivet tange,” atiuve.
Judas-in sum chu Houin sunga aseplhan, apotdoh paiyin agakikhai lihtai.
Thempulen hon dangka chujat chu alauvin, “Hiche sum hi thisan man ahin, Houin sung sumkholnaa koi ngai ahipoi,” atiuve.
Akihoutoh phat’un gamdang miho lhan mol din, beldengpa lou mun achoh natauve.
Hijeh a chu tuni geiya hiche mu khu, “Thisan mun,” kiti ahi.
Hichea hin Jeremiah Themgao seisa, “Israel miten man tuh a atepsau dangka somthum chu mihon alauvin,
Pakaiyin eithupeh bangin beldingpa loumun choh nan anei tauve,” kiti chu aguilhunge.
Jesu chu Rome gamvai popa angsunga adinsah tauvin, gamvaipon ajah a, “Judate lengpa nahim?” tin adonge. Jesun, “Chutia nasei ahi,” ati.
Thempulen ho le upaten ahehsetna thudol’a vang imacha adonbut poi.
Pilate’in Jesu jah a, “Mihon hijat’a nahehset nau hi najah lou ham?” ati.
Jesun thu cheng khat cha jong adonbut lou phat’in gamvaipopan kidang asa lheh jenge.
Kalchuh kut sunga hi sohchang koi hileh japi dei pen pen khat Gamvaipon alhadoh peh ji ahi.
Hichepet hin sohchang minse tah Jesu Barabbas-khat akihen’e.
Mipi hung kikhop phat’in Pilate’n ajah uvah, “Jesu Barabbas kalhadoh peh diu ha, Messiah kiti Jesu joh kalhahdoh peh diu ham?” tin adonge.
Ijeh-inem itile Juda lamkaiten thangset suma Jesu apehdohu chu ahet ahi.
Thutanna muna Pilate atoupet man ajinun thu ahin thot’in, “Themmona bei hichepa chu limsah hih-in, ama jeh hin tunin kamangin kathoh gim lheh jenge,” ati.
Ahin Thempulen ho le upa ten Jesu asuhmanga Barabbas joh alha na din mipi atilseuvin, angeh sah tauve.
Gamvaipopan mipi adongin, “Hite ni kah a hoijoh kalhadoh peh ding nadeiyum?” ati. Mipin, “Barabbas!” atiuve.
Pilate’n, “Ahile Messiah kiti Jesu hi iba kalo ding hitam?” ati. Mipin, “Thingpel’a khenbehtan!” tin asamtauve.
Pilate’n, “Ipi suhset aneiyam?” tin adonge. Miho la a-olheh lheh-in apengun, “Thingpel’a khenbeh-in!” tin asam’ui.
Athilbol phat chomlou, boina asohjoh amu phat’in Pilate’in twi alan mipi angsunga khut asil’in, “Hichepa thina chung change mona po ponge, nang hon kivet tauvin,” ati.
Mipin adonbut’un, “Hichepa thisan phu chu keiho le katu kachateu chunga chu nante,” atiuve.
Pilate’n Barabbas alhadoh peh in, Jesu vang chu ajep’in thingpel’a khetbeh din apedoh tai.
Gamvaipopa sepaiten Jesu chu gamvaipo inpi sunga apui lut’un, sepia hon lhingset’in akikhomui.
Jesu ponsil ahoh lhauvin, pon sandup asilpeh-un,
ling lukhuh apheh-un akhuh peh-uvin, akhut jet lama peng tenggol khat achoisah-un, tot nan aangsunga aboh khup’un, “Judate lengpa hingsot’in!” atiu ve.
Chil set khumun, atneggol’in aluchang ajep’un
tot nopna anei jou phat’un asilpeh-u ponsan chu ahoh lhauvin, ama pon asilpeh-un, thingpel’a khetbeh din apui mang tauve.
Akijotdoh-u leh sepia hon, Cyrene gam mi Simon atoh khauvin, Jesu thingpel put hu did nada acham louvin aman’ui.
Golgotha, “lugu mun,” kiti lai ahung ge phat’un,
adon din cheikha toh kihal lengpitwi chu Jesu apeh-u leh, aman la atep’in adon nompoi.
Sepaihon Jesu chu thingpel’a akhenbeh-un, vang asan’un apon sil chengse akihomtauve.
Hikoma chun atouvun Jesu chu angah-ui.
Jesu luvuma ahehsetna, “Hichepa hi Jesu Judate lengpa ahi,” tia kisun chu atah-uve.
Gucha michom ni jong Jesu jet le veiya akhetbeh thauve.
Ache le avah le jouse Jesu chu ataitom nan akhasuh khum khum’ui.
“Houin phelha a nithum sunga sadoh ding Pa! Pathen Chapa nahileh Nangma kihuhhingin lang, thingpel’a konin hung kumlhan! Atiuve.
hitobangma chun Thempulen ho le Danthu them ho chule upaten jong a-eng houvun,
“Midang bon huhhinga, ama akihuhhing theipoi! Israel leng ahi-ong! Tutah-in thingpel’a konin hung kumlha hen tahsan unge!
Pathen a kisong ahi me, Pathen lungdei ahileh tutah-in huhdoh hen; ajeh chu, ‘Pathen chapa kahi,’ ati me,” atiuve.
Akikhetbeh pi gucha michom te geiyin jong chutobangma chun ahouse lhon’e.
Nidan gup a pat nidan ko geiyin leiset pumpi chunga mu athimtai.
Nidan ko donin Jesu hapenin apengin, “Eli, Eli, lemasabachthni?” ati. Hichu “Ka-Pathen, i-bol’a neilha hitam?” tina ahi.
Chukoma ding mi phabeh’in apen gin ajauvin, “Hei, Elijah akouve,” atiuve.
Alah-uva mi khat alhaijel’in, twichop phon khat alan, lengpitwithuh adekot’in, tenggol leh a atah-in Jesu chu donsah ding agoi.
Midang hon, “Limsah hih-un, ahuhhing dia Elijah hung nam, veu hite,” atiuve.
Jesu hapenin apengin ahaitan paitan.
Chutah chun Houin pondal chu achunga pat anoi geiyin keh ni akison, ling akihot’in, songpi jouse apoh keh gamtai;
hijeh chun lhankot tampi akihongtan, mitheng thisa ho kaithouvin aum’ui.
Amahon lhan adalhauvin, Jesu thodoh nungin khopi thenga alut’un, mi tamtah henga akilah-ui.
Sepai jalamkai pa le aumpi sepia, Jesu ngah a pang hon, ling kihot le thilsoh chengse amu’vin, akicha behseh jengun, “hiche Pa hi Pathen Chapa tahbeh ahi,” atitauve.
Galilee gama pat Jesu nung hinjui, ajen lea pang numei ho chun galkanga konin Jesu ave-lhi jingui.
Alah-uva hin Magdalene khoa Mary toh, Jacob le Joseph nu Mary chule Zebedee chapate ni nu jong apanguve.
Nilhah phat’in, jesu seijuisa, Arimathea khoa amin Joseph kiti mihao tah khat ahungin,
Pilate henga achen Jesu long chu agathumtai. Pilate’n Jesu long chu Joseph din aphalpeh tai.
Joseph-in Jesu long chu adom lhan, tupat pon ngimseh-in atomin,
songpi akhet homa akisemsa, ama lhan thah beh sunga chun alupsah-in, lhankot’ah song lentah khat atnag lut’in asing chah-in achetai.
Magadalene khoa Mary le Mary khat joh chu hikoma chun lhan lam ngan atou lhone.
Ajing nikho, kigot ni kichai jouvin thempulen ho le Pharisee ho Pilate henga ahungun,
“Pu, hiche milhem chavai pa hin, ahinlaiyin, ‘Nithum jou le kaithouva ka-um ding ahi,’ ati kageldoh-uve.
Hijeh chun nithum geiya kitup tah a lhan ngah din mi koiyin, achutiloult aseijuite hunga atahsa longdamsa aguh mang diu, miho jah a, ‘Thina konin kaithouvin aumtai,’ atiuva, amasa eilhep chatvai sanguva anukhah tneg khoh cheh a eilhep diu ahi,” atiuve.
Pilate’n adonbut’in, “A-ngah ding naneiyu chu me, cheuvin lang pha nasah bangun lhan chu gaki-nga tup tau!” ati.
Amahon acheuvin. Lhankot song chu mohor anam khum’un, angah ding akoitauve.
Choldo nikho kichai, hapta kipatna ni masa jingkah khoovah thin thenin Magdalene khoa Mary le Mary khat nu chu lhan vedin ahung lhone.
Phulou helouvin ling hahon akihot’in, van a konin Pakaiya kon Vantil khat ahung kumlhan, lhankot sin song chu atangdohin, song chu kolphe vah-in avah-in, aponsil meibang banin abnage.
Vantil vouso chu kolpha vah-in avah-in, aponsil meibang banin abnage.
Lhan ngah hon akicha behseh jengun athisa abnag jengui.
Vantil chun numeiho ahin houvin, “Kicha hih-un, thingpel’a kikhetbwh Jesu chu nahol’u ahin, kahenai.
Ama hikoma aumtapoi, Aman aseisa bangin athoudoh tai. Hungin alupna hung veuvin.
Cheloiyun aseijuite jah a, ‘Ama thinaa konin athoudoh-in, Galilee gama nang ho sangin amasajotai, hikoma chu nakimupi diu ahi,’ tin gaseiyun. Ngai phauvin kaseipeh nahitauve,” ati.
Numeihon kichat le kipa thon lhan phung dalhan, seijuite gaseipehdin lhaijel tauve.
Phulou helouvin jesun numeiho chu akimupin, “Lung monguvin!” ati. Numeihon ahin nailut’un, akeng phang atuh-un aboh khup tauve.
Jesun ajah-uva, “Kicha hih-un, kile kit’uvin, kasopite chu Galilee gama che din gaseipeh-un, hikoma chu eimu diu ahi,” ati.
Numeho lamkai agei nalaiyun, lhan ngah sepia hokhopi sunga alut’un, thilsoh chengse abonchan Thempulen ho kom alhut tauve.
Thempulen ho le upaho akihou toh loiyun, sepia ho hi sum tampi apeuvin,
“Nang hon, ‘Jan ka-ihmut lan’un aseijuiten along ahung gu mang tauve,’ tia nasei tei tei diu ahi.
Hiche thu hi Gamvaipon ajah tah jongle keihon houjol’ung ting, nang ho lung olmosah pou vinge,” atiuve.
Lhan ngah sepaihon sum chu akilah un, ahil nau bangin abol tauve. Hitobang thujou
Jesun che dia atepeh nau Galilee lhanga chun seijui somle khat chu anachetauve.
Abang bang along opkai vangun, seijuihon Jesu amu phat’un chibai aboh tauve.
Jesun ahin nailut’in ajah-uvah, “Van le leiset’a tha neina jouse eikipetai.
hijeh chun cheuvin lang muntin a mi jouse seijuiyin gasem tauvin, amaho chu a-Pa, a-Cha chule Lhagao Theng minin baptize galbol’un,
chule kathupeh chengse anitna diuvin hilun; veuvin leiset khang kichai ni geiyin Keiman nang ho ka-umpi jing nauve,” ati.
Pathen chapa Jesu Christaa Kipana Thupha chu hitia kipan ahi.
Isaiah Themgao lekhabua kisun: “Ven keiman kasolle chu namasang’ah kasol’e, Aman nalampi semtohsa akoi ding ahi,
Gamthip’a khosam ogin khat’in, ‘Pakai lampi semtoh-un leng, Alamlen semjang san koiyun,’ tin akiseiye,” kiti bang chun,
gamthip’a John ahung kilah-in, chonset lung heiya baptize chan ding thu ahil lhang len chule baptize achansah-e.
Judea gam mun tin’a miho le Jerusalem khopia mi jouse John henga acheuvin, achonset chengse aphongun, Jordan vadunga ama khut’a baptize achang tauve.
John chun sa-ngongsao mul ponin akivonin, savun konggah aki-gah-in, chule khaokhote anen, gam khoiju adon’e;
lhang asamin, “Kei sanga hatjo khat ka-nunga ahunge, kei hi kun’a akengchot khao sut lham dinga kilom jong kahipoi.
Ken nang ho twiya baptize kachansah ahin, Aman vang Lhagao Thenga baptize nachansah diu ahi,” ati.
Hiche lai chun Galiee gam Nazareth khoa konin Jesu ahungin Jordan vadunga John khut’a baptize achangtai.
Twi lah a ahung dindoh doh chun van akikehson Lhagao Theng vakhu banga hung lenglhaa achunga chu amui.
Chule vana konin O-khat’in, “Nangma kachapa deitah nahin, nachunga kalung alhai ta-ngeiye,” ati.
Lhagaovin Jesu chu gamthip’a anolut paiyin,
