Jesun ajah-uva, “Kichen tah a kaseipeh nahiuve, nang hon Mihem Chapa sa naneh louva athi nadon louvu leh nasunguva hinna naneipouve.
Kasa nea kathi don’a chun tonsot hinna anei ahitan, phat chai nikhoa Keiman kakaithou ding ahi.
Ajeh chu kasa hi neh ding mong ahin, kathi hi don ding mong ahi.
Kasa nea kathi don’a chu kasunga aumin, keima ama sunga kaume.
pa hing jing chun eisol’a Keijong pa vanga kahin banga, Keima einea jong chu Keivanga hing ding ahi.
Vana kona hung kumlha changlhah chu hiche hi ahi: pute paten aneh-uva thi khemlouva aum nau tobang ahipoi, hiche changlhah nea vang chu tonsot’a hing ding ahi,” ati.
Jesun hicheng hi Capernaum khosung Houthua kihopnaina thu ahilpet’a asei ahi.
Jesu seijui tampin hiche hi ajah phat’un, “Asei hi ahahsa behseh jenge, kon angai thei ding ham?” atiuve.
Aseijuite hiche thua aphun chu Jesun along gil’in ahen ajeh-uva, “Kasei hin nakipalsah-u hita ong?
Mihem Chapa hi masanga aumna ngaiya akaltou muleu chun iti tauvin natem?
Hinna pea Lhagao ahin, tahsaphen ima atahpoi; najah-uva kathuseiho hi Lhagao le hina ahi.
Ahinla nalahuva atahsan lou jong naum’uv,” ati. Ijeh-inem itile Jesun abul’a pat atahsan lou ding koi koi hiuva chule Ama matsah dingkoiham, ahet jingsa ahi.
Aman aseiyin, “Hichejeh a chu, ‘Pan aphalpeh tilouvin koiman kaheng ahinjon theipoi,’ ti najah-uva kasei ahi,” ati.
Hichea pat hin Jesu seijuitampi akinung leuvin, Amatoh akilhon le tapouve.
Hichun Jesun som le ni jah a, “Nang ho la nakinungle nom louvu ham?” atileh;
Simon Peterin adonbut’in, “Pakai koiheng kabel diu ham? Nangin tonsot hinna thu hijat neiya;
chule Pathena hung kon Athengpa chu nahi katahsan kihe ta chu,” ati.
Jesun amaho adonbut’in, “Nang ho som le ni kalhen chil hilou ham? Nalah-uva khat Dia bol nanalai ong?” ati.
Jesun Iscariot Simon chapa Judas aseina ahi; ajeh chu som le nil ah a apan vangin Jesu matsah a pang ding chu ama ahi.
Hicheng nung hin Juda lamkai hon tha dia aholjeh-un Jesu Judea gamsunga avahle nom tapon Galilee gamsunga bou akholjin lei.
Juda ho lhambuh kut ding phat anaitai.
Hijeh chun asopiten Jesu jah a, “Nathilbol natoh ho hi naseijui hon jong amu theina diuvin hikom dalhan Judea gama chetan.
Ijeh-inem itile minthan dei mi koiman guh thimin thil abol ngaipoi. Thil hicheng nabol ahileh vannoi kimusah ngal’in,” atiuve.
Ajeh chu asopite jengin jong atahsan pouve.
Hijeh chun Jesun ajah-uva, “Nang ho didnga phat ahijing vangin Keidin phat ahi hih laiye.
Anatoh chengse phat louna kahettohsah jeh-in vannoiyin Keima eihon nang ho vang naho pouve.
Nang ho kut’a chun chetauvin, Keivang kaphat alhin loulai jeh-in hiche kut’a hin cheponge,” ati.
Hicheng hi aseiyin Ama Galilee gamsunga aumdentai.
Asopi kut’a dia ache nungun Jesu jong lhang phong hilouvin guh thimin achetouve.
Kut laiyin Judah on Jesu ahol’uvin, “Ama chu hoiya um ham?” atiuve.
Japi lah a chun Jesu thudol’a kinel baotamna asoh-in, loi khat’in, “Ama hi mipha ahi,” atiuvin; abangin, “Ahipoi, mipi apui chavai boue,” atiuve.
Juda ho agin jeh-un koiman vang athudol lhang phongin asei ngampouve.
Kut lai tah-in Jesu Houina achetouvin thu agahil’e.
Hichea hin Judah on adatmo lheh jengun, “Hichepan kahilna bon nei louva iti lekha hiti thep hi nga na?” atiuve.
Jesun amaho adonbut’in, “Kathuhil hi Keiya ahipoi, Eihinsolpaa ahibouve.
Eihinsolpa lung dei bolnom mi chun thu kihil hi Pathena kon ha, kachama kasei ham, ahet didng ahi.
koi hileh achama thuseipan Ama kichoi atna ding bou aholjin, ahinsolpa choi tana ding holpa vang chu adih ahin, ama sunga chun adih lou aumpoi.
Mose’n danthu napeh-u hilou ham? Ahinla nang ho khat cha beh-in danthu chu namangpouve. I-bol’a tha dia neihol’u ham?” ati.
Mipin adonbut’un, “Nang hi thilhavop nahi. Kooiham tha dia nahol’ah?” atiuve.
Jesun adonbut’in ajah-uva, “Ken na khat katongin nabonchauvin nadatmouve.
Amaa kon ahilou vangin pu le patea konin Mose’n chaptan ding thu napeuvin, hijeh chun Choldo ni jeng jongleh mihem chep natanjiuve.
Mose Danthu suhkeh louna dia Choldo mikhoa mikhat chep akitan leh, Choldo bikhoa mikadamthengsah hel jeha i-bol’a kachunga lung hang nahiuvam?
Polam mitvet’a thu tan louvin adih bangtah-in tan’uvin,” ati.
Jerusalem Kon miphabep’in “Mihon tha dia ahol’u chu hichepa hi hilou naimo?
ahinla ve, aman lhang phongtah-in thu asiyin, amahonla ajah a imacha aseipouve. Vaipoten ama hi Messiah ahi tia ahet chet mongu hitam?
Keihon hichepa ahung kina kihea, Messiah ahung teng vang leh koiman akonna ahet lou ding ahi,” atiuve.
Jesun hitea Houina thu ahilpet hin asamin, “Nang hon Keima neiheuvin, kahung konna geiyin naheuve. Ahinla Keima kachama hung kahipoi, Eihinsolpa chu dih tah ahin, nang hon Ama nahepouve.
Kenvang Ama kahei, ajeh chu Amaa hung kon Ama sol kahi,” ati.
Hichun mihon mat dingago’uvin, aphat lhin loulai jeh-in koiman achunga khut alhapouve.
Mipilah a tampin Ama atahsanun, “Messiah hung teng jongle hichepa bol sanga tamjo melchihna abol mong ding hinam?” atiuve.
Jesu thudol’a mipi akinel baotam nau chu Pharisee hon ajauvin, hijeh chun thempu pipuho leh Pharisee hon Jesu man din lhacha ho asoltauve.
Jesun, “Phat chomcha ka-umpiuva, chutengleh Eihinsolpa henga kache ding ahitai.
Nang hon neihol’uvaneimu lou diu, Kei umnaa la nahung thei lou dingu ahi,” ati.
Judaho akihouvun, “Hoiya che idng kigo hiya, eihon i-hol’uva imu lou diu ham? Chi dang namdang lah akithecheh Judate lah a chea, chiding namdang h gahil ding agot kha tham?
Athusei, ‘Neihol’uva neimu lou diu, Kei umna la nahung thei lou dingu ahi,’ ati hi ipi atina mong ham?” atiuve.
Kut kichai ni, ni loupe nin Jesu adingin o-ging tah-in asamin, “Koi hileh adangchah a chu kahenga hung hen lang don hen,
Pathen lakhabun, ‘Keima eitahsana chu along sunga hintwi put’a luiya long ding ahi,’ ati banga um ding ahi,” ati.
Jesun Ama tahsanhon Lhagao akisan diu aseina ahi, ijeh-inem itile Jesu choi-at a aum loulai jeh a hiche ni geiya hi Lhagai kihom loulai ahi.
Hiche aseiho hi mipi phabep’in ajauvin, “Hichepa hi Themgao tahbeh ahibouve,” atiiuvin ahi.
Adang hon ma, “Hichepa hi Messiah ahi,” atiuvin, konkhat’in vang, “Galilee gama Messiah sohdoh din gong?”
Pathen lekhabun, ‘Messiah chu David guiya kona Bethlehema hung sohdoh ding ahi,’ ati lou ham, David chenna khopia chu?” atiiuve.
Hijeh chun Ama jehin mipi akibung khentauve.
Abang bangin mat din ago’uvin, koi manla achunga khut alhapouve.
Lhachaho chu Thempu pipu ho le Pharisee ho henga ahung phat’un amahon, “I-bol’a nahin kaidiu ham?” tin anadongui.
Lhachahin adonbut’un, “Khu cheap thusei tobangin koiman thu asei khapoi,” atiuve.
Pharisee hon adonbut’un, “Doha nalhah-u hitalou ong?
Vaipo ho lah a khat beh le Pharisee mikhat beh-in atahsan em?
Danthu hetoh lou hiche mipi vang hi sapset chang hiuva khu,” atiuve.
Alah-uva mikhat, masanga Jesu henga hungsa, Nicoddemua vang chun ajah-uva,
I-danthu’vin mi athu ngai masa loule athilbol muchen louva achung thu eitahsanji nah um?” ati.
Amahon adonbut’un ajah a, “nang jong Galilee mi nahim? Hol’in vetang, Galilee kona Themgao sohdoh ngai lou chu,’” atiuve.
Mihon inlam ajon cheh-un,
Jesu chu Olive mol lama achei.
Jingkah matah-in houina agache kit’e. Ahenga mipi abonchan ahung kikhomun, Ama atouvin miho thu ahiltai.
Danthu them ho le Pharisee hon ajon pettah a kimandoh numei khat ahin kailut’un, Jesu to akah-uva adinsah-un,
ajah a, “Houhil hiche nu hi ajon petah a kimandoh ahi.
Danthua chun Mose’n hitobang numei ho songa selih dinga asei ahi. Nangin iti na-ngaitom?” atiuve.
Ama hetsahna theiya akipalna dia aseiyu ahin, ahinla Jesu abungin akhut jungin tol ajih tai.
Amahon adoh tei tei jeng phat’un Jesu adding jangin ajah-uva, “nalahuva chonsetna neilou pen chun amanu hi songin sep masapen hen,” atin;
abungin tol ajih kittai.
Hiche hi ajah phat’un a-upapen hoa pat’in khat khat’in adalhauvin Jesu le numeinu chubou alailunga aumtai.
Hichun Jesu adahdoh-in ajah a, “Numei, hoiya umtauvem? Koiman themmo nachan lou hitam?” tin adonge.
Amanun, “Pakai, koiman themmo eichan tapoi,” ati. Jesun, “kenjong themmo kachan poi, chen lan gchonse kit ta hihin,” ati.
Jesun ajah-uva aseikit’in, “Keima vannoi slvah kahin, kanung juiya chun muthima lam’ajot lou ding, hinna khovah anei idng ahi,” ati.
Pharisee hon ajah a, “Nangin nachung thu nahettohsah jeh-in nahettohsah chu adihpoi,’ atiuve.
Jesun adonbut’in jah-uva, “ken kachung thu hettohsah jong leng kahettohsah hi adih-e; ajeh chu hoiya hung kona hoi lam kajot kakihet’in, nang hon hoiya hungkona hoi lam kajot nahepouve.
Nang hon tahsa dol’in thu natan jiuvin, Ken koima thu katanpoi.
ijehtin tan jeng jong leng kathutan adih-e, ajeh chu kachang kahinpon, Eihinsol’a pa chun eiumpi.
Ajeh chu nadanthu va jong mini thu hettohsah chu adihna akisune.
Kachung thu hettohsah a pang Kei kahin, chule Eihinsol’a panjong kachung thu ahettohsah-e,” ati.
Amahon ajah a, “Napa hoiya um ham?” atiuleh; Jesun adonbut’in, “Nang hon Keila neihepouvin, ka-pa jong nahepouve; Keima neihetsau hileh ka-Pa jong nahet diu ahi,” ati.
Hicheng hi Jesun Houina athuhil pet’a thil kholna muna asei ahin, Ama phat ahung lhun loulai jeh-in koiman aman pouve.
Jesun ajah-uva asei kit’in, “Keima che mang ing ting, nang hon neihol diu, ahinla nachonset’a nathiden’uvaa kache naa nahung thei lou dingu ahi,” ati.
Juda hon, “Ama le ama kithat ngap ding ham, ‘Kache naa nahung thei lou diu,’ ati khu?” atiuve.
Jesun ajah-uva, “Nang ho hoiya kon nahiuvin, Keima chunga kon kahi; nang ho hiche vannoiya nahiuvin, Keima vang hiche vannoiya kahipoi.
“Hichejeh a chu nachonset ho’uva nathi diu ahi, tia kasei ahi; nang hon Kei hi, ‘Ama chu ahi,’ tia natahsan louvu leh nachonset ho’uva nathi tei diu ahi,” ati.
Hichun amahon ajah a, “Nang koi nahim?” atiuleh; Jesun ajah-uva, “Atil’a pat koi kahi kaseipeh-u chu la?
Nachung change thu Pathena siya tan ding tampi kaneinan, Eihinsolpa amatah Adih ahijeh-in Amaa kona kajah cheng chu Vannoi mite kaseipeh ahibouve,” ati.
Pa thudol’a ajah-uva asei chu ahdoh thei pouve.
Hijeh chun Jesun ajah-uva, “Nang hon Mihem Chapa hi nakhai san gtengu leh Kei hi Ama chu kahi nahetdoh-uva, imacha kachama bol louva, hicheng kaseiho jong hi Pan eihil’a kasei ahi, nahet diu ahi.
Chule Eihinsolpa chun alungdei kaboljeh-in eiumpin, kachangin eidalhapoi,” ati.
Aman hicheng hi asei nalaiyin mi tampin ama atahsantauve.
Ama tahsan Jusa hojah a Jesun, “Nang hon kasei najom jingo leh kaseijui tahbeh mong nahiuvin,
chuteng atah chu nahet’uva, atah chun najalensah diu ahi,” ati.
Amahon adonbut’un ajah a, “Keiho Abraham chilhah kahiuvin itih-in jong koima koma soh-in kalut khapouve; ati dan a nangin ‘Najalen diu ahi,’ natiham?” atiuve.
Jesun amaho chu adonbut’in, “Kichen a kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hileh achonsea chu chonset’a kihen soh ahi.
Soh chu tonsot’in in’a acheng pon, Chapa vang acheng jinge.
Hijeh chun Chapan jalensah leu chun najalen tahbeh diu ahi.
Abraham chilhah nahiu kahenai; ahinla nasunguva kathun mun anei lou jeh-in tha din neigo’uve.
Ka-pa koma kamu chukasei ahin, nang hon jong na-pauva kaona najah chan nabol’u ahi,” ati.
Amahon Jesu adonbut’un ajah a, “Ka-pau Abraham ahi,” atiuleh; Jesun ajah-uva, “Abraham chate hileu chun Abraham thilbol ho nabol diu ahi.
Tunla Pathenna kona thutah ja a nahenguva sepia Kei hi tha din neigo’uve, Abrahamin hitobang hi abolpoi.
Nang hon napau thil bol nabol’u ahi,” ati. Amahon ajah a, “Keiho bolam kahipouve, ka-pau khat Pathen ahi,” atiuve.
Jesun ajahuva, “Pathen na-pau hile Kei nei ngailut diu ahi, ajeh chu Kei hi Pathena hung kon hikoma um kahi, kacham hung kahipon, Aman eihinsol ahi.
Idinga kasei nahet khen thei louvu ham? Kahil hi-na-ngai jou loujeh-u ahibouve.
Nang ho napau Diabol’a nahiuva napauva hung kon alungdei chu namolso namu ahi. Ama chu semtil’a pat tolthat ahin, thutah aum loujeh a atah a pang ngailou ahi. Aman thujou asei teng along chama aseiji ahi; ajeh chu jousei ahin, jou penna pa ahi.
Kenvang atah kasei ahin, ahinla neitahsan pouve.
Michonse ahi eiti thei ding koipen nahiuvem? Atah kasei ahileh ibol’a neitahsan dau ham?
Pathena kon chun Pathen thu angaiyin, nang hon thu na-ngailouvu hi Pathena kon nahilou jeh-u ahi,” ati.
Judahon adonbut’un ajah a, “Nangma Samaria mi nahin, thilhavop nahi katiu hi dih lou ham?” atiuve.
Jesun adonbut’in, “Keima thilhavop kahipon, ka-Pa kajabol ahin, nang hon Keima neijabol pouve.
Keiman kaloupina ding kaholpon, ahol’a athutan khat aum nai.
Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, kathu nit chun itih chan hijongle thina atep khah lou ding ahi,” ati.
Juda hon ajh a, “Thilhavop nahi tun kahetauve. Abraham athitan, Themgao jouse jong athitauvin, ahinla nangin, “Kathu nit chun itih chan hijongle thina atep khah lou ding ahi,’ nati.
Kapu luiyu Abraham athitan, asanga lenjo nahim? Themgao jouse jong athigamtan, koipenba kahi nakitim?” atiuve.
Jesun adonbut’in, “Kei kichoi-an kahileh kaloupina chu ima ahipoi, nang hon, “Ka-pau ahi,’ natiu hiche ka-Pa chun eichoi-at joh ahibouve.
Ama chu nang hon nahe hih laiyun, Kenvang kahenai; Ama chu kahepoi tileng nang ho banga jousei kahi ding ahi, Ken ama kahen athu kanit’e.
Na-pau Abraham chu Keima nikho mu ding athanomin, amun akipah lheh jenge,” ati.
Juda hon ajah a, “Nakum som nga bon lhing lou laiya Abraham namusa hiya ong?” atiuve.
Jesun ajah-uva, “Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, Abraham pem masanga jong um jing Keima kahi,” ati.
Amahon ase na didng song akilo phat’un Jesu achamin akiseldoh-in, Houina kon chun ache mangtai.
Jesu ache naa mi apen’a pat mitcho khat amui.
Aseijuiten ajah a, “Rabbi, hichepa mitchoa apen hi ama chonset jeh ha anu le apa chonset jeh ham?” tin adongui.
Jesun adonbut’in, “Hiche hi ama chonset vang jong ahipon; Pathen natoh ho kiphondoh theina dinga ama hi mitchoa peng ahibouve.
Sun ahipet’a Eihunsolpa na i-tih tei diu hiveh ta, koiman na atoh thei louna ding jan hung lhung ding hita hi.
Vannoiya kaum laisea vannoi salvah kahi,” ati.
Jesun hiche hi aseiyin, tol’ah achil aset lhan, achil’in bonlhoh asemin, mitchopa mit te nia aloiyin
ajah a, “Chen lang Siloam (Siloam hi ‘sol’ kiti ahi) twikul’a gakiphet lhah tan,” ati. Ama achea agakiphet lhah leh kho amun ahung kile kittai.
Mitchopa heng le kom ho, khutdoa apan lai musa hon, “Touva khutdoji chu ama hi hilou haimo?” atiuve.
Abangin, “Ama ahinai,” atiuvin, kim khat’in, “Ahipoi, amato lim kilo ahibouve,” atiuve. Mitchopa ama tah-in, “Kei ama chu kahinai,” ati.
Amahon ajah a, “I-atileh namit te ni hah hitam?” atiuve.
Aman adonbut’in, “Jesu kitipa khun bonlhoh asemin, kamit te nia aloiya, ‘Siloam a chen gakiphet lhah tan,’ atia, kachea kagaphet lhah leh kho kamu ahitai,” ati.
Amahon ajah a, “Ama hoiya umtam?” atiuleh; aman, “Kahepoi,” ati.
Amahon masanga mitchopa chu Psarisee ho henga apuitauve.
Jesun bonlhoh asema mitchopa mitt e nia aloiya ahasah ni chu CHoldo nikho ahi.
Pharisee hon amapan kho amu thudol chu akhol kit’uvin ahileh aman ajah-uva, “Aman bonlhoh asemin kamit te nia aloiya kagasop lhah phat’a kho kamuthei ahi,” ati.
Pharisee ho phabep’in, “Choldo ni anit loujeh-in hichepa hi Pathena kon loujeh-in,” atiuvin; abangman, “Michosen hitobang thil kidang ho abol thei ngai ong?” tin, hitobang hin alah-uva kibung khenna asohtai.
Amahon mitchopa jah a avel’in, Amahon namit ahasah jeh a chu nangin Ama chu koi ahiba natim?” atiuleh; aman, “Themgao ahi,” ati.
Juda hon ama chu mitchosa ahi kho amu kit hi anu le apa kouva,
amani jah a, “Hichepa hinachapa lhon, amitchosa peng niti lhonpa lhon, amitchosa peng nati lhonpa chu himong nam? Ahileh iti kho amu kitham?” tia adoh masang seuvin atahsanpouve.
Anu le apan adonbut lhonin, “Amahi kachapa lhon ahiya chule mitcho anahi chu kahe lhon nai;
i-atileh kho amu kit’a, koipenin amit te ni ahasah ham vang kahe lhonpoi. Ama dongun, upa hita chu achung thu aman kisei nante,” ati lhone.
Judaho aginjeh lhona anule apan hiche hi asei lhon ahi; ajeh chu Jesu hi Messiah ahi tia phongdoh pen pen Houthua kikhopna ina kona pamse ding tia Judahon dettah a kilolna aneisau ahi.
Hichejeh a chu anu le apan, “Upa hita chu ama dongun,” ati lhon ahi.
Anivei nan amahon masanga mitchopa chu akouvun ajah a, “Pathen choi-atnan adih seiyin, hichepa vang hi michonse ahi, keihon kahei,” atiuve.
Ama adonbut’in, “Michonse ahi ahilou kahepoi; masang chun kamit achon tun kho kamui, tibou kahei,” ati.
Amahon ajah a, “Aman i-nalom? Namit te ni iti ahasah ham?” atiuleh;
Aman amaho adonbut’in, “Nakiseipeh tauva na-ngaipouvin, i-bol’a najah nom kit’u ham? Ama seijuiya napan nom’uvem?” ati.
Hichun ama ahouseuvin, “Nang chu ama seijui nahi Chula em, keiho Mose seijui kahiya chu.
Pathenin Mose henga thu asei kihea, hichepa hoilam kon ahibon kahepha lou,’ atiuve.
Mipa chun adonbut’in ajahuva, “Aman kamit te ni geiya hasah taa, hoilam kon ahi nahet louvu chu datmo aum lheh-e!
Pathenin michonse ho thu angaipon, amavang khattouvin houguttah a Pathen lungdei abol leh athu a-ngaipehjie, ti ihesoh keiyui.
Semtil’a pat koiman mi mitchoa peng mit ahasah-w, ti akija khapoi.
Hichepa hi Pathenna kon ahilouleh imacha bol theiponte,’ ati.
Amahon adonbut’un, “Napum changa chonsea peng nangin keiho neihil’um?” atiuvin, anoddoh tauve.
Hichepa chu anodoh-u ahen Jesun akimupi kit phat’in, “Nangman Mihem Chapa chu natahsanem?” ati.
Aman adonbut’in, “Pakai, katahsan thei ding ama chu koiham?” atileh;
Jesun ajah a, “Ama chu namutan, najah a thu seiya hi Ama ahi,” atipeh-e.
Aman adonbut’in, “Pakai katahsane,” atin; a-angsunga aboh khup’in chibai aboh tai.
Chuin Jesu, “Khomu louhon kho amu a, khomu ho mit chotna dinga vannoiya thutana hung kahi,” ati.
Asei hi avel’a um Pharisee hon ajauvin, “Keiho mitcho kahilouvu hinai?” atiuleh;
Jesun ajah-uva, “mitcho hileu chun chonsetna nanei lou diu ahi, tun vang, ‘Kho kamui,’ natijeh-un nachonsetnau aum cheh-e,” ati.
“Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, kot’a lut louva mundanga kal’a kelngoi hong sunga lut mi chu gucha le michom ahi.
Kot’a lut’a vang chu kelngoiho chingpa ahi.
Kotngahpan ama chu kot ahonpeh jin, akelngoite chu amin cheh a akouteng kelngoiten a-ogin aheuvin, abonchan apuidoh jin ahi.
Aboncha ahoidoh soh teng ama alamkaiyin, a-ogin ahet jeh-uvin kelngoiten anung ajuiyui.
Midang nung vang ajui louhel diu ahi, a-ogin ahet loujehuva akoma kona jamming jo diu ahibouve,” ati.
Jesun hiche thulem hi miho aseipeh-in, ahinla ipi aseipeh-u chu amahon ahepouve.
Jesun asei kit’in, “Kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, Keima kelngoite hongkot kahi.
Keima masanga hung jouse chu gucha le michom jeng ahiuvin, kelngoiten jong athuu a-ngaipouve.
Keima kot chu kahi; Keiya hung lut chu huhhinga uma, lut le pot lea neh thei ham hing akimu ding ahi.

Hijeh chun asei jop chengse chu baptize achangunm hiche nikho chun mi sang thum jenin abetauve.
Amaho chu solchah ho thuhil’in jong, antheng jongin jong chule taovin jong gunchutah-in apangdet jing tauve.
Thil kidang le melchihna tampi Solchah hoa kona kiboldoh phat’in amitakip chunga kichatna achutai.
Atahsan ho abonchauvin thukhatseh kisauvin, ijakai neilhangin aneikhomun,
aneiyu athilkeo chengseu ajoh-un, a-ngaichat dungjui cheh-in akihom jiuve;
niseh le lung khatseh pun Houin a gunchu tah-in akikhom jiuvin, in tin’a changlhah helbal’in akikhomun, lung lhaisel le kipah tah-in an anekhom jiuvin;
Pathen avah choiyun mipi pumpi seiphat achangui. Hichun Pakaiyin niseh leh huhhinga umdoh ho chu aloi lah-uva abejing jin ahi.
Peter le John chu tao phat nilhah lam nidan thumin Houin a achetou lhone.
Chuin Houin kaiya cheho henga khutdoa thil thum dinga ahinpoh-uva ‘Kotkhah hoi’ kiti Houin kelkot bul’a kiseh leh kitousahji, anusunga kona elbaiya pengpa chu aumin,
amahin Peter le John Houin a lut kigo amun, i-khat khat apehna lhon din thil athume.
Peterin John toh ama chu avechang mel’in “Keini lam hinven,” ati.
Hijeh chun aman i-khat khat mu ding kinemin amani phatah-in avei.
Hichun Peterin, “keiman dangka le sana kaneipon, kanei hiche hi napenge, Nazareth Jesu Christa minin lam jot tan!” ati.
Hiti chun akhut jetlamin atuh-in akaithou leh, apettah chun akenghang te ni le akhochang dung jouse ahatdohin,
ama akichomin adding jangin lam ajot’in, amanitoh Houin a alut’in, avah len, akichom chomin Pathen avahchoi choi jenge.
Mipin jong ama ava le lea Pathen avah choi choi jeng chu amu cheh-uvin,
Houin ‘Kotkhah hoi’ kiti laiya kitousahjia khutdo pa chu ahi ahet doh phat’uvin hichepa chunga chu ipi thilsoh hitam, tin lung dongin akicha gamtauve.
Elbai kidamsah pan Peter le John akolchah jing phat’in mipin adat mouvin, Solomon hongcha kiti laiya chun ahenguva ahung lhai khom’uve.
Peterin amu phat’in mipi agah houvin, “Israel mite, ibol’a hiche thilsoh hi nadatmouva, keini thahat le houdih jeh a ama hi lam kajotsah thei lhona nagel’uva, neivet vet jengu ham?
Nang hon napehdoh-uva Pilate’n lhadoh dinga thu atan jouva jong a-angsung laitah a napaisau, alhacha Jesu chu i-pu i-pateu Pathen, Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen, chule Jacob Pathenin achoi-at ahin,
nang hon Atheng le Adihpa chu napaiyun tolthatpa joh chu nalhadoh peh diuvin nathum’ui;
hinna Bulpi chu nathat’uvin, ahinla Pathenin Ama chu thinaa konin akaithou kittai, keihohi ahetoh kahiuve.
Ama min a tahsan vanga hiche namu’va nahetsahpau hi ama tahsanna chun ama hi adamthengsah hel jenga, hiche ama min’a chu nabonchau angsunga kidinsah ahitai.
“Tun sopite, nang hon jong navaipoteu banga hetoh louva nabol’u ahi kahenai;
chujongle Pathenin a-Messiah chun gim hesoh athoh ding thu Themgao jouse kamsunga ‘anaphondoh masah chu hitia hi guilhung ahitai.
Hichejeh chun chonset lung heiyun lang nachonset chengseu suhmanga aumna din hung kile kit’un,
chutileh Pakai angsunga konin lhagao haldoh kitna thei umdoh-intin, Aman nang ho dia lhendohsa akoi messiah Jesu chu ahinsol thei ding ahi.
Hiche Jesu chu Pathenin akhang khanga a-Themgao theng ho jouse kama ahinsei jing banga thil ijakai akiledohsah kit phat kah a van’a lahtouva umtei ding ahi.
Mose’n jong, ‘Pakai na Pathen’uvin keibanga hi nasopiteu laha kona Themgao khat natundoh peh diu ahi; ipi hileh aman nasei peh chanu aboncha na-ngaisoh kei diu ahi.
Koi hileh hiche Themgaopa thusei ngailou chu mipilah a kona kisumang ding ahi,’ ati.
Samuel a pat ama nunga thusei Themgao chengsen jong tu hiche nikho ho didng hi anaphon masah sau ahitai.
Nang ho hiche Themgao ho leh, Pathenin napu napauteu apeh a Abraham jah a, ‘Nangma chilhah vanga vannoi phungtin phatthei chang diu ahi,’ tia ateppeh hiche Kitepna chate chu nahiuve.
Pathenin amasaa nang ho dia alhachapa chu akaithouva, nagit louna chengseuva kona leheisoh keiya phatthei naboh diuvin nahenguva ahinsoltai,” ati.
Peter le Johnin mipi jah a thu asei nalai lhonin, Thempu ho le Houin ngah sepai lamkaipa chule Sadducee hon ahindel vuh-un,
mipi thu ahilnalhona Jesu jal’a thinaa kona thokitna aseiphong lhon chu athi mah ten jengun,
amani chu aman’uvin nilhah ahipai phat’in ajinga din mihenna in’a akhumtauve.
Ahinla athusei lhon jaa mi tampin atahsanin, amijat jong sang nga jen alhingtauve.
Ajing nikhon avaipoteu le upaho chengse le Danthu themho Jerusalema akikhomun,
(Thempu chungnung insung lhah jeng, Thempu chungnung Annas le Caiaphas toh John le Alexander ahiuve,)
amani chu alailunguvah adinsah-un, “Ipi tha neina neiya, kei min pan’a hiche hi nabol lhon ham?” tin adongui.
Chutah chun Peter Lhagao Theng adimset’in ajah-uva, “Japi vaipote leh upate ho,
tunia elbaipa thilpha kibolpeh chung chang a eikidong lhona, ama iti kihuhdoh ham, kiti ahileh,
Israel mipi leh nang ho nabonchauvin kihet chehun, Nazareth Jesu Christa, nang hon thingpel’a nakhetbeh-uva, Pathenin thinaa kona akaithou kitpa min kipana, hichepa jeh a chu ama damthenga na angsunguva ding’ah ahi.
Hiche hi, ‘Insa hon napaiyu Song, ‘Inning khomdet pen’a pang,’ kiti chu ahitai.
Chule koima dang’ah ‘huhhingna ‘aumpoi; ‘ijeh-inem iti le vannoiya mihem lah a huhhinga i-umna diuva kipea min dang him him aumpoi,” ati.
Mihon Peter le John hanje chu amu’uvin, lekha them lou, mimol ahi lhon aheuvin adatmo lheh jengui; amavang Jesu toh kiloisa ahi lhon ahenauve.
Aboldam lhonpa ma amani toh adin khom jing amu’u leh asuhsetna din imacha abol theipouve.
Chuin amani chu akouvun Hou vaipoloi kikhopnaa kona potdoh din asol’uvin, amaho achangin akihou khomun,
“hiche mi te ni hi iba ilo diu ham? Ijeh-inem itile ama ni jeh a melchihna dsoh hi la Jerusalema cheng jouse het’a kiphongdoh ahitan, eihon jong iseilep thie pouvin,
hijongleh athu mipi lah a akithejeh be louna dingin, miho koimacha jah a hiche min’a hi thu asei kit lhon louna din gihsal’u hite,” akitiuve.
Chuin amani akouvun Jesu min’a thu aseiphong thei lhon lou ding, mijong ahil thei lhon louhelna din akhah chah tauve.
Ahinla Peter le Johnin amaho adonbut lhonin ajah-uva, “Pathen thu sanga nang ho thu ngaijoh Pathen mitmua din jom, nang hon ngaitouvin;
keinin vang kamusa le kajahs alhon chu kaseida thei lhon louhel ding ahi,” ati lhone.
Thilsoh chung chang jeh a mihon Pathen avahchoi cheh-u leh, mipijeh chun talen peh na thieya thepmona imala amudoh pouvin, hijongleh amani chu nasatah-in agihsal kit leuvun alhadoh tauve.
Achunga damsah theina thil kidang kibolpehpa ma chu akum som li val ahitai.
Alhadoh phat’un Peter le John jong aloite henga ahung lhonin Thempu pipu ho le upahon ajah lhona agih nau thu chu asei peh lhontai.
Amahon ajah phat’un lung khat tah-in ogin khat’in Pathen akouvun, “Vo Pakai, van le leiset, Twikhanglen chule asunga um jouse Sempa nangma nahi,
Lhagao Thenga kona kapuluiyu nalhacha David kama ‘Ibol’a chiding namdangte lung hanguva, Mipin pannabei thil angaitou ham?
Leiset lengte akigol’un, avaipoteu jong akikhomun Pakai le a-Messiah dou din agouve,’ tia kiseisa chu
atahbehin hiche khopi sunga hin thao nanusa nalhacha theng Jesu dou din, Herod le Pilate, chiding namdang toh chule Israel mipi geiyin akikhomun,
bo dinga nakhut tah a nagontohsa le nalungthima na-ngaito chengse chu bol ding agatauve.
Chule tun Pakai, ami gihsal nau hi vetan, chujongle nalhachate hin hangtah a nathu asei ngamna diuvin lung ngamna pen,
nalhacha Theng Jesu min’a dammo veiset akiboldama, melchihna tampi akiboldoh a chule thil kidang dang akisodohna din nakhut hin lhangin,” atiuve.
Hitia chu ataovu leh aum nau mun chu ahung kilingin, amaho abonchauvin Lhagao Theng achangun lung ngamtah-in Pathen thu aseitauve.
Atahsan loise chu lung khat she le hinkho khat’in aumun, koiman anei athilkeo chu amaa tuma sei louvin, abonchan akikop cheh-uve.
Thahat nasatah kengin Solchah hon Pakai Jesu thokit thu ahettohsah-un, achunguva phat theina lentah-in aume.
Ijeh-inem itile alah-uva khat cha jong alhasam aumpouve, lou le in neihon jong ajoh-un aman jouse chu ahin choi khom’uvin
Solchah ho kengbul’a akoiyun, mihon angaichat bep cheh-in ahoppeh jiuvin ahi.
Mi tilkouva pang ahi, tia Solchah hon Barnabas asah-u, Cyprus aping Levi mi Joseph chun
lou ching khat aneiyin agajoh-in sum chu ahinchouyin Solchah ho kengbul’a akoiye.
Amin Ananias kiti pasal khat hin ajinu Sapphira jong anomin anei thil khat ajoh-in,
ajinu het’in thilman akeh khat akikoiyin, akeh khat chu ahinchoiyin Solchah ho kengbul’a akoiye.
Hichun Peterin, “Ananias, ibol’a nalung sung Satan nalo dimsah a Lhagao Theng najoulhep’a, gam man akeh khat chu nakoiden hitam?
Najoh masanga nanga ahibanga najoh nunga jong nanga chu nathu thu hilou ham? Ibol’a hitobang thil hi nalungthima navop ham? Mihem hilouva!” ati.
Ananias chun thu hicheng hi ajah jah chun alhun athitai; hichea hin ajapha jouse chunga kichatna lentah ahung lhungtan ahi.
Gol-lhang ho adding doh-un along chu atom’uvin chule apodoh-un agavuitauve.
Nidan thum don nungin thilsoh umchan hepha louvin ajinu ahung lut’e.
Peterin amanu anahouvin, “Seitemin, hijat man a bou hi gam chu najoh lhon ham?” ati leh; amanun, “Henge, hijat ahinai,” ati.
Chuphat’in Peter ajah a, “Ibol’a nangnin Pakai Lhagao patep dia nagot lhon ham? Ven, najipa vuiho kotpi phung ahung geitauve, nang jong napohdoh pai diu ahtai,” ati.
Amanu jong alhu paiyin Peter kengbul’a athidentai. Gollhang ho ahung lut’u leh amanu athisan ahung toh-un, along chu apodoh-uvin ajipa koma agavuitauve.
Chutah chun Houbung pumpi le athilsoh ho japha chan chunga kichatna lentah ahung lhungtai.
Mipi lah a melchihna le thil kidang tampi Solchah hon akhut tah-uvin aboldoh doh jengun, chujongle lungkhat tah-in Solomon hongchaa chun aum cheh-ui.
Midang koiman amaho jop dinga ngap chatapon, ahinla mipin aseipha jing nauvin,
hijeh chun mipilah a Pakai tahsan tahbeh ho pasal’in jong numeiyin jong abejingun,
Peter ahungle tengleh alebeh achunguva achuh khahna din, dammo veise jouse khosung lamlen dunga ahinpohdoh-un khunpeh chung le pheh dunga alupsah-ui.
Jerusalem kimvel khopi dunga mipi ahung kikhom’un, dammo veise jouse le lhagaoboh vop ho ahinpuiyun, abonchan aboldamsoh keiyui.
Thempu chungnung chu chu pet’a Sadducee loi lah a aloite chengse chutoh akipatdoh-in, athang tom behseh jengun,
Solchah ho chunga khut alhauvin, aman’un, lhangpi kihenna in’a akhumtauve.
Ahinla hiche jan chun Pakaiya kon Vantil khat’in songkul kotkhah aongin amaho apuidoh-in ajah-uva,
“Cheuvin Houin a ga dingun lang hiche Hinna thudol hi abonchan gaseipeh tauvin,” ati.
Hiche ajah phat’un khovah lhah-in Houin a alutuvin thu agahiltauve. Thempu chungnung chunla aloi te chengse toh ahungin Israel chate Hou vaipoloi upa changse toh Houthua kikhopna abol’un, amihenho’u gakailut dingin songkul’a mi asol’ui.
Vaihom asol ho’u ahungu leh Solchah ho chu songkul sunga agamu tapouvin, ahung kile kit’uvin athudol aphongun,
“Songkul kaga lhun’un kotheh chengse phatechan akiheh-in songkul ngah ho jong kotpi phung dunga adding cheh-un, kot kahondoh phat’un la asunga koima kamupouve’” atiuve.
Athuseiyu hi Houin ngah sepai vaipopa le Thempu pipu loiyin ajah phat’un Solchah ho chu iti hiuva hichea hi ipi hungsoh hitam, tin alunggel’u abeihel tai.
Hichepet hin mikhat ahenguva ahungin, “ven, songkul’a namihen ho’u khu, Houin a adingun mipi thu ahil’uve,” ati.
Chuphat’in Houin ngah sepai vaipopa le vaipoloi chengse akon’un amaho agakailut’uvin, mipi akichauvin songa ase louna diuvin pumhat’in vang abolpouve.
Solchah ho ahinkailut phat’un Hou vaipoloi kikhopna adinsah-un, Thempu chungnungin amaho adongin,
“Hiche min pan’a mi nahil louhelna diuva hachang khama nakikhamu ahin, ahinla ven, hiche nathuhil’u hi Jerusalem nadipsoh hel’in, hiche mipa thisan phu hi keiho chunga lhut khum din neigouve!” atiuve.
Ahivangin Peter le Solchah hon adonbut’un, “Mihemho thu hilouva Pathen thu joh a kanun tei tei diu ahi.
Ipu ipateu Pathenin thinga nakhai sanguva nathasau Jesu chu akaithouvin,
Israelte achonset chengseu ngaidama aumna dia chonset lung heina apehna din ama chu Pathenin ama jetlama vaipo le huhhingpan achoisangtai.
Hiche thu ho ahetoh a chu Pathenin athua nung ho apeh Lhagao Theng le keiho kahiuve,” atiuve.
Ajapha chan alung hang beseh jengun Solchah ho chu thadoh jengdia akiloltauve.
Hichun Hou vaipoloi lah a Pharisee mi, amin Gamaliel kiti, Danthu hilthem, mi jousen ajasohkei, ama chu adingdoh-in Solchah ho chu phat chom khat polama soldoh dingin aseiyin,
chuin Hou vaipoloi jah a, “Hiche miho chunga hi ipi bol ding natiu ham kichih theiyun.
Ijeh-inem itile tu masngin jong Theudas kiti mi khat anaumin, ama le ama i-khat hidainnin akiseiyin, pasal phabep jen, ja li bangin ajop’uvin, ahinla ama atha phat’un anungjui chengse akithe chehsoh-in, imacha lou asoh tai.
Hiche nung hin leiset mi kisim laiyin Galilee mi Judas ahung kipan kit’in, mipi phabep geiyin akijuisah-e; ama jong hi amang thah tah, anungjui chengse jong akithecheh tauve.
Hijeh a chu tu hiche thua jong kaseipeh nahiuve, hiche mihoa kon hin kikangseuvin lang don dauvin, ijeh-inem itile hiche jong hi mihema kon le lunggel chule natoh ahile kisumang thou ding ahi;
Pathena hungkon ahivangleh nasuh mang joulou diu ahi, ajo leh Pathen kidoupi nahilo diu ahi,” ati. Gamaliel thun anungun,
Solchah ho chu akou lut’uvin, avoh juvun Jesu min’a thu asei louhelna diuvin hatah-in agihsal’un alhadoh tauve.
Solchah ho chu Hou vaipoloi kikhopna maiya konin achedohun, chuche Min jal’a hesoh genthei thoh a kiloma akibol’u chu akipah lheh jengui.
Niseh-in Houin le a-in tin’uva tang louhel’in thu ahil’un, chule Jesu chu Messiah ahi Kipana Thupha asiphong jingui.
Hiche lai chun seijuih mijat apunbe cheh cheh phat’un niseh a thil kihopnaa ameithaiho’u anah sah peh pouve, tin Greek pao tho Juda-numeiho chu Hebrew mite chunga aphun’un, akah-uva kinahna asodoh tai.
Chuphat’in som le ni chun seijui jouse akoukhom’un, “Keihon Pathen thu seiphong kangah-uva dokhanga ankong sem’a kapan diu adihpoi;
hijeh chun sopite, hiche kin’a kapansah diuvin, nalah-uva konin Lhagao le chihna dim mia nahettohsau sagi lhengdohuvin;
chuteng keiho tah vang taona le hill hang kin’a kipumpeh jo’uvinge,” atiuve.
Athu chu mipi maiya lung lhai aumin, hijeh chun tahsan le Lhagao Thenga dim Stephan toh, Philip le Prochorus, Nicanor le Timon, Parmenas le juda houva kilalut chiding namdang mi Antioch khoa hung Nicolaus alhengdoh-un,
amaho chu Solchah ho angsunga adinsah-u leh, Solchah hon ataopeh-uvin achunguva khut a-ngamtauve.
Hichun Pathen thu achaljah tan, jerusalema seijuiho mijat hapunin apungin, Thempu ho lah a tamtah jong tahsan thun anung tauve.
Stephen chu lungset le thahat adamtan, mipi lah a melchihna le thil kidang lentah tah aboldoh tai.
Hichun akiminvo na banga chamlhat miho Houthua kikhopna in kitia konin mi phabep, Cyrene gama, Alexandria, Cilicia le Asia a hung kon ho akipatdoh-un Stephen chu akinelpiu leh,
aman chihna le Lhagao thu asei chu anel thei tapouve.
Chuphat’in amahonmi phabep, “Amah in Mose le Pathen taitomna thu asei kajauve,” tia sei dingin atlseuvin ahi.
Hiti chun mipi le upa ho, Danthu themho aban tilset’uvin, amaho achunga achu’vin, aman’un Hou vaipoloi kikhop naa akailut’un,
jouthua hettohsah-uvin, amahon, “Hichepa hin Muntheng le Danthu douna thu tang louhel’in asei sei jengin,
Nazareth Jesun hiche mun hi asuhmanga Mose’n eipeh-u chondan ho hi akheldoh ding ahi,’ tia asei jong kajauve,” atiuvin ahi.
Hichun Hou vaipoloi kikhopnaa tou chengsen Stephen chu avesoh keiyun ahileh amai chu Vantil maiso bangin amu’uve.
Thempu chungnungin, “Hichengse hi hiti mong ham?” atileh;
Stephenin adonbut’in, “Ngaiyuvin sopite le pate ho: Penna bulpipa Abraham chu Haran aching dia ache masang, Mesopotamia gama achen laiyin loupina Pathen ahenga ahung kilah-in
ama jah a, ‘Nagam leiset le naphung mite dalhan potdoh-in lang keiman kavetsah ding gam jonin chetan,’ ati.
Hijeh chun ama Chaldea gama konin achen Haran a achengtai. Apa thi nungin tua nachen nau hiche gamsunga hin akichon lutsah-in,
ahinla agam leiset halsi khat, kengpeh thol jeng cha jong ama din apepoi; cha anei lou vangin, agam chu ama le anunga achilhahpa apeh din thu anatep’e.
Pathenin hiti hin achilhah te chu mi gama gapem’uva, mihon sohna atohsah diu, genthei hesoh a abol diuvin aseiye.
Pathenin aseiyin, ‘Amahon sohna agatoh peh-u nam mite chu thu katan khuma, chujou teng Abraham chilhahte hung kitoldoh-uva hiche lai mun’a Keima kinbol’a eihou diu ahi,’ ati ahi.
Chuin Abraham chu cheptan ding kitepna thupeh apen, hijeh chun Isaac ahingin niget nin chep atanpeh-in, Isaac-in Jacob, Jacob’in penna pate somle ni ahingin chep atanpeh-e.
“Penna pate chu Joseph chunga athang thip’un Egypt gama ajoh mangun, ahile Pathenin aumpi jingin,
ahesoh genthei tin tanga konin ahinhuhdoh pehin, Egypt lengpa Pharaohang’a lungset le chihna apen, hijeh chun lengpan Egypt gam pumpi le ama insung pumpia vaipon asemtai.
Hichun Egypt gam punpi le Canaan gam pumpia nahiuve kel alhan, gentheina lentah ahung, lhungin, i-puteuvin neh le chah akimu joutapouve.
Hichea hin Jacob’in Egypt gama anneh aume, ti ajah phat’in i-puteu chu khatvei chan nan agah solpai jenge.
anivei chan na Joseph-in asopite akihetdohsah tan, Jacob insung chu Pharaoh geiyin ahetai.
Chuphat’in Joseph-in jong apa Jacob le a-inkote mihem som sagi le nga jen chu gakou din mi asol’in,
Jacob jong Egypt’a ahung suh tai. Hichun ama ahin i-puteu ahin athitauvin,
alongu chu Shechema alepoh-uvin, Shechem muna Abrahamin Hamor chatea kona dang kaa achohsa lhan’a chun avuitauve.
“Pathenin Abraham koma akihahsel’a a thupeh phat chu ahung lhinpai ding phat’in, Egypt gama mipi apungtel tul jengun,
Joseph hephalou leng chom khat hung letdoh geiyin apunguve.
Lengchompa hin ijat miteu heltah-in dohan abol’in, i-pu i-pateu chu achasen jouseu ahing aum louna din acham louvun polama apaidoh sah jenge.
Hiche lai tah hin Mose apengin Pathen din it aum lheh jenge; lha thum sungin apa insunga avah-un,
ama jong apaidoh phat’uvin Pharaoh chanun akilah-in achapa vah-in ahin kivahdoh tai.
Mose chu Egypt mite chihna jouse ahil’un, athusei jouse le antohna chan a pheltah ahiye.
“Mose chu kum som li alhin phat’in asopi Israel chate gavil ding alungthima aumdoh tai.
Mi khat hi adih loutah a kibol amun, ama chu akithopin aphu lahnan Egypt mipa chu athattai.
Mose gel’a chu Pathenin ama khut mangchaa ama hochu huhhingna apeh got ahi asopiten kihetnah tau atileh, amahon ahepouve.
ajingin ahenguva ahung kit leh mi ni akina lhonin, aman akah lhona chamna thu aseiyin, ‘Mi te ni, sopi cha hlhona ibol’a khat’in khat adih louva kibol nahi lhon ham?’ ati.
Ahinla a-inhengpa adih louva bolpa joh chun Mose chu asondoh-in, ‘Keiho chunga vaipo le thutana kon natun beh am?
Janhia Egypt mipa natha banga chu tha ding neigot ham?’ ati.
Hiche athusei jeh hin Mose ajamin Midian gama agapemin, hikoma chun chapa ni agahinge.
“Kum som li lhinin Sinai mol gamthip laiya Vantil khat hamboh lah meikongin Mose henga ahung kileh-e.
Hiche thil amu hi Mose’n adatmon, ga ve chen dia anailut leh Pakai o ahung gingin,
‘Keima napu napate Pathen, Abraham le Isaac chule Jacob Pathen kahi,’ ati.
‘Nakeng te nia konin nakengchot te ni sut lhan, ijeh-inem itile nadinna chu muntheng ahi.
Egypt gama kamite kibolsetna kaven kamu chentai, chule apen gin’u kajan apuidoh diuva hung kumlha kahi; hijeh chun tun hungin Egypt’a kasol ding nahi,’ ati.
“Hiche Mose amahon apaidal’uva, ‘Vaipo le thutan a kon na tun beh am?’ atipau, hichepa tah hi Pathenin hamboh lah a ahenga hung kilah Vantil ban thahat’a ama ho vaipo le huhdoh din asoltai.
Amahin Israelte ahinpuidoh chun Egypt gama jong Twikhanglen san mun le gamthip noiya kum som li sungin thil kidang dang le melchihna tampi anabol’e.
Hiche Mose hi ahiye Israel chate jah a, ‘Pathenin nasopiteu lah a kei tobang Themgao khat natundoh peh diu ahi,’ tia sei chu.
Gamthip laiya Houbunga anapanga, i-pu i-pateu toh pang khoma Sinai mol’a Vantil toh kihouva, eiho pehson dia hinna Thupeh lapa chu ama hi ahin,
i-pu ipateu ama noiya alut nom pouvin, asondoh-un alungthimun pouvin, asondoh-un alungthimun Egypt lam angai cha jingun,
Aaron jah a, ‘Kamasanguva lamkai din Pathen lim tobang ho neisempeh-un, ajeh chu Egypt’a kona eihin puidoh pau hiche Mose chu achunga ipi soh hitam kahetapouve,’ atiuvin ahi.
Hiti chun amahon hiche lai hin bongnou lim asemun, hiche lai hin bongnou lim asemun, hiche koma hin kilhaina abol’uvin, akhut’a asemsau thi ho ja nan golnop abol’uve.

Moloch houna ponbuh po leuvin, Rephan ahsi pathen limsemthu napo leuvin Hiche nasemsau thil ho hi houdin nago meu! Hijeh a chu Babylon kal’a katolmang diu nahiuve,’ akiti.
I-pu i-pateuvin gamthip laiya, Alim kigon namu bang bangin ponbuh san,’ tia Mose jah a thusei Pathenin avetsah hettosah na Houbuh chu neiyun,
hiche hi i-pu i-pateuvin alason’un, Joshua lamkainaa Pathenin i-pu i-pateu masanga chiding namdangte anodoh a amahon gam alo lai geiyun ahinpo lut’uvin, David nikho lai geiyin aume;
David chu Pathen angsunga lungset achanjeh-in Jacob Pathen Inmun amudoh din athume.
Ahinla in chu Solomonin asahpeh bouve.

Ijakai Keiman kakhut tah a Kasemsa hilou ham?” tin aseiye,’ ati.

Napu napateuvin Themgao koipen bolset louva akoiyum? Alhacha Theng hung masanga anaseiphong masa chengse athat’uvin, nang hon tuna ma najoh doh-un nathattauve,
chule Vantiltea kona Danthu kilahsaon nang ho nahiuvin, nit la nanit pouve,” ati.
Asei chengse ngaiho chu alungthimu atongkhan athimah cheh-un Stephen chu ha agoikhum cheh-uve,

“Ven, van akihon’a Mihem Chapa chu Pathen jetlama ding kamui!” ati.

khopi polama aleh doh-un songin aseptauve. Ahetoh a pang hon Saul kiti gol-lhang khat kengbul’a aponsil’u akoiyuve.
Mihon Stephen songa asepet’u chun aman ahin samin, “Pakai Jesu, ka-lhagao lan!” tin aseiye.
Hichun aboh khup’in going tah-in asamin, “Pakai, hiche chonsetna hi amaho chunga simdan!” ati. Hiche hi aseiyin akijamdap deltai.
Hiche nikho hin Jerusalema Houbung chunga hesoh gentheina lentah achutan, Solchah ho tilou adangse Judea gam le Samariagama ajamchehsoh heltauve.
Hougut mi phabep’in Stephen chu avuiyun, hakan akauve.
Saul vang chun Houbung suhmangna din in tin’a alut’in numei pasal aman’in ajendoh doh jengin songkul’a akhum thu thui.
Mi ajamcheh ho chu avah leuvin Kipana Thupha thu aseiphongin apangjo tauve.
Philip jong Samaria khopia achesuh-in miho jah a Messiah chu aseiphongtai.
Mipi hon asei chengse ajah uva melchihna abol ho amu phat’un lung khat tah-in Philip thuseiho chu lung lut cheh-in angaiyui.
Ajeh chu mi tamtah a konin lhagaoboh ho hapenin apengun ahung potdoh doh jengun, ;angthi ho le elbai ho geiya damdoh dodh jeng ahiuvin,
khopi sunga chun kipana tampi asohdoh tai.

ama hi aneova pat alen geiyin lung lut tah-in athu angaiyun, “hichepa hi pathen tha hat chungnung kiti chu ahi,” atiuve.
phat sottah amitpheldoi chu amaho kidang tah a avetsah jingjeh-in lung khat tah-in angai nasauve.
Ahin Philip’in Pathen Lenggam le jesu Christa mina Kipana Thupha aseiphong tahsan chengse chu numei jong pasal jong baptize achansahtai.
Simon amatah jengin jong atahsanin, baptize achan jouvin Philip toh akiloiyin, melchihna le tha neina nasatah tah a thil kidang abol ho amu leh adatmo lheh jengin ahi.
Jerusalema um solchah hon Samaria khopin jong Pathen thu akisantauve, ti ajah phat’un ahenguva Peter le John asolpeh-un,
amani ahung suh lhonin amaho chu Lhagao theng achan theina diuvin ataopeh lhone;
ajeh chu Pakai Jesu min’a baptize chang bep ahinalaiyun, alah-uva khat beh jong Lhagao Theng chang loulai ahi.

Ahinla Peterin ajah a, “Nasumle nangma manthan, Pathen thilpeh suma chohjou dol’in nagel’in ahi!
Pathen maiya nalungthimput adih loujeh-in hiche thua hin namu jong aumpon, chan jong naneipoi.

ijeh-inem itile cheikha khaveng vung banga kha adih louva kihen nahi kamui,” ati.
Simonin adonbut’in, “Nasei chengse hi khatcha kachunga achuh louna din nangmin Pakai henga kei khel’in neitaopeh lhonin,” ati.
Peter le Johnin Pakai thu ahettosah lhona aseisoh phat lhonin Jerusalema ahung kile kit lhonin, Samaria miho kho tamtah a Kipana Thupha asei phong peh lhone.
Pakaiya kon Vantil khat’in Philip jah a thu aseiyin, “Kipatdoh-in lang Jerusalema kona Gaza jotna lamlena khun lhanglama chesuh temin,” ati; alam len chu donlouva kikoithip ahitai.
Philip jong akipat’in acheleh ven, Ethiopia mi nukiso, Ethiopia lengnu Candace Semangpa, agou chengse chunga vaihom, Jerusalema Pathen hou dia ‘hung,
akile kit lamin akangtalai chunga atounaa Isaiah Themgao lekhabua asim’e.
Hichun Lhagaovin Philip jah a, “Chen lang hiche kangtalai khu lhonpin,” ati.
Hijeh chun Philip alhailut jeng leh Isaiah themgao lekhabu asimgin ajan, hichun, “Nasim chu nahet hinai?’ atileh;
aman, “Hoiya, mikhattouvin eihilchet lou leh iti kahet ding ham?” atin, Philip chu hung ‘kaldoh a amatoh toukhom din agah kouve.
Aman Pathen lekhabu asimna laimun chu hiche hi ahi: “Ama chu tha dinga kikai kelngoi bang le Kelngao nou amulvoupa ang’a paopoh lou bangin kam cheng khat jong keh louvin aum’e.
Kineosahnaa thu adih-in atanpeh pouvin, Ama khaggui hi kon asei ding hitam?Ajeh chu leiset’a kona ahinkho kiladoh ahitai,” kiti lai ahi.
Nukisopan Philip agah houvin, “Neihil chen temin, Themgaopan ama chung chang thua ha, midang khattou thua hiche hi asei ham?” ati.

Lampia ahung kijot jot lhon leh twi veina khat’a ahung lhonin, nukisopan agah houvin, “Ven twihi, baptize kachanmona ding ipi um am?” atileh;
Philip’in ajah a, “Nalungthim pumpia natahsan leh baptize chang theiyin nate,” ati. Aman, “jesu Christa chu Pathen Chapa ahi, ti katahsan nai,” ati.
Chuin nukisopan kangtalai chu angah din aseiyin, anilhonin akumlha lhonin twi lah a chun Philip le nukisopa alut lhonin, Philip’in nukisopa chu baptize achansah tai.
Twi lah a kona ahungkaldoh phat lhonin Pakaiya kon Lhagaovin Philip chu alhoh mangin nukisopan amukit tapon, ahivangin ache na lampia kipah tah-in achepaitai.
Ahinla Philip chu Azotus khopia akimudoh-in, chule aman Caesatea alhun kahsen achepeh-in Kipana Thupha asei phongpeh-e.

chuche lampia kai jouse chu koi koi hijongleh numei pasal amudoh chan kan’a Jerusalema ahinkai lut theina din Damascus khopia Houthua kikhopna in dudnga peh din lekha agathume.
Acheleh Damascus khopi ahin phah ding konin phot lot louvin van’a konin vah khat’in akimvel asalvah soh jengtai.
Hichun ama tol’a akileh lhan, ogin khat’in ajah a, “Saul, Saul, ibol’a nangin neibol set set ham?” ati.
Ahinla aman, “Vo Pakai nang koi nahim?” atileh; Aman, “Keima nabolset jing Jesu chu kahi;
hijongleh kipatdoh-in lang khopi sunga khun lut’in, chuteng ipi nabol ding kiseipeh nan nate,” ati.
Alhonpi miho chu paopoh uhsa beihel’in adding thip chet’un, ogin chu aja nauvin koima amupouve.
Saul chu tol’a konin ahung ding doh-in amit te ni ahasah vangin imacha amutapon, hijeh chun mihon akhut’in akaiyun Damascus khosunga apuilut tauve.
Nithum sungin khomu louvin aumtan, nelou donlouvin aumtai.

Hichun Pakaiyin ajah a, “Kipat’in lang, ‘Lamjangpet kiti khosung lamlen khu jonin, Judas in’a tarsua a lungkon Sual kitipa chu gaholin; ven, ama ataopet ahin,
aman Themgao thilmua mu aneina Ananias kiti mikhat hunga kho amukit theina dia achunga khut a-ngap ding amui’,’ ati.
Ahinla Ananias chun adonbut’in, “Pakai, hiche mipa thudol itobang tah aJerusalema name thengte ijat’a abolset hitam, ti mi tamtah a kona kijataa;

Ahivangin Pakaiyin ajah a, “Chen, ama hi namdangte le leng ho, chule Israel chate angsunga kamin po le dia manchah a kalhen ahi;
ijeh-inem itile Keima min jal’a ijatvei hesoh genthei athoh ding jong kavetsah ding ahi,” ati.

apet pet chun Houthua kikhopna in dung jousea Jesu kiti hichepa chu Pathen Chapa ahi, tin asamle tai.

Ahinla Saul chu asei ahattou tel tul tan, Jesu chu Messiah ahimongtai, tin Damascus khopia Juda ho chu anelkhupsoh keiye.

Hichun Barnabas-in Paul solchah ho henga apuiyin, ajahuva itobanga lampia chu Pakaiamu’a, Pakaiyin ajah a thu aseiya, chule Damascus khopia chu aman itobang tah a hangsan’a Jesu min’a thu asei ahilchentai.

hiche lai hin amanu anan athitai; mihon asil jou phat’uvin indan chungnunga alupsahui.

ama hi hougut tah, ama le a-insung mi aboncha Pathen gingte, miho thilpeh a hongphal tah, chule Pathena tao jing ahi.
Amahin nikhat nilhah lam nidan thum donin Themgao thilmua mu aneinaa hunga ajah a, “Cornelius,” ahinti kichentah-in amui.

Chule tun Joppaa mi sol’in lang Peter kiti Simon chu gapuisah tan;
ama chu Twikhanglen panga cheng, savun sem Simon in’a alhunge,” ati.

Hitia akihoupi pum hin insunga alut leh mi tampi kikhom agatoh-in,
hijeh chun aman ajah-uvah, “Juda min jatchom mi kiloipia ahenga kholai leh hi Dan toh akitolou nang hon jong nahecheh-ui; ahinla Pathenin mihem koima aboh le atheng lou kiti louna din eivetsah tai;

Joppaa mi sol’in lang Peter kiti Simon chu gakousah tan; ama chu Twikhanglen panga cheng savun sem Simon in’a lhung ahi,’ ati.

chitin namtin lah a koi hileh Ama ginga adih bol jouse chu ama dia santhei ahicheh-e,

Judea gamsung le Jerusalema thil hichengse abol hetoh a pang keiho kahiuve; ama chu thinga akhaiyun athat tauve.

japi heng ahilou vangin Pathenin hettohsah a pang dia alhentum keiho heng ahin; hiti chun thinaa kona athodoh nungin Amatoh kanekhom kadon khom’uve;

Themgao jousen Ama thudol ahttohsah-u ahin, koi hileh Ama tahsan jouse chu Ama min jal’a chonset ngaidamna amu ding aseiyui,” ati.
Peterin hiche hi asei nalaiyin thu ngaiho jouse chunga Lhagao Theng achutai.

Ijeh-inem itile paochom chom thoa Pathen avahchoiyu chu ajah-u ahi. Chutah chun Peterin adonbut’in,
“Eiho chan banga Lhagao Theng changtaa hite ho Baptize channa ding twi kham theididng koiham?”

solchah ho le Judea gamsunga sopiten chiding namdangten jong Pathen thu akisanu hi ajatauve.

“Joppa khopia katao leh gao kachangin, Thengao thilmua mu kanei na-a thilpheng hep hop khat van’a kona aninglia hung kikhai lhaa, keima komcha hung ki-nga kamun,
phatecha kavet chenset leh neh thei ganhing nam kim, chunga leng vachate kamui.
Hichun ogin khat hin kajah a, ‘Peter, kipat’in that’in lang nen, ati kajai.
Ahinla keiman, ‘Hithei hih hel’inte Pakai, thilboh le atheng lou imacha kakamsunga lut kha louhel ahi,’ kati.
Ahivangin ogin chun van’a konin nivei chan nan eihindohbut’in, ‘Pathenin asuh thengsa chu bohsa hih-in, eiti.
Hitobang hin thumvei ahung kibol’in van’a akitol toutai.
Hichun ven, hichepet tah ahi Caesarea kona kahenga hung kisol mi thum chu kalhunna in maiya ana ding tauve.
Lhagaovin ma lung sa-ih louhel’a amaho chutoh lhona kache din eiseipeh-e. Hicheng sopi gup ho jong hin eilhonpuiuvin, mipa insunga chun kaluttauve.
Mipa chun kajah-uva a-in a Vantil ding amun, ‘Joppa mi sol’in lang Peter kiti Simon chu gakousahtan,
aman nang le na-insung pumpi huhhinga naum na diu Thupha naseipeh dingu ahi,’ ati thu aseitai.
Ajahuva thusei kagah kipat panbep leh abul’a eiho chunga achuh bang chun amaho chunga jong Lhagao Theng achutai.
Hichun kenjong Pakaiyin, ‘Johnin twiya baptize achansah ahin, nang ho vang Lhagao Thenga baptize nachansah diu ahi,’ ati chu kageldoh-e.
Chutia Pathenin Pakai Jesu christa itahsanuva eipeh-u thilpeh tobang chu amaho jong apeh leh, kei koi kahiya Pathen kakham thei ding ham?” ati.
Amahon hiche hi ajah phat’un aneldauvin, Pathen avahchoiyun, “Ahile Pathenin chiding namdang te jong hinna dia lung heina apeh ahita ong!” atiuve.
Thoh hahsa asoa Stephen kitha lo jeh a jamcheh chengse chu Phoenicia le Cyprus chule Antioch geiyin acheuvin, koima dang jah a seilouvin Judate henga Thu chu aseileuve.
Ahin alah-uva phabep Cyprus le Cyrene miho, Antioch ahung lhun phat’un Greek miho toh akihouvun Pakai Jesu aseiphongtauve.
Amaho chu Pakaiyin aban thahat’in ahu jingun, hijeh chun Pakaiya atahsan mitamtah akihei luttauve.
Hiche thu hi Jerusalema Houbungin ajatan, hijeh chun Barnabas chu Antioch geiyin asol’un,
ama ahungleh Pathenin alungset nau amun akipah lheh jengin, ama ho chu Pakaiya lunggil tah a um chah jing din atilkhouvin ahi;
ajeh ch Barnabs hi mipha le Lhagao Theng dimset chule tahsan det mi ahi. Mi tampi Pakaiya alutbe tauve.
Barnabas chu Saul hol din Tarsus a achen,
Saul amudoh phat’in Antioch a ahinpuiye. Kum khat lhingset amanin miho chu Houbunga akikhoppi ji lhonin, mi tampi ahil lhonin, hiche Antioch khoa hi seijuite chu ‘Chritian’ ahinsah masah pen’u ahi.
Hiche lai hin Themgao phabep Jerusalema konin Antioch a achesuh-ui;
chuin alah-uva amin Agabus kitipa chu akipatdoh-in Lhagao thahat’in vannoi pumpia kel lhah ding asei masan, hiche hi Claudius nikho laiyin aguilhunge.
Hijeh chun seijuite chu ajikham cheh a thil tokhoma Judea gama sopite thot dingin akiloltauve;
adongkhom’un Barnabas le Saul khut’ah Houbung upate agah thot’ui.
Hiche lai hin Herod lengpan Houbung mi konkhat chunga ban-gol khautah-inna atongin abolsetai.
John upa Jacob chu chemjamin athattai.
Amitha hin Juda miho along lhaisah amun, Peter jong amatbe kit’e, aphat hi cholsolou changlhah kut lai ahiye.
Peter amat chun songkul’a akhumin, mi li lia kiloi sepaiho chun kilhauva a-nga diduvin apedoh-in, kalchuh ku tkichai tang mipi ang’a puidoh dingin agoi.
Hiti hin songkul’a akhumtan, ahinla Houbungin ama din lung luttah-in Pathen henga ataopeh-uve.
Herod-in Peter chu puidoh dinga agotin jan chun Peter, a-ngah sepaite kah a a-ihmun, thih khao nin akihenin, kotpi bul’a jong a-ngah a pang sepaiho adding jingui.
Hichun ven, Pakaiya kon Vantil khat ahung kilah-in, akikhumna bom sung avahcahnsel’e; Vantil chun Peter pang abengin asukhangin, “kipatdoh loiyin!” ati. Chutah chun akhut te nia akihenna thih khao te ni chu akilhamtai.
Chuin Vantil chun ajah a, “Nakong kigahin nakengchot te ni kise loiyin,” ati. Aman chutin aboltai. Chuin ajaha, “Naponin kihiutup loiyin neihin juiyin,” ati.
Peter apotdoh-in ama chu ajuitai; hichea chun Vantil thilbol chu atahbeh a soh-in agelpon, gaochanga mu aneiyin agelbouve.
Vantil le Peter chun kotngah masa le ani na akhel lhon leh khopi sung lutna thih kotkha apha lhonin, kotkhah chu ama ni dingin acham tah-in akihong jengin, apotdoh lhonin khosung lamlen khat ajui lhonleh Vantil chung Peter adalhapaitai.
hichun Peter akhangdoh lap’in “Tua vang Pakaiyin avantil ahinsol’a Herod ban thahat le Judate kinepna chengsea eihuhdoh ahitai, ti kahedoh tai,” ati.
Ahetdoh phat hin Peter chu aminchom Mark kiti John nu Mary in’a ahungleh mi tampi kikhomin anataovui.
Aman kot pi nung chu akiu leh donbut din amin Rhoda kiti lhacha numei khat ahunge,
ahin Peter ogin ahi ahetdoh phat’in akipah behseh jengin kot honta louvin alhai lut’in kot po lama Peter din thu chu agaseiphong jo tai.
Ahinla mihon amanu jah a, “A-gol’a nahi,” atiuve. Amanun atah mong ahi thu asei tei tei vangin, amahon, “A-Vantil hiya chu,” atibep’ui.
Ahinla Peterin kot akiu kiu jeng phat’in agah hon’u leh ama amu cheh-un kidang asalheh jenguve.
Hichun Peterin athip behna diuvin khut ajap’in, Pakaiyin itobanga kidangtah a songkul’a kona ahin puidoh ham, ti thu aseiyin, “Hicheng thusoh hi Jacob le sopite gaseipeh tauvin,” atin, apotdoh-in munchoma achetai.
Khovah vah-in Peter chung change thusoh jeh chun sepaiho lah a boina lentah asodoh tai.
Herod chun Peter ahol’a amudoh jou lou phat’in a-ngah a pang ho thu atantai. Amavang chu Judea gama konin Caesarea achesuh-in chukoma aumdentai.
herod chu Tyre le Sidon mite chunga along hang lheh jenge; hijeh chun agam miho loikhat ahungun, lengpa Semanga pang Blastus chu athu nun’un cham lensah din athum’ui; ijeh-inem itileh agam miteu chun Herod lengpa gama neh le chah akilah-u ahiye.
Akitepniuvin Herod chun lengpon chol akisil’in, laltouna atouvin, ajah-uva thu aseiye.
Hichun mipin asam’un, “Mihem ogin ahibouve,” atiuve.
Aman loupina chu Pathen pelouva aumjeh-in hiche pettah chun Pakaiya kon Vantil khat’in adengin, lungin anen athitai.
Pathen thu vang achal jal’in akhatou cheh tai.
Barnabas le Saul vang chu kin achaisoh lhon phat’in aminchom Mark kiti John chu ahinpui lhonin Jerusalema konin ahungkile kit lhontai.
Antioch khoa Houbunga chun Themgao le mihilphabep aumun; amahon chu Barnabas, Nigerkiti Simeon, Cyrene gam mi Lucius, gambih vaipo Herod toh seilet tha Manaen chule Saul ahiuve.
Amaho chu Pakai kinbol’a an a-ngol laitah-un Lhagao thengin, “Kakouna natong din Barnabas le Saul neipedoh-uvin,” ati.
Hijeh chun an ngol’a atao jouvun achung lhona thenso khut ngap abol’un asoldoh tauve.
Lhagao Theng sol’a konin Barnabas le Saul chu Seleucia ajonsuh lhonin, chua pat’in Cyprus lama akitol lhontai.
Salamis kho alhun phat lhonin Judate Houthua kikhopna in hoa Pathen thu aseiphong lhonin, akithopi lhon ding John jong ahiuve.
Twikol gamsung achotsoh-uva Paphos kho ahung gei phat’in Juda mi Temgao lhem, mitpheldoi them Bar-Jesu kitipa chu amudoh tauve;
ama hi twikol gamvaipopa, Sergius Paulus, milung chingtah chutoh kihe ahin, gamvaipopan Pathen thu asei lhon ngai dingin Barnabas le Saul chu akouve.
Hichea chun mitpheldoi thempa Greek paova amin Elymas jong atipau chun amani thusei adoudal len gamvaipopan atahsan louna ding aboltai.
Chuin Paul kitipa Saul chu Lhagao Theng adimset’in amapa chu ave changel’in,
“Vo thilpha jouse doudal, lhep lhahna le nambolna dimset, Diabol son, Pakai lampi dih heikonle ding nabol hi natat lou lai ding ham?
Tun ven, Pakaiyin nachunga khut alhatai, phat chom khat sunga nisa vah him him namu loudidng ahi,” atileh; apettah chun meijing le muthimin ahintomin, kho amulou jeh chun akhut’a kaile ding mi aholtai.
Hichun Gamvaipopan thilsoh chu amun Pakai thudol kihilna kidang asan atahsantai.
Paul le aloite ni chu Paphos a konin akitol’un Pamphylia gama perga kho alhungun, Johnin amani dalhan Jerusalema ahung kile kittai.
Paul le Barnabas vang achepai lhonin Pisidia gama Antioch kho alhung lhonin Choldo nikhon Houthua kikhopna in’a alut’in atou lhontai.
Danthubu le Themgao lekhabu akisim chaiyin Houthua kikhopna in vaihonpan miho asol’in ajah lhona, “sopite ni mipi tilkhouna ding thu nanei lhon leh sei lhonin,” agatisah-e.
Hijeh chun Paul adingdoh-in khut ajah-in aseiyin: “Israel mite le Pathen gingte jousen ngaiyun.
Hiche Isreal mite Pathen chun i-pu i-pateu analhengdoh-in, Egypt gama apemlaiyun achoi len lheh jengin, aban thahat panin ahinpuidohtai.
Kum som li tobang sungin pa naovah bangin gamthip noiya akhan chah-u aven,
chuin Canaan gamsunga mihem nam sagi asuhmang phat’in agam’u chu agoulo diuvin apen,
kum ja li le som nga geiyin achenguve. Hiche nung chun Samuel Themgao nikho lai geiyin amaho chu Thutan vaibol ho apen ahi.
Chuin amahon leng athum’u leh Pathenin Benjamin phunga Kish chapa Saul chu kum som li geiyin akoipeh-e.
Pathenin Saul chu apaidoh nungin aleng thudol’a hin Keiman kalung dei tah David, Jesse chapa kamudoh tai, aman kalungdei chan abol ding ahi,’ tin hettohsahnan aseitai.
David chilhah a kon hin thutep dungjuiyin Pathenin Huhhingpa Jesu chu ahinlhut tan ahi.
Jesu kiphondoh masang hin Johnin lungheiya baptize chan ding thu Israel mipi henga aseiphonge.
John chun atoh achaisoh ding konin, ‘Nang hon kei hi koiya neigel’um? Keima Ama chukahipoi; amavang ven, kanunga khat ahunge, kei hi Ama kengchot khao te ni sut lham dia jong kilom kahipoi,’ ati.
“Abraham chilhah sopite le nalah-uva Pathen ging miho, hiche Huhhingna thu hi eiho henga hung kithot ahitai.
Ijeh-inem itile Jerusalema ilengteu le avaipouteuvin Ama chu anahedoh pouvin, Choldo niseh le kisimji Themgao thuseiho hcu guilhunsah nan hekhen louvin Ama chu themmo achan’un,
athina thei lom themmona amudoh jou lou geiyun jong Pilate henga atha na din a-ngeh-uve;
achung chang thudol kisei jouse asuh bulhingsoh phat’un thing chunga akikhainaa konin adom lhauvin avuitauve.
Ahinla Pathenin Ama chu thinaa konin akaithouvin,
nikho phabep pi sungin Galiee gama pat Jerusalem lama alhonpi miho henga akilah jin, amaho chu tua hi mipi henga hettohsah a pang ahiuve.
Chule pu le pate henga hungsoh dinga kiteppeh thutep chu keihon kipah tah a kaseiphongu ahi,
hiche chu Pathenin achateu eiho henga aguilhunsah nan Jesu chu akaithouvin, athudol hi labu ninaa akisunin: ‘Nangma kachapa, Tunia kahin nahi,’ akiti.
Mon mangna mu louhel dinga Pathenin thinaa kona akaithou thudol chu hiti jong hin aseiye: ‘Keiman David kipe thonlou le atheng Phattheina kapeh ding nahiuve,’ akiti.
Aman labu munchom khat’a jong aseiyin: ‘Nalhentum lhachapa chu Nangin mon mang dia naphaldoh lou idndg ahi,’ akiti.
David vang chun ama khang laiyin Pathen toh akivuithan, mon mangna amutan,
Pathenin akai thou kitpan van gmin mangna amupoi.
Hijeh a chu hiche hi nahet cheh diu ahi sopite, Jesu jal’a chonset jouse ngaidamna thudodl nahenguva kaseiphongu ahin, Mose Danthua kona them nachan jou louna jouseuva chu
koi hile atahsan chan them chang’ah ahi.
Hijeh chun Themgaoho thusei nachunguva ahung chuh louna din ching theiyun:
‘Veuvin nahsahmo ho, Kidang sauvin lang mangthah-un; Ajeh chu nanikho laiyun thil Hitobang thil hi min seipeh jong leu chun natahsan lou hel diu ahi,’ tia asei chu,” ati.
Akikhendoh phat’un mihon Choldo nikit jongleh ajah-uva hiche ho aseipeh kit diuvin a-ngeh-uve.
Houthua kikhopna in’a akikhendoh dodh-uvin Juda mi tampi le Juda houva kilalut ah hougut tampin Paul le Barnabas nung ajuiyun, amanin amaho chu Pathen lungset naa umdet jing din atilkhou lhone.
Choldo nikit’in akhothing hel tobangin Pakai thu kisei ngai didngin akikhomtauve.
Mipi kihonlel lul’a akikhop jengu chu Juda hon amudoh phat’un athangseuvin, Paul thuseichu ataitom’un anel kale tauve.
Ahinla Paul le Barnabas hangtah-in thu asei lhonin, “Pathen thu hi amasaa nang ho seipeh lou khoh ahin, nang hon napai manguva tonsot hinna chang dia kilom nakisah louvu leh, ven chiding namdangte henga kihei tauvinge.
Ijeh-inem itile Pakaiyin keiho hitia hi eiseipeh-u ahi: ‘Keiman nang hi chidnag nam dang salvah dia katun’a, Vannoi pumpia sochatna lampi dia katun nahi,’ tia asei ahi,” ati.
Chidang namdang hon hicheng hi ajah phat’un akipah-un Pakai thu kisei chu achoi-an’un tonsot hinna chang dia kigosadema um hon atahsan tauve.
Chuin Pakai thu hiche gamkol sungsea chun achalsoh tai.
Amavang Juda mihon hougut numei lal ho le khopi sunga lamkaiho atilseuvin, Paul le Barnabas abolset sah-uvin agamkol sunguva konin adeldohsah tauve.
Amanin amaho dounan akeng phanga leivui athin lhah khum lhonin Iconium lama ache lhontai.
Seijui ho vang chu kipana le Lhagao thengin adimsetu’ve.
Iconium khoa Juda ho Houthua kikhopna in’a alut khom lhonin, hitima chun thu asei lhon le Judate le Greek mi tampin atahsan tauve.
Hichun Juda mi atahsang lou hon sopite dounan chiding namdang ho atilseuvin adsulung hangtauve.
Ahivangin ama ni sotpi anichong lhonin, alungsetna thu hettohsah a amani khut’a melchihna thil kidang tampi bolsah Pakaiya hangtah-in thu asei jom jing lhone.
Hichun khopi sung miho chu kehni akisouvin, abang Juda miho langa apangun, abang solchah te ni lama apangui.
Ahinla chiding namdang ho le Juda mi phabep’in alamkaiteu toh kithon amani chu nahsahmoa bol’a songa seding agouvin ahile,
amanin ahetdoh lhon phat’in Lycania khopi Lystra le Derbe chule akimvel gamsunga ajamlut lhontai;
hikom dunga jong chun Kipana Thupha aseiphong lhone.
Lystra khoa chun apen’a pat kengbai, itih a jong lamjot louhel, akeng chasah thei lou hel pasal khat atouvin ahi.
Amahin Paul thusei angaiyin, Paul’in avechangmel’in ahileh damsah theina kham tahsan anei chu amun,
oging tah in, “nakeng te nin ding jangin,” ati. Mipa chu ahung kichomdoh jengin avah le paitai.
Mipin Paul thilbol chu amu phat’uvin Lycaonia paovin oging tah-in, “Eiho lah a Pathen ho chu mihem lim’a hung kumlha ahitauve!” tin asamtauve.
Barnabas chu Zeus asah-un, Paul chu thusei lamkai ahijeh-in Hermes asah-uve.
Chule khopi maiya ahouin kisa Zeus doi Thempupan bongchal ho ahinkaiyin pahvui ho jong ahinchoiyin dongkot phunga mipi chutoh amani hounaa kilhaina gan tha din agouve.
Ahinla solchah te ni Barnabas le Paul’in ajahdoh lhon phat’in aponsil abottel jeng lhonin mipi lah a alhai lut lhonin apengjah lhontan,
“Miho, idia hiti ho hi nabol’u ham? Keini jong nang ho banga mihem kahi lhonin, hitobang pannabei thil hoa kona hi van le leiset chule Twikhanglen le asunga um jouse Sempa, Pathen hing jing henga nakiheina diuva Kipana Thupha kaseipeh lhon nahibouvui.
Aman khang masa laiyin chitin namtin hi Ama dei cheh a chon din alhan,
ahivangin Ama ipi ahichu hettohsahna beiyin akoidehpoi, ajeh chu thilpha aboljin, van’a konin gotwi napeuvin, muchi chivo gaphat, kumkihei chin nakoipeh-un, neh le chah napeuvin, nalungthimu kipa le thanopna adim jinge,” ati lhone.
Hicheng hi asei lhonin amani houna dinga gan athagot’u chu asutang nah nah lhone.
Hichea chun Antioch le Iconiuma kona hung Juda mihon mipi chu athu anun’un Paul chu songin asesah-un, athi ahitai, tin khopi polama akaidohtauve.
Ahinla akoma seijuite adin pet’uvin Paul athoudoh-in khopi sunga aluttai; ajing nikhon Barnabas toh Derbe lama ache lhontan ahi,
Hiche khopia chu Kipana Thupha aseiphong lhona, seijuitampi asemdoh jou lhonin Lystra le Iconium chule Antioch lama ahung kile kit lhonin,
genthei hesoh tampi thoh a Pathen lenggama ilut mong diu ahi tin tahsana pang det jing dingin seijuiho atilkhou lhon in alungu asuhal lhon’e.
Houbung jousea Houbung upa alhenpeh lhonin, an ngol’in ataovun, atahsanpau Pakaiyah upa ho chu apedoh doh jenguve.
Paul le Barnabas-in Pisidia ajotpa lhoin Pamphylia alhung lhonin,
Perga thu aseiphong jou lhonin Attalia achesuh lhontai.
Chua konin kongin akitol lhonin, ahintoh chaisoh lhon hiche natoh tong dinga Pathen lungsetnaa akipehdohna lhon khopi, Antioch jonin ache lhontai.
Ahung lhun lhon phat’in Houbung mi abonchan akhom lhonin, Pathenin amani amanchah a atoh jouse aseidoh lhonin, chiding namdangte dia tahsan lam kihon thu asei lhon’e.
Antioch khoa seijuite toh sotpi aumkhomna lhon chu phat chomcha ahipoi.
Judea gama konin mi phabep ahungun sopite chu, “Mose Danthu dungjuiya chepnatan louvu leh huhhingin umthei pouvin nate,” tin ahiltauve.
Hiche thudol’a chun Paul le Barnabas toh akihanel lheh jengun akinahso phat’un athu ngaito khom din Paul le Barnabas to midang phabep toh Jerusalema chea Solchah ho le upaho toh kihoutoh din alhengdoh tauve.
Houbung sol’a konin amaho acheuvin Phoenicia le Samaria ajot pepeh-un, chidnag namdang ho Pathena akiheilut thu aseipeh-u le sopite cheng akipah lheh-ui.
Jerusalem alhun phat’un Houbung miho le Solchah ho chule Houbung upahon analamtouvin, ama hon ajah-uva Pathenin amaho amanchah a na atoh chengse aseiyuve.
Hichea hin atahsansa ahivanga Pharisee loi hinalai mi phabep akipatdoh-un, “Amaho chu chep tanpeh a Mose Danthu anit tei diu ahi,” tin asei yui.
Solchah ho le Houbung upaho hiche thu ngaito ding hin akikhom tauve.
Tamtah a kholtohna anei nungun Peter akipatdoh-in ajahuva, “Sopite, masang chun nang ho lah a kona keima kama hi chiding namdangten Kipana Thupha ajah-uva atahsanna diuva keima Pathenin eilhendoh chu naheuve,
chule mei lungthim hesoh Pathenin ahenguva ahettohsah-in, eiho eipeh bangun amaho jong Lhagao Theng apei;
ei ho le amaho kah a dat neichom louvin tahsanin alungthimu asuthengtai.
Chuti ahileh ibol’a tua ipu ipateu leh eihon jong ipoh jou louvu namkoljon chu seijuite lengkouva naseuva Pathen napatep’u ham?
Keihon vang Pakai Jesu lungset vanga tahsan jal’a huhhinga eiho i-um diu banga amaho jong chute dinga katahsanu ahi,” ati.
Akikhom mipi chu athip chet jengun, Barnabas le Paul’in Pahtenin amani amanchah achidang namdangte lah a melchihna ho le thil kidang aboldoh ho asei lhon chu angaisoh keiyuve.
Amanin thu asei chai lhonin Jacob’in adonbut’in, “Sopite kasei ngai ta diuvin!
Simonin chiding namdangte Pathenin avil’a alah-uva kona ama min’a ding mi alhendoh thu aseitai.
Hiche hi Themgaoho thusei toh akitoh soh keiyin hitin akisune:
‘Hiche nung hileh Keima hung kile kit’ing ting, Alhusa David houbuh chu kasah phat’a; A-in gem jouse kasah phat ding, Katundoh kit ding ahi;
Chutia chu mihem amoh chengsen Pakai ahol theiyuva, Kamin a kikou chiding namdang jousen jong ahol thei ding, atin,
khanglui laiya pat hicheng thil ho hetsah Pakaiyin aseiye,’ kiti ahi.
Hijeh chun chidang namdang ho lah a kona Pathen lama hung kiheiho lah a kona Pathen lama hung kiheiho chu bolgenthei dau hite, tin ka-ngaitoi;
amavang amaho chu lekha thot’u hitin, doi houna thil thenglou neh, jon thanghoi, alol kimeh a kithatsa le thisan neh a kona kitim them din hil’u hite;
ijeh-inem itile khanglui laiya pat Mose’in khop jouseah athusei ding anei jingin, Choldo nikho seh leh ama thudol Houthua kikhopna in jouse akisim jenge;” ati.
Solchah ho leh Houbung upaho chule Houbung pumpi lung gel’in alah-uva kona mi lhendoh a Paul le Barnabas toh Antioch khoa sol din pha asauvin, Barsabbas kiti Judas le Silas, sopiten ajabol cheh te ni chu alhengun,
aban’a kisei bang hin asun’un amani khut’a athot tauve; “Solchah ho leh Houbung upa, sopite chengsen, Antioch leh Syria chule Cilicia gama um chidang namdang ho lah a sopite chengse kasalam’ui.
Keiho lah a konin mi koi koiham kei ho thupeh louhel’in ahungun thu tampin nahung sulung jingun lung ling laovin nakoiyui, ti kajauve;
hijeh chun keihon lung khat tah-in mi lhendoh a amaho chu nahenguva i-ngailut tah-u Barnabas le Paul toh hinsol tha ding pha kasauve,
amaho hi i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa min’a ahinkho phal ngam cheh ahiuve.
Hijeh a chu Judas le Silas kahinsol’u ahin, amanin jong hiti amaho hi thuchangin seipeh nauvinte.
Ijeh-inem itile Lhagao Thengin jong keihon jong akhoh cheh ho tilou pohgih hahsa dang na chunguva koi lou ding pha kasauvin,
limsemthu houna doisa, hicheng hi neh dauvin, jon thanhoiya konin kikangse leu chun pha ding hi, damsel’uvin,” atiuve.
Amaho chu alhah doh phat’un Antioch khoa achesuhuvin, mipi akhop khomsoh phat’uvin lekha thot chu apetauve.
Miho chun asimu leh tikhouna thuho chu akipapi lheh jenguve.
Judas le Silas hi anilhona Themgao gel ahilhonjeh-in sopite chu thu tampin atikhou lhonin ahatsah cheh lheh lhon’e.
Chukoma chom khat set aum jou lhonin ahinsol ho henga dingin sopiten amani chu lung mongin alhadoh tauve.
Silas vang chu anichon ding joh aphat jeh-in aum den tai.
Paul le Barnabas chu Antioch khoa mi tamtah toh aum khom lhonin, Pakai thu ahil chenin aseiphong lhon’e.
Phat chom khat nungin Paul chun Barnabas jah a, “Hungin Pakai thu i-naseiphongna khopi jousea chekit hitin sopite chu itobanga iti nauvem gave hite,” ati.
Hichun Barnabas-in Mark kitipa John chu amani toh kilhona pui din angaitoi.
Ahinla Paul’in Pamphylia amani dalhaa na tohkhompi nom lou mi chutoh kilhon khom lou ding thilpha pen ahisah e.
Hijeh chun Paul le Barnabas akihanel ten lhon phat’in akikhenlo lhonin, Barnabas chun Mark akipuiyin Cyprus lam jonin kongin akitol’in,
Paul’in vang Silas akilhenin, sopiten jong Pakai lungsetnan alhadoh-un, ama jong akipatdohtai.
Paul chun Syria le Cilicia ajotpeh-in Houbung jouse atilkhoupeh-in ahi.
Paul chu Derbe kho le Lystra khoa ahunge. Ven, Lystra khoa chun apa Greek mi, atahsan Juda numei khat cha amin Timothy kit seijui khat aumin,
ama hi Lystra kho le Iconium khoa sopite jousen aseipha lheh jengui.
Paul’in Timothy hi kilhonpi ding adeijeh-in, chute dunga um Judah on apa Greek mi ahi ahetjeh-uvin apuiyin chep atanpeh e.
Hichun amahon khopi jouse achonsoh keiyun, Jerusalema Solchah ho le upaho kilolna chengse chu nit din miho apeleuvin ahi.
Hijeh chun Houbung ho chu tahsan lama ahat cheh cheh jengun, niseh-in amijat apun be be jenguve.
Amahon Asia gamsunga thu asei diu Lhagao Thengin akham jeh-in Phrygia le Galatia gamkol sungse ajotsoh keiyun,
Mysia gam gal ahung gei phat’uvin Bithynia lut ding akigot’u leh Jesu Lhagaovin aphalpeh pouve;
hijeh chunMysia gam ajot paiyun Troas a achesuh tauve.
Hiche jan chun Paul agaochan naa mu aneiyin, Macedonia mi khat hi ahungna dingin ataovin, “Macedonia hung galkaiyin neihung kithopiuvin,” ati.
Paul’in gaochan naa mu anei jou jou hin Pathenin Kipana Thupha chu miho hil dinga eikouvu ahi, tin kagel’uvin Macedonia gama chelut ding kasompaitauve.
Troas a pat kakitol’uvin paljangin Samothrace kajon’un, ajing nikhon Neapolis kalhunguve;
hichea kon chun Macedonia gam kolsunga khopi minthang pen, Rome mite tolpi Philippi kalhung tauve. Hiche khopia hin nikho phabeppi kanichongui.
Choldo nikhon taona mun khat aume, ti kaginchat nau khopi dongkot polam vadung panga chun kacheuvin, katouvun numei hung kikhomho jah a thu kaseitauve.
Kathuseiyu ngaiya numei khat chu amin Lydia ahin, Thytira khopia hung kon, ponsandup joh a pang, Pathen hou khat ahi, Paul thuseiho lung luttah a angaina din Pakaiyin along kot ahonpeh tai.
Amanu hi-ainsung mite to baptize achan phat’in, “Pakai tahsan tah beh a neigel’u leh ka-in’a hung lhunguvin,” tin eijol’uvin, eithu nun tauvin ahi.
Taona muna chu kacheu le khonung thusoh ding seiya apute dinga phatchomna lentah mupeh lhagaoboh vop soh nu-ngah khat hin eitoh khauvin ahi.
Hiche nu hin Paul le keiho nung ajuiyin, “Hiche miho hi Pathen chungnung pen lhachate ahiuvin, huhhingna lampi nahung hil’u ahi,” tin asam sam jenge.
Hitobang hin nikho tampi sungin abol jinge. Paul’in athei chimjeh phat’in akiheiyin lhagao jah achun, “Hiche nua koon chun hung potdoh jengin, tia Jesu Christa min a kasol nahi,” atileh; hichepet tah chun lhagao chu apotdoh tai.
Aputeu akinepnau phatchom na aneidiu sum mu na ding abeitai, ti amudoh phat’un Paul le Silas chu aman’uvin kailhang mun’a vaipoho ang sunga akailutauve;
hitia hi thutan vaihomho heng alhut phat’un, “Hiche mi te ni hi Juda mi ahi lhonin, i-kho sungu asuboi lheh jeng lhontai.
Ama nin Rome mi eiho dinga jop thei lou le lah thei lou chondan sodoh dingin ago lhon’e,” atiuve.
Mipin ma amani anokhum jeng phat’uvin, vaipoten aponsil lhon ahoh lhauvin mol’a voh din thupeh aneitauve.
Mol’a tamtah vei avoh jouvun songkul’a akhum’uvin, songkul ngahpa chun kitup keiya a-nga din ahilchah tauve.
Hitobanga hil chahna aneijeh-uvin songkul ngahpan songkul sung nung lama akoiyin, akhochong lhon’a bul atuh-in ahi.
Jan khangkim donin Paul le Silas Pathen henga atao lhona la asah lhon le sohchang dang hon angaiyuve;
hichun photlot louvin lingnasa tah ahung kihot’in ahile songkul bul ahot kangsoh tan, apettah chun kotpi jouse akihong don tan, akihen nau bul jouse geiyin akilhamsohtai.
Songkul ngahpa ahung kin khah le kotkhah jouse kihongsa um chu amun, sohchang jouse jamdoh hitante, tin ama kithah din achemjam asatdoh jenge.
Hichun Paul’in going tah-in asamin, “Kithat didng kigo hih hel’in keiho ka-umsoh keinauve,” ati.
Chuphat’in aman meivah athum loiyin alhai lut’in, kichaa kithing thingin Paul le Silas angsunga alhu jengin,
chuin amani chu ahinpuidoh-in, “Put e ni, huhhinga ka-umna dinga kabol khoh pen ding ipi ham?” atileh;
Amanin, “Pakai Jesu tahsan le chun nang le na-insung mi huhhinga naum diu ahi,” ati.
Hiti hin ama le a-insunga um chengse jah a Pakai thu aseipeh lhontai.
Hiche nidanle le hin janlaiyin songkul ngahpan amani chu apuiyin, avoh nau maha jouse asop theng peh-in, a-insung mite le ama baptize achangtai.
Chujouvin amani chu ain’a ahinpuitouvin a-angsung lhona ankong aluipeh-in, Pathen atahsan jeh chun a-insung mite jouse to kipah thanom khom-uve.
Khovah phat’in vaipoten mi man sole ho asol’uvin, “Mi te ni chu lhadoh tauvin,” agatisah-ui.
Hichun songkul ngahpan athu sei chengsu hi Paul jah a aseiyin, “Vaipoten nangni lhadohna thu sei din mi ahinsoltai; hijeh chun tun hungdoh lhonin lang lung mongin ch lhontan,” ati.
Ahi vangin Paul’in miho jah achun, “Rome mi kihiya themmona beiya amahon japi maiya eivouva songkul’a eikhum’uva, tua guh thim’a iti tilhadoh diu ham? Hitheiponte, amahon eihung puidoh-u hem,” ati.
Mi man sole hon athu hi vaipote heng alhut’u le, Rome mi ahi ti ajah phat’un akicha cheh kit’un,
hijeh chun aheng lhona kiphat lam thu ahung seiyun, apuidohuvin khopia kona potdoh dingin ajoltauve.
Hiti chun amani songkul’a apotdoh-in Lydia avepa lhonin sopite to akimuto’uvin, atil khou lhonin apotdoh lhontai.
Amphipolis le Apollonia jotpaiya Thessalonica khoa ahung lhon leh hia chun Juda ho Houthua kikhopna in khat aum’e.
Achonna ngai banga Paul chu ahenguva alut’in, Choldo nikho thum sungin Pathen lekhabua konin mipichu akinelpi jin,
Messiah chun gin genthei athoh tei ding le thinaa kona atodoh tei ding thu ahilchenin phot chena aseipeh-in, “Nahenguva kaphondoh hiche Jesu hi Messiah chu ahitai,” ati.
Hichun alah-uva mi phabep’in dih asauvin paul le Silas ajop’un, Pathen ging Greek mi tampin chule numei lal ho lah a jop’a jong atamuve.
Chutah chun Juda miho athangseuvin, khopi sung lamlen dunga pananbei mithase phabep akhomun, khopi sunga boina lentah asosah-uvin, Jason in abulu’vin, Paul le Silas ahol’un mipi lah a kaidoh din ago’uve.
Amani amu lou phat’un Jason le sopite phabep pi khopi sung vaipote angsunga akailut’un, “Hiche ho hi vannoi akhup athal’a leh ho chu ahiuvin, hikom ahinphah-u ahitai,
Jason hin amaho alhunsah-in, ‘Jesu kiti leng chom khat aum’e,’ tin Caeasar thupeh chengse kal lhahnan abonchan na atongui,” tin asam’uve.
Hicheng hi ajah phat’un mipi le khopi sung vaipote jong anoh lheh jenguvin,
hijehchun Jason le midang hoa kilhadoh man alauvin amani chu alhadoh tauve.
Sopiten kinloi tah-in ajan janin Paul le Silas chu Berea khoa asoltauve; alhun lhon phat’in Juda ho Houthua kikhopna in’a alut lhon’e.
Berea khoa Juda miho chu Thessalonica khoa ho sangin along lenjo’uvin, lung opkai louhel’in thu asangun, athilsoh ho chu chute mong nam tin niseh le Pathen lekha to avetoh jiuve.
Hichea hin mi tampin atahsan lo tauvin, Greek mi numei lel ho le pasal ho jong atahan atam’uve.
Thessalonica khoa Juda mihon Barea khoa jong Paul’in Pathen thu asei phong ahet phat’un chukoma jong mipi ahung tiles kit tauve.
chuphat’in sopiten Paul chu Twikhanglen pamlama asol pai jengun, Silas le Timothy vang chua aumden lhon’e.
Paul gathah hon Ahen khopi geiyin apuiyun, Paul’in Silas le Timothy chu ahenga hung loi ding adeina thupeh kengin ama ho ahung kile kittauve.
Paul’in Athen khopia Silas le Timothy a-nga pet’in khopi sunga limsemthudoi dimset’a kikoi amudoh-in alunng nalheh jenge.
Hijeh chun Houthua kikhopna in’a miho le Pathen ging ho toh akinel’in, kailhangdunga jong niseh leh ato phah chant oh akinel nel ji’e.
Hichea hin Epicurea loi le Stoic loi chihgut mihon Paul akinelpiuvin, alah-uva mi kon khat’in, “Hiche kamtam belbulpa hin ipi asei ding hi-nga na?” atiuvin, adang hon ma, “Gamdang miho hou, doi le kao asei ahitoh-e,” atiuve. Hiche hi ama Jesu le athodoh kit thu aseiphongjeh ahi.
Mihon Paul chu aman’un Areopagus molvum kikhopnaa apuiyun, “Hiche nasei thuhil thah hi kahetbe thei diu ham?
Ajeh chu kajah-uva nasei abang bang hi alamdang lheh jengin, hijeh a chu hiche ho hi ipi kiseina mong ham ti kahet chet nom’u ahi,” atiuve.
Athens kho mite le akhosunga cheng gamdang mi abonchauva ima dang gel louva thuthah thah seina le ngai naa phat amanjiu ahi.
Hichun Paul Areopagus lai lunga adingin miho adonbut’in, “Athen kho mite, ima lam jousea nang ho hi hougut tah nahiu kamui.
Ijeh-inem itile nahou mun chengu kavet le naa ‘Hetphah lou Pathen ding,’ tia kijih maicham khat kamu doh-e. Hiche nang hon het louva nahouvu hi keiman nahenguva kahung seiphong ahi.
Vannoi leiset le asunga um thil jouse sem Pathen, van le leiset Pakai chu mihem dem thu doiphung dunga apansapoi;
thil ngaichat nei banga mihem khutsoh a jen lun glhai thei jong ahipoi; Amatah-in mi jouse ahinsah, ahaitheisah a chule thil ijakai apeh joh ahibouve.
Aman mihem khat’a kona leiset chunga chang ding chitin namtin hijat asemdoh a, gamgi asekhenpeh cheh a aphat teppeh a achensah ahi;
amahon Pathen chu kinemtah a hol’uva amaikhah thei na diuva ahol ahin, ahinla Ama chu eiho koimacha dia jong gamla lou ahiye;
ijeh-inem itile: ‘Eiho Ama jal’a hinga, Chatloh, chule Amaa ihiuve,’tin nalah-uva chiguh sun hon aseiyui; ‘Tahbeh-in eiho ama chilhah ahiuve,’ tin aseinauve.
Eiho jong Pathen chilhah ihijeh-uva chu mihem lunggel le khut them man chah a sana ham, dangka ham, song ham a limsemthu tobang chu Pathen hinte tia igel lou diu ahi.
Het loulai khang chu Pathenin avet thim ahin, tun vang mutin’a mi jouse lung aheina diuvin thu apei,
ipijeh-inem itileh aman amilhendohpa amanchah a thudih a vannoi leiset hi thu atanna dinga nikho khat atepsa ahitan, hiche hi tahsan din amilhendohpa chu thinaa konin akaithoutai,” ati.
Thinaa kona thodoh kit thu ajah phat’un, mi phabep’in anuisat uvin, adang hon vang, “Hiche nasei hi ka-ngaikit nom’ui,” atiuve.
Hichun Paul alailunguva konin apotdohtai.
Mi phabep’in vang akilhonpiuvin atahsan tauve, alahuva hin Areopagus a kikhomji lah a mi Dionysius le Demaris kiti numei khat le adang ho jong ahiuve.
Hiche jou vin Paul’in Athens dalhan Corinth ajontai.
Hichea hin Claudius lengpan Judate aboncha Rome a kona potdoh dia thu apeh jeh a Italy gama kona ajinu Priscilla toh hung lhungtil, Pontus gama peng Juda mi amin Aquila kiti chu akimupin, aheng lhona achen,
pon in sem ahicheh jeh-uvinm akiveinau akitha khat ahijeh chun akom lhona apansan na atongkhom’uve.
Choldo niseh leh Houthua kikhopna in’a Juda ho l eGreek mite chu thu aseitohpi jin jol lut tei din agoji’e.
Macedonia gama kona Silas le Timothy ahung lhun phat’in, Paul chu thu seiphongin bou apangin, Juda ho henga Jesu chu Messiah ahidol ahettohsah-e.
Ahinla amahon adoudal’un, ataitomuleh, Paul’in aponsil ho athingin ajah-uva, “Manthaina naneiyu leh nang hon ma nakipoh diu ahi! Keiman themmona kaneipoi! Tua kalvang chiding namdang te henga kachei!” ati.
Hiti chun chua konin achen Pathen ngaisah tah mi amin Titus Justus kitipa in’a aluttai; ama in chu Houthua kikhopna in bantah ma ahi.
Houthua kikhopna in vaipo Crispus chun a-insung mi chengse toh Pakai atahsanin, chule athu ja Corinth mi tampin jong atahsanun baptize achangtauve.
Jan’a Paul’in Themgao thilmua mu aneinaa Pakaiyin, “kichat dan, umthim louhel’in seijom jingin;
ajeh chu Keiman ka-umpi jingin, koiman suhset dia nanokhum lou ding ahi; ijeh-inem iti le hiche khopi sung jenga jong mihem tampi kaneiye,” ati.
Hijeh chun Paul kum khat le lhagup alah-uva apansan Pathen thu ahil hil jenge.
Achaia gam gamvaipoa Gallio apan laiyin Juda ho apangkhomun Paul aman’uvin thutannaa ahinkailut’un,
“Hichepa hin chonna dan nagilouva Pathen hou din miho ajol lha lhai,” atiuve.
