Hichea hi Paul pao akigot leh Gallio chun Juda ho jah a, “Vo Juda ho, namiheh nau hi suhkhelna ham khan gitlouna ham thu hileh kangaipeh ding nahiuvin,
nang ho Danthua le min ho thudol vang nang hon kivet tup tauvin, hiche hoa hin keima thutanin pang ponge,” ati.
Hiti hin thutanaa konin aban nodohtai.
Amahon Houthua kikhopna in vaipo Sothenes chu aman’un thutanna in mai laitah a avoh jeng vangun, Gallio chun donin aseppoi.
Paul chu nisot tah sopite toh aumkhomin, chuin amaho chutoh akilhan, Priscilla le Aquila toh lhonin Syria lam ajontai. Cenchreas khoa kitepna anei jeh-in sam akivoi.
Ephesus kho ahung lhun’un Paul’in amani dalhan, Houthua kikhopna in’a alut’in Juda ho toh thu asuitoh-ui.
Amahon nichong sot jep dia alho vangun anompon,
amaho toh akilhan, “Pathen lungdei ahileh nahenguva hung kit nange” atin, Ephesus khoa konin apotdohtai.
Paul Caesarea khopia akumlhan, Jerusalema achetouvin Houbung miho salam agabol’in, Antioch lama achesuh paitai.
Chukoma chomkhat aum nungin akipatdoh-in Galitia le Phrygia gamkol muntin akhol len, seijuite aphutdet len ahi.
Juda mi Alexandria peng, amin Apollos kiti khat Ephesus khopia ahungin, amahi thusei them le Pathen lekhabua themtah jong ahi.
Apollos chu Pakai lampi kihil themsa, Lhagaova gunchu tah ahin, Jesu thudol aseiyin kitoh chet’in ahilnan, ahivangin John baptize chandol chubou anahei.
Ama hi akipat’in Houthua kikhopna in’a hakattah-in thu aseiye; ahinla Prisilla le Aquilan athusei ajah lhon phat’in apui lhonin Pathen lampi chu kichentah-in ahilchen lhone.
Apollos chu Achaiiiia gama ache nom phat’in sopiten atilkhou’un seijuiten anasan theina diuvin phatseina lekha jong asutpeh-ui. Ahung lhunin lungset vanga atahsante chengse hatah-in akithopi;
ijeh-inem itile Jesu chu Messiah ahidol Pathen lekhabua konin phot chetna tampin Juda ho chu japi maiya anel khuptai.
Apollos Corinth khopia aumpet’in Paul chun sahgam lam alhahpeh-in Ephesus khopia ahungle hikoma chun seijui phabep amun,
hiche ho jah achun “Natahsan’uva chu Lhagao Theng nachanu hinam?” atileh; amahon ajah a, “Lhagao Theng aum’e, tobon kija kha loulaiya,” atiuve.
Chuphat’in Paul’in, “Ipipen tah a ba baptize chang nahiuvem?” atileh; amahon, “John baptize chansah bangin,” atiuve.
Hichun Paul’in, “John chun lung heina dinga baptize achansah a, anunga hung dingpa, Jesu chu atahsan theina diuva miho aseipeh ahibouve,’ ati.
Hichu ajah phat’un amaho Pakai Jesu minin baptize achangun,
Paul’in achunguva akhut te ni a-ngap le Lhagao Theng achunguva ahung chun, amahon paochom chom thon gaothu aseitauve.
Abon’un mi som le ni tobang bep ahiuve.
paul chu Houthua kikhopna in’ah alut’in, kicha louhel’in lha thum sungin miho chu Pathen leng gam thu asuitohpin, jollut tei din agoi.
Ahinla mi phabep alouchal’a atahsan louvu toh chule mipi maiya chuche Lampi chu aseiset phat’uvin Paul’in amaho chu adalhan, seijuite apuidoh-in, niseh le Tyrannus kihilna in’a akihoulimpiji’e.
Kum ni sunga hitia hi abol lehAsia gama cheng, Juda ho le Greek mite geiyin Pakai thu ajasoh tauve.
Pathenin thil kidang seithei louhel hel Paul khut’in aboltan,
Paul ultheh pon le a-op tomna pon ho san achoiyun ana damlouho henga apoh lut’u leh anat nauvin alhauvin lhagaoboh jo jong apotdohjitai.
Hichun Juda mi vahvei doithemnaa kivah loiyin jong lhagaoboh vopte chunga Pakai Jesu min apan’un, “Paul’in aseiphongle Jesu jal’a kahahsel nahiuve,” atitauve.
Hitia bol ho chu Juda mi thempu pipu Sceva chapate ahiuve.
Ahinla lhagaoboh chun adanbut’in ajah-uva, “ken Jesu kahen Paul jong kahenai; nang ho koi nahiuvam?” ati.
Chuin lhagaoboh voppa chu achomin achunguva achuh jengle mi ni athajo paiyin, abonchauva athajosoh phat’in in’a kon chun sagoh keo le mapun ajamdoh tauve.
Athusoh hi Ephesus khopia cheng Juda mi jouse le Greek mi jousen ahesoh tauvin, akicha lheh jenguve; hijeh chun Pakai Jesu min aloupi cheh tai.
Atahnsan ho jong ahungun japi maiya atahsanu chu aphongdoh-un athilbol’u aseidoh tauve.
Mitpheldoi them tampin alekha jouseu ahinpo khom’un mitin mitmun ahalvam’uve; ahalvam sangsom nga alhinge.
Hiti hin Pakai thu hahattah-in akhang touvin ajousohtai.
Thilsoh hicheng kichai nung hin Paul’in alungthimin Macedonia le Achaia gam chotsoh a Jerusalema chepai ding. “Hiche kichai soh teng Rome kagamutei ding ahi.” Ati.
Ahivangin alhacha Timothy le Erastus Macedonia gama, asol’in, ama Asia gama chom khat aum nalaiye.
Hiche lai hin chuche Lampi thudol’a boina chu thuneo them ahitapoi.
Ijeh-inem itile dang ka kheng them Demetrius kiti mi khat hin Artemis doilim houna inlim dangkaa asemdoh a, dangka kheng themho dia kiveina asohdoh chu thil neocha ahipoi.
Hiche miho hi le asumkol veinau kibahpi chengse akoukhomin, “Mihem ho, hiche akiveinauva kona haodoh ihiunahecheh-ui.
Ephesus khopi sung goh hilouvin Asia gam pumpi chansah pai ding ahitan, hiche Paul hin mihem khut’a kisemthu ho hi Pathen ahipoi, tia mi aloi loiya tamtah ajol lhah a aheimang gam ahitai, ti mujong namu’uvin he jong naheuve.
Hichea hi ikiveinau manlou asoding kichat aumgoh hilouvin ipathen len nu Artemis houin geiya nahsahmoa hung kibol’a, Asia gam pumpi le vannoi pumpin ahou cheh Pathen len nu geiya suhjuma hung umtah bah ding ahi,” ati.
Mihon hichu ajah tah-un along hang lheh jengun, “Ephesus mite Artemis alen’e,” tin asam cheh-ui.
Hiti chun akhothingiin alingsoh jengun, mihon Paul toh hung jinkhom Massssedonia gam mi Gaius le Aristarchus chu aman’un japi lemkhomna in’a alhoh lut jengui.
Paul chu japi lailunga agalutnom vangin seijuiten aphal pouve;
Asia gam vaipo aloite phabep man japi lenkhomna in’a ahunglut louhelna din mi ahinsol’un ahung kham’ui.
Akikhom chengse chun ipi jeh a kikhom ahiu ahetchet loujeh-un aboi lhehjengun, abang in thu khat asamun, kimkhat man thuchom khat asam’ui.
Mipi phabep’in vang Judah on japi maiya ahinsot lut’u Alexander chu a ngoh-un, hijeh chun Alexanderin japi maiya akihonna seidin khut ajep’e.
Ahin mihon ma chu Juda mi ahi ahetdoh phat’un, “Ephesus mite Artemis alen’e!” tin o-khat tah-in nidan ni jen asam sam jengui.
Hichun khopi sung lekha sunpan mipi aphoh thip’in, “Ephesus kho mite, Ephesus khopia hi Artemis len nu le van’a kona hung lenglha song theng kikoi ahi kon ahetmoa nabol’u ham?
Hiche thil ho hi seitoh ahilou het’a thip beh a na-um’uva kholtoh louva jong chu namoh bol lou diu ahi.
Hichea nahinkai lut jengu miho jong hi houin choma la ahipouvin, Pathen nu taitoma jong ahipouve.
Hichejeh chun Demetrius le atoh khompi khut them hon mi khattou chunga lung lhai louna aneiyule kihehna in honsa ahin, thutan vaihom ho jong aum nauve, akiheh nom nom gakiheh tauhen.
Hiche kalval’a thudang nahol’u aum vangleh angaiyin khoppilen teng seitoh ding ahibouve.
Ajeh chu tuni boina thua hi mipi tilsea eiki-ngoh diu tijat kichentah a seithei ding jong i-umpouvin ahi,” ati.
Khopi boina athip phat’in Paul’in seijuite akoukhomin, amaho atilkhou nungin akilhahpin Macedonia gam jonin akipatdohtai.
Macedonia gamkol sungse se achotsoh a tilkhouna nasatah anei jouvin Greek gama ahung lhungtai.
Hiche gama chun lhathum achamin, Syria gam jon’a achegot leh Judah on achanlhih jeh-un, Macedonia gam jot lhungkei kit din akigotai.
Hichun Beroea khoa Pyrrhus chapa Sopater chun alhonpin, Thessalonica khoa Aristarchus le Secundus, Derbe khoa Gaius le Timothy, Asia gam mi tychicus le Trophimus jong ahiuve.
Amaho hi anacheuvin troas khoa eina ngah-ui;
keiho vang cholsolou changlhah kut jouvin phillippi khopia konin kongin kakitol’un ni-nga lhin nin Troas khoa ahengu kalhungun, hikoma chun ni sagi kanichongui.
Choldo nikho jou ni masa nia changlhah nekhom din kakikhop’u le Paul’in ajing nikhoa che ding agot jeh-in jan khangkim geiyin miho thu ahil hil jenge.
Chungnung indan kakikhop nauva chun meivah tampi akivah-e.
Hichea chu gollhang amin Eutychus kiti khat bangkot geiya tou ahin, Paul’in thu aseisot jeh chun golhangpa hi aihmut asoh behseh jengin, anaihmu lhutan, chungnung indan thumnaa konin alha mangin ahileh athisan agaphongdoh-ui.
Hichun Paul akumlhan golhangpa akoichah denin, “Tija hih-un, ajeh chu asunga ahinkho aum nalaiye,” ati.
paul akaltouvin changlhah ahehbal bal’in, anen, jingkah khovah lhah geiyin miho to akihoulimin, chuin apotdohtai.
Mihon gollhangpa chu ahingin akipuiyun seithei louhel’in along mongui.
Keihon kong lam kajon’un, Paul chu kong sunga lalut din Assos lama kakitol’ui; ijeh-inem itile aman hiche geiya chu kenglama che ding agot ahiye.
Paul’in Assos mun’a eikimupi phat’un konga kalalut’uvin Mitylene lang kajontauve.
Chua konin konga kakitol’un ajing nikhon Chios gal kalhungui; athai nin Samos kalhungun, athai nin Miletus kalhung tauve.
Ijeh-inem itile Paul’in ahithei leh Pentecost nikhoa Jerusalema lhun tei ding agot jeh-in, Asia gama umsot louna din konga kitol’a Ephesus khopi chu palam ajotpa ding agot ahitai.
Paul’in Miletus khoa konin Houbung upaho kou din Ephesus khoa mi asol’e.
UPaho ahenga ahung phat’in Paul chun ajah-uvah, “Asia gam kahin chotlut’a pat hitih chan’a hi itobang nang ho toh kalhat khom umchan naheuvin,
Juda hon eichan lhih jinguva thoh hesoh tampi kachunga alhunvangin nun nemtah le mit lhi pumin Pakai kin kabol jing jin;
itobang tah a in beihel’a thil phachom ding chu japi lah hihen intin hijongle nang ho kahilji hitam!
Juda ho hihen Greek mite hijongle kibang cheh-in Pathen lama lung aheiyuva i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa atahsanna diuvin kahetsahji’e.
Chule tan ven, Lhagaova kigahna jeh-in Jerusalem lam kajonin, chukoma kahcunga ipi ahung lhun ding kahepoi;
khopi jousea kanchalna le hesoh gentheinan ei-nga jing bou Lhagao thengin eihetsah ahi.
Ahivangin Pathen lungset Kipana Thupha hettohsah ding Pakai Jesua kalah katoh ding kin hi kamolso poule kahinkho jeng jong hi imacha man din ka-it chapoi.
Nalah-uva chelae Pathen langgam seiphongle kahin, ahinla ven, nang hon kamai namukit louhel diu tan kahetai.
Hijeh a chu tunia kichentah a kaseipeh nahiuve, amangthah um jongleur chun mi kapopoi;
ijeh-inem itile nahenguva Pathen lungdei apumpia hetsah lou in mang kaneipoi.
Kichih thieyun lang nachin diuva Lhagao Thengin napeh-u kelngaohon chunga jong ching theiyun, Pathenin athisana achohsa a-Hobung chu ching them’uvin.
Kache nungle ngei giloutah tah nalah-uva hung lut’a kelngoihon hi adep louhel dingkahetai;
nang ho lah akona jongmi hung kipat’uva thu akaleh akalouva seiya seijuite phabep geiya apui manguva akijuisah diu ahi.
Hijeh chun kiging phauvin, kum thum sunga tang louhel’a sun le jan’a mit lhi puma nachang cheh-uva katilkhou jing chu geldoh jingun.
Chule tua hi nang ho khantousah thei le suh thengsa ho lah a gou chankhomsah thei Pathen le alungset thua nang ho kakhum lut nahitauve.
Koima dangka sana, nihchen ponsil kadeipoi.
Kei le kaloi ho ngaichat chan hiche kakhut te ni hin abol bulhit jing nang ho tah-in nahet’u ahi.
Pakai Jesu amatah-in,’Lah sangin peh nopnajo ahi,’ ati chu geldoh jinga na hatoh a alhasam chatmo ho kithopi theina dia thil ijakai najui diuvin kavetsahsoh tauve,” ati.
Paul’in thu hicheng aseiyin dilsun abonchauvin ataopitai.
Chutah-in abonchauvin akap-un, Paul akoiyun achop’uve;
ajahuva, amai amukit lou diu aseijeh tah jong chun na asa behseh jengun ahi. Chuin kong mun geiyin ahung thah-ui.
Upaho toh kakilhauvin jangkeiyin kongin kakitol’un Cos kalhungui; ajingin Rhodes kalhungun, chua konin Patera kalhunguve;
chuin Phoenica jotpa ding kong khat kamu’vin, kong chun katouvun kakitoltauve.
Cyprus twikol akimu phah phat’in veilam ngan kapel’un Syria lam jonin kakitol paiyun, konga thil solhah ding aumjeh-in Tyre khopia ka-ki-ngauve.
Seijuiho kaholdohun hikoma chun ni sagi kanichongui; Lhagaova konin amaho hin Paul Jerusalema ache ding ajadauve.
Nikho chujat kanichon jouvun kakipatdoh-uvin kholjin ban kamasot tauve; hichea hin seijuite chu ajite achateu pumin khopi kulpamgeiyin eihung thah-un, Twikhanglen pamchin’a dilsun kataovun, khat kaht’in kakilhauvin,
keiho kong sunga kakaldoh-un, amaho inlama akiletauve.
Twichung kholjin chainan Tyre a konin Ptolemais gei kaki tol’un, hikoma chun sopite salam kabol’un akom’uvah nikhat kanichongui.
Ajing nikhon kakipatdoh-un Caeasarea kalhungun, sagi lah a Philip Evangelist pu in’a kalut’uvin amatoh ka-um khom’uve.
Philip hin cha nu jinei loulai cheh li aneiyin, amaho hi gaothuseiyin apangui.
Nikho phabeppi chukoma ka-um laiyu hin Judea gama konin amin Agabus kiti Themgao khat ahungsuh-in,
kahengu ahinjonin Paul konggah chu alan akhut te ni le akeng te ni akikanin, “Lhagao Thengin hitia hi, Jerusalema Juda mihon hiche konggah neipa akan’uva chiding namdang ho khut’a apehdoh diu ahi,’ tin aseiye,” ati.
Hichu kajah phat’un keiho le chukoma um mihon Paul chu Jerusalema chetou lou din kaholtauve.
Ahinla Paul’in adonbut’in, “Ibol nahiuva kap’a kalung nasuhdoiyu ham? Ajeh chu kanchal ding keo hilouva Jerusalema Pakai Jesu min’a thi dinga kogosadema um kahi,” ati.
kathu nun joulou phat’un kahaiyun, “Pakai lunggot got himai hen,” katitauve.
Nikho phabep jouvin kakigouvin Jerusalema kachetouvun,
Caesarea konin seijui phabep’in eilhonpiuvin, amaho hin kalhunna dingpau, Cyprus twikol’a mi Mnason kitipa in’a chun eipuilut’uve.
Jerusalem kalhun’u le sopiten kipah tah-in eina sangui.
Ajingnikhon keiho toh lhonin Paul chu Jacob kimupin achen, upaho chengse jong akimkeiyui.
Amaho asalam soh phat’in Paul’in alhacha natohnaa kona chiding namdangte lah a Pathen thilbol chengse chu abonchan aseitai.
Amahon hichu ajah phat’un Pathen avahchoiyuvin ajah a, “Sopi, atahsan te lah a Juda mi sang ijat pang tam ti namui, abonchauva Danthua tom ngaitah ahiuvin,
nang hin chiding nam dan glah a cheng Juda mihon Moses Danthu apaiyuva, achateu chep tandaa chule puchon pachon adonda diuvin ahil’in asei lei tin min aseipeh-uve.
Ipi iti ding hitam? Nahunghi la ajah tei diu ahitan;
Hichea hin i-khat seipeh unge hichu bol’in; kitepna neisa mi li kaneiyun,
amaho hi puiyin lang acholamu topeh-in, nangma jeng jong amaho hitoh kisuthengin, chutile sam akivo thei diu ahin, chuteng nangma nasa tah-a chondan nit mi nahi, nachung change thu kithang jou ahidol mitinin ahet soh diu ahi.
Atahsan chiding namdang ho thudol vang hi limsemthu houna doithil neh lou ding, thisan neh lou ding, alol kimeh a kithatsa neh lou ding le jonthanhoi bol lou ding thua lekha ithotsu ahitai,” atiuve.
Chuphat’in Paul’in miho chu apuiyin, ajing nikhoa amatoh kisuh thengna kin abolsoh phat’uvin itih tah le kisuh thengna nikho kichaiya chule amaho mi khat khat dia chu kilhaina gantha itih a kibol ding ham, ti hetsah din Houin agalut’e.
Nisagi alhin ding konchan Asia gama hungkon Juda mihon Houin sunga Paul amudoh-un, japi atilseuvin achunga khut alhauvin aman’un,
“Israel mite, neipanhu’uvin, muntin’a mipi le Danthu chule hiche mun douna thu hil lepa ama hi ahi; hiche keo chu hilouvin Houin sunga Greek miho ahinpuilut’in hiche Muntheng phung ho asubohtai,” tin asamtauve.
Miho chun Paul le Ephesus gam mi Trouphimus khopi sunga akiloile amujeh-uva Houin sunga jong apuilut tei dia agin mou ahi.
Chutah chun khopumpi akithingun, mipi alhaikhom loiyun Paul chu aman’uvin Houina konin akaidoh-un, kotpi chengse akhah paitauve.
Mihon Paul tha dia agot lai tah-un Jerusalem kho pumpi boi thu hi sepai vaipipo kam ahung lhungin,
aman jong apettah chun sepai jalamkaiho le sepaihon apuiyin aselsuh jengu leh, mihon sepai vaippipo le sepaiho amuphat’un Paul avohda tauve.
Hichun sepai vaipipon anailut’in Paul amanin, thih khao nia kan din aseiyin, chuin, koihiya ipi asuhset ham ti akholtoh-e.
Ahin mipi lah a abangin thuchom asamun, phabep khat man thuchom beh asamui; hitia chu aboi behseh jeh-u chun ipi mong iti ham ti ahetdoh thei lou phat’in Paul chu kulpi sunga kailut din aseijotai.
Japi aphut deng dung phat’un kalbileiya alempet’in jong Paul chu sepaihon adop thobouvui;
ajeh chu mipin ahinjuipeh-un, “Sumangun!” tin asam jengui.
Paul kulpi sunga akailut kon’un aman sepai vaipopa jah a, “Nahenga thu them khat sei theiying em?” ati leh; aman, “Greek pao nahet’em?
Nang hi Egypt mi, tu masang jep’a mihem sang li jen gamthip laiya loidoh a jelen gal bolsah chu nahilou ham?” ati.
Hichun Paul’in, “Keima Cilicia gam Tarsus khoa cheng Juda mikahin, khopi mai maiya mi kahipoi; nahenga kataove mipi jah a thu neiseisah-in,” ati.
Sepai vaipipon aphalpeh phat’in Paul kalbileiya adingin mipi akhutjap leh, athip chet phat’uvin Paul’in Hebrew paovin thu aseiyin:
“Sopite le pate ho tua na angsunguva kakihonna thu kasei ding hi nei ngaipeh-uvi,” ati.
Paul’in a jah-uva Hebrew paova thu asei ajah phat’un ahathip chehuvin, hichun aman:
“Kei hi Cilicia gam Tarsus khopia cheng Juda mi kahin, hiche khopia Gamaliel khonung juiya, ipu apateu Dan dungjuiya kikheltah a them, tunia nang ho banga hi Pathen dinga tom ngaitah kahi;
hiche Lampi juiho chu thina geiyin kabolsen, numei pasal’in kakanin songkul’a din kapedoh doh jin,
athu hi Thempu chungnung le upa chengse ahetoh ahiuve; amahoa kona hi Damascus khoa um sopite gamat’a kanchal jenga Jerusalema hinpuiya talen matsahna ding lekha kipoh-in kachei.
“Ddamascus kho kom kageiyin, sunkim don hin phulou helouvin van’a konin vah nasatah ahung vahin kakimvel asalvah soh jenge,
keila tola kalhutan, kajah a, “Saul, Saul, ibol’a neibolset set ham?” ti ogin khat kajai.
Kenjong kadonbut’in, ‘Koi nahim Pakai?’ katile, aman kajah a, ‘Nabolset set Nazareth Jesu chu kahi,’ ati.
Kalhonpi hon vah chu amu’vin kahenga thuseipa ogin vang chu ajapouve.
Hichun keiman, ‘Ipi kabol ding hitam Pakai?’ katile, Pakai chun kajah a, ‘Kipatdoh-in lang Damascus khopi sunga lut’in, hikoma chu natoh dia kigo chengse aboncha nakiseipeh ding ahi,’ ati.
Vah loupe behseh jeh-in kho kamutapon, kalhonpi hon khut’in eikaiyun Damascus khosung kaluttai.
“Damascus khoa chun Juda mihon aseiphat cheh-u, Danthu dudngjuiya Pathen ngaisah tah, Ananias kiti mi khat aumin,
ama hi kahenga ahungin kakoma adingin kajah a, ‘Sopi Saul, kho mutan,’ eitileh, hichepettah chun kamit akikeovin ama kamutai.
Chuin aman, ‘Ipu ipateu Pathen chun alunggot he ding le Adihpa mua akamsoh ogin ja dinga nalhen doh ahitai;
ijeh-inem itile nang man nahin mu le najahsah chu Ama dinga mitin henga nahettohsah ding ahi.
Hijeh chun tua ibol’a kho ngai ngai nahim? Kipatdoh-in baptize changing lang, nachonset soplhahna din Ama minin taovin,’ eiti.
“Jerusalema kakile kit phatin Houina katao le Themgao thilmun mu kaneiyin,
hichea chun Pakaiyin kajah a, ‘Kinloi tah-in Jerusalema konin potdoh loiyin, ajeh chu mihon Kei chung chang thudol nahettohsah hi asan lou diu ahi,’ ati.
Kenjong, ‘Pakai, amaho tah-in nangma tahsan ho Houthua kikhopna intin’a kalut’a kamatjia chule kavohji chu aheuve;
chule nathu hettohsah Stephen thisan kiso jong chun akoma kadidngin pha kasan, athat ho ponsil jouse kachoipeh ahi,’ kati.
Hichun Aman kajah a, ‘Chen, ijeh-inem itile gamla tah a chiding namdang ho henga kasol ding nahi,’ eititai,” ati.
Thu hicheng asei athip nauvin, chutah-in a-o khoset’in lhang asam’un, “Hitobang mi chu leiset’a konin sumang jengin, ama chu ahing dia kilom ahipoi!” atiuve.
Chutitah chun kho asam’un aponsil’u aleh-un, van lama leivui akitunsah jengun ahile,
sepai vaipi pon Paul chu kulpi sunga kailut’a, ama douna chutobang tah akho asap jengu chu phot chetna dinga jep din asol’e.
Sepaihon savun khaova akan phat’un Paul’in akoma ding sepai jalamkaipa jah a, “Themmosahna bon um loulaiya Rome mi jep ding chu nang dia dan ngai hinam?” ati.
Sepai jalamkaipan hichu ajah phat’in sepai vaipipo henga achen a jah a, “Ipi bol kigo nahim? Ajeh chu hichepa khu Rome mi hibouva khu men!” agate.
Hijeh chun sepai vaipipo chu ahungin ajah a, “Rome mi nahi mong-em neiseipeh-in?” atileh; aman, “Kahinai,” ati.
Hichun sepai vaipipo adonbut’in, “Ken Rome mi hina hi sumtamtah a kichoa,” atileh; Paul’in, Keivang pen’a hisa kahitai,” ati.
Apettah chun achung thu kholchil kigo ho chu ahaiyun alhamkangun, sepai vaipipopa jong Paul Rome mi khat ahi ahetdoh a chule ama anakan jeng chu akichatai.
Ajing nikhon sepai vaipipon ipijeh pen’a Judah on Paul aheh-u chu hetdohna din Paul akanna alhamin, Thempu pipu ho le Houvaipoloi chengse kikhomsoh din aseiyin, chuin Paul chu ahinpuidoh-in a-angsunguva adinsah-e.
Paul’in Houvaipoloi chu avechangmel’in, “Tuni geiya hi Pathen angsunga lung sa-ihna beihel’a hing jing kahi,” ati.
Chutah chun Thempu pipu Ananias chun Paul koma dingho chu akam behpeh din asol’e.
Chuphat’in Paul’in jong ajah a, “Vo bang kiloibang, Pathenin nang nadenjoh ding ahi! Dan toh kikal’a keima deng dia mi nasol ham?” ati.
Akoma ding hon, “Nangin Pathen Thempu chungnung chutia nahouset jeng ong?” atiuleh;
Paul’in, “Ama Thempu chung nung ahilam kahetlou ahi sopite, ajeh chu, ‘Namite chunga vaipo chunga thuse nasei lou ding ahi,’ tinakisun nai,” ati.
Paul’in miho chu akehkhat Sadducee ahiuva akeh khat Pharisee ahiu ahetdoh phat’in, Houvaipoloi kikhopnaa chun ahinsamin, “Sopite, keima Pharisee chapa Pharisee kahin, mi thi thokit kinepna thu dol’a kathu kibol’a ahi,’ ati.
Paul’in chutia aseiphat’in Pharisee ho le Sadducee ho kah a kinel khenlotauve.
Ijeh-inem itile Sadducee loiyin mi thi thokit hihen Vantil hileh chule lhagao geiya aumsah louvu ahin, Pharisee loiyin vang aboncha aumsah-u ahinai.
Hiti tah chun apoh veng vung jengun, Pharisee loi lah a Danthem ho phabep adingdoh-uvin mipi anellun, “Keihon hichepa chunga thildih lou ima kamupouve, lhagao ahim Vantil ahim khattouvin ajah a thu asei hi hih ding ham?” atiuve.
Akihanelten phat’un sepai vaipipon Paul chu abotel diu ham ti akichan, sepaiho chu chesuh a alah uva kona pumhat’a Paul chu gakaidoh a kulpi sunga lhoh lut jeng din aseipeh-e.
Ajing nilhah-in Paul koma Pakai adingin, “Lung ngamin, Jerusalema kathu nahettohsah banga Rome khopia jong nahettohsah tei ding ahi,” tin aseiye.
Khovah lhah-in Judaten thilgon aneiyun Paul atha masangseuva anneh twidon abol louhel diuvin akihahsel’un akihan lho cheh tauve.
Hitia mi philna thil gong ho chu mi som li val ahiuve.
Amaho hi Thempu pipuho le upaho henga acheuvin, “keihon Paul katha masangseuva neh le chah bol louhel dia khoh tah a kihahsel’a kihan lho kahitauve.
Hijeh chun tun nang hon Houvaipoloi toh kithoa Paul thudol kholchil’a bol dingveh kisauvin, sepai vaipipon nahenguva ahin puina din gahetsah-un; hikom ahinphah kah a that dia kigosadem’a um kahitauve,” agatiuvin ahi.
Ahinla anachan lhih-u thilgon hi Paul sopinu chapan ajadoh-in, hijeh chun achen kulpi sunga alut’in Paul jah a agaseitai.
Chuphat’in Paul chun sepai jalamkaiho khat akouvin, “Hiche gollhangpa hi sepai ding khat aneiye,” ati.
Hijeh chun aman agollhangpa chu apuiyin sepai vaipipo heng alhut’in, “Sohchang Paul khun eikouvin hiche gollhangpa hin nakoma seiding khat aneijeh a nahenga eihin puisah ahi,” ati.
Sepai vaipipon ama chu akhut’in atuh-in munchoma apuidoh-in guh thim chan adongin, “Kakoma sei ding ipi naneiyem?” atile,
aman, “Jing teng Houvaipoloi kikhopnaa achung chang thudol kichen cheh a kholtoh idng banga Paul hi napuisuhna didnga nahenga ngeh ding tin Juda ho akiloltauve.
Hijeh chun athu’u lahpeh hih-in, ajeh chu mi som li valjen Paul atha masangseuva um’uva nangma thupeh ngah maiya um nahitauve,” ati.
Chuphat’in sepai vaipipon gollhangpa chu alhadoh-in, “Hiche neihung seipeh hi koimacha naseipeh louhel ding ahi,” tin agah chah tai.
Sepai vaipipon sepai jalamkai ni akouvin, “Tujan nidan koa Caesarea che din sepai ja ni le sakol sepai som sagi toh, teng choi sepai ja nit oh gonsan koi lhonin;
chule gamvaipo Felix henga bitkeiya pui lhungna din Paul touna ding sakol ho jong ngaitopeh lhonin,” atin;
hiti chun athu dol hi lekha ajih-in:
“Lal chungnungpen gamvaipo Felix, Claudius-in salam kahinboh-e.
Hichepa hi Juda hon aman’un, atha ding kon’uvin sepai ho toh kakon’un, Rome mi ahi kahetjeh-in kagahuhdohtai.
Ahehnau ajeh kahet nompeh-in ama hi Houvaipoloi kikhopnaa kapuisuh leh,
thina thei le kanchahna thei ima abolset jeh a aheh nau kamupon, amaho Danthu dol’a aheh-u ahitohe.
Ama hi tha dia agot’uva achan lhih-u eikiseipeh phat’a khongai louhel’a nahenga kahinsol pai jenga, aheh ho jong nangma maiya aheh nau asei diuva kahil ahitai,” ati.
Sepaihon akiseipeh bangun ajan janin Paul chu apuiyun Antipatris alhut tauve.
Ajing nikhon sakol sepai chengse chutoh kilhon pai din adalhah thauvin, sepai dangse vang kulpi lama ahung kilekit tauve.
Caesarea ahung lhun phat’un lekha thot chu gamvaipo apeuvin, Paul jong akoma adinsahui.
Gamvaipon lekha thot chu asim jou phat’in hoigam poh mi ha ti adoh a Cilicia gam mi ahi ahetdoh phat chun
“Naheh ho ahung lhung teng nathu ngai nange,” atin, Herod inpi thutanna in’a kaiya hentup din aseipeh tai.
Ni nga jouvin thempu chung nung Ananias le upa phabep chule thusuitoh them Tertullus kitipa toh ahungsuh-un, Paul aheh nau thudol chu gamvaipo henga aseiyuve;
chuin agah kouphat’un Tertullus chun aheh nau thu aseipanin: “Lal chungnungpen, nangma jeh’in cham le lung ol’in ka-um’un, chule navaihom them jal’in jong hiche nam mi ding hin phatna tampi akisemdoh-e;
Ima lam jouse le muntin’a thilbol ho hi keihon kipah tah-in kasangui-pu Felix!
Hijongleh tampi seiya nangma phat suhmang din kadeipon, kathuu paltan’a kaseiyu hi lungset’a nei ngaipeh diuva kataotho ahi.
Ijeh-inem itile hichepa hi mi sunoh phah tah, vannoi gamtin’a Juda ho chohsea pang, Nazareth chon’a chonho lamkai pipu ahi ti keihon kamandoh-un,
houin geiya suh boh ding agot’jeh a kahin mat’u ahi; keiho Dan dungjuiya athu katan nomu ahin,
ahinla sepai lamkai Lysias hunga thahat san’a ka khut’uva kona ahung lhoh mang ahi;
aheh ho ma aanga ding din thu apen, nangman dongtoh le chun kahehnau hi adih adih lou abonchan hesoh keinan naete,” ati.
Juda ho jong chun ahunan asei chengse chu adih cheh-in aseiyui.
Gamvaipon thusei didnga akhasuh pha’in Paul’in adonbut’in: “Kum sotpi hiche nam mite chunga thutan vaihom nahi kahen, kipah tah-in keima kihonna thu seiyinge;
nangman nakhol chet thei ahi, keima Jerusalema Pathen hou dinga kache na hi nisom le ni aval hih laiye;
Houin sung hihen Houthua kikhopna in hijongle, kholai dung jeng cha jong mikhattou kakinahpi ham ahiloule jap katilset ham hijongle hiche ho hin eimandoh pouve;
tua eihehna jengu jong hi aphot chetna kichentah-in seithei pouvinte.
Ahin nahenga kaphondoh nom chu hiche ahi, amahon houdan loitum asah-u Lampi dungjuiya kapu kapateu Pathen houva, Dan thu le themgao lekhabua kisun jouse katahsan’a,
amahon jong dih asah cheh, midih hihen midih lou hileh mi thi thokitna aum’e, ti katahsan ahi;
hitia chu Pathen lam hihen mihem thudol hijongleh lung theng lung navah a um jing dinga kihabol kahi.
Kum phabeppi nungin kanam mite din thilpeh le thilto kahinpon kahung leh,
hiche kinbol’a Houin a kakisuh theng pet’a eihung mudoh-u ahin, hichea chu mipi kikhom jong aumpon, japi noh phahna jong aumpoi.
Asia gama hung kon Juda mi phabep vang aum’un, amaho chun hehna ding eineiyu leh hikoma nangma angsunga hung ding dol ahiuve.
Ahilouva Houvaipoloi kikhopna kadinpet’a chu ipi suh khel toh khel kachunga amudoh-um hiche ho hin seileu hiding ahi;
a-angsunguva kadinpet’a othong leuva kasei thil khatseh, “Tunia hi na-angsunguva mi thi thokit thudol’a kachung thu kikhol’ah ahi,’ kati chubou ahiye,” ati.
Ahin Felix chun hiche Lampi thudol chu ahetchetsa ahijeh-in thutan ding avochonin, “Sepai vaipipo Lysias ahung tengleh nathuu ngaito chen nange,” atitai.
Felix in sepai jalamkaipa chu Paul songkul’a ahen din aseipeh-in, amavang achamlhatdom theiya, agol apaiho jong ajenle nomchan alutsdah din ahil’e.
Nikho ijat ham nungin Felix chu ajinu, Juda numei Drusilla toh ahungin Paul agakousah-in Christa Jesua tahsan thudol aseisah-in angaiye.
Paul’in thutandih le kitim them chule khonunga thupi tanna thudol adsei phat’in Felix atija jah tan, “Tun chetan, phat kanei kom khat leh hinkousah kit nange,’ ati.
Chujongle Paul chun sumguh apeh din agel’in phiveng vungin akousah-in akihoupi piji’e.
Ahinla kum ni jen alhin chun Porcius Festus chun Felix ahinkhel’in, Felix chun Juda ho dei abolnom jeh-in Paul songkul’a kihen nalaiyin adalhai.
Hiche gamkaiya ahung lhun kal nithum jouvin Festus chu Caesarea konin Jerusalema achetouve.
Jerusalema chun Thempu pipu ho le Juda lamkaihon ahenga Paul hehsetna thu anaseiyui; Festus chu a-ngeh-un,
ahinpui jeng khat leh lampia chanlhih a Paul chu thadohna didn, Jerusalema ahinpui dingin athum’uve.
Festusin adonbut’in, “paul Caesarea akikoiyin chule keimatah jong chu koma che ding kahi;
hijeh chun keito lhonin nalah-uva athu neidom chengse cheu hitin, hichepa hin suh khel tohkhel anei leh amahon aheh nom nomin heh-u hen” ati.
Festus chu alah-uva niget ham nisom ham anichongin Caesarea achesuh-in; ajing nikhon thutanna mun’a atouvin Paul gapui din aseiye.
paul ahung lhun phat’in, Jerusalema kona hungsuh Juda ho akimvel’a adingun, phot chetna apeh thei louhel hel’u thuse tamtah-in ahehseuvin ahi.
Hichun Paul’in akihonan thuaseiyin, “juda Danthu douna hihen Houin douna hileh, chuleh Caesar douna hijongleh keiman imacha suhset tohset kaneipoi,” ati.
Hichea hin Festus-in Juda ho lung lhaina abolnom jeh-in paul adonbut’in ajah a, “Jeruaselema chetouva keima angsunga hiche thudol ho hi nachung kikhol ding nadeiyem?” atileh;
paul’in, “Keima kathu kitanna ding sol Caesar thutanna mun’a ding kahi; Juda ho chunga bol khel ahi.
Keima bol khel nei kahiya, thina thei lom suh khel toh khel kanei leh thi ding kadapoi; amavang eihehna chengseu hi ima ahilouleh koiman amaho khut’a eipehdoh theiponte, Caesar henga kathu kalhuttai,” ati.
Festus chu avaibolpi chengse toh akihoutoh phat’in adonbut’in, “nangin Caesar henga nathu anlhutsa ahitan, Caesar henga nache ding ahi,” ati.
nikho phabep jouvin lengpa Agrippa le Bernice chu Festus vailhun din Caesarea ahung lhontai.
Caesarea sotpi anichon lailhonin Festus chun lengpa koma Paul thu chu apodoh-in, “Felix dalhah soh chang kihen khat aumin,
Jerusalema ka-umpet chun Thempu pipu ho le Juda ho upaten achung thu eihetsah-un, chule ama mochansah a athu tan din a-ngeh-ui.
Ahivangin akihehpa le aheh ho kimaitoa akinel’uva aheh apauvin akihonna thu asei masanga koi hileh moh pehdoh jeng chu Rome mite chondan ngai ahilou kaseipehin kanadonbut’e.
Hijeh chun abonchauva ahung kikhopsoh phat’un geisang louhel’in ajing nikhoma man thutanna amun’a katou mun kakijot’in mipa chu hinpuidoh din kaseitai.
Ahinla aheh a pang ho adindoh-uva athudol aseiyu chun ahehpauvin kagel bangin ima thilse abolpoi;
akinel nau chu amaho houthudol le Paul’in ahinga asei mithisa Jesu kiti khat thudol mai mai ahibouve.
Atanna je kahetvah loujeh-in ahehnau thuho jeh a hi Jerusalema chea kholchil ding adeiyem adei hih-em ti Paul kadonge.
Hichea chun Paul’in Kumpipa henga thu chaina a-nga dingin kihenan in’a koi din a-ngeh-in, hijeh chun Caesar henga kasol thei kah a koi dingin kaseitai,” ati.
Hichun Agrippan Festus jah a, “Hichepa thu chu keima tahin jong ngai leng kadeiye,” atileh, aman, “Jing tng jana veh ta chun,” atipeh-e.
Ajing nikhon Agrippa le Bernice loupe tah a sepai vaipo ho le khopi sunga japi lamkai ho toh thu ngaina inpia ahung lut phat’uvin Festus thusah-in paul ahinpui lut tauve.
Chutah-in Festus chun aseiyin, “lengpa Agrippa chule keiho toh umkhom chengse, veuvin hichepa hi Juda mi jousen, Jerusalema ahin, hikoma ho ahiuvin, ama ahinga hoisot louhel ding dol’a asap sap jenguva kahenga angeh-u ahiye.
Ahinla keiman amah in thina thei lom thilse aboldoh kamupoi, aman ma Kumpipa henga thu alhut tahjeh-in sol dinga thu kalhuhsah ahitai.
Hichea hi achung chang thudol’a Kumpipa henga sutding ima kichentah-in kahe theipon, hijeh a chu na-angsunguva kahinpuidoh ahi! Athu doh toh nunga sut idng kati ahiye.
Ijeh-inem itile akihehna thudol kichen a sun louva sohchang gahsol jeng chu kitoh din kagelpoi,” ati.
Agrippan Paul jah a, “Nakihonan thusei theiyin nate,” ati. Chutah-in paul chun akhut ajah-in anoiya banghin akihonna thu aseiye:
“Lengpa Agrippa, Judahon eiheh na jouseu thua tunia nangma angsunga kakihonna thu sei dia ka-um hi lungnom kakisa lheh jenge;
ajeh chu Judate puchon pachon Dan jouse le akinel nohna nangin nahe themsoh keiyin, hijeh chun lung nengtah-in kasei nei ngaipeh-in tia tao kahi.
“Keima kaneocha lhah kanam mite lah a Jerusalema kachen a kanun kakhan aboncha Juda miten ahetsoh keiyu ahi;
amahon asei nom’uva ahileh phat sotpi sunga eihetsau ahijeh chun kahoudanuva chon kakhelpen tah a Pharisee mi kahin,
chule tua hi kapu kapateu henga pathen tepsa kinepna thudol’a kathu khol dinga hikoma ding kahiye.
Hiche kinepna thudol’a hi kaphungbul piu som le nijenin gunchu tah a sun le jan a Pathen ahouvu anahi. Vo lengpa hiche kinepna thudol’a hi Juda mi hon eiheh-u ahbouve.
Juda mi nang hon Pathenin mi thisa athodoh kit thudol hi natahsan ding hahsa nasah-u ham?
“keijengin jong kajo chan’a bol’a Nazareth Jesu min douna thil ijakai bol ding kagotsa ahi.
Hitobang hin Jerusalem khosunga kabol’in Thempu pipu hoa konin thu neina kalan, minthengte tampi songkul’a kakhumin, chule athau jong chun pha kasai.
phat atamjon Houthua akikhopnau in tin’a talen kamatsah-in, atahsanu ataitom teina diuvin ka-engbol’in, achunguva kalung hangten tun jengin gamdang miho khopi dung geiyin kagabol sen ahi.
“Hitobanga amaho bol genthei ding chun Thempu pipu hoa kona thu neina kengin Damascus khopi jonin kachen,
vo lengpa, sumkim dontah-in lampia nisa sanga vahjo van’a konin vahkhat kamun, vah chun keima kimvel chengse le ka lhonpi ho chengse asalvah soh keiye;
hichun tol’a kalhunsoh phat’uvin Hebrew paovin kajah a, “Saul, saul, ibol’a neibolset set ham? Nang dia thihtul monghem lho chu bongchal’in apu mol-hem anungsai beh ahi,’ eiti.
Hichun keiman, ‘Pakaiyin, ‘Nabolset set Jesu chu kahi.
Hijongle thouvin nakengin pansan dingin, nahenga kahung kilahna jeh chu nangma kalhachaa pansah din gle nathilmu chengse le nahinmu kit ding chengse hettohsah a pansah dinga hung kilah kahi,
kasolna mi Israeltea kon le chiding namdang hoa kona khovah a ahung kiheidoh theiyuva Satan tha neinaa kona Pathen henga ahung kihei theina diu chule Keima eitahsan jal’uva chonset ngaidamna amutheiyuva, lhat thengsa ho lah a goulo chan anei theina diuva amit’u hasah dinga ahenguva kasol ding nahi,’ eiti.

“Hijeh chun volengpa Agrippa, van’a kona themgao thilmu kamu chu athua nu glouvin kaumpoi;
amasan Damascus khopia umho henga kaseiyin, Jerusalem le Judea gam pumpia jong, chiding namdang holah geiyin lung heiya Pathen lama akiheiyuva chule along heiyu toh kiloma natohpha atohna diuvin kaseipeh soh keiye.
Hichejeh a hi Judah on Houin sunga eimat’uva tha dinga eigot’u ahi.
Ahivangin tuni chan geiyin pathenin eikithopin, hkoma kadingin milen mineo hengah hettohsahna thu hi kaseiye; kasei hi Themgaoho le Mose’n hung guilhung dinga anaseisau chu ahin,
Christan hesoh genthei athoh tei ding, thinaa kona thoudoh maspen’a panga, Juda mi le chiding namdang ho henga khovah thuaphondoh dingahi,” ati.
Paul’in hitia kihonna thu asei chun Festus-on othongin akouvin, “Vo Paul a-ngol nahitai; nalekhathem sang chun na-ngolsahjoh ahitai,” ati.
Ahivangin Paul chun, “Vo lalchungnung Festus, a-ngol’a kahipon, kicheh tah athu dih kaseijoh ahibouve.
Ijeh-inem itile leng Agrippan hiche hi ahet ahijeh a ajah angamtah a kasei ahiye; ajeh pentah chu athil hi ningkoiya kibol ahiloujeh-in ama hetlou um louhel din katahsan’e.
Lengpa Agrippa, Themgao ho natahsan em? Natah san kahei,” ati.
Hichun Agrippan Paul jah a, “Hiche chomkah cha sunga hin Christian hisah neigoi!” ati.
Hijongle Paul’in, “Phat chom hen sao leh tunia karhusei ngai chengse hi thihkhaova kakihenna ho tilouvin keima tobang hisoh keiyu leh tin Pathen henga kathum’e,” atitai.
Hichun lengpa le gamvaipo Bernice chule atoukhompi chengse akipatdoh-in
adalhah phat’un khat le khat akihou lhiuvin, “Hichepa hin thina thei lom hihen songkul’a henna thei lom hijongleh ima abol set atohset aumpoi,” akitiuve.
Hichea hin Agrippan Festus jah a, “Hichepa hin Kumpipa henga thu alhut lou hileh lhadoh thei ahitai,” ati.
konga kitol’a Italy gam kajot diu akichet phat’in Kumpipa sepai lhentum lah a sepai jalamkai Julius kitipa khut’a paul le sohchang dang ho apedoh tauve.
Adramyttium a chun Asia gam kongkai mun jouse jotpa ding kong khat’a kalut’un, Macedonia gam Thessalonica khoa hung kon Aristarchus chutoh kilhonin kakitol’uve;
ajing nikhon Sidon kaimun kalungun, Julius chun Paul along set’in agol apai ho henga che angaichat chan apeh diuvin asol’e.
Chua konin keiho lam ngaa hui anun Jeh-in Cyprus twikol lesun sun’ah kakitol’uvin,
Cilicia le Pamphylia Twikhanglen thuh lai kagal kaiyun Lycia gama Myra kho kalhungtauve.
Hikoma hin sepai jalamkaipan Italy jon ding Alexandria kong khat aga mudoh-in hia chun eikhumtauve.
Nikho sotpi sungin olcha chan kakitol’un hahsa tah-in Cnidus kho kalhungvin, huiyin kajotna lam’uva chetheiya eilha lou phat’uvin Cretetwikol lesun sun’ah kakitol’un Salmone jon kajot’un,
twi pamchim chin kalhah peh-uvin, nah nah-in Lasea khopia kona gamla behseh lou kongkai munhoi kiti khat kalhungtauve.
Phat sottah kanichon nungun Thoidamna anngol phat jong akichaitan, konga kitol’a kholjin banjop dingla kachat aumtah jeh-in Paul’in miho athumop’in,
ajahuvah, “Miho, konga akitol’u hi toset ito tei didu thil le lo mai hilouva ihinkho diuva jong manthahna um ding kichat tijat aum’e ti kamui,’ ati.
Ahinla sepai jalamkai chun Paul thusei sangin kong lamkai pa le kong neipa thujoh alajoi.
Kongkai mun chu phalbi sunga umna dia aphat loujeh-in, mi atamjon Twikhanglena kitoldoh a ahithei chan a Phoenix lhun tei ding asom’ui; Phoenix chu Crete gama kongkai mun khat ahin, lhanglam lhum le sahlam-lhum angat ahi, hichea chu phalbi sunga cham ding atiu ahiye.
Lhanglam hui olcha cha ahung nun phat’in mihon along ngaito bang molso thei din agel’un, kong khaopi alhauvin Crete twikol pamchin chin’ah atoltauve.
Ahivangin chom khat jouvin sahlam-niso hui kiti hui hattah twikol gam lama konin ahung nungsuh paiyin,
hui chun kong ahinsem khath phat’in anang joutapon, kamoh lhau le ei-lhoh lhoh jeng tauve.
Hichun Cauda kiti twikol neocha khat lesun sun’a ka lhaiyun nah changsal’in kong inneiya kong neochu kahendet nah nah-ui.
Kongneo chu kong innei kimvel’a chun akanbeh-un ahunan amangun, Libya twipam chin nel lah a kilenglut khante, ti gin nan pondal kipeina chu aloi lhauvin hui amoh lhohsah sah tauve.
Hui tahtah chun eisuh gim behseh phat’un ajing nikhon kong sunga thil le lo apai pan tauve.
Nithum nin kong manchah ho geiyin akhut’a uvin apai kit tauvin ahi.
Nikho tamtah sunga nisa mel le ahsite mel kimudoh louhel’a hui hattah tang louhel’a anun nun jeng phat’in kasochatna diuva kinepna jouse abeitai.
Phat sottah miho nelou chalouva aum nungun Paul alah-uva adingin, “Vo miho, nang hon kathusei na-ngaiyuva Crete a kona ihung kitoldoh lou diu, hitobang settona le manthahna hi itokhah lou diu dol ahi.
Hijongle tua jong nahenguva katao ahi, hang tah-in pang un! Ijeh-inem itile nalah-uva komacha athi amang na-um lou diu, kong innei vang mang ding ahi;
ajeh chu Amaa kahia alhachaa kapan Pathena kon Vantil khat tujan chun kahenga ahung kilah-in
“Vo Paul, kicha hih-in, Kumpipa ang’a nadin tei tei ding ahi chule ven nalhonpi chengse hi Pathenin nang napeh ahitai,’ eiti.
Hijeh chun hangtahin pangun miho, ajeh chu eikiseipeh bang banga chu hung guilhing tei dinga Pathen katahsan in ahi.
Amavang twikol gam sung khat A igalkai tei diu ahi,” ati.
Kakisuhtol kakitoutol’uva jan som le li lhin jan Adria Twikhanglen kagalkaiyun jankhangkim in kongtol hon gam leiset kinaiyah hitam ti agingmouve.
Hijeh chun thilgih khat khaovin akan’un twite na dia ale lut’u leh twi chu lam som ni thuh ate doh ui; phabep acheuva atekit’u leh lam some le lam nga atedoh-uvin ahi.
Song lah a kilenglut khante ti ginmo nan kong tom lam’ah konghenna khao li aleh lhauvin khovah loi nadin ataovui.
Kongtol ho chu jamdoh ding akigo’uvin, kong mai lama chu kong henna khao sep lha ding veh kisan twi lah a kongneo chu akhai lhauvin lungthim aboltauve.
Paul’in sepa jalamkai pa le sepaite jah-a, “Hiche kongtol ho hi kong sunga aumden louvu leh nang ho sohcha jou pouvin n ate,” atitai.
Hijeh chun sepai hon kongneo kikhaina khao ho chu asat tanpeh-un akitolmangsah tauve.
Khovah niso ding phat’in Paul’in an ne din asol’in abonchauva jah a, “Sei ding get ding helouhel’a nelou cha lou, tep lou don louva na-um kal’u tuni nisom le ni li alhingtai;
hijeh a chu anne dinga ka-ngeh nahiuve, nakihinso theina diuva natha nei dom nadiu vin, ajeh chu nalu chunguva samjang khat jeng cha jong mangthah louhel ding ahi,” ati. Ahivangin sepai jalamkai chun Paul ahuhdoh nom jeh-in athilgon u chu asutangin, twijap thei chan jap galkaiya tolgo anakai masa din aseiyin,
Hitia asei jou hin changlhah chu alan mi jouse angsunga Pathen athangvah jouvin aheh bal’in anepantai.
Hichun miho ahung lung ngam tauvin amahon jong an anepantauve.
Kong sunga um chu mihing jani le som sagi leh gup kahiuve.
Mi jousen an anehva phat’un kong chu ajankhai domna din kong sunga suhlou chang chu Twikhanglen a aleh lut tauvin ahi.
Khovah phat’in kongtol hon gam leiset chu ahetapouvin, ahin twilen pang ningkoi khat amu’vin, ahithei leh hikoma chu kong tol lut’a galkai din akihousomtauve.
Hijeh chun konghenna khao chengse alha lhauvin Twikhanglena aleh lut’uvin, chule kongkhe kanna khao asut lhauve; chutengleh huiyin aputlut theina diuvin ponjal atungdoh-un twiningkoi lam chu ajontauve.
Ahinla kong chu twikinong ni kisuhtonaa alut khan kong mong chu nel lei lah a akiphut lutdentan, achalbe thei tapoi, chuma leh twikinong chun hanuh a anuh jeh-in anung lama ahal hal’in aleng lhan akeh pan tai.
Sohchang ho chu akijap galkaiyuva ajamdoh thei louna diu tin sepaihon abonchauva tha ding thilgon aneitauve.

adang amohse chu khunpeh le konghalse pouva kitol galkai din aseiye. Hitia chu aboncha tolgo geiya kishinso na um ahi.
Kakihonso phat’uvin twikolgam chu Malta akiti ti kahedoh tauve.
Koitoh kisamkai khah loulai agam mihon datmo tah-in eikhoto’uvin, go juh jeh a adap phat chun mei eitipeh-un eilamdot chehui.
Paul’in thingkang lom khat achomdah-in meiya atileh, meisa hul chun gulse khat ahungdoh-in akhut achun akikhaiden jenge.
Koitoh kisamkai khah lou agam mihon paul khut’a gul kikhai chu amudoh phat’un khat le khat akihou lhiuvin, “hichepa vang hi tolthat mong mong ahin, Twikhanglen setto naa ahindoh jeng vanga thudih chun ahing hoi lou dingsam ahiye,” akitiuve.
Ahinla Paul’in gulse chu meilhum sunga athing lhan a-ima aloudeh poi.
Agam mihon vang hung pom ding ham ahi loule phulou helouvin lhua thi didng ham, tin a-ngah jingui; sotpi chutia angauva imacha atilou phat’in along gel akhel’uvin Paul chu Pathen khat danin aseitauve.
Hiche kona gamla behseh lou mun khat’a hin twikol haosapu amin Publius kitipan loumin aneiyin, amahin thanom tah-in eisangun nithum sungin eivah gunset’uve.
Publisu pa chu khosih le eithit veiya dammoa lum ahin, Paul’in agaven, achunga khut angamin ataopeh-in aboldamtai.
Hitabong thilsoh aumdoh phat hin twikol gamsunga cheng ana damlou neichanin ahinpuiyun abonchan adamsoh keiyuve.
Agam mihon keiho jabolnan thilpeh tampi eipeuvin, konga kitol kagot phat’un kangaichat ding dol jouseu kong sunga eihung thah peh-uve.
Lha thum jouvin Alexandria hung kon kong, ‘Pathen cha pengkop,’ tia kiminvo, phalbi sungsea chukom twikol gama nichong denpaa chun kakitol kit tauve.
Syracuse kaimun’a kaki-ngauvin nithum kanichonguve.
Chua konin kakitol velkil leuvin Rhegium kalhungun, nikhat jouvin lhanglam hui ahung nungin, ni ni lhin hin Puteoli kalhungu.
Puteolia chun sopite phabep kamudoh-un, akom’uva ni sagi nichong din eikouvui. Hitia chu Rome hung lhung kahiuve.
Rome a um sopiten kathuu ajah phat’un Appius kailhang le Jinlhun in thum geiyin keiho lamto din ahungun, amaho amu phat hin Paul’in Pathen athangvah-in along ngamtan ahi.
Rome kalhun phat’un Paul chu a-ngah a pang sepai chutoh ama changseh a cheng din phalna aneipeh tauvin ahi.
Nithum jouvin Paul’in khosunga Judate lamkaiho akoukhomin, ahung kikhopsoh phat’un ajahuvah, “Sopiho, i-nam miteu douna hihen ipu ipateu chondan douna hijongle imacha kabolset aum lou vangin Jerusalema pat Rome mite khut’a sohchanga eihung kipedoh ahitai.
Kachung thu akhol chil’u chun thina thei lom ima kabolset aumdoh loujeh-in eina lhadoh nom tauve.
Ahina Juda mihon aneljeh-un, ka-nam mite douna imacha sei ding kanei lou vangin Kumpipa henga kacham louvinthu kalhuttai.
Hichejeh tah a hi nang ho toh kimutoa kihoulimpi dia kakou nahiuve; ijeh-inem itile Israel kinepna ijeh a keima hiche thih khaova hi kihen’ah kahibouve,” ati.
Hichun amahon ajah a, “Keihon jong Judea gama kona nathudol lekha thot la kimu louva, hikoma sopite khatcha beh-in jong nagit louna thudol thulhut’a le houlima jong umlouva,
hi jongle la nalung ngaito mong mong nanga konin kajahbe nom nauve; ajeh chu hiche Houbih vang hi muntin gamtin’a seiset’in aumtin ahi ti kei hon jong kanaheuve,” atiuvin ahi.
Nikho khat ateppeh –un, apansatna ina’a chun mi tampi ahung kikhom’uve; Paul’in amaho chu jingkah a pat nilhah geiyin Mose Danthu le Themgaoho lekhabua konin hilchetna abol’in, Pathen Lenggam thudol ahettohsa-in, Jesu chu tahsansah tei din ajoltai.
Paul thuseiho chu abangin atahsan lou vangun abang vang anomtauve.
Amaho chu akihoutoh thei loud phat’uvin Paul’in anoiya thu khat hi asei jou phat’in apotdoh tauve; athusei chu: “Lhagao Thengin Isaiah Themgao kamin napu napateu henga phatah-in anaseiyin,
hitin: “Hiche mite henga hin chen lang gaseiyin, ‘Ja vang najah tei diu ahin nehetkhen thei lou diu, Mujong namu tei diu navet chen thei lou diu ahi.
Ijeh-inem itile hiche mite hi alungthimu amoh-in, Anabenguvin thu angaichimtan, Chutilou hileh amit’uva avet chet theiyuva Alungthim’uva ahetkhen them diu, Kadamsahna dia kahenga hung kilekit diu ahi,’ ati bang chun;
hichu kihet cheh-un, hiche Pathen mihuhhingna thu hi chiding namdangte henga kithot ahitan, amahon angai tei diu ahi,” ati.
(Paul’in hicheng asei jou hin Judah on ada lhauvin hanel’in akineltauve.)
Hikoma chun Paul’in inman akipeh-in kum ni sung in achengin, ahenga hung jouse lamdot’in
Pathen Lenggam thu aseiphongin, koima asunoh beihel’in phongtah in Pakai Jesu thudol ahil lhang lei.

















































































































































































































































































































































































































































Pathen lungdeiya Christa Jesu solchah dinga kikou Paul le sopi Sosthenes-in,
Corinth khoa Pathen Houbung, Christa Jesua kisuthenga, atheng dinga kikou ho le muntin’a um miho, amaho le eiho dinga i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa min’a kikou chengse henga,
i-Pau Pathen le i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christaa konin lungsetna le chamna nahenguva hung lhung hen!
Christa Jesu ti nakigop jeh-uva nachunguva kipe Pathen lungsetna jeh chun nang ho jel’in phat jousen ka-Pathen kathangvah jing’e,
ajeh chu, Amato nakigop’u hin ima jousea, thuseina hihen hetna hijongle nahaosah-u ahitan,
nang hoa hi Christa thudol hettohsahna phudet’a aum banga,
i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa hung kiphondoh ding na-ang nauva Lhagao thilpeh chan khel nanei louna diu ahi.
Aman nang ho akhon ni, i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa nikho geiya natuh chah jinguva monabeiya nakoi diu ahi.
Achapa Jesu Christa, i-Pakaiyu vanga kiloikhomnaa nakoulut’u Pathen chu kitah tah ahiye.
Sopite, nabonchauva nakinopto cheh-uva, nasei jouseu akitha khat’a, lunggel le ngaito kitha khat nahina diuva i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa min jal’a ka-ngeh nahiuve.
Ijeh-inem itile kasopite, nalah-uva kinah baotam alen chu Chloe insung miten kajah a kichentah-in eiseipeh tauve.
Kasei chu hiche ahi, nang ho amitakip, “Keivang Paul loi kahi, keima Apollos loi kahin, keima Peter loi kahi, chule keima Christa loi kahi” natiuve.
Christa chu kihomtel hitam? Paul la nang ho din thingpel’a akikhet beh pon, ole Paul min’a baptize chang ngap nahiuvem?
Cripus le Gaius tilou nang ho khat beh baptize kachansah loujeh-un kakipah-e,
hiche hi koima kei min’a baptize changa nakisei thei louna diu ahiye.
Stephanas insungmite vang baptize kachan sah nan, hiche kalval vang midang koima baptize kachansah kahepoi.
Christan baptize kachansah dinga eisol ahipon, Kipana Thupha sei phong dingjoh a eisol ahibouve, Christa thingpel thu chu ahomkeo ahilouna dinga chihna thujong kasei lou ahi.
Thingpel thu hi amangthah ho dia ngol kai tah ahin, huhhinga um eiho din vang Pathen thahatna ahi.
Ijeh-inem itile Pathen lekhabua kisun chun, “Keiman miching ho chihna kasuh manga, het themna neiho hetna moh kahisah ding ahi,” ati.
Miching hoiya uma, lekhathem hoilam ham? Tukhang minel them hoiyaba um ham? Pathenin hiche vannoi chihna hi ngolna ahisah lou ham?
Ijeh-inem itile Pathen chihnaa hin hiche chihna vannoiyin mangcha Pathen ahetdoh thei lou phat’in, ngol kai thua kigel hiche thu kisei phong tahsan ho joh huhhing ding hi pha asai.
Judaten melchihna a-ngeh-uvin, Greek mihon chihna ahol’ui,
Keihon vang thingpel’a kikhenbeh Christa chu kaseiphongu ahi; hiche hi Judate din kipalna ahin, chidnag namdang ho dia ngolna ahi;
ahinla Juda mi hihen Greek mihijong le akikoute dinga Christa chu Pathen thahat le Pathen chihna ahiye.
Ajeh chu Pathen dia ngol kei chu mihem chihna sangin achingjon, Pathen dia hatmona chu mihem hatna sang in ahatjo nalaiye.
Sopite nakikou dol’u chu vetem’un, tahsaphe dol’a chingtah jong nahipouvin, thahat tahbeh jong nahipouve; phunglun laiya mi jong nahideh pouvin ahi;
amavang Pathenin vannoiya mimol ho hi miching ho jumso dia alhendoh a, vannoiya mihatmo ho hi mihat ho jumso dinga Pathenin alhendoh ahiuve.
Pathenin vannoiya mi lhasamho le nahsahmoa kikoi ho alhen’a, aumsa thil ho imacha lou sosahna dinga aumlouhel thil ho geiya aumsah ahi.
Hitia hi Pathen angsunga mihing khat cha kiletsah thei louhel ding ahiuve.
Pathen vanga nang ho hi Christa to hingkhom nahiuvin Christa chu Pathena kon eiho chihna, them chamna, kisuh thengna le lhatdamna ahin,
Pathen lekhabua, “Akisonga chu Pakai vangin kisong hen,” tia kisun banga um ahi.
Sopite, nahenguva Pathen thuguh phongjal dia kahung chun kamthem le chihna manga hung kahipoi.
Ijeh-inem itile nang ho lah a thingpel’a akhetbeh pau Jesu Christa tilou ima dang helou hel dinga kihan lho kahitai.
Keima nahenguva lhasam tah le kichatah chule kihot hot’a hung kahin,
kathusei le kathuseiphong chu chihna thugil tah akisei ahipon, lhagao le athahat phondohna joh ahibouve;
hiche hin natahsan’u chu mihem chihna vang hilouva Pathen thahat vanga ahijoh photchetna ahiye.
Apilhingsa ho henga vang chihna thun jong kaseiji nauvin, amavang hiche leiset chihna le amang thah ding leiset vaipote chihna jong ahipoi;
amavang leiset um masanga Pathenin iloupina diuva gotsa akoi, kiselguh, Pathen chihna thuguh joh chu kaseijiu ahibouve.
Hichu hiche leiset vaipote khat chan jong ahepouve, ajeh chu heule loupina Pakai chu thingpel’a akhetbeh louhel diu ahi.
Ahinla Pathen lekhabua kisun: “Mit mukhah lou, naa jah khah lou, Mihem lungthima jong lutkha loulai, Pathenin ama ngailuho dinga agonsa chu,” tia kisei bang chun,
lhagao amangchan Pathenin eiho henga aphongdoh tai; ajeh chu Lhagaovin thil ijakai akholchil jin, Pathen selguh ho geiyin ahildohjie.
Ama sunga cheng mihem, lhagao tilou mihem umdol thil ho chu koipen ham ahea? Hitobang chun Pathen umdol thil ho chu Pathen Lhagao tilou koiman ahepoi.
Pathena kona manbei thilpeh eipeh ho’u ihet theina diuva vannoi leiset lhagao ikisanu ahipon, Pathen Lhagao joh ahibouve.
Hiti ho chun hilson chihna thu hoa seilouva, lhagaova kihilna dungjuiya Lhagao neiho henga Lhagao thudih kahilchet’uva kaseijoh-u ahi.
Tahsa lam mihemin vang Pathen Lhagao thil ho chu akisanjipoi; ajeh chu ama din hichu ngolna ahin, Lhagao dol’a phot chet ding ahijehin hejong ahe theipoi.
Lhagaova hingmi vangin ijakai aphochen theiyin, midangin vang ama chung thudol atan theipoi.
“Ajeh chu koiham Pakai lungthim hea, Ama hil thei ding mi chu?” akiti. Eihon vang Christa lungthim ineiyui.
Sopite, Lhagao chenna miho henga bangin keiman nang ho henga thu kasei theipon, tahsaphe mihem, Christa sunga cheng naosen henga sei banga kasi ahibouve.
Keiman noitwiya kavah-uva anham kapeh loulai nahive, ajeh chu nahe theihih laiyuve. Tujengin jongnahe thei hih laiyui,
ijeh-inem itile tahsaphe mihem nahi nalaiyuve. Nalah-uva kithangsetto le, khat le khat kinah kiphun aum laisea chu tahsa mihem hiya mihem chon chon’a chon nahiu hilou ham?
khat’in, “Keima Paul loukahi,” atia; adang khatman, “Keima Apollos loi kahi,” ati laisea chu namihem chon’u hilou ham?
Ahimonga Apollos chu ipi hiya, Paul chu ipi ham? Amani hi lhacha natong, amani jal’a natahsan’u ahin, koijoh ahilhona Pakai thilpeh nei cheh ahilhon’e.
Keiman kaphu ahin, ahin Apollos-in twi achap’a, Pathenin akhansah ahi.
Hichejeh chun aphutpa jong ima ahidehpoi; akhansah Pathen bou thupi ahi.
Aphutpa le atwichappa akibang lhonin, atohgim dungjui cheh a tohman asancheh lhon ding ahinai.
Keini Pathento tongkhom kahi lhonin, nang ho Pathen loulai, Pathen insah nahiuve.
Eikipe Pathen lungsetna dungjuiya, insa themtah banga abul kaphu ahitan, midangin achunga asahjom ahi. Asachanin iti asah kivet them hen.
Abul kiphutsa Jesu Christa tilou koiman abul dang phutdoh theiponte.
Koi ahin hiche abul kiphut chunga chun san an ashen, dangkan ashen, dong mantamin, ashen lang, thingin ashen, hampa ham changpol hamin sajong le,
min atoh cheh chu hung kiphongdoh cheh a, min atoh cheh chu meiya kipatep ding ahiye.
Mi khat natoh a-insah chu adin jou nah leh tohman asan ding;
mikhattou anatoh meiyin akahvam vangle tohman asan lou ding ama tah vang huhhing chang ding, mei pi pal galkaipa tobang hiding ahi.
Pathen Houin nahiuva nasunguva Pathen Lhagao achen chu nahet louvu ham?
Khattouvin hiche Pathen Houin chu asuhmang le Pathenin ama asuhmang ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile Pathen Houin chu atheng ahin, nang ho a-Houin chu anahiuve.
Koima ama kilhen lha hih hen; nalah-uva khattou tulai khanga dia chinga kigel aumle, achihna din ngoljo hen.
Ijeh-inem inem itile hiche vannoi chihna hi Pathen koma ngolna ahibouve; ajeh chu Pathen lekhabua akisunin: “Aman miching ho chu Ajonchih nauva amudohji,” akitin;
Chule avel’in: “Pakaiyin miching ho lung gel jouse Aboncha pannabei ahi ahenai,” akiti.
Hijeh chun koima mihemin kisonda hen; ajeh chu ijakai aboncha nang hoa jeng ahin,
Paul hihen Apollos hile, Cephas ahin, vannoi ahin, hinna hihen thina hijongle, tupet le khonung geiya aboncha nang hoa ahibouve.
Nang ho Christa mi nahiuvin, Christa chu Pathen’a ahi.
Keiho hi Christa lhacha, Pathen thuguh chingin min eingaitou hen.
Hichea neiching ding kihol’a chu tahsan um hiding ahi.
Keidin vang nang hon kachung thu nakhol diu hihen mihem thutan nikhoa kikhol ding hijongle, thu neochan bou kagel’e; keiman bon kachung thu kakikholsampoi.
Keiman kiphat lamna ding kahepon, hijongle themmona beihel kahi tina ahidehpoi, hichea kahcung thu khol chil’a pang Pakai ahi.
Hiti ahijeh a chu aphet tep phat, Pakai hung kahsen nang hon koima thu tandauvin, aman muthima kisel thiljouse khovah a a phondoh a, mihem lungthim ngaoto chengse jong aphondoh ding ahinai. Chutah le amitakip’in Pathena kona achan ding lom pachatna akisan cheh ding ahi.
Sopite, hichengse hi nang ho khohsah jal’a kei le Apollos pan’a nang ho kheldoh goa, Pathen lekhabua “Akisun kalval’in akichon ngaipoi,” ti hi keinia kona nakihil’uva, chule mikhat sonnaa mi khat chun midang khat anahsahmo louna dinga kasei ahi.
Ajeh chu koiham nang nachom khen a? Mia nalah lou ipi naneiyem? Nalah ahile ibol’a alallou banga hoithoa kiletsah nahim?
Tun nalung nau achimset’in, nahulhingsoh tauve; keiho beiya leng chang gam nahitauvin, keiho to leng ichan khom theina diuvin leng chang tahbah hileu chun kati tave!
Ipijeh- inem itile vannoi le Vantilte chule mihemte vetchan bep dia amangthah dia umsa mihem ho banga Pathenin keiho Solchahho hi anukhah pen’a eikoidan’uvin kagel’e.
Christa khohsah jeh a keiho a-ngol kahiuvin, Christa sunga cheng nang ho vang nachingui; kei ho kadoiyun, nang ho nahat’uve; nang ho gin le jabol nahiuvin, keiho mi not thap’in ka-um’ui!
Tugeiyin jong gilkel dangchah kathoh-un, nihchen ponsil bei, mi khut thah lhauna, chenna intum neilou kahiuve;
kakhut nin chol le nangin na katong gim’un, eihousete phat thei kaboh-un, min eibol genthei tengu kathoh ham ham’un,
min kallah a eihou tengule lungdamsel’iin kahouvun vannoi kithenhonna bang in ka-umdoh tauvin, tugeiyin mitin kilepnan ka-umdoh tauve.
Nang ho jumsona ding hilouva kasha tah kachate banga nang ho hilchahna joh ahicheng hi kahindut ahibouve.
Christa dinga nail’uva sangsom neijeng jong leu chun patampi naneipouve; ajeh chu Kipana Thupha jeh a Christa Jesu dinga kahinsa nahitauve.
Hichejeh a chu ka-ngeh nahiuve, keima umchan jom hiuvin.
Hiche dinga hi Timothy nahenguva kahinsol ahi, ama hi Pakaiya tahsan um kasahtah kachapa ahin, aman muntin le Houbung jousea kahilleji, Christa Jesu hinkhoa kachon namlhah aboncha nageldohsah diu ahi.
Nahenguva kei hi hung lou dia gel’a nalah-uva kiletsah hoitho mi na-um’uvin,
Pakai lungdei ahile keila nahenguva hungvah jel didng kahi; chutengle hiche mi kiletsah ho thusei mai hilouva atha neina geiyuva kahetdoh idndg ahi,
ajeh chu Pathen lenggam chu thuhomkeo ahipon, tha neina ahi.
I-ham naseiyu? Mol choiya nahenguva kahung ding ha, ngailut neiya lhagaova lungnemtah a kahungjoh ding ham?
Nalah-uva jon thanhoi um kichentah-in akijan, hitobang jon thanhoi hi chiding namdangte lah jenga jong umji lou ahi; hichea hinmi khat’in apa ji jin aneiye.
Hitobang thilbol natongpa chu nalah-uva kona paidoh ahitheina dinga lunggimpijo talouva ibol’a kiletsah hoithojo nahiuvem?
Tahsaa ka-um lou vangin lhagaovin nalah-uva kalhan, nalah-uva lha mong bangin hitobang thilbolpa chung thu chu katan chaiyin,
i-Pakaiyu Jesu minin nang ho to kalungthimin ikihou khom’un, i-Pakaiyu Jesu thahat’in
Pakai nikho ni le alhagao huhhinga aumtheina din hitobang mi hi atahsa suhmangna dia Satan henga napehdoh diu ahi.
Nakiletsah-u hi aphapoi. Chol themchan changlhah lhon pumpi achansohji nahet louvu ham?
Cholsolou nahijeh-un, changlhah lhon thah nahitheina diuvin chollui chu then ngimsel’uvin. Ijeh-inem itile i-kalchuh kut’uva din Christa kelngoi tha’n akithattai.
Hichejeh chun chollui le gitlouna le thilse bolna chol mang louvin, cholsoloi, thenna le thutah changlhah joh-in kut bol’u hite.
Kalekha thotnaa chun jon thanhoi bol ho to nakivop khom louna diuvin kahinsuntai;
hiche vannoiya jonthanhoi bol ho le neipap kilose ho chule misumang ho le doihouho kati ahipoi, achutilou le vannoiya kona napotdoh diu ngai ding ahi.
Tua nakivoppi lou diuva kasut ho chu sopia kisimsa khattouvin jongthanhoi, neipap kiloset abol’a, doi ahouva, Pathen ataitoma, ju akham’a chule mi anambol le, hitobang mi chu kiloikhohmpi louding kati ahi.
Polam miho thutan ding ka-ilouna ham? Asunga umho thubou natan jiu hilou ham?
Polam mite thu Pathenin tannante. Pathen lekhabua kisei bangin, thilse bolpa vang nalah-uva konin paidoh jengun!
Nang ho koi nahiuva khat’in achom khat chunga thu aneitengle mitheng ho angsunga kiheh ding go louva mithenglou chiding namdang ho henga heh ding nangap chat jeng jiu ham?
Mithengten vannoi thu geiya atan diu jong helou lai nahiuvem? Chutia vannoi thubon natan diu ahile thu neocha tan dia kilommo nahiuvem?
Leiset hinkho thu titah louva Vantilte thu geiya itan diu nahet louvu ham?
Chutia leiset hinkho thudol’a thu tanding nei nahiule Houbung sunga pamse miho chu thutan dia natousah jengu leh iti am?
Najachatna diuva hiche hi kaseikhum nahiuve. Nalah-uva sopicha kah a thu chai thei miching khatbeh umlou hitam?
Chutia chu sopi khat chun sopi khat aheh a atahsanlou ho ang’a kiheh jenglhon ham?
Hitia khat le khat nakihehtosau sauvu hin apumthon nahiu aphongtai; dih hih jongle nathoh gimjoh-u phalou ham? Kitoh lou hijongle nakido jenguva phalou ham?
Hichea hi nangho adih louva kibolgim’a kitoh louva kichom gam, sopite geiya chutibol nahiuve.
Midih louvin Pathen lenggam alo lou diu ahi nahet lou laiyu ham? Lhep chatvaiyin um hih-un; jonthanhoi bol ho, doi houho, mito jong ho, pasal le pasal, numei le numei jongho,
gucha ho, neipap kilose ho, jukham ho, mihanse ho, michomhat ho khat chan jong Pathen lenggam alo louhel diu ahi.
Nang ho abang bang hitobang chu nahiuvin, hijongle Pakai Jesu Christa min le i-Pathen’u lhagaova kisop ngim’a kithensoa them kichansah nahitauve.
Keidin thil ijakai bolngai ahin, ahinla abonchan thilpha asohdoh deh poi. Keidia thil ijakai bolngai ahivangin imacha noiya lut pong’e.
Khattouvin an hi oisunga lut, oisung hi ankholna ahi tinte; ahinla Pathenin agoma asuh bei ding ahi. Mihem tahsa hi jonthanhoi bolna ding ahipon, Pakai ding joh ahi, chule Pakaiyin jong tahsaa ding agelnai.
Thinaa kona Pakai kaithou Pathen chun eiho jong athahat pan’a eikaithou diu ahi.
Natahsau chu Christa tibah khat ahi naheuve. Hichea hi Christa tibah chu kalah manga noti tibah a kasemdoh ding ham? Hithei naisai ponte!
Notinu toh kijopmatpa chu amanu to tikhat ahilhon helou lai nahiuvem? Ajeh chu Pathen lekhabun kichentah-in, “Amani chu tikhat hilhon ding ahi,” tin aseiye.
Hichea hin Pakai to kijopmatpa jong chu Amato Lhagao khat ahilhontai.
Jonthanhoiya konin jam’un; mihemin chonsetna abol adang jouse chu atahsa polam ahin, jonthanhoi bolpa vang chu ama tahsa chunga chonse ahi.
Natahsau hi Pathena kona naneiyu nasunguva cheng Lhagao Theng Houin ahi, chule nang ho hi nang hoa nahilou lam helou nahiuvem?
Nang ho man kipea chohsa nahitauvin, hijeh chun natahsauvin Pathen choianuvin.
Lekha nahinsut thudol’uva hin, pasal’in numei amai louhel ding thilpha ahi;
Jonthanhoi atamtai, pasal’in numei, numeiyin jong pasal ji kinei cheh hen,
pasal’in numei chu achan ding lom pehen lang, hitobangma chun numeiyin jong ajipa pehen lung nachim lhonhen.
Numeiyin ama tahsa chunga tha aneipon, pasal’in aneijoi; chutobangma chun pasal’in jong ama tahsa chunga tha aneipon, numeiyin bou aneiye.
Phat chom khat taonaa nakipeh theina diuva nakidondauva nahung kivop khom kit loi diu nakinopto gel’u tilouvin khat le khat don louvin kikoi hihun, chutile kitimlel jeh a Satanin nalhep lhah lo diu ahi.
Hiche hi phatsah thua kasei ahin, thupeh dungjui ahipoi.
Mihem jouse keima tobang hicheh le kadeiyin, ahinla min Pathen Lhagao thilpeh ama chan anei cheh-ui, khat’in hitobang, achom khatman khutobang aneiye.
Jinei louho le meithaiho kasei ahi, amaho chu kei bangin umleu aphai;
amavang akitimjou lou diu le ji aneijoh diu ahi, moh huh sangin jinei aphajoi.
Jineisa ho chu thu kapeh nahiuve, (Keima hijo louva Pakaiahi) numeiyin ajipa ajamsan louhel ding ahi,
ajamsan tah bah jongle jinei louva um ding, ahiloule ajipa to kihoucham kit lhon hen, chule pasal’in numei ada louhel ding ahi.
Adang ho henga, Pakai hilouva, keisei ahi, sopi khatouvin a tahsan lou numei jia aneiya, numei chu amatoh chen khom jing ding anop le, ajipan da hih hen;
chule numei khattouvin jong atahsan lou pasal jia aneiya, pasal chu amato chenkhom jing ding anop le, aman pasal chu da hih hen.
Atahsan lou pasal chu numeinu to ahinkhom jeh a akithenso ahitan, atahsan lou numei jong chu sopipa t0 ahinkhom jeh a kithenso ma ahitai, chutilou hile nachateu chuboh diu ahin, tua vang akithenso ahitai.
Ijemtia atahsan loupan adalhah vangle dalha jeng hen, hitobang thua hin sopipa hihen sopinu hijongle akikan lou ahitai, ahinla Pathenin kichamdel dia eikouvu ahi.
Hijeh a chu ipi nahet em numei, pasal nahoidohsah ding hinam? Chule pasal’in ipinahet em, numei nahoidohsah ding hinam?
Mitakip Pakaiyin chan ahoppeh dungjui le mitakip Pathenin akoudoh hungjui banga achonlou khoh ahi, hiti dinga chu Houbung jousea chondan kasem ahitai.
Cheptansa kikou koiham? Selmang dahen. Cheptan louva kikou koiham? Cheptan din gotda hen.
Cheptan jong ima ahipon, cheptan lou jong imachom ahidehpoi, Pathen thupeh nit bou thu ahi.
Mitakip akikou pet’a bang cheh-in um cheh hen.
Nakikouva chu soh nahim? Ima gel khoh dan, amavang nachamlhatdoh thei le hichu mangcha jon.
Ijeh-inem itile soh ahipet’a Pakai dia kikou chu Pakaiya chamlhat ahin, hitobangma chun chamlhat ahipet’a kikou chu Christa soh ahi.
Man pea kichosa nahitauve, mihem soh-in pangkit hih-uvin.
Sopite, amitakip akikoupet tobang cheh-in hiti chun Pathen angsunga um cheh hen.
Nu-ngah ho thudol vang Pakaiya konin thupeh kaneipoi, hijong le Pakai hepina jal’a tahsan tah a keiman kagel khat kasei ahi.
Pha kasha chu ahile tulai hesoh gentheina jal hin mihem ama aum bang banga aum jeng ding pha kasai.
Numeito kisomlhopsa nahim? Onthol ding gotdan; numeiya kona ongdoh nahim, numei holdan,
Jinei jongle chun achonsea vang nahipoi, nu-ngah jeng jong ajineiya chu chonsea ahipoi. Amavang jinei hon tahsa genthei hesoh athoh diu ahin, hichu kapeldohsah nom nahiuve.
Ahinla hiche hi kaseipeh nahiuve sopite, phat anaitai, tukal’in jineisa chengse jong jinei lou bangin,
akapte chu kap lou bangin, akipahte kipah lou bangin, thil kichohten jong imacha nei lou bangin,
vannoiya natong thilbol’an jong imacha bol louhel bangin um hen; ijeh-inem itile hiche vannoi hi alim-agong akitolmang jing’e.
Lungkham louva naum diu kadeiye. Jinei loupan Pakai jeng agel’in Pakai lung lhai ding bou agel’e.
Jineisan vang vannoi thil ho agel’in, ajinu lung lhai ding agel’in;
hijeh chun akikhenna aum’e. Numei jineilou nu-ngah chun Pakai kinbol ding jeng agel jin, tahsa le Lhagaova kithenso ding adeiye; ahin jineisa numeiyin vang vannoi thil ho jeng angaiton ajipa along lhaina ding angaitoi.
Hicheng hi nang ho khichahna ding hilouva naphat chomna diu le khen beihel’a Pakaiya kitup keicha naum jing theina diuva kasei peh nahiuve.
Koiham khat’in kitimatpi lou dia akiloipi agolnu akivoppidol kitoh lou asah a, akitimlel behseh a, ikhat aso tei ding le, kicheng lhon hen, alungdeiyin bol jeng hen, chonsea ahipoi.
Amavang koi hile along sunga dettah a dinga, kitim lelna neilou, alunggul se thununtheiya, alunggil’a pangdet’a agolnu kitimatpi louva koijou chu thilpha bola hi;
hiti hin agolnukichenpi pa jong thilpha bol ahinan, ahivangin akichenpi loupan thilpha cheh abol ahiye.
Ajipa ahin laisea numei chu akihen ahin, ajipa thi teng vangle a-ongthol ahitan, Pakai lungdei adei dei to kicheng thei ahitai.
Ahinla keima ngaiton vang achuti moh um jeng thei le nomsa jonte, ajeh chu keijong Pathen Lhagao change kigel kahi.
Doihouna kinei neh le chah thudol’a vang, ijakai hetna inei bukimsoh-un ihesoh keiyui. Hetna vang hin mi kiletsah hoithona apensah jin, ngailut nan vang mi akhantousah ji’e.
Mi khattou i-them khat hea akigel le ama chun ahet ding dol jeng jong akihet lou lai ahibouve.
Amavang koi tobang khat’in Pathen angailut le ama chu Pathen hetmi ahitai.
Doi houna kinei neh le chah thudol’a vang vannoiya limsemthu doi hi ima ahipon, chule Pathen khatseh tilou adang aumlou jong i-hesoh keiyui.
Ijeh-inem itile vanlaijol le leiset chunga Pathen kisah ho um’u hen lang, hiti chun pathen tampi le Pakai tamtah hijong leu,
eiho din vang thil jouse konna le eiho geiya Amaa ihiu Pa Pathen khatseh le thil jouse amavanga um eiho jong Amavanga hing Pakai khatseh Jesu Christa bou ahi.
Ahinla mi jousen hiche hetna hi aneipon, abang khat’in doihou lai umchan tugeiya achinjeh-un aneh achah-u chu doihouna kinei mongin agel’un, alung gelnau tha alhemjeh-in hichea hin akisuhboh lo jitauve.
Ahin anneh chun Pathen kom einaisah chom diu jong ahipon, ne hih jongleu hen kemchom lou nejongleu hen phatchompi deh lou ihiuve.
Hijongle hiche natha neinau hi alhasamte dia kipal lhuhna ahilouna din ching theiyun.
Ijeh-inem itile hetna neisa nangin doihouna ankong naum chu lhahsamna neimin namudoh le, lhasam tah ahivanga alung gel’a doihouna an neh ding katilkhou lou ding ham?
Hijeh a chu hiche sopi hetnaa lhasam, ajal’a Christa thipeh mi chu nang hetnan asuhmang ahitai.
Hitobang hin sopite dounan chonseuvin lang along gel’u hat lou chu suhnat peh leu chun Christa douna chonse nahiuve.
Hijeh chun kasopi kipal lhuh louna din, neh le chah a kasopi akipal lhuh ding le a-itih chan geiyin sa asan neh dange.
Chamlhat kahilou ham? Solchah kahilou ham? I-Pakaiyu Jesu mu lou kahim? Nang ho hi Pakai dia katohga nahilouvu ham?
Midang din solchah hi hih jong leng nang ho din kahi; ajeh chu solchah kahina mohor chu Pakai hinkhoa nang ho hinna hi ahi.
Hiche hi einelkal ho henga kakihonna ahi.
Nehna dingle donna dia thunei mo kahiuvem?
Solchah dang ho le Pakai sopite chule Cephas banga atahsan numei jia kipuile dia thanei lou kahiuvem?
Ahiloule kei le Barnabas hin natong louva kivahna thei tha kanei lhon lou ham?
Ama sum kisan’a sepai natong koiham? Lengpilei bol’a aga nelou koiham? Ahiloule kelngoi hon ching’a panga kelngoi noitwi nelou koiham?
Hicheng hi mihem ngaidol’a kasei hilou ham? Ahiloule hicheng hi Danthun jong aseihilou ham?
Ijeh-inem itile Mose Danthua chun, “Bongchal chang chilpet muh nakan lou ding ahi,” tin akisun’e. Pathenin bongchal ho akhohsah mong ham?
Hichengpi keiho khohsahna asei hilou ham? Ajeh chu keiho jal’a kisun ahi; ajeh pen tah chu loukaiyan kinepna neiya akaitei ding, chang chil’an jong chan akisan ding kinem’a achil ding ahi.
Keiin nang ho dia Lhagao muchi kitupeh a, nang hoa kon’a leiset thil kakisan lhon didng chu keini dia thupi tah ham?
Midang hon nachunguva thu anei theile keihon kahanei cheh joh lou diu ham? Ahivangin keihon hiche thuneina chu kamangpouve; Christa thudol Kipana Thupha imachaa kasuhmo louna diuvin ijakaiya kathoh ham ham jo’uve.
Houin lhacha kinbol hon Houin’a kona neh le chah akijon’uva, chule maicham phunga lhachasen jong maicham’a kitoh thil hoa chan aneijiu khu helou nahiuvem?
Hitobanga chu Kipana Thupha lhangsam hon jong Kipana Thuphaa kona kivah hingna anei diuva Pakaiyin thu alhuhsah ahi.
Ahinla ken hiche ho hi khat cha jong kamangchapoi. Hichengse chu hitia chu kachan theina dia jong kahinsut ahipoi; ajeh chu kakisonna hi khattouvin ahomkeo asosah sangin thileng keidin aphajoi.
Kipana Thupha seiphongle jong leng keidia kisonna ahidehpoi, kabollou khoh eikisekhum ahibouve; ajeh chu Kipana Thupha seiphong louva um hileng keidia iti khoh a khoh ding hitam!
Ijeh-inem itile keima lungchama bol’a kahile tohman kasan ding hitin, ahinla kachama tong kahiloujeh-in katoh ding lom kin eikisekhumjo ahi.
Ahile katohman chu ipiba ham? Kipana Thupha chu manbeiya seiphonga aum theina ding le hiche Kipana Thuphaa keiman katha neina kachan lom chu lhingset’a kangeh louna ding ahi.
Keima mi jousea kona chamlhat kahitah vangin mi tamcheh kalah lut theina din kei le kei mitin soha kisemdoh kahin,
Judate lah lut theina din Judate lah a Juda mi umin ka-umin, Danthu noiya um miho kalah thei nan, Danthu noiya ka-um lou vangin Danthu noiya umte bangin ka-umjie;
Danneiloute kaloilut theina din Dan nei loute henga Dan neiloute henga Danneilou bangin ka-umjin, amavang Christa Danthua um kahin, Pathen Dan mang lou kahipoi;
mi lhasamte kalah lut theina din alhasamte henga alhasam bangin ka-umjin ahi; hitia hi mi phabep kahuhhing theina dia mitin henga ijakai kahiji ahi.
Aboncha hi Kipana Thupha khohsah jal’a kabol’a, hichea chu chan kaneidoh theina ding ahi.
Lhaitet golseh mun’a khu mi jouse alhai cheh vanga mi khat’in bou hatman asanji nahet louvu ham? Hitia chu nasan theina diuvin lhaiyun.
Golseh bol jousen ijakaiya atibah chengseu atimhat jiuvin, hiche ho hin kem mangthei lallukhuh san na dia abol’u ahin, eihoa vang kem thei lou ahi.
Hitia chu lhaiya kahin, abidoi kicheh neilou kahipon, onghom lai khuttum’a sua jong kahipoi.
Midang henga thu kiseiphonglea ajo le kei ma lah louva ka-um louna dia katahasa hi kachup’a thua kanunsah ahi.
Sopite ima hetoh louva naum diu kadeipoi, ajeh chu ipuipateu chu abonchauva meilhang noiya kijot’a, Twikhanglen pal galkai ahiuvin,
chule abonchauvin Mose nungjui ahiu hetnan meilhang lah le Twikhanglena baptize achangui;
abonchan Lhagao an thakhat anekhom’un,
abonchauvin lhagao twi thakhat adonkhom’ui; ajeh chu anung jui jing Lhagao songpia kon in twi adon’un, hiche Songpi hi Christa chu ana hi.
Ahinla alah-uva mi kon khat chunga Pathen alung lhai loujeh-in gamthip laiya alhukamtauve.
Amahon alung gul banguva thilse ilung gul louna diuva thilsoh hichengse hi eiho hilchahna soh ahitai.
Pathen lekhabua, “Mipi chu anne ding le twidon din atouvun ahinla lam din akipatdoh kittauve,” tia kisun bang chun alah-uva kon khat bangin limsemthu doi houdauvin.
Alah-uva mi phabep’in jonthan hoi apat jeh-uva nikhat sungseh a mihem sang som ni le sang thumin athi lo jeh-in jonthanhoi bol poute.
Alah-uva mi konkhat’in Pakai apatep jeh-uva gulsen achuh lihgam jeh-in eihon patep pou hite.
Alahuva abang bang akiphin jeh-uva misumang Vantil’in asuh mangjehin kiphin hih-vin.
Achunguva thilsoh hichengse hi vetkah dinga soh ahin, chule khang nu nunga mi eiho pho tangna dinga kisundoh ahiye.
Hichejeh chun koi hile adinga kigel’an alhuh louna din ching thei hen.
Mihem doulel lhepna na chunguva achukhapoi, Pathen tahsan umtah ahin, Nathan adoujou kalval’in lhepna anchunguva chuh sah ponte, chule lhepna chuto kilhon’a nathoh jouvuva nahoidohna diu lampi nasempeh diu ahi.
Hichejeh chun ka-ngai tahte, doihou jamsan’un.
Lung khomto mi nahijeh-uva kasei ahi, nang hon kigel toh-uvin.
Phatthei channa khon’a phattheiboh i-ngeh tengu, hiche hi Christa thisan donkhomna hilou ham? Chu le changlhah ihebaljiu khu Christa tahsa changkhomji ihilouvu ham?
Hichea hin changlhah pheng khatseh ahin, eiho tampi jong hi tahsa khatseh ihiuve; ijeh-inem itile ibonchauva changlhah pheng khat changkhom ihiuve.
Tahsa dol’a Israel khu veuvin; maicham thilto neho khu maicham thil changkhom cheh hilou ham?
Ipi kaseiyem? Doi houna kinei neh le chah chu ikhat ahi katia; ahiloule limsemthu doi khu ikhat ahi katim?
Katipoi, chidang namdangten kithoina aneiyu chu thilhaho apeh-u ahin, Pathen apeh-u ahipoi, hijeh a chu thilhaho to chan naneikhom diu kadeilou ahiye.
Nang hon Pakai khon le thilhaho khon’a nadonkop thei lou diu, Pakai dokhang le thilhaho dokhanga ankong na-umkhom thei lou diu ahi.
Ahiloule Pakai chu thangset sahna dia iphin lung hang diu ham? Ama sangin la ihatjo pouvin!
“Ijakai bolngai ahi,” akitin, ahinla aboncha khantouna ahidehpoi.
Koiman ama changseh phatna ding hol louvin midang phatna ding holjo hen.
Kailhang sajohna mun’a thil kijoh ipi hile hetchetna dia dongtoh le louvin nejengun.
“Ijeh-inem itile leiset le asunga um jouse hi Pakaiya ahi,” tin akiseiye.
Pathen tahsanlou min an nea nakouva nache nom’u le na-angsunguva aluichan chu hetchetna dongtoh le louvin nejenguvin.
Amavang, “Hiche hi doiphunga kithoina sa ahi,” atile, naseipeh pau jeh le lung gel’a hetchetna aumtah jeh-in neh dauvin,
nang lung gel’a hetchetna mai kasei ahi pon, khatpa joh a chu kasei ahi. “Iti keima chamlhatna chu mi dang lung gel maiyin atuh oh thei ding ham?
Keiman lunglhaisel’a kisanga, thangvah puma kasan chu kon eitaitompeh ding ham?” tin nate.
Hichea hinneuvin don jong leu chun nabol jouseu Pathen loupina din bol’uvin.
Judate hihen Greek miho hile chule Pathen Houbungmite dia kipal lhuh nan um dauvin lang,
keiman kachangseh a phatchomna ding hol louva, ijakaiya mitin lunglhaina kahol’a huhhinga aum theina diu kabol bangin bol’uvin.
Keiman Christa umchan ka-jop bang hin keima umchan jom-uvin.
Keima neigeldoh jinguva nang ho kapeh kihilna chengse natuh chah jing jeh-uvin nang ho kaseiphai.
Hichea hin Christa mitin luchang ahiya, pasal numei luchang chule Christa luchang Pathen ahidol hinahet diu kadeiye.
Pasal koi hile lukhuh khuh puma taova ha, ahiloule gaothuseiya ham chun aluchang Christa i-asah lou ahin;
numei koi hile lukhuh louva taova ha, ahiloule gaothuseya ham jong chun aluchang ajipa i-asah lou ahi, ama nu chu alikiveltol nu tobangma ahibouve.
Numeiyin lukhuh akhuh lou ngal ding le asam kivotol hen, sam kivotol chu numei dinga jachatna ahile lukhuh akhuh a pha jeng ahi.
Pasal vangin Pathen lim le loupina aput jeh a lukhuh akhuh lou ding ahi; numeiyin pasal thupi na aphondoh ahi.
Ijeh-inem itile Pasal hi numeiya kondoh ahipon, numeijoh pasal’a kondoh ahibouve.
Chule numei khohsahnaa pasal kisem ahipon, pasal khohsahna joh numei kisem ahi.
Hijeh a chu Vantilte jal’a numeiyin ajipa noiya ahichu aluchanga achin ding ahi.
Ahinla Pakaiya hinkhoa hin pasal beiya numei ima ahipon, numei beiyin jong pasal ima ahipoi.
Ajeh chu pasal’a numei akondoh banga Pasal jong numeiya peng ahi, ahinla thil ijakai Pathena kon cheh ahiye.
Nang hon geltoh-uvin, numei lukhuh khuh louva Pathen henga ataoji chu kilom nam?
Pasal dia sam hoisao hi ama dinga nahsahmona ahi, thil umdol mongin jong nahil louvu hiya,
numei dia samsao hi thupina ahi umchanin nahil louvu ham? Ipijeh-inem itile samsao chu akhujol dinga kipe ahi.
Ahinla koitobang anel’a aumle, hiche thudol’a hin eihon chonna lhongpi mong ineipouvin, Pathen Houbungten jong aneipoi.
Hiche hilchahna kapeh diuva hin kaseipha pouve, ajeh chu phat jep jepna dia kikhom hilouvin setna cheh joh dia kikhom nahiuve.
Amasa penin nang ho Houbunga nahung kikhopji tengle loitum tuma nakikhenjiu thu kajan, tahjong katahsan thim thim’e.
Nalahuva lah thei tah miho ahung kiphondoh a hetdoh a aum theina diuva nasunguva lung gel ngaito chom jong um ding mong ahinai.
Ahinla mun khat’a nahung kikhop khom tengule Pakai jan anjon nehna dingdol ahipoi,
ajeh chu amitakip’in ama jan an cheh akineh masah jin, abang khat’in kel athoh jin, adang khatma akham avan aum’e.
Nehna ding donna ding in neilou nahiuvem? O-le Pathen Houbung chu nahsahmoa bol’a aneiloute jachatsah nahiuvem? Ipi kaseipeh diu ham? Kaseiphat diu ham? Hiche thua vang pahcha pouving’e.
Pakaiya kona kalah nang ho kapehson’u thuhil chu hiche ahi, Pakai Jesu apehdoh jan chun, aman changlhah alan,
phatthei aboh jouvin aheh bal bal’in, “Hiche hi nang ho khel’a pang katahsan chu ahi, neihet jingna diuvin bol’un,” ati.
Hitobangma chun jan anneh jouvin khon chu alan, “Hiche khon hi kathisan’a kitepna thah ahi, nadon chan’uva keima neigeldoh jing na diuvin bol’un,” ati.
Ijeh-inem itile hiche changlhah naneh-uva hiche khon’a nadon laiseuva ahung kit kahsea Pakai thina chu naphondoh jingu ahi.
Hijeh chun koi hile alam louva changlhah chu nea ha, ahiloule Pakai khon’a kona don hamchu Pakai tahsa le thisan douna chonsea kisim ding ahi.
Mihem amacheh kikhol chil hen lang akikhol dungjuiyin changlhah chu nehen, khon’a konin jong don hen.
Ijeh-inem itile Pakai tahsa chu ipi kiseina ahi helouva nea don’a chun, aneh a adon’a kona achung thu akitan ahi.
Hichejeh a chu nalah-uva mi tamtah chatmoa na-chea ahin, aihmu mil’a jong atam lheh tai.
Eiho kikhol chil masa leu hen thutanna ichuh khah lou diu ahi;
hijongle vannoi to ithuu akitan tha louna din Pakaiyin eikholchil’uvin eigah chah tauve.
Hijeh chun kasopite, anedinga nahung kikhop tengule khat le khat ki-ngah khom’uvin.
Nahung kikhop tengule thutannanachuh louna diuvin, koihile agilkel’a chun a-in’a hin kineh hen. Thudang dang ho thudol vang kahung tengle sutoh nang ‘e.
Sopite, Lhagao thilpehdol helouva na-um diu kanompoi.
Chidang namdang nahi laiyuva chu limsemthu doi paomo ho noiya kun’a, hiche ho chun napui mangjiu naheuve.
Hijeh a chu kahetsah nahiuve, Pathen Lhagao puihoi mi koiman, “Jesu gaosap chang hen,” atipon, chule Lhagao Thenga konlouvin koiman, “Pakai Jesu,” ati thei poi.
Lhagao thilpeh tampi aumnan, ahinla apea Lhagao khat bou ahi;
chule lhacha natoh tampi aumvangin Pakai khatseh bou ahiye;
chuma le natoh gotchom chom aumin, ahinla Pathen khatseh bou ahin, aman thil hichengsea chu na atohji ahibouve.
Amitakip hi japi phat touna dia Lhagao kiphondoh na hetna thilpeh khat cheh kipea ahi.
Ijeh-inem itile hiche Lhagaova kona chu mi khat chihna thu kipea, michom khat chu hiche lhagaoma maa kona chu hettheina thu kipea,
chom khat jong hiche Lhagaova kona hi tahsan kipea, hiche Lhagaova kon kit’a hi midang khat damsah theina Lhagao thilpeh kipea,
midangkhat chu thil kidang bol theina kipea, adang khatma gaothu seitheina kipea, mikhatma chu Lhagao le Lhagao dat khen themna kipea, khat jong paotin tang hetna kipea, khatma paotin tang ledoh jouna kipea ahin,
ahinla hichengse bol’a chu hiche Lhagao khatseh chu ahin, aman angaito le adei dungjuiya amichan cheh a ahoppeh ahi.
Tahsa pumkhat sunga tibah tampi aumin, tahsa tibah tampi ahivangin tipum khat bou ahi, Christa jong chuti ahiye.
Ajeh chu eiho Juda mi hiu hen Greek mi hijongleu hen, soh hiu hen chamlhat hijongleu hen, Lhagao khat’a dia ibonchauva tahsa khat’a baptize changkhom, Lhagao khat’a dia ibonchauva donkhom ihiuve.
Ijeh-inem itile tahsa hi tibah khatseh ahipon, tampi ahibouve.
Kengphang hin, “Khut kahiloujeh-in keima tipuma kahipoi,” tile hiche vanga chu tipuma hida deh lou ding ahi.
