Chule bilkol hin, “Mit kahiloujeh-in keima tipuma kahipoi,” tile hiche vanga chu tipuma hida deh lou ding ahi.
Tahsa pumpi hi mit hita le hoiya khojahna um ding ham? Apumpin khojahna hita le hoiya gimnam jahna um ding ham?
Tua vang Pathenin tibah ho hi khat khat’a tahsa puma adeina laimun cheh a aphulut ahi.
Aboncha hi tibah khat seh hita le tipum hoiya umtan tem?
Tua vang tibah atam vangin tipum khat bou ahi.
Mit hin khut jah’a, “Nangma ka-ngai chatna aumpoi,” ti theilou, chukit le luchang hin kengphang te nijah a, “Nang ni ka-ngai chapoi, “ti thei lou ahi.
Chuti titah sanga tahsa pumpia um tibah hatmoa kigel chengse hi akhohjo a pang cheh ahiuve.
Eihon jong nahsah louva kigel tibah ho chu ikhohsah jo’uvin, itibah hoimoa um lai jouse jong ijemhoijo jiuvin,
hiche kijepna ho chu itibahhoi ho hin angai chapoi. Ahinla Pathenin tahsa pum hi asuton, alhasam tibah ho chu akhohsah cheh joi,
hitia chu tahsa pum sunga kikhenna aumdaa, hisanga chu tibah ho khat le khat akigel khoh to cheh na diu ahijoi.
Hijeh a chu tibah khat’in athohgim le tibah jousen athoh gimpia, tibah khat seiphat achan le tibah dang jouse jong kipah khom ihiuve.
Nang ho Christa tipum nahiuvin, khat cheh chu atibah nahiuve.
Pathenin Houbung sunga hi amasatah a Solchah ho, aninaa themgao ho, thum channaa mihil ho, chuban’a bolmo kidang bol ho, abankit’a damtheina lhagao thilpeh chang ho, thilphachom bol ho, vaipo them ho, paochom chom tho thei ho atun ahi.
Aboncha Solchah hiuvam? Abonchauva themgao hiuvam? Abonchauva mihil hiuvam? Abonchauva bolmo kidang bol thei hiuvem?
Abonchauva damsah theina Lhagao thilpeh neila hilouva ong? Aboncha pao chom thoa hi-ngal louva ong? Aboncha pao ledoh theila hilouva ong?
Amavang Lhagao thilpeh lencheh ho hadel’un. Lampi phachehjo kavetsah diu ahinalaiye.
Keiman mihempao jouse le Vantilte pao tho thei jong leng, ngailut kanei loule sum-eng dah kivonging le khutbeh kibeng ging bep kahi.
Keiman gaothu sei dohna kaneiya thil imguh jouse jong seidoh a hetna jouse kanei thei, mol tolmang helna thei tahsan geiya kanei thei ahin, ngailut kanei loule imacha kahipoi.
Vaicha gentheite vahna kanei jouse kato thei, katahsa geiya meiya govam jeng dia kaphal ngam thei ahinan, ngailut ka nei loule phatchomna kaneideh poi.
Ngailut nan athoh hat jingin, hejong ahepin, athangsepon, akithang-at pon, akiletsahpoi;
alam louvin achonpon, ama chang phat chomna aholpon, alung hang baipon, thil phalou jat amelchihpoi;
thildih louva akipahji pon, thudih akipapijie;
imajousea athoh hat’in, imajousea atahsanin, ima jousea akinemin, ijakaiya athoh tun tun’e.
Ngailutnan beitih neiponte. Gaothu seidoh um jongle beiding, paochom chom tho um jongle hai ding, hetna um jongle bei ding ahi.
Ijeh-inem itile ihetnau le gaothu iseidoh nau hi bukim lou ahi;
abulhing chamkim ahung tengle akimlou chengse bei ding ahi.
Kachapan laiyin chapang thuseiyin kaseiyin, chapang lung gel’in kagel’in, chapang thil ngaiton ka-ngaitoi; pasal lhing kahiphat’in vang chapan lai thil jouse kapaitai.
Ajeh chu eihon tugeiya phatvetsunga lim kichen louva imu’u ahin, ajo tah le kimaitoa imudiu ahi; tu chan geiya kahet kimlou ahin, ajo tah le eihet kimsoh banga kahet kimsoh ding ahi.
Tun tahsan, kinep, ngailut hicheng thum hi um jing ahin, hicheng lah a ngailut athupipen’e.
Ngailutna del jingun, Lhagaothilpeh ho tup’un lang, ahideh-in Pathen thu seidohna ding hatup’uvin.
Paochom thoa thusei chun mihemte koma sei ahipon, Pathen henga asei ahi, ajeh chu koiman ahetpeh poi, aman Lhagaova thuguh asei ahibouve.
Pathen thu seidoh vang chun mihemte koma khantouna ding le tilkhouna chule lungmonna sei ahi.
Paochom thoa vang ama khantouna ding bou akisei ahin, Pathen thu seidohpa vang chun Houbung akhantousah-e.
Paochom thoa thu nasei cheh diu kadeiyin, ahinla Pathen thu naseidoh diu kadei cheh-e, Houbungin akisan’a khantouna anei theina dia aledoh aum loule paochom thoa thusei sangin Pathen thu seidohpa chu gamchengin aphachomjoi.
Tun sopite, nahenguva hunging paochom thon thuseiying, thu phondoh ham, hetna ham, gaothu seidohna ham ahiloule hilchetna ham mangin seipeh dau leng ipi naphatchompi diu ham?
Hitobang chun hinna bei thil ging thei, kuli ahim, selangdah ham akimut teng agin akicheh loule ipi kitho ahi kon iti ahetdoh ding ham?
Ijeh-inem itile sumkon mutgin akichet loule koi galkon dia kigo thei ding ham?
Hitobanga chu paochom thoa thu nasei tengu nasei cheng akicheh loule ipi naseiyu kon iti ahetdoh ding ham? Hui lhoh mang ding bep’a aseiyu ahibouve.
Vannoiya hin aging thei ogin atam lheh jengin, khat cha jong ajeh bei aumpoi.
Keiman hiche ogin chu ipi kiseina ham he hih leng aseipa dia keima pao helou kahitan, amachu kei dinga pao helou ahitai.
Hitobang hin nang hon jong aban’a Lhagao thilpeh hol nahiuvin, hichea chun lolhin chehna din Houbung khantouna ding ho hahol’uvin.
Paochom thoa thusei chun ipi kisei ham aledoh theina din tao hen.
Ajeh chu keima paochom thon tao leng kalhagao vang atao nan, kalung gil’a van aga aumpoi.
Ahile iti dingba ham? Lhagaova katao tengle lung gil’a katao tei ding, Lhagaova la kasha teng lung gil’a jong kasah tei ding ahi.
Nangin phattheiboh ngeh nan Lhagaovin tao le chun kikhopna mun’a um milham chun ipi naseila helouva nang thangvahnaa chu, “Amen,” iti ati thei ding ham?
Nangin phatah-in thangvahna sei jong le chun khatpa chun akhantoupi lou ahi.
Nang ho sei sanga paochom thoa thu kaseitamjoh jeh-in Pathen kathangvah-e.
Ahivangin Houbung sunga paochom thoa thu cheng asang sang kasei sangin mihil chah na dia kalunggil’a thu cheng nga seh sei kadeijoi.
Sopite, lung gel’in chapang hih-un, nunsetna lama chapangun lang, lung gel’in vang pilhinguvin.
Pathen lekhabua Danthu kisun: “‘Paochomhel tho ho, Michom beh ho kamsunga Keiman hiche mite henga thu kasei ding, Hijongle amahon kasei ngaipouvinte,’ tin Pakaiyin aseiye,” akiti.
Hichejeh a chu paochom tho hi tahsan loulai ho dinga melchihna ahin, atahsansa ho ding ahipoi; Pathen thuseidoh vang hi atahsansa ho ding ahin, atahsan loulai ho ding ahipoi.
Houbung pumpi kikhom hen lang amitakip’in paochom thoa thu aseipet’in milhamho ham atahsan lou lai hoham hung lut jengle, a-ngolgam dol’a namudoh lou diu ham?
Amavang mi jousen Pathen thu aseidoh pet’in atahsan loulai ham milham khat hung lutkha ta le, ajah chengsen asosol’a aboncha chu a-oimoa pang ding,
alungthim selguh jouse kiphongjal’a, chutah le amai tol’a asuh lut jenga Pathen chibai aboh ding, “Tahbeh mongin nalah-uva Pathen aum’e” tia aphonjal ding ahi.
Ipi iti dingba ham sopite? Nakikhop khom tengu amitakip, la sah dingnei jong, thuhil ding nei jong, thuphon ding nei jong, paochom tho ding nei jong, ledoh ding neiyan jong, aboncha chun khantousahna jeng hihen.
Koiham khat paochom thoa thuseiya na-umu le, mi ni ham, atam penin thum geiyin, khat khat’in kilhau hen chule mi khat’in akisei chu ledoh hen.
Pao ledoh ding aum lou vang le Houbung kikhopna ama chu umthim hen, ama changseh le Pathen henga seijo hen.
Gaothu seidoh ho jong chu mi ni ham thum ham geiya aseiyuva, adang hon aseiyu ageltoh diu ahi.
Amavang mi atou thim khattou henga thu ahung kiphondoh le amasapa chu thip hen.
Ijeh-inem itile mi jouse akitilkhouva aboncha alung mon theina diuva nabonchauva khat khat’a gao thu naseidoh theiyu ahi.

ajeh chu Pathen hi lungnoh phahna ding hilouva chamnajo ahibouve. Mithengte Houbung jousea chonna bangin,

I-khat khat hetnom aneiyu jongle a-in’uva ajiteu akidoh diu ahi, ajeh chu numei dia Houbung kikhopna thusei chu jachat um ahi.
O-le Pathen thu hi nang hoa kona hungjah doh pan ha, ahiloule nang ho komseh a bou hung lhung ham?
Khattou Themgaova kigel’a Lhagao thilpeh changa kibol aumle nahenguva kalekhasut hi Pathen thupeh ahi kihet them hen.
Koitobang khat’in anahsah loule ama nahsah louva kikoi ding ahi.
Hijeh chun kasopite, gaothu seidoh ding gut’un lang, chule paochom thoa thusei ding jong khamhih-un;
amavang ijakai hoitah le kitup keiyin kibol cheh hen.
Sopite, nahenguva kaseiphong Kipana Thupha, nakisan’uva pansatna naneiyu chu kahetsahnom nahiuve;
nahenguva kathusei phonga chu napandet jingu le hiche vanga chu huhhinga um ding nahiuve, achutiloule mohseh a natahsan’u ahibouve.
Ajeh chu amasapen’a nang ho kapeh, kathulah chu ahile Pathen lekhabua kisei dungjuiyin eiho chonset chengse khel’in Christa athin,
ama chu avuiyun, chuin Pathen lekhabua kiseibangin nithum nin kaithouvin aumtai;

hiche ban hin sopite mi ja nga valjen henga khatvei lah-in akilah-in, alah-uva atamjo tugeiyin ahing nalaiyun, phabep vang athitauve;
abanin Jacob henga akilah-in, chule solchah jouse henga jong akilah-e;
Akhon nan aphat louva peng tobang kei henga jong ahung kilah-in ahi.
Keima Solchah ho lah a alhumpen kahin, Pathen Houbung kabolset jeh chun Solchah tiding jong kakilompoi;
hijongle Pathen lungset jal’a keima hiche hi hikha kahibouve, chule alungsetna hi kei dia ima pang lou ahipoi, amaho chengse sangin kaha toh gim cheh jon, keivang kahipoi, eiumpia Pathen lungsetna joh chu ahibouve.
Hijeh chun amaho hiu hen kei hileng hitia hi kaseiphonuva, nang hon chutima chun natahsantauve.
Christa thinaa kona kaithouva aumdol kiseiphong lea, itia nalahuva koi koihamin mithiho thokitna umlouva aseiyu ham?
Mithi thokitna aum loule Christa jong kaithouva umlou hinte;
chutia Christa kaithouva aum lou mong le kathuseiphongu jong moh ahin, natahsanu jong pannabei,
mithiho kaithouva aum loule Pathenin Christa akaithou lou ahin, akaithouva akiseijeh a Pathen douna hettosaha pang Pathen dia jouthua hettohsah a pang mia eikimandoh diu ahi.
Ijeh-inem itile mithiho kaithouva aum loule Christa jong kaithouva umlou ahin,
chutia Christa kaithouva aum loule natahsan’u jong phachom lou, tugeiya nachonset chengseuva um jing nalai nahiuve.
Chule Christa hinkhoa ihmu milsa chengse jong amangthah gam ahitai.
Chutia Christa to hingkhom dia ikinepnau hi tu hinkho sung mai maiya ding ahile, mi jouse lah a eiho hi voujang natna theipen ihiu diu ahi.
Tun vang Christa thina konin kaithouvin aumin, a-ihmu milsa ho thokit tei ding photchehnan apangtai.
Mihem khat jeh a thina aumdoh bangin, mihem khatjeh-in thina kona thokitna aumdoh tan,
Adam sunga pen jeh-in mi jousen athilon, hitobanga chu Christa sunga um jeh a mi jouse kicho hing ding ahiuve.
Hiche hi amichang cheh ama phat phat’a kilhah tho ding ahi; Christa hung teng amite hintin,
achaina hipaiya, Christan vaihom na jouse le tha neina jouse chule thahat tin cheng asuhmangsoh teng Lenggam chu Pa Pathen apeh ding ahi.
Ijeh-inem itile Pathenin agalte jouse ajoa akengto noiya alutsah masangsea Christan lengvai apoh tei ding ahi.
Suhmang ding gal nukhah pen chu thina ahi;
ajeh chu Pathen lekhabun, “Aman ijakai akengto noiya akoisohtai,” ati. Ijakai athu noiya kikoisoh lah a hi ijakai athu noiya koisohpa tah vang chu kisimtha lou ahi akichen’e.
Pathenin ijakai Christa thu noiya alutsah soh teng, Pathen chu abonchakei chunga ahitheina dinga, thil ijakai aboncha anoiya lutsahpa noiya chu Chapa jeng jong lut ding ahi.

Tahsaphea hing jouse tahsaphe jong akibangpoi; mihem’a achomin, gancha tahsaphe achomin, vachate tahsaphe achomin, nga hoa achom’e.
Van tahsa ho aumin, leiset tahsa ho jong aum’e; ahinla van’a ho loupina achomin, leiset’a hoa jong achomin ahi,
Nisa loupina achomin, lha loupina achomin, ahsite loupina jong achome. Ahsi khat loupina jong ahsi dang khat sangin achomin ahi.

leivuiya konpa lim ilo banguva van’a konpa lim jong ilo cheh diu ahi.

nang hon taonaa neihu diu ahin, chutia chu mi tamtah-in eitaopeh nau donbutna eikipeu phattheina chengse jal’a chu mi tampin thangvahna anei diu ahi.
Kakison nau chu hiche hi ahi: vannoiya kachon namlhah-u le nang ho kabolnau hi tahsaphe chihnaa kabol’u ahipon, lung thengsel le lung navahpel’a Pathen lungset jal’a bol kahiu kahet themnau lung gil hi hettohsah a pang ahi.

Hiche ginchatna jal’a hi lungsetna avel vel’a nanei theina diuva nang ho henga hung masah ding kanatup ahin,

Hiche bol kagot’a doi beiya lung linglao beh kahim? O-le tahsaphe lunggel’a, “Heng’e, heng’e,” moh tia, “Ahipoi, ahipoi,” moh ti ding kagot beh ham?
Pathen tahsan umtah ahin, nahenguva kathuseiyu chu, “Ahinai, ahipoi,” moh ti thei ahipoi.
Ajeh chu kei le Silvanus chule Timothy, keiho seiphong jal’a nasunguva cheng Pathen Chapa Jesu “Ahinai, ahipoi,” moh ti ding ahi pon, ama sunga chu, “Kanom nai,” tina umdoh jeng ahi.
Ijeh-inem itile Pathen thutep chengse chu amasunga hi, “Ahinai,” kitia; hichejeh tah a chu Ama jal le eiho jeh a choi-at ahichehna dia Pathen henga, “Amen,” kitiji ahi.
Christa hinkhoa dia keiho le nang ho gom’a eisudet’uva thao einu’va chu Pathen ahin,
Aman eiho mohor einamkhum’uva, lhagaova khamgahna chu i-lungthim sunguva eipeh-u ahi.
Nang ho kakhohsah jeh a tugeiya Corinth a kahung lou hi kahinkhoa ahetoh Pathen pan’a ka kou ahi.
Natahsan thu’uva kipuchansah kahipouve, nakipana diuva natoh khonpiujoh kahiuve, ajeh chu tahsanin nadingdet nauve.
Lung phatmo sah dia nahenguva hung kit lou dinga kei le kei kiphatsah kahitai;
ajeh chu nasulung hangu leng, hiche kalung phatmo sah ho tilou chu konba eikipasah tan tem?
Hijeh a chu kahung teng le eikipasah dinghon eilung phat mosah louna diuva hiche hikahinsut ahi, ipijeh-inem itile kei kipana chu nang ho nabonchauva nakipa nauva kaginchat tahbeh ahiye.
Nang ho lung phatmosahna ding hilouva thalhingset’a nang ho dia ngailutna kanei hinahetdoh theina diuva, lung hesoh genthei tampi, lungkham chule mit lhi long longa hiche hi kahinsut ahibouve.
Koiham khat’in lung phatmona aboldoh le kaima eilung phatmosah ahipoi, nabonchauva nabol khoh behseh louna diuva miphabep nalung himosah-u ahibouve.
Hitobang thua hi japin ama a-oimo chu phaset ahin,
nang hon ama chu lung gim behseh a, alhah lhop pailouna dinga na-ngaidam’uva natil khoujoh diu ahi.
Ama dia ngailutna nakicheh sah diuva ka-ngeh nahiuve.
Nangho imalam jousea thua nungte nahiu photchetnaa akipatepnau chu hetdohna dinga hiche hi kahinsut ahinai.
Nang hon mi khattou na-ngaidamu le kenjong ama chu ka-ngaidam thouve, hitia chu khattou ka-ngaidam le Christa angsunga nang ho jal’a kabol ahin,
Satanin eijotho louna diu ahi, ajeh chu eihon ama dohna lungthim ihaiyu ahipoi.
Christa Kipana Thupha seiphong dia Troas a kahung chun Pakai dinga katohna dingkot lent ah-in akihonge;
ahivangin kasopi Titus kamudoh loujeh-in kalungthim akicholdo theipon, hijeh chun miho kalhadoh-in Macedonia lama kahungtai.
Christa hinkhoa galjonaa eikijotkhompi jinguva, keiho mangchaa Christa hetdohna le phondohna chu muntin’a gim namtui banga either chansoh-uva Pathen chu thangvahin um jing hen.
Pathen koma kei ho hi Christa dinga huhinga umsate heng le amangthah ding ho heng geiya jong gim namtui kahiuvin,
athi dingin thipo kanam’un, ahin gdin jong gim namtui kanamuva. Hicheng dinga chu akhomto soh thei koiham?
Keiho vang Pathen thu kiveina mang miho tobang kahipouve, lung thengseljoa Pathena kona Pathen angsunga Christa to hingkhoma thusei kahi bouvui.
Keiho le keiho kiseipha pan kit kahiuvem? O-le konkhat banga nahenguva ding hihen nang hoa kon hijongle seiphatna lekha thot neilou khoh mi kahibeh-um?
Nang ho hikeiho dinga lekha thot, ka lunggil’uva kisun’a, mitinin asim’a ahet nahiuve;
keiho lhacha kapan’uva nang ho hiChrista lekha thot kichentah nahiuvin, songpheng chunga lekha twiya kisun ahipon, mihem tahsa lung chang’a Pathen hing lhagaova kisunjo ahi.
Hiche kisonna hi Christa jal’a Pathen henga kaneiyu ahi.
Keihoa kona bulhing dinga seithei, keiho chamin ima kahipouvin, kabulhin nau hi Pathena konjo ahin,
Aman keiho hi jih tho Danthu hilou Lhagaova kitepna Thah kinbol lhacha theiya eisem’u ahi; ajeh chu jih tho Danthu chun thina asodoh-in, Lhagaovin vang mi ahinsoi.
Thi lo na ding bep’a akin kibol songpheng chunga kijih tho Danthu jeng bon chubanga aloupia, amaivah loupina chu amolsuh suh ahi vanga, Israel chaten Mose mai avet chang ngam louvu le, 8Lhagaova dinga lhacha kinbolna chu ijat’a loupe da ding ham?

Themmo chan na dinga lhacha kinbolna bon aloupi le them channa dinga lhacha kinbolna loupina chun tamtah a akhokheljoh ding ahi.
Hichejeh a chu loupe tah akigel chu hiche hin aloupina adeh lhah phat’in aloupi thei tapoi.
Ijeh-inem itile aloupina molsuh suh bon athupi le tonsot’a loupe den jing jeng ding chu gamchenga thupijo ahi.
Hiche kinepna hi kanei jehuva hijat vei hi phongtah a hakatji kahiuve.
Amaivah molmang hel Israel chaten amu louna diuva ponlu kikhuhji Mose tobang kahipouve.
Ama ho chu alunggel’u atah jo cheh tai. Tuni chan geiyin Kitepna Lui asim tengulehiche ponlukhuh chu kihohdoh louvin aumden jing nalaiye; ijeh-inem itile Christa to hinkhom tengle bou kihohdohji ahi.
Tuni geiya hiche Mose Danthu chu asim tengu le alungthimu pon lukhuh kikhujol banga kikhu khumji ahi.
“Aman Pakai heng ajot lut teng ponlukhuh chu ahohdohji,” akiti.
Ahin Pakai chu Lhagao ahin, Pakai Lhagao umna chan acham-lhat aum’e.
Keiho maikhu lou chengse, phatvet’a kive banga Pakai loupina kimusah ho hi Pakai kisah Lhagao chun loupina khat’a kona loupina cheh lim khat’a eikheldoh-u ahitai.
Lungset vanga hiche lhacha kinbolna kanei khah jeh-uvin keiho kalhadah hih hel’ui;
jachatna thilguh chengse kapai lhauvin, doha lungthima chon lou, Pathen thu seilep louvin Pathen maiya mitin vetchah dingin phongtah-in thudihin kachon’uvin, keiho le keiho kiseiphatna kabol’uve.
Ijentia ka Thupha seiphongu jong hi akikhu mang akisel ahijongle amangthah dia bou kikhu mang hiding ahin,
amaho chu hiche vannoi pathenin Pathen lim mong monga hung um Christa loupina Kipana Thupha khovah amu thei louna diuva atahsan lou nau lungmit asuhchot peh ahi.
Ijeh-inem itile keiho le keiho kiseiphongle kahipouvin, Jesu Christa chu Pakai ahije kaseijuva, chule Jesu jal’a keihojoh hi lhachaa pang kahidolu kaseiyu ahi.
Ajeh chu, “Muthim lah a konin kho hungvah hen,” tia Pathen ma ma chun Christa meiya Pathen loupije hetna khovah chu keiho lungthim ahinsalvah sah ahitai.
Keihon hiche leibel’a gou kachin’u hi thaneina chungnungpen chu keihoa kon hilouva Pathena hungkon ahije photchetna ahi.
Hoima lam jousea eikineh chintouvin, ahivangin eikisu ngem deh pouve; lung dongin ka-um’uvin, ahinla kalung lhadeh pouve;
eikinojam leuvin, ahivangin donlouvin ka-umdeh hih-ui; eikijep lhu-vin, ahinla eikisumang deh pouve;
Katahsauva hi Jesu hinna akiphondoh theina dingin katahsauva hin Jesu thin achu kapole jingui.
Thitheina katahsauva hi Jesu hinna akiphondoh theina din, kahin vangun Jesu jel’in athi dingin eikipedoh jinguve.
Hichejeh a chu keiho sunga thinan na atoh jinga, nang ho sunga hinna um’ah ahi.
Pathen lekhabun, “Katahsan jeh a thu kasei ahi,” ati bang chun, keihon jong tahsanna Lhagao chu kaneiyuva, hijeh a chu keihon katahsan’uva thu kaseiyu ahi;
ajeh chu Pakai Jesu kaithoupa chun Keiho jong Jesu to eikaithou thauva nang ho to eihin dinkhomsah diu kaheuve.
Lungsetna ahapunbe cheh a mihon Pathen loupina athangvahbe chehna diuva ijakai aboncha nang ho jal’a ahisoh keiye.
Hichejeh chun kalung lhapouve, kamihem tahsau po nung hi akem jing vangin, kasung lam’u hi ani nin athah cheh cheh jeng’e.
Ijeh-inem itile hiche jangkhai cha phat chom khat kathoh gim nai hin hachunga chungnungjoa tonsot’a ding loupina eisemdoh peh diu ahi;
ajeh chu mithei thil kakat pouvin muthei lou thiljoh kakatjo’uve; ijeh-inem itile muthei thil chu phat chom khat’a ding ahin, muthei lou thil chu tonsot’a ding ahiye.
Ajeh chu hiche ponin tobang kaleiset in’u hikiphe lha jongle khut’a sah lou Pathen’a kon tonsot in van’a kaneiyu kahenauve.
Hiche ponin sunga kap le penga ka-umu hi khut’a sah lou van in’a chen kal ngah lel kahiuve;
hichea chu kachen tengu le sagoh keova eiki-imsah lou diu ahitai.
Ijeh-inem itile hiche ponin a kachen laiyuva hi pohgih hahsa pao kap a peng kahiuvin, hichu katahsan in hi paidoh jeng ding deina ahipon, van in’a chenjoh a hin nan thina aval lhum ding deina ahijoi.
Hiche dinga chu Pathenin eigontoh-uva khamgahna Lhagao geiya eipeh-u ahiye.
Hichejeh a chu lung ngam’a um kahiuvin, chule hiche tahsaa kachen laiseuva hi Pakaiya kon’a gamla tah a kihindal kahi kaheuve.
Ajeh chu tahsan’a khosa kahiuvin, mitvet maiya kahipouvin ahi.
Kalung ngamlo nau chu hiche tahsa in’a kachenu hi dalhaa Pakai in’a chen ding gam chenga deijo kahi tauve.
Hijeh a chu hikom in’a cheng ung, chukom in’a chensa jong leuveng Ama lung lhaisah dingbou katuppi pen’u ahi.
Ijeh-inem itile mitinin tahsaa athilbol pha le se tohman akisan chehna dinguva ibonchauva Christa thutanna masanga ikilah cheh diu ahinalaiye.
Pakai ginje kahetjeh-uva miho katemu’va thunun kagot’u ahin, Pathen dia vang hetsa kahiuvin, chule nang hon nalunggil’uva neihet diu kakinem’e.
Nahenguva hung kiseipha ki tkahipouve, mihem lungthim lam velouva maivet’a ki song ho chu nadeh jouna diuva kei ho neikisonpi theina diuva phat kapehjoh-u nahiuve.
Ajeh chu kangol’ule Pathen ding ahin, kachihule nang ho ding ahi.
Christa ngailutnan eituh khom jeng jeh-uva japi khel’a khat athitah jeh a, japi thisoh dol’a ki-ngaito ahin,
hijeh a chu ahing ho chu amahoding mai maiya hing hilouva, amaho dia thia thoudoh kitpa dinga chu ahin theina diuva amaho khel’a Ama chu thia ahitai.
Hichejeh chun tukal’a lhah koima tahsa dol’in kahetapouve; Christa jong tahsa dol’a kanahet nau um jongle tukal’in vang chutin hetapou vinge.
Hijeh a chu koi hi le Christa to hingkhom chu thilsem thah soh ahitan, atil’a kisem masa chengse kitolmang ahitai, ven thil thah asohtai.
Hiti ijakai hi Christa jal’a keiho le ama kihouchamna boldoh a, chule hiche kihouchamna dinga lhacha kin eibolsah-uva, Pathena hungkon jeng ahi.
Ijeh-inem itile Pathenin Christa hinkho sunga chu vannoi le ama kihoutohna asem’a, asuh khelna chengseu asimpeh daa, chule hiche kihouchamna thu chu keiho sunga eikhumpeh-u ahi.
Hijeh a chu keiho Christa dinga palai kahiuvin, Pathenin eimanchah-uva a-ngeh ahin, keihon Christa jal’a kathum nahiuve, pathen to kicham’un.
Chonset helouhelpa chu, Ama hinkhoa Pathen dihna ichan theina diuvin eiho khel’in, Pathenin chonsen asemtai.
Amato tongkhom kahijeh-uva Pathen lungsetna namu’ chu mohseh nahisah louna diuva katem nahiuve;
ajeh chu Pathen lekha bun: “Lah phat chan nataona kasangin, Huhhing nikhon nangma kahui,” ati. Ven tu hi lah phat mong ahin, ven tu hi huhhing nikho ati.
Lhacha kinbolna hi nolnabei ahina dinga koima masanga kipal lhuhna dingkikoi lou ahi.
Ahin Pathen lhacha kinbol kahinauva keiho le keiho ijakaiya kipah chaa, lung dehat tah a hesoh genthei jou se le thoh hahsa, tosetna tin cheng,
eikivohna jouseu, songkul lutna ho gei, japi eikitilset pehna jouseu hi le, choldo lou, ihmu lou le nelou chalou kahiuvin;
lung thengsel le hetna, thoh hatna, khotona, Lhagao Theng vangin ngailutna giltah-in kaneiyun,
thudih le pethen tha hat’in kapngun, dihna galvonin kamangun, jel le vei kahongui;
jabolna hihen jumso na hijongle, seiphatna ahiya seisetna ahiya, thudih kaseiyu jongle jouseiyin eiki bol’uve;
suhmilsa kabah vangun kihedoh thouvui; athisa kabah vangun, ven kahing jinguve; eikibolgeh lheh kabangun, eikithat paipouve;
lunghem tah eikibahsah vangun kakipah jingui; vaicha lheh kabangun ahila mi tamtah kahaosah tauve;imacha neilou kabanguvin ahinla ijakai kanei kimsoh nauve.
Vo Corinth mite kalungthimu lentah a kihonga, nahenguva kambem bema thu kaseiyu ahi.
Nasunguva lungnoh phahna ima kibol lou ahin, nang ho kilhaset sum’a kisunoh phah lou nahiuve.
Chate henga thusei banga kasei ahi, keiho bol lethuh nan nalungu hong len’uvin.
Atahsan lou ho to namkoljon khat pokhom hih-un, ajeh chu adih le dan dih lou ipia kikop theiya, o-le khovah-in muthim to ipi aneikhom beh am?
Christa le thilha ipia kihou theiya, 0-le atahsan le atahsan lou ipi chan kihom theibeh am?
Pathen Houin le doilim sem thu ipia kihoutoh theiyem? Ijeh-inem itile eiho Pathen hing Houin ihiuve. Ajeh chu Pathenin hitin aseiyin: “Keima alah-uva kachen’a ka lhat le ding, A-Pathenu kahiya, amaho kamite hidiu ahi.
Hijeh chun miho lah a konin hung potdoh-un, Amaho chu dalhauvin,” tin Pakaiyin aseiye. “Thilboh chu tongkha hih-uvin, Keiman kalamto ding nahiuve.
Keima na-Pau hing ting, Nang ho kachate nahi diu ahi,” tin Hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseiye.
Ngaitahte, thutep hicheng hi ineijeh-un tahsa le Lhagao suboh thei jousea konin kisuthengu hitin, Pathen ging’a then chamkimsoh a hin ding ngaitou hite.
Nalung neihonpeh-un, koima adih louvin kabol pouvin, koima kasuse pouvin, koima kichungtoh lapnan kabol pouve.
Nang ho mosona dinga kasei ahipoi, ithiu le thisap ding ihin’ule hingsap dia kalunga kavop jingo thu kasei ahitai.
Nahenguva ngamtah tah a kasei ahin, kisonpitah tah ajong avumval’in kakipah lheh jeng’e.
Macedonia kahungu chun tahsaa choldona neilou kahiuvin, muntin, a gentheina jeng ahin, polama mito kinahna jeng lung sunga kichatna jeng ahi.
Ahivangin lung lhadaisa ho tilkhou kit thei Pathenin titus hung lhun chu tilkhou nan eineiyui.
Ahung mai mai jeh hilouva, nang hoa kona lungmon thu ahin lhut, itobanga neimu nom’uva, neigimpi dol’u chule neihuh nom dol thuu aseijeh ahiye. Hiti chun eikihapasah cheh jeng’e.
Lekha kahin thot chun nalunghemsah jengu jongle kakisih dehpoi; hiche lekha thot chun phat chom khat’a ding hijongle nalunghemsahu kahetdoh a chu nommo kasha ding sol ahitan,
tun vang kakipah tai; amavang nalunghemu kakipapi ahipon, nalunghemu chun lungheina asosah jeh ahi; Pethen deilama lunghemna chu natoh-u ahitan, kei ho jeh a manthahna ima naneipouve.
Pathen deiya lunghem chun lungheina asojin huhhinga nasodoh jin ahi; leiset thudol’a lung gim nan vang thina asodohji ahibouve.
Pathen deiya lunghem nan itobang tah a nachunguva na atoh ham ven, lunghanna, kichatna, nagichatna, tom ngaina, thu adih lama kitan ding deina asosah tai. Hiche thu dol’a chun themmonabei nahiu akichetsahtan ahi.
Hijeh chun lekha chu kahin thot jeng vangun, adih lou bolpa le adih bolpa jeh a kahin thot ahipoi, Pathen maiya keiho dinga itobang gunchu nahiu phondohna dingjoh kati ahibouve.
Hichejeh a chu eikitilkhou chom’uva ahi. Keiho cheng kitilkhouna chungvuma Titus lhagao nakidosah jehuva akipa jeh chun keiho jong kakipah chom lheh jenguvin ahi.
Ama koma chu nang ho kakisonpiuva ahile nang hon neijumso dauvin, ajeh chu nahenguva thutah jeng kaseiyu ahin, hiche Titus henga kakison nau chu atahje kiphonchen ahitai.
Itobangtah a thua nung dia kigosadema um nahiule kithing thinga gingkhen cha ama nalamtou ageldoh chanin nakhoto nau akhang khang jeng’e.
Nachunguva ijakaiya kakisonpi thei jeh-uvin kakipah lheh jengin ahi.
Sopite, Mecedonia Houbung ho kipe Pathen lungsetna hi nahet diu kadeiye;
ajeh chu gim genthei nasatah thoh a patepna atokhah vangun hitobang lah a hin akipanau achung chonjo nalaiyin, avaichat lheh vangun teptena val’in hongphal tah-in thil apejengui.
Hetoh a kasei ahi athauvin ajochan, akalval geiyin jong apeuvin, achamtah-uvin
mithengte dia lungsetna lhacha kinbolnaa chu pankhah tei deinan kahenguva a-ngeh-uve.
Hiche hi kaginchat kalval’u ahitan, amasan amaho tah Pakaiya akiphaldohuvin, chuin Pathen di bangin keiho henga akipedoh jengui.
Hijeh a chu hiche lungsetna kin anabol pansa Titus chun nang ho lah ajong abol molsoh dinga katilkhou jingo ahi.
Keihon katildoh-uva ijakaiya nahaodoh-uva tahsan, thusei, hetna lengailutna tilkhouna tin chenga nabulhin banguvin, hiche lungset thilpeh a jong hin bulhingsoh-uvin.
Chondan dungjuiya kasei ahipoi, na-ngailut nau atahbeh ahidol kholdoh teina di amidnag ho mi kithopinaa athanop dol’u kasei ahibouve.
I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa lungstna chu naheuve; haotah ahin, avaichatna chu nang hon nahaolo nadiuvin nang hojal’in amatah vai chan ahung umdoh tai.
Hiche thua hin kagel seipehung’e: ningkum chun nang ho mi kithopi nom le akithopi masapen nahiuve.
Tua hi natoh patsau chu nachaisoh ngal diu ahi. Nang ho mi kithopi tha nom nahiuvin, hijeh chun nathauvin ajochanin bulhitsoh jenguvin.
Mihem khat’in kithopina thilpeh apeh nomten le Pathenin apeh ding jet mong teptena aneipon, apeh ding jat bep chu asanpeh ahibouve.
Midang ho pohgih ngai janga nang ho pohgih punsah dingngaito kahipoi. Chamgol’a tetph chet ding ahijoi.
Tulai nang ho neival chu amaho lhahsam hunan kimangle nang ho nalhahsam tengu amaho neival’a kidit thei ding, hitia chu chamgaol’a kisutoh dingahi.
Pathen lekhabun: “Atam kilopan jong aval’in akilah dehpon, Lhomcha kilodoh pan jong lhasam chomin akilah dehpoi,” ati bang chu hi ding ahi.
Titus lungthim sunga nang ho khoto theina tilkhouna chutobang khumpeh Pathen chu thangvah-in um hen!
Nahenguva hung dinga ka-ngeh-u le nom’a ahitan, hiche jong hi achamtah a nahenguva hung dia kigosademsa anahitai.
Houbung tin’a Kipana Thupha asei phong jeh a minthangtah sopi khat jong titus ti kahinsol thauve.
Chutijeng goh ahipon, Pakai ama tah loupina dinga hiche thilpeh lakhom ding le keihon jong kakithopi nom’u vetsahna ding monga kalhonpi le diuva Houbung hon alhendohdau ahiye.
Hongphal tah a kitohdoh hiche thilpeh kabol lenauva hi koiman eidem louna diuva chingthei tah a thilbol kahiuve.
Thilpha bol katup’u hi Pakai mitmu maiya hilouva mihem mitmua jong ahi.
Keihon mun tamtah a aguncheje kaphottohsau isopiu khat jong amani to kahinsol thauve, nachunguva ginchatna lentah aneijeh a tujenga jong kitlkhoujah jeng’ah ahitai.
Titus vang hi nang ho dinga kapankhompi le katoh khompi ahin, isopite niu hi Houbung ho solchah, Christa loupina ahilhon’e.
Nang hokakisonpiu adih dol Houbungho maiya phot chet ahina din amani hi na-ngailut nau kichentah-in chansah-uvin.
Mithengte kinbol thudol vang hinahenguva lekha hinsut ding valjo din bon kagel’e.
Ajeh chu mi nakithopi nomjeu kahenai; hijeh a chu kisongtah a Macedonia mite henga jong ningkum’a apat nang ho Achaia miten thil ijakai gonsadema nakoiyu thu kasiepeh ahi. Natom nagi vauvin amaho geiya atildoh ahiye.
Nachunguva kakison nau chu thu hom keo ahilouna dinga sopi cheng hi kahinsol ahi; kasei jing bangin nepeh diu gonsademin um’uvin.
Macedonia miho to hung lhonin lang kigo louva na-um’u hung toh kha leu, nang ho jum ding katipon, chubanga kipaopi chu kajachat lo diu ahi.
Hichejeh a chu nakitepnau thilpeh chu gonsa koi dinga hiche sopite hi nahenguva hung masa ahiuve; thilpeh ding chu gonsan ana umle lhan lhaisel’a napeh-u kichen ding, cham louva kila hilou ding ahi.
Hiche thua hin alhom tun alhon at ding atam tuna tam at ding ahi.
Kisih pum le peh lou khoh man hilouvin mitinin along dei bang cheh a apeh ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile lung lhaisel’a pea chu Pathenin angailui.
Imalam joousea ijakaiya bulhingsoh nahiuva, ntoh theina diuva Pathenin lungsetma lhingset, aval hel’a jong napeh theiyu ahi.
Pathen lekhabua kisun: “Aman atheijal’in vaichate atoi. Ama dihna chu tonsot’a um jing ahi,” ati bangin.

Hiche hi Abraham vang kiboh chu Jesu Christa jal’a chidang namdangte jong achan theiya tahsan vanga tepsa Lhagao chu ikisan theina diu ahi.
Sopite, mihem ngaidol’a kasei ahi, mihem ngaidol mongin jong suhdetsa kitepna chu koiman isah louvin abolpon, koijong akoibe ngaipoi.
Thutep chengse chu Abraham le achilhah kipea ahi. Mi tampi kiseina banga, “Chule nachihlhah ho din,” kiti louvin, khatseh seina bangin, “Chule nachilhahpa din,” akitin, Ama chu Christa ahi.
Hiche hi kisei ahi: Pathenin asuhdet’a aphondohsa kitepna chu kum ja li le somthum nunga umdoh Danthun thutep chu man mo asosah a ason amang thei ahipoi.
Goulo ding chu Danthu jal’a ahile thutep jal’a hilou ahin, ahinla Pathenin thutepsa jeh a Abraham apeh ahibouve.
Danthu hi ipi ding ba ham? Suhkhel phondohna dia kikoibe, thutep kipe chilhahpa hung kah a ding ahin, Vantilte kimanga palaipa khut’a kitungdoh ahi.
Khatseh dinga thupo le ngailou ahin, Pathen chu khat ahi.
Achutile Danthu hi Pathen thutep to kikal ham? Ahinai saipoi; micho hing theina thaneiya Danthu kipe hile hiche Danthua chu them chan na um ding ahi.
Ahinla Jesu Christa tahsan jal’a atahsan chengse thutep chu akipeh theina diuva Pathen lekhabua thun ijakai chon set noiya akhumchah ahitai.
Tahsan thu hung lhun kah, ahung lhung ding tahsan kiphondoh kah a chu Danthu noiya ki hen kikhakhum ihiuve.
Hitia chu tahsan vanga them ichan theina diuva Danthun eina kaihoiyuva Christa henga eipui naiyu ahi.
Tahsan thu hung lhun kalvang eikaihoi nau noiya chu ihitapouve.
Ijeh-inem itile Jesu Christa tahsan jal’a Pathen chate nahiu ahitai.
Ajeh chu Christa sunggil’a baptize changsa nang hon Christa chu nakivon’u ahi.
Hiche a hin Juda mi le Greek mi kidatna, soh le chamlhat kikhena, pasal le numei kibahlouna aum tapoi, ajeh chu Christa sung gil’a nabonchauva pumkhat nahiu ahitai.
Hitia chu Christa mi nahijeh-un, Abraham chilhah nahiuvin, thutep goulo jong chu nang hon chan ding ahitai.
Goulo dingpa chu thil ijakai neipa ahivangin aneo laisen soh to imachom ahipoi kati ahi.
Apan atep phat lhin kahsen akaihoi ho le in-ngah ho thu noiya bou aume.
Hitobanga chu eiho jong ipilhin masanguva vannoi leiset lekhajembul noiya soh chang inahiuve.
Ahinla phat alhinset phat’in Pathenin a-Chapa ahinsol lhan, Danthu dungjuiyin numei sunga ahungpengin,
Danthu noiya umho lhatdoh a eiho chalam thu ihina diuvin ahung’e.
Chate nahiu kichetna dinga Pathenin a-Chapa Lhagao chu i-lung sunguva ahinlha lut’a, “Abba hepa,” tia ikoujiu ahi.
Hiti ahijeh chun soh nahitapon, chapa nahitan, chapa nahijeh chun Pathen jal’a gouloa pang ding jong nahitai.
Pathen nahet masnguvin aumdol monga Pathen hilou ho lhachan napangui;
tun vang Pathen nahetauvin, lamkhat’a Pathen het jong nahituvin, i-atile sonlel um lhasam tah Danthu lekha jembul lam’a kihei kit’a, abul lama sohna toh nom kit nahiuvem?
Nang hon nikho phabep le lha phabep chule kum kiheichin ho pou nanit jiuve.
Nang ho dinga katoh gimna jouse moh nahisah diu kati ajai.
Sopite, keitobang hiuvin, keijong nang ho tobanga um kahi; nang hon adih louvin neibol pouve.
Katahsa dammo jeh a Kipana Thupha kahung seipeh masah lo’u nahetsau ahi;
katahsa veiset chu nang ho dinga patepna ahijeng vangin thei le hot’in neibol pouvin, Pathen Vantil bang tah le Jesu Christa bang tah-in neisang jo’uve.
Chubanga nakipa nau hoilamba hitam? Hithei le namit chang te ni geiya kaldoh a neipeh nom leu jengu kichentah a kahettoh jing ahi!
Thutah kaseipeh jeh-uva nagal’u kahi ngap hitam?
Miho chun thilpha dinga natom ngaipiu ahipoi, pamse dinga bou nadeiyu ahin, hiti ho dinga chu natompanpi bol’u ahibouve.
Keiman ka-umpi pet maiya hilouvin thil ijakaiya thilpha ding jenga tompan ding aphai.
Kachate, nasunguva Christa lim le mel akigondohsoh masangsea numei naoso nat thoh banga kathohgimpi kit nahiuve.
Tugeiya na kom’uva um’a ka-oso chombeh a hou ding kadei lheh jeng ahi, ajeh chu nachung thu’u kalung agim’e.
Vo Danthu noiya um nom ho na seipeh-un, Danthu najah khah louvu ham?
“Abrahamin chapa ni aneiyin, khat sohnu sunga peng ahin, khat jalen nu sunga peng ahi,” tin akisun’e.
Sohnu sunga peng vang chu tahsaphe pen ngaidol’a peng ahin, jalen nu sunga peng vang thutep guiya peng ahi.
Hiche hi tekah a kihilna thei ahi; Numei te ni hi kitepna ni vetsahna ahin, khat nu hi Sinai molsanga hung kon ahin, hiche nu chate chu soh natong ding ahiuve, hiche nu chu Hagar ahi.
Hagar hi Arabia gama Sinai molsang lim’a um ahin, tuali Jerusalem vetsah apang, achate to soh chang ahitauve.
Jalen nu vang chu chunga Jerusalem lim’a um ahin, ama chu inu’u ahiye.
Ijeh-inem itile “Vo ching-a cha neilou nu kipah-in, Naoso nat thoh khalou nu kipa othongin kho samin; Ijeh-inem itile jipa luppi sangin, Don lou dailouva kikoinu chate atamjoi,” tin akisun’e.
Sopite, nang ho jong Isaac banga thutep chate nahiuve.
Chulaiya tahsaphe dol’a pengpan Lhagao lama pengpa asumang got banga tua jong chuti ahi.
Ahinla hichea hi Pathen lekhabun ipi aseiyem? “Sohnu chu achapato kaidoh than, ajeh chu sohnu chapan jalen nu chapa to gou lokhom theiponte,” ati.
Sopite, hichea hin eiho sohnu chate ihi pouvin jalen nua joh ihibouvui.
Jalenna inei theina diuva Christan eilhatdoh-u ahitai. Hijeh chun dingdet jingun, soh namkol jona chun kihen oh kit tahih-un.
Ven, nahenguva thusei hi keima Paul kahi, nanghon chaptan thu najop’u le Christan imacha naphat chomsah lou diu ahi.
Cheptan thu jop chengse kahettohsah nahiuve, hitobang mi chun Danthua kisei chengse atohdoh ding abat nalaiye.
Danthu juiya themchan go ho chu Christaa kona kisat lhaa, lungsetnaa pul lha nahitauve.
Keiho vang Lhagao chun tahsan jal’a them chang dia kinem’a ei ngasah-u ahi.
Ijeh-inem itile Jesu Christa to hinkhomnaa hin chaptan le tan lou imachom ahipoi, ngailutnaa tong hat jing tahsan thupi ahi.
Nalhai toh lheh meu! Thutah na-ngai nauva koiham nasu tanguvah?
Hiche kijol lhahna hi nakoupauva kon ahipoi.
Chol themchan changlhah lhon pumpi achansohji ahi.
Pakaito hinkhomnaa imachan nasuhmo lou diuva nang ho hi kason lheh jeng nahiuvin, koi hijong le akhohpoi, nasumo pen penu chu athu kitantei ding ahi.
Sopite, keiman chaptan thu kaseiphong lai hile ibol’a eikibolse se ding ham? Kaseiphong tahbah hile Thingpel thudol hi kipal lhuhna hilou ding ahi.
Nang ho suling lao ho chu amaho kisumangsih seh leu kadei lheh-e.
Sopite, nang ho jalen dia kikou nahiuvin, hiche jalenna hi tahsaphe lama jaothauna mai din mang hih-un, khat le khat ngailut’a kijento nan mang jo’uvin.
Ijeh-inem itile Danthu jouse jong hi thugol khat, “Nangma naki-ngailut bangin naheng nakom ngailun,” kitia hi bukimsoh ahibouve.
Amavang khat le khat kiketto sao sao le kibahgamto sao sao nahi khah-u jong le nakisuhmang hel louna diuvin ching theiyun.
Kenvang, “Lhagaovin chon’un chutile tahsaphe lunggul chu namolso lou diu ahi,” kati ahi.
Ajeh chu tahsaphe lunggul chu Lhagao lama to kidouva, Lhagao lama chu tahsa phea to kidou ahin, nang hon nabolnom nom nabol louna diuva hicheng chu kidouto ahiuve.
Hichea hi nang ho Lhagaovin napuiyu le Danthu noiya um nahipouve,
tahsaphe lam natoh chengse chu kichentah a: jonthanhoi, thenlou, huh,
limsemthu doi hou, doichoi, kidou, kinah, thangthip, lunghan, kiloset, loitumsem, kilangkhen,
sumsel, jukham, eltol hitobang ho hi ahi. Kahilchah masah banguva kahilchah nahiuve, hitobanga chon ho chun Pathen lenggam alo lou dingu ahi.
Lhagao ga vang chu ngailut, kipa, cham, thothat, mi khoto, phat, kitahna,
nunnem, kitimthem hiti ho hi ahi. Hitobang ho doudal ding Danthu aumpoi.
Christa Jesu to hinkhom chengsen tahsaphe chu alunggul le angaichat chengse pum a thingpel’a akhetbeh-u ahitai.
Eiho Lhagaova hing ihiule Lhagaovin chon’u hite.
Ikiletsah louhel diu, khat le khat kiphin lunghang ahiloule khat le khat kithang settoa ium louhel diu ahi.
Sopite, mi khattou suhkhel nei, athemmona kimandoh aum jongle Lhagao mi nang hon Lhagaova nunnema nasemphat diu dol ahi; kivephan.
Khat le khat pohgih kipoh hun, chuti chun Christa Danthu nit chamkimsoh-un.
Khattou ikhat khat’a kigel’a, atahbeh a la imacha hilou chu ama le ama jeng jong kijoulhep ahibouve.
Min ama ama natoh cheh kikholtoh hen, anatoh chu aphatnah le midang titah louva ama le ama jeng jong kipah chaa kichoi an thei ahi.
Ajeh chu mitinin ama ama pohgih cheh akipoh ding ahibouve.
Thua kihil’a mi chun ahilpa chu thilpha chengse chankhompi hen.
Nang ho kilhem chavai hih-un, Pathen chu nelpeh dan ahipoi; ajeh chu mihemin atu tu a-at ding ahi.
Ijeh-ienm itile tahsa dol’a tupan tahsaphea kona kemmang theiga alo ding, Lhagao dol’a tupan jong Lhagaova tonsot hina aloding ahi.
Thilpha bolna lama chimtih neipouhite, i-lhah dah louvu le aphatcha tohga ilo diu ahi.
Hijeh chun hungun aphat gomkom inei dungjuiyun mitin chunga thilpha bol’u hitin, ahideh-in eima insung mi atahsan ho chunga habol deh-u hite.
Veuvin, keima kakhut tah-in nahenguva lekha jemkhou tah-in kahin sun’e.
Tahsa vet-hoisah ding go chengsen chaptan sah ding nagot hamu chu imacha ding ahi pon, Christa thingpel jal’a thoh hesohna apeldohna diuva abol’u ahibouve.
Cheptan mong hon jong Danthu anit pouve, chep natansah nom nau chu tahsaa hiche melchihna naneisah jeh-uva chu hoithonom ahiuve.
Kenvang I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa thingpel ti lou thildang ima song hih inge; ajeh chu hichea chu vannoi kei dinga, keima vannoi dinga kikhetbeh kahitai.
Ajeh chu cheptan le tan louvin koima ima asochompoi, thilsem thah hiding bou chu khoh ahi
Hiche Dan mang jouse, Pathen Israelte chunga chamna le hepina um hen.
Tukal vang koiman eisulunggim ta hih hen, ajeh chu kati chunga hi Jesu melchihna polea kahitai.
I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa lungset chun na-lhagaovu umpi hen, sopite: Amen.
Pathen lungdeiya Jesu Christa solchoh Paul’in Ephesus khoa cheng tahsan’a Jesu Christa to hingkhom mithengte henga;
I-Pau Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christaa kon lungsetna nahenguva um hen!
I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa Pa le Pathen jal’a van muntin’a Lhagao vangbohna tin chenga vang eibohPau chau thangvah-in um jing hen;

Aman adeile atup duing juiya Jesu Christa vanga a-lamthu chapate ihi theina diuva Ama dinga eina chom khendoh-u ahi.
Hiche angailut tah achapa jal’a manbeiya eipeh-u thilpeh loupi chu i-vahchoi diu adoi ahi.

Leiset khang lhin’a phat ahung lhun teng Christa hong sunga chu thil i-jakai, vanmun jousea hihen leiset chunga hi jongle Ama sunga chu gopkhomsoh ding,
Ama hong sunga chu Pathenin keiho Judate eina lhendoh-uva eina gonsau ahin, agonsa dungjuiya thil ijakai hin na atoh cheh a, Ama ngaito le dei dungjuiya um jing ahi.
Christa hongsunga dia kinem jing keihon Ama loupina chu kavah choina diuva chuti ahi.
Ama jal’a chidang namdang nang hon jong huh hing nachan nau Kipana Thupha, thudih chu najah-uva, Ama vanga na tahsan’uva, tepsa Lhagao Thenga mohor kinamsa nahitauve.
Pathen vahchoina ding le amiten jalen i-muna dinguva, Lhagao Theng chu eiho goulo ding khamgahna ahi tai
Hichejeh hin Pakai Jesu natahsanu le mithengte chengse na ngailutnau kajah a pat,
kataochanin tang louhel’in nang ho ding kathang vah jinge.
Hichu I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa dinga Pathen, loupina Pa chun chihna leh Ama hetna phondohna thei Lhagao napeh theiyuva,
nakou nau kinepna hi nahet theina diuva nalungthim mit’u ahasah theiya, mithengte dinga goulo anei loupina thalhinje,
atahsan ei ho sunga natong athahat natsatje so-phah hoi ahi lou het theina ding ahi. Hiche athahat thilbol theina kidangtah hi
amanchah a Christa-a thiho lah a akaithouva, van gamsunga ajetlama atou sah ahi.
Hikoma chu Aman vaipo thunei jouse chung, thahat le piputna jouse chunga loupipen minchang ahitai.
Pathenin thil ijakai Christa kengto noiya akoi soh a, Houbung dinga Ama chu ijakiya ima jouse luchang ahisah ahitai.
Houbung chu Christa tahsa ahin, tahsa chu aluchang to akijop teng thil ijakai subukimpa chu bulhingset ding ahi tai
Masanga chu nasuh khel nau le nachonset nauva thisa nahiuve;
hiche laiya chu hiche vannoi leiset khang um chan dungjuiya na chonuva, vanlai jol’a thunei vaipo ho nung juiya, tulai Pathen ngaisah loute lah a natong lhagao thusah a chon’a nahiuve.
Phat khat laiya Juda mi keiho jong hitobang chu kahiuvin, katahsapheu ngaichat lamjenga chon, tahsaphe lunggul le lungtup a chon kahiuvin, midang banga keiho jong lunghanna chate kanahiuve.
Ahinla Pathen he-pina bulhingset, ami-ngailut ning lhing sel’in eingailuvin,
suh khelna-a ithi laitah-un Christa to eicho hing khomtauve, lugnset vanga huhhingchang nahiuve.
Amato ei kaithou thauva, vangam, Jesu Christa hongsunga eitou sah-u ahi tai.
Hichu ahung lhung ding khanga Jesu Christa sunggil’a eikhoto nau lungsetna letset jeng chu eivetsah theina diu ahiye.
Ijeh-inem itile tahsan jal’a lungset man’a huh hing chang nahiuvin, hichehi nang hoa kona hilouva Pathen thilpeh ahibouve.
Natoh vanga ahilou jehhin kisonna thei jong ahi poi.
Eiho Pathen semsa ihiuvin, Pathenin ichonna diuva ana gon masah chengsea chu ichon theina diuva natoh pha chengse tong dia Jesu Christa sunggil’a kisemdoh ihiuve
Tahsa phea chidang namdang nahilaiyu, tahsa khut’a cheptan mihon cheptan lou nahi sah laiyu khang chu geldoh-uvin;
hiche laiya chu Christa to kimat lou, Israel lhangpi kiloikhomnaa pang lou, thutep jal’a kimu kitepnaa pangkhalou, hiche leiset’a hi kinepna bei le Pathen helouva um nahiuve.
Tua vang Jesu Christa sunga na umtah jeh-un masanga na gamlat vangun Christa thisan jal’a ngai dam nahitauve
Christa chu eiho kichamna ahi. Aman kikhena bang lai chu aphe lhan, kidouna chu atahsa phen asumangin, Judate le chidang namdang te pumkhat asotai.
Aman namnia kona Amato hingkhom dinga mithah khat asemdoha chamna asemdoh na dinga Danthu chu athupeh chengse le adan jouse toh asuhmangtha ahi tai.
Thingpel’a athi chun Christan kidouna chu atahsa tah-in asumangin, jat ni chu asuchamin, Pathen henga tahsa pumkhatseh asemdoh tai.
Hiti chun ahungin Pathen to kigamlat namdang nang ho heng le Pathen to kinai Judate henga hiche chamna Kipana Thupha hi ahung seiphong tai.
Hijeh a chu Christa jal’a chidang namdang le Judaten iloi niuva Lhagao khat’a Pa henga lut theina ineiyu ahi je.
Hichejeh chun nang ho maljin le khopem nahi tapouvin, Pathen mithengte chan khompi le a-insung mite nahitauve.
Jesu Christa chu inning song khomdet ahin, sholchahho le Themgao ho songset chunga nang ho kisadoh nahiuve.
Christa chun in kisa chengse chu aloikhomsoh keiya, Pakai Houin theng hi dinga akhantousah ahi;
Ama sunga chu nang ho jong adang chegse to kisakhom Pathenin Lhagaova chenna anei theina dia kisa doh nahiuve
Hichejeh a chu chiding namdang nang ho jal’a soh changa kihen keima Paul,
Pathen lungset vanga nang ho dinga hiche kinbolna eikipeh hi najahsau ahi tan,
thil kiselguh kahenga kiphongdoh a kihetsah dungjuija paltan’a kahinsutsa jong ahitai;
simpou pou leu chun Christa selguh thil kahet themdol hetauvin nate.
Tulaiya Lhagaovin Christa solchah theng ho le Themgao ho henga aphondoh bang hin khang masa laiyin mihem chate akihetsahpoi.
Athuguh chu Jesu Christa jal’a Kipana Thupha hung lhun hin chidang namdang ten jong Judate to gou lokhomna le tahsan khat hikhomna chule thutep chankhomna aneitauve
Athilbol thei thahat le Pathen lungset manbeiya thilpeh eikipe dungjuiya hiche Kipana Thupha lhachaa eikipansah ahitai.
Mitheng te jouse lah a alhumpen kahi vangin Christa haoje akhona bei Kipana Thupha hi chidang namdangte henga seiphongna ding lungsetna hi eikipei;
hichu thil ijakai sempa Pathenin ama sunga tonsot’a akoi thilgon kiselguh chu mitin kamusah a,
tulaiya Houbung jeh a Pathen chihna jat chom chom ahidol hi vanlaijol’a vaihom thuneite hetsahna ding ahi.
Hiche hi i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa chunga kimolso tonsot’a gonsa thilgon dungjuiya um ahiye.
Ama itahsan jal’u le Amato ihinkhom jeh-uva lung ngamna le hanna neiya ahenga lut ngam ihitauve.
Hichejeh chun nang ho jeh a hesoh genthei kathoh hi lung thoi hih-un, hiche hi naloupinau joh ahibouve
Hichejeh a chu dilsua Pa henga taoji ka hin,
hiche Pa vanga hi vanmun jouse le leiset chunga phungtinin kiminvo na aneiyu ahi;
Aman aloupi haoje akhonna beiya kona thahat le thilboltheina a-Lhagao vanga nami-sung nunguva dia napeh theiyuva,
tahsan jal’a Christa chu na lungthim sunguva achen theiya,
hitia chu mithengte chengse to Christa ngailutna jaoje le saoje, chule asanje le athuhje het khen jouna na nei theiyuva,
hetna jouse khokhelsoh hel Christa ngailutna nahet theiyuva, ijakai chamkimsoh hel Pathen chamkimna nabulhin thei na dingu ahije
I-sunguva natong jing athahat dungjuija ithum sangule igel sanguva thil ijakai thahat tah a bolthei Pa,

Christa thilpeh tepte na dan dungjuija eiho mi khat cheh hi lungsetna thilpeh khat cheh eipeh-u ahi.
Hijeh chun Pathen lekhabua: “Ama chung sanga akaltou chun Gal-hing kiman tampi akaitouvin; Mihemte jong thilpeh Tampi apei,’ ati
“Ama akaltouvin,” kiti hi, ‘Leiset noinung geiya akumlhai,’ tilou adang ipi kiseina ham? 10Akum lhapa chu ijaki asuh bulhitsohna dinga vanmun jouse chungvum’a kaltoupa ma ma chu ahi.

Chule Aman miho thil apehho chu: abang sohchah hi na, abang Themgao hi na, abang evangelist hi na, abang Pastor hi na le mihil hi na ahin,
ama ho hin mithengte chu lhacha natohna lam le Christa tahsa sahdohna ding lama agontoh-uva,
eiho chengse hi tahsan’a pumkhat ihikahseu le Pathen Chapa ihet kahseu, mi kikhan lhit ihiuva chule Christa pilhin dung chan iphah kah seuva abol diu ahi.
Hichu ei ho chapang banga mi suhmangna dinga doha thuh a kipodoh ho le mihem lungthim gilouva kon kihilna lhem ho chu kipui chatvaisah a hui nung jousen amut ling le alhoh mang theibep tobang ihilouna diu ahi.
Chuti sanga aluchang hiya Christa chu thil ijakaiya ikhantouna diu va ngailut neiya thuttah isei jing diu ahi;
Amaa kona tahsa pumpi hi kitoh chet’a kisuto khoma kisolmat cheh, tahsa pumpi hi tibah dang chengse hin atuhmat soh keiya, atoh ding dol cheh abol’uva ngailutnaa asahdoh a akhantousah-u ahi je
Pakai pan’a hiche hi seiya kahettohsah nahiuve: chidang namdang ten lung chatvai aput’uva achon bangun chon hih-un;

Ajeh chu Jesu Christa hinkhoa natahsanu le mitheng jouse na-ngailut’u ka jauvin,
nang ho dinga kinepna chu van’a kholsa ahitai, hichu Kipana Thupha thutah thudol’a chun najatauvin,
hiche nahenguva ahung lhun a pat nalah-uva aumdol bangin vannoi pumpia aga pung lheh jengin, najah niuva pat Pathen lungsetna chu thutah-in amachal jingin ahi.
Hitia hi nang hon kangailut tah-u le sohna katoh khompiu Ephras a kona nahetdoh-u ahin, ama hi Christa dinga keiho cheng thalhenga tahsan umtah le lhachaa pang ahin,
ama hin lhagao vin napeh-u ngailutna naneiyu chu eiseipeh-u ahi.

Achapa jal’a chu lhatdohna le chonset ngaidamna ineiyu ahi.
Chapa chu mu theilou Pathen limpu ahin, thilsem jouse sanga masajo ahi;
ijeh-inem itile ama jal’a thil ijakai, van a hihen leiset chunga hijongle, muthei le mumo ho, laltouna ho le loinehna gam ho gei, vaihom thu neina ahin, thil ijakai hi Ama jalle Ama dinga kisem ahi;
chule Ama chu thil jouse masanga anaum jing ahin, thil ijakai hi Amato akijopmat teng ding det ahiuve.
Ama chu atahsa Houbung luchang, abul ahin, ima lam jousea amasat jingna din athiho lah a jong athoudoh masapen’e.
Ijehinem itile Chapa sunga hi Patheinin chamkimkeiya chenpha adei ahi;
ajeh chu Ama jal’a thil ijakai aboncha ahenga suhchamsoh a, Ama vangle a-Thingpel thisan jal’a leiset chunga um jouse le vanlaijol’a um jouse kah a chamna asem ahitai.
Masang laiya thilse nabol’uva lunggel’a nadou laiyun Pathena kona pamse nahiuvin,
tua vang Ama angsunga nolna beihel le boh beh lou, athenga dinsah dinga tahsaphe pua athina tahsa jal’a chu nakicham piu ahitan;
tahsan’a nadindet jinguva, dettah le longlouva, najahsau Kipana Thupha kinepnaa chu long louhel’a napandet jing dingu ahi. Hiche Kipana Thupha chu vannoi thilsem jouse henga kiseiphongsoh ahitan, keima Paul jong hiche lhachaa chu pang ka hi.
Tun nang ho dinga hesoh genthei kathoh jouse hi kakipapi. Ajeh chu katahsaphea thohna hin atahsaa kisim Houbung thalhenga Christa gimgentheina bangkhai jouse asuh bulhit ahi.
Hiche dinga chu Pathen gouching kahiya, na henguva Pathen thu lhingkeiya seiphong dinga eiki-ngense dungjuiya keima lhachaa pang kahi;
hiche thuguh hi tonsot tonsot, akhang khanga ki-im ahin, tua vang amithengte henga kiphongdoh ahi tai.
Pathenin hiche thuguh thalhinje le loupije itobang lom ahi chu namtin henga hilchet ding adeitan, hiche kinepna loupipen nasunguva Christa achen hi ahi.
Amabou hi kaphonjal’uva mitin kathumop’uva, chihna top’a mijouse kahilchah-u ahi; ajeh chu amitakip hi Christa dinga pilhingsaa kadinsah nom’u ahi.
Hiche nadinga hi Aman kasunga eikhumpeh thahat tah a natong jing ahatna chu mangchaa kiseh tah a tonggim ka hi.

Ama sunga chun chihna le hetna gou jouse akisel’e.
Hiche hi koiman seithem’a nanel lhah louna diuva kasei ahi.

Jesu Christa chu Pakai dinga nakisan’u ahitah jeh-in, Amato hingkhom’un;
Ama sunga jung khouvin, kisadoh-un, nakihil banguvin tahsan nan kiphutdet’un, thangvah nan bulhingset’uvin.
Koiman chihgut lekha themna le mihemte pehson doha lhep lhahna thei moh thu homkeiuva gal-hing banga nakai mang louna diuvin ching theiyun, hichu vannoi leiset chondan dungjui bou ahin, Christa-a tobang ahipoi.
Ajeh chu Christa sung, atahsa sunga chu Pathen, a-Pathen hina chamkimsoh a pansa ahin,
vaipoh thu neina jouse luchang Christa to na hinkhom tengu le nang ho jong chamkimji nahiuve;
Ama sunga chu nang ho khut’a kitan hilou, cheptan nahiuvin, tahsaphe pu tahsa chu ponse selhah banga napaiyuva, Christa dinga chep kitan nahiutauve.
Ijeh-inem itile baptize nachan’uva chu amato kivuitha nahitauvin, Pathenin Ama chu thinaa athodoh kit, hiche thokitna chu tahsan jal’a amato thoukhom kit nahiutauve.
Nang ho chonset’a thisa, natahsapheu jong cheptan lou nahiuvin, Pathenin Christa to nachohing khom’uva ichonsetna jouseu angaidamsoh ahitai.
Eidou dal’uva pang khut’a kisun kihilna lhongpi Danthu chu Christan anoi manga, hichu asumangsoh-in Thingpel’a akhetbeh tai.
Christan vaipoh thu neina jouse ahoh lhasoh-in, atahsa chun abonchan ajousoh-in, kichentah-in aphongjal’e.

hichengse chu ahung lhung ding thil ho lim’a um ahin atahsa tahbeh chu Christaa umjo ahibouve.

Amaho chu atahsa pumpi Pathen thilgon banga akhantouna dinga tuhgom’a kilmatsoh guchin thagui chengse kigopsohna aluchang chutoh kimat lou ahitauve.

“Tham hih, tep hih, tongkha hih,” kiti ho chu.
Hicheng hin akimanchah teng mangthahji thilho aseidoh ahin, aboncha hi mihem thupeh le thuhil jeng ahibouve.
Hiche ho hin ki engbol’a hougutna le kichon nemsah chule tahsa tibah engtim’a kitimna jal’in chihna gong apun, ahinla tibah ho kitiman dinga imacha phachom louhel ahibouvui.

Leiset chunga thil ho hilouvin chung lam thil ho jeng gel’uvin.

Masanga nang ho jong hichenga hi ana chon’a ana hing nahiuve.
Tun vang lungsat, lunghan, mitthip, taitom, nakamsunguva kona thujahmo sei jouse hi aboncha napai mangsoh diu ahij.

Sopite, nangho kahung vil’u chu mohjenseh ahilou nahenauve.

Hiche hi Pakai thusah akona kaseipeh nahiuve, ipijeh-inem itile Pakai hungkit ni geiya eiho ahinga kidalha chengse hi itinama jong le a-ihmumilte sanga masajo lou ding ihiuve.
Ijeh-inem itile Pakai ama tah ogin to, Vantil pipu ogin to chule Pathen sumkon gin to kithoa van’a kona hung kumlha ding, chu tengle Christa jal’a thisa chengse thoudoh masa diu ahi.
Chujoutah le eiho ahing nalai amoh chengse hi amaho chutoh vanlaijol’a Pakai lamto dinga meilom’a ikitoltou dingu ahi; hitia chu imatih chan’a Pakai to iumkhom jing diu ahitai.
Hiti ahijeh chun hiti thu ho hin nang ho khat le khat kitilkhou jingun,
Sopite, aphat le achang thudol hi nahenguva hinsut angaipoi,
ajeh chu janlaiya gucha ahung banga Pakai nikho chu ahung lhun ding nang hon kichentah a nahetsau ahi.
Mihon, ‘Chamle lungmon aum’e,” atilai tah-u le numei naoso nat banga photlot louva manthahna chu achunguva hung chuphung jeng ding, koimacha hoidoh louhel diu ahi.
Sopite, nang ho vang muthima um nahitapouvin hiche nikho chun gucha banga nahinlap den lou diu ahi.
Ajeh chu nang ho nabonchauva khovah le sunlai chate nahiuve. Eiho hi janlai muthim lah a um ihipouve;
hijeh chun midang ho banga ihmu louvin, lung limgeh chan kihong jingu hite.
Ijeh-inem itile a-ihmua jong janin bou a-ihmun jukham ho jong janin bou akham’ui,
eiho vang sunlaiya limgeh ihiuvin, tahsan le ngailut ompho bangin kivon’u hitin, huhhing dia kinepna chu thih lukhuh bangin kikhuh-u hite.
Ajeh chu eiho hi Pathenin lungsat khum dinga ei lhenu ahipon, i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa jal’a huhhing chang ding joh a eikouvu ahibouve.
Eiho hah jingu hen ihmu jongleu hen Amato ihinkhom jingna diuva Ama eiho khel’a thia ahitai.

Anatoh nau jal chun ngailut nan hajan jabol’uvin. Nasunguva kichamdel’un.

Paul le Silvanus chule Timothyn i-pau Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christa jal’in Thessalonica khoa Houbung henga:
Pa Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christa konin chamna le lungsetna nachunguva um hen.
Sopite, natahsanu seithei louhel’a akhantou jeh le nabonchauva khat le khat ki-ngailutna apunjal jeh-in keihon tang louhel’a nang ho dia Pathen thangvah vah jeng ding hi akitoh lheh-e.
Nang hon thohgim le bolsetna hichengpi douva hi natahsan jom jeh-un Pathen Hou bung dang ho henga nang ho kaki thang-at pi lheh jengui.
Hicheng nathoh jeh-uva hi nathoh lo na pen’u Pathen lenggam dinga lah thei lom nahi diu, hichun Pathen thutan dihje photchetna aphondoh ding ahi.
Pathen dihtah chun nabol gen theiteu chu kitoh chet’a thohgimna apeh ding ahi;
hiche hi van’a kona Pakai Jesu A-Vantil thanei tah te to ahung kiphondoh teng Pathenin nang ho hi nathoh gimna jouseuva kona keiho puma eilhadoh diu,
meikou deuje ju apat’a Pathen heloute le i-Pakaiyu Jesu Kipana Thupha jop lou jouse chunga phu alah ding ahi.
Amaho talen mat ding chu tonsot’a thoh ding man thahna, Pakai angsung le aloupina thanei tah akona tolmang hel ding ahiuve.
Hiche hi amithengtea kona loupina le atahsan jousea kona jabolna kisan dinga Pakai ahung nikho le chuti ding ahin, keiho hettohsah tahsan nahijeh-un atahsan lah a nang ho jong napangui.
Hichea hin i-Pathen’uvin akouna to kitoh a nasan’uva, thilpha ding nadei jouseu le tahsan vanga natoh chu athahat’a amolso soh keina din tang louhel’in nang ho kataopeh jingui.
Hitobanga chu i-Pathenu le Pakai Jesu Christa lungsetna dungjuiya nang ho jal’a i-Pakaiyu Jesu min choi-at’a auma, nang ho Amasunga naum diu deina ahi.
Sopite, i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa hungkit ding thudol le amato ikikhop khom diu thudol’a hi kangeh-u nahiuve.
Lhang kisam khat tou hihen, Lhagaova kon hihen, thu kithanga kon hihen, keiho lekha thot’a kondol’a kisei hijongle, Pakai nikho chu hung lhungsa dol’in gel’un lang lung ngaito kisuh noh phahsah le lung linglaovin um hih hel’uvin.
Imacha lamin jong koima kilhep lhahsah dauvin; ajeh chu Pathen doumah bolna hung lhung masa ding, mangthah dia peng dan bei agiloupa hung kiphongdoh ding ahina laiye;
amahin dou apat’a, Pathen min pu jouse le houdia kibol thil jouse chunga kichoi sanga, hitia chu acham cham’a Pahen houin geiya jong touphaa aneiya, hung kipathensah ding ahi.

Ijeh-inem itile Danbei chun guh thimin na atong jinge; alailunga kona akilah mang kaha dinga bou atuhkih a chu ahen-oh ahibouve.
Danbeipa ahung chu kiphon doh tah le Pakai Jesu ahungkitna dinga hung kilah paiya akamsunga kikhong doh huiya athaa, asuh mang ding ahi.
Danbeipa hung chu Satan thahatna to hung kilhon ding, thaneina tin cheng le melchihna ho chule jouva bolmo kidang tampi bol theina to hung kilhon diu ahi.

thutah tahsan louva thujouva nomsa chengse chu athuu kitan cheh ding ahi.

imalam jousea natoh pha le thupha seinaa nalungthimu tilkou hen lang phutdet jing hen.

Sopite, sopi koi hile akahleh akalouva chon, keiho hilchahna to kitoh a chon lou mi jouse chu nakiloikhompi louna diuva Pakai Jesu Christa min pan’a thu kapeh nahiuve.
Nakom’uva tong louva ka-umlouvu, keiho umchan itobanga najop’u nang hon na heuve.
Koima an manbeiyin kanepouvin, nang ho koimacha pohgih kahi khah louna diuvin gim genthei hahsa thoh-in sun le janin na katongu’ve.

tahsan jal’a cha dihtah Timothy henga: i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa le Pa Pathen’a konin lungset le hepi chule chamna hunglhung hen.

amahon semthu thusim ho pou le akhonna bei khanggui thusim aseiho’u chun miho lung lutsah hih-in, hiche ho hin tahsan vanga ki mu Pathen gou-thilho sangin kinel baotam na jeng bou asosah-e.

Kihilna dih chu keima eikivopsah kipa umtah Pathen loupina Kipana Thupha dungjuija kihilna chu ahi.
Keima tahsan theiya eigel’a lhacha eipansah, thahat eipea i-Pakai Jesu chunga kakipah lhehjenge.

Ama hintahsan’a tonsot hinna nei ding ho vetkah a pang dia Jesu Christan thoh hatna chengse chu amasapen’a kei chunga photchetna abol nom jeh a hita chu eihepi lheh jeng ahi.

ahinla nangma lung hilounaa ima nacham louvin kabolsah nompoi, chutia chu nathilpha bol chu chamlouva hilouva, nachamtah a naboljoh ding aphai.

Hitia chu nangin kei hi chan khopia neigel le kei khel’in ama hi analemin.
Aman na chunga suh khel anei ham, bat anei ham ahijongle, hijong chu kei chunga del din sim jengin.

Christa Jesu jeh a kasoh chanpi Epaphras-in nahinsalam’e;

Pathenin Vantilte koipen jah a itih a chu: "Nangma kachapa nahin, Tunia kahin nahi, " ati khah em? Chujongle: "Keima apa kahi ding, Ama kachapa hiding ahi, " atim?
chukit le ijakai sanga masapeh achapa vannoi leiset’a ahinpui ding chun aseiyin: "Pathen Vantil jousen Ama chu chibei boh cheh-u hen, " ati.

Nangin adih na-ngailun, Dan dih lou nahot bol’e; Hijeh a chu Pathen, na-Pathenin thao nanua, Naloite jouse sanga nachoi sanga olive thao nanu ahi, " atibouve.
Chule: Vo Pakai, nangman semtil’in Leiset bulpi naphutdoh-in, Chule van ho jong hi nakhutsem ahi.
Hiche ho hi mangthah diu ahin, Nang vang um jing ding nahi; abonchauva ponsil banga chulsoh diu ahi.
Aboncha hi ponlhe banga najeldoh a Ponsil banga nakheldoh ding ahi. Nang vang nabang nahi jingin, Nakum jong beitih um lou ding ahi.
Hichea hi Vantilte koipen jah a: "Keiman namelmate nakengchotpha kaneisah masangsen Kajet lam’a tou jingin, " ati beh em?
Vantilte chu abonchauva lhacha kinbol lhagao, huhhingna goulo ding ho jenle dinga hinkisol hilou hiuvem?
Hichejeh tah a hi ithujah chengseu hi lung nachang cheh a i-ngai diu, achutiloule ikimoh tolmang diu ahi.
Ijeh-inem itile Vantilte seidoh thu bon chubanga adet’a, asu-khel ho le angailou hon kitoh chet’a talen akisan’u le,
hitobang huhhingna nasatah hi nahsah mo leu hen iti isochat diu ham? Athu hi akipatnaa Pakai tah-in aseidoh a, ajahon eiho henga aphotchetsah-u ahin,
Pathenin jong melchihna tampi le thil kidang tampi, bolmo kidang tampi to thoa adei dungjuiya Lhagao Theng ahoppeh a ahettoh sahpi ahi.
Iseiyu vannoi leiset ahung um doh got jong chun Vantilte noiya akoipoi.
Chusangin mun khat’a akihettohsah bangin aseiyin: "Mihem hi ipi hiya ama ding hibanga nagelpeh a, Mihem Chapa chu koiham hibanga navil jing?
Phat chom khat din Vantilte sangin noi nungjon nakoiyin, Leng bangin loupina le janna najemin,
Thil ijakai akengto noiya nakoisoh tai, " ati. Hichea ijakai aboncha anoiya akoina a hin imacha ama noiya lut lou aumpoi. Ahivangin tun thil ijakai hi anoiya lutsoh hel imudoh hih laiyui.
Imuu chu phat chom khat dia Vantilte sanga noi nungjoa akoi Jesu chu ahin, Pathen lungset jal’a mi jouse dinga thina atepkhah tei ding jeh-in thina geiyin athohin, hijeh chun loupina le jabolna lallukhuh-in akijemtai.
ijeh-inem itile ama vanga thil ijakai umsah-a, ama jal’a ijakai hinsah pan chapa tamtah loupinaa apui lut ding jeh a amaho huhhingna phutdohpa chun gim genthei athoh a asuh cham ding chu kitoh ahi.

ajeh chu chapangte hi thisan le tahsaphe kikop ahiuvin, aman jong amaho tobangin alim’u ahung louvin hitia chu thina jal’a thina chunga thunei vaipo, hiche Diabol chu suhmang ding agot ahi;
chule thina kichat jeh a hinkhoa soh a kihen chengse chu lhadoh ding agot ahi.
ama chun vantilte ding akhohsahjo pon, Abraham chilhahte ahujotai.

Chuti ahijeh chun Lhagao Thengin aseiyin: "Tunia a-ogin najah-u le
Doumah bol nikhoa bang chun Nalung tahsah hih-un, Gamthip laiya kipatep nikhoa bangin:
Napu napa teuvin eipatep’un eideh-uve, Kanatoh kathilbol amu’uvin
Kum som li sungin. Hijeh a chu hiche khang mite chunga lung hanga, ‘Amaho hi lungthim chavai mong ahiuvin, Hijeh chun kalampi jouse ahepouve,’ kati ahi.
Hia chun kalunghan jeh a kihahsel’a: ‘Amaho kacholdoh mun’a lut louhel diu ahi,’ kati aihye.
Sopite, Pathen hing jinga kona pul lhahna dia nalah-uva mi koi hile tahsan louva lungthim gilou pu aum louna din ching theiyun.
Nalah-uva chonset lhep lhah a lungtah cheh cheh aum louna din, "Tuni’ kiti aum laisen nangho khat le khat kitilkhouto jingun.
Ijeh-inem itile abul’a pat’a i-hung kison nau chu akhon nigeiya ituh chah jing pouvu le eiho hi Christa to chan kikop ihitauve.
Hichea hin akiseiyin: "Tunia a-ogin najah-u le Doumah bol nikhoa bang chun nalung tahsah hih-un, " akiti.
Ja taa doumah bol’a chu koi koi ham? Egypt’a kona Mose vanga hung potdoh chengse hilou ham?
Kum som li sunga koi chunga lung hang ham? Chonsea gamthip laiya along lumden ho chung hilou ham?
Amaho acholdo mun’a lut louhel dinga ahahsel khum ho chu hiche thu ngailou ho chu hilou ham?
Hiti hin atahsan loujeh-uva alut thei louvu imutauve.
Hijeh chun kichau hite, achutiloule acholdo mun’a lut theina ding thutep um jeng jongle nalahuva khattou athon’a um khante.
Ijeh-inem itile eiho jah banga ama hon jong Kipana Thupha ajah-u ahinan, ahivangin athu jah-u chun amaho aphat chomsah poi, ajehchu ajahon tahsan’a asanlouvu ahi.
Atahsan eiho vang hi choldo mun’a chu lut ihiuve, hitia aseibang chun: "Kalunghan jeh-in kakihahsel’in, ‘Amaho kacholdo mun’a lut louhel diu ahi,’ kati, " akiti. Leiset bulpi khom kiphu til’a pat natoh thilsem chu akichaisa ahitah vangin.
Chuma le mun khat’a Ni sagi ni thudol aseiyin: "Chuin Nisagi lhin nin anatoh chengsea konin Pathen akicholdoi, " ati.
Chukit le hichea hin: "Amaho kacholdo mun’a lut louhel diu ahi, " ati.
Kipana Thupha ja masahon thu angai lou jeh-uva alut lou vangun, hichea lut ding chu mi aum jing nalaiyin,
chuin "Tuni" kiti nikho dang khat atep kit’in, athu hi khonungin David kama aseiyin, akisei masa bang chun. "Tunia a-ogin najah-u le Nalung tahsah hih-un, " ati.
Ijeh-inem itile Joshuan amaho chu acholdosah hita le, aman kho nunga nikho dang khat um kit ding thu hi aseilou ding ahitai.
Hijeh chun Pathen mite din Choldona khat aum nalaiye.
Ipijeh-inem itile Pathen jeng jong anatoh na akona acholdo banga Pathen choldo mun’a lut pa chu anatoh akona kicholdo ahitai.
Thu ngailouna jeh a lut louho umchan jop’a alut lou ium louna diuvin, chua lut’a choldo cheh din kihabol’u hite.
ijeh-inem itile Pathen thu hi hing jing le na tong hat jing, hemto chemjam sanga jong hemjo, hinna Lhagao gu kisuhtona le lhin, hicheng geiya sukhen theihel’a sun thei, lunggel le lungthim ngaito hetoh paijen jeng thei ahi.
Pathen maiya kilang lou thilsem aumpon, ichung thu i-lhutna ding pau mitmua chu thil ijakai hi asagoh keova kijam cheh ahibouve.
Van mun jouse jotpaiya Thempulen, Pathen Chapa Jesu ineijeh-un iphondoh-u tahsan chu tuhdet jing u hite.
Ijeh-inem itile ihatmo lhahsam nauva eihu theilou Thempu chungnung nei ihipouvin, eiho banga imalam jousea lhep patepna tohsa, ahivanga chonsetna bei thempu chungnung ineiyui.
Hijeh chun panpi i-ngai kom’u le alungset vanga hepina le panpina ikilah theina diuvin hangtah-in lungset laltouna chu nailut’u hite.
Thempu chungnung jouse hi chonset jal’a thilto ho le kilheina gan tha ho Pathen koma tohdoh dinga, mihem ho thalhenga mihem te lha a kiladoh a kipansah ji ahi.
Amatah jeng jong lhahsam nan aumkimvel soh jeh chun imaheloute le lamvaite lung de-hattah a abol thei ahinai,
ajeh chu mipi dinga kilhaina abol lou akhoh banga amatah jeng dinga jong achonset nau jeh a abol lou khoh ahi.
Chule Aaron bang chun Pathenin akouna jeh tilouvin koiman hiche jabolna kintheng hi acham chamin akilah theipoi.
Hitobang chun Christa jengin jong Thempu chungnung hi-na ding hi achamtah a kichoi-at nan aneipon amavang ajah a seipeh pan: "Nangma kachapa nahin, Tunia kahin nahi, " ati.
Hitobangma hin mun khat’a jong aseiyin: "Melchizedek themput dungjuiya Nangma tonsot’a dia thempu nahi, " ati.
Tahsaphe pua aum lai nikhon thinaa kona ahuhhing theipa henga Jesu chu o-thong leu le mit-lhi pumin thumna le taona neiya, Pathena akipeh thengjeh-in ataona aki-ngaipehin ahi.
