Ama achamkimsoh phat’in ama thua nungte jouse din tonsot sochatna bulpin apangin,
Pathenin Melchizedek themput dungjuiyin Thempu chungnung asahtai.
Hiche thudol’a hin sei ding tampi kaneiyun, ahinla nakolseh tah jeh-un ahilchet ahahsai.
Hitih chanpi hi mihil thei nahi diu ahitan, chutitah sangin khattouvin Pathen thubul kipatna lhongpi ho hil leu chun na-ngaikit nalaiyui, anham hilou bongnoitwi ngai nalaiyin naum’uve.
Ijeh-inem itile bongnoitwiya kivah nalai chu chapang ahijeh-in adih thudol’a hetna ima aneipoi.
Anham vang chu mi kikhan lhitsa ho ding ahin, amaho chu ahet thei nau mangchaa ase apha datkhenje themsa ho chu ahiuve.
Chuti ahijeh chun Christa thu bul kipatna lam chu dalhau hitin, philhinna ding lamjoh del’u hite; natoh thisa hoa kona lunghei ding bul phut kit louvin, Pathen tahsan thupou,
batize thua kihilna pou, thenso-khut ngap ham, thinaa kona thokit thu ham, chule tonsot’a dia thutan thupou velsei daute.
Hiche jong chu Pathenin pha asah le ibol diu ahinai.
Ijeh-inem itile khatvei khovah changsa ho, van’a kon thilpeh chu atep khah-uva, Lhagao Theng changkhasa,
chule Pathen thu phat dan tep khaa, khang hung lhung dinga thaneina hesa ahiuvin,
amaho hi alhuh tah-u le, amaho tumtah a Pathen Chapa chu Thingpel’a khen beh kit’a lhang phong tah a taitoma aumsah-u ahitan, lungheina dinga semphat kit thei hoi ahitapouve.
Ajeh chu Pathen kona phattheiboh achan jeh a leiset’in achunga ju-lha jing jeng gotwi adon’a, aphatchomna diuva lou kibolpeh ho dinga anche louhing ahinsep dohji ahin,
amavang ling phung ho le simbiling ho asepdoh le pannabei ahitan, gaosap anaiyin, achaina govam ding ahi.
Deitahte, hitia kasei vangun thilpha cheh le huhhingna nanei jeh-un nachung thu’va kagin chat nau aum nai.
Ajeh chu mithengte kin nabolsau chu nabol jingu ahin, Ama min ngailutna naphondoh-u ahitah jeh-in, hiche natoh nau asuhmil ding chu Pathen adih lou ahipoi.
Akhonna geiya kinepna chu lhingkeiya akihetdoh kahsea natompan ngai banguva nang ho khat cheh hi napan diu kadei lheh jengui.
Chutile nathaset lou diu, tahsan le thoh hat jal’a thutep gou lo chang ho umchan jom nahidiu ahiye.
Pathenin Abraham thu atep chun ama sanga len jodang aum loujeh-in ama changseh akihahsel’in
Keiman phatthei kaboh tei tei ding, punjong kapunsah ding nahi, " ati.
Abrahamin thoh hattahin thutepga akimutai.
Chujongle mihemten amaho sanga chungnung jo chu kihahselna aneijiu ahin, chule thu kichetna dinga kihahsel na chun akah-uva kibaona jouse asuh chaiji ahi.
Thutep goulo ding ho henga chu alung ngaito chu khelkit louhel ding ahidol kichentah a avetsah nom jeh a Pathenin kihahselna chu palai banga anei ahi.
Hitia chu hiche thilbol nia kona hi Pathen kikheltih neilou le itih a jou thei lou ahi hea, hite ni jeh a ama koma kisel eiho hin imasanguva kikoi kinepna chu tuh chah dinga nasa tah a kitilkhou ihiuve.
Hiche kinepna chu hinkho dia thihhat aiya ineiyu ahin, kichentah le dettah pondal sung lam geiya lut pai ahi.
Hikoma chu Melchizedek themput dungjuiya tonsot’a dia thempu chungnunga pang Jesu chu eiho thalhenga analut masa ahitai.
Hiche Melchizedek Salem leng pa hi Chungnungpen Pathen thempu ahin, Abrahamin lengho agatha ahung kilekit lam chun Melchizedek-in agalamton phatthei aboh-e.
Ama chu Abrahamin athil chomdoh jousea konin som a khat apen, amasaa Mechizedek hi ‘Kalengpa dih’ tina ahin, chujongle ‘Salem lengpa’ jong hin chamna lengpa kiti ahi.
Ama hi nubei pabei, khanggui thusim neilou, hinnikho kipatna le kichaina bei, Pathen Chapa tobang ahin, a-itih a thempua pang jing jeng ahi.
Lung gel’in ngaitouvin, ipului bulpiu Abrahamin athilchom hopsom a hop khat apehpa chu itobanga len hitam!
Abraham chilhah ahicheh vangun Levi chilhah thempu mun chang ho chun Danthu dungjuiya asopiteu hijongle miholah akon hopsom’a khat lahna ding thu aneiyu ahi.
Ahile Levite khangguiya kimatna bon neilou Melchizedek chun Abrahama konin hopsoma hop khat alan, chule thutep kisanpa chu phatthei aboh jenge.
Chule mineojon asanga lenjoa kona phatthei boh khat akilah uvin, khatjoh a vang hin akilahpa chu hing jing ahidol hettohsahna aum’e.

Chujongle Abraham jeh chun, hopsom’a hop khat kilahpa Levi jeng jong chun hopsom’a hopkhat apei tia sethei ai.
Ajehchu Melchizedek chun Abraham agalamto pet’a hi Levi chu apu Abraham taiguiya um nalai ahi.
Mipi dia Danthu kipeh lo na Levite themput dol’a chu chamkimsohna umthei hile Aaron themput dol’a kisei louva Melchizedek thempu chom dang khat umdoh khoh ngai ding ham?
Hiche achung chang thudol akikhel le Danthu jong kikhel teiji ahi.
Hiche achung chang thudol kiseipa hi phung chom’a kon ahin, hiche phunga kon hin koimacha maicham phunga lhachan apang kha hih laiye.
Akichen veng tai, ajeh chu i-Pakaiyu chu Judah phunga hung kon ahin, hiche phunga themput dol hi Mosen ima aseipoi.
Melchizedek tobanga chu thempu chom dangkhat akitundoh phat hin athu hi gamchengin akichen kit tai.
Ama themputna hi tahsaphe Danthu thupeh dungjui ahipon, mantih neilou hinkho khat tha neinaa konjoh ahibouve.
Ijeh-inem itile hettohsah nan: Melchizedek themput dol’a Nangma tonsot dia thempu nahi,” akiti.
Chujongle thupeh masa chu alhah sam jeh le aphatchom loujeh-in akinoi mangtai.
Ijeh-inem itile Danthun imacha achamkimsah lou phat’in, kinepna pha cheh khat ahung kipolut tan, hiche kinepna jeh hin Pathen kom anailut’uve.
Hiche hi kihahselna beiya ahipoi, adang ho vang chu kihahselna beiya thempua pang anahiuvin,
Ama vang hi ajah a kihahsel na to lhon’a kiseipeh-a “Pakai akihahseltai, Lung akhel kit lou ding ahi; ‘Nangma tonsot’a dia thempu nahi,’ tin,” ati.
Hiche dungjui hin Jesu chu Kitepna phajo phutdet’in apangtai.
Chule masanga chu thi nan asuhmoa aumden jing thei loujeh-uva mi tampi thempua anapang ahiuve.
Hichepa vang hi tonsot’a um jing jeng ahijeh-in themputna chu adang khat’a kichon thei ahipoi.
Ama hi hing jing ahijeh-in ama jal’a Pathen henga hung lut jouse chu amaho thalhenga taopeh a, abonchauva ahuhhing chamkimsoh thei ahi.
Chuti ahijeh chun chutobang thempu chungnun, athen a theng lepthol bei, boh beh lou le chonsete lah a kona kikhenhel, van mun ho jouse sanga chungnung joa kitung doh chu eiho dinga kilom mong ahi.
Thempu dang ho banga aman niseh le amasaa ama chonset then sona ding chule miho chonset then sona dinga kilhaina gantha atolou akhoh poi, ajeh chu amatah kilhai na gantha dia akitodoh jeh chun khat veiyin asubulhittai.
Danthun lhahsamna nei mihemte thempun anapansah jin, amavang Danthu nunga hung umdoh kihahselna tun vang tonsot’a dia chamkimsoh Chapa chu apansah tai.
Akisei thulu chang pen chu: eihon hitobang thempu chung nung hi ineiyun, ama chu Van’a Chungnung pen Lalatouna jet lam’a atouve,
chukoma mihem tundoh hilouva Pakai tundoh ponbuh tahbeh, muntheng chungnung sunga achamtah a kin theng bol’a pang ahi.
Thempu chungnung jouse thilto hinchoi ding le kilhaina gantha toh dinga kitung ahin, hiche Thempu chungnung jong hin todoh thil khat aneitei ding ahi.
Ama hi leiset chunga um hile Thempu jong hilou ding ahi, ajeh chu Danthu dungjuiya Thempuho lah athilto hinchoi ding aumnauve.
Mose’n ponbuh ason ding kon’a akihilchahnaa, "Ajeh chu ven, molsang chunga nakivetsah lim dungjui banga ijakai nabol ding ahi, " ati banga chu leiset’a thempu ho hin van chunga thil um lim le ale thoa kintheng bol ‘u ahibouve.
Tun vang Jesu chu kintheng bolna pha chungnung achangtai; ajeh chu hiche hi ama palainaa kisemdoh kitepna pha cheh le thutep pha jo chunga kiphutdoh ahi.
Kitepna masa chu nolnabei hile ni lhinna pamun ding kihol khoh ponte.
Ahinla Pathenin miho chunga nolna amujeh-in aseiyin: "Ven, keiman Israel insung chung, Judah insung chunga Kitepna thah khat kasemdohna ding Nikho ho ahung lhunge’ tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
Hiche kitepna chu Apu apateu kakhuttah a katuh a Egypt gam’a kona kahin puidoh nikhoa Amaho to kasemdoh tobang chu hilou ding ahi. Ajeh chu amaho kakitepnaa aum jing pouvin, Kenjong amaho kadonlou ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
Nikho hijat nunga keiman Israel insung kakiteppiding Kitepna chu hiche hi ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseiye: Alunggil’uva Kadanthu ho peng ting, Hiche ho chu alungthim’uva kasut’a, Amaho dia a-Pathenu kahi ding, amaho kamite hidiu ahi.
Koi hile tolsung khat’a achenpi le Koi ahiya asopi jah a, ‘Pakai hen, tia Ahil lou diu ahitai. Ajeh chu aneopen’a alenpan geiya Abonchauva eihetsoh diu ahitai.
Ijeh-inem itile asuh khel nauva jong kahepia, achonset nau jong kageldoh kit lou ding ahitai.
Hichea ‘Athah’ kiti hin amasa chu aluisah tan, ipi hile luiya, tehse chu abei ding kon ahitai.
Kitepna masa jong chun kintheng bolna Danthu le leiset’a muntheng ananeiye.
Ijeh-inem itile houbuh akisondoh teng indan masapen’a chu thaomei khom le do khang chule Pathen um hetna changlhah to aumin, hilai chu "Muntheng" akiti.
Hiche ban’a Houbuh pondal dan ni na chu "Muntheng chung nung" akitin,
asunga chu gimnamtui halna sana maicham le kitepna thingkong-sana kitomkhum chu um ahin, kitepna thingkong sunga chu manna umna sana bel le Aaron tenggol pahmum chule kitepna songpheng ni chu um ahi.
Achunga chu Cherubim loupitah ni uma, alhaving hoa chonset ngaidam kinbolna mun chu ale lhon ahin, hiti ho hi achen achaiya tua seijou ahipoi.
Hitobang hin akisemin, hiche houbuh dan masa sunga chun lhacha kinbol molsoh dingin thempuho alut jing jiuve.
Asung nung dan nina avang chun kumkhat sungin thempu chungnung changseh khat vei bou, thisan choilou hilouva, amatah le mipin hettoh louva achonset na ho’u thenso dinga galutji ahi.
Lhagao Thengin kichentah a asei chu ahile, Houbuh dan masa adin laisea muntheng’a lutna lampi chu kilangdoh lou ding ahi.
Hiche hi tulai phat sunga thilsoh ding tekahna ahin, thil to kilhaina gantha kichoijia kitoh ho hin kilhaina neiho het khenna lunghtim umdol bangin asuchamsoh theipoi.
Neh le don chule twiya kisil theng thudol jatchom chom thubou ahin, kisemthah phat hung lhun kah a tahsaphe danthu jeng ahibouve.
Ahinla Chrita chun khut’a kisem jong hilou, hiche thilsem lah a pang lou, Houbuh lenjo le chamkimjo ding jal’in thilpha hung lhung ho thempu chungnungin ahung pangin,
kelchal ho le bongnou ho thisan vanga hilouvin, amatah thisan jal’in munthenga chun khat veiseh alut’in tonsot lhatdamna aphutdohtai.
Ijeh-inem itile kelchal ho le bongchal hi thisan, chule kella ho pumgo vutvam kithekhum chun tahsaphe bohna neiho chu asuh theng le,
tonsot Lhagao jal’a ama chamtah a nolnabeiya Pathen henga kilhaina gantha dinga kikat doh jeng Christa thisan chun Pathen hing jing lhacha kinbol dinga, athisa natoh chengsea kona, eihet khen nau lungthim ho hi gamchenga asuh thengjoh ding ahi.
Hichejeh a chu Christa chu Kitepna Thah palaiya pang ahin, Kitepna masa chung changa suh khelna neiho lhatdoh dinga athina jeh a akikouho tonsot goulo ding thutep chu akisan thei diu ahitai.
Ajeh chu Kitepna aum teng kitepna sempa thina phot chetna boltei ngai ahi.
Ijeh-inem itile Kitepna chun kitepna sempa hinlaisen ima thu aneipon, athi nungle bou kiphutdetji ahi.
Hijeh a chu kitepna masa jong thisan beiya kiphutdet lou ahi.
Hichejeh chun Mose’n jong Danthu dungjuiya thupeh chengse mipi aseipeh soh phat’in, kella ho thisan le twito, ponsandup le hyssop alan lekhabu le mipi abonchauvin athe khumin,
"Hiche hi Pathenin nang ho nathupehsau Kitepna jal’a thisan chu ahi, " ati.
Hitobanga chun houbuh le kintheng bolnaa kimang manchah jouse chu thisan athekhumtai.
Danthu dungjuiya ijakai chu thisan’a suhthengsoh hel ahimaiyin, hijeh chun thisan solouvin ngaidamna aumdoh poi.
Hitobanga hi van mun hoa thil ho lim vetsahnaa um thil ho jong suh theng tei ding ahin, ahin van thil tah tah ho dia kilhaina gantha phajo cheh ngai ahi.
Atah beh lim tobang khut’a kisa mun theng phunga Christa lut ahipon, amatah van’a lut’a tua hi eiho tha lhenga Pathen angsunga kilah jing dia um ahi.
Thempu chungnungin ama thisan hilou choiya kumseh a muntheng phung alut banga Christa amatah kikatdoh dinga lut matchet ji ahipoi.
Chuti hile vannoi bulkiphua pat aman hesoh genthei athoh matchet ding ahin, tun vannoi khag kichai kon hin chonset suhmangna din amatah kilhaina gantha din khatvei bou ahung kilahtai.
Mihemte dia khatvei thia chujou teng thutanna lut ding hi gotsa ahi,
hitobanga chu Christa jong mi tamtah chonset suhmangna dinga khatvei kitohdoh ahitan, chonset thua hilouva kinemtah a ama galdot jing ho huhhingna pe dia aniveina hung ding ahi.
Danthu chu thilpha hung um ding ho ale mai mai, alim tahbeh jeng jong ahiloujeh-in, kumseh a kilhaina gantha chu avel vel’a alha vangun kilhaina bol ho dingin imacha asubulhit joupoi;
asuh bulhit hihen, khatvei seh kisuh thenga chu kilhaina bol ho het khenna lungthim sunga chonsetna ho chu chin jingna um lou hel hile ibol’a tang louva ahinchoi jing diu ham?
Chuti tah sangin hiche ho chun kumseh-in chonsetna ageldohsah jotai;
ajeh chu bongchal ho le kelchal ho thisana konin chonset ngaidamna aumpoi.
Hijeh chun leiset’a ahung chun Christan aseiyin’ "Kilhaina gantha le thilto nadeipon, Keidin tahsapum joh neigonpeh tai; Ganpumgo thilto ho le chonset thensona thilto hoa jong Nalung lhaideh poi.

Hichun keiman kaseiyin: "Vo Pathen ven, Lekhabu sunga kachung thu jempia kisun bangin Nangma lungdei bol dingin kahunge’ kati, " tin aseiye.
Masanga chu Danthu dung juiya kitohji hijongle, aman aseiyin "Nangma kilhaina gantha ho le thilto ho, ganpumgo thilto ho le chonset thensona thilto ho chunga nakipah pon, lung jong nalung lhaipoi, " atin;
chujouvin aseipaiyin, "Ven, nalungdei lam bol din, hikoma ka-ume, " ati. Hiti hin ani channa chu tundohna din amasa chu asumangtai.
Hiche Pathen lungdeiya chu Jesu Christa tahsapum, a-itih a dinga khat vei akitodoh jeng jeh chun eiho eisutheng tauve.
Thempu jouse chu niseh a ding jinga kilhaina gantha thilto chu ato jing vangun hiche ho chun chonsetna ala mang thei dehpoi.
Jesu Christan vang chonset thensona din, a-itih a dinga khatvei, kilhaina thilto chu atoh-in, Pathen jel lam’a atoutai.
Chukelsen vang amelmate chu akeng chotpha akoipeh ding angah jinge.
Ijeh-inem itile Aman thilto khatseh a asuh theng ho chu tonsot’a dingin achamkimsah soh tai.
Lhagao Thengin jong eihettohsah nauve; ijeh-inem itile hiche jou hin aseiyin.
"Ni nu nung teng le keiman amaho to Kakitepna ding chu hiche ahi, ati Pakaiyin; ‘Alungthim’uva Kadanthu ho kakhumpeh ding, Hiche ho chu alung gil’uva kasut ding ahin,
chule achonset jouseu le Danthu asuh keh nau jouse Kageldoh kit louhel ding ahitai, " ati.
Chonsetna ho jal’a ngaidam umnaa chun chonset jeh a thilto ding angaitapoi.
Sopite, Jesu thisan jal’in eihon muntheng phung jot’a, sung lhah ngamna ineiyui;
ajeh chu aman pondal banga amanchah atahsaphe eiho din lampi thah le ahing jing chu eihondoh peh tauve.
Ama Pathen insunga Thempu lenin ahung pangin;
hijeh chun lung dih tah le tahsan bulhingset’in chule het khenna lungthima thilse jouse kisop thengsel le tahsa kisil thengin nailut’u hite.
Thutep chu tahsan umtah ahijeh-in iphondoh sau kinepna hi dettah-in tuh det jingute.
Chule ngailutna le thilpha bolna lam’a khat le khat kisuh lip jing ding phate chan gel’u hite.
Mi kon khat’in akikhop nau donda achon nau banga bol louvin, Nikho chu ahung nai dol namu ahitan, hatahin kitilkhou to chehjo’u hite.
Ajeh chu thutah hetna kisan nung hin eihon chonset henasan boljom jing leu hen, chonset suh mangna ding kilhaina gantha kikhenlou ahitan,
doumah bol jouse bahgam hel ding le kavam hel ding tom ngaina meikong le thutanna ngah a kicha jinga um ding ahitauve.
Koi hile Mose Danthu nahsah lou chu mi ni hihen thum hile hettohsah jeh a hepina beihel’a kithat ding ahi.
Chuti ahile Pathen Chapa keng chotpha nei, akisuh thengna Kitepna thisan suhboh a chule lungsetna Lhagao daithang ho chun itobang khohjo cheh talen amat diu kilom nasah um?
Ijeh-inem itile: "Phulah chu kei kin ahi, Keiman lethut nange, " Chukit le: "Pakaiyin amite chung thu atan ding, " tipa chu koi ahi keihon kaheuve.
Pathen hing jing khut te nia chuh khah ding chu kichat umtah ahi.
Masanga khovah nachan nung geiyuva jong hesoh genthei hahsa tah thoh a napan laiyu nikho ho geldoh-uvin.
Hichea chun genthei thoh pum puma japi vetchah din naum’un, ahinla nang hon jong hitobang thoh ho chu nathoh piu ahiye.
Ijeh-inem itile songkul lut ho geiya nathoh piuva, chule apha cheh le a-itih a um jing ding gou nanei nahet jeh-uvin naneiyu kichom jeng jong kipah tah-in nathoh jo’uve.
Hiche hin kipaman lentah nasodoh peh jeh-uvin nakison nau chu paimang hih hel’uvin.
Ipijeh -inem itile Pathen lungdei bol’a thutep kisan na din thoh hat jing ding angaiye.
Ajeh chu: "Chomcha khat jou teng Ahung ding pa chu hunga Geisang lou dig ahi;
Tahsan jal’a kei dia midih changa chu hing ding, Anung chon vang achunga kahinkho kapeh lou ding ahi, " ati.
Eiho vang manthahna dinga nung chon ho ihipouvin, tahsan jal’a hinkho hoidoh a um ho ihibouvui.
Tahsan hi kinepna atahbeh a lah a, muthei lou thil ahisa koi ding hi ahi.
Hijeh a chu tahsan jal’a upate chu hettohsah a kipansahji ahiuve.
Tahsan na jeh a Pathen thusah a vannoi kisem le akilangdoh kha lou thil hoa kona muthei thil hung umdoh dol ihet’u ahi.
Tahsan na jeh a Abel’in Cain sanga Pathen henga kilhaina gantha thilto phajo atojeh-in, amidih hi na hettohsahna amun, Pathen jengin jong athilto ho chu ahettohsah tan, chule athi nung geiyin thu asei thei nalaiye.
Tahsan na jeh-in Enoch chu thina mulouvin atahsa akheldoh peh-in, Pathenin atasan akheldoh peh jeh-in koiman aholdoh joutapoi; tahsa kheldoh a aum masanga Pathen koma lung lhaina kimu ahi hettohsahna aum’e.
Hijeh chun tahsan beiya Pathen lung tohoi ahipoi; ijeh-inem itile Pathen aum je le ama holte chengse tohphat man apeh dol hi ama kom nailutten atahsan tei diu dol ahi.
Tahsan na jeh-in Noah chun kho nung thilsoh ding muphah lou thua hilchahna thu angaiyin, ama le a-insung huhhingna din kong innei khat asem’e, hichea hin vannoi themmo achanin, tahsan’a them channa jal’in goulo chu achangtei.
Tahsan na jeh-in Abraham chu potdoh a goulo dia akisan ding mun’a lut din akikou chun thun anungin, hoilam jot ding ahet lou vangin apotdoh jenge.
Tahsan na jeh-in tepna gamsunga hung kholjin bangin apem len, tepna gam alopi ding Isaac le Jacob chutoh ponbuh sunga acheng leuve.
Ajeh chu Abrahamin Pathen gontoh le asah doh bul dettah chu akat jing’e.
Tahsan na jeh-in athuteppeh pa chu tahsan umtah ahidol ahetjehin acha nei phat akilet tah vangin Sarah-in naovopna thei tha aneitai.
Hiti chun mithikonsa paa kon chun van’a ahsite jat le Twikhanglen kama neldi jat hel simsen lou chilhah apeng doh tai.
Amaho chengse hi tahsan ahitauvin, thutep chengse chu akisan man louvu ahitai; ahinla gamla tah a konin amu’uvin alem’un, chule amaho chu leiset chunga kholjin le khopem ahiu aphongdoh tauve.
Hichea hitobang thusei ho hin pugam pagam ahol dol’u aphondoh u ahibouve.
Amaho ahung kondoh nau gam chu geldoh kit hileu kilekitna ding phat gomkom jong anei diu ahi.
Tua la amahon aphajo cheh khat, van gam chu atup’u ahijeh-in, Pathen jeng jong amaho Pathen a kikou ding jahcha lou ahi; ijeh-inem itile aman amaho dinga khopi khat agonpeh ahitai.
Tahsan na jeh-in Abrahamin patep’a aum chun thutep changpa tahsan vangin achapa chang khatseh, Isaac chu kilhaina gantha banga todoh jeng din agoi.
Ama chule Isaac a kon ahi nachilhah kisim ding ahi, " tia kiseipeh ahin,
Pathenin athisa jong akaithou kit thei chu agel jon, tekah a seidin Isaac chu anung chankit nai.
Tahsan na jeh-in Isaac chun kho nung teng phatthei chang din Jacob le Esau phatthei aboh-e.
Tahsan na jeh-in Jacob-in athi ding konin Joseph chapate ni phatthei aboh gol’in, atenggol chunga aki-ngamin Pathen alhaiye.
Tahsan na jeh-in Joseph chun athi ding konin Egypt gama kona Israel chate potdoh ding ageldoh-in, ama gu le chang thudol’a thu apei.
Tahsan na jeh-in anu le apan Mose apen nungin lha thum asel lhonin, ama chu naosen mel-hoi tah ahidol amu lhonin, lengpa thu peh jong kicha louvin aum lhon’e.
Tahsan na jeh a Mose’n akhan lhit phat’a Pharoah chanu chapa kiti ding da ahi.
Chonset’a chomkhat nopsah sangin Pathen mite to gim hesoh thoh khom ding akilhenjoi.
Tohman san ding avetjoh jeh chun Egypt gama gou jou se sangin Messiah kihousetna chu thupijon agel’e.
Tahsan na jeh-in lengpa lung han ding ging louvin Egypt gamadalhan, mit muthei loupa chu amu bangin abol’e.
Tahsan na jeh-in kalchuh kut aphutdoh-in, cha peng masa sumang Vantil chun amahoa asuh khah louna din thisan chu athekhumsah-in ahi.
Tahsan na jeh-in Israel chaten Twikhanglen chu tolgo jot’in ajot galkaiyun, Egypt miten chutia bol agot’u le twiyin achup lih gamtauve.
Tahsan na jeh a Israelten Jericho khopi ni sagi avel’u le, khopi pal achimtai.
Tahsan na jeh a Rahab notinun gam ve-lhi ho lung monga alhunsah jeh chun thu ngailou ho to akisuh mang tha tapoi.
Ipi kaseibe ding ham? Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jepthah, David, Samuel chule themgao ho chengse thudol seisoh kei ding phat’in toh ponte.
Tahsan na jel’in lenggam tampi ajouvun, adih aphutdet’un, thutep akisan’un, Phaisameigeo kam asingun,
meikou laipi aphel mit’uvin, chemjem hem’a konin ahoidoh un, lhahsam na konin ahatdoh-uvin, galmun’a hatah ahiuvin, gamdang sepaite adeljam tauve.
Numei hon amithi sa ho’u thoudoh kit akisan’uvin adang ho jong thokitna phajo cheh aneina diuvin huhdoh a aum diu anom pouvin, hesoh genthei thoh-in aumjotaove.
Abang bang jong elbol le jepna thoh, bulput le songkul lut’in aum’uve.
Amaho chu songin asep’un, thing-at’in a-attan’un, chemjamin athat’uvin, kelngoivun le kelcha vun kisil’in avah leuvin, vaichat le bolset thoh, genthei hesoh bolset’in aum’uve;
vannoi leiset hi amaho umna hoi ahitapon, gamthip lai le mol le lhanga avah leuvin, songko dung le leiko dunga akisel’ui.
Mi hijat chu tahsan na jeha hettohsah a apan vangun thutep ga chu alopha pouve;
eiho beiya achamkimsoh thei louna diuva Pathenin ibonchauva dinga thilphajo cheh khat amu masah ahi.
Hettohsahna hijat pin meilhang banga eiumkimvel jehuvin einoh phahsah jouseu le ichunguva kaijing chonsetna hi pailhan, thoh hat tah-in imasanguva kilhai tetna lama hin lhaiyu hite.
Tahsan bulpi le kikhomna Jesu lam kat jingute; aman amasanga koisa um kipana jeh chun jum le jachatna nahsah louvin thingpel’a thina geiyin athoh-in Pathen laltouna jet lam’a atoutai.
Nahinkhouva nalhah dah-uva nalel louna diuvin, chonseten amadouna a thuse chujatpi aseiyu dou lhumkeipa chu geldoh jingun.
Chonset louna lam’a nang ho thisan long leuvin napang hih laiyuve.
Tilkhouna dinga nang ho chapate dol’a nakisei nau chu nasuhmil’u ahitai: "Kachapa, Pakaiyin nabolgimna chu isah louvin geldan, Aman naphosal teng jongle lung lhadeh hih-in;
Ijeh-inem itile Pakaiyin angailut chu abolgim’a, Chapa dia akisansa chu ajepji ahibouve, " kiti chu.
Bolgimna chu thoh tun tun’un, Pathenin chapate banga nasungse nau ahibouve; Pan chapa koipen gahchah louva akoiyem?
Chate louvin um leu chun chapa tahbeh hilouva bolamcha nahi diu ahi.
Hiche kalval’in jong tahsaphea eigah chah diuvin pate ineiyun amaho chu ijabol lheh-ui; achutile Lhagao ho thudol’a Pa koma chu ihinna diuva i-halut cheh joh lou diu ham?
Amaho chun aphasah lam lam’uva ni chom khat kahseh a dinga bou eigah chah jiu ahin, Pathenin vang eiho phatna ding, ama thenna ichan theina diuva eithoh gimsah jiu ahibouve.
Gahchah na hi apet tah le lung nopna ahipoi, lhaset nan akigel bouve; ahinla kho nung teng le hita bolgimna thoh ho ding hin them channa din cham nan ahung gadoh jin ahi.
Hijeh chun khut ngoi hon domsangun lang, khup ngoi ho jong ding janguvin;
Kengbaiya chu chatmoa um louva, adamjohna dingin nalampiu kisem jenguvin.
Mi jouse to kichamna ding le thenna ding hadel’un, hiche tilouva chu koiman Pakai amu louhel ding ahi.
Koima Pathen lungsetna changlel aum louna ding le thingkha jung dondoh a tamtah asuhmo banga nasuhboh louna dingin ching theiyun.
An neh khat man dinga a-upat kijoh Esau banga alop’a le chonthanghoi bol naum louna diu vin ching theiyuvin.
Ijeh-inem itile kho nunga goulo tei ding adei chat vanga lunghei kitna ding mun anei tah lou jeh-in mit lhi puma ahol vangin vangbohna akipeh lou naheuve.
Ijeh-inem itile nang ho toh khah thei molvum, meisi pah lah lah lai, muthim lai, thimpi lah, chule khopihui lah a hungvah lut nahipouvin,
sumkon gin le thu kisei gin ki thong lah jong ahipoi; hiche japha ho chun ajah-uva thu chu akisei kit louna din ataojo tauve.
Ajeh chu, "Molvum dung chu gancha ho jeng jong atongkha chan songa selih ding ahi, " tia thu kisei chu athoh jouhel’u ahi.
Chule hiche thil hung kilah chu kichat um behseh jeng ahin, Mose’n jong aseiyin, "Keima kakichan kakihot hot jenge, " ati.
Nang ho vang Zion molvum, Pathen hing jing khopi, Van Jerusalem, Vantil asang sang lah hung lhunga, kipah thanom
le van’a kisun lutsah apeng masa chengse kikhopna, mi jouse thutan Pathen kom, them changsa ho Lhagao suh chamkimna mun,
Jesu palainaa kisemdoh Kitepna Thah a chu hung nahitauvin, hiche thisan kitheikhum na chun Abel thisan sangin thilpha jo cheh sei ding aneiye.
Ching theiyun thuseipa chu jopda khauvin nate; ajeh chu leiset’a thuseipa thujop louho bon ahoidoh jou lou le, van’a kona thuseipaa konin kiheimang leu hen ihoidoh louhel diu akichen jenge.
Hichea ogin chun leiset seh bou aholingsoh ahin, tun aman athu tep’in aseiye, "Keiman leiset keoseh hilouva Van geiya khatvei seh akaho ling ding ahi, " ati.
Hikoma, "Khatvei seh, " kiti hin thilsem jouse kiholingsah a kitolmang ding kichentah-in aseiyin, hitia chu suh ling theilou chengse umden ding ahi.
Hichejeh chun suh longhoi hilou Lenggam ikisan jeh-un thangvahna neiyu hitin, ginna le jabolna pumin alungdei lamtah-in Pathen lhachan pangu hite.
Ijeh-inem itile i-Pathennu chu mi kavamhel thei meikou tobang ahi.
Kisopi ngailutna um jing hen.
Maljin lhunsah ding hailou jen’un, hitobang hoa hin abangin jong Vantilte geiyin alhunsah tauve.
Sohchang kihen ho chu toh kihentha bangin kigel’in lang, tahsaphea um jing nahi heuvin lang genthei hesoh thoh te chu geldoh jinguvin.
Kichen hi mi jousen jabol cheh hen, jalkhun jong kisuhboh da hen; jonthanhoi bol le mijito jonga chu Pathenin athu atan ding ahi.
Sum ngailut hinkhon kimang hih-un, nanei chengsen lung lhai jo’uvin; ajeh chu aman, "Keiman kadonda louhel ding, dajong kada lhah louhel ding nahi, " ati.
Hijeh a chu eihon kisongtah a isei theiyu chu: "Eipanpia chu Pakai ahin kicha ponge, Mihemin i-eilo ding ham?" ti hi ahi.
Nalamkaiteu nakom’uva Pathen Thu naseipeh teu chu geldoh-un lang, anun akhan’u phatah-in geldoh-uvin, atahsan’u chu tho’uvin.
Jesu Christa chu janhi tuni chule tonsot’in abang ahijinge.
Thuhil gotchom chom kilhoh mangsah loujen’un, lung hi lungsetna aphudet aphan, neh le chah a phu ding ahipoi, hiti neh le chah thua chonte chun phat chom nan aneideh pouve.
Houbuh a lhacha kintheng bol hon aneh thei lou nau maicham aneiyui.
Thempu chungnung hon chonset thensona ding gancha ho thisan chu muntheng chungnunga ahin choilut jiuvin, atahsapum ho vang chu polama agouvamji tauve.
Hijeh chun ama thisan’a mipi suh thengna dingin Jesun khopi kelkot polam’a thina athoh tai.
Chuti ahijeh-in ngahmun polam, ama henga potdoh-u hitin, ahouset nau chu gathoh hu hite.
Ijeh-inem itile hikoma hin eihon khopi det inei pouve, ahung lhung ding khopi joh chu i-hol’u ahibouve.
Hijeh chun Jesu jal’in vahchoina ho chu Pathen henga kilhaina bangin bol jingu hite, hiche hi ama min phongdoh ho kamsungsoh aga ahi.
Kikhoto them’a chule ima kikop del chu hai hih-un, hitobang hi Pathen lung lhaiselna kilhai na ahi.

Eiho chonse louva ikiseiyule, ama chu ijoubol’uva athu eiho sunga umlou ahi.
Kachate, nachonset louna diu vin hicheng hi nahenguva kahinsun’e. Ahin khattou chonse jeng tajongle, Pahenga eisei champeh diu, dih tah Jesu Christa ineinauve.
Aman chu eiho chonset jouse thoina ahi, eiho chang jenga jong hilouva vannoi pumpi ding jong ahi.
Athupeh chengse init’u le ama ihetsau ahidol kichen ding ahi.
Khattouvin, “Ama kahetai,” atia, athupeh chengse la anit loule mijou ahin, asunga thutah umlou ahibouve.
Athu nit’a vang chu, hiche anitna jeh a chu Pathen ngailutnaa kisuchamkimsoh ahitai. Hichea hi ama sunga um ihiu iheuve.
Ama sunga um jinga kiseiya chu Christa chonchan banga chontei ding ahi.
Deitahte, nahenguva thupeh thah kahinsunpoi, semtil’a pat nanei sau thupeh lui chu ahibouve; na jahsau chu hiche thupeh lui thu hi ahi.
Muthim beisoh deh deh a, khovah tah beh hung vah pan thudol, nang ho le Christa sunga um thutah thudol thupeh thah jong nahenguva kahinsun nai.
Khovah sunga um’a kiseiya, asopi hotbol nalai chu tugeiya muthim sunga um ahibouve.
Asopi ngailua vang chu khovah sunga umah ahitan, ama sunga hin kipal lhuhna aumpoi.
Asopi hotbol nalai vang chu muthim sunga um, muthim sunga vah le ahin, muthimchun amit te ni achotsah jeh-in, hoilam ajot jong ahepoi.
Chate, Ama min jal’a nachonset jouseu ngaidam ahijeh a Nahenguva kahinsut ahi.
Pate, semtil’a pat ama chu nahetsau ahijeh a Nahenguva kahinsut ahi. Khangdong ho, agiloupa nanan jou phat’uva Nanghenguva kahinsut ahi.
Chapangte, Pa chu nahet phat’uva Nahenguva kahinsutsa ahi. Pate, Ama chu semtil’a pat nahetsau ahijeh a Nahenguva kahinsutsa ahitai. Khangdong ho, nathau aphat’a Nasunguva Pathen thu aum jinga, Agiloupa chu nanan jou phatu’va Nahenguva kahinsutsa ahitai.
Vannoi leiset le leiset sunga um thil ho ngailu hih hel’un; koi hile vannoi leiset ngailua chu Pa-ngailutna asunga um lou ahi.
Ijeh-inem itile vannoi leiset’a um chengse tahsaphe lung ngaichat le mit te nin jon lunggul’a amu, chule hinkhoa kimoh vahchoi-hiti ho hi Paa hungkon ahipon, vannoi leiset’a konjoh ahibouve.
Vannoi leiset le athil ngaichat lunggul abeikon ahitan, Pathen lungdei lam nol’a vang chu tonsot’a um jing ding ahi.
Chapangte, nidan nukhah ahitan, Christa doupa hung ding najah banguvin, tun Christa douho tampi asohdoh tauve; hichea kon hin nidan nukhah ahi ihetauve.
Amaho hi ilah-uva kona potdoh ahiuvin, eiho lah a vang apang pouve; eiho lah a pang hileu iumkhom jing diu ahi; ilah-uva apan louvu akiphondoh theina dia potdoh ahitauve.
Nang ho vang Athengpa thaonu changkha nahiuvin, hijeh chun ijakai nahesoh keiyui.
Thutah nahet loujeh-uva nahenguva kahinsut ahipon, hiche nahet’uva, thujou ho hi thutah akon ahilou nahet jeh-uva kahinsut ahibouve.
Jesu chu Christa hisah louva seileppa, jousei ahiloule koi dangba hiding ham?
Chapa seilep jousen Pa aneilou ahin, Chapa phongdoh jousen vang Pa anei ahi.
Nang hon semtil’a pat najahsau chu nasunguva um jing hen; semtil’a pat najahsau nasunguva aum vang le, nang ho jong Chapa le Pa sunga um jing nahiuve.
Amatah-in eitep’u athutep chu tonsot’a hinna hi ahi.
Hicheng hi nang ho lhem lhaji ho thudol’a kahinsut ahitai.
Nang hon vang ama thaonu chu nakisan’uva, nasunguva aum jeh-in, nahil diu midang koima na-ngaicha pouve; amaa kona naneiyu thaonu chu thutah hiya, jousei ahilou jeh-in, ijakai thudol nahilsoh nauve. Hejih chun aman nahil bangun amasunga um jinguvin.
Chule tun chate, ama ahung kilah teng kisonna ineiyuva, ahungkit tengle maimohna ineilouna diuvin, ama sunga um jing jenguvin.
Ama chu adihje nahet’ulle, adih bol jouse hi amaa kona pengdoh ahidol jong nahet diu ahi.
Veuvin, Pathen chate i-kisah thei na diuva Pan eipeh-u ngailutna hi iti natsat hitam! Chule hichu hijong ihitauve. Hijeh a hi Vannoiyin eihet louvu ahi, ajeh chu Pathen jong ahepouve.
Deitahte, tun eiho Pathen chate i-hitauvin, ahivangin ipi ihung hidiu akichen hih laiye. Ama ahung kilah teng le eiho jong ama to ibah diu vang iheuve, ajeh chu ama ahi na banga imu diu ahi.
Ama jal’a hiche kinepna nei chan chu ama atheng banga ama jong kisuhtheng ahi.
Koi hile chonset bol’an Danthu to kikal abol ahi, ijeh-inem itile Danthu to kikal chu chonset ahi.
Ama sunga chu chonset beihel ahijeh a chonset pomang dinga ama hung kilah ahi naheuve.
Koi hile ama sunga um jouse achonsepoi; achonse jousen ama chu mujong amukhah lou, het jong ahet khah louvu ahibouve.
Chate, koima kilhep lhahsah hih-un; koi hile thildih bol’a chu Christa adih banga ama jong midih ahi.
Chonset bol’a vang chu Diabol’a kon ahi, ajeh chu Diabol chu semtil’a pat hung chonse jing ahi. Hichejeh tah a chu Diabol natoh sumang dinga Pathen Chapa hung kilah ahi.
Pathen’a kona pengdoh jousen chonset aboljom jing poi, ajeh chu Pathen muchi chu ama sunga aum jingin ahi. Chujongle Pathen’a kona pengdoh ahi jeh in achonset jing ding chu ahitheipoi.
Hichea hin Pathen chate le Diabol chate umdol akichen’e. Thildih bol lou jouse le asopi ngailu lou jouse chu Pathen’a kon ahipoi.
Eiho khat le khat iki-ngailut diu hi najahsau semtil’a pat thu thot chu ahi.
Agiloupaa kon, asopi that’a pang Cain to ibah lou diu ahi. Ipijeh pen a aman asopi atha ham? Ajeh chu ama natoh chengse agilou jeng ahia, asopipa a jouse adih jeng ahijeh ahi.
Vo sopite, vannoiyin nahot’u le kidang sahih hel’un.
Ijeh-inem itile eihon isopiteu ingailut jeh-uva thinaa kona hinna galkai i-hi tauve. Angailu lou vang chu thinaa um jing nalai ahi.
Koi hile asopi hotbol tol that ahin tolthat lung sunga tonsot hinna aum lou iheuve.
Aman eiho dia ahinkho apeh jeng jeh hin, hichea hin ngailutna ihetauve; hijeh a chu eihon jong sopite dinga hinkho ito doh diu thil khoh tah ahi.
Khattou hinkhoa ning lhingin um hen lang chule asopi ngaichat neiya um amu nasan achung changa lainatpi da le, ama sunga chu Pathen ngailut na iti um thei ding ham?
Chate, eihon thuhom keo le kamsung jengseh hilouvin, natoh le thutah in ngailu hite.
Hichea hi eiho thutah apang ihidan’u ihet’uva, ama angsunga ilungthima ikison diu ahi.
I-lung thim’un ei-oi mo tengu jongle, Pathen chu eiho lungthim sanga lenjoa ima jouse hesoh ahiye.
Deitahte, ilungthim’un ei-oi mo louvu le Pathen henga lung ngamna ineiyun,
hijeh chun thum inei tengu jongle athupeh jouse init’uva, a-angsunga alungdei lam jeng ibol jeh-un, amaa konin akisan jiuve.
Athupeh chu achapa Jesu Christa min’a itahsan’uva, aman eipeh-u thupeh banga khat le khat ikingailut diu hi ahi.
Koi hile athupehho nit’a chu Christa sunga um ahin, Christa jong ama sunga um ahi; hichea hin aman eipeh-u Lhagao jal’in ama isunguva aum i-heuve.
Deitahte, Lhagao tapou tahsan dauvin, lhagao ho chu Pathen’a kon hinam patep masauvin; ajeh chu vannoi leiset chunga Themgao lhem tampi asohdoh tai.
Pathen Lhagao chu hichea hi nahet diu ahi. Jesu Christa tahsaphe pua ahungna phongdoh Lhagao tapou chu Pathen’a kon ahin,
hitia Jesu phong doh lou lhagao jouse chu Pathena kon ahipoi, hiche tah chu Christa doupa, ahung ding najahsau chu ahin, tutah a jong hi vangnoiya um-ah ahitai.
Chate, nang ho Pathen’a kon nahiuvin, hiche ho chu nanang joutauve; ijeh-inem itile nasunguva umpa chu vannoiya umpa sangin achungnungjoi.
Amaho hi vannoi ya kon ahiuvin, hijeh achu vannoi thudol jeng aseiyule, vannoi athua nung ahi.
Eiho vang Pathen’a kon aihiuvin, Pathen hepan ithuu angaiye, Pathen helouvan vang ithuu angaipoi. Hichea hi eihon Lhagao tah le lhagao lhem ihetdoh-u ahi.
Deitahte, eiho khat le khat ki-ngailu hite, ajeh chu ngailut hi Pathen’a kon ahi; hijeh chun ngailut neiya chu Pathen’a kona peng ahin, Pathen ahei.
Ngailut neilouvin Pathen ahepoi, ajeh chu Pathen hi ngailut ahi.
Chapa jal’a eihon hinna inei theina diuva Pathenin Achapa chang khatseh vannoiya ahinsol, hichea hi eiho sunga Pathen ngailutnachu kiphongdoh ahitai.
Hichea hi ngailut um ahi, eihon Pathen ingailut’u ahipon, amajoh-in eingailut’uva, eiho chonset thoina dinga Achapa ahinsol ahibouve.
Deitahte, Pathenin eiho chutia eingailut’u le eiho jong khat le khat iki-ngailut diu dol ahi.
Koiman imatih-in Pathen amukhapoi, eiho khat le khat iki-ngailut’u le Pathen eiho sunga uma chule amingailut chu eiho sunga chamkimsohji ahi.
Pathenin eipeh-u ama Lhagao jal hin eiho ama sunga i-um’uva chule ama eiho sunga aum iheuve.
Pan Chapa vannoi huhhing dinga ahinsol hi keihon kamu’uva kahet tohsah-u ahi.
Koi hile Jesu chu Pathen Chapa ahi phongdoh chan asunga Pathen um ahin, ama Pathen sunga um ahi.
Chule Pathenin eiho sunga ngailutna anei hi eihon iheuvin itahsan’uve. Pathen chu ngailut ahin, ngailut sunga um michu Pathen sunga um ahin, chule ama sunga Pathen um’a ahi.
Thupi tan nikhoa lungngamna inei theina diuva hichea hi eiho chunga ngailutna kisuchamkim ahi; ajeh chu hiche vannoiya hi eiho jong ama tobanga um ihiuve.
Ngailut sunga kichat aumpoi, ngailut chamkim chun kichat anodohji; kichat hin talen mat ding aneijeh ahin hijeh chun kichajing mi chu ngailut sunga achamkim theipoi.
Aman eingailut masah jeh a eihon ingailut’u ahibouve.
Khattouvin,” Pathen ka-ngailui,” ti hen, asopi hotbol le, mijou ahi. Ijeh-inem itile amusa asopibon angailut loule, amulou Pathen chu angailut thei lou ding ahi.
Koi hijongle Pathen ngailu chun asopi angailut tei ding thupeh Christaa kona ineiyu ahi.
Koi hileh Jesu hi Christa ahidol tahsan jouse chu Pathen’a kona peng ahi; chule koi hile ahingpa ngailua chun ahinsa acha jong angailui.
Eihon Pathen ingailutuva, athupeh chengse init’ule hichea hin Pathen chate ingailut’u iheuve.
Ijeh-inem itile athupeh chengse init’u hiche laitah chu Pathen ngailutna ahi, chule athupeh ho chu pohgih hahsa jong ahipoi.
Ajeh chu Pathena kona peng jousen vannoi hi anan jou ahitan, hiche vannoi nang joupen tah chu itahsan’u hi ahiye.
Jesu chu Pathen Chapa ahina tahsan mi chun vannoi ajo ahitai.
Twisih le thisan jal’a hungpa chu Jesu Christa ahi, twisih keoseh hilouvin, twisih le thisan jal ahi. Hiche hettosah chu Lhagao ahi, ajeh chu Lhagao hi thutah ahi.
Ijeh-inem itile hettohsah thum aumin,
Lhagao le twisih chule thisan ahi, hicheng thum hi khat’a longkhom ahi.
Eihon mihem hettohsah bon isan’u le Pathena hettohsahna chu achungnungjoi, ajeh chu aman Achapa thudol ahettohsah ahi.
Pathen Chapa tahsan chun asunga hettohsahna anei ahin, Pathen tahsan lou vang chun Pathen ajousah ahi; ajeh chu Pathenin Achapa thudol ahettohsah, hiche hettohsahna chu aman atahsan tapoi.
Hiche hetohsahna chu Achapa sunga um hinna, hiche tonsot hinna, Pathenin eipeh-u hi ahi.
Koihile Chapa neiyan hinna aneitan, Pathen Chapa neilou chun hinna aneipoi.
Nang ho Pathen min’a tahsan chengsen tonsot hinna naneiyu nahetna diuva hicheng hi kahinsut ahi.
Eihon ipi hijongle ama lungdei lama ithum chan’u aman eingai peh jeh-uva, hiche hi eihon ama koma lung ngamna ineiyu ahi.
Ipi hijongle ithum chan’u eingaipeh ihet jeh-uvin, ipi tobang hileh akithum chan chu amaa kona ineisan ihetauve.
Khattouvin asopi chu thi lo hel theina chonset ahilou vanga chonset bol amu le taopeh hen lang hinso hen; thi lo hel theina hilouva chonse chubou kisei ahi. Thi lotheina hel’a chonset aumin, hitobang dia chu tao dinga kasei ahipoi.
Adih lou jouse chu chonset ahin, ahinla thi lo theina hel lou chonset jong aum’e.
Koi hile Pathena kona penga chu achonse jom jing poi, Pathena kona peng chun ama angah jingin, hijeh chun agiloupan atongkhapoi.
Eiho Pathena kona ihiuva, vannoi pumpi agiloupa noiya aum iheuve.
Pathen Chapa thutah ihet theina diuva thil hetkhen themna lungthim eihungpeh-u chu iheuve; eiho thutah, Achapa Jesu Christa sunga chu um ihiuve. Ama chu Pathen tahbeh le tonsot hinna ahi.
Chate doilim semthu hou lah a kihong phauvin.
Upa keiman lhentum Numei lalnu chule achate changse, thutah a ka-ngailut, kei chang hilouva, thutah heho jousen jong angailut ho heng,
eiho sunga um jing, tonsot geiya eiumpi jing diu thutah jal’in:
Pa, Pathen le Pa Chapa Jesu Christa konin thutah le ngailut jal’a lungsetna le hepina, chamnan eiumpi jing diu ahi.
Nachate konkhatse Paa kona ikisan’u thupeh dungjuiya chon kamun, kakipah lheh jengin ahi.
Chule tua hi hung tao kahi-lalnu, nahenga thupeh thah jong hinsun louva, khat le khat iki-ngailutto chehna diuva, semtil’a pat ineisau chu ahibouve.
Athupeh chengse dungjuiya ichon theiyu le hichu ngailut ahi. Semtil’a pat thu um najahsau bangin chonleu chun, hichu ngailut ahi.
Ajeh chu vannoiya hin doha mi-lhem lha tampi asohdohtai, amaho hin Jesu Christa tahsanphea ahung hi aphongdoh nompouve; doha mi lhemlha, Christa douva chu ama hi ahi.
Natohsa chu na-ngah louva tohga lhingset’a nasan na diuvin, nang ho ching theiyun, kivephauin.
Koi hile Christa thuhil’a um louva, akalval’a chon’a chun Pathen aneipoi. Thuhil’a um jing vang chun Pa le Chapa anei kop ahitai.
Koi hile hiche thuhil keng louva nahenguva hunga chu san dauvin, na-in’uva lhunsah hih-uvin, kam phan jong hou dauvin.
Ijeh-inem itile ama kamphaa houva chun ama toh gitlou jouse jong achankhompi ahitai.
Nahenguva hinsut ding tampi kanei vangin, lekhapheng le lekhatwi maiya sut kanompoi, nakipa nau achamkimsohna dinga nahengu hungphah a kimaitoa kamchenga ikihoulim diu kakinem’e.
Lhentum nasopi nu chaten nasalam’uve.
Upa keiman thutah beh a kangailut, kadeitah Gaius henga:
Ngaitah, nahinkhoa phatthei nachan banga, ima lam jousea naphat theiya, nadam jingna din kataopeh jie.
Sopite phabep ahung uva nangma thutah a nachon hetsahjing banga, nathutah dol eihung hetsah-u iti kakipa hitam!
Kachate thutah a achon kajah a kakipa sanga chungnungjo kipana kaneipoi.
Ngaitah, hetphah lou maljin hung hijongleu, sopite nabolna, natohna chu nakitah lheh jenge:
amahon jong ngailut nanei chu Houbung angsunga ahettohsah-uvin, Pathen deidol bangin amaho hi ajin nauva anathahson le chun pha lheh inte.
Ijeh-inem itile Christa min khohsah jal’a hungpot jeng ahiuvin, chidang namdangtea konin imacha akilah pouve.
Thutah a atohnau hi ikithopi theina diuva hite ho tobang hi ilem diu thil khoh tah ahi.
Houbung henga thu them khat kahinsun’in, ahinla alamkaiyuva pang nom Diotrephes chun ei nahsah pouve.
Hijeh a chu kahung le athilbol, achonna, eiseiset nauva thu gilou asei jouseu kasosal ding ahi; hicheng abol jong hi achim hih laiyin, sopite chu alhunsah dan lhunsah dia go ho geijin aja da nalaiyin, amaho chu Houbunga konin anodoh jenge.
Ngaitah, ase jom louvin, apha chubou jomin. Thilpha bol’a chu Pathena kon ahin, thilse bol’an vang Pathen amu loulai ahi.
Demetrius chu mi jousen aseiphan, thutah-in jong aseiphai; chule keihon jong ama kaseiphauvin, kahettohsah nau thutah ahidol nangin nahenai.
Nahenga hinsut ding tampi kanei vangin, lekhatwi le lekhamol maiya sut ding kadeipoi.
Nangma muloi ding kakinemin, chutengle kimaiton kamchengin kihou nau hi te.
Nachunga cham leng hen. Goldei jousen nasalam’ui. Goldeite chu amin cheh-in panin salamin.
Jacob naopa, Jesu Christa soh natong Jude chun, Pa Pathen ngailu jouse le Jesu Christa dinga kikouva kikheh khol ho henga;
Hepina le chamna chule ngailutna nachunguva hapunin pung hen.
Deitahte, nahenguva ineikhom cheh-u huhhingna thudol lekha hinsut kagot pettah-in khatvei mi thengte kipedohsa, tahsan thua napot tho diu deina tilkhouna joh a, hinsut ding khoh kasajotai.
Ijeh-inem itile eiho lah a hin hitobang thudol’a achung thu tan’a themmo chang dinga koisa Pathen helou mi phabep guh thimin ahung lut’uvin, amaho hin Pathenin eipeh-u lungsetna chu huhna lamin aheidoh-un, chule ipipu le i-Pakaiyu Jesu geiyin aseilep tauve.
Khatvei chu nahetsau hitajongle, Pakaiyin mipi chu Egypt’a kona ahuhdoh a, anichan naa atahsan lou jeh-uva asuh mang hel thudol hi nang ho kageldohsah kitnom nahiuve.
Atha neinau panmun tuh det louva, apanmun dalhaa Vantilte jeng jong aman, ni loupi chungnung ni le athuu tan dinga tonsot thihkhaova ahen’a, muthim lah a akoi ahi.
Hitobanga chu Sodom le Gomorrah chule akimvel dunga khopi ho, alam loutah a huh le jonthanhoi lam a kipeuva, japi hilchahna dinga tonsot meikouva kihalvam’a achung thuu kitan talen kimatsah chu geldohuvin.
Hitobang hin hite hon mudih lou anei jeh-un tahsa asuboh-un, Pathen thunei vaipohna asan dauvin, loupina chengse ataitom jiuve.
Vantil pipu Michael jengin bon Mose long chung thua Diabol to akinel chun taitoma houset ding, chule achung thu tan ding angam pon, “Pakaiyin nahouse hen,” atijoi.
Amaho hin ahettoh lou ataitom jiu ahin, gancha ho banga atichunguva hetna ho hin amaho asuhmang gamjoh ahitai.
Achung’u thu akhoh-e! Amaho Cain lampi kijot’a tohman duchatnaa Balaam lampia cheuva, Korah-in doumah abolnaa chu mangthah gam ahitauve.
Amaho hi kidei golvah nabolnauva nolna um ahiuvin, kiphalam louhel hel’in akideitouvin, amaho le amaho akive tup’un, twi kotlou meilhang huiyin alhoh lonle, chavang laiya thingga bei, nivei thia ajung geiya kibotdoh tobang ahiuve.
Twikhanglen twi kinongsuh kinong tou tobang, achonthang nau twiphon banga hung phondoh bep ahiuvin, muthim lhangkhal kiheh leiloi kikoipeh, ahsi vah thai ho tobang ahiuve.
Adam’a pat khang sagi lhinna, Enoch chun hite ho chung chang thudol’a hi gaothu anaseiyin, “Ven Pakai chu amitheng asang sang to hunga,
Mitin chunga thutanna abol ding, chule Pathen helouten a-Pathen hetlou jeh-uva athilbol anatoh chengseu le Pathen hephalou chonseten ama douna thuse asei jouseu themmo ahinchan ding ahi,” ati.
Amaho hi phunchel le seiset hat, alunggul lam cheh a kihei, akamsunguva ham, hoitho seival val sei, phatchom ding deina mi maiya kamthem le ahiuve.
Deitahte, nang hon vang tu masanga i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa solchahten aseisau thu ho chu geldoh jing jengun;
ajeh chu amahon naseipeh-un, “phat nu nung lam le Pathen ngaisah lou, alunggul lam jenga chon, mi jontai hatte hung sohdoh diu ahi,” atiuve.
Amaho hi loitum sem ho, tahsa hing mai, Lhagao nei lou ahiuve.
Deitahte, nang ho vang natahsan’u thengtah chunga chun kisadoh-un lang, Lhagao Thengin tao jingun;
Pathen mi-ngailutnaa kihong jinguvin, i-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa hepina jal’a napeh diu tonsot hinna chu kat jinguvin.
Kihol lel lung opkaina neiho chu hepiuvin.
Abang bang jong meikouva konin loidoh loiyun, huhhinguvin, abang jong kiphalam khen’a nahepi diu ahi; tahsaphe nen be-na ponsil nihchen geiyin theuvin.
Nakipal lhuh louna diuva nahongbit theiyu, aloupina masanga nolnabei le kipah thanom tah a napuilut theipau,
I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa jal’in, loupina le chungnun na thahat le thuneina jouse, phat um masang le tun, chule tonsot geiyin jong eihuhhingpau Pathen khatseh, amaa hijing jeng hen: Amen.
Thil hung sohvah ding ho, asohte hetsah dinga Pathenin Jesu Christa apeh a, a-Vantil asol’a asoh John henga ahetsah, Jesu Christa Thuphondoh chu,
Johnin amu chengse le Jesu Christa hettohsah thudol to Pathen Thu ahettohsah-e.
Hiche Themgao thuseidoh chengse hataha simphonga le ajahho chengse, asunga kisun nit ho chu anun nom’ui; ijeh-inem itile phat ahung naiye.
Johnin Asia gamsunga Houbung sagi henga; Lungsetna le cham nan unpiuvin, aum jing, asumsa chule ahung um dingpaa kon, alaltouna maiya lhagao sagi hoa kon,
hettohsah tahsan umpen, thinaa kona peng masapen, leiset leng jouse chunga vaihompaa konin. Eingailu’uva athisan jal’a ichonsetna jouseuva kona eisut lham’uva,
lenggam khat’a eisem doh-uva a-Pa Pathen kintheng bol dia Thempua eisemdoh pau, Ama chu loupina le vaihomna tonsot tonsot geiyin chang jing hen: Amen.
Ven, meilhang lah a ahunge, Mit jousen Ama amusoh keidiu; Ama teng’a sun ho geiyin jong amu diu, Ama jeh a leiset’a phungtin le namtinin Adip alai akidop diu ahi; hihen Amen.
Aum jing, aumsa, ahung um ding Hatchungnung Pakai Pahtenin, “Keima Alpha le Omega kahi,” ati.
Keima Jesu jal’a gim hesoh thotna le lenggam jeh le bolsetna jal’a nathoh khompiu, nasopiu John kahin, Jesu hettohsahna jal le Pathen thu jal’a Patmmos kisah twikol’a hi eikikoiya ahi.
Pakai nikho nin keima Lhagavin kana umtan, chuin kanung lama konin sumkon gin tobang ogin sangtah khat kajai;
hichun, “Nathilmu chu lekhabua sunin lang, Houbung sagi- Ephesus le Smyrna, Pergamum le Thyatira, Sardis le Philadelphia chule Laodicea henga thot’in” eiti.
Keijong kahenga thusei ogin chu vedin kakiheiyin, hitia kakiheinaa chun sana thaomei khom sagi kamui;
chule khomho lah a chun Mihem Chapa tobang khat, aponsil khophang te nia lenglhaa, a-opkonga sana khaopeh kivei,
aluchang le asam kelngaoi mul ban’a bang buhbang tobang, amit te ni meikong tobang hiya
akengto te ni chu, meilhum sunga kisoujolsa, sum-eng kinotval tobang ahin, chule a-ogin chu twi tamtah gin tobang ahi.
Akhut jet lama ahsi sagi achoiyin, akamsunga kon in hemto chamjam hemtah ahungdoh-in, chule amaivah chu sunlai nisa sat-ham pettah tobang ahi.
Ama kamu phat hin akhophang te ni bul’a kalhun, athi tobang in ka-umtai. Hichun aman akhut jet lamin eithamin, “Kicha hih-in, Keima akipatna le akichaina,
ahing jingpa, kanathin, ahinla ven, Keima tonsot tonsot’a dingin ka hing jinge; thina le thikhol khul kot-heh kaneiye.
Hijeh chun nathilmu chengse, aum ho hi le tu nung teng hung um ding ho hi sunin.
Kakhut jet lama ahsi sagi namu ho hi le sana thaomei khom sagi ho thuguh chu; ahsi sagi chu Houbung sagi sole ho ahiuvin, sana thaomei khomsagi chu Houbung sagi chu ahi.
“Ephesus Houbung solle henga chun hitin sunin: ‘Akhut jet lama ahsi sagi choiya, sana thaomei khom sagi lah a vah le chun hitin aseiye,
“Keiman nanatohjouse le thohgim thohda nathoh jouse kahei; solchah la hilouva solchah kihisah ho jong napatep’in, ajou nau namandoh-in, hiti hin migilou ho chu nathoh nom hih hel’e.
Nangman thoh hahsa chu Keim amin jal’in nathoh thoh jengin nalha dah deh sampoi.
Ahnla amasa na-ngailutna chu nalha tahjeh-in nachunga demna kaneiye.
Hijeh chun hoikoma kisep lhu nahim, geldoh-in, chule lung heiyin lang, natoh masah chengse chu tong kit’in; chutia lung nahei loule nahenga hung ing ting nathaomei khom chu akitunnaa kona kachon mang ding ahi.
Hijongle Nicolai mi ho natoh keiman kathet ho chu, nangin jong nathen, phatna hiche vang hi naneiye.
Angaina ding na neiyan Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei hi ngai hen. Galjouva chu Pathen honsunga keh hinthing ga chu neh dia kapeh ding ahi.
“Smyrna Houbung solle henga chun hitin sunin: ‘Akipatna le akichaina, thia hingkit chun hitin aseiye:
“Keiman nathohgim hesoh navaichat kahenai, ahinla nahaove; Juda midan a kiseiyuva hila hi-ngal lou, Satan kikhopna hungkon hon taitomna aneiyujong kahei.
Nahin thot gimna ding ho hi kicha hih hel’in. Ven, nang ho patepna dinga nalahuva abang bang Diabol’in songkul’a ahinkhum ding, ahivang nisom bou nathothgim diu ahi. Thina geiyin thot-in tahsanin, Keiman hinna lallukhuh kapeh ding nahi.
Angaina ding na neiyan Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei hi ngai hen. Galjouva chu thi ni nan asuh nat louding ahi.
“Pergamum Houbung solle henga chun thitin sunin: ‘Hemto chemjam hemtah neipan hitin aseiye:
“Keiman nachenna mun, Satan laltouna chu kahei; Kei dinga tahsan um, kadinga hettohsah pha Antipas atha laiyu nikhon jong Keiya um tahsan nadalha pon, kamin natuh det jinge; Antipas chu Satan chenna mun, nang ho lah a athau ah.
Ahivang in na chunga demna phabep kanei ye, ajeh chuIsreael chate masanga kipal lhuhna ding koiya, doilim semthu houna sa nehsah a, chule jonthanhoi patsah dinga go Balak hilchah a Balaam thuhil choiya mi phabep naneiye.
Hitobang hin nangin jong Nicolai mi ho thuhilchoiya mi phabep naneiye.
Hijeh chun lung heiyin, achutiloule nahenga kahungvah jel’a kakamsung chemjam them’a amaho chu kasat gam diu ahi.
Angaina ding na thuseina neiyan Houbung hohenga Lhagao thusei hi ngai hen. Galjouva chu selguh manna kapeh ding, chule che songval chunga chu minthan khat kijih ahi, akisanpa tilou koima ding in asimthei lou hel ding ahi.
“Thyatira Houbung solle henga chun hitin sunin: ‘Amit te ni meikou pah lah lah tobang, akengto te ni sum-eng kinotval tobang Pathen Chapan hitin aseiye, “Keiman natoh josue le na ngailut je, natahsan le nalhacha natoh, chujongle nathot hatje, natohna jouse amasa natohsanga aphatjoh kahenai.

Ahinla nachunga cemna kaneiye, ajeh chu Jezebel kithemgaosah nu chu nacham lhan, aman kasohte jonthanho lam ahil’in, doilim semthu houna sa nehsahdin ajol lhai.
Ken amanu chu along heina ding phat kapen, hila aman ajon thanhoinaa konin lung aheidehpoi,
Ven, keiman amanu hi jalkhun chng se na kanei ding, hiche jonthanghoi thilbol josue a kona lung ahie louvu le ajonpi chenrsen jong thoh gentei chungnung athoh diu ahi.
Thina kaman a achate jouse kathagam ding, chuteng le Houbung jousen lung ngaito chengse le lungthim josue hethei kahi ahet diu, chujong le anatoh dung jui cheh-uva amitakip kalethuh ding nahiuve.
Ahila Thyatira a um amoh cheng, hiche thuhil jop lou, Satan thugil kiti helou chengse nachunguva pohgih dang koibe peh pouvinge.
Ahin nanei sun’u chu kahung kahsen tuhdet jingun.
Chule galjouva, kanatoh ho achaina geiya nit jing chu namtin vaipi chunga thu neina kapeh ding,
aman amaho chu kelngaoi chin bang thih tenggol’a achin’a, leibel kivochip banga abol ding,
Keman ka-Paa kona kalah thu neina jal’a am chu Jingvalpa kapeh ding ahi.
Angaina ding na neiyan Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei hi ngaihen.
“Sardis Houbung solle henga hitin sunin: ‘Pathen Lhagao sagi le ahsi sagi neipan hitin aseiye, “Keiman nanatoh josue kahen, amin’a hinga nahin, athisa nahibouve.
Khangin lang hah jing jengin, amoh cheng, athikon ho dindetsah-in; ajeh chu ka-Pathen mitmua nanatoh ho achamkimsoh kamudoh poi.
Hichejeh chun atil’a itobanga nakisan’a, iti najah-em geldoh jingin, nit phan, lung heiyin. Hijeh a chu nahajing loule gucha banga kahung ding, itih phat le naheng kahinsuh ding nahet lou ding ahi.
Amvang aponsil’u kisuh nen lou mi phabep Sardis a aum’un, amaho hi ponbang vamleh sil’a Keito kilhon le ding ahiuve, ajeh chu amaho chutidia limtah ahiuve.
Galjouva chu amaho kivonna ponbang vamleh a kivon ding, chule hinna lekhabua kona Keiman amin kathai mang louding, ka-Pa angsung le a-Vantilte angsunga ama min chu kasei doh ding ahi.
Angaina ding na neiyan Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei hi ngai hen.
“Philadelphia Houbung solle henga thitin sunin: ‘Atheng le atahbeh, David kanglongheh neiya, aman ahon le koiman khah thei lou, aman akha le koiman hong thei lou, ama chun hitin aseiye.
“Keiman nanatoh jouse kahenai, ven, koman akha thei lou na-angasunga kot honsan kakoiye; tha them khat vang naneiyin, kathu nanit’in, kamin nasei leppoi.
Ven, Satan kikhpna pang ho phabep, acham cham’a Juda mi kihisah a, hila hilouhel, jousei ho chu kapehdoh ahin, ven keiman nang ka-ngailut hi ahetdoh theina diuva, na-anga sung, nakhophang bul’a boh khup’a chibai kahung bohsah ding ahiuve.
Nangin thoh hat dinga kasei nanit jeh a vannoi leiset pumpi chunga patepna ahung lhun’a, leiset chung cheng jouse akipatep phat teng le ken jong nang kahuhdoh ding nahi.
Kahungvah jet ding ahi, nalal lukhuh koman nalahpeh louna din nanei sun tuuhdet jingin.
Galjouva chu keiman ka-Pathen Houin khom’a kasem ding, hikoma kona chu potdoh louhel ding ahitan, achunga ka-Pathen min le ka-Pathen khopi Jerusalem thah, van’a ka-Pathen koma kona hung kitol lha, min kasut ding ahi.
Angaina ding na neiyan Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei hi ngaihen.
“Laodicea Houbung solle henga chun hitin sunin: ‘Amen, Hettohsahpa, Tahsan um, Atahbeh, Pathen thilsem jouse Bulpi chun hitin thu aseiye.
“Keiman nanatoh jouse kahen, vot la navot pon, sa la nasapoi. Navot le votngal’in lang, nasat le san gal le chun pha kasai.
Hitia hi lumheo bep nahiya, sa la san gal lou, vot la votngal lou nahijeh hin kakamsunga kona kakhondoh ding kon nahitai.
Ijeh-inem itil nangin, ‘Kahaove, sum kaneiye, imacha ngaichat kaneipoi,’ natin; nang tah chu adapen le khoto umpen, vaichatah le micho chu le sagohkeio nahilam nakihet poi.
Nahaona dia kakoma, kilha thengsel sana kichoh ding le, nakisil’a najamo kimudoh lou na dia nakhu jol ding pon bangle kichoh a, kho namu theina dia mitlou kichoh dinga kathu mop nahi.
Keiman kalungset chan kaphosal’a kaoblgimji ahi, hijeh chun tompan in lang lung heiyin.
Ven, kotkha bul’a ka dingin kakiu jinge, khattouvin ka-ogin ajah a kot eiho leh, ahenga kahung sung lhah a ama chu an kaneh khompia, aman jong eineh khompi ding ahi.
Galjouva chu ken jong kajoa ka-Pa to alaltouna katoukhom banga hi keito kalaltouna toukhomna thei thu kapeh ding ahi.
Angaina ding na neiyan Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei hi ngai hen!” tin aseiye” ati.
Hicheng jou hin vetan, van’a kot khat honsa um kamun, chule kajah masat pen ogin chu sumkon gin tobang ahin, kahenga thu aseiyin, “Hilama hung kaltouvin, hicheng nunga soh tei ding thil ho chu kavetsah ding nahi,” eiti.
Apettah chun Lhagaovin kaumtan, hichun ven, van’a laltouna khat akidon, laltouna chunga chun koiham khat atouve;
atoupa chu jasper song le sardis song bangin alange, chule laltouna kimvel’a chun lhagui aumin, emerald song tobangin akimui.
Laltouna kimvel’a chun laltouna som ni le li akidon, laltouna ho chunga chun ponbang jeng kisil’a alua sana lal lukhuh jeng kikhuh, upa som ni le li atouvui.
Laltouna a kon chun kolphe avah lap lap’in, o-agingin, van akithinge; laltouna maiya chun mei kou jing jeng thaomei sagi aumin, hiche ho chu Pathen Lhagao sagi ho ahiuve.
Lalouna maiya chun Crystal song tobang, phatvet banga kimu, Twikhanglen aumin, chule laltouna lailung le akimvel’a chun, anung le amaa amit jeng amit jeng dimset ganhing li aum’ui.
Ganhing masapen chu Phaisammeigeo tobang ahin, ganhing ni na chu Bongnou tobang ahin, ganhing thumna chun mihem mai tobang aneiyhin, gang hing li lhinna chu Muvanlai lengpet tobang ahi.
Ganhing li ho chun lhaving gup cheh aneiyun, akimvel le anung lam amite jeng ahiuve; chule sun le janin choldo louhel’in la asauvin: “Atheng, Atheng, Atheng, Pakai Pathen Hatchungnung ahin, Aumsa le aum jing chule ahung um ding,” atiuve.
Hiche ganhing li ho chun tonsot’a hing jing jeng, Laltouna kitousah Pa chu achoi-at’a, ajabol’uva chule athangvah tengu le,
upa som ni le li jong chu laltouna kitousah Pa angsunga chu lhujiuva, tonsot’a hing jing jeng Pa chu chibai abohuva, laltouna maiya chu alal lukhuh-u aselhah-uva, hitia asei yuva:
“Ka-Pakaiyu le ka-Pathenu, Nangma bou loupina le jabolna chule tha neina changa lomtah nahi; Ajeh chu nangin thil ijakai nasemin, Nangma deiya kisem doh a um ahiuve,” Atiuvin ahi.
Laltouna Toupa khut jetlama chun, asung lam apolam, alangtoa kisun, mohor sagi jen jinamkhum, lekhajol khat kamui.
Chuin Vantil hattah ogin sang tah a samphong lea, “Hiche lekhajol mohorkinam ho sut lhaa lham jou dinga lom chu koipen ham?” ti khat kamui.
Ahinla van’a hihen leiset’a hijongle, leiset noi geiyin lekhabu chu ahongdoh theiya le avetheiya aumtapoi.
Hichun lekhabu phong doh thei le avetheiya akimudoh lou phat’in hakan kakaptai.
Hichea chun upaho lah akhat’in kajah a, “Kap hih-in, ven, Juda phunga phaisameigeo, David Jung chu hiche lekhabu phongdoh ding le amaohor sagi chu lhamla didnga galjousa ahitai,’ eiti.
Hichun ganhing li ho le upahon aumkimve’u laltouna lailunga chun Kelngoinou kithatsa lheh lheh khat ding kamun, ki le mit sagi gi aneiye; chule hiche ho chu leiset chun gpumpia hung kisol lha Pathen Lhagao sagi ho ahiuve.
Ama chu ahingin laltouna Toupa khut jetlama konin lekhajol chu alai.
Alah phat’in ganhing li ho le upa som ni le li chu kelngoinou angsunga chun abohkhup cheh-uvin amaho khat cheh-in akhut’uva selangdah khat le sana sumlheng dung’ah, mithengte taona chu, gimnamtui bangin akichoi cheh-ui.
Amaho hin lathah khat asauvin: “Lekhabu kilah ding le Mohor ho lhamlha hong din nangbou nakilom’e; Ajeh chu nangma kithatsa nahin, Nathisan’a phungtin le paotin tanga kon Mitin mitanga kona Pathen mi hi dinga nachohdohsa ahitan,
Nangin amaho chu i-Pathenu dia Thempu Lenggam’a nasemdoh ahitan, Hijeh a chu leiset chunga lengvai aph diu ahi,” atiuve.
Hichun kagah vet leh laltouna le ganhing ho chule upaho kemvel’a ding, Vantil tampi ogin kajan, amaho chu ajat sangsom jet tamtah sang jat alhinguve.
Amaho hin ogin sangtah-in aseiyun: “Akithatsa Kelngoinou chu Boltheina tha, haona, thahat, Jabolna, loupina chule Vahchoina kisan dinga lomtah ahi,” atiuve.
Chuin van, leiset chung, leiset noiya, Twikhanglen sunga, thilsem kiti jousen aseiyu kajah chu: “Laltouna chung Toupa le Kelngoinou, Tonsot tonsot geiyin vahchoina le choi-atna, Lopina le thunei vaipohna chang jing hen,” kiti ahi.
Hitah chun ganhing li hon, “Amen,” atiuvin, upa chengsen jong abohkhup’un chibai abohtauve.
Keima Kelngoinou chun mohor sagi ho lah a khat alhap lhah a ahondoh kamun, chule ganhing li lah a khat’in ogin sangtah a asap’a, “Hungin,” ati kajai.
Hijeh chun vetemin, sakol kang khat kamun, achunga toupan gophel khat achoiyin, ama chu lallukhuh khat apeuvin, galjouva jousoh peh din akondohtai.
Mohor ni na alhap’a ahondoh phat’in ganhing ni nan, “Hungin,” ati kajan ahi.
Hichun sakol chom, asan khat ahungdoh-in, achunga toupa chun leiset chung chamna alah manga, mihem khat le khat kithatona thu aneina akipen, chemjam lentah khat jong apeuve.
Mohor thumna alhap’a ahondoh paht’in, ganhing thum lhin nan, “Hungin,” ati kajai. Hichun vetemin, sakolvom khat kamun, achunga toupan thil tena khat achoiye.
Hichun ganhing li ho lah a kona hung ging tobanga kajah ogin khat chun, “Suhlou chang khai khat’in denarii khat amanin, sakolchang khai thumin denarii khat aman’e; hijongle thao le lengpitwi chu suboh hih-in,” ati.
Mohor li na alhap’a ahondoh phat’in ganhing li lhin nan, “Hungin” ati kajai.
Hichun vetemin, sakol engdang khat kamun, achunga toupa min chu “Thina” ahin, chule thikhol khul’in anung ahinjuipeh-e. Chemjam le gilkel, gamna hise chule leiset gamsaho mangchaa, leiset hop lia hop khat thatgam dinga thahat kipe ahiuve.
Mohor nga lhin na alhap’a ahondoh phat’in, maicham phung noiya chun Pathen thujeh le nettoh sahna jal’a kithatsa lhagao ho kamui.
Amaho chun going tah-in asamun, “Vo pipu, Atheng le kitah, leiset chung chengte chunga keiho phulaa thutan louva itih chan um ding nahim?” atiuve.
Amaho khat cheh chu poncho bangle apeuvin, asohchanpi chengseu le adopiteu, upaho kitha banga kithat ding ho akimsoh kahsea chom khat kho-ngai dingin akiseipeh tauve.
Mohor gupna chu alhap’a ahondoh phat’in ling nasatah kihot kamun, nichang khaodippon vom bangin avomtan lhachang pumpi jong thisan bangin asan jenge;
van’a ahsite chu huipi hattah-in theichang phung amut’a, apul lhah bangin tol’a apul lhatai.
Chule-van chu lekhajol kijel mang bangin amanghel tan, mol le lhang jose, twikol gam jouse pumin aumna mun cheh a koninakichon mangtauve.
Hichun leiset leng jouse le milen milalte, sepai lamkai pipu ho, mihao hole thahat ho, soh jouse le chamlhat ho geiyin songko dung le mol dunga songpiho khi kah dunga akiseltauve.
Amaho hin mol le lhang chule songpiho jah a, “Nei opkhum” un lang, laltouna Toupa maikoh le Kelngoinou lungsatnaa konin neisel mangun;
ajeh chu alungham nau nikho nasatah ahung lhungtan, hichea pang jou dding koi ham?” atiuve.
Hiche nung hin leiset chung le Twikhanglen chunga chule thingphung khat cha chunga jong huianun louhelna dinga, leiset ning lia kon huipi tuh tang din, leiset ning lia Vantil li adin kamui.
Chuin Pathen hing jing mohor choiya, niso lama hung kaltou Vantil chom khat kamun, ama chun going tahin asamin, leiset le Twikhanglen suhsetna dinga thu kipe Vantil li ho jah a chun,
“Keihon i-Pathenu sohte chalpanga melchihna mohor kanamsoh kahseuvin leiset le Twikhanglen chule thingphung ho hi suse hih-un,” ati.
Chuin mohor kinamsa mijat kajah le, Israel phungtin’a kona mohor kinamsa chengse chu sang jakhat le sangsom li le sang li alhing’e.
Judah phunga kona mohor kinamsa sangsom le sang ni, Reuben phunga kona sangsom le sangni, Gad phunga kona sangsom le sang ni,
Asher phunga kona sangsom le sang ni, Naphtali phunga kona sangsom le sang ni, Manasseh phunga kona sangsom le sang ni,
Simeon phunga kona sangsom le sang ni, Issachar phunga kona sangsom le sang ni,
Zebulun phunga kona sangsom le sang ni, Joseph phunga kona sangsom le sang ni, Benjamin phunga kona sang som le sang ni.
Hicheng nung hin mipi kihon lel lul jeng, simjou lou, chitin namtin le phung tin’a kon, mitin mitang le paotin paotanga kon, abang jenga kivon’a, akhut’uva lusu na kichoiya, laltouna masanga, kelngoinou angsunga ding kamui.
Amahon ogingtah-in asam’un: “Hunhingna chu laltouna Toupa, I-Pathenu le Kelngoinouva ahi,” atiuve.
Laltouna le upaho chule ganhing li ho kimvel’a ding jing Vantil jouse, laltouna masanga chun amaiyu tol’a asulut’uvin Pathen alhaiyun,
asei cheh-un: “Amen, phattheina le loupina, Chihna, thangvahna jousea, jabolna Thuhatna thu neina jouse tonsot tonsot geiya I-Pathen’uva ahijinge, Amen,” atiiuve.
Hichea hin upa ho lah a khat’in eihin houvin kajah a, “Hiche ponabng jenga kivon ho hi koi hiuva, hoiya hungkon hiuvam?” tin eidonge.
Kenjong ajah a, “KaPakai nangin nahenai,” kati. Chuin aman kajah a, “Hite ho hi bolgen thei hesoh hahsa hinthoh doh a Kelngoinou thisan’a avon jouseu kisop bang ho vhu ahiuve.
Hijeh a chu Pathen laltouna masanga um’iva, asun ajan’a a-Houin sunga lhacha kin abol’u ahi; chule laltouna Toupa khun amaho hi ponbuh kison khum banga alekhu diu ahi.
Amahon gilkel dangchah athoh kit louhel diu, nisan jong san gtalou diu, asa jong thoh lou iddng ahiuve.
Ijeh-inem itile laltouna lailunga um Kelngoinou khu achinguva pang, hintwi nah dunga apuihoi le ding, Pathenin amit lhi jouseu atheh hulsoh ding ahi,” ati.
Kelngoinouvin mohor sagi na alhap’a ahondoh phat’in van chunga nidan keh khat set athip chet’e.
Hichun Pathen masanga ding jing Vantil sagi chu kamun, amaho chu summon sagi apeuve.
Chuin gimnamtui halna sana lhengkong khat choiya, Vantil chom khat ahungin maicham phunga chun adinge. Ama chu, mithengte taona belap peh dinga laltouna mai, maicham phunga chu todoh dingin, gimnamtui tampi apeuve.
Hichun Vantil khut’a konin gimnamtui khu chu mithengte taona kilhonin Pathen angsunga akikhotoutai.
Chuin Vantil’in gimnamtui halna lhengkong chu alan, maicham phunga mei-al chu aham dimin, leiset chunga athe lhah le, van aginglul lul jengin, ogin akithongin, kol aphen, ling akihottai.
Sumkon sagi choi Vantil sagi ho chu sumkon mut din akigotauve.
